Adapting foundation models under resource budgets relies heavily on Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), with LoRA being a standard modular solution. However, LoRA suffers from spectral interference. Low-rank updates often concentrate energy on the leading singular directions of pretrained weights, perturbing general capabilities and causing catastrophic forgetting and fragile multi-adapter merging. To resolve this, we propose HiP-LoRA, a spectrum-aware adaptation framework. Utilizing the cached singular value decomposition (SVD) of pretrained layers, HiP-LoRA decomposes updates into two channels: a principal channel within the dominant singular subspace, and a residual low-rank channel in the orthogonal complement. A singular-value-weighted stability budget on the principal channel continuously balances pretrained behavior preservation with task-specific plasticity. Experiments on Llama-3.1-8B demonstrate that under matched budgets, HiP-LoRA drastically reduces pretraining degradation and multi-adapter MergeFail, robustly outperforming baselines in interference-sensitive tasks like continual tuning and knowledge editing.

item.title: Sharpening Lightweight Models for Generalized Polyp Segmentation: A Boundary Guided Distillation from Foundation Models
item.author: Shivanshu Agnihotri, Snehashis Majhi, Deepak Ranjan Nayak
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为LiteBounD的轻量级分割框架，用于将多个视觉基础模型的互补语义和结构先验知识蒸馏到紧凑的分割骨干网络中，以实现精确的息肉分割。

背景: 息肉分割对于早期结直肠癌检测和预防至关重要，但面临边界弱、外观变化大和标注数据有限等挑战。轻量级模型如U-Net、U-Net++和PraNet虽然具有临床部署的实用性，但难以捕捉复杂息肉区域所需的丰富语义和结构线索。而大型视觉基础模型虽然表现出强大的泛化能力，但由于领域不匹配、边界敏感度不足和高计算成本，难以有效迁移到息肉分割任务中。

目的: 为了弥合轻量级模型与大型视觉基础模型之间的差距，提出了一种轻量级边界引导蒸馏框架，将多个VFMs的互补语义和结构先验知识转移到紧凑的分割骨干网络中。

方法: LiteBounD框架包含三个主要创新点：1) 双路径蒸馏机制，用于解耦语义和边界感知表示；2) 频率感知对齐策略，分别监督低频全局语义和高频边界细节；3) 边界感知解码器，将多尺度编码器特征与蒸馏的丰富语义边界信息融合，以实现精确分割。

主要发现: 在Kvasir-SEG、CVC-ClinicDB等已见数据集和ColonDB、CVC-300、ETIS等未见数据集上的广泛实验表明，LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use。

结论: LiteBounD在保持实时临床使用所需效率的同时，显著优于其轻量级基线，并达到了与最先进方法相当的性能。

翻译: 摘要：自动息肉分割对于早期结直肠癌检测和预防至关重要，但由于边界弱、外观变化大和标注数据有限，仍然具有挑战性。U-Net、U-Net++和PraNet等轻量级分割模型为临床部署提供了实用的效率，但在捕捉复杂息肉区域所需的丰富语义和结构线索方面存在困难。相比之下，包括SAM、OneFormer、Mask2Former和DINOv2在内的大型视觉基础模型表现出强大的泛化能力，但由于领域不匹配、边界敏感度不足和高计算成本，难以迁移到息肉分割任务中。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了LiteBounD，一种轻量级边界引导蒸馏框架，它将多个VFMs的互补语义和结构先验知识转移到紧凑的分割骨干网络中。LiteBounD引入了(i)一种双路径蒸馏机制，用于解耦语义和边界感知表示；(ii)一种频率感知对齐策略，分别监督低频全局语义和高频边界细节；(iii)一种边界感知解码器，将多尺度编码器特征与蒸馏的丰富语义边界信息融合，以实现精确分割。在Kvasir-SEG、CVC-ClinicDB等已见数据集和ColonDB、CVC-300、ETIS等未见数据集上的广泛实验表明，LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use。

Abstract

Automated polyp segmentation is critical for early colorectal cancer detection and its prevention, yet remains challenging due to weak boundaries, large appearance variations, and limited annotated data. Lightweight segmentation models such as U-Net, U-Net++, and PraNet offer practical efficiency for clinical deployment but struggle to capture the rich semantic and structural cues required for accurate delineation of complex polyp regions. In contrast, large Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), including SAM, OneFormer, Mask2Former, and DINOv2, exhibit strong generalization but transfer poorly to polyp segmentation due to domain mismatch, insufficient boundary sensitivity, and high computational cost. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{\textbf{LiteBounD}, a \underline{Li}gh\underline{t}w\underline{e}ight \underline{Boun}dary-guided \underline{D}istillation} framework that transfers complementary semantic and structural priors from multiple VFMs into compact segmentation backbones. LiteBounD introduces (i) a dual-path distillation mechanism that disentangles semantic and boundary-aware representations, (ii) a frequency-aware alignment strategy that supervises low-frequency global semantics and high-frequency boundary details separately, and (iii) a boundary-aware decoder that fuses multi-scale encoder features with distilled semantically rich boundary information for precise segmentation. Extensive experiments on both seen (Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicDB) and unseen (ColonDB, CVC-300, ETIS) datasets demonstrate that LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use. Our code is available at https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD.

item.title: Spatiotemporal Sycophancy: Negation-Based Gaslighting in Video Large Language Models
item.author: Ziyao Tang, Pengkun Jiao, Bin Zhu, Huiyan Qi, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了视频大语言模型在对话交互中的鲁棒性问题，特别是针对基于否定引导的煤气灯效应的脆弱性。

背景: 视频大语言模型在视频理解任务中表现出色，但它们在对话交互中的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 识别并研究视频大语言模型在基于否定引导的煤气灯效应下的失败模式，即模型在用户反馈的误导下撤回最初正确且基于视觉的判断。

方法: 提出了一个基于否定引导的煤气灯效应评估框架，并引入了GasVideo-1000基准数据集，用于测试视频大语言模型在具有清晰视觉基础和时间推理要求下的表现。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，即使基线性能强大的模型，也普遍且严重地容易受到基于否定引导的煤气灯效应的影响。虽然提示级的基础约束可以在一定程度上缓解这种行为，但它们并不能可靠地防止幻觉性解释或信念反转。

结论: 当前的Vid-LLMs缺乏在对抗性对话反馈下维持基于时空信念的鲁棒机制。

翻译: 视频大语言模型在视频理解任务中表现出色，但在对话交互中的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索。本文识别了时空煤气灯效应，这是一种失败模式，即Vid-LLMs在基于否定的煤气灯效应下撤回最初正确、基于视觉的判断并迎合误导性用户反馈。模型经常编造不支持的时空解释来证明不正确的修订。为了系统研究这一现象，我们提出了一个基于否定的煤气灯效应评估框架，并引入了GasVideo-1000基准数据集，该数据集旨在通过清晰的视觉基础和时间推理要求来探测时空煤气灯效应。我们在各种视频理解任务上评估了广泛的最新开源和专有Vid-LLMs。大量实验表明，对基于否定的煤气灯效应的脆弱性普遍且严重，即使在基线性能强大的模型中也是如此。虽然提示级基础约束可以在一定程度上缓解这种行为，但它们并不能可靠地防止幻觉性解释或信念反转。我们的结果表明，当前的Vid-LLMs缺乏在对抗性对话反馈下维持基于时空信念的鲁棒机制。

Abstract

Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in video understanding tasks, yet their robustness under conversational interaction remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we identify spatiotemporal sycophancy, a failure mode in which Vid-LLMs retract initially correct, visually grounded judgments and conform to misleading user feedback under negation-based gaslighting. Rather than merely changing their answers, the models often fabricate unsupported temporal or spatial explanations to justify incorrect revisions. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we propose a negation-based gaslighting evaluation framework and introduce GasVideo-1000, a curated benchmark designed to probe spatiotemporal sycophancy with clear visual grounding and temporal reasoning requirements. We evaluate a broad range of state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary Vid-LLMs across diverse video understanding tasks. Extensive experiments reveal that vulnerability to negation-based gaslighting is pervasive and severe, even among models with strong baseline performance. While prompt-level grounding constraints can partially mitigate this behavior, they do not reliably prevent hallucinated justifications or belief reversal. Our results indicate that current Vid-LLMs lack robust mechanisms for maintaining grounded spatiotemporal beliefs under adversarial conversational feedback.

item.title: Latent Preference Modeling for Cross-Session Personalized Tool Calling
item.author: Yejin Yoon, Minseo Kim, Taeuk Kim
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了MPT基准和PRefine方法，旨在解决LLM代理在工具调用中因用户请求细节缺失导致的个性化挑战。

背景: 用户在向基于LLM的代理发出请求时经常遗漏关键细节，导致工具使用的输入规格不足。

目的: 引入MPT基准（包含265个多会话对话）以研究偏好回忆、偏好诱导和偏好转移三个挑战，并提出PRefine方法以提升工具调用准确性。

方法: PRefine是一种测试时记忆增强方法，将用户偏好表示为不断演变的假设。通过生成-验证-细化循环，从历史记录中提取可重用的约束。

主要发现: PRefine方法仅使用全历史提示所需1.24%的token，显著提高了工具调用准确性。

结论: 代理系统中的鲁棒个性化依赖于能够捕捉用户选择背后原因的内存，而不仅仅是选择本身。

翻译: 用户经常在向基于LLM的代理发出的请求中遗漏关键细节，导致工具使用的输入规格不足。这是工具增强代理的一个基本挑战，因为API执行通常需要完整的参数，这凸显了对个性化工具调用的需求。为了研究这个问题，我们介绍了MPT，这是一个包含265个多会话对话的基准，涵盖了三个挑战：偏好回忆、偏好诱导和偏好转移。我们还提出了PRefine，一种测试时记忆增强方法，将用户偏好表示为不断演变的假设。通过生成-验证-细化循环，它从历史记录中提取可重用的约束，并提高了工具调用准确性，同时仅使用了全历史提示所需1.24%的token。这些结果表明，代理系统中的鲁棒个性化依赖于能够捕捉用户选择背后原因的内存，而不仅仅是选择本身。

Abstract

Users often omit essential details in their requests to LLM-based agents, resulting in under-specified inputs for tool use. This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem, we introduce MPT, a benchmark comprising 265 multi-session dialogues that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Preference Induction, and Preference Transfer. We also propose PRefine, a test-time memory-augmented method that represents user preferences as evolving hypotheses. Through a generate--verify--refine loop, it extracts reusable constraints from history and improves tool-calling accuracy while using only 1.24% of the tokens required by full-history prompting. These results indicate that robust personalization in agentic systems depends on memory that captures the reasons behind user choices, not just the choices themselves.

item.title: Beyond Binary Contrast: Modeling Continuous Skeleton Action Spaces with Transitional Anchors
item.author: Yingjie Feng, Yi Wang, Jiaze Wang, Anfeng Liu, Zhuotao Tian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TranCLR是一个基于过渡锚点的对比学习框架，用于捕捉动作空间的连续几何结构，通过ATAC和MGMC机制增强动作连续性的感知和表示空间的校准。

背景: 现有的基于骨架的动作识别方法依赖于二元对比目标，忽略了人类运动的内在连续性，导致特征聚类碎片化和类边界僵硬。

目的: 为了解决现有方法忽略动作内在连续性的问题，提出TranCLR框架以捕捉动作空间的连续几何结构。

方法: 提出了动作过渡锚点构建（ATAC）机制，显式建模过渡状态的几何结构；引入多级几何流形校准（MGMC）机制，自适应校准跨多个连续性层级的动作流形。

主要发现: 在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD数据集上的广泛实验表明，TranCLR实现了优越的准确性和校准性能，有效学习了连续且具有不确定性感知的骨架表示。

结论: TranCLR通过显式建模过渡状态和自适应校准流形，显著提升了骨架动作识别中动作连续性的感知能力，生成了更平滑且更具判别力的表示空间。

翻译: 自监督对比学习已成为基于骨架的动作识别的一种强大范式，通过在嵌入空间中强制一致性。然而，现有方法依赖于二元对比目标，忽略了人类运动的内在连续性，导致特征聚类碎片化和类边界僵硬。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了TranCLR，一个基于过渡锚点的对比学习框架，用于捕捉动作空间的连续几何结构。具体而言，所提出的动作过渡锚点构建（ATAC）显式建模了过渡状态的几何结构，以增强模型对运动连续性的感知。基于这些锚点，引入了多级几何流形校准（MGMC）机制，以自适应地校准跨多个连续性层级的动作流形，从而产生更平滑且更具判别力的表示空间。在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD数据集上的广泛实验表明，TranCLR实现了优越的准确性和校准性能，有效地学习了连续且具有不确定性感知的骨架表示。代码可在https://github.com/Philchieh/TranCLR获取。

Abstract

Self-supervised contrastive learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for skeleton-based action recognition by enforcing consistency in the embedding space. However, existing methods rely on binary contrastive objectives that overlook the intrinsic continuity of human motion, resulting in fragmented feature clusters and rigid class boundaries. To address these limitations, we propose TranCLR, a Transitional anchor-based Contrastive Learning framework that captures the continuous geometry of the action space. Specifically, the proposed Action Transitional Anchor Construction (ATAC) explicitly models the geometric structure of transitional states to enhance the model's perception of motion continuity. Building upon these anchors, a Multi-Level Geometric Manifold Calibration (MGMC) mechanism is introduced to adaptively calibrate the action manifold across multiple levels of continuity, yielding a smoother and more discriminative representation space. Extensive experiments on the NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120 and PKU-MMD datasets demonstrate that TranCLR achieves superior accuracy and calibration performance, effectively learning continuous and uncertainty-aware skeleton representations. The code is available at https://github.com/Philchieh/TranCLR.

item.title: Prompting Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Ship Instance Segmentation in SAR Imagery
item.author: Islam Mansour, Francescopaolo Sica, Michael Schmitt
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于YOLOv11和SAM2的零样本船舶实例分割方法，通过检测器定位船舶并提示SAM2生成实例掩码，无需像素级标注。

背景: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）在海上监视中发挥关键作用，但深度学习在SAR分析中受限于缺乏像素级标注。

目的: 探索通用视觉基础模型如何实现SAR图像中的零样本船舶实例分割，消除对像素级监督的需求。

方法: 使用在开放SAR数据集上训练的YOLOv11检测器定位船舶，然后提示Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2)生成实例掩码，无需任何掩码标注。

主要发现: 与依赖微调或适配器的先前SAM-based SAR方法不同，SAR训练检测器的空间约束能有效正则化基础模型预测；该方法部分缓解了光学-SAR领域差距；在SSDD基准测试中达到0.637的平均IoU（为全监督基线的89%）和89.2%的船舶检测率。

结论: 该方法证明了通过基础模型驱动的SAR图像理解，存在一条可扩展且标注高效的路径。

翻译: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）在海上监视中发挥着关键作用，然而用于SAR分析的深度学习受限于缺乏像素级标注。本文探讨了通用视觉基础模型如何实现SAR图像中的零样本船舶实例分割，消除了对像素级监督的需求。一种基于YOLOv11的检测器在开放SAR数据集上训练，通过边界框定位船舶，然后提示Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2)生成实例掩码，无需任何掩码标注。与依赖微调或适配器的先前SAM-based SAR方法不同，我们的方法表明SAR训练检测器的空间约束能有效正则化基础模型预测。该设计部分缓解了光学-SAR领域差距，并使下游应用成为可能，如船舶分类、尺寸估计和尾流分析。在SSDD基准测试上的实验实现了0.637的平均IoU（为全监督基线的89%）和89.2%的船舶检测率，证实了通过基础模型驱动的SAR图像理解，存在一条可扩展且标注高效的路径。

Abstract

Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) plays a critical role in maritime surveillance, yet deep learning for SAR analysis is limited by the lack of pixel-level annotations. This paper explores how general-purpose vision foundation models can enable zero-shot ship instance segmentation in SAR imagery, eliminating the need for pixel-level supervision. A YOLOv11-based detector trained on open SAR datasets localizes ships via bounding boxes, which then prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to produce instance masks without any mask annotations. Unlike prior SAM-based SAR approaches that rely on fine tuning or adapters, our method demonstrates that spatial constraints from a SAR-trained detector alone can effectively regularize foundation model predictions. This design partially mitigates the optical-SAR domain gap and enables downstream applications such as vessel classification, size estimation, and wake analysis. Experiments on the SSDD benchmark achieve a mean IoU of 0.637 (89% of a fully supervised baseline) with an overall ship detection rate of 89.2%, confirming a scalable, annotation-efficient pathway toward foundation-model-driven SAR image understanding.

item.title: ZSG-IAD: A Multimodal Framework for Zero-Shot Grounded Industrial Anomaly Detection
item.author: Qiuhui Chen, Jiaxiang Song, Shuai Tan, Weimin Zhong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ZSG-IAD是一个用于零样本 grounded 工业异常检测的多模态视觉语言框架。

背景: 现有的基于深度学习的工业异常检测器通常表现为黑盒，难以用物理上有意义的缺陷证据来证明决策的合理性。

目的: 提出ZSG-IAD框架，旨在实现零样本 grounded 工业异常检测，生成结构化异常报告和像素级异常掩码。

方法: 引入语言引导的双跳 grounding 模块，利用异常相关句子选择证据类潜在槽位，并通过通道空间门控和轻量解码器生成细粒度掩码；同时应用可执行规则 GRPO 以提高可靠性。

主要发现: 在多个工业异常基准测试中表现出强大的零样本性能，相比先前方法具有更透明和物理上可验证的解释。

结论: ZSG-IAD 提供了更透明、物理上可验证的解释，并将在未来发布代码和注释以支持可信工业异常检测系统的研究。

翻译: 基于深度学习的工业异常检测器通常表现为黑盒，使得难以用物理上有意义的缺陷证据来证明决策的合理性。我们提出了ZSG-IAD，一个用于零样本 grounded 工业异常检测的多模态视觉语言框架。给定RGB图像、传感器图像和3D点云，ZSG-IAD生成结构化异常报告和像素级异常掩码。ZSG-IAD引入了一种语言引导的双跳 grounding 模块：（1）异常相关句子从多模态特征中蒸馏出证据类潜在槽位，产生粗略的空间支持；（2）选定的槽位通过通道空间门控和轻量解码器调节特征图，以产生细粒度掩码。为了提高可靠性，我们进一步应用可执行规则 GRPO 和可验证奖励来促进结构化输出、异常区域一致性和推理结论的一致性。在多个工业异常基准测试中的实验表明，与先前方法相比，具有更强的零样本性能和更透明、物理上可验证的解释。我们将发布代码和注释以支持未来关于可信工业异常检测系统的研究。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有工业异常检测系统是“黑盒”，难以提供物理上有意义的缺陷证据和精确定位的问题。在现实中，工业质检需要可追溯的决策，而通用模型难以描述细微缺陷，且自由生成的报告缺乏标准化格式，导致难以验证。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者思考是因为现有工业检测系统是黑盒，通用模型难以处理非语义细粒度异常且描述模糊。设计上采用“冻结编码器+轻量级适配器”架构，利用CSS模块增强多模态交互，通过Slot Attention提取证据标记，并引入语言引导的两跳grounding头将文本映射到像素级掩码，最后用GRPO优化报告一致性。借鉴了多模态IAD基准（如MVTec AD）、grounded language-image pretraining以及GRPO算法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是解决工业异常检测中“黑盒”问题，通过结合多模态输入与结构化报告生成，提供可解释、可验证的物理证据，实现零样本检测。整体实现流程包括：首先利用冻结的编码器提取RGB、传感器和3D点云特征，并通过通道-空间交换和轻量级适配器增强特征交互与对齐；接着利用槽注意力机制从2D特征中提取区域感知的潜在证据令牌；最后通过语言引导的两跳检测-区域定位模块，将文本描述转化为像素级异常掩码，并生成结构化的异常报告。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 关键创新点包括：构建了一个融合RGB、传感器图像和3D点云的多模态框架；引入了语言引导的两跳grounding机制，将文本描述与像素级掩码关联；以及采用可执行规则GRPO强化学习来确保报告的结构化和逻辑一致性。相比之前的工作，该框架不同之处在于：它不像通用视觉语言模型那样产生模糊或未grounded的描述，也不像传统工业异常检测系统那样仅输出黑盒分数；而是能生成可审计的结构化报告和像素级定位，实现了跨模态证据的联合解释。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个多模态框架 ZSG-IAD，用于零样本 grounded 工业异常检测，能够从 RGB、传感器和 3D 数据中生成结构化报告和像素级掩码，实现可解释的检测。

Abstract

Deep learning-based industrial anomaly detectors often behave as black boxes, making it hard to justify decisions with physically meaningful defect evidence. We propose ZSG-IAD, a multimodal vision-language framework for zero-shot grounded industrial anomaly detection. Given RGB images, sensor images, and 3D point clouds, ZSG-IAD generates structured anomaly reports and pixel-level anomaly masks. ZSG-IAD introduces a language-guided two-hop grounding module: (1) anomaly-related sentences select evidence-like latent slots distilled from multimodal features, yielding coarse spatial support; (2) selected slots modulate feature maps via channel-spatial gating and a lightweight decoder to produce fine-grained masks. To improve reliability, we further apply Executable-Rule GRPO with verifiable rewards to promote structured outputs, anomaly-region consistency, and reasoning-conclusion coherence. Experiments across multiple industrial anomaly benchmarks show strong zero-shot performance and more transparent, physically grounded explanations than prior methods. We will release code and annotations to support future research on trustworthy industrial anomaly detection systems.

item.title: DifFoundMAD: Foundation Models meet Differential Morphing Attack Detection
item.author: Lazaro J. Gonzalez-Soler, André Dörsch, Christian Rathgeb, Christoph Busch
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为DifFoundMAD的参数高效D-MAD框架，利用视觉基础模型的泛化能力来捕捉疑似变形图像与实时捕获图像之间的差异。

背景: 传统的D-MAD系统通常依赖人脸识别嵌入或手工制作的特征差异，而本文提出的方法通过用从基础模型中提取的嵌入替换底层表示空间，遵循标准微分范式。

目的: 通过结合轻量级微调与类别平衡优化，更新仅一小部分参数，同时保留底层基础模型的丰富表示先验。

方法: DifFoundMAD框架利用视觉基础模型的泛化能力，在标准微分范式下，用基础模型提取的嵌入替换传统方法中使用的底层表示空间。

主要发现: 在标准D-MAD基准测试的广泛跨数据库评估中，DifFoundMAD在边境控制等操作部署所需的严格安全级别上实现了持续改进，将当前最先进系统的错误率从6.16%降低至2.17%。

结论: DifFoundMAD在保持基础模型丰富表示先验的同时，通过参数高效更新，在严格安全级别下显著降低了错误率，优于现有最先进系统。

翻译: 本文介绍了一种名为DifFoundMAD的参数高效D-MAD框架，利用视觉基础模型的泛化能力来捕捉疑似变形图像与实时捕获图像之间的差异。与依赖人脸识别嵌入或手工制作特征差异的传统D-MAD系统不同，DifFoundMAD遵循标准微分范式，同时用从基础模型中提取的嵌入替换底层表示空间。通过结合轻量级微调与类别平衡优化，该方法仅更新一小部分参数，同时保留了底层基础模型的丰富表示先验。在标准D-MAD基准测试的广泛跨数据库评估中，DifFoundMAD在边境控制等操作部署所需的严格安全级别上实现了持续改进，将当前最先进系统的错误率从6.16%降低至2.17%。

Abstract

In this work, we introduce DifFoundMAD, a parameter-efficient D-MAD framework that exploits the generalisation capabilities of vision foundation models (FM) to capture discrepancies between suspected morphs and live capture images. In contrast to conventional D-MAD systems that rely on face recognition embeddings or handcrafted feature differences, DifFoundMAD follows the standard differential paradigm while replacing the underlying representation space with embeddings extracted from FMs. By combining lightweight finetuning with class-balanced optimisation, the proposed method updates only a small subset of parameters while preserving the rich representational priors of the underlying FMs. Extensive cross-database evaluations on standard D-MAD benchmarks demonstrate that DifFoundMAD achieves consistent improvements over state-of-the-art systems, particularly at the strict security levels required in operational deployments such as border control: The error rates reported in the current state-of-the-art were reduced from 6.16% to 2.17% for high-security levels using DifFoundMAD.

item.title: Modeling Multiple Support Strategies within a Single Turn for Emotional Support Conversations
item.author: Jie Zhu, Huaixia Dou, Junhui Li, Lifan Guo, Feng Chen, Jinsong Su, Chi Zhang, Fang Kong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文重新审视了情感支持对话任务，将其定义为多策略话语生成，即每个话语可能包含一个或多个策略-回复对。

背景: 先前的工作通常假设每个支持者的回合对应单一策略，但现实中的支持性交流往往涉及单个话语中的多个策略。

目的: 通过将情感支持对话任务重新定义为多策略话语生成，以更好地模拟现实中的支持性交流。

方法: 提出了两种生成方法：All-in-One，在单次解码步骤中预测所有策略-回复对；以及One-by-One，迭代生成策略-回复对直到完成。这两种方法都进一步增强了由强化学习引导的认知推理，以改善策略选择和回复组合。

主要发现: 在ESConv数据集上评估结果显示，我们的方法有效地对多策略话语进行了建模，并提高了支持质量和对话成功率。

结论: 这项工作提供了首个系统的实证证据，表明允许单个话语中包含多个支持策略不仅可行，而且对情感支持对话有益。

翻译: 情感支持对话旨在帮助经历痛苦的个人生成共情和支持性对话。虽然先前的工作通常假设每个支持者的回合对应单一策略，但现实中的支持性交流往往涉及单个话语中的多个策略。在本文中，我们通过将其定义为多策略话语生成来重新审视情感支持对话任务，其中每个话语可能包含一个或多个策略-回复对。我们提出了两种生成方法：All-in-One，在单次解码步骤中预测所有策略-回复对；以及One-by-One，迭代生成策略-回复对直到完成。这两种方法都进一步增强了由强化学习引导的认知推理，以改善策略选择和回复组合。我们在ESConv数据集上评估了我们的模型，分别在话语级和对话级设置下。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地对多策略话语进行了建模，并提高了支持质量和对话成功率。据我们所知，这项工作提供了首个系统的实证证据，表明允许单个话语中包含多个支持策略不仅可行，而且对情感支持对话有益。所有代码和数据将在 https://github.com/aliyun/qwen-dianjin 上公开。

Abstract

Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) aims to assist individuals experiencing distress by generating empathetic and supportive dialogue. While prior work typically assumes that each supporter turn corresponds to a single strategy, real-world supportive communication often involves multiple strategies within a single utterance. In this paper, we revisit the ESC task by formulating it as multi-strategy utterance generation, where each utterance may contain one or more strategy-response pairs. We propose two generation methods: All-in-One, which predicts all strategy-response pairs in a single decoding step, and One-by-One, which iteratively generates strategy-response pairs until completion. Both methods are further enhanced with cognitive reasoning guided by reinforcement learning to improve strategy selection and response composition. We evaluate our models on the ESConv dataset under both utterance-level and dialogue-level settings. Experimental results show that our methods effectively model multi-strategy utterances and lead to improved supportive quality and dialogue success. To our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic empirical evidence that allowing multiple support strategies within a single utterance is both feasible and beneficial for emotional support conversations. All code and data will be publicly available at https://github.com/aliyun/qwen-dianjin.

item.title: Paradigm Shift from Statistical Channel Modeling to Digital Twin Prediction: An Environment-Generalizable ChannelLM for 6G AI-enabled Air Interface
item.author: Yichen Cai, Yuelong Qiu, Jianhua Zhang, Li Yu, Yuxiang Zhang, Zhen Zhang, Guangyi Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于ChannelLM的数字孪生信道架构，旨在解决传统信道建模在多样化环境下的局限性，通过环境重建、特征提取和通用环境表示实现多任务信道预测。

背景: 随着6G的发展，空口对无处不在的连接和高容量提出了更高要求，传统统计信道建模依赖离线有限环境数据，难以支持在线多样化环境应用。

目的: 为了解决现有AI模型在数字孪生信道（DTC）中难以同时实现强环境泛化和端到端实时信道预测的问题，提出了一种ChannelLM驱动的DTC架构。

方法: 该架构包含三个模块：基于动态物体检测和多模态对齐的图像与点云数据环境重建、物理可解释的环境特征提取，以及将特征映射为通用环境表示的ChannelLM核心，用于多任务信道预测。

主要发现: 在未见过的测试环境中，与小型AI模型相比，ChannelLM在信道状态信息预测中减少了4.23 dB的预测误差，并在现实中实现了70毫秒的端到端推理延迟。

结论: 提出的ChannelLM驱动的DTC架构能够有效提升信道预测的准确性和实时性，在多样化环境中表现出更强的泛化能力。

翻译: 随着6G的推进，无处不在的连接和空口更高的容量要求给多样化环境下的准确和实时无线信道获取带来了重大挑战。传统的统计信道建模依赖于有限环境中的离线测量数据，难以支持面临多样化环境的在线应用。为此，数字孪生信道（DTC）作为一种新范式应运而生，它通过高保真感知构建物理环境的数字副本，并利用人工智能（AI）模型实时预测相应的信道。作为DTC的引擎，现有的AI模型难以在现实世界中同时实现强环境泛化和端到端实时信道预测。因此，本文提出了一种由信道大模型（ChannelLM）驱动的DTC架构，包含三个模块：基于动态物体检测和图像与点云数据多模态对齐的低复杂度高精度环境重建、物理可解释的环境特征提取，以及将特征映射为通用环境表示的ChannelLM核心，用于多任务信道预测。仿真结果表明，在未见过的测试环境中，与小型AI模型相比，ChannelLM在信道状态信息预测中减少了4.23 dB的预测误差，并在现实中实现了70毫秒的端到端推理延迟。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统统计信道建模难以适应动态环境变化，以及现有AI模型难以同时实现环境泛化和实时预测的问题。这在6G研究中至关重要，因为6G需要高容量和无处不在的连接，如物联网和低空通信，这要求通信系统能够实时、准确地感知环境变化并自适应调整，以支持空口技术的智能演进。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者思考了传统统计信道模型难以适应动态环境的局限，借鉴了数字孪生（DTC）概念，将物理环境数字化。设计上，他们利用多模态传感器（如RGB-D和激光雷达）融合数据，将环境分解为静态和动态部分进行重建，并借鉴AI大模型（如GPT-2）学习环境特征与信道的映射。现有工作方面，他们参考了NVIDIA的AODT平台，但指出其依赖预构建地图且无法实时变化；参考了多模态传感融合技术；参考了CNN和UNet等小模型，但指出其泛化能力有限；参考了基于LLM的大模型，但指出其缺乏对无线环境的显式建模。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将传统的统计信道建模转变为基于数字孪生信道（DTC）的预测范式，利用 AI 大模型实现环境泛化和实时信道预测。整体实现流程包括三个步骤：首先，通过分层重建策略将环境分解为静态和动态部分，利用离线建模和实时传感器数据融合，构建高精度的 3D 环境；其次，提取物理可解释的环境特征；最后，利用 ChannelLM 将这些特征映射为通用环境表示，结合轻量级导频输入，协同预测路径损耗和信道状态信息。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了ChannelLM驱动的数字孪生信道架构。关键创新点包括：利用分层重建策略融合静态环境和动态物体；通过无线传播引导提取物理特征；利用预训练大模型学习环境与信道的关联，实现大尺度和小尺度信道的联合预测。相比之前工作，它不再依赖有限环境的离线数据，解决了现有AI小模型泛化能力差的问题，并且显式建模了无线环境，而非仅处理原始数据，从而实现了强环境泛化能力和实时预测。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种基于信道大模型（ChannelLM）的数字孪生信道架构，通过环境重建、特征提取和预测三个模块，实现了对大规模和小规模衰落的联合预测，解决了现有模型难以兼顾环境通用性和实时性的问题。

Abstract

As 6G advances, ubiquitous connectivity and higher capacity requirements of the air interface pose substantial challenges for accurate and real-time wireless channel acquisition in diverse environments. Conventional statistical channel modeling relies on offline measurement data from limited environments, struggling to support online applications facing diverse environments. To this end, the digital twin channel (DTC) has emerged as a novel paradigm that constructs a digital replica of the physical environment through high-fidelity sensing and predicts corresponding channel in real time utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) models. As the engine of DTC, existing AI models struggle to simultaneously achieve strong environmental generalization in real-world and end-to-end channel prediction for real time tasks. Therefore, this paper proposes a channel large model (ChannelLM)-driven DTC architecture comprising three modules: low-complexity and high-accuracy environment reconstruction based on dynamic object detection and multimodal alignment of image and point cloud data, physically interpretable environment feature extraction, and a ChannelLM core to mapping these features into generalized environment representations for multi-task channel prediction. Simulation results demonstrate that, in unseen test environments, compared with small-scale AI models, ChannelLM reduces prediction errors by 4.23 dB in channel state information prediction while achieving an end-to-end inference latency of 70 milliseconds in the real world.

item.title: CFSR: Geometry-Conditioned Shadow Removal via Physical Disentanglement
item.author: Pan Wang, Yihao Hu, Xiujin Liu, Hang Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为CFSR的多模态先验驱动框架，用于解决传统阴影去除网络缺乏物理可解释性的问题。

背景: 传统阴影去除网络将图像恢复视为无约束映射，缺乏平衡局部纹理恢复与全局光照一致性的物理可解释性。

目的: 提出CFSR框架，将阴影去除重新定义为物理约束的恢复过程，通过整合3D几何线索与大规模基础模型语义来弥合2D-3D领域差距。

方法: 首先将观测映射到自定义HVI颜色空间以抑制阴影引起的噪声；核心采用几何与语义双显式引导注意力机制，利用DINO特征和3D表面法线直接调节注意力亲和矩阵；通过冻结的CLIP编码器注入整体先验；最后使用频率协作重建模块（FCRM）实现最优合成，该模块在几何先验条件下协调高频遮挡边界与低频全局光照的恢复。

主要发现: CFSR在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: CFSR通过物理约束的恢复过程和频率协作重建模块，有效解决了局部纹理恢复与全局光照一致性的平衡问题。

翻译: 传统阴影去除网络通常将图像恢复视为无约束映射，缺乏平衡局部纹理恢复与全局光照一致性所需的物理可解释性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CFSR，一个多模态先验驱动的框架，将阴影去除重新定义为物理约束的恢复过程。通过无缝整合3D几何线索与大规模基础模型语义，CFSR有效地弥合了2D-3D领域差距。具体而言，我们首先将观测映射到自定义HVI颜色空间以抑制阴影引起的噪声，并稳健地融合RGB数据与估计的深度先验。在其核心，我们的几何与语义双显式引导注意力机制利用DINO特征和3D表面法线直接调节注意力亲和矩阵，结构性地强制执行物理光照约束。为了恢复严重退化的区域，我们通过冻结的CLIP编码器注入整体先验。最后，我们的频率协作重建模块（FCRM）通过解耦解码过程实现最优合成。在几何先验的条件下，FCRM无缝协调了锐利高频遮挡边界的重建与低频全局光照的恢复。广泛的实验表明，CFSR在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

Traditional shadow removal networks often treat image restoration as an unconstrained mapping, lacking the physical interpretability required to balance localized texture recovery with global illumination consistency. To address this, we propose CFSR, a multi-modal prior-driven framework that reframes shadow removal as a physics-constrained restoration process. By seamlessly integrating 3D geometric cues with large-scale foundation model semantics, CFSR effectively bridges the 2D-3D domain gap. Specifically, we first map observations into a custom HVI color space to suppress shadow-induced noise and robustly fuse RGB data with estimated depth priors. At its core, our Geometric & Semantic Dual Explicit Guided Attention mechanism utilizes DINO features and 3D surface normals to directly modulate the attention affinity matrix, structurally enforcing physical lighting constraints. To recover severely degraded regions, we inject holistic priors via a frozen CLIP encoder. Finally, our Frequency Collaborative Reconstruction Module (FCRM) achieves an optimal synthesis by decoupling the decoding process. Conditioned on geometric priors, FCRM seamlessly harmonizes the reconstruction of sharp high-frequency occlusion boundaries with the restoration of low-frequency global illumination. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CFSR achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple challenging benchmarks.

item.title: Sonata: A Hybrid World Model for Inertial Kinematics under Clinical Data Scarcity
item.author: Blaise Delaney, Salil Patel, Yuji Xing, Dominic Dootson, Karin Sevegnani
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Sonata是一个紧凑的潜在世界模型，用于在临床数据稀缺的情况下学习六轴躯干IMU表示，通过预测未来状态而非重建原始传感器轨迹来提高临床诊断和跌倒风险预测的准确性。

背景: 临床队列通常包含数十到数百名患者，使得大规模掩码重建目标与该问题不匹配。

目的: 开发一个紧凑的潜在世界模型，以解决临床数据稀缺问题，并实现设备端可穿戴推理。

方法: Sonata是一个3.77M参数的混合模型，在九个公共数据集（739名受试者，190k窗口）的协调语料库上进行预训练，采用潜在世界模型目标预测未来状态。

主要发现: 在14臂评估套件中，Sonata在冻结探头临床鉴别、前瞻性跌倒风险预测和跨队列迁移方面始终优于匹配的自回归预测基线（MAE），并产生更高排名、更结构化的潜在表示。

结论: 该模型兼容设备端可穿戴推理，为神经学评估的通用运动学世界模型迈出了一步。

翻译: 我们介绍了Sonata，这是一个紧凑的潜在世界模型，用于在临床数据稀缺的情况下学习六轴躯干IMU表示。临床队列通常包含数十到数百名患者，使得大规模掩码重建目标与该问题不匹配。Sonata是一个3.77M参数的混合模型，在九个公共数据集（739名受试者，190k窗口）的协调语料库上进行预训练，采用潜在世界模型目标预测未来状态而非重建原始传感器轨迹。在14臂评估套件中，Sonata在冻结探头临床鉴别、前瞻性跌倒风险预测和跨队列迁移方面始终优于匹配的自回归预测基线（MAE），并产生更高排名、更结构化的潜在表示。在3.77M参数下，该模型兼容设备端可穿戴推理，为神经学评估的通用运动学世界模型迈出了一步。

Abstract

We introduce Sonata, a compact latent world model for six-axis trunk IMU representation learning under clinical data scarcity. Clinical cohorts typically comprise tens to hundreds of patients, making web-scale masked-reconstruction objectives poorly matched to the problem. Sonata is a 3.77 M-parameter hybrid model, pre-trained on a harmonised corpus of nine public datasets (739 subjects, 190k windows) with a latent world-model objective that predicts future state rather than reconstructing raw sensor traces. In a controlled comparison against a matched autoregressive forecasting baseline (MAE) on the same backbone, Sonata yields consistently stronger frozen-probe clinical discrimination, prospective fall-risk prediction, and cross-cohort transfer across a 14-arm evaluation suite, while producing higher-rank, more structured latent representations. At 3.77 M parameters the model is compatible with on-device wearable inference, offering a step toward general kinematic world models for neurological assessment.

item.title: Towards a Foundation-Model Paradigm for Aerodynamic Prediction in Three-dimensional Design
item.author: Yunjia Yang, Babak Gholami, Caglar Gurbuz, Mohammad Rashed, Nils Thuerey
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer架构的AeroTransformer方法，通过在大规模数据集上预训练并在少量特定样本上进行微调，构建高效的气动预测代理模型。

背景: 在复杂三维构型中开发准确的机器学习模型以加速形状优化具有挑战性，因为生成训练数据成本高昂。

目的: 开发一种高效构建准确代理模型的方法，用于设计目的，并系统地研究模型配置和训练策略的影响。

方法: 首先在大规模数据集上预训练模型，然后使用少量特定任务样本进行微调。具体采用基于Transformer的AeroTransformer架构，在SuperWing数据集上预训练，并在Common Research Model翼型上进行微调。

主要发现: 在450个特定任务样本下，该方法在表面流动预测上实现了0.36%的误差，相比从头训练减少了84.2%。

结论: 该方法在有限数据和计算预算下有效，并提供了训练和部署指导。作者公开了数据集、预训练模型和在线交互式设计工具。

翻译: 摘要：准确的机器学习模型对于加速形状优化至关重要，但由于生成训练数据成本高昂，在复杂三维构型中开发这些模型仍然具有挑战性。本文介绍了一种用于设计目的的高效构建准确代理模型的方法，首先在大规模模型上预训练，然后使用少量更详细的特定任务样本进行微调。开发了一种基于Transformer的AeroTransformer架构，并针对大规模训练进行了定制，以学习空气动力学。该方法在跨音速机翼上进行了评估，模型在SuperWing数据集上预训练，该数据集包含近30000个样本，具有广泛的几何多样性，随后微调以处理从Common Research Model偏离的特定机翼形状。结果表明，使用450个特定任务样本，所提出的方法在表面流动预测上实现了0.36%的误差，相比从头训练减少了84.2%。还系统地研究了模型配置和训练策略的影响，以提供在有限数据和计算预算下有效训练和部署此类模型的指导。为了促进重用，我们在https://github.com/tum-pbs/AeroTransformer上发布了数据集和预训练模型。还在预训练模型上构建了一个交互式设计工具，并在https://webwing.pbs.cit.tum.de上提供在线访问。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决三维气动设计中，由于生成训练数据成本高昂，导致难以开发准确且通用的机器学习模型的问题。现有方法往往局限于特定领域，而三维设计空间的高维特性使得物理仿真极其昂贵。这个问题很重要，因为它是为了加速气动设计过程，通过基础模型范式在保持高精度的同时降低计算成本，从而实现更高效的经济设计。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者借鉴了“基础模型范式”来思考并设计该方法。针对3D气动预测数据生成成本高的问题，他们设计了平衡预训练和微调阶段几何保真度的策略：预训练阶段优先考虑几何多样性（简化细节）以学习通用物理，微调阶段在局部设计域恢复细节以提高精度。在架构上，他们借鉴了PDE-Transformer（一种用于PDE推理的Transformer变体）。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是采用基础模型范式，通过在大规模数据集上预训练以学习通用的流动物理关系，再利用少量特定任务样本进行微调，从而在可接受的计算成本内构建高精度的空气动力学代理模型。整体实现流程包括：首先在包含大量样本的大型数据集上进行预训练，优先考虑几何多样性而非细节；随后使用少量针对特定任务的高保真度样本对模型进行微调，以恢复局部设计域内的几何细节。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了基础模型范式，利用大规模数据预训练后微调，并开发了基于Transformer的AeroTransformer架构。相比之前的工作，不同之处在于

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种用于三维空气动力学预测的基础模型范式，开发了基于Transformer的Aero-Transformer架构，并通过平衡预训练和微调阶段的几何保真度策略，在跨音速机翼上实现了高精度预测，显著降低了数据需求。

Abstract

Accurate machine-learning models for aerodynamic prediction are essential for accelerating shape optimization, yet remain challenging to develop for complex three-dimensional configurations due to the high cost of generating training data. This work introduces a methodology for efficiently constructing accurate surrogate models for design purposes by first pre-training a large-scale model on diverse geometries and then fine-tuning it with a few more detailed task-specific samples. A Transformer-based architecture, AeroTransformer, is developed and tailored for large-scale training to learn aerodynamics. The methodology is evaluated on transonic wings, where the model is pre-trained on SuperWing, a dataset of nearly 30000 samples with broad geometric diversity, and subsequently fine-tuned to handle specific wing shapes perturbed from the Common Research Model. Results show that, with 450 task-specific samples, the proposed methodology achieves 0.36% error on surface-flow prediction, reducing 84.2% compared to training from scratch. The influence of model configurations and training strategies is also systematically studied to provide guidance on effectively training and deploying such models under limited data and computational budgets. To facilitate reuse, we release the datasets and the pre-trained models at https://github.com/tum-pbs/AeroTransformer. An interactive design tool is also built on the pre-trained model and is available online at https://webwing.pbs.cit.tum.de.

item.title: Towards Real-Time ECG and EMG Modeling on $μ$ NPUs
item.author: Josh Millar, Ashok Samraj Thangarajan, Soumyajit Chatterjee, Hamed Haddadi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysioLite 是一种轻量级且与 NPU 兼容的模型架构和训练框架，用于 ECG/EMG 信号分析。

背景: 神经处理单元和其他低功耗加速器的微型化使其能够集成到微控制器级的可穿戴硬件中，支持近实时、离线和隐私保护的推理。然而，生理信号分析在这些硬件上一直不可行；基于 Transformer 的模型虽然表现出最先进的性能，但由于其动态注意力操作，对资源受限的硬件不兼容且体积过大。

目的: 介绍 PhysioLite，一种用于 ECG/EMG 信号分析的轻量级、NPU 兼容的模型架构和训练框架。

方法: 使用可学习的小波滤波器组、CPU 卸载的位置编码以及硬件感知的层设计。

主要发现: PhysioLite 在 ECG 和 EMG 基准测试中达到了与最先进的基于 Transformer 的基础模型相当的性能，同时其大小仅为后者的 10% 以下（量化后约 370KB）。

结论: 在 MAX78000 和 HX6538 WE2 微型 NPU 上对其组件级延迟和资源消耗进行了分析，证明了其在受限、电池供电硬件上进行信号分析的可行性。

翻译: 神经处理单元和其他低功耗加速器的微型化使其能够集成到微控制器级的可穿戴硬件中，支持近实时、离线和隐私保护的推理。然而，生理信号分析在这些硬件上一直不可行；基于 Transformer 的模型虽然表现出最先进的性能，但由于其动态注意力操作，对资源受限的硬件不兼容且体积过大。我们介绍了 PhysioLite，一种用于 ECG/EMG 信号分析的轻量级、NPU 兼容的模型架构和训练框架。利用可学习的小波滤波器组、CPU 卸载的位置编码以及硬件感知的层设计，PhysioLite 在 ECG 和 EMG 基准测试中达到了与最先进的基于 Transformer 的基础模型相当的性能，同时其大小仅为后者的 10% 以下（量化后约 370KB）。我们还在 MAX78000 和 HX6538 WE2 微型 NPU 上对其组件级延迟和资源消耗进行了分析，证明了其在受限、电池供电硬件上进行信号分析的可行性。

Abstract

The miniaturisation of neural processing units (NPUs) and other low-power accelerators has enabled their integration into microcontroller-scale wearable hardware, supporting near-real-time, offline, and privacy-preserving inference. Yet physiological signal analysis has remained infeasible on such hardware; recent Transformer-based models show state-of-the-art performance but are prohibitively large for resource- and power-constrained hardware and incompatible with $μ$ NPUs due to their dynamic attention operations. We introduce PhysioLite, a lightweight, NPU-compatible model architecture and training framework for ECG/EMG signal analysis. Using learnable wavelet filter banks, CPU-offloaded positional encoding, and hardware-aware layer design, PhysioLite reaches performance comparable to state-of-the-art Transformer-based foundation models on ECG and EMG benchmarks, while being <10% of the size ($\sim$370KB with 8-bit quantization). We also profile its component-wise latency and resource consumption on both the MAX78000 and HX6538 WE2 $μ$ NPUs, demonstrating its viability for signal analysis on constrained, battery-powered hardware. We release our model(s) and training framework at: https://github.com/j0shmillar/physiolite.

item.title: Modeling Human Perspectives with Socio-Demographic Representations
item.author: Leixin Zhang, Cagri Coltekin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Socio-Contrastive Learning 的新方法，旨在通过联合建模标注者视角并学习社会人口学表示，来更好地融合社会人口学特征与文本表示以预测标注者视角。

背景: 人类对同一问题往往持有不同的观点，标注者之间的分歧可以反映有效的主观视角。现有研究通常关注单一人口学因素或有限组合，但现实场景中标注者视角受复杂社会背景影响，更细粒度的人口学属性能更好地解释人类视角。

目的: 提出 Socio-Contrastive Learning 方法，以有效融合社会人口学特征和文本表示来预测标注者视角。

方法: 提出 Socio-Contrastive Learning 方法，该方法联合建模标注者视角并学习社会人口学表示，通过融合社会人口学特征和文本表示来预测标注者视角。

主要发现: 该方法优于基于拼接的标准方法；学习到的表示进一步实现了对人口学因素如何与标注者视角变化相关联的分析和可视化。

结论: Socio-Contrastive Learning 提供了一种有效的融合社会人口学特征和文本表示以预测标注者视角的方法。

翻译: 人类经常对同一问题持有不同的观点。在许多自然语言处理任务中，标注者分歧可以反映有效的主观观点。建模标注者观点并理解其与其他人类因素（如社会人口学属性）的关系，已受到越来越多的关注。先前的工作通常关注单一人口学因素或有限组合。然而，在现实环境中，标注者观点是由复杂的社会背景塑造的，更细粒度的社会人口学属性能更好地解释人类观点。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Socio-Contrastive Learning，一种联合建模标注者观点并学习社会人口学表示的方法。我们的方法提供了一种有效的方法来融合社会人口学特征和文本表示以预测标注者观点，优于基于拼接的方法。学习到的表示进一步实现了对人口学因素如何与标注者观点变化相关联的分析和可视化。我们的代码可在 GitHub 上获得：https://github.com/Leixin-Zhang/Socio_Contrastive_Learning

Abstract

Humans often hold different perspectives on the same issues. In many NLP tasks, annotation disagreement can reflect valid subjective perspectives. Modeling annotator perspectives and understanding their relationship with other human factors, such as socio-demographic attributes, have received increasing attention. Prior work typically focuses on single demographic factors or limited combinations. However, in real-world settings, annotator perspectives are shaped by complex social contexts, and finer-grained socio-demographic attributes can better explain human perspectives. In this work, we propose Socio-Contrastive Learning, a method that jointly models annotator perspectives while learning socio-demographic representations. Our method provides an effective approach for the fusion of socio-demographic features and textual representations to predict annotator perspectives, outperforming standard concatenation-based methods. The learned representations further enable analysis and visualization of how demographic factors relate to variation in annotator perspectives. Our code is available at GitHub: https://github.com/Leixin-Zhang/Socio_Contrastive_Learning

item.title: DSAINet: An Efficient Dual-Scale Attentive Interaction Network for General EEG Decoding
item.author: Zhiyuan Ma, Zeyuan Li, Zihao Qiu, Jinhao Li, Lingqin Meng, Xinche Zhang, Yixuan Liu, Xinke Shen, Sen Song
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DSAINet是一个高效的双尺度注意力交互网络，用于通用EEG解码，通过并行卷积分支和注意力机制处理不同时间动态，在多个数据集上表现出色。

背景: 在非侵入式EEG的实际应用中，专用解码器在跨任务和跨受试者的设置下通用性有限。任务相关的EEG信号在不同任务中往往遵循不同的时间组织模式，而现有方法通常依赖于任务定制的架构设计，引入了任务特定的时间归纳偏置。

目的: 为了解决这些挑战，提出DSAINet，一个用于通用EEG解码的高效双尺度注意力交互网络。

方法: DSAINet从原始EEG信号构建共享时空token表示，通过细粒度和粗粒度尺度的并行卷积分支建模多样化的时间动态。随后，通过分支内注意力自适应细化表示以强调显著的比例特定模式，以及分支间注意力整合跨比例的任务相关特征，最后进行自适应token聚合以产生紧凑的表示用于预测。

主要发现: 在五个下游EEG解码任务和十个公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，DSAINet在严格的受试者独立评估下始终优于13个代表性基线。值得注意的是，这种性能是在跨数据集使用相同架构超参数的情况下实现的。此外，DSAINet以约77K可训练参数实现了有利的准确率-效率权衡，并提供了解释性的神经生理学见解。

结论: DSAINet在通用EEG解码任务中表现优异，具有高效性和可解释性。

翻译: 在非侵入式脑电图（EEG）的实际应用中，专用解码器在跨任务和跨受试者的设置下通用性有限。一个核心挑战是任务相关的EEG信号在不同任务中往往遵循不同的时间组织模式，而许多现有方法依赖于任务定制的架构设计，引入了任务特定的时间归纳偏置。这种不匹配使得在不改变模型配置的情况下跨任务适应时间建模变得困难。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了DSAINet，一个用于通用EEG解码的高效双尺度注意力交互网络。具体而言，DSAINet从原始EEG信号构建共享时空token表示，并通过细粒度和粗粒度尺度的并行卷积分支建模多样化的时间动态。随后，通过分支内注意力自适应细化表示以强调显著的比例特定模式，以及分支间注意力整合跨比例的任务相关特征，最后进行自适应token聚合以产生紧凑的表示用于预测。在五个下游EEG解码任务和十个公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，DSAINet在严格的受试者独立评估下始终优于13个代表性基线。值得注意的是，这种性能是在跨数据集使用相同架构超参数的情况下实现的。此外，DSAINet以约77K可训练参数实现了有利的准确率-效率权衡，并提供了解释性的神经生理学见解。代码在 https://github.com/zy0929/DSAINet 上公开。

Abstract

In real-world applications of noninvasive electroencephalography (EEG), specialized decoders often show limited generalizability across diverse tasks under subject-independent settings. One central challenge is that task-relevant EEG signals often follow different temporal organization patterns across tasks, while many existing methods rely on task-tailored architectural designs that introduce task-specific temporal inductive biases. This mismatch makes it difficult to adapt temporal modeling across tasks without changing the model configuration. To address these challenges, we propose DSAINet, an efficient dual-scale attentive interaction network for general EEG decoding. Specifically, DSAINet constructs shared spatiotemporal token representations from raw EEG signals and models diverse temporal dynamics through parallel convolutional branches at fine and coarse scales. The resulting representations are then adaptively refined by intra-branch attention to emphasize salient scale-specific patterns and by inter-branch attention to integrate task-relevant features across scales, followed by adaptive token aggregation to yield a compact representation for prediction. Extensive experiments on five downstream EEG decoding tasks across ten public datasets show that DSAINet consistently outperforms 13 representative baselines under strict subject-independent evaluation. Notably, this performance is achieved using the same architecture hyperparameters across datasets. Moreover, DSAINet achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only about 77K trainable parameters and provides interpretable neurophysiological insights. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zy0929/DSAINet.

item.title: Training LLM Agents for Spontaneous, Reward-Free Self-Evolution via World Knowledge Exploration
item.author: Qifan Zhang, Dongyang Ma, Tianqing Fang, Jia Li, Jing Tang, Nuo Chen, Haitao Mi, Yan Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种让智能体具备内在元进化能力的方法，使其能在执行任务前自发学习未知环境。

背景: 现有的智能体大多依赖人类定义的奖励和规则进行自我进化，这种进化过程本质上依赖于外部监督，缺乏人类指导时进化就会停止。

目的: 训练智能体具备内在的元进化能力，使其能够在执行任务之前自发地学习关于未知环境的知识。

方法: 设计了一种基于结果的奖励机制，该机制衡量智能体自生成的世界知识对其下游任务成功率提升的程度。该奖励信号仅在训练阶段使用，用于教导模型如何有效地探索和总结。在推理阶段，智能体不需要外部奖励或人类指令。

主要发现: 当应用于 Qwen3-30B 和 Seed-OSS-36B 模型时，这种向原生进化的转变使 WebVoyager 和 WebWalker 的性能提高了 20%。最引人注目的是，生成的世界知识甚至使一个紧凑的 14B Qwen3 模型能够超越未经辅助的 Gemini-2.5-Flash。

结论: 本研究建立了一种真正进化的智能体的新范式。

翻译: Most agents today ``self-evolve'' by following rewards and rules defined by humans. However, this process remains fundamentally dependent on external supervision; without human guidance, the evolution stops. In this work, we train agents to possess an intrinsic meta-evolution capability to spontaneously learn about unseen environments prior to task execution. To instill this ability, we design an outcome-based reward mechanism that measures how much an agent's self-generated world knowledge improves its success rate on downstream tasks. This reward signal is used exclusively during the training phase to teach the model how to explore and summarize effectively. At inference time, the agent requires no external rewards or human instructions. It spontaneously performs native self-evolution to adapt to unknown environments using its internal parameters. When applied to Qwen3-30B and Seed-OSS-36B, this shift to native evolution yields a 20% performance increase on WebVoyager and WebWalker. Most strikingly, the generated world knowledge even enables a compact 14B Qwen3 model to outperform the unassisted Gemini-2.5-Flash, establishing a new paradigm for truly evolving agents.

Abstract

Most agents today ``self-evolve'' by following rewards and rules defined by humans. However, this process remains fundamentally dependent on external supervision; without human guidance, the evolution stops. In this work, we train agents to possess an intrinsic meta-evolution capability to spontaneously learn about unseen environments prior to task execution. To instill this ability, we design an outcome-based reward mechanism that measures how much an agent's self-generated world knowledge improves its success rate on downstream tasks. This reward signal is used exclusively during the training phase to teach the model how to explore and summarize effectively. At inference time, the agent requires no external rewards or human instructions. It spontaneously performs native self-evolution to adapt to unknown environments using its internal parameters. When applied to Qwen3-30B and Seed-OSS-36B, this shift to native evolution yields a 20% performance increase on WebVoyager and WebWalker. Most strikingly, the generated world knowledge even enables a compact 14B Qwen3 model to outperform the unassisted Gemini-2.5-Flash, establishing a new paradigm for truly evolving agents.

item.title: Multi-Agent Systems: From Classical Paradigms to Large Foundation Model-Enabled Futures
item.author: Zixiang Wang, Mengjia Gong, Qiyu Sun, Jing Xu, Shuai Mao, Xin Jin, Qing-Long Han, Yang Tang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对基于大型基础模型的智能体系统进行了系统回顾和比较分析，涵盖了经典智能体系统和基于大型基础模型的智能体系统。

背景: 随着人工智能的快速发展，多智能体系统正从经典范式演变为基于大型基础模型构建的架构。

目的: 对经典多智能体系统和基于大型基础模型的智能体系统进行系统回顾和比较分析。

方法: 首先在闭环协调框架内，从感知、通信、决策和控制四个基本维度回顾经典多智能体系统；然后对比分析两者在架构、运行机制、适应性和应用方面的差异；最后总结未来展望。

主要发现: 基于大型基础模型的智能体系统将协作从低级状态交换提升到语义级推理，实现了更灵活的协调和跨场景的适应性。

结论: 文章指出了多智能体系统面临的开放挑战和潜在研究机会。

翻译: 随着人工智能的快速发展，多智能体系统正从经典范式演变为基于大型基础模型构建的架构。本文对经典多智能体系统和基于大型基础模型的智能体系统进行了系统回顾和比较分析。首先，在闭环协调框架内，从感知、通信、决策和控制四个基本维度回顾经典多智能体系统。在此基础上，基于大型基础模型的智能体系统将协作从低级状态交换提升到语义级推理，实现了更灵活的协调和跨场景的适应性。然后，对两者在架构、运行机制、适应性和应用方面进行了对比分析。最后，提出了多智能体系统的未来展望，总结了开放挑战和潜在研究机会。

Abstract

With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, multi-agent systems (MASs) are evolving from classical paradigms toward architectures built upon large foundation models (LFMs). This survey provides a systematic review and comparative analysis of classical MASs (CMASs) and LFM-based MASs (LMASs). First, within a closed-loop coordination framework, CMASs are reviewed across four fundamental dimensions: perception, communication, decision-making, and control. Beyond this framework, LMASs integrate LFMs to lift collaboration from low-level state exchanges to semantic-level reasoning, enabling more flexible coordination and improved adaptability across diverse scenarios. Then, a comparative analysis is conducted to contrast CMASs and LMASs across architecture, operating mechanism, adaptability, and application. Finally, future perspectives on MASs are presented, summarizing open challenges and potential research opportunities.

item.title: Can LLM-Generated Text Empower Surgical Vision-Language Pre-training?
item.author: Chengan Che, Chao Wang, Jiayuan Huang, Xinyue Chen, Luis C. Garcia-Peraza-Herrera
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LIME是一个大规模多模态数据集，SurgLIME是一个参数高效的视觉语言预训练框架，用于在噪声叙事中学习可靠的跨模态对齐。

背景: 自监督学习在手术视觉编码器方面取得了进展，但扩展到多模态推理任务受到专家文本注释成本高昂的限制。

目的: 克服可扩展性限制，引入LIME数据集，并提出SurgLIME框架以学习可靠的跨模态对齐并缓解生成文本中的错误。

方法: 使用LoRA适配的双编码器架构保留医学先验知识，并引入自动置信度估计机制在对比对齐期间动态降低不确定文本的权重。

主要发现: SurgLIME在AutoLaparo和Cholec80基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的零样本跨模态对齐，同时保持了视觉基础模型的鲁棒线性探测性能。

结论: SurgLIME能够有效利用噪声叙事进行训练，在保持视觉基础模型性能的同时，解决了生成文本错误对预训练医学先验的潜在负面影响。

翻译: 摘要：自监督学习方面的最新进展导致了强大的手术视觉编码器，能够进行时空理解。然而，将这些视觉基础扩展到多模态推理任务受到专家文本注释成本高昂的严重瓶颈限制。为了克服这种可扩展性限制，我们介绍了LIME，一个使用人类免费、大型语言模型生成的叙事从开放获取手术视频中衍生的大规模多模态数据集。虽然LIME提供了巨大的可扩展性，但未经核实的生成文本可能包含错误，包括幻觉，这可能导致标准对比管道中的预训练医学先验灾难性退化。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了SurgLIME，一个参数高效的视觉语言预训练框架，旨在使用噪声叙事学习可靠的跨模态对齐。SurgLIME使用LoRA适配的双编码器架构保留基础医学先验，并引入自动置信度估计机制，在对比对齐期间动态降低不确定文本的权重。在AutoLaparo和Cholec80基准测试上的评估表明，SurgLIME实现了具有竞争力的零样本跨模态对齐，同时保持了视觉基础模型的鲁棒线性探测性能。数据集、代码和模型在https://github.com/visurg-ai/SurgLIME上公开提供。

Abstract

Recent advancements in self-supervised learning have led to powerful surgical vision encoders capable of spatiotemporal understanding. However, extending these visual foundations to multi-modal reasoning tasks is severely bottlenecked by the prohibitive cost of expert textual annotations. To overcome this scalability limitation, we introduce \textbf{LIME}, a large-scale multi-modal dataset derived from open-access surgical videos using human-free, Large Language Model (LLM)-generated narratives. While LIME offers immense scalability, unverified generated texts may contain errors, including hallucinations, that could potentially lead to catastrophically degraded pre-trained medical priors in standard contrastive pipelines. To mitigate this, we propose \textbf{SurgLIME}, a parameter-efficient Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) framework designed to learn reliable cross-modal alignments using noisy narratives. SurgLIME preserves foundational medical priors using a LoRA-adapted dual-encoder architecture and introduces an automated confidence estimation mechanism that dynamically down-weights uncertain text during contrastive alignment. Evaluations on the AutoLaparo and Cholec80 benchmarks show that SurgLIME achieves competitive zero-shot cross-modal alignment while preserving the robust linear probing performance of the visual foundation model. Dataset, code, and models are publicly available at \href{https://github.com/visurg-ai/SurgLIME}{https://github.com/visurg-ai/SurgLIME}.

item.title: Modular Representation Compression: Adapting LLMs for Efficient and Effective Recommendations
item.author: Yunjia Xi, Menghui Zhu, Jianghao Lin, Bo Chen, Ruiming Tang, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为MARC的方法，旨在解决大语言模型在推荐系统中的表示压缩问题，通过显式控制模块化来提升性能。

背景: 大语言模型已广泛应用于推荐系统，但高维表示带来了存储和计算成本。现有方法通常在最终层进行压缩，但研究发现中间层表示往往优于最终层。

目的: 为了解决表示压缩中的反直觉现象（中间层表示优势），并提高压缩效率。

方法: 提出Modular Representation Compression (MARC)，包括显式引入压缩和任务适应模块的Modular Adjustment，以及使用信息约束和不同网络结构的Modular Task Decoupling。

主要发现: MARC能够解决中间层表示优势现象，并产生高效的表示；在大型商业搜索广告场景的在线A/B测试中，实现了2.82%的eCPM提升。

结论: MARC通过显式控制模块化，有效提升了推荐系统中的表示压缩效果。

翻译: 最近，大语言模型（LLMs）在推荐系统（RSs）方面取得了进展，近期的工作开始探索如何将LLMs集成到工业级RSs中。虽然大多数方法在离线部署LLMs以生成和预缓存增强表示给RSs，但来自LLMs的高维表示引入了大量的存储和计算成本。因此，有效地压缩LLM表示至关重要。然而，我们在表示压缩过程中识别出了一个反直觉的现象：中间层表示优势（MRA），即LLM中间层的表示在推荐任务中优于最终层的表示。这种退化的最终层使得现有的压缩方法（通常在最终层进行压缩）变得次优。我们基于模块化理论对此进行了解释，即LLMs发展出自发的内部功能模块化，并迫使最终层专门化用于代理训练任务。因此，我们提出了Modular Representation Compression (MARC)来显式控制LLMs的模块化。首先，Modular Adjustment显式引入了压缩和任务适应模块，使LLM严格作为表示学习模块运行。接下来，为了将每个模块锚定到其特定任务，Modular Task Decoupling使用信息约束和不同的网络结构来解耦任务。广泛的实验验证了MARC解决了MRA并产生了高效的表示。值得注意的是，MARC在大型商业搜索广告场景的在线A/B测试中实现了2.82%的eCPM提升。

Abstract

Recently, large language models (LLMs) have advanced recommendation systems (RSs), and recent works have begun to explore how to integrate LLMs into industrial RSs. While most approaches deploy LLMs offline to generate and pre-cache augmented representations for RSs, high-dimensional representations from LLMs introduce substantial storage and computational costs. Thus, it is crucial to compress LLM representations effectively. However, we identify a counterintuitive phenomenon during representation compression: Mid-layer Representation Advantage (MRA), where representations from middle layers of LLMs outperform those from final layers in recommendation tasks. This degraded final layer renders existing compression methods, which typically compress on the final layer, suboptimal. We interpret this based on modularity theory that LLMs develop spontaneous internal functional modularity and force the final layer to specialize in the proxy training task. Thus, we propose \underline{M}odul\underline{a}r \underline{R}epresentation \underline{C}ompression (MARC) to explicitly control the modularity of LLMs. First, Modular Adjustment explicitly introduces compression and task adaptation modules, enabling the LLM to operate strictly as a representation-learning module. Next, to ground each module to its specific task, Modular Task Decoupling uses information constraints and different network structures to decouple tasks. Extensive experiments validate that MARC addresses MRA and produces efficient representations. Notably, MARC achieved a 2.82% eCPM lift in an online A/B test within a large-scale commercial search advertising scenario.

item.title: VerilogCL: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Robust LLM-Based Verilog Generation
item.author: Yan Tan, Tong Liu, Xiangchen Meng, Yangdi Lyu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出VerilogCL框架以提升Verilog代码生成质量

背景: 大型语言模型在软件代码生成中表现强劲，但在硬件描述语言如Verilog的应用中面临挑战，因为高质量训练数据稀缺，生成的代码常包含语法或结构错误，导致编译失败或功能错误，限制了其在硬件设计工作流中的可靠性

目的: 通过对比学习和主动错误筛选增强Verilog代码生成

方法: 引入最小错误数据增强生成正确RTL和最小扰动错误RTL的配对样本，应用对比学习在表示空间中学习清晰的正确性边界，并引入结合语义嵌入和令牌级不确定性特征的主动筛选模块以过滤低置信度候选

主要发现: 在VerilogEval和RTLLM公共基准测试中，7B参数模型在编译成功率和功能正确性方面均优于评估的开源、Verilog专用和商业基线

结论: VerilogCL框架有效提升了Verilog代码生成的可靠性和准确性

翻译: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently achieved strong performance in software code generation. However, applying them to hardware description languages (HDLs), such as Verilog, remains challenging because high-quality training data are relatively scarce. In practice, LLM-generated Verilog often contains syntactic or structural errors that either cause compilation failures or produce functionally incorrect designs, which limit its reliability in hardware design workflows. In this work, we propose VerilogCL, an integrated framework that enhances Verilog code generation by explicitly learning the boundary between correct and erroneous RTL through contrastive learning and proactive error screening. Our approach introduces minimal-error data augmentation, generating paired training samples of correct RTL and minimally perturbed erroneous RTL to teach the model to recognize fine-grained distinctions between correct and erroneous code. We then apply contrastive learning to learn a clearer validity boundary in the representation space, improving the separation between correct and erroneous RTL code. In addition, we introduce a proactive screening module that combines semantic embeddings with token-level uncertainty features to filter low-confidence candidates during generation. Experiments on public benchmarks, including VerilogEval and RTLLM, show that our 7B-parameter model outperforms the evaluated open-source, Verilog-specialized, and commercial baselines in both compilation success rate and functional correctness.

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently achieved strong performance in software code generation. However, applying them to hardware description languages (HDLs), such as Verilog, remains challenging because high-quality training data are relatively scarce. In practice, LLM-generated Verilog often contains syntactic or structural errors that either cause compilation failures or produce functionally incorrect designs, which limit its reliability in hardware design workflows. In this work, we propose VerilogCL, an integrated framework that enhances Verilog code generation by explicitly learning the boundary between correct and erroneous RTL through contrastive learning and proactive error screening. Our approach introduces minimal-error data augmentation, generating paired training samples of correct RTL and minimally perturbed erroneous RTL to teach the model to recognize fine-grained distinctions between correct and erroneous code. We then apply contrastive learning to learn a clearer validity boundary in the representation space, improving the separation between correct and erroneous RTL code. In addition, we introduce a proactive screening module that combines semantic embeddings with token-level uncertainty features to filter low-confidence candidates during generation. Experiments on public benchmarks, including VerilogEval and RTLLM, show that our 7B-parameter model outperforms the evaluated open-source, Verilog-specialized, and commercial baselines in both compilation success rate and functional correctness.

item.title: Extending One-Step Image Generation from Class Labels to Text via Discriminative Text Representation
item.author: Chenxi Zhao, Chen Zhu, Xiaokun Feng, Aiming Hao, Jiashu Zhu, Jiachen Lei, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Jufeng Yang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于LLM文本编码器的文本条件MeanFlow生成方法，实现了高效的文本条件合成。

背景: MeanFlow是一种一步生成方法，现有研究主要关注类别到图像的生成，而将条件从固定类别标签扩展到灵活文本输入是一个未被探索的方向。

目的: 为了解决文本条件在MeanFlow框架下理解能力不足的问题，实现高效的文本条件合成。

方法: 利用具有所需语义属性的高效LLM文本编码器，并调整MeanFlow生成过程以适应该框架。

主要发现: 由于MeanFlow的细化步骤极少（如仅一步），文本特征表示需要具备足够高的判别性；离散且易于区分的类别特征在MeanFlow框架下表现良好。

结论: 该方法在广泛使用的扩散模型上验证了显著的生成性能提升，为未来的文本条件MeanFlow生成研究提供了通用且实用的参考。

翻译: Few-step generation has been a long-standing goal, with recent one-step generation methods exemplified by MeanFlow achieving remarkable results. Existing research on MeanFlow primarily focuses on class-to-image generation. However, an intuitive yet unexplored direction is to extend the condition from fixed class labels to flexible text inputs, enabling richer content creation. Compared to the limited class labels, text conditions pose greater challenges to the model's understanding capability, necessitating the effective integration of powerful text encoders into the MeanFlow framework. Surprisingly, although incorporating text conditions appears straightforward, we find that integrating powerful LLM-based text encoders using conventional training strategies results in unsatisfactory performance. To uncover the underlying cause, we conduct detailed analyses and reveal that, due to the extremely limited number of refinement steps in the MeanFlow generation, such as only one step, the text feature representations are required to possess sufficiently high discriminability. This also explains why discrete and easily distinguishable class features perform well within the MeanFlow framework. Guided by these insights, we leverage a powerful LLM-based text encoder validated to possess the required semantic properties and adapt the MeanFlow generation process to this framework, resulting in efficient text-conditioned synthesis for the first time. Furthermore, we validate our approach on the widely used diffusion model, demonstrating significant generation performance improvements. We hope this work provides a general and practical reference for future research on text-conditioned MeanFlow generation. The code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/EMF.

Abstract

Few-step generation has been a long-standing goal, with recent one-step generation methods exemplified by MeanFlow achieving remarkable results. Existing research on MeanFlow primarily focuses on class-to-image generation. However, an intuitive yet unexplored direction is to extend the condition from fixed class labels to flexible text inputs, enabling richer content creation. Compared to the limited class labels, text conditions pose greater challenges to the model's understanding capability, necessitating the effective integration of powerful text encoders into the MeanFlow framework. Surprisingly, although incorporating text conditions appears straightforward, we find that integrating powerful LLM-based text encoders using conventional training strategies results in unsatisfactory performance. To uncover the underlying cause, we conduct detailed analyses and reveal that, due to the extremely limited number of refinement steps in the MeanFlow generation, such as only one step, the text feature representations are required to possess sufficiently high discriminability. This also explains why discrete and easily distinguishable class features perform well within the MeanFlow framework. Guided by these insights, we leverage a powerful LLM-based text encoder validated to possess the required semantic properties and adapt the MeanFlow generation process to this framework, resulting in efficient text-conditioned synthesis for the first time. Furthermore, we validate our approach on the widely used diffusion model, demonstrating significant generation performance improvements. We hope this work provides a general and practical reference for future research on text-conditioned MeanFlow generation. The code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/EMF.

item.title: Multiplication in Multimodal LLMs: Computation with Text, Image, and Audio Inputs
item.author: Samuel G. Balter, Ethan Jerzak, Connor T. Jerzak
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究介绍了一个受控的多模态乘法基准测试，通过系统地变化数字长度、稀疏性、表示形式和模态来评估多模态大语言模型在乘法任务中的表现。

背景: 现有的多模态大语言模型虽然能准确感知跨模态的数值内容，但在将相同的算术问题以数字、数字单词、图像或音频形式呈现时，往往无法进行精确的多位数乘法。此外，由于现有基准测试缺乏跨模态的成对实例，难以比较模型家族内部和跨模型的真正算术极限。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，研究引入了一个受控的多模态乘法基准测试，旨在系统地评估模型在不同条件下的算术能力。

方法: 研究构建了一个基准测试，该测试通过因子化方法变化数字长度、数字稀疏性、表示形式（如数字与数字单词）和模态（文本、渲染图像、音频），并使用可重现的生成器提供成对实例。同时，定义了算术负载 C，作为总位数和非零位数的乘积，作为操作计数的紧凑代理指标。

主要发现: 评估结果显示，随着 C 值的增长，准确率急剧下降，当 C > 100 时准确率接近零。C 值在跨模态和跨模型中仍能预测性能，R平方值通常大于 0.5。感知与计算的分解分析表明，多模态性能下降主要源于计算而非感知；在匹配感知的检查中，模型在所有模态下的准确率接近完美（>99%）。此外，研究通过强制完成损失探针发现，分解策略在文本和视觉模态中均被偏好。

结论: 多模态大语言模型在乘法任务上的表现主要受限于计算能力而非感知能力。模型内部存在一个经过良好调整的路由机制，能够区分不同的推理策略。

翻译: Multimodal LLMs can accurately perceive numerical content across modalities yet fail to perform exact multi-digit multiplication when the identical underlying arithmetic problem is presented as numerals, number words, images, or in audio form. Because existing benchmarks often lack systematically paired instances across modalities, it remains difficult to compare genuine arithmetic limits within and across model families. We therefore introduce a controlled multimodal multiplication benchmark that factorially varies digit length, digit sparsity, representation (e.g., numerals vs. number words), and modality (text, rendered images, audio), with paired instances from a reproducible generator. We also define arithmetic load, C, as the product of the total and non-zero digit count as a compact, mechanistically motivated proxy for operation count. Across evaluations, accuracy falls sharply as C grows, often nearing zero by C > 100. Indeed, C remains predictive of performance across modalities and models, with R-squared often > 0.5, nearing the value from more complex measures of arithmetic load that count the number of intermediate arithmetic steps. A separate perception-versus-computation decomposition shows that multimodal degradation is primarily computational rather than perceptual: on matched-perception checks, models are near-perfect (> 99%) across modalities, even when multiplication accuracy drops. Beyond measuring when models fail, we ask which procedures they are predisposed to follow. We introduce a forced-completion loss probe that scores heuristic-specific reasoning prefixes--including columnar multiplication, distributive decomposition, and rounding/compensation. Here, decomposition is favored in both text and vision modalities; heuristic-specific LoRA adapters produce near-orthogonal updates yet degrade accuracy, indicating the base model maintains a well-tuned internal router.

Abstract

Multimodal LLMs can accurately perceive numerical content across modalities yet fail to perform exact multi-digit multiplication when the identical underlying arithmetic problem is presented as numerals, number words, images, or in audio form. Because existing benchmarks often lack systematically paired instances across modalities, it remains difficult to compare genuine arithmetic limits within and across model families. We therefore introduce a controlled multimodal multiplication benchmark that factorially varies digit length, digit sparsity, representation (e.g., numerals vs. number words), and modality (text, rendered images, audio), with paired instances from a reproducible generator. We also define arithmetic load, C, as the product of the total and non-zero digit count as a compact, mechanistically motivated proxy for operation count. Across evaluations, accuracy falls sharply as C grows, often nearing zero by C > 100. Indeed, C remains predictive of performance across modalities and models, with R-squared often > 0.5, nearing the value from more complex measures of arithmetic load that count the number of intermediate arithmetic steps. A separate perception-versus-computation decomposition shows that multimodal degradation is primarily computational rather than perceptual: on matched-perception checks, models are near-perfect (> 99%) across modalities, even when multiplication accuracy drops. Beyond measuring when models fail, we ask which procedures they are predisposed to follow. We introduce a forced-completion loss probe that scores heuristic-specific reasoning prefixes--including columnar multiplication, distributive decomposition, and rounding/compensation. Here, decomposition is favored in both text and vision modalities; heuristic-specific LoRA adapters produce near-orthogonal updates yet degrade accuracy, indicating the base model maintains a well-tuned internal router.

item.title: TacticGen: Grounding Adaptable and Scalable Generation of Football Tactics
item.author: Sheng Xu, Guiliang Liu, Tarak Kharrat, Yudong Luo, Mohamed Aloulou, Javier López Peña, Konstantin Sofeikov, Adam Reid, Paul Roberts, Steven Spencer, Joe Carnall, Ian McHale, Oliver Schulte, Hongyuan Zha, Wei-Shi Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TacticGen是一个用于适应性战术生成的生成模型，将战术建模为基于比赛情境的多智能体移动和交互序列。

背景: 足球的成功依赖于个人技能和协调战术。虽然时空数据和深度学习的进步使得轨迹预测等预测分析成为可能，但战术设计的发展仍然有限。

目的: 弥合预测（揭示可能发生什么）与战术生成（确定为实现战略目标应该发生什么）之间的差距。

方法: TacticGen采用多智能体扩散变换器，结合智能体自注意力和上下文感知交叉注意力来捕捉球员和球之间的合作与竞争动态。

主要发现: 在超过330万事件和1亿跟踪帧的训练数据上，TacticGen在预测球员轨迹方面达到了最先进的精度。它通过分类器引导机制实现了适应性战术生成，支持规则、自然语言或神经网络指定。

结论: 专家案例研究证实TacticGen生成逼真且具有战略价值的战术，展示了其在专业足球战术规划中的实际效用。

翻译: 摘要：足球的成功依赖于个人技能和协调战术。虽然时空数据和深度学习的进步使得轨迹预测等预测分析成为可能，但战术设计的发展仍然有限。弥合这一差距至关重要，因为预测揭示了可能发生什么，而战术生成决定了为实现战略目标应该发生什么。在这项工作中，我们提出了TacticGen，一个用于适应性战术生成的生成模型。TacticGen将战术建模为基于比赛情境的多智能体移动和交互序列。它采用多智能体扩散变换器，结合智能体自注意力和上下文感知交叉注意力来捕捉球员和球之间的合作与竞争动态。使用来自顶级联赛的超过330万事件和1亿跟踪帧进行训练，TacticGen在预测球员轨迹方面达到了最先进的精度。在此基础上，TacticGen通过分类器引导机制实现了适应性战术生成，该机制通过规则、自然语言或神经网络指定。其建模性能也具有内在的可扩展性。一项与足球专家的案例研究证实，TacticGen生成逼真且具有战略价值的战术，证明了其在专业足球战术规划中的实际效用。项目页面可在：https://shengxu.net/TacticGen/ 获取。

Abstract

Success in association football relies on both individual skill and coordinated tactics. While recent advancements in spatio-temporal data and deep learning have enabled predictive analyses like trajectory forecasting, the development of tactical design remains limited. Bridging this gap is essential, as prediction reveals what is likely to occur, whereas tactic generation determines what should occur to achieve strategic objectives. In this work, we present TacticGen, a generative model for adaptable and scalable tactic generation. TacticGen formulates tactics as sequences of multi-agent movements and interactions conditioned on the game context. It employs a multi-agent diffusion transformer with agent-wise self-attention and context-aware cross-attention to capture cooperative and competitive dynamics among players and the ball. Trained with over 3.3 million events and 100 million tracking frames from top-tier leagues, TacticGen achieves state-of-the-art precision in predicting player trajectories. Building on it, TacticGen enables adaptable tactic generation tailored to diverse inference-time objectives through classifier guidance mechanism, specified via rules, natural language, or neural models. Its modeling performance is also inherently scalable. A case study with football experts confirms that TacticGen generates realistic, strategically valuable tactics, demonstrating its practical utility for tactical planning in professional football. The project page is available at: https://shengxu.net/TacticGen/.

item.title: WebCompass: Towards Multimodal Web Coding Evaluation for Code Language Models
item.author: Xinping Lei, Xinyu Che, Junqi Xiong, Chenchen Zhang, Yukai Huang, Chenyu Zhou, Haoyang Huang, Minghao Liu, Letian Zhu, Hongyi Ye, Jinhua Hao, Ken Deng, Zizheng Zhan, Han Li, Dailin Li, Yifan Yao, Ming Sun, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Jiaheng Liu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WebCompass是一个多模态基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在网页工程方面的能力，涵盖生成、编辑和修复三个任务类型，并采用LLM-as-a-Judge和Agent-as-a-Judge协议进行评估。

背景: 现有基准测试仅评估大语言模型网页编码能力的狭窄切片，通常仅关注文本条件生成和静态正确性指标，忽略了视觉保真度、交互质量和代码库级推理。

目的: 介绍WebCompass，一个多模态基准测试，提供网页工程能力的统一生命周期评估。

方法: WebCompass涵盖三种输入模态（文本、图像、视频）和三种任务类型（生成、编辑、修复），产生七个任务类别。通过多阶段、人机循环管道策划实例，涵盖15个生成领域、16种编辑操作类型和11种修复缺陷类型。评估采用清单指导的LLM-as-a-Judge协议用于编辑和修复，并提出新颖的Agent-as-a-Judge范式用于生成，在真实浏览器中自主执行生成的网站。

主要发现: 闭源模型仍然更强且更平衡；编辑和修复表现出不同的难度概况，修复保持更好的交互性但执行具有挑战性；美学是持续存在的瓶颈，尤其是开源模型；框架选择对结果有实质性影响，Vue始终具有挑战性，而React和Vanilla/HTML根据任务类型表现更强。

结论: WebCompass为评估大语言模型的网页工程能力提供了一个全面的基准，揭示了现有模型在美学和框架选择方面的局限性。

翻译: 大型语言模型正迅速演变为能够端到端网络编码的交互式编码代理，然而现有基准测试仅评估了这种能力的狭窄切片，通常仅关注文本条件生成和静态正确性指标，忽略了视觉保真度、交互质量和代码库级推理。我们介绍了WebCompass，一个多模态基准测试，提供网页工程能力的统一生命周期评估。认识到现实世界的网络编码是生成、编辑和修复的迭代循环，WebCompass涵盖了三种输入模态（文本、图像、视频）和三种任务类型（生成、编辑、修复），产生了七个任务类别，反映了专业工作流程。通过多阶段、人机循环管道，我们策划了涵盖15个生成领域、16种编辑操作类型和11种修复缺陷类型的实例，每个实例都以简单/中等/困难级别标注。对于评估，我们采用清单指导的LLM-as-a-Judge协议用于编辑和修复，并提出了一种新颖的Agent-as-a-Judge范式用于生成，在真实浏览器中自主执行生成的网站，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）探索交互行为，并迭代合成有针对性的测试用例，紧密模拟人类验收测试。我们评估了代表性的闭源和开源模型，并观察到：(1)闭源模型仍然显著更强且更平衡；(2)编辑和修复表现出不同的难度概况，修复保持更好的交互性但执行仍然具有挑战性；(3)美学是最持久的瓶颈，尤其是对于开源模型；(4)框架选择对结果有实质性影响，Vue始终具有挑战性，而React和Vanilla/HTML根据任务类型表现更强。

Abstract

Large language models are rapidly evolving into interactive coding agents capable of end-to-end web coding, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only narrow slices of this capability, typically text-conditioned generation with static-correctness metrics, leaving visual fidelity, interaction quality, and codebase-level reasoning largely unmeasured. We introduce WebCompass, a multimodal benchmark that provides unified lifecycle evaluation of web engineering capability. Recognizing that real-world web coding is an iterative cycle of generation, editing, and repair, WebCompass spans three input modalities (text, image, video) and three task types (generation, editing, repair), yielding seven task categories that mirror professional workflows. Through a multi-stage, human-in-the-loop pipeline, we curate instances covering 15 generation domains, 16 editing operation types, and 11 repair defect types, each annotated at Easy/Medium/Hard levels. For evaluation, we adopt a checklist-guided LLM-as-a-Judge protocol for editing and repair, and propose a novel Agent-as-a-Judge paradigm for generation that autonomously executes generated websites in a real browser, explores interactive behaviors via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and iteratively synthesizes targeted test cases, closely approximating human acceptance testing. We evaluate representative closed-source and open-source models and observe that: (1) closed-source models remain substantially stronger and more balanced; (2) editing and repair exhibit distinct difficulty profiles, with repair preserving interactivity better but remaining execution-challenging; (3) aesthetics is the most persistent bottleneck, especially for open-source models; and (4) framework choice materially affects outcomes, with Vue consistently challenging while React and Vanilla/HTML perform more strongly depending on task type.

item.title: Equivalence of Local Dynamical Hidden-Variable Models to Static Bell Locality
item.author: Ming Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了局部动力学模型是否能够绕过贝尔定理，并建立了一个广义过渡核框架来涵盖任意局部动力学。

背景: 物理直觉表明，局部动力学演化或测量引起的隐藏变量干扰可能会绕过贝尔定理。

目的: 建立一个广义过渡核框架以涵盖任意局部动力学，并证明任何严格局部动力学模型在数学上等同于静态贝尔模型。

方法: 通过建立广义过渡核框架，涵盖任意局部动力学，并分析历史时间模型和宏观引导波流体动力学类比等方法。

主要发现: 任何试图绕过这一等价性的尝试（包括历史时间模型和宏观引导波流体动力学类比）不可避免地引入显式非局域性（参数依赖）或放弃测量独立性。

结论: 非局域统计相关性无法由纯局部动力学过程产生。

翻译: 物理直觉表明，局部动力学演化或测量引起的隐藏变量干扰可能会绕过贝尔定理。我们建立了一个广义过渡核框架，涵盖任意局部动力学，并严格证明任何严格局部动力学模型在数学上等同于静态贝尔模型。我们表明，任何试图绕过这一等价性的尝试——包括历史时间模型和最近的宏观引导波流体动力学类比——不可避免地引入显式非局域性（参数依赖）或放弃测量独立性。我们的结果确立了一个一般边界：非局域统计相关性无法由纯局部动力学过程产生。

Abstract

Physical intuition suggests that local dynamical evolution or measurement-induced disturbances of hidden variables might bypass Bell's theorem. We establish a generalized transition-kernel framework encompassing arbitrary local dynamics and rigorously prove that any strictly local dynamical model is mathematically equivalent to a static Bell model. We show that attempts to circumvent this equivalence -- including historical temporal models and recent macroscopic pilot-wave hydrodynamic analogs -- inevitably introduce explicit nonlocality (parameter dependence) or forfeit measurement independence. Our results establish a general boundary: nonlocal statistical correlations cannot be generated by purely local dynamical processes.

item.title: WiFo-MiSAC: A Wireless Foundation Model for Multimodal Sensing and Communication Integration via Synesthesia of Machines (SoM)
item.author: Xuanyu Liu, Shijian Gao, Boxun Liu, Xiang Cheng, Liuqing Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WiFo-MiSAC是一种任务无关的基础模型，通过将异构信号标记化为统一空间进行自监督预训练，采用共享-特定解纠缠混合专家架构来分离模态共享和模态特定表示，结合掩码重建与对比对齐实现下游任务性能提升。

背景: 当前基于学习的方法由于通信和感知数据的碎片化处理，在泛化方面面临困难。

目的: WiFo-MiSAC旨在解决这一问题，作为一个任务无关的基础模型。

方法: 采用共享-特定解纠缠混合专家（SS-DMoE）架构来解耦模态共享和模态特定表示，促进交互而不受跨模态干扰；通过结合掩码重建与对比对齐进行自监督预训练。

主要发现: 模型在波束预测和信道估计等下游任务中实现了最先进的性能；实验结果展示了稳健的少样本适应能力和新模态的无缝集成。

结论: WiFo-MiSAC为未来集成感知与通信系统提供了一个可扩展的骨干网络。

翻译: 当前基于学习的方法由于通信和感知数据的碎片化处理，在泛化方面面临困难。WiFo-MiSAC作为一个任务无关的基础模型，通过将异构信号标记化为统一空间进行自监督预训练，解决了这一问题。采用共享-特定解纠缠混合专家（SS-DMoE）架构来解耦模态共享和模态特定表示，促进交互而不受跨模态干扰。通过结合掩码重建与对比对齐，模型在波束预测和信道估计等下游任务中实现了最先进的性能。实验结果展示了稳健的少样本适应能力和新模态的无缝集成，将WiFo-MiSAC定位为未来集成感知与通信系统的可扩展骨干网络。

Abstract

Current learning-based wireless methods struggle with generalization due to the fragmented processing of communication and sensing data. WiFo-MiSAC addresses this as a task-agnostic foundation model that tokenizes heterogeneous signals into a unified space for self-supervised pre-training. A shared-specific disentangled mixture-of-experts (SS-DMoE) architecture is employed to decouple modality-shared and modality-specific representations, facilitating interaction without cross-modal interference. By combining masked reconstruction with contrastive alignment, the model achieves state-of-the-art performance across downstream tasks, including beam prediction and channel estimation. Experimental results demonstrate robust few-shot adaptation and seamless integration of new modalities, positioning WiFo-MiSAC as a scalable backbone for future integrated sensing and communication systems.

item.title: Geometry-Guided 3D Visual Token Pruning for Video-Language Models
item.author: Han Li, Zehao Huang, Jiahui Fu, Naiyan Wang, Si Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Geo3DPruner是一种几何引导的3D视觉标记修剪框架，旨在通过两阶段修剪过程提高3D场景理解效率。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在2D视觉方面表现出色，但将其扩展到3D场景理解时面临视觉标记数量过多的问题。现有修剪方法忽略了空间视频的视图一致性和剩余标记的空间多样性。

目的: 提出Geo3DPruner框架，以有效去除帧间冗余并保持场景完整性，同时提高推理效率。

方法: Geo3DPruner首先通过几何感知的全局注意力建模跨帧相关性，然后执行两阶段修剪过程：体素内阶段选择每个体素内的代表性多视图特征，体素间阶段通过选择全局分布的体素子集来保留空间多样性。

主要发现: 在多个3D场景理解基准测试中，Geo3DPruner在修剪90%视觉标记的同时保留了超过90%的原始性能，显著优于现有的文本引导和视觉引导修剪方法。

结论: Geo3DPruner在保持高精度的同时大幅减少了视觉标记数量，显著提高了3D场景理解任务的效率。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在2D视觉方面表现出色，这促使人们将其扩展到3D场景理解。近期研究将3D场景表示为包含深度和相机姿态信息的图像序列的3D空间视频，使预训练的视频语言模型能够执行3D推理任务。然而，空间视频中大量的视觉标记仍然是高效推理和上下文管理的主要瓶颈。现有的修剪方法忽略了空间视频的视图一致性和剩余标记的空间多样性，这阻碍了它们有效去除帧间冗余并保持场景完整性。在本文中，我们提出了Geo3DPruner，一种几何引导的3D视觉标记修剪框架。Geo3DPruner首先通过几何感知的全局注意力建模跨帧相关性，然后执行两阶段修剪过程。体素内阶段选择每个体素内的代表性多视图特征，而体素间阶段通过选择全局分布的体素子集来保留空间多样性。在多个3D场景理解基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Geo3DPruner在修剪90%的视觉标记的同时保留了超过90%的原始性能，显著优于现有的文本引导和视觉引导修剪方法。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决多模态大语言模型在处理 3D 场景时，因视觉 Token 数量巨大导致计算效率低的问题。现有方法忽略了空间视频的视图一致性和 Token 的空间多样性，无法有效去除帧间冗余并保留场景完整性。这个问题在现实中很重要，因为 3D 场景理解是实现物理世界空间智能的关键。保留 Token 的空间多样性对于以物体为中心的 3D 任务至关重要，能确保场景覆盖全面。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法忽略了视角一致性和空间多样性，导致无法有效去除跨帧冗余。因此，他们利用几何感知的全局注意力建模跨帧相关性，设计了包含体素内和体素间两阶段的剪枝框架。在借鉴方面，他们基于Video-3D LLM和VG LLM，并使用了VGGT等前馈3D重建模型提取几何特征，同时改进了现有的文本引导和视觉引导剪枝方法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用几何相关性建模跨帧依赖，去除因不同视角产生的冗余视觉 Token，同时保留 3D 场景的完整性。整体实现流程首先通过 2D 视觉和 3D 几何编码器处理视频，将视觉特征分配到对应的体素位置；随后进行两阶段修剪：第一阶段在体素内选择最具代表性的多视图 Token，第二阶段在体素间选择空间分布多样的 Token 子集。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 本文提出了Geo3DPruner框架，利用几何感知的全局注意力建模跨帧相关性，并采用两阶段剪枝策略：第一阶段在体素内选择代表性特征，第二阶段在体素间选择空间分布多样的token。相比之前的工作，现有方法通常局限于单帧或相邻帧，忽略了全局跨帧相关性以及token的空间多样性，而Geo3DPruner通过几何特征建模全局相关性，有效消除了不同视角的冗余并保留了场景完整性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为 Geo3DPruner 的几何引导式 3D 视觉 Token 剪枝框架，通过两阶段剪枝策略在去除冗余 Token 的同时保持 3D 场景的完整性。

Abstract

Multimodal large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in 2D vision, motivating their extension to 3D scene understanding. Recent studies represent 3D scenes as 3D spatial videos composed of image sequences with depth and camera pose information, enabling pre-trained video-language models to perform 3D reasoning tasks. However, the large number of visual tokens in spatial videos remains a major bottleneck for efficient inference and context management. Existing pruning methods overlook the view consistency of spatial videos and the spatial diversity of the remaining tokens, which prevents them from effectively removing inter-frame redundancy and preserving scene completeness. In this paper, we propose Geo3DPruner, a Geometry-Guided 3D Visual Token Pruning framework. Geo3DPruner first models cross-frame relevance through geometry-aware global attention, and then performs a two-stage pruning process. The intra-voxel stage selects representative multi-view features within each voxel, while the inter-voxel stage preserves spatial diversity by selecting a globally distributed subset of voxels. Extensive experiments on multiple 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Geo3DPruner retains over 90% of the original performance while pruning 90% of visual tokens, significantly outperforming existing text-guided and vision-guided pruning methods.

item.title: Enhancing Tabular Anomaly Detection via Pseudo-Label-Guided Generation
item.author: Wei Huang, Yuxuan Xiong, Hezhe Qiao, Yu-Ming Shang, Xiangling Fu, Guansong Pang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PLAG的伪标签引导异常生成方法，旨在提升表格数据的异常检测性能。

背景: 由于真实异常标签稀缺，现有方法主要依赖无监督模型或利用少量标签通过样本生成或对比学习进行检测。然而，无监督方法缺乏足够的异常感知，而当前的生成和对比方法倾向于全局计算异常，忽略了表格特征的局部异常模式，导致检测性能不佳。

目的: 为了解决现有方法的局限性，提出PLAG方法，以增强表格数据的异常检测能力。

方法: PLAG利用伪异常作为引导信号，并将样本的整体异常量化分解为特征级异常的累积。此外，提出了一个两阶段数据选择策略，结合格式验证和不确定性估计来严格筛选候选样本，确保合成异常的保真度和多样性。

主要发现: PLAG在八个代表性基线方法中实现了最先进的性能。作为一种灵活的框架，它可以无缝集成到现有的无监督检测器中，一致地将F1分数提高了0.08到0.21。

结论: PLAG通过伪标签引导和两阶段数据选择策略，有效地消除了对稀缺真实标签的需求，并为模型提供了在细粒度层面理解局部异常信号的新视角，从而显著提升了异常检测性能。

翻译: 在表格数据中识别异常实例对于提高数据可靠性和维持系统稳定性至关重要。由于真实异常标签的稀缺，现有方法主要依赖无监督异常检测模型，或者利用少量标记的异常通过样本生成或对比学习来促进检测。然而，无监督方法缺乏足够的异常感知，而当前的生成和对比方法倾向于全局计算异常，忽略了表格特征的局部异常模式，导致检测性能不理想。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了PLAG，一种伪标签引导的异常生成方法，旨在增强表格异常检测。具体而言，通过利用伪异常作为引导信号，并将样本的整体异常量化分解为特征级异常的累积，PLAG不仅有效地消除了对稀缺真实标签的需求，还为模型提供了在细粒度层面理解局部异常信号的新视角。此外，提出了一个两阶段数据选择策略，结合格式验证和不确定性估计来严格筛选候选样本，从而确保合成异常的保真度和多样性。最终，这些筛选出的合成异常作为稳健的判别性引导，使模型能够更好地分离正常和异常实例。广泛的实验表明，PLAG在八个代表性基线中实现了最先进的性能。此外，作为一个灵活的框架，它可以无缝集成到现有的无监督检测器中，一致地将F1分数提高了0.08到0.21。

Abstract

Identifying anomalous instances in tabular data is essential for improving data reliability and maintaining system stability. Due to the scarcity of ground-truth anomaly labels, existing methods mainly rely on unsupervised anomaly detection models, or exploit a small number of labeled anomalies to facilitate detection via sample generation or contrastive learning. However, unsupervised methods lack sufficient anomaly awareness, while current generation and contrastive approaches tend to compute anomalies globally, overlooking the localized anomaly patterns of tabular features, resulting in suboptimal detection performance. To address these limitations, we propose PLAG, a pseudo-label-guided anomaly generation method designed to enhance tabular anomaly detection. Specifically, by utilizing pseudo-anomalies as guidance signals and decoupling the overall anomaly quantification of a sample into an accumulation of feature-level abnormalities, PLAG not only effectively obviates the need for scarce ground-truth labels but also provides a novel perspective for the model to comprehend localized anomalous signals at a fine-grained level. Furthermore, a two-stage data selection strategy is proposed, integrating format verification and uncertainty estimation to rigorously filter candidate samples, thereby ensuring the fidelity and diversity of the synthetic anomalies. Ultimately, these filtered synthetic anomalies serve as robust discriminative guidance, empowering the model to better separate normal and anomalous instances. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PLAG achieves state-of-the-art performance against eight representative baselines. Moreover, as a flexible framework, it integrates seamlessly with existing unsupervised detectors, consistently boosting F1-scores by 0.08 to 0.21.

item.title: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
item.author: Guanting Dong, Junting Lu, Junjie Huang, Wanjun Zhong, Longxiang Liu, Shijue Huang, Zhenyu Li, Yang Zhao, Xiaoshuai Song, Xiaoxi Li, Jiajie Jin, Yutao Zhu, Hanbin Wang, Fangyu Lei, Qinyu Luo, Mingyang Chen, Zehui Chen, Jiazhan Feng, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了Agent-World，一个用于通过可扩展环境推进通用智能体智能的自进化训练竞技场。

背景: 大型语言模型被期望作为通用智能体与外部有状态工具环境交互，但训练鲁棒的智能体受到缺乏真实环境和终身学习原则机制的限制。

目的: 通过可扩展环境推进通用智能体智能，解决训练鲁棒智能体面临的缺乏真实环境和原则性终身学习机制的问题。

方法: Agent-World包含两个主要组件：1. 智能体环境任务发现，自动探索主题对齐数据库和可执行工具生态系统，合成可验证任务；2. 持续自进化智能体训练，结合多环境强化学习和自进化智能体竞技场，通过动态任务合成识别能力差距并驱动针对性学习。
