Macro-averaging mitigates this bias by weighting clusters equally, but may overemphasize noise from under-represented groups. We introduce Composite Silhouette, an internal criterion for cluster-count selection that aggregates evidence across repeated subsampled clusterings rather than relying on a single partition. For each subsample, micro- and macro-averaged Silhouette scores are combined through an adaptive convex weight determined by their normalized discrepancy and smoothed by a bounded nonlinearity; the final score is then obtained by averaging these subsample-level composites. We establish key properties of the criterion and derive finite-sample concentration guarantees for its subsampling estimate. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that Composite Silhouette effectively reconciles the strengths of micro- and macro-averaging, yielding more accurate recovery of the ground-truth number of clusters.

item.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization
item.author: Zhengxi Lu, Fei Tang, Guangyi Liu, Kaitao Song, Xu Tan, Jin Ma, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UI-Copilot是一个协作框架，旨在解决基于多模态大语言模型的GUI代理在长期任务中的挑战，通过将GUI代理与轻量级副驾驶分离，实现记忆解耦和工具集成策略优化。

背景: MLLM-based GUI agents在复杂用户界面交互任务中表现出强大能力，但在长期场景中面临超出其内在能力的任务负担，导致记忆退化、进度混淆和数学幻觉等问题。

目的: 提出UI-Copilot框架，通过协作机制使GUI代理专注于任务执行，同时轻量级副驾驶提供按需记忆检索和数值计算辅助，以解决长期场景中的挑战。

方法: 引入记忆解耦将持久观察与临时执行上下文分离；训练策略代理根据任务需求选择性调用副驾驶作为检索器或计算器；提出工具集成策略优化（TIPO），分别通过单轮预测优化工具选择，通过多轮滚动优化任务执行。

主要发现: UI-Copilot-7B在挑战性MemGUI-Bench上达到最先进性能，优于GUI-Owl-7B和UI-TARS-1.5-7B；在AndroidWorld上比基础Qwen模型提升17.1%，显示出对真实GUI任务的强大泛化能力。

结论: UI-Copilot通过协作框架和工具集成策略优化，有效解决了长期GUI任务中的挑战，实现了显著的性能提升和泛化能力。

翻译: 基于MLLM的GUI代理在复杂的用户界面交互任务中展示了强大的能力。然而，长期场景仍然具有挑战性，因为这些代理背负着超出其内在能力的任务，遭受记忆退化、进度混淆和数学幻觉的困扰。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了UI-Copilot，这是一个协作框架，其中GUI代理专注于任务执行，而轻量级副驾驶提供按需的记忆检索和数值计算辅助。我们引入了记忆解耦，将持久观察与临时执行上下文分离，并训练策略代理根据任务需求选择性调用副驾驶作为检索器或计算器。为了实现有效的工具调用学习，我们提出了工具集成策略优化（TIPO），它分别通过单轮预测优化工具选择，并通过多轮滚动优化任务执行。实验结果表明，UI-Copilot-7B在具有挑战性的MemGUI-Bench上实现了最先进的性能，优于强大的7B规模GUI代理，如GUI-Owl-7B和UI-TARS-1.5-7B。此外，UI-Copilot-7B在AndroidWorld上比基础Qwen模型提升了17.1%，突显了UI-Copilot对真实GUI任务的强大泛化能力。

Abstract

MLLM-based GUI agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex user interface interaction tasks. However, long-horizon scenarios remain challenging, as these agents are burdened with tasks beyond their intrinsic capabilities, suffering from memory degradation, progress confusion, and math hallucination. To address these challenges, we present UI-Copilot, a collaborative framework where the GUI agent focuses on task execution while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance for memory retrieval and numerical computation. We introduce memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context, and train the policy agent to selectively invoke the copilot as Retriever or Calculator based on task demands. To enable effective tool invocation learning, we propose Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO), which separately optimizes tool selection through single-turn prediction and task execution through on-policy multi-turn rollouts. Experimental results show that UI-Copilot-7B achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging MemGUI-Bench, outperforming strong 7B-scale GUI agents such as GUI-Owl-7B and UI-TARS-1.5-7B. Moreover, UI-Copilot-7B delivers a 17.1% absolute improvement on AndroidWorld over the base Qwen model, highlighting UI-Copilot's strong generalization to real-world GUI tasks.

item.title: Robust parameter inference for Taiji via time-frequency contrastive learning and normalizing flows
item.author: Tian-Yang Sun, Bo Liang, Ji-Yu Song, Song-Tao Liu, Shang-Jie Jin, He Wang, Ming-Hui Du, Jing-Fei Zhang, Xin Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对太基探测器配置中大质量黑洞双星参数推断中的瞬态噪声伪影挑战，开发了一种抗故障的推断框架。

背景: 瞬态噪声伪影，通常称为故障，对基于空间的引力波观测参数推断构成了重大挑战。

目的: 开发一种抗故障的推断框架，用于太基探测器配置中的大质量黑洞双星。

方法: 结合条件归一化流、时频多模态融合编码器和对比学习。此外，引入了神经故障生成器以在受污染数据上进行大规模训练。

主要发现: 在故障污染下，提出的方法比传统的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛基线产生更准确和更好校准的后验。全时频模型结合对比学习表现最佳，且对故障持续时间和合并相对时机的变化保持稳健。标准覆盖诊断不足以完全评估后验保真度，因此补充了连续等级概率分数以提供更严格的评估。

结论: 这些结果确立了基于深度学习的推断框架作为未来基于空间的引力波观测中快速和稳健贝叶斯参数估计的有前景的框架。

翻译: 瞬态噪声伪影，通常称为故障，对基于空间的引力波观测参数推断构成了重大挑战。我们通过结合条件归一化流、时频多模态融合编码器和对比学习，为大质量黑洞双星在太基探测器配置中开发了一种抗故障的推断框架。为了在受污染数据上进行大规模训练，我们进一步引入了神经故障生成器，以产生高保真合成瞬态，且计算成本大幅降低。系统实验表明，在故障污染下，提出的方法比传统的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛基线产生更准确和更好校准的后验。在消融研究中，结合对比学习的全时频模型总体表现最佳，且对故障持续时间和合并相对时机的变化保持稳健。我们进一步表明，仅靠标准覆盖诊断不足以完全评估后验保真度。因此，我们用连续等级概率分数补充它们，以提供对非理想引力波数据中全局分布一致性的更严格评估。综上所述，这些结果确立了基于深度学习的推断框架作为未来基于空间的引力波观测中快速和稳健贝叶斯参数估计的有前景的框架。

Abstract

Transient noise artifacts, commonly referred to as glitches, pose a major challenge to parameter inference for space-based gravitational-wave (GW) observations. We develop a glitch-robust amortized inference framework for massive black hole binaries in the Taiji detector configuration by combining conditional normalizing flows, a time-frequency multimodal fusion encoder, and contrastive learning. To enable large-scale training on contaminated data, we further introduce a neural glitch generator that produces high-fidelity synthetic transients at substantially reduced computational cost. Systematic experiments show that, under glitch contamination, the proposed method yields more accurate and better-calibrated posteriors than a conventional Markov Chain Monte Carlo baseline. In ablation studies, the full time-frequency model with contrastive learning performs best overall and remains robust to variations in glitch duration and merger-relative timing. We further show that standard coverage diagnostics alone are insufficient to fully assess posterior fidelity. We therefore complement them with the continuous ranked probability score, which provides a stricter assessment of global distributional agreement in non-ideal GW data. Taken together, these results establish deep-learning-based amortized inference as a promising framework for fast and robust Bayesian parameter estimation in future space-based GW observations.

item.title: Context Sensitivity Improves Human-Machine Visual Alignment
item.author: Frieda Born, Tom Neuhäuser, Lukas Muttenthaler, Brett D. Roads, Bernhard Spitzer, Andrew K. Lampinen, Matt Jones, Klaus-Robert Müller, Michael C. Mozer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于神经网络嵌入的上下文敏感相似度计算方法，应用于锚图像作为同时上下文的奇偶一异任务，显著提升了模型性能。

背景: 现代机器学习模型通常将输入表示为高维嵌入空间中的固定点，这与人类根据环境不断适应、以高度上下文敏感的方式处理信息的方式不同。

目的: 为了弥合机器学习模型与人类信息处理方式之间的差距，提出一种从神经网络嵌入中进行上下文敏感相似度计算的方法。

方法: 提出了一种从神经网络嵌入中进行上下文敏感相似度计算的方法，该方法将锚图像作为同时的上下文，应用于建模奇偶一异任务。

主要发现: 建模上下文使模型在奇偶一异准确率上比无上下文模型提高了高达15%，且这种改进在原始和“人类对齐”的视觉基础模型中均一致。

结论: 该方法有效提升了模型在上下文敏感任务中的表现，且效果在多种模型中保持一致。

翻译: 现代机器学习模型通常将输入表示为高维嵌入空间中的固定点。虽然这种方法已被证明对广泛的下游任务非常有效，但它从根本上不同于人类处理信息的方式。因为人类不断适应他们的环境，他们以高度上下文敏感的方式表示对象及其关系。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种从神经网络嵌入中进行上下文敏感相似度计算的方法，应用于建模锚图像作为同时上下文的奇偶一异任务。建模上下文使我们能够在奇偶一异准确率上比无上下文模型提高高达15%。我们发现这种改进在原始和“人类对齐”的视觉基础模型中均一致。

Abstract

Modern machine learning models typically represent inputs as fixed points in a high-dimensional embedding space. While this approach has been proven powerful for a wide range of downstream tasks, it fundamentally differs from the way humans process information. Because humans are constantly adapting to their environment, they represent objects and their relationships in a highly context-sensitive manner. To address this gap, we propose a method for context-sensitive similarity computation from neural network embeddings, applied to modeling a triplet odd-one-out task with an anchor image serving as simultaneous context. Modeling context enables us to achieve up to a 15% improvement in odd-one-out accuracy over a context-insensitive model. We find that this improvement is consistent across both original and "human-aligned" vision foundation models.

item.title: MolCryst-MLIPs: A Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Database for Molecular Crystals
item.author: Adam Lahouari, Shen Ai, Jihye Han, Jillian Hoffstadt, Philipp Hoellmer, Charlotte Infante, Pulkita Jain, Sangram Kadam, Maya M. Martirossyan, Amara McCune, Hypatia Newton, Shlok J. Paul, Willmor Pena, Jonathan Raghoonanan, Sumon Sahu, Oliver Tan, Andrea Vergara, Jutta Rogal, Mark E. Tuckerman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者发布了一个名为MolCryst-MLIPs的开放分子晶体机器学习势数据库，包含九种分子晶体的MACE模型。

背景: 为了简化机器学习势开发流程，从参考数据生成到模型训练和验证，作者开发了自动化机器学习管道（AMLP）。

目的: 构建一个可重现且用户友好的MLIP开发流程，并发布经过验证的MLIPs和数据库，以便在不同热力学条件下进行分子晶体多晶型生产的分子动力学模拟。

方法: 使用AMLP开发流程，从MACE-MH-1基础模型进行微调，并通过分子动力学模拟评估模型的动力学稳定性和结构完整性，评估指标包括能量守恒、P2取向序参数和径向分布函数。

主要发现: 微调后的模型在所有系统上的平均能量平均绝对误差为0.141 kJ/mol/atom，平均力平均绝对误差为0.648 kJ/Angstrom。

结论: 发布的模型和数据集构成了一个不断增长的开放数据库，包含经过验证的MLIPs，可用于生产分子晶体多晶型的分子动力学模拟。

翻译: 我们介绍了一个名为MolCryst-MLIPs的开放分子晶体（MC）数据库，包含机器学习势（MLIP）。第一个版本包含九种分子晶体系统的微调MACE模型——苯甲酰胺、苯甲酸、香豆素、茋、异烟酰胺、烟酰胺、尼可酰胺、吡嗪酰胺和间苯二酚——这些模型是使用自动化机器学习管道（AMLP）开发的，该管道将整个MLIP开发工作流程从参考数据生成到模型训练和验证简化为一个可重现且用户友好的流程。模型是从MACE-MH-1基础模型（omol头）微调而来的，在所有系统上的平均能量MAE为0.141 kJ/mol/atom，平均力MAE为0.648 kJ/Angstrom。通过分子动力学模拟评估了通过能量守恒、P2取向序参数和径向分布函数评估的动力学稳定性和结构完整性。发布的模型和数据集构成了一个不断增长的开放数据库，包含经过验证的MLIPs，准备在不同热力学条件下进行分子晶体多晶型的生产分子动力学模拟。

Abstract

We present an open Molecular Crystal (MC) database of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials (MLIP) called MolCryst-MLIPs. The first release comprises fine-tuned MACE models for nine molecular crystal systems -- Benzamide, Benzoic acid, Coumarin, Durene, Isonicotinamide, Niacinamide, Nicotinamide, Pyrazinamide, and Resorcinol -- developed using the Automated Machine Learning Pipeline (AMLP), which streamlines the entire MLIP development workflow, from reference data generation to model training and validation, into a reproducible and user-friendly pipeline. Models are fine-tuned from the MACE-MH-1 foundation model (omol head), yielding a mean energy MAE of 0.141 kJ/mol/atom and a mean force MAE of 0.648 kJ/mol/Angstrom across all systems. Dynamical stability and structural integrity, as assessed through energy conservation, P2 orientational order parameters, and radial distribution functions, are evaluated using molecular dynamics simulations. The released models and datasets constitute a growing open database of validated MLIPs, ready for production MD simulations of molecular crystal polymorphism under different thermodynamic conditions.

item.title: Towards Enabling An Artificial Self-Construction Software Life-cycle via Autopoietic Architectures
item.author: Daniel Rodriguez-Cardenas, David Nader Palacio, Denys Poshyvanyk
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于人工生命理念的自构建软件架构，旨在通过引入自构建机制实现软件的自主演化和维护。

背景: 软件工程研究一直致力于自动化维护和演化过程以降低成本和提高可靠性。随着基础模型在代码理解和推理方面能力的增强，为自主软件行为提供了新机遇。

目的: 探索自构建软件的潜力，特别是自构建架构 Psi-Arch 作为自构建软件的基础框架。

方法: 通过分析传统维护方法的局限性以及当前软件开发生命周期自动化的空白，识别实现自构建的核心挑战，包括集成基于基础模型的推理单元和建立新型架构范式。

主要发现: 本文未提出确定的解决方案，而是旨在激发讨论并启发研究，推动软件工程迈向新范式。

结论: 自构建软件代表了软件开发生命周期自动化的下一个前沿。

翻译: 软件工程研究一直专注于自动化维护和演化过程，以降低成本并提高可靠性。随着基础模型的出现，它们在代码理解和推理方面表现出强大的能力，为自主软件行为提供了新的机遇。受人工生命理念的启发，我们通过引入自构建机制，实现了软件开发生命周期（SDLC）的根本性转变，使软件能够自主演化和维护。这篇立场论文探讨了自构建架构的潜力，特别是自构建架构 Psi-Arch，作为自构建软件的基础框架。我们首先分析了传统维护方法的局限性，并确定了当前 SDLC 自动化中的空白。随后，我们概述了实现自构建的核心挑战，包括集成基于基础模型的推理单元和建立新型架构范式。虽然本文没有提出确定的解决方案，但它旨在催化讨论并启发研究，推动软件工程迈向新范式，即自构建软件代表了 SDLC 自动化的下一个前沿。

Abstract

Software engineering research has focused on automating maintenance and evolution processes to reduce costs and improve reliability. The emergence of foundation models (FMs) with strong code understanding and reasoning abilities offers new opportunities for autonomous software behavior. Inspired by Artificial Life (ALife), we propose a fundamental shift in the Software Development Life-Cycle (SDLC) by introducing self-construction mechanisms that enable software to evolve and maintain autonomously. This position paper explores the potential of Autopoietic Architectures, specifically Psi-Arch, as a foundational framework for self-constructing software. We first analyze the limitations of traditional maintenance approaches and identify gaps in current SDLC automation. Subsequently, we outline the core challenges in achieving self-construction, including the integration of foundation-model-based reasoning units and the establishment of novel architectural paradigms. Although this paper does not present a definitive solution, it seeks to catalyze discourse and inspire research toward a new paradigm in software engineering, one in which self-constructing software represents the next frontier in SDLC automation.

item.title: [Emerging Ideas] Artificial Tripartite Intelligence: A Bio-Inspired, Sensor-First Architecture for Physical AI
item.author: You Rim Choi, Subeom Park, Hyung-Sin Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文介绍了物理人工智能的ATI架构，该架构包含大脑干、小脑和大脑皮层推理子系统，旨在通过模块化设计优化传感器控制和推理，在移动相机原型中实现了更高的准确性和更少的远程调用。

背景: 随着人工智能从数据中心向机器人和可穿戴设备扩展，单纯扩大模型规模已不足够。物理人工智能在延迟、能源、隐私和可靠性方面面临严格约束，其性能不仅取决于模型容量，还取决于在动态环境中通过可控传感器获取信号的方式。

目的: 提出一种受生物启发的、以传感器为先的ATI架构，旨在通过模块化组织实现传感器控制、自适应传感、边缘-云执行和基础模型推理的协同进化，同时保持时间关键传感和控制设备化，仅在需要时调用高层推理。

方法: ATI架构在系统层面分为三个部分：大脑干（L1）提供反射性安全和信号完整性控制，小脑（L2）执行连续传感器校准，大脑皮层推理子系统（L3/L4）支持常规技能选择和执行、协调及深度推理。该方法在动态光照和运动下的移动相机原型中进行了实例化。

主要发现: 在路由评估（L3-L4拆分推理）中，与默认自动曝光设置相比，ATI（L1/L2自适应传感）将端到端准确率从53.8%提高到88%，同时减少了43.3%的远程L4调用。

结论: 这些结果表明，为具身人工智能协同设计传感和推理具有重要价值。

翻译: 随着人工智能从数据中心向机器人和可穿戴设备扩展，单纯扩大模型规模已不足够。物理人工智能在延迟、能源、隐私和可靠性方面面临严格约束，其性能不仅取决于模型容量，还取决于在动态环境中通过可控传感器获取信号的方式。论文介绍了物理人工智能的ATI架构，该架构包含大脑干、小脑和大脑皮层推理子系统，旨在通过模块化设计优化传感器控制和推理，在移动相机原型中实现了更高的准确性和更少的远程调用。

Abstract

As AI moves from data centers to robots and wearables, scaling ever-larger models becomes insufficient. Physical AI operates under tight latency, energy, privacy, and reliability constraints, and its performance depends not only on model capacity but also on how signals are acquired through controllable sensors in dynamic environments. We present Artificial Tripartite Intelligence (ATI), a bio-inspired, sensor-first architectural contract for physical AI. ATI is tripartite at the systems level: a Brainstem (L1) provides reflexive safety and signal-integrity control, a Cerebellum (L2) performs continuous sensor calibration, and a Cerebral Inference Subsystem spanning L3/L4 supports routine skill selection and execution, coordination, and deep reasoning. This modular organization allows sensor control, adaptive sensing, edge-cloud execution, and foundation model reasoning to co-evolve within one closed-loop architecture, while keeping time-critical sensing and control on device and invoking higher-level inference only when needed. We instantiate ATI in a mobile camera prototype under dynamic lighting and motion. In our routed evaluation (L3-L4 split inference), compared to the default auto-exposure setting, ATI (L1/L2 adaptive sensing) improves end-to-end accuracy from 53.8% to 88% while reducing remote L4 invocations by 43.3%. These results show the value of co-designing sensing and inference for embodied AI.

item.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Methane Sorption: Cross-Gas Transfer Learning, Ensemble Collapse Under Physics Constraints, and Monte Carlo Dropout Uncertainty Quantification
item.author: Mohammad Nooraiepour, Zezhang Song, Wei Li, Sarah Perez
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于物理信息的迁移学习框架，用于预测不同煤阶的甲烷吸附，通过弹性权重巩固、煤特定特征工程和三阶段课程学习，在993个平衡测量数据上实现了高精度预测和不确定性量化。

背景: 现有框架很少同时解决热力学一致性、跨数据稀缺地质系统的知识高效迁移以及校准的不确定性估计问题。

目的: 开发一种物理信息迁移学习框架，将氢吸附PINN适配到甲烷吸附预测，通过弹性权重巩固、煤特定特征工程和三阶段课程学习，实现热力学一致性、高效知识迁移和校准的不确定性估计。

方法: 使用弹性权重巩固、煤特定特征工程和三阶段课程学习，将氢吸附PINN适配到甲烷吸附预测；在从褐煤到无烟煤的114个独立煤实验的993个平衡测量数据上训练；采用五种贝叶斯不确定性量化方法；利用SHAP和ALE分析解释性。

主要发现: 框架在保留样本上R2达到0.932，比仅压力的经典等温线提高227%；氢预训练比随机初始化降低18.9%的均方根误差并加快19.4%的收敛速度；蒙特卡洛Dropout在最小开销下实现良好校准的不确定性；深度集成因共享物理约束导致性能下降；学习表征具有物理可解释性，如水分-挥发分相互作用、压力-温度耦合的非单调效应。

结论: 蒙特卡洛Dropout是该物理约束迁移学习框架中表现最佳的不确定性量化方法；跨气体迁移学习是地质材料建模的数据高效策略。

翻译: Accurate methane sorption prediction across heterogeneous coal ranks requires models that combine thermodynamic consistency, efficient knowledge transfer across data-scarce geological systems, and calibrated uncertainty estimates, capabilities that are rarely addressed together in existing frameworks. We present a physics-informed transfer learning framework that adapts a hydrogen sorption PINN to methane sorption prediction via Elastic Weight Consolidation, coal-specific feature engineering, and a three-phase curriculum that progressively balances transfer preservation with thermodynamic fine-tuning. Trained on 993 equilibrium measurements from 114 independent coal experiments spanning lignite to anthracite, the framework achieves R2 = 0.932 on held-out coal samples, a 227% improvement over pressure-only classical isotherms, while hydrogen pre-training delivers 18.9% lower RMSE and 19.4% faster convergence than random initialization. Five Bayesian uncertainty quantification approaches reveal a systematic divergence in performance across physics-constrained architectures. Monte Carlo Dropout achieves well-calibrated uncertainty at minimal overhead, while deep ensembles, regardless of architectural diversity or initialization strategy, exhibit performance degradation because shared physics constraints narrow the admissible solution manifold. SHAP and ALE analyses confirm that learned representations remain physically interpretable and aligned with established coal sorption mechanisms: moisture-volatile interactions are most influential, pressure-temperature coupling captures thermodynamic co-dependence, and features exhibit non-monotonic effects. These results identify Monte Carlo Dropout as the best-performing UQ method in this physics-constrained transfer learning framework, and demonstrate cross-gas transfer learning as a data-efficient strategy for geological material modeling.

Abstract

Accurate methane sorption prediction across heterogeneous coal ranks requires models that combine thermodynamic consistency, efficient knowledge transfer across data-scarce geological systems, and calibrated uncertainty estimates, capabilities that are rarely addressed together in existing frameworks. We present a physics-informed transfer learning framework that adapts a hydrogen sorption PINN to methane sorption prediction via Elastic Weight Consolidation, coal-specific feature engineering, and a three-phase curriculum that progressively balances transfer preservation with thermodynamic fine-tuning. Trained on 993 equilibrium measurements from 114 independent coal experiments spanning lignite to anthracite, the framework achieves R2 = 0.932 on held-out coal samples, a 227% improvement over pressure-only classical isotherms, while hydrogen pre-training delivers 18.9% lower RMSE and 19.4% faster convergence than random initialization. Five Bayesian uncertainty quantification approaches reveal a systematic divergence in performance across physics-constrained architectures. Monte Carlo Dropout achieves well-calibrated uncertainty at minimal overhead, while deep ensembles, regardless of architectural diversity or initialization strategy, exhibit performance degradation because shared physics constraints narrow the admissible solution manifold. SHAP and ALE analyses confirm that learned representations remain physically interpretable and aligned with established coal sorption mechanisms: moisture-volatile interactions are most influential, pressure-temperature coupling captures thermodynamic co-dependence, and features exhibit non-monotonic effects. These results identify Monte Carlo Dropout as the best-performing UQ method in this physics-constrained transfer learning framework, and demonstrate cross-gas transfer learning as a data-efficient strategy for geological material modeling.

item.title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents
item.author: Kangsan Kim, Minki Kang, Taeil Kim, Yanlai Yang, Mengye Ren, Sung Ju Hwang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种跨域记忆迁移学习方法，旨在解决现有编码代理在单一任务领域内利用记忆的局限性。

背景: 现有的基于记忆的自进化方法通常将记忆利用限制在单一任务领域内，未能利用不同现实世界编码问题之间共享的基础设施（如运行时环境和编程语言）。

目的: 为了解决这一局限性，本文调查并提出了跨域记忆迁移学习（MTL）方法。

方法: 通过利用来自异构领域的统一记忆池进行跨域记忆迁移学习。实验评估了六个编码基准测试中的四种记忆表示（从具体轨迹到抽象见解）。

主要发现: 跨域记忆平均提高了3.7%的性能，主要通过转移元知识（如验证例程）而非特定任务的代码。抽象程度决定了可迁移性；高层见解泛化良好，而低层轨迹往往因过度具体性导致负迁移。记忆池的大小影响迁移效果，且记忆可以在不同模型之间转移。

结论: 本文确立了将记忆利用扩展到单一领域孤岛之外的经验设计原则。

翻译: 基于记忆的自进化已成为编码代理的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有方法通常将记忆利用限制在单一任务领域内，未能利用不同现实世界编码问题之间共享的基础设施（如运行时环境和编程语言）。为了解决这一局限性，我们通过利用来自异构领域的统一记忆池，调查了跨域记忆迁移学习（MTL）。我们在六个编码基准测试中评估了四种记忆表示的性能，范围从具体轨迹到抽象见解。我们的实验表明，跨域记忆平均提高了3.7%的性能，主要通过转移元知识（如验证例程），而不是特定任务的代码。重要的是，我们发现抽象程度决定了可迁移性；高层见解泛化良好，而低层轨迹往往因过度具体性导致负迁移。此外，我们还表明迁移效果随记忆池大小的增加而增加，并且记忆甚至可以在不同模型之间转移。我们的工作确立了将记忆利用扩展到单一领域孤岛之外的经验设计原则。

Abstract

Memory-based self-evolution has emerged as a promising paradigm for coding agents. However, existing approaches typically restrict memory utilization to homogeneous task domains, failing to leverage the shared infrastructural foundations, such as runtime environments and programming languages, that exist across diverse real-world coding problems. To address this limitation, we investigate \textbf{Memory Transfer Learning} (MTL) by harnessing a unified memory pool from heterogeneous domains. We evaluate performance across 6 coding benchmarks using four memory representations, ranging from concrete traces to abstract insights. Our experiments demonstrate that cross-domain memory improves average performance by 3.7\%, primarily by transferring meta-knowledge, such as validation routines, rather than task-specific code. Importantly, we find that abstraction dictates transferability; high-level insights generalize well, whereas low-level traces often induce negative transfer due to excessive specificity. Furthermore, we show that transfer effectiveness scales with the size of the memory pool, and memory can be transferred even between different models. Our work establishes empirical design principles for expanding memory utilization beyond single-domain silos. Project page: https://memorytransfer.github.io/

item.title: Free Geometry: Refining 3D Reconstruction from Longer Versions of Itself
item.author: Yuhang Dai, Xingyi Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Free Geometry 框架通过自监督学习在测试时改进前馈3D重建模型，无需3D真值，提升重建精度。

背景: 前馈3D重建模型高效但缺乏灵活性，在遮挡、高光和模糊线索下重建结果常含错误。

目的: 使前馈3D重建模型能够在测试时自我进化，无需3D真值即可适应测试场景。

方法: 通过遮挡部分帧构建自监督任务，强制全观测与部分观测表示间的跨视图特征一致性，并保持被遮挡帧对之间的成对关系，利用轻量级LoRA更新实现快速重校准。

主要发现: 该方法在4个基准数据集上持续改进了最先进的基座模型，包括Depth Anything 3和VGGT，相机位姿准确率平均提升3.73%，点云预测平均提升2.88%。

结论: Free Geometry框架能有效提升前馈3D重建模型的性能，代码已开源。

翻译: 前馈3D重建模型高效但僵化：一旦训练完成，它们以零样本方式进行推理，无法适应测试场景。因此，视觉上合理的重建通常包含错误，特别是在遮挡、高光和模糊线索下。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了Free Geometry，一个使前馈3D重建模型能够在测试时无需任何3D真值的情况下自我进化的框架。我们的关键见解是，当模型接收到更多视图时，它会产生更可靠和视图一致的重建结果。利用这一属性，给定一个测试序列，我们遮挡一部分帧来构建一个自监督任务。Free Geometry强制全观测和部分观测表示之间的跨视图特征一致性，同时保持被遮挡帧所暗示的成对关系。这种自监督允许通过轻量级LoRA更新进行快速重校准，在单个GPU上每个数据集耗时不到2分钟。我们的方法在4个基准数据集上持续改进了最先进的基座模型，包括Depth Anything 3和VGGT，使相机位姿准确率平均提高3.73%，点云预测平均提高2.88%。代码可在 https://github.com/hiteacherIamhumble/Free-Geometry 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决前馈3D重建模型在测试时缺乏适应性、无法根据新场景调整参数的问题。这些模型一旦训练完成就固定不变，导致在遮挡或镜面反射等复杂情况下重建出现几何错误。这个问题很重要，因为现实场景复杂多变，模型需要具备自我进化能力来提高重建精度，且该方法无需额外的3D真值数据，降低了应用成本。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于“更多视图能提供更强几何约束”的直觉，借鉴了知识蒸馏和关系知识蒸馏的思想，将全视图预测作为教师，部分视图预测作为学生，通过遮挡部分帧构建自监督任务，强制特征一致性。同时，他们利用LoRA技术实现轻量级快速更新。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用“更多视角能提供更可靠几何约束”的直觉，将完整视图的特征作为教师，对被遮蔽视图的特征进行学生蒸馏。实现流程是：输入测试序列后，全视图通过冻结的骨干网络提取特征作为教师特征，部分视图通过同一冻结骨干网络并附加轻量级LoRA模块提取特征作为学生特征，最后通过特征一致性损失优化LoRA参数，使模型在测试时快速自我进化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于利用“更多视图更好”的规律，将全视图预测作为遮盖视图预测的监督信号，并通过特征级一致性实现模型的快速自我进化。相比之前的工作，它不同于Test3R，因为它使用全视图作为更强的教师信号而非对称一致性；也不同于TENT/TTT，因为它利用架构保证的质量层级而非熵或旋转预测作为监督。此外，它在特征级而非输出级进行适应，以节省时间和内存。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种无需 3D 真值的测试时适应框架，利用“更多视图更好”的直觉，通过特征一致性约束让模型在测试时自我进化，从而提高重建精度。

Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models are efficient but rigid: once trained, they perform inference in a zero-shot manner and cannot adapt to the test scene. As a result, visually plausible reconstructions often contain errors, particularly under occlusions, specularities, and ambiguous cues. To address this, we introduce Free Geometry, a framework that enables feed-forward 3D reconstruction models to self-evolve at test time without any 3D ground truth. Our key insight is that, when the model receives more views, it produces more reliable and view-consistent reconstructions. Leveraging this property, given a testing sequence, we mask a subset of frames to construct a self-supervised task. Free Geometry enforces cross-view feature consistency between representations from full and partial observations, while maintaining the pairwise relations implied by the held-out frames. This self-supervision allows for fast recalibration via lightweight LoRA updates, taking less than 2 minutes per dataset on a single GPU. Our approach consistently improves state-of-the-art foundation models, including Depth Anything 3 and VGGT, across 4 benchmark datasets, yielding an average improvement of 3.73% in camera pose accuracy and 2.88% in point map prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/hiteacherIamhumble/Free-Geometry .

item.title: Training-Free Semantic Multi-Object Tracking with Vision-Language Models
item.author: Laurence Bonat, Francesco Tonini, Elisa Ricci, Lorenzo Vaquero
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TF-SMOT 是一种无需训练的语义多目标跟踪方法，通过组合预训练组件实现从轨迹到人类可解释描述的转变。

背景: 现有的语义多目标跟踪系统是端到端训练的，耦合了进度与昂贵的监督，限制了快速适应新基础模型和新交互的能力。

目的: 提出 TF-SMOT，一种无需训练的语义多目标跟踪流水线，旨在快速适应新基础模型和新交互，并生成视频摘要、实例级描述和交互标签。

方法: TF-SMOT 结合了 D-FINE 和 promptable SAM2 分割跟踪器以产生时间一致的轨迹片段，使用轮廓定位生成视频摘要和实例描述，并通过基于词汇表的语义检索与 LLM 歧义消除将提取的交互谓词与 BenSMOT WordNet 同义词对齐。

主要发现: 在 BenSMOT 上，TF-SMOT 在语义多目标跟踪设置中实现了最先进的跟踪性能，并提高了摘要和描述质量；然而，在细粒度和长尾 WordNet 标签空间的严格精确匹配评估下，交互识别仍然具有挑战性。

结论: 语义重叠和标签粒度显著影响测量的性能，分析表明交互识别在细粒度标签空间中仍面临挑战。

翻译: 语义多目标跟踪（SMOT）通过视频摘要、实例级描述和交互标签等语义输出来扩展多目标跟踪，旨在从轨迹转向动态场景的人类可解释描述。现有的 SMOT 系统是端到端训练的，耦合了进度与昂贵的监督，限制了快速适应新基础模型和新交互的能力。我们提出了 TF-SMOT，一种无需训练的 SMOT 流水线，它组合了检测、基于掩码的跟踪和视频语言生成等预训练组件。TF-SMOT 结合了 D-FINE 和可提示的 SAM2 分割跟踪器以产生时间一致的轨迹片段，使用轮廓定位利用 InternVideo2.5 生成视频摘要和实例描述，并通过基于词汇表的语义检索与 LLM 歧义消除将提取的交互谓词与 BenSMOT WordNet 同义词对齐。在 BenSMOT 上，TF-SMOT 在 SMOT 设置中实现了最先进的跟踪性能，并提高了摘要和描述质量。然而，在细粒度和长尾 WordNet 标签空间的严格精确匹配评估下，交互识别仍然具有挑战性；我们的分析和消融实验表明，语义重叠和标签粒度显著影响测量的性能。

Abstract

Semantic Multi-Object Tracking (SMOT) extends multi-object tracking with semantic outputs such as video summaries, instance-level captions, and interaction labels, aiming to move from trajectories to human-interpretable descriptions of dynamic scenes. Existing SMOT systems are trained end-to-end, coupling progress to expensive supervision, limiting the ability to rapidly adapt to new foundation models and new interactions. We propose TF-SMOT, a training-free SMOT pipeline that composes pretrained components for detection, mask-based tracking, and video-language generation. TF-SMOT combines D-FINE and the promptable SAM2 segmentation tracker to produce temporally consistent tracklets, uses contour grounding to generate video summaries and instance captions with InternVideo2.5, and aligns extracted interaction predicates to BenSMOT WordNet synsets via gloss-based semantic retrieval with LLM disambiguation. On BenSMOT, TF-SMOT achieves state-of-the-art tracking performance within the SMOT setting and improves summary and caption quality compared to prior art. Interaction recognition, however, remains challenging under strict exact-match evaluation on the fine-grained and long-tailed WordNet label space; our analysis and ablations indicate that semantic overlap and label granularity substantially affect measured performance.

item.title: TIP: Token Importance in On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Yuanda Xu, Hejian Sang, Zhengze Zhou, Ran He, Zhipeng Wang, Alborz Geramifard
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了On-policy知识蒸馏（OPD）中哪些token对学习最有用，提出了TIP分类法，并发现高熵和低熵高分歧的token是关键。

背景: 现有的token重要性观点不完整，并非所有token位置同等重要。本文直接提问：在OPD中，哪些token携带最有用的学习信号？

目的: 识别在On-policy知识蒸馏中携带最有用学习信号的token，并解释为什么熵是有效但结构上不完整的。

方法: 提出了TIP（Token Importance in on-Policy distillation）分类法，基于学生熵和师生分歧两个维度对token重要性进行分类；提出了类型感知的token选择规则。

主要发现: 1. 有用的token来自两个区域：高学生熵和低学生熵加高师生分歧（学生过度自信且错误）；2. 学生熵是强的一阶代理，保留50%的熵采样token与全token训练匹配且峰值内存减少47%；3. 低熵高分歧token训练效果接近全token基线，表明过度自信的token携带密集的修正信号；4. 在DeepPlanning基准上，Q3模型在<20%的token上训练超越全tokenOPD。

结论: 通过结合不确定性和分歧的类型感知token选择规则，可以在大幅减少内存使用的情况下实现与全token训练相当甚至更优的性能，支持在有限GPU预算下对更大模型进行高效蒸馏。

翻译: On-policy知识蒸馏（OPD）在教师token级监督下，利用自身的rollouts训练学生模型。并非所有token位置同等重要，但现有的token重要性观点不完整。本文直接提问：在OPD中，哪些token携带最有用的学习信号？我们的回答是，有用的token来自两个区域：高学生熵的位置，以及低学生熵加高师生分歧的位置（此时学生过度自信且错误）。实验表明，学生熵是一个强的一阶代理：保留50%的基于熵采样的token与全token训练匹配，且峰值内存减少高达47%。但仅靠熵会遗漏第二个重要区域。当我们隔离低熵、高分歧的token时，在少于10%的token上训练几乎匹配全token基线，表明过度自信的token尽管对仅基于熵的规则几乎不可见，却携带密集的修正信号。我们用TIP（Token Importance in on-Policy distillation）组织这些发现，这是对学生熵和师生分歧的双轴分类法，并给出了熵为何有用但结构上不完整的理论解释。这一观点激励了结合不确定性和分歧的类型感知token选择规则。我们在跨越Qwen3、Llama和Qwen2.5的三对师生模型上，在MATH-500和AIME 2024/2025上，以及在DeepPlanning基准上进行长视界智能体规划的验证，其中Q3模型在<20%的token上训练超越了全tokenOPD。我们的实验通过扩展OPD仓库https://github.com/HJSang/OPSD_OnPolicyDistillation实现，支持在有限GPU预算下对更大模型进行内存高效的蒸馏。

Abstract

On-policy knowledge distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under token-level supervision from a teacher. Not all token positions matter equally, but existing views of token importance are incomplete. We ask a direct question: which tokens carry the most useful learning signal in OPD? Our answer is that informative tokens come from two regions: positions with high student entropy, and positions with low student entropy plus high teacher--student divergence, where the student is overconfident and wrong. Empirically, student entropy is a strong first-order proxy: retaining $50\%$ of tokens with entropy-based sampling matches or exceeds all-token training while reducing peak memory by up to $47\%$. But entropy alone misses a second important region. When we isolate low-entropy, high-divergence tokens, training on fewer than $10\%$ of all tokens nearly matches full-token baselines, showing that overconfident tokens carry dense corrective signal despite being nearly invisible to entropy-only rules. We organize these findings with TIP (Token Importance in on-Policy distillation), a two-axis taxonomy over student entropy and teacher--student divergence, and give a theoretical explanation for why entropy is useful yet structurally incomplete. This view motivates type-aware token selection rules that combine uncertainty and disagreement. We validate this picture across three teacher--student pairs spanning Qwen3, Llama, and Qwen2.5 on MATH-500 and AIME 2024/2025, and on the DeepPlanning benchmark for long-horizon agentic planning, where Q3-only training on $<$$20\%$ of tokens surpasses full-token OPD. Our experiments are implemented by extending the OPD repository https://github.com/HJSang/OPSD_OnPolicyDistillation, which supports memory-efficient distillation of larger models under limited GPU budgets.

item.title: UMI-3D: Extending Universal Manipulation Interface from Vision-Limited to 3D Spatial Perception
item.author: Ziming Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UMI-3D是一个多模态扩展系统，通过集成轻量级激光雷达传感器，在具有挑战性的环境中实现了鲁棒且可扩展的数据收集，显著提升了机器人操作任务的学习性能。

背景: 原始的通用操作接口（UMI）依赖单目视觉SLAM，容易受到遮挡、动态场景和跟踪失败的影响，限制了其在现实世界环境中的适用性。

目的: 解决UMI在单目视觉SLAM方面的局限性，通过引入轻量级且低成本的激光雷达传感器，实现基于激光雷达的SLAM和准确的度量级姿态估计。

方法: 开发了一个硬件同步的多模态感知管道和一个统一的空间时间校准框架，将视觉观测与激光雷达点云对齐，产生一致的演示3D表示；同时保持原有的2D视觉运动策略形式。

主要发现: UMI-3D显著提高了收集数据的质量和可靠性，直接转化为增强的策略性能；在标准操作任务上实现了高成功率，并支持学习对原始视觉-only UMI设置具有挑战性或不可行的任务，包括大型可变形物体操作和关节物体操作。

结论: UMI-3D支持端到端的数据采集、对齐、训练和部署管道，同时保持了原始UMI的便携性和可访问性；所有硬件和软件组件均已开源，以促进大规模数据收集和加速具身智能研究。

翻译: 我们介绍了UMI-3D，这是通用操作接口（UMI）的多模态扩展，旨在在具身操作中进行鲁棒且可扩展的数据收集。虽然UMI能够进行便携式、腕部安装的数据采集，但其对单目视觉SLAM的依赖使其容易受到遮挡、动态场景和跟踪失败的影响，限制了其在现实世界环境中的适用性。UMI-3D通过引入紧密集成在腕部接口中的轻量级且低成本的激光雷达传感器解决了这些局限性，使得在具有挑战性的条件下能够实现以激光雷达为中心的SLAM和准确的度量级姿态估计。我们进一步开发了一个硬件同步的多模态感知管道和一个统一的空间时间校准框架，将视觉观测与激光雷达点云对齐，产生一致的演示3D表示。尽管保持了原始的2D视觉运动策略形式，UMI-3D显著提高了收集数据的质量和可靠性，这直接转化为增强的策略性能。广泛的现实世界实验表明，UMI-3D不仅在标准操作任务上实现了高成功率，而且支持学习对原始视觉-only UMI设置具有挑战性或不可行的任务，包括大型可变形物体操作和关节物体操作。该系统支持数据采集、对齐、训练和部署的端到端管道，同时保持了原始UMI的便携性和可访问性。所有硬件和软件组件均已开源，以促进大规模数据收集并加速具身智能研究：https://umi-3d.github.io。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决原始 UMI 系统因依赖单目视觉 SLAM 而在遮挡、动态场景和纹理稀疏环境中容易跟踪失败的问题。这个问题很重要，因为视觉 SLAM 的局限性限制了机器人学习任务的多样性，导致数据收集偏向于特定环境。UMI-3D 通过引入激光雷达，显著提高了数据收集的可靠性和适用范围，使得原本难以完成的任务也能被有效收集和学习。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过分析原始UMI依赖单目视觉SLAM在遮挡和动态场景下容易失效的问题，决定从视觉为中心转向几何感知。他们借鉴了UMI的便携式设计，并引入了轻量级LiDAR传感器。同时，他们参考了LiDAR SLAM在几何测量上的优势，以及现有UMI变体在时间一致性或便携性上的不足，设计了硬件同步的多模态感知管道。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将感知方式从依赖单目视觉 SLAM 转向以 LiDAR 为中心的几何感知。通过在腕部设备中集成轻量级 LiDAR，实现更鲁棒的位姿估计，从而解决视觉 SLAM 在遮挡、动态场景下的局限性，并支持 3D 空间感知。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先通过腕部多模态传感器套件（LiDAR、相机、IMU）同步采集演示数据；其次利用 LiDAR 中心 SLAM 技术处理数据，生成准确的度量级轨迹和一致的 3D 表示；最后使用同步的视觉-动作数据训练视觉运动策略，并在机器人上部署执行。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于引入了轻量级且低成本的激光雷达传感器，集成到手腕接口中，并开发了硬件同步的多模态感知管道。相比之前的工作，它从依赖单目视觉 SLAM 转向了激光雷达中心 SLAM，解决了视觉 SLAM 在遮挡和动态场景下容易失败的问题，从而提高了数据收集的可靠性和质量，并使得以前难以完成的任务变得可行。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 UMI-3D 系统，通过在手腕上集成轻量级激光雷达，解决了原版 UMI 依赖视觉 SLAM 在遮挡和动态场景下容易失效的问题，从而提高了数据收集的可靠性，并使得学习以前难以完成的任务成为可能。

Abstract

We present UMI-3D, a multimodal extension of the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) for robust and scalable data collection in embodied manipulation. While UMI enables portable, wrist-mounted data acquisition, its reliance on monocular visual SLAM makes it vulnerable to occlusions, dynamic scenes, and tracking failures, limiting its applicability in real-world environments. UMI-3D addresses these limitations by introducing a lightweight and low-cost LiDAR sensor tightly integrated into the wrist-mounted interface, enabling LiDAR-centric SLAM with accurate metric-scale pose estimation under challenging conditions. We further develop a hardware-synchronized multimodal sensing pipeline and a unified spatiotemporal calibration framework that aligns visual observations with LiDAR point clouds, producing consistent 3D representations of demonstrations. Despite maintaining the original 2D visuomotor policy formulation, UMI-3D significantly improves the quality and reliability of collected data, which directly translates into enhanced policy performance. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that UMI-3D not only achieves high success rates on standard manipulation tasks, but also enables learning of tasks that are challenging or infeasible for the original vision-only UMI setup, including large deformable object manipulation and articulated object operation. The system supports an end-to-end pipeline for data acquisition, alignment, training, and deployment, while preserving the portability and accessibility of the original UMI. All hardware and software components are open-sourced to facilitate large-scale data collection and accelerate research in embodied intelligence: \href{https://umi-3d.github.io}{https://umi-3d.github.io}.

item.title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
item.author: Fei Tang, Bofan Chen, Zhengxi Lu, Tongbo Chen, Songqin Nong, Tao Jiang, Wenhao Xu, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种无需训练的自适应放大框架UI-Zoomer，用于解决GUI grounding中图标定位和密集布局的挑战。

背景: GUI grounding任务中，小图标和密集布局的定位仍然具有挑战性。现有的测试时放大方法在所有实例上应用统一的裁剪和固定大小，忽略了模型在每个具体案例中的实际不确定性。

目的: 提出UI-Zoomer框架，将放大触发和缩放比例视为预测不确定性量化问题，以实现自适应放大。

方法: UI-Zoomer包含一个置信度感知门控，用于融合空间共识和生成置信度以选择性触发放大；以及一个不确定性驱动的裁剪大小模块，通过总方差定律分解预测方差并推导出每个实例的裁剪半径。

主要发现: 在ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision和ScreenSpot-v2数据集上，与强基线相比，在多种模型架构上取得了持续改进，增益分别高达+13.4%、+10.3%和+4.2%，且无需额外训练。

结论: UI-Zoomer在无需额外训练的情况下显著提升了GUI grounding的性能。

翻译: GUI grounding，即根据自然语言查询从屏幕截图中定位界面元素，对于小图标和密集布局仍然具有挑战性。测试时放大方法通过在更高分辨率下裁剪和重新运行推理来提高定位精度，但在所有实例上应用统一的裁剪和固定大小，忽略了模型在每个具体案例中的实际不确定性。我们提出了UI-Zoomer，一个无需训练的自适应放大框架，将放大触发和缩放比例视为预测不确定性量化问题。一个置信度感知门控融合了随机候选者之间的空间共识和基于令牌的生成置信度，仅在定位不确定时选择性触发放大。当触发时，一个不确定性驱动的裁剪大小模块将预测方差分解为样本间位置分布和样本内框范围，通过总方差定律推导出每个实例的裁剪半径。在ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision和ScreenSpot-v2上的广泛实验表明，与多种模型架构的强基线相比取得了持续改进，增益分别高达+13.4%、+10.3%和+4.2%，且无需额外训练。

Abstract

GUI grounding, which localizes interface elements from screenshots given natural language queries, remains challenging for small icons and dense layouts. Test-time zoom-in methods improve localization by cropping and re-running inference at higher resolution, but apply cropping uniformly across all instances with fixed crop sizes, ignoring whether the model is actually uncertain on each case. We propose \textbf{UI-Zoomer}, a training-free adaptive zoom-in framework that treats both the trigger and scale of zoom-in as a prediction uncertainty quantification problem. A confidence-aware gate fuses spatial consensus among stochastic candidates with token-level generation confidence to selectively trigger zoom-in only when localization is uncertain. When triggered, an uncertainty-driven crop sizing module decomposes prediction variance into inter-sample positional spread and intra-sample box extent, deriving a per-instance crop radius via the law of total variance. Extensive experiments on ScreenSpot-Pro, UI-Vision, and ScreenSpot-v2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple model architectures, achieving gains of up to +13.4\%, +10.3\%, and +4.2\% respectively, with no additional training required.

item.title: ID and Graph View Contrastive Learning with Multi-View Attention Fusion for Sequential Recommendation
item.author: Xiaofan Zhou, Kyumin Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MVCrec的多视图对比学习框架，用于序列推荐，通过整合基于序列和基于图的两种视图的互补信号来提升用户和物品的表示学习。

背景: 在电子商务等领域，序列推荐旨在从历史交互序列中提取用户偏好并预测下一个可能互动的物品。虽然对比学习和图神经网络已被用于学习更丰富的表示，但很少有研究探索ID和图视角之间的多视图对比学习，特别是在仅拥有交互数据而没有辅助信息的情况下。

目的: 为了解决上述差距，提出MVCrec框架，旨在通过整合来自序列视图和图视图的互补信号，联合改进用户和物品的表示。

方法: MVCrec框架包含三个对比目标：序列视图内的对比、图视图内的对比以及跨视图的对比。为了有效融合学习到的表示，引入了多视图注意力融合模块，该模块结合了全局和局部注意力机制来估计目标用户购买目标物品的可能性。

主要发现: 在五个真实世界基准数据集上的综合实验表明，MVCrec consistently outperforms 11 state-of-the-art baselines，在NDCG@10指标上比最强基线提高了14.44%，在HitRatio@10指标上提高了9.22%。

结论: MVCrec在多个真实数据集上显著优于现有的11种最先进基线方法，证明了该方法的有效性。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/sword-Lz/MMCrec获取。

翻译: 序列推荐在学术界和工业界（特别是在电子商务中）变得越来越突出。其主要目标是从历史交互序列中提取用户偏好并预测用户可能互动的下一个物品。最近的进展利用了对比学习和图神经网络从交互历史中学习更具表现力的表示——图捕捉节点之间的关系，而基于ID的表示编码物品特定信息。然而，很少有研究探索ID和图视角之间的多视图对比学习以联合改进用户和物品的表示，特别是在仅拥有交互数据而没有辅助信息的情况下。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了用于序列推荐的多视图对比学习（MVCrec），这是一个整合来自序列（基于ID）和基于图视图的互补信号的框架。MVCrec包含三个对比目标：在序列视图内、在图视图内以及跨视图。为了有效融合学习到的表示，我们引入了一个多视图注意力融合模块，该模块结合了全局和局部注意力机制来估计目标用户购买目标物品的可能性。在五个真实世界基准数据集上的综合实验表明，MVCrec consistently outperforms 11 state-of-the-art baselines，在NDCG@10上比最强基线提高了14.44%，在HitRatio@10上提高了9.22%。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/sword-Lz/MMCrec获取。

Abstract

Sequential recommendation has become increasingly prominent in both academia and industry, particularly in e-commerce. The primary goal is to extract user preferences from historical interaction sequences and predict items a user is likely to engage with next. Recent advances have leveraged contrastive learning and graph neural networks to learn more expressive representations from interaction histories -- graphs capture relational structure between nodes, while ID-based representations encode item-specific information. However, few studies have explored multi-view contrastive learning between ID and graph perspectives to jointly improve user and item representations, especially in settings where only interaction data is available without auxiliary information. To address this gap, we propose Multi-View Contrastive learning for sequential recommendation (MVCrec), a framework that integrates complementary signals from both sequential (ID-based) and graph-based views. MVCrec incorporates three contrastive objectives: within the sequential view, within the graph view, and across views. To effectively fuse the learned representations, we introduce a multi-view attention fusion module that combines global and local attention mechanisms to estimate the likelihood of a target user purchasing a target item. Comprehensive experiments on five real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that MVCrec consistently outperforms 11 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving improvements of up to 14.44\% in NDCG@10 and 9.22\% in HitRatio@10 over the strongest baseline. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sword-Lz/MMCrec.

item.title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration
item.author: Zerun Ma, Guoqiang Wang, Xinchen Xie, Yicheng Chen, He Du, Bowen Li, Yanan Sun, Wenran Liu, Kai Chen, Yining Li
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TREX是一个多智能体系统，用于自动化大语言模型的整个训练生命周期，包括需求分析、文献和数据研究、策略制定、数据准备、模型训练和评估。

背景: 虽然大语言模型已经使AI研究智能体能够执行独立的科学任务，但自动化复杂、现实世界的工作流程，如大语言模型训练，仍然是一个重大挑战。

目的: 介绍TREX，一个多智能体系统，旨在自动化整个大语言模型训练生命周期。

方法: TREX通过协调研究者和执行者两个核心模块之间的协作，将多轮实验过程建模为搜索树，以高效规划探索路径、重用历史结果并从迭代试验中提炼高层见解。

主要发现: TREX智能体在目标任务上持续优化模型性能。

结论: TREX系统成功实现了大语言模型训练的自动化，并在构建的基准测试FT-Bench上表现出色。

翻译: 虽然大语言模型已经使AI研究智能体能够执行独立的科学任务，但自动化复杂、现实世界的工作流程，如大语言模型训练，仍然是一个重大挑战。在这篇论文中，我们介绍了TREX，一个自动化整个大语言模型训练生命周期的多智能体系统。通过协调两个核心模块——研究者和执行者——之间的协作，该系统无缝地执行需求分析、开放领域文献和数据研究、制定训练策略、准备数据配方以及模型训练和评估。多轮实验过程被建模为搜索树，使系统能够高效地规划探索路径、重用历史结果，并从迭代试验中提炼高层见解。为了评估自动化大语言模型训练的能力，我们构建了FT-Bench，这是一个包含10个来自现实世界场景的任务的基准测试，范围从优化基本模型能力到增强特定领域任务上的性能。实验结果表明，TREX智能体在目标任务上持续优化模型性能。

Abstract

While Large Language Models (LLMs) have empowered AI research agents to perform isolated scientific tasks, automating complex, real-world workflows, such as LLM training, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce TREX, a multi-agent system that automates the entire LLM training life-cycle. By orchestrating collaboration between two core modules-the Researcher and the Executor-the system seamlessly performs requirement analysis, open-domain literature and data research, formulation of training strategies, preparation of data recipes, and model training and evaluation. The multi-round experimental process is modeled as a search tree, enabling the system to efficiently plan exploration paths, reuse historical results, and distill high-level insights from iterative trials. To evaluate the capability of automated LLM training, we construct FT-Bench, a benchmark comprising 10 tasks derived from real-world scenarios, ranging from optimizing fundamental model capabilities to enhancing performance on domain-specific tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the TREX agent consistently optimizes model performance on target tasks.

item.title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
item.author: Lin-Zhuo Chen, Jian Gao, Yihang Chen, Ka Leong Cheng, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Nan Xue, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Yao Yao, Yinghao Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LingBot-Map 是一种基于几何上下文变换器架构的前馈 3D 基础模型，旨在从视频流中重建场景，包括相机位姿和点云。

背景: Streaming 3D reconstruction 需要几何精度、时间一致性和计算效率。受 SLAM 原理的启发，提出了 LingBot-Map。

目的: 从流数据中重建场景，包括相机位姿和点云。

方法: 基于几何上下文变换器架构，设计了包含锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口和轨迹记忆的注意力机制。

主要发现: 在 518 x 378 分辨率输入下，长序列超过 10,000 帧时，推理速度约为 20 FPS，且在多种基准测试中优于现有的流式和基于迭代优化的方法。

结论: LingBot-Map 在几何精度、时间一致性和计算效率方面表现优越。

翻译: 流式 3D 重建旨在从视频流中恢复 3D 信息，如相机位姿和点云，这需要几何精度、时间一致性和计算效率。受同时定位与建图原理的启发，我们介绍了 LingBot-Map，这是一个用于从流数据重建场景的前馈 3D 基础模型，构建于几何上下文变换器架构之上。LingBot-Map 的一个决定性特征是其精心设计的注意力机制，它集成了锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口和轨迹记忆，以分别解决坐标定位、密集几何线索和长距离漂移校正。该设计使流式状态保持紧凑，同时保留丰富的几何上下文，能够在 518 x 378 分辨率输入下，长序列超过 10,000 帧时实现稳定高效的推理，速度约为 20 FPS。在各种基准测试中的广泛评估表明，我们的方法在性能上优于现有的流式和基于迭代优化的方法。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决从连续视频流中高效且一致地进行3D重建的难题，特别是现有方法在处理长序列时难以平衡上下文保留与计算效率，导致轨迹漂移或性能下降。这个问题在现实中非常重要，因为无人机、自动驾驶等应用需要实时处理无限的视频流，同时保持高精度和低资源消耗。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过分析现有流式重建方法在长序列中难以管理上下文的局限性，借鉴了经典SLAM系统的见解，即稳健重建需要维护参考帧、局部窗口和全局地图三种互补上下文。他们用端到端学习的注意力机制替换了手工优化的优化，设计出几何上下文注意力（GCA）来平衡长时一致性与紧凑状态。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是模仿经典 SLAM 系统的结构，用端到端学习的注意力机制取代手工优化的组件，通过维护锚点、局部窗口和轨迹记忆三种互补的上下文来平衡长程一致性与紧凑状态。实现流程是输入连续图像流，利用 ViT 骨干网络编码每一帧，通过交替的帧级注意力和几何上下文注意力处理，最终预测相机姿态和深度图。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了LingBot-Map模型及其核心的几何上下文注意力机制。其关键创新在于设计了三种互补的上下文类型：锚点上下文用于定位、局部窗口用于局部几何、以及轨迹记忆用于全局一致性，从而在保持紧凑状态的同时保留丰富几何信息。相比之前的工作，它不像CUT3R那样容易遗忘信息，也不像StreamVGGT那样保留所有历史导致计算量激增，更不像传统SLAM那样依赖手工启发式规则，而是通过端到端学习实现了高效且一致的流式重建。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为LingBot-Map的流式3D重建模型，其核心贡献是设计了几何上下文注意力机制。该机制通过维护锚点、局部窗口和轨迹记忆三种上下文，在保持紧凑状态的同时实现了高效推理和长序列一致性，显著提升了重建质量。

Abstract

Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.

item.title: From $P(y|x)$ to $P(y)$: Investigating Reinforcement Learning in Pre-train Space
item.author: Yuqiao Tan, Minzheng Wang, Bo Liu, Zichen Liu, Tian Liang, Shizhu He, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PreRL和DSRL方法通过在预训练空间中应用强化学习来增强大语言模型的推理能力，利用负样本强化机制有效提升推理表现。

背景: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）虽然能优化条件分布P(y|x)，但受限于基础模型的输出分布；传统预训练依赖静态语料库导致分布偏移，阻碍了推理能力的针对性增强。

目的: 引入PreRL（预训练空间强化学习），通过奖励驱动的在线更新直接优化边际分布P(y)，并进一步提出Dual Space RL（DSRL）策略以提升推理能力。

方法: PreRL在预训练空间中应用奖励驱动的在线更新；DSRL采用策略重生策略，利用NSR-PreRL初始化模型以扩展推理范围，随后过渡到标准RL进行精细优化。

主要发现: PreRL中的负样本强化（NSR）是推理的有效驱动力，能快速修剪错误推理空间并刺激内生反思行为，使过渡和反思思维分别增加14.89倍和6.54倍。

结论: DSRL在大量实验中持续优于强基线，证明预训练空间修剪能有效引导策略向精细化的正确推理子空间发展。

翻译: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances LLM reasoning by optimizing the conditional distribution P(y|x), its potential is fundamentally bounded by the base model's existing output distribution. Optimizing the marginal distribution P(y) in the Pre-train Space addresses this bottleneck by encoding reasoning ability and preserving broad exploration capacity. Yet, conventional pre-training relies on static corpora for passive learning, leading to a distribution shift that hinders targeted reasoning enhancement. In this paper, we introduce PreRL (Pre-train Space RL), which applies reward-driven online updates directly to P(y). We theoretically and empirically validate the strong gradient alignment between log P(y) and log P(y|x), establishing PreRL as a viable surrogate for standard RL. Furthermore, we uncover a critical mechanism: Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) within PreRL serves as an exceptionally effective driver for reasoning. NSR-PreRL rapidly prunes incorrect reasoning spaces while stimulating endogenous reflective behaviors, increasing transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x, respectively. Leveraging these insights, we propose Dual Space RL (DSRL), a Policy Reincarnation strategy that initializes models with NSR-PreRL to expand the reasoning horizon before transitioning to standard RL for fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSRL consistently outperforms strong baselines, proving that pre-train space pruning effectively steers the policy toward a refined correct reasoning subspace.

Abstract

While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances LLM reasoning by optimizing the conditional distribution P(y|x), its potential is fundamentally bounded by the base model's existing output distribution. Optimizing the marginal distribution P(y) in the Pre-train Space addresses this bottleneck by encoding reasoning ability and preserving broad exploration capacity. Yet, conventional pre-training relies on static corpora for passive learning, leading to a distribution shift that hinders targeted reasoning enhancement. In this paper, we introduce PreRL (Pre-train Space RL), which applies reward-driven online updates directly to P(y). We theoretically and empirically validate the strong gradient alignment between log P(y) and log P(y|x), establishing PreRL as a viable surrogate for standard RL. Furthermore, we uncover a critical mechanism: Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) within PreRL serves as an exceptionally effective driver for reasoning. NSR-PreRL rapidly prunes incorrect reasoning spaces while stimulating endogenous reflective behaviors, increasing transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x, respectively. Leveraging these insights, we propose Dual Space RL (DSRL), a Policy Reincarnation strategy that initializes models with NSR-PreRL to expand the reasoning horizon before transitioning to standard RL for fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSRL consistently outperforms strong baselines, proving that pre-train space pruning effectively steers the policy toward a refined correct reasoning subspace.

item.title: SpatialEvo: Self-Evolving Spatial Intelligence via Deterministic Geometric Environments
item.author: Dinging Li, Yingxiu Zhao, Xinrui Cheng, Kangheng Lin, Hongbo Peng, Hongxing Li, Zixuan Wang, Yuhong Dai, Haodong Li, Jia Wang, Yukang Shi, Liang Zhao, Jianjian Sun, Zheng Ge, Xiangyu Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了SpatialEvo框架，通过确定性几何环境解决三维空间推理中自进化范式依赖模型共识导致错误放大的问题。

背景: 三维空间推理是具身智能的核心能力，但连续模型改进受限于几何标注成本。自进化范式虽然提供了一条有前景的路径，但依赖模型共识构建伪标签会导致训练强化而非纠正模型自身的几何错误。

目的: 识别三维空间推理中的一种独特属性，该属性绕过了模型共识的局限性，即真实值是底层几何的确定性结果，可从点云和相机位姿精确计算。

方法: 提出SpatialEvo框架，以确定性几何环境为核心。该环境将16类空间推理任务形式化，并转换为零噪声交互式预言机。单一共享参数策略在约束下协同进化，任务自适应调度器自动聚焦于模型最弱类别。

主要发现: 在九个基准测试中，SpatialEvo在3B和7B规模下均达到最高平均分，在空间推理基准上持续提升，且未在通用视觉理解上出现性能下降。

结论: SpatialEvo通过将模型共识替换为客观物理反馈，实现了无需人工设计动态课程的自进化训练，显著提升了三维空间推理能力。

翻译: SpatialEvo: A Self-Evolving Framework for 3D Spatial Reasoning

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决 3D 空间推理模型在持续进化过程中，因依赖模型共识生成伪标签而导致训练信号存在偏差的问题。这个问题在现实中很重要，因为 3D 空间推理是具身智能的核心能力，而现有方法无法有效纠正模型自身的几何错误，限制了模型能力的提升。论文提出利用几何环境的确定性来生成零噪声的监督信号，从而实现更准确的自我进化。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有自进化方法依赖模型共识生成伪标签，会导致训练强化模型自身的错误。作者利用3D空间推理中ground truth是底层几何确定性后果的特性，设计了确定性几何环境（DGE），将未标注的3D场景转化为零噪声的交互式预言机，用客观物理反馈替代模型共识。在借鉴现有自进化范式（如VisPlay, V-Zero）的基础上，作者采用了GRPO算法，让单个模型在DGE约束下共同进化提问者和求解者角色。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用3D场景几何的确定性，通过确定性几何环境（DGE）计算精确的地面真值，替代模型共识，从而实现无噪声的自我进化。实现流程包括：DGE模块从点云和相机位姿中验证问题并计算真值；单个VLM模型在DGE约束下，在“提问者”和“求解者”角色间协同进化，任务调度器根据历史表现动态调整训练重点。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了基于确定性几何环境（DGE）的 SpatialEvo 框架，将未标注的 3D 场景转化为零噪声交互式预言机，并设计了自动化几何验证管道来精确计算真值。相比之前依赖模型共识构建伪标签的自进化方法，SpatialEvo 利用 3D 空间推理的确定性属性，用客观的物理反馈替代了有噪声的模型判断，从而避免了强化模型自身错误。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了 SpatialEvo 框架，通过构建确定性几何环境（DGE）从场景中计算精确的物理真相，替代了模型共识，从而实现了无需人工标注的零噪声自我进化。

Abstract

Spatial reasoning over three-dimensional scenes is a core capability for embodied intelligence, yet continuous model improvement remains bottlenecked by the cost of geometric annotation. The self-evolving paradigm offers a promising path, but its reliance on model consensus to construct pseudo-labels causes training to reinforce rather than correct the model's own geometric errors. We identify a property unique to 3D spatial reasoning that circumvents this limitation: ground truth is a deterministic consequence of the underlying geometry, computable exactly from point clouds and camera poses without any model involvement. Building on this insight, we present SpatialEvo, a self-evolving framework for 3D spatial reasoning, centered on the Deterministic Geometric Environment (DGE). The DGE formalizes 16 spatial reasoning task categories under explicit geometric validation rules and converts unannotated 3D scenes into zero-noise interactive oracles, replacing model consensus with objective physical feedback. A single shared-parameter policy co-evolves across questioner and solver roles under DGE constraints: the questioner generates physically valid spatial questions grounded in scene observations, while the solver derives precise answers against DGE-verified ground truth. A task-adaptive scheduler endogenously concentrates training on the model's weakest categories, producing a dynamic curriculum without manual design. Experiments across nine benchmarks demonstrate that SpatialEvo achieves the highest average score at both 3B and 7B scales, with consistent gains on spatial reasoning benchmarks and no degradation on general visual understanding.

item.title: ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement
item.author: Song Tang, Guangquan Jie, Henghui Ding, Yu-Gang Jiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了针对多模态大语言模型分割任务的挑战，提出了NEST基准和ROSE框架以提升模型对新兴实体的识别能力。

背景: 现有的基于多模态大语言模型的分割模型（如LISA）难以处理新颖或新兴实体，因为它们无法融入最新知识。

目的: 为了解决这一挑战，本文提出了新颖新兴分割任务（NEST），旨在分割两类实体：1）模型因训练数据缺失而无法识别的新颖实体；2）模型知识库中存在但需要最新外部信息才能准确识别的新兴实体。

方法: 本文构建了NEST基准，并提出了ROSE框架。ROSE包含四个关键组件：1）互联网检索增强生成模块，利用用户提供的多模态输入检索实时网络信息；2）文本提示增强器，利用最新信息和丰富背景知识提升模型感知能力；3）视觉提示增强器，利用网络图像补偿模型对新颖实体的接触不足；4）WebSense模块，智能决定何时调用检索机制以保持效率。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，ROSE在NEST基准上显著提升了性能，在基于Gemini-2.0 Flash的检索基线上提升了19.2的gIoU。

结论: ROSE框架能有效增强多模态大语言模型分割模型对新颖和新兴实体的识别能力。

翻译: Existing segmentation models based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as LISA, often struggle with novel or emerging entities due to their inability to incorporate up-to-date knowledge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Novel Emerging Segmentation Task (NEST), which focuses on segmenting (i) novel entities that MLLMs fail to recognize due to their absence from training data, and (ii) emerging entities that exist within the model's knowledge but demand up-to-date external information for accurate recognition. To support the study of NEST, we construct a NEST benchmark using an automated pipeline that generates news-related data samples for comprehensive evaluation. Additionally, we propose ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement, a plug-and-play framework designed to augment any MLLM-based segmentation model. ROSE comprises four key components. First, an Internet Retrieval-Augmented Generation module is introduced to employ user-provided multimodal inputs to retrieve real-time web information. Then, a Textual Prompt Enhancer enriches the model with up-to-date information and rich background knowledge, improving the model's perception ability for emerging entities. Furthermore, a Visual Prompt Enhancer is proposed to compensate for MLLMs' lack of exposure to novel entities by leveraging internet-sourced images. To maintain efficiency, a WebSense module is introduced to intelligently decide when to invoke retrieval mechanisms based on user input. Experimental results demonstrate that ROSE significantly boosts performance on the NEST benchmark, outperforming a strong Gemini-2.0 Flash-based retrieval baseline by 19.2 in gIoU.

Abstract

Existing segmentation models based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as LISA, often struggle with novel or emerging entities due to their inability to incorporate up-to-date knowledge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Novel Emerging Segmentation Task (NEST), which focuses on segmenting (i) novel entities that MLLMs fail to recognize due to their absence from training data, and (ii) emerging entities that exist within the model's knowledge but demand up-to-date external information for accurate recognition. To support the study of NEST, we construct a NEST benchmark using an automated pipeline that generates news-related data samples for comprehensive evaluation. Additionally, we propose ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement, a plug-and-play framework designed to augment any MLLM-based segmentation model. ROSE comprises four key components. First, an Internet Retrieval-Augmented Generation module is introduced to employ user-provided multimodal inputs to retrieve real-time web information. Then, a Textual Prompt Enhancer enriches the model with up-to-date information and rich background knowledge, improving the model's perception ability for emerging entities. Furthermore, a Visual Prompt Enhancer is proposed to compensate for MLLMs' lack of exposure to novel entities by leveraging internet-sourced images. To maintain efficiency, a WebSense module is introduced to intelligently decide when to invoke retrieval mechanisms based on user input. Experimental results demonstrate that ROSE significantly boosts performance on the NEST benchmark, outperforming a strong Gemini-2.0 Flash-based retrieval baseline by 19.2 in gIoU.

item.title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
item.author: Team Seedance, De Chen, Liyang Chen, Xin Chen, Ying Chen, Zhuo Chen, Zhuowei Chen, Feng Cheng, Tianheng Cheng, Yufeng Cheng, Mojie Chi, Xuyan Chi, Jian Cong, Qinpeng Cui, Fei Ding, Qide Dong, Yujiao Du, Haojie Duanmu, Junliang Fan, Jiarui Fang, Jing Fang, Zetao Fang, Chengjian Feng, Yu Gao, Diandian Gu, Dong Guo, Hanzhong Guo, Qiushan Guo, Boyang Hao, Hongxiang Hao, Haoxun He, Jiaao He, Qian He, Tuyen Hoang, Heng Hu, Ruoqing Hu, Yuxiang Hu, Jiancheng Huang, Weilin Huang, Zhaoyang Huang, Zhongyi Huang, Jishuo Jin, Ming Jing, Ashley Kim, Shanshan Lao, Yichong Leng, Bingchuan Li, Gen Li, Haifeng Li, Huixia Li, Jiashi Li, Ming Li, Xiaojie Li, Xingxing Li, Yameng Li, Yiying Li, Yu Li, Yueyan Li, Chao Liang, Han Liang, Jianzhong Liang, Ying Liang, Wang Liao, J. H. Lien, Shanchuan Lin, Xi Lin, Feng Ling, Yue Ling, Fangfang Liu, Jiawei Liu, Jihao Liu, Jingtuo Liu, Shu Liu, Sichao Liu, Wei Liu, Xue Liu, Zuxi Liu, Ruijie Lu, Lecheng Lyu, Jingting Ma, Tianxiang Ma, Xiaonan Nie, Jingzhe Ning, Junjie Pan, Xitong Pan, Ronggui Peng, Xueqiong Qu, Yuxi Ren, Yuchen Shen, Guang Shi, Lei Shi, Yinglong Song, Fan Sun, Li Sun, Renfei Sun, Wenjing Tang, Boyang Tao, Zirui Tao, Dongliang Wang, Feng Wang, Hulin Wang, Ke Wang, Qingyi Wang, Rui Wang, Shuai Wang, Shulei Wang, Weichen Wang, Xuanda Wang, Yanhui Wang, Yue Wang, Yuping Wang, Yuxuan Wang, Zijie Wang, Ziyu Wang, Guoqiang Wei, Meng Wei, Di Wu, Guohong Wu, Hanjie Wu, Huachao Wu, Jian Wu, Jie Wu, Ruolan Wu, Shaojin Wu, Xiaohu Wu, Xinglong Wu, Yonghui Wu, Ruiqi Xia, Xin Xia, Xuefeng Xiao, Shuang Xu, Bangbang Yang, Jiaqi Yang, Runkai Yang, Tao Yang, Yihang Yang, Zhixian Yang, Ziyan Yang, Fulong Ye, Bingqian Yi, Xing Yin, Yongbin You, Linxiao Yuan, Weihong Zeng, Xuejiao Zeng, Yan Zeng, Siyu Zhai, Zhonghua Zhai, Bowen Zhang, Chenlin Zhang, Heng Zhang, Jun Zhang, Manlin Zhang, Peiyuan Zhang, Shuo Zhang, Xiaohe Zhang, Xiaoying Zhang, Xinyan Zhang, Xinyi Zhang, Yichi Zhang, Zixiang Zhang, Haiyu Zhao, Huating Zhao, Liming Zhao, Yian Zhao, Guangcong Zheng, Jianbin Zheng, Xiaozheng Zheng, Zerong Zheng, Kuan Zhu, Feilong Zuo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Seedance 2.0 是一个于2026年2月在中国发布的原生多模态音频视频生成模型，相比前代在架构、生成能力和用户体验上均有显著提升。

背景: Seedance 2.0 是继 Seedance 1.0 和 1.5 Pro 之后推出的新模型，旨在通过统一、高效的大规模架构改进多模态音频视频生成。

目的: 提供行业领先的全面多模态内容参考和编辑能力，支持四种输入模态，并提升视频和音频生成的关键维度表现。

方法: 采用统一、高效且大规模的架构进行多模态音频视频联合生成，并推出了加速版以提升生成速度。

主要发现: 在专家评估和公开用户测试中，Seedance 2.0 的表现与行业领先水平相当；支持生成 4 到 15 秒的音频视频内容，原生输出分辨率为 480p 和 720p。

结论: Seedance 2.0 在基础生成能力和多模态生成性能上取得了显著改进，为终端用户带来了增强的创意体验。

翻译: Seedance 2.0 是一个于2026年2月在中国发布的原生多模态音频视频生成模型，相比前代在架构、生成能力和用户体验上均有显著提升。

Abstract

Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. This allows it to support four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video, by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field. Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal inputs as reference, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. In addition, we provide Seedance 2.0 Fast version, an accelerated variant of Seedance 2.0 designed to boost generation speed for low-latency scenarios. Seedance 2.0 has delivered significant improvements to its foundational generation capabilities and multi-modal generation performance, bringing an enhanced creative experience for end users.

item.title: One Token per Highly Selective Frame: Towards Extreme Compression for Long Video Understanding
item.author: Zheyu Zhang, Ziqi Pang, Shixing Chen, Xiang Hao, Vimal Bhat, Yu-Xiong Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为name的极端视频压缩模型，通过可学习的渐进式模块和问题条件压缩，显著提升了长视频理解能力。

背景: 长视频理解对视觉语言模型具有挑战性，因为视频帧通常会产生大量token，而大语言模型的有限上下文长度迫使模型稀疏感知帧并丢失时间信息。

目的: 探索极端视频token压缩，实现每帧一个token，并提高token效率。

方法: 提出了可学习的渐进式模块进行token级压缩，以及问题条件压缩进行帧级压缩；通过将长视频分割为短片段并使用局部注意力来缓解位置偏差。

主要发现: 该模型能够消化更多帧，压缩比显著更大，且仅需2.5%的监督微调数据即可将准确率从42.9%提升至46.2%。

结论: 提出的name模型在LVBench和其他多个长视频基准测试中表现显著提升，实现了更密集的帧采样。

翻译: Long video understanding is inherently challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) because of the extensive number of frames. With each video frame typically expanding into tens or hundreds of tokens, the limited context length of large language models (LLMs) forces the VLMs to perceive the frames sparsely and lose temporal information. To address this, we explore extreme video token compression towards one token per frame at the final LLM layer. Our key insight is that heuristic-based compression, widely adopted by previous methods, is prone to information loss, and this necessitates supervising LLM layers into learnable and progressive modules for token-level compression (LP-Comp). Such compression enables our VLM to digest 2x-4x more frames with improved performance. To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate frame-level compression, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named question-conditioned compression (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, i.e., the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined token-level and frame-level leads to an extreme compression model for long video understanding, named name, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our name is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient supervised compression tuning stage that only requires 2.5% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9% to 46.2% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

Abstract

Long video understanding is inherently challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) because of the extensive number of frames. With each video frame typically expanding into tens or hundreds of tokens, the limited context length of large language models (LLMs) forces the VLMs to perceive the frames sparsely and lose temporal information. To address this, we explore extreme video token compression towards \emph{one token per frame} at the final LLM layer. Our key insight is that heuristic-based compression, widely adopted by previous methods, is prone to information loss, and this necessitates supervising LLM layers into \emph{learnable} and \emph{progressive} modules for \emph{token-level compression} (LP-Comp). Such compression enables our VLM to digest 2x-4x more frames with improved performance. To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate \emph{frame-level compression}, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named \emph{question-conditioned compression} (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, \emph{i.e.}, the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined \emph{token-level} and \emph{frame-level} leads to an e\textbf{x}treme compression model for long video understanding, named \textbf{\name}, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our \name is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient \emph{supervised compression tuning} stage that only requires 2.5\% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9\% to 46.2\% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

item.title: Hierarchical SVG Tokenization: Learning Compact Visual Programs for Scalable Vector Graphics Modeling
item.author: Ximing Xing, Ziteng Xue, Zhenxi Li, Weicong Liang, Linqing Wang, Zhantao Yang, Tiankai Hang, Zijin Yin, Qinglin Lu, Chunyu Wang, Qian Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HiVG是一个针对自回归矢量图形生成的分层SVG标记化框架，通过原子标记和几何约束的段标记分解原始SVG字符串，引入HMN初始化策略和课程训练范式，显著提高了序列效率和生成质量。

背景: 现有大型语言模型在SVG生成中仍依赖自然语言处理继承的通用字节级标记化，这种标记方式无法良好反映矢量图形的几何结构，导致数值坐标被分割成离散符号，破坏空间关系并引入严重标记冗余，常导致坐标幻觉和低效的长序列生成。

目的: 解决现有标记化方案在SVG生成中存在的几何结构反映不佳、空间关系破坏、标记冗余严重以及坐标幻觉等问题，旨在提高序列效率和生成质量。

方法: HiVG提出了一种分层SVG标记化框架，将原始SVG字符串分解为结构化的原子标记，并将可执行命令-参数组压缩为几何约束的段标记；引入分层均值-噪声（HMN）初始化策略以注入数值排序信号和语义先验；结合课程训练范式逐步增加程序复杂性。

主要发现: 在文本到SVG和图像到SVG任务上的广泛实验表明，与传统的标记化方案相比，HiVG实现了更高的生成保真度、空间一致性和序列效率。

结论: HiVG通过其创新的标记化方法和训练策略，能够更稳定地学习可执行的SVG程序，从而在SVG生成任务中取得了显著优于传统方法的性能。

翻译: 近期大型语言模型已将SVG生成从可微渲染优化转向自回归程序合成。然而，现有方法仍依赖于从自然语言处理继承的通用字节级标记化，这无法良好反映矢量图形的几何结构。数值坐标被分割成离散符号，破坏了空间关系并引入了严重的标记冗余，常导致坐标幻觉和低效的长序列生成。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了HiVG，这是一个专为自回归矢量图形生成的分层SVG标记化框架。HiVG将原始SVG字符串分解为结构化的原子标记，并将可执行命令-参数组进一步压缩为几何约束的段标记，显著提高了序列效率，同时保持了语法有效性。为了进一步缓解空间不匹配问题，我们引入了分层均值-噪声（HMN）初始化策略，将数值排序信号和语义先验注入新的标记嵌入中。结合逐步增加程序复杂性的课程训练范式，HiVG能够更稳定地学习可执行的SVG程序。在文本到SVG和图像到SVG任务上的广泛实验表明，与传统的标记化方案相比，HiVG实现了更高的生成保真度、空间一致性和序列效率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/ximinng/HiVG 公开获取。

Abstract

Recent large language models have shifted SVG generation from differentiable rendering optimization to autoregressive program synthesis. However, existing approaches still rely on generic byte-level tokenization inherited from natural language processing, which poorly reflects the geometric structure of vector graphics. Numerical coordinates are fragmented into discrete symbols, destroying spatial relationships and introducing severe token redundancy, often leading to coordinate hallucination and inefficient long-sequence generation. To address these challenges, we propose HiVG, a hierarchical SVG tokenization framework tailored for autoregressive vector graphics generation. HiVG decomposes raw SVG strings into structured \textit{atomic tokens} and further compresses executable command--parameter groups into geometry-constrained \textit{segment tokens}, substantially improving sequence efficiency while preserving syntactic validity. To further mitigate spatial mismatch, we introduce a Hierarchical Mean--Noise (HMN) initialization strategy that injects numerical ordering signals and semantic priors into new token embeddings. Combined with a curriculum training paradigm that progressively increases program complexity, HiVG enables more stable learning of executable SVG programs. Extensive experiments on both text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG tasks demonstrate improved generation fidelity, spatial consistency, and sequence efficiency compared with conventional tokenization schemes. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ximinng/HiVG

item.title: SPPO: Sequence-Level PPO for Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
item.author: Tianyi Wang, Yixia Li, Long Li, Yibiao Chen, Shaohan Huang, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SPPO是一种序列级PPO算法，旨在解决推理任务中LLM对齐的问题

背景: 标准token级PPO在长链式思维推理任务中因时间信用分配不稳定和价值模型内存成本高昂而表现不佳；虽然GRPO等无批评家替代方案缓解了这些问题，但它们通过多次采样估算基线产生了显著的计算开销，限制了训练吞吐量

目的: 引入序列级PPO（SPPO）算法，以实现样本效率与基于结果的更新的稳定性相平衡

方法: 将推理过程重新表述为序列级上下文赌博机问题，采用解耦的标量值函数来推导低方差优势信号，无需多次采样

主要发现: 在数学基准测试中，SPPO显著优于标准PPO，并与计算密集型基于组的方法性能相匹配

结论: SPPO为对齐推理LLM提供了一种资源高效的框架

翻译: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 是在推理任务中与可验证奖励对齐大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的核心方法。然而，由于长链式思维 (CoT) 时间范围内时间信用分配的不稳定性以及价值模型的高昂内存成本，标准 token 级 PPO 在此设置中表现不佳。虽然像 GRPO 这样的无批评家替代方案缓解了这些问题，但它们通过需要多次采样来估算基线，产生了显著的计算开销，严重限制了训练吞吐量。在本文中，我们介绍了序列级 PPO (SPPO)，这是一种可扩展的算法，它将 PPO 的样本效率与基于结果的更新的稳定性相结合。SPPO 将推理过程重新表述为序列级上下文赌博机问题，采用解耦的标量值函数来推导低方差优势信号，无需多次采样。在数学基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SPPO 显著优于标准 PPO，并与计算密集型基于组的方法性能相匹配，为对齐推理 LLMs 提供了一种资源高效的框架。

Abstract

Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. However, standard token-level PPO struggles in this setting due to the instability of temporal credit assignment over long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) horizons and the prohibitive memory cost of the value model. While critic-free alternatives like GRPO mitigate these issues, they incur significant computational overhead by requiring multiple samples for baseline estimation, severely limiting training throughput. In this paper, we introduce Sequence-Level PPO (SPPO), a scalable algorithm that harmonizes the sample efficiency of PPO with the stability of outcome-based updates. SPPO reformulates the reasoning process as a Sequence-Level Contextual Bandit problem, employing a decoupled scalar value function to derive low-variance advantage signals without multi-sampling. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that SPPO significantly surpasses standard PPO and matches the performance of computation-heavy group-based methods, offering a resource-efficient framework for aligning reasoning LLMs.

item.title: TriDeliver: Cooperative Air-Ground Instant Delivery with UAVs, Couriers, and Crowdsourced Ground Vehicles
item.author: Junhui Gao, Yan Pan, Qianru Wang, Wenzhe Hou, Yiqin Deng, Liangliang Jiang, Yuguang Fang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TriDeliver是一个集成人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆的三级协同框架，用于高效即时配送。

背景: 即时配送在日常生活中至关重要，但现有配送方式如快递员、无人机和众包车辆各自存在局限性，无法单独满足日益增长的需求。

目的: 提出TriDeliver框架，整合人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆以实现高效即时配送。

方法: 设计了一种基于迁移学习的算法，从快递员的行为历史中提取配送知识，并将其微调后应用于无人机和地面车辆，以获取初始调度知识并提高协同配送性能。

主要发现: 在真实世界轨迹和配送数据集上评估显示，TriDeliver相比现有的无人机与快递员协同配送方法降低了65.8%的配送成本；在配送时间、配送成本以及对众包地面车辆原有任务的影响方面分别实现了17.7%、9.8%和43.6%的进一步改善。

结论: TriDeliver通过集成多种配送方式，利用迁移学习有效提升了即时配送的效率和性能，即使在简单的神经网络表示下也取得了显著成果。

翻译: 摘要：即时配送，在截止日期前运送物品，在日常生活中至关重要。虽然多种配送代理，如快递员、无人机和众包代理已被广泛使用，但它们各自都面临着固有的局限性（例如，低效率/劳动力短缺、飞行控制和动态能力），阻止它们单独满足日益增长的需求。本文提出了TriDeliver，第一个集成人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆（GVs）的层级协同框架，用于高效即时配送。为了获得地面车辆和无人机的初始调度知识，并提高协同配送性能，我们设计了一种基于迁移学习（TL）的算法，从快递员的行为历史中提取配送知识，并通过微调将其转移到无人机和地面车辆上，然后用于调度包裹以实现高效配送。在一个月的真实世界轨迹和配送数据集上评估显示，1）通过集成快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆，TriDeliver相比现有的无人机与快递员协同配送方法降低了65.8%的配送成本；2）TriDeliver在配送时间（-17.7%）、配送成本（-9.8%）以及对众包地面车辆原有任务的影响（-43.6%）方面实现了进一步改善，即使是以简单的神经网络表示转移的知识。

Abstract

Instant delivery, shipping items before critical deadlines, is essential in daily life. While multiple delivery agents, such as couriers, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and crowdsourced agents, have been widely employed, each of them faces inherent limitations (e.g., low efficiency/labor shortages, flight control, and dynamic capabilities, respectively), preventing them from meeting the surging demands alone. This paper proposes TriDeliver, the first hierarchical cooperative framework, integrating human couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced ground vehicles (GVs) for efficient instant delivery. To obtain the initial scheduling knowledge for GVs and UAVs as well as improve the cooperative delivery performance, we design a Transfer Learning (TL)-based algorithm to extract delivery knowledge from couriers' behavioral history and transfer their knowledge to UAVs and GVs with fine-tunings, which is then used to dispatch parcels for efficient delivery. Evaluated on one-month real-world trajectory and delivery datasets, it has been demonstrated that 1) by integrating couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced GVs, TriDeliver reduces the delivery cost by $65.8\%$ versus state-of-the-art cooperative delivery by UAVs and couriers; 2) TriDeliver achieves further improvements in terms of delivery time ($-17.7\%$), delivery cost ($-9.8\%$), and impacts on original tasks of crowdsourced GVs ($-43.6\%$), even with the representation of the transferred knowledge by simple neural networks, respectively.

item.title: Variational Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Hydrological PDE-Constrained Learning with Inherent Uncertainty Quantification
item.author: Prasad Nimantha Madusanka Ukwatta Hewage, Midhun Chakkravarthy, Ruvan Kumara Abeysekara
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种混合量子经典物理信息神经网络（HQC-PINN），用于水文偏微分方程约束学习，通过量子电路编码遥感特征并利用物理约束损失函数，实现了比经典PINN更快的收敛速度和更少的参数量。

背景: 该研究旨在将参数化变分量子电路集成到物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架中，以解决水文预测问题。

目的: 构建一种混合量子经典物理信息神经网络（HQC-PINN），用于水文偏微分方程约束学习，并探索其在环境科学中的量子优势。

方法: 采用可训练角度编码将多源遥感特征编码为量子态，通过具有纠缠层的硬件高效变分假设进行处理，并利用圣维南浅水方程和曼宁流方程作为可微物理损失项来约束输出。此外，还引入了量子迁移学习协议，在洪水特定事件之前在多灾害灾难数据上进行预训练。

主要发现: 在斯里兰卡卡鲁河流域的多模态卫星和气象数据上的数值模拟显示，HQC-PINN比等效的经典PINN收敛速度快约3倍，可训练参数少约44%，同时保持了竞争力的分类准确率。理论分析表明，水文物理约束缩小了有效优化景观，为变分量子电路中的 barren plateaus提供了自然的缓解机制。

结论: 这项工作建立了量子增强物理信息学习在水文预测中的首次应用，并展示了在环境科学中实现量子优势的可行路径。

翻译: 我们提出了一种混合量子经典物理信息神经网络（HQC-PINN），将参数化变分量子电路集成到PINN框架中，用于水文偏微分方程约束学习。我们的架构通过可训练角度编码将多源遥感特征编码为量子态，通过具有纠缠层的硬件高效变分假设进行处理，并利用圣维南浅水方程和曼宁流方程作为可微物理损失项来约束输出。量子测量的内在随机性为不确定性量化提供了自然机制，而无需显式的贝叶斯推断机制。我们进一步引入了一种量子迁移学习协议，在洪水特定事件之前在多灾害灾难数据上进行预训练。在斯里兰卡卡鲁河流域的多模态卫星和气象数据上的数值模拟显示，HQC-PINN比等效的经典PINN收敛速度快约3倍，可训练参数少约44%，同时保持了竞争力的分类准确率。理论分析表明，水文物理约束缩小了有效优化景观，为变分量子电路中的 barren plateaus提供了自然的缓解机制。这项工作建立了量子增强物理信息学习在水文预测中的首次应用，并展示了在环境科学中实现量子优势的可行路径。

Abstract

We propose a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Physics-Informed Neural Network (HQC-PINN) that integrates parameterized variational quantum circuits into the PINN framework for hydrological PDE-constrained learning. Our architecture encodes multi-source remote sensing features into quantum states via trainable angle encoding, processes them through a hardware-efficient variational ansatz with entangling layers, and constrains the output using the Saint-Venant shallow water equations and Manning's flow equation as differentiable physics loss terms. The inherent stochasticity of quantum measurement provides a natural mechanism for uncertainty quantification without requiring explicit Bayesian inference machinery. We further introduce a quantum transfer learning protocol that pre-trains on multi-hazard disaster data before fine-tuning on flood-specific events. Numerical simulations on multi-modal satellite and meteorological data from the Kalu River basin, Sri Lanka, show that the HQC-PINN achieves convergence in ~3x fewer training epochs and uses ~44% fewer trainable parameters compared to an equivalent classical PINN, while maintaining competitive classification accuracy. Theoretical analysis indicates that hydrological physics constraints narrow the effective optimization landscape, providing a natural mitigation against barren plateaus in variational quantum circuits. This work establishes the first application of quantum-enhanced physics-informed learning to hydrological prediction and demonstrates a viable path toward quantum advantage in environmental science.

item.title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents
item.author: Jingyu Zhang, Tianjian Li, William Jurayj, Hongyuan Zhan, Benjamin Van Durme, Daniel Khashabi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对大语言模型代理在处理多源指令冲突时，现有指令层级范式存在局限性，作者提出Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH)范式及ManyIH-Bench基准测试。

背景: 大语言模型代理接收来自系统消息、用户提示、工具输出等多种来源的指令，这些指令具有不同的信任度和权威性。当指令冲突时，代理必须可靠地遵循最高权限的指令。现有的指令层级（IH）范式假设固定且较少的权限级别（通常少于五个），由刚性角色标签定义，这在现实代理设置中是不够的，因为冲突可能来自更多来源和语境。

目的: 提出Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH)范式，用于解决具有任意多级权限的指令之间的冲突。

方法: 1. 提出了ManyIH范式，允许任意多级权限的指令冲突解决。2. 引入了ManyIH-Bench基准测试，这是第一个针对ManyIH的基准测试。3. ManyIH-Bench要求模型导航多达12个具有不同权限的冲突指令，包含853个代理任务（427个编码和426个指令遵循任务）。4. ManyIH-Bench由LLM开发的约束和人类验证的约束组成，以创建涵盖46个现实世界代理的现实且困难的测试用例。

主要发现: 实验表明，即使当前最先进的模型在指令冲突规模扩大时表现也很差（准确率约为40%）。

结论: 这项工作强调了在代理设置中明确针对细粒度、可扩展的指令冲突解决方法的紧迫需求。

翻译: Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, other agents, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, agents must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. We introduce ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH. ManyIH-Bench requires models to navigate up to 12 levels of conflicting instructions with varying privileges, comprising 853 agentic tasks (427 coding and 426 instruction-following). ManyIH-Bench composes constraints developed by LLMs and verified by humans to create realistic and difficult test cases spanning 46 real-world agents. Our experiments show that even the current frontier models perform poorly (~40% accuracy) when instruction conflict scales. This work underscores the urgent need for methods that explicitly target fine-grained, scalable instruction conflict resolution in agentic settings.

Abstract

Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, other agents, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, agents must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. We introduce ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH. ManyIH-Bench requires models to navigate up to 12 levels of conflicting instructions with varying privileges, comprising 853 agentic tasks (427 coding and 426 instruction-following). ManyIH-Bench composes constraints developed by LLMs and verified by humans to create realistic and difficult test cases spanning 46 real-world agents. Our experiments show that even the current frontier models perform poorly (~40% accuracy) when instruction conflict scales. This work underscores the urgent need for methods that explicitly target fine-grained, scalable instruction conflict resolution in agentic settings.

item.title: BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation
item.author: Hippolyte Gisserot-Boukhlef, Nicolas Boizard, Emmanuel Malherbe, Céline Hudelot, Pierre Colombo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为BERT-as-a-Judge的方法，用于评估大语言模型生成答案的正确性，旨在解决传统基于词汇的方法计算成本高的问题。

背景: 在大语言模型生态系统中，准确的评估对于模型选择和下游应用至关重要。然而，传统的评估方法依赖于僵化的词汇方法，这可能会混淆模型的真实问题解决能力与对预定义格式指南的遵守情况。虽然基于LLM的评估方法通过评估语义正确性而非严格的结构一致性来缓解这一问题，但它们也引入了大量的计算开销，使评估变得昂贵。

目的: 为了解决传统词汇评估方法的局限性（与人类判断相关性差）和LLM-as-a-Judge方法的高计算成本问题，本文引入BERT-as-a-Judge方法，旨在提供一种在准确性和计算成本之间取得良好平衡的评估方案。
