We show that this default choice, not the diffusion architecture, is the dominant constraint on reconstruction quality. In a controlled experiment holding all other pipeline components fixed, replacing the generic Stable Diffusion VAE with MedVAE, a domain-specific autoencoder pretrained on more than 1.6 million medical images, yields +2.91 to +3.29 dB PSNR improvement across knee MRI, brain MRI, and chest X-ray (n = 1,820; Cohen's d = 1.37 to 1.86, all p < 10^{-20}, Wilcoxon signed-rank). Wavelet decomposition localises the advantage to the finest spatial frequency bands encoding anatomically relevant fine structure. Ablations across inference schedules, prediction targets, and generative architectures confirm the gap is stable within plus or minus 0.15 dB, while hallucination rates remain comparable between methods (Cohen's h < 0.02 across all datasets), establishing that reconstruction fidelity and generative hallucination are governed by independent pipeline components. These results provide a practical screening criterion: autoencoder reconstruction quality, measurable without diffusion training, predicts downstream SR performance (R^2 = 0.67), suggesting that domain-specific VAE selection should precede diffusion architecture search. Code and trained model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/sebasmos/latent-sr.

item.title: Clustering-Enhanced Domain Adaptation for Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection in Industrial Control Systems
item.author: Luyao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于聚类增强的域适应方法，用于解决工业控制系统在动态环境下的跨域入侵检测问题，通过特征对齐和聚类策略显著提升了未知攻击的检测准确率。

背景: 工业控制系统运行在动态环境中，流量分布随场景变化，标记样本有限，且未知攻击频繁出现，给跨域入侵检测带来了重大挑战。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，提出一种聚类增强的域适应方法，以实现工业控制流量的跨域入侵检测。

方法: 该方法包含两个关键组件：一是基于特征迁移学习的模块，通过基于谱变换的特征对齐将源域和目标域投影到共享潜在子空间，并迭代减少分布差异；二是聚类增强策略，结合K-Medoids聚类和基于PCA的降维来改善跨域相关性估计。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了未知攻击检测能力。与五个基线模型相比，检测准确率提高了高达49%，在F-score上取得了更大的增益，并表现出更强的稳定性。此外，聚类增强策略在代表性任务上进一步将检测准确率提高了高达26%。

结论: 该方法有效缓解了数据稀缺和域偏移问题，为动态工业环境中的鲁棒跨域入侵检测提供了实用的解决方案。

翻译: 摘要：工业控制系统在动态环境中运行，其中流量分布随场景变化，标记样本有限，且未知攻击频繁出现，给跨域入侵检测带来了重大挑战。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种用于工业控制流量的聚类增强域适应方法。该框架包含两个关键组件。首先，一个基于特征的迁移学习模块通过基于谱变换的特征对齐将源域和目标域投影到共享潜在子空间，并迭代减少分布差异，从而实现准确的跨域检测。其次，一种聚类增强策略结合K-Medoids聚类和基于PCA的降维来改善跨域相关性估计，并减少由手动参数调整引起的性能下降。实验结果表明，所提出的方法显著提高了未知攻击检测能力。与五个基线模型相比，它将检测准确率提高了高达49%，在F-score上取得了更大的增益，并表现出更强的稳定性。此外，聚类增强策略在代表性任务上进一步将检测准确率提高了高达26%。这些结果表明，所提出的方法有效地缓解了数据稀缺和域偏移，为动态工业环境中的鲁棒跨域入侵检测提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract

Industrial control systems operate in dynamic environments where traffic distributions vary across scenarios, labeled samples are limited, and unknown attacks frequently emerge, posing significant challenges to cross-domain intrusion detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for industrial control traffic. The framework contains two key components. First, a feature-based transfer learning module projects source and target domains into a shared latent subspace through spectral-transform-based feature alignment and iteratively reduces distribution discrepancies, enabling accurate cross-domain detection. Second, a clustering enhancement strategy combines K-Medoids clustering with PCA-based dimensionality reduction to improve cross-domain correlation estimation and reduce performance degradation caused by manual parameter tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves unknown attack detection. Compared with five baseline models, it increases detection accuracy by up to 49%, achieves larger gains in F-score, and demonstrates stronger stability. Moreover, the clustering enhancement strategy further boosts detection accuracy by up to 26% on representative tasks. These results suggest that the proposed method effectively alleviates data scarcity and domain shift, providing a practical solution for robust cross-domain intrusion detection in dynamic industrial environments.

item.title: Unveiling the Surprising Efficacy of Navigation Understanding in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
item.author: Zhihua Hua, Junli Wang, Pengfei LI, Qihao Jin, Bo Zhang, Kehua Sheng, Yilun Chen, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对现有端到端自动驾驶系统过度依赖局部场景理解而忽视全局导航信息的问题，提出了一种名为Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG)的框架及模型SNG-VLA，通过构建SNG-QA数据集并融合全局与局部规划，实现了在无需感知任务辅助损失函数的情况下达到最先进的性能。

背景: 全球导航信息和局部场景理解是自动驾驶系统的两个关键组成部分。然而，实验结果表明许多端到端自动驾驶系统过度依赖局部场景理解，未能有效利用全局导航信息，导致规划能力与导航输入的相关性弱，且难以在复杂场景中执行导航跟随。

目的: 为了克服现有系统过度依赖局部场景理解而忽视全局导航信息的局限性，提出一种高效的基于现实世界导航模式的全局导航信息表示方法。

方法: 提出了Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG)框架，该框架包含用于约束长期轨迹的导航路径和用于实时决策逻辑的逐向(turn-by-turn, TBT)信息。构建了SNG-QA数据集，并引入了SNG-VLA模型，该模型将局部规划与全局规划融合，且无需感知任务的辅助损失函数。

主要发现: SNG-VLA模型通过精确的导航信息建模，实现了最先进的性能。

结论: SNG框架和SNG-VLA模型能够有效解决端到端自动驾驶系统对全局导航信息利用不足的问题，实现了全局与局部规划的协同。

翻译: Global navigation information and local scene understanding are two crucial components of autonomous driving systems. However, our experimental results indicate that many end-to-end autonomous driving systems tend to over-rely on local scene understanding while failing to utilize global navigation information. These systems exhibit weak correlation between their planning capabilities and navigation input, and struggle to perform navigation-following in complex scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG) framework, an efficient representation of global navigation information based on real-world navigation patterns. The SNG encompasses both navigation paths for constraining long-term trajectories and turn-by-turn (TBT) information for real-time decision-making logic. We constructed the SNG-QA dataset, a visual question answering (VQA) dataset based on SNG that aligns global and local planning. Additionally, we introduce an efficient model SNG-VLA that fuses local planning with global planning. The SNG-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance through precise navigation information modeling without requiring auxiliary loss functions from perception tasks. Project page: SNG-VLA

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有端到端自动驾驶系统过度依赖局部场景理解、未能有效利用全局导航信息的问题。作者发现，移除导航信息对模型性能影响微乎其微，且现有的驾驶命令表示方式存在歧义和过度简化，导致模型无法正确理解导航意图。这个问题很重要，因为全局导航信息是轨迹规划的关键方向参考，若系统无法有效利用，将导致规划能力与导航输入相关性弱，难以在复杂场景中准确执行导航跟随任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有系统过度依赖局部场景而忽视全局导航，受现实世界导航模式启发，提出了包含导航路径和逐向导航信息的顺序导航指导框架。作者借鉴了 Google Maps 来构建导航信息，利用 Qwen2.5 VL 生成 TBT 信息和标注数据，并参考了 LLaVA、Qwen2.5、SigLIP 和 Simlingo 等模型架构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是针对现有端到端自动驾驶系统过度依赖局部场景理解而忽视全局导航信息的缺陷，提出了顺序导航引导框架。该方法将全局导航路径用于约束长期轨迹，结合实时逐向导引信息用于实时决策，从而更准确地建模导航信息。整体实现流程包括：首先利用导航 API 构建包含导航路径和 TBT 信息的 SNG，并构建 SNG-QA 数据集来对齐全局和局部规划；其次构建 SNG-VLA 模型，将 TBT 信息、导航路径、多视角图像和车辆自身状态作为输入，通过多模态特征融合编码器和 Transformer 解码器，自回归地生成文本推理和规划轨迹。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了顺序导航指导（SNG）框架，将全局导航信息建模为导航路径和逐向导航信息，提供长期轨迹约束和实时决策逻辑。此外，构建了SNG-QA数据集来对齐全局和局部规划，并提出了SNG-VLA模型进行多模态融合。相比之前主要使用离散驾驶命令（如“左转”）的工作，SNG利用导航路径和逐向导航信息模拟更准确、更符合现实的导航信息，解决了命令标注歧义和过度简化的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种顺序导航引导框架，通过结合导航路径和实时导航信息，构建了SNG-QA数据集，并开发了SNG-VLA模型，从而显著提升了端到端自动驾驶系统的全局导航理解与规划能力。

Abstract

Global navigation information and local scene understanding are two crucial components of autonomous driving systems. However, our experimental results indicate that many end-to-end autonomous driving systems tend to over-rely on local scene understanding while failing to utilize global navigation information. These systems exhibit weak correlation between their planning capabilities and navigation input, and struggle to perform navigation-following in complex scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG) framework, an efficient representation of global navigation information based on real-world navigation patterns. The SNG encompasses both navigation paths for constraining long-term trajectories and turn-by-turn (TBT) information for real-time decision-making logic. We constructed the SNG-QA dataset, a visual question answering (VQA) dataset based on SNG that aligns global and local planning. Additionally, we introduce an efficient model SNG-VLA that fuses local planning with global planning. The SNG-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance through precise navigation information modeling without requiring auxiliary loss functions from perception tasks. Project page: SNG-VLA

item.title: Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation
item.author: Jiayi Li, Shijie Tang, Gün Kaynar, Shiyi Du, Carl Kingsford
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Shortcut Guardrail 是一个部署时的框架，用于减轻基于梯度的归因方法识别出的 token 级别捷径，通过训练一个轻量级的 LoRA 去偏模块来实现。

背景: 预训练语言模型往往依赖训练期间看似具有预测性但测试时无法泛化的表面特征，这种现象被称为捷径学习。现有的缓解方法通常在训练时运行，需要大量监督，例如访问原始训练数据或了解捷径类型。

目的: 提出 Shortcut Guardrail，一个部署时的框架，旨在减轻 token 级别的捷径，且无需访问原始训练数据或捷径标注。

方法: 利用基于梯度的归因方法来突出显示捷径 token，并训练一个轻量级的基于 LoRA 的去偏模块，该模块使用 Masked Contrastive Learning 目标来鼓励在没有或包含个别 token 的情况下保持一致的表示。

主要发现: 基于梯度的归因方法可以突出显示捷径 token。

结论: Shortcut Guardrail 在分布偏移下提高了未缓解模型的总体准确率和最差组准确率，同时保持了分布内性能。

翻译: 预训练语言模型往往依赖训练期间看似具有预测性但测试时无法泛化的表面特征，这种现象被称为捷径学习。现有的缓解方法通常在训练时运行，需要大量监督，例如访问原始训练数据或了解捷径类型。我们提出了 Shortcut Guardrail，这是一个部署时的框架，用于减轻 token 级别的捷径，且无需访问原始训练数据或捷径标注。我们的关键见解是，对有偏模型的基于梯度的归因突出了捷径 token。基于这一发现，我们训练了一个轻量级的基于 LoRA 的去偏模块，该模块使用 Masked Contrastive Learning 目标来鼓励在没有或包含个别 token 的情况下保持一致的表示。在自然发生的和受控的捷径下的情感分类、毒性检测和自然语言推理中，Shortcut Guardrail 在分布偏移下提高了未缓解模型的总体准确率和最差组准确率，同时保持了分布内性能。

Abstract

Pretrained language models often rely on superficial features that appear predictive during training yet fail to generalize at test time, a phenomenon known as shortcut learning. Existing mitigation methods generally operate at training time and require heavy supervision such as access to the original training data or prior knowledge of shortcut type. We propose Shortcut Guardrail, a deployment-time framework that mitigates token-level shortcuts without access to the original training data or shortcut annotations. Our key insight is that gradient-based attribution on a biased model highlights shortcut tokens. Building on this finding, we train a lightweight LoRA-based debiasing module with a Masked Contrastive Learning (MaskCL) objective that encourages consistent representations with or without individual tokens. Across sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and natural language inference under both naturally occurring and controlled shortcuts, Shortcut Guardrail improves overall accuracy and worst-group accuracy over the unmitigated model under distribution shifts while preserving in-distribution performance.

item.title: Fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso for Heterogeneous Environments
item.author: Jinhang Chai, Jianqing Fan, Cheng Gao, Qishuo Yin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了Fine-tuning factor augmented neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso)框架，用于高维非参数回归中的变量选择和迁移学习，同时处理协变量和后验偏移。

背景: 微调是适应预训练模型到新任务的广泛策略，但在高维非参数设置和变量选择背景下的方法论和理论性质尚未开发。

目的: 引入FAN-Lasso框架，旨在处理高维非参数回归中的变量选择，同时处理协变量和后验偏移，实现迁移学习。

方法: 使用低秩因子结构管理高维依赖协变量，提出新颖的残差微调分解，将目标函数表示为冻结源函数的变换和其他变量的组合。

主要发现: 推导了微调FAN-Lasso的极小极大最优超额风险界，表明微调在相对样本量和函数复杂度条件下比单任务学习具有统计加速。

结论: 广泛的数值实验表明，微调FAN-Lasso在各种协变量和后验偏移场景中始终优于标准基线，并在严重目标样本量限制下实现接近Oracle性能。

翻译: Fine-tuning is a widely used strategy for adapting pre-trained models to new tasks, yet its methodology and theoretical properties in high-dimensional nonparametric settings with variable selection have not yet been developed. This paper introduces the fine-tuning factor augmented neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso), a transfer learning framework for high-dimensional nonparametric regression with variable selection that simultaneously handles covariate and posterior shifts. We use a low-rank factor structure to manage high-dimensional dependent covariates and propose a novel residual fine-tuning decomposition in which the target function is expressed as a transformation of a frozen source function and other variables to achieve transfer learning and nonparametric variable selection. This augmented feature from the source predictor allows for the transfer of knowledge to the target domain and reduces model complexity there. We derive minimax-optimal excess risk bounds for the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso, characterizing the precise conditions, in terms of relative sample sizes and function complexities, under which fine-tuning yields statistical acceleration over single-task learning. The proposed framework also provides a theoretical perspective on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Extensive numerical experiments across diverse covariate- and posterior-shift scenarios demonstrate that the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso consistently outperforms standard baselines and achieves near-oracle performance even under severe target sample size constraints, empirically validating the derived rates.

Abstract

Fine-tuning is a widely used strategy for adapting pre-trained models to new tasks, yet its methodology and theoretical properties in high-dimensional nonparametric settings with variable selection have not yet been developed. This paper introduces the fine-tuning factor augmented neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso), a transfer learning framework for high-dimensional nonparametric regression with variable selection that simultaneously handles covariate and posterior shifts. We use a low-rank factor structure to manage high-dimensional dependent covariates and propose a novel residual fine-tuning decomposition in which the target function is expressed as a transformation of a frozen source function and other variables to achieve transfer learning and nonparametric variable selection. This augmented feature from the source predictor allows for the transfer of knowledge to the target domain and reduces model complexity there. We derive minimax-optimal excess risk bounds for the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso, characterizing the precise conditions, in terms of relative sample sizes and function complexities, under which fine-tuning yields statistical acceleration over single-task learning. The proposed framework also provides a theoretical perspective on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Extensive numerical experiments across diverse covariate- and posterior-shift scenarios demonstrate that the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso consistently outperforms standard baselines and achieves near-oracle performance even under severe target sample size constraints, empirically validating the derived rates.

item.title: CBAM-Enhanced DenseNet121 for Multi-Class Chest X-Ray Classification with Grad-CAM Explainability
item.author: Utsho Kumar Dey
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于迁移学习的框架，通过将注意力模块集成到DenseNet121中，实现了对胸部X光片的三分类任务，即正常、细菌性肺炎和病毒性肺炎。研究还进行了系统性的二元任务基线研究，发现EfficientNetB3的性能甚至低于自定义的CNN基线模型。

背景: 肺炎是全球儿童死亡的主要原因，在孟加拉国等医疗资源匮乏的地区负担沉重，且放射科医生的可及性有限。大多数现有的深度学习方法将肺炎检测视为二元问题，忽略了细菌和病毒病因之间临床上至关重要的区别。

目的: 提出一种能够区分细菌性肺炎和病毒性肺炎的深度学习框架，以解决现有方法忽略病因区分的问题。

方法: 提出了CBAM-DenseNet121框架，将卷积块注意力模块集成到DenseNet121中进行三分类胸部X光片分类。同时进行了系统性的二元任务基线研究，对比了EfficientNetB3和自定义CNN基线模型。所有实验重复三次以确保统计可靠性。

主要发现: CBAM-DenseNet121在测试集上达到了84.29%的平均准确率，细菌性肺炎、正常和病毒性肺炎的AUC分数分别为0.9565、0.9610和0.9187。Grad-CAM可视化显示模型关注解剖学上合理的肺部区域。

结论: CBAM-DenseNet121在区分细菌性和病毒性肺炎方面表现良好，具有可解释性，适用于资源受限的临床环境。

翻译: 肺炎仍然是全球儿童死亡的主要原因，在孟加拉国等医疗资源匮乏的地区负担沉重，且放射科医生的可及性有限。大多数现有的深度学习方法将肺炎检测视为二元问题，忽略了细菌和病毒病因之间临床上至关重要的区别。本文提出了一种基于迁移学习的框架，通过将注意力模块集成到DenseNet121中，实现了对胸部X光片的三分类任务，即正常、细菌性肺炎和病毒性肺炎。研究还进行了系统性的二元任务基线研究，发现EfficientNetB3的性能甚至低于自定义的CNN基线模型。所有实验重复三次以确保统计可靠性。CBAM-DenseNet121在测试集上达到了84.29%的平均准确率，细菌性肺炎、正常和病毒性肺炎的AUC分数分别为0.9565、0.9610和0.9187。Grad-CAM可视化显示模型关注解剖学上合理的肺部区域。该模型具有可解释性，适用于资源受限的临床环境。

Abstract

Pneumonia remains a leading cause of childhood mortality worldwide, with a heavy burden in low-resource settings such as Bangladesh where radiologist availability is limited. Most existing deep learning approaches treat pneumonia detection as a binary problem, overlooking the clinically critical distinction between bacterial and viral aetiology. This paper proposes CBAM-DenseNet121, a transfer-learning framework that integrates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into DenseNet121 for three-class chest X-ray classification: Normal, Bacterial Pneumonia, and Viral Pneumonia. We also conduct a systematic binary-task baseline study revealing that EfficientNetB3 (73.88%) underperforms even the custom CNN baseline (78.53%) -- a practically important negative finding for medical imaging model selection. To ensure statistical reliability, all experiments were repeated three times with independent random seeds (42, 7, 123), and results are reported as mean +/- standard deviation. CBAM-DenseNet121 achieves 84.29% +/- 1.14% test accuracy with per-class AUC scores of 0.9565 +/- 0.0010, 0.9610 +/- 0.0014, and 0.9187 +/- 0.0037 for bacterial pneumonia, normal, and viral pneumonia respectively. Grad-CAM visualizations confirm that the model attends to anatomically plausible pulmonary regions for each class, supporting interpretable deployment in resource-constrained clinical environments.

item.title: Boosting Robust AIGI Detection with LoRA-based Pairwise Training
item.author: Ruiyang Xia, Qi Zhang, Yaowen Xu, Zhaofan Zou, Hao Sun, Zhongjiang He, Xuelong Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于LoRA的配对训练策略，旨在提高AI生成图像在复杂环境下的检测鲁棒性。

背景: 随着高度逼真的AI生成图像的激增，开发实用的检测方法变得必要。虽然现有的AIGI检测器在干净数据集上表现良好，但在野外环境中，由于图像受到不可预测和复杂的扭曲，其检测性能经常下降。

目的: 为了解决这一关键漏洞，我们提出了一种新颖的LoRA配对训练策略，旨在在严重扭曲下实现AIGI检测的鲁棒性。

方法: 该策略的核心涉及对视觉基础模型的针对性微调、在训练阶段故意模拟数据分布以及独特的配对训练过程。具体而言，我们引入了扭曲和大小模拟以更好地适应验证和测试集的分布。基于视觉基础模型强大的视觉表示能力，我们微调模型以实现AIGI检测。配对训练被用于通过解耦泛化和鲁棒性优化来提高检测能力。

主要发现: 实验表明，我们的方法在NTIRE野外AI生成图像检测挑战赛中获得了第三名。

结论: 本文提出的方法在严重扭曲条件下实现了鲁棒的AIGI检测，验证了其有效性。

翻译: 高度逼真的AI生成图像的激增使得开发实用的检测方法变得必要。虽然现有的AIGI检测器在干净数据集上表现良好，但在野外环境中，由于图像受到不可预测和复杂的扭曲，其检测性能经常下降。为了解决这一关键漏洞，我们提出了一种新颖的LoRA配对训练策略，旨在在严重扭曲下实现AIGI检测的鲁棒性。该策略的核心涉及对视觉基础模型的针对性微调、在训练阶段故意模拟数据分布以及独特的配对训练过程。具体而言，我们引入了扭曲和大小模拟以更好地适应验证和测试集的分布。基于视觉基础模型强大的视觉表示能力，我们微调模型以实现AIGI检测。配对训练被用于通过解耦泛化和鲁棒性优化来提高检测能力。实验表明，我们的方法在NTIRE野外AI生成图像检测挑战赛中获得了第三名。

Abstract

The proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Image (AIGI) has necessitated the development of practical detection methods. While current AIGI detectors perform admirably on clean datasets, their detection performance frequently decreases when deployed "in the wild", where images are subjected to unpredictable, complex distortions. To resolve the critical vulnerability, we propose a novel LoRA-based Pairwise Training (LPT) strategy designed specifically to achieve robust detection for AIGI under severe distortions. The core of our strategy involves the targeted finetuning of a visual foundation model, the deliberate simulation of data distribution during the training phase, and a unique pairwise training process. Specifically, we introduce distortion and size simulations to better fit the distribution from the validation and test sets. Based on the strong visual representation capability of the visual foundation model, we finetune the model to achieve AIGI detection. The pairwise training is utilized to improve the detection via decoupling the generalization and robustness optimization. Experiments show that our approach secured the 3th placement in the NTIRE Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild challenge

item.title: Towards Realistic and Consistent Orbital Video Generation via 3D Foundation Priors
item.author: Rong Wang, Ruyi Zha, Ziang Cheng, Jiayu Yang, Pulak Purkait, Hongdong Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种利用3D基础生成模型作为辅助约束，从单张图像生成几何真实且一致的轨道视频的新方法。

背景: 现有视频生成工作主要依赖像素级注意力来强制帧间视图一致性，但在长距离外推（如后视图合成）时约束不足，导致像素对应关系有限，难以产生合理且连贯的结构。

目的: 解决现有方法在长距离外推和结构连贯性上的不足，通过引入3D基础生成模型的丰富形状先验来增强约束。

方法: 利用3D基础生成模型编码的两个尺度潜在特征作为辅助约束：一是去噪的全局潜在向量作为整体结构引导；二是从体素特征投影的潜在图像提供视相关和细粒度几何细节。通过多尺度3D适配器利用交叉注意力将特征令牌注入基础视频模型，实现简单且模型无关的微调。

主要发现: 该方法在多个基准测试中实现了优于最先进方法的视觉质量、形状真实性和多视图一致性，并能稳健地泛化到复杂相机轨迹和野外图像。

结论: 该方法通过引入3D基础生成模型的形状先验和高效的特征注入机制，成功生成了几何真实且一致的轨道视频，显著提升了生成效果。

翻译: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用3D基础生成模型作为辅助约束，从单个物体图像生成几何真实且一致的轨道视频。现有的视频生成工作大多依赖像素级注意力来强制帧间视图一致性。然而，这种机制对长距离外推（如后视图合成）施加的约束不足，其中输入图像的像素对应关系有限。因此，这些工作往往无法产生具有合理且连贯结构的结果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出利用来自3D基础生成模型的丰富形状先验作为辅助约束，这是由其从大型3D资产语料库中学习到的建模真实物体形状分布的能力所激发的。具体而言，我们用3D基础模型编码的两个尺度的潜在特征来提示视频生成：（i）去噪的全局潜在向量作为整体结构引导，（ii）一组从体素特征投影的潜在图像，以提供视相关和细粒度几何细节。与常用的2.5D表示（如深度或法线图）不同，这些紧凑特征可以建模完整的物体形状，并通过避免显式网格提取来帮助提高推理效率。为了实现有效的形状条件化，我们引入了一个多尺度3D适配器，通过交叉注意力将特征令牌注入基础视频模型，这保留了其来自通用视频预训练的能力，并实现了一个简单且模型无关的微调过程。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，我们的方法实现了卓越的视觉质量、形状真实性和多视图一致性，并能稳健地泛化到复杂的相机轨迹和野外图像。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有视频生成方法在生成长距离视角（如后视图）时，因像素对应关系有限而导致的结构不真实和连贯性差的问题。这个问题很重要，因为生成逼真的视频对于电子商务、扩展现实和游戏设计等应用至关重要，且现有方法难以处理未见过的物体和挑战性视角。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法仅靠像素级注意力难以约束长距离外推，且2.5D先验无法建模完整形状，因此借鉴了3D基础模型来提取丰富的形状先验。设计上，他们利用3D模型的全局潜在向量和潜在图像作为条件，通过多尺度3D适配器将这些特征注入基础视频模型，从而生成更真实的视频。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用 3D 基础模型学到的形状先验作为辅助约束，以解决现有视频生成方法在生成长距离视角变化（如后视图）时结构不真实的问题。整体实现流程是：首先将输入图像输入 3D 基础模型，提取两个尺度的特征，包括整体结构引导的全局向量和细粒度几何细节的潜在图像；接着，通过多尺度 3D 适配器将这些特征注入到基础视频模型中；最后，结合相机轨迹信息生成逼真且一致的轨道视频。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出利用3D基础模型的形状先验作为辅助约束，显著提升视频生成的形状真实性和视图一致性；同时引入多尺度3D适配器，通过交叉注意力将全局和局部形状特征注入基础视频模型。相比之前的工作，现有方法主要依赖像素级注意力，在长距离外推时效果差；而本文利用3D先验避免了显式网格提取，提高了推理效率，且比迭代细化框架更鲁棒。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种利用3D基础模型先验来生成逼真且一致轨道视频的新方法，通过引入多尺度3D适配器将全局结构引导和视图依赖的几何细节注入基础视频模型，从而显著提升了生成结果的形状真实性和视图一致性。

Abstract

We present a novel method for generating geometrically realistic and consistent orbital videos from a single image of an object. Existing video generation works mostly rely on pixel-wise attention to enforce view consistency across frames. However, such mechanism does not impose sufficient constraints for long-range extrapolation, e.g. rear-view synthesis, in which pixel correspondences to the input image are limited. Consequently, these works often fail to produce results with a plausible and coherent structure. To tackle this issue, we propose to leverage rich shape priors from a 3D foundational generative model as an auxiliary constraint, motivated by its capability of modeling realistic object shape distributions learned from large 3D asset corpora. Specifically, we prompt the video generation with two scales of latent features encoded by the 3D foundation model: (i) a denoised global latent vector as an overall structural guidance, and (ii) a set of latent images projected from volumetric features to provide view-dependent and fine-grained geometry details. In contrast to commonly used 2.5D representations such as depth or normal maps, these compact features can model complete object shapes, and help to improve inference efficiency by avoiding explicit mesh extraction. To achieve effective shape conditioning, we introduce a multi-scale 3D adapter to inject feature tokens to the base video model via cross-attention, which retains its capabilities from general video pretraining and enables a simple and model-agonistic fine-tuning process. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves superior visual quality, shape realism and multi-view consistency compared to state-of-the-art methods, and robustly generalizes to complex camera trajectories and in-the-wild images.

item.title: RSGMamba: Reliability-Aware Self-Gated State Space Model for Multimodal Semantic Segmentation
item.author: Guoan Xu, Yang Xiao, Guangwei Gao, Dongchen Zhu, Wenjing Jia, Guo-Jun Qi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的跨模态融合框架RSGMamba，通过可靠性感知自门控机制动态调节跨模态交互，在RGB-D和RGB-T语义分割任务上取得了最先进的性能。

背景: 现有的跨模态融合方法通常假设所有模态同等可靠，但在辅助模态存在噪声、未对齐或不完整时会导致特征退化。

目的: 从模态可靠性的角度重新审视跨模态融合，提出一种新的框架。

方法: 提出了可靠性感知自门控状态空间模型RSGMamba，核心是可靠性感知自门控模块RSGMB，显式建模模态可靠性并通过自门控机制动态调节跨模态交互；此外引入轻量级局部跨门控调制LCGM来细化细粒度空间细节。

主要发现: 在RGB-D和RGB-T语义分割基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，在NYUDepth V2上达到58.8%/54.0% mIoU，在SUN-RGBD上达到+0.4%/+0.7%，在MFNet和PST900上达到61.1%/88.9% mIoU（最高提升1.6%），且参数量仅为48.6M。

结论: 该方法验证了其有效性和优越性。

翻译: 多模态语义分割通过利用来自多种传感模态（如RGB、深度和热成像）的互补信息来增强场景理解，已成为一种强大的范式。然而，现有的跨模态融合方法通常隐含地假设所有模态同等可靠，这可能导致当辅助模态存在噪声、未对齐或不完整时特征退化。在本文中，我们从模态可靠性的角度重新审视跨模态融合，并提出了一种新颖的框架，称为可靠性感知自门控状态空间模型（RSGMamba）。该方法的核心是可靠性感知自门控模块（RSGMB），它显式地建模模态可靠性并通过自门控机制动态调节跨模态交互。与不区分地在模态之间交换信息的传统融合策略不同，RSGMB实现了可靠性感知的特征选择和信息丰富的特征聚合。此外，还引入了一种轻量级的局部跨门控调制（LCGM）来细化细粒度空间细节，补充了RSGMB的全局建模能力。广泛的实验表明，RSGMamba在RGB-D和RGB-T语义分割基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，在NYUDepth V2上达到58.8%/54.0% mIoU，在SUN-RGBD上达到+0.4%/+0.7%，在MFNet和PST900上达到61.1%/88.9% mIoU（最高提升1.6%），且参数量仅为48.6M，从而验证了所提出方法的有效性和优越性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有跨模态融合方法通常假设所有模态同等可靠，且忽略了显式建模模态可靠性，导致当辅助模态存在噪声、未对齐或不完整时，融合效果变差的问题。在现实应用中，如自动驾驶和机器人操作，辅助模态往往不稳定，盲目融合会引入噪声降低精度；在研究中，这有助于解决现有方法计算成本高或鲁棒性差的问题，实现更精准的跨模态交互。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过分析现有方法的局限性，发现内交互方法依赖大规模预训练且计算开销大，而外交换方法虽高效但易受噪声模态影响。因此，作者借鉴了基于状态空间模型（SSM）的架构来处理全局依赖，并设计了可靠性感知的自门控机制来评估模态的不确定性和一致性，从而动态调节信息注入。此外，还引入了局部门控调制模块来细化细节。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是显式建模模态的可靠性，通过自门控机制动态调节跨模态交互，以避免噪声或未对齐的辅助模态污染特征。整体实现流程是：首先通过共享编码器提取多级特征，随后利用可靠性感知自门控Mamba块（RSGMB）进行全局融合，该模块通过不确定性门控和一致性门控控制信息注入；同时结合局部跨门控调制（LCGM）细化细粒度空间细节，最后将融合特征送入解码器生成分割结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了RSGMamba框架，其核心创新点包括：设计了可靠性感知自门控模块来显式建模模态可靠性并动态调节跨模态交互，以及引入局部跨门控调制来细化细粒度空间细节。相比之前的工作，RSGMamba不再假设模态同等可靠，而是通过不确定性感知和一致性感知的门控机制，有选择地信任模态信息，从而有效缓解了噪声或未对齐辅助输入带来的负面影响。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为RSGMamba的可靠性感知融合框架，通过显式建模模态可靠性并动态调节跨模态交互，从而在RGB-D和RGB-T分割任务上取得了优异效果。

Abstract

Multimodal semantic segmentation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing scene understanding by leveraging complementary information from multiple sensing modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and thermal). However, existing cross-modal fusion methods often implicitly assume that all modalities are equally reliable, which can lead to feature degradation when auxiliary modalities are noisy, misaligned, or incomplete. In this paper, we revisit cross-modal fusion from the perspective of modality reliability and propose a novel framework termed the Reliability-aware Self-Gated State Space Model (RSGMamba). At the core of our method is the Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block (RSGMB), which explicitly models modality reliability and dynamically regulates cross-modal interactions through a self-gating mechanism. Unlike conventional fusion strategies that indiscriminately exchange information across modalities, RSGMB enables reliability-aware feature selection and enhancing informative feature aggregation. In addition, a lightweight Local Cross-Gated Modulation (LCGM) is incorporated to refine fine-grained spatial details, complementing the global modeling capability of RSGMB. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSGMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance on both RGB-D and RGB-T semantic segmentation benchmarks, resulting 58.8% / 54.0% mIoU on NYUDepth V2 and SUN-RGBD (+0.4% / +0.7% over prior best), and 61.1% / 88.9% mIoU on MFNet and PST900 (up to +1.6%), with only 48.6M parameters, thereby validating the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach.

item.title: Self-Adversarial One Step Generation via Condition Shifting
item.author: Deyuan Liu, Peng Sun, Yansen Han, Zhenglin Cheng, Chuyan Chen, Tao Lin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: APEX 是一种基于流模型条件变换提取对抗性校正信号的文本到图像生成方法，旨在解决现有方法在单步生成中面临的保真度、推理速度和训练效率之间的权衡问题。

背景: 现有文本到图像合成方法在单步采样方面面临保真度、推理速度和训练效率之间的权衡。依赖外部判别器的方法虽然能提高单步性能，但往往引入训练不稳定、高GPU内存开销和收敛缓慢等问题。

目的: 提出 APEX 方法，旨在通过从流模型中提取对抗性校正信号，在单步生成中保持细节，同时避免外部判别器带来的训练不稳定和资源消耗问题。

方法: APEX 基于一个关键理论洞察：通过条件变换从流模型中提取对抗性校正信号。具体而言，创建一个变换后的条件分支，其速度场作为模型当前生成分布的独立估计器，产生与 GAN 对齐的梯度，从而替代导致梯度消失的样本依赖判别器项。该方法无需判别器，且架构保持兼容。

主要发现: 在实验中，0.6B 参数的 APEX 模型在单步质量上超越了 FLUX-Schnell 12B 模型。在 Qwen-Image 20B 上使用 LoRA 微调后，APEX 在 NFE=1 时达到 0.89 的 GenEval 分数，耗时 6 小时，超越了原始 50 步教师模型（0.87），并提供了 15.33 倍的推理速度提升。

结论: APEX 通过无需判别器的设计和架构保持特性，实现了高效的单步文本到图像生成，在保持细节的同时显著提升了训练效率和推理速度。

翻译: The push for efficient text to image synthesis has moved the field toward one step sampling, yet existing methods still face a three way tradeoff among fidelity, inference speed, and training efficiency. Approaches that rely on external discriminators can sharpen one step performance, but they often introduce training instability, high GPU memory overhead, and slow convergence, which complicates scaling and parameter efficient tuning. In contrast, regression based distillation and consistency objectives are easier to optimize, but they typically lose fine details when constrained to a single step. We present APEX, built on a key theoretical insight: adversarial correction signals can be extracted endogenously from a flow model through condition shifting. Using a transformation creates a shifted condition branch whose velocity field serves as an independent estimator of the model's current generation distribution, yielding a gradient that is provably GAN aligned, replacing the sample dependent discriminator terms that cause gradient vanishing. This discriminator free design is architecture preserving, making APEX a plug and play framework compatible with both full parameter and LoRA based tuning. Empirically, our 0.6B model surpasses FLUX-Schnell 12B (20$imes$ more parameters) in one step quality. With LoRA tuning on Qwen-Image 20B, APEX reaches a GenEval score of 0.89 at NFE=1 in 6 hours, surpassing the original 50-step teacher (0.87) and providing a 15.33$imes$ inference speedup. Code is available https://github.com/LINs-lab/APEX.

Abstract

The push for efficient text to image synthesis has moved the field toward one step sampling, yet existing methods still face a three way tradeoff among fidelity, inference speed, and training efficiency. Approaches that rely on external discriminators can sharpen one step performance, but they often introduce training instability, high GPU memory overhead, and slow convergence, which complicates scaling and parameter efficient tuning. In contrast, regression based distillation and consistency objectives are easier to optimize, but they typically lose fine details when constrained to a single step. We present APEX, built on a key theoretical insight: adversarial correction signals can be extracted endogenously from a flow model through condition shifting. Using a transformation creates a shifted condition branch whose velocity field serves as an independent estimator of the model's current generation distribution, yielding a gradient that is provably GAN aligned, replacing the sample dependent discriminator terms that cause gradient vanishing. This discriminator free design is architecture preserving, making APEX a plug and play framework compatible with both full parameter and LoRA based tuning. Empirically, our 0.6B model surpasses FLUX-Schnell 12B (20$\times$ more parameters) in one step quality. With LoRA tuning on Qwen-Image 20B, APEX reaches a GenEval score of 0.89 at NFE=1 in 6 hours, surpassing the original 50-step teacher (0.87) and providing a 15.33$\times$ inference speedup. Code is available https://github.com/LINs-lab/APEX.

item.title: HyperLiDAR: Adaptive Post-Deployment LiDAR Segmentation via Hyperdimensional Computing
item.author: Ivannia Gomez Moreno, Yi Yao, Ye Tian, Xiaofan Yu, Flavio Ponzina, Michael Sullivan, Jingyi Zhang, Mingyu Yang, Hun Seok Kim, Tajana Rosing
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HyperLiDAR是一种基于超维计算（HDC）的轻量级LiDAR语义分割框架，旨在解决边缘设备部署后的适应性挑战。

背景: LiDAR语义分割在自动驾驶等边缘应用中至关重要，但现实环境变化导致模型性能下降，且边缘设备计算和能源受限，难以直接适配大型神经网络模型。

目的: 提出HyperLiDAR框架，利用HDC的快速学习和高效率特性，解决实时部署适应性问题，并提高适配效率。

方法: HyperLiDAR基于HDC设计，引入缓冲区选择策略以聚焦于最具信息量的点，从而提高学习效率。

主要发现: 在两个最先进的LiDAR分割基准和两个代表性设备上的广泛评估显示，HyperLiDAR在适配性能上优于或达到最先进方法，且重训练速度提升高达13.8倍。

结论: HyperLiDAR成功实现了轻量级、高效的LiDAR语义分割模型在边缘设备上的部署后适应，显著提升了重训练速度。

翻译: LiDAR语义分割在自动驾驶等边缘应用中扮演着关键角色。然而，对于现实世界的部署，特别是设备后部署的适应，仍面临重大挑战。随着系统在不同地点导航，现实世界环境会发生变化，导致如果没有有效及时的模型适应，性能会大幅下降。此外，边缘系统在严格的计算和能源限制下运行，使得直接在设备上适配传统的分割模型（基于大型神经网络）变得不可行。为了解决上述挑战，我们介绍了HyperLiDAR，这是第一个基于超维计算（HDC）的轻量级、设备后部署LiDAR分割框架。HyperLiDAR的设计充分利用了HDC的快速学习和高效率，灵感来源于人类大脑处理信息的方式。为了进一步提高适应效率，我们识别出每次扫描的高数据量是一个关键瓶颈，并引入了一种缓冲区选择策略，专注于对最具信息量的点进行学习。我们在两个最先进的LiDAR分割基准和两个代表性设备上进行了广泛评估。我们的结果表明，HyperLiDAR在适配性能上优于或达到最先进方法，同时实现了高达13.8倍的重训练加速。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决在资源受限的边缘设备上，如何对激光雷达语义分割模型进行快速、高效的部署后适应的问题。这个问题很重要，因为现实环境（如从城市到农村）和扫描模式会不断变化，导致固定模型性能下降。现有的基于大型神经网络的模型在边缘设备上难以适应，且存在灾难性遗忘问题。HyperLiDAR 提供了一种轻量级方案，能在不破坏旧知识的情况下快速更新模型，以应对动态变化。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现实环境变化导致模型性能下降及边缘设备算力受限的问题，借鉴人脑处理信息的方式，设计了基于超维计算（HDC）的框架。他们发现传统神经网络在边缘端训练太慢，因此采用仅通过向量加法更新模型的方法。此外，为了解决点云数据量大的瓶颈，他们引入了缓冲区选择策略，仅选取表现最差的样本进行训练。作者参考了跨域适应和高效分割领域的研究，但指出这些方法通常缺乏部署后适应能力或计算成本过高。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用超维计算（HDC）模拟人脑处理信息的方式，将 LiDAR 点云数据编码为高维低精度向量，通过简单的向量运算实现模型在边缘设备上的快速适应。同时，它引入了缓冲区选择策略，只关注学习最困难的数据点，从而在资源受限的设备上高效处理大规模点云数据。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先在云端预训练一个通用的特征提取器并冻结；然后在边缘设备上，将新获取的 LiDAR 扫描数据输入该提取器，通过随机投影将其编码为高维超向量，仅更新各类别的代表超向量；最后在推理时，计算新点云与各类别超向量的相似度，从而实现语义分割。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了首个基于超维计算（HDC）的轻量级LiDAR分割框架，并设计了缓冲区选择策略，仅用5%的数据就能实现高效的自适应学习。相比之前的工作，它解决了传统神经网络在边缘设备上难以进行后部署适应的算力瓶颈问题，实现了高达13.8倍的重新训练加速。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了HyperLiDAR，首个基于超维计算（HDC）的轻量级LiDAR分割框架，用于解决边缘设备上的部署后适应问题。该框架通过引入缓冲区选择策略，仅使用5%的数据即可实现高效率的自适应学习，相比现有方法速度提升高达13.8倍。

Abstract

LiDAR semantic segmentation plays a pivotal role in 3D scene understanding for edge applications such as autonomous driving. However, significant challenges remain for real-world deployments, particularly for on-device post-deployment adaptation. Real-world environments can shift as the system navigates through different locations, leading to substantial performance degradation without effective and timely model adaptation. Furthermore, edge systems operate under strict computational and energy constraints, making it infeasible to adapt conventional segmentation models (based on large neural networks) directly on-device. To address the above challenges, we introduce HyperLiDAR, the first lightweight, post-deployment LiDAR segmentation framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC). The design of HyperLiDAR fully leverages the fast learning and high efficiency of HDC, inspired by how the human brain processes information. To further improve the adaptation efficiency, we identify the high data volume per scan as a key bottleneck and introduce a buffer selection strategy that focuses learning on the most informative points. We conduct extensive evaluations on two state-of-the-art LiDAR segmentation benchmarks and two representative devices. Our results show that HyperLiDAR outperforms or achieves comparable adaptation performance to state-of-the-art segmentation methods, while achieving up to a 13.8x speedup in retraining.

item.title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding
item.author: Tanzila Rahman, Renjie Liao, Leonid Sigal
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种统一的数据生成流水线，用于自动创建无限且多样化的多模态视频数据，并引入了基于视觉问答的微调策略以增强模型的推理能力。

背景: 训练多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行视频理解需要大规模标注数据，但现实世界中收集和标注多模态视频数据成本高昂、速度缓慢且多样性有限。

目的: 解决现实世界中收集和标注多模态视频数据成本高昂、速度缓慢且多样性有限的问题，并增强模型的推理能力。

方法: 提出了一种统一的数据生成流水线，支持多种任务格式，并引入了基于视觉问答的微调策略，训练模型回答关于视觉内容的结构化问题。

主要发现: 在视频目标计数、基于视频的视觉问答和视频目标分割三个具有挑战性的任务中，主要在合成数据上训练的模型在真实世界数据集上表现出色，往往优于传统训练的模型。

结论: 统一的数据生成流水线作为昂贵现实世界标注的可扩展替代方案，在多模态视频理解中具有巨大潜力。

翻译: 训练用于视频理解的多模态大语言模型需要跨越多种任务的大规模标注数据，如目标计数、问答和分割。然而，在现实世界中收集和标注多模态视频数据成本高昂、速度缓慢，且在多样性和覆盖面上固有限制。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种统一的数据生成流水线，能够自动生成无限且具有丰富监督信号的多模态视频数据。我们的框架支持单个流水线内的多种任务格式，实现了跨任务的可扩展且一致的数据创建。为了进一步增强推理能力，我们引入了一种基于视觉问答的微调策略，训练模型回答关于视觉内容的结构化问题，而不是仅仅依赖字幕或简单指令。这种形式鼓励更深层次的视觉基础和推理。我们在三个具有挑战性的任务中评估了我们的方法：视频目标计数、基于视频的视觉问答和视频目标分割。实验结果表明，主要在合成数据上训练的模型在真实世界数据集上泛化效果良好，往往优于传统训练的模型。我们的发现突显了统一的数据生成流水线作为昂贵现实世界标注的可扩展替代方案在多模态视频理解中的潜力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决训练多模态大语言模型进行视频理解时，获取大规模、高质量标注数据困难且昂贵的问题。现实世界的数据收集和标注成本高、速度慢、多样性有限，且存在偏差。合成数据可以按比例生成，且对质量、平衡和多样性有精确控制，同时避免隐私问题，从而帮助模型学习更通用的多模态推理原则，显著降低标注成本。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者从单张图像出发，利用大语言模型生成描述，再结合图像和描述生成视频，最后通过视觉问答微调来增强推理能力。设计上采用了顺序且连接的流水线，确保多模态一致性。作者借鉴了现有工作，如利用VAE和GAN进行生成，参考了Fake2M和HC3等合成数据检测基准，以及What'sUp和SPEC等组合推理基准，还使用了Wan 2.2和SAM2等模型。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用可控的仿真环境和自动标注机制，生成无需人工标注的高质量多模态视频数据，并采用基于视觉问答的微调策略来增强模型的推理能力。其整体实现流程是从单张图片开始，首先利用大语言模型生成图片的描述文本，接着将图片和文本作为条件输入视频生成模型来创建连贯的视频序列，最后可选地生成同步音频，并生成视频分割掩码。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了一个统一的数据生成管道，能从单张图像自动产生无限多模态数据；引入了一种基于视觉问答（VQA）的新颖微调策略，以增强模型的推理能力；并在三个任务上验证了模型在真实世界数据上的泛化效果。相比之前依赖昂贵真实标注或简单标题的工作，本文利用可控仿真环境生成结构化监督数据，并通过VQA微调鼓励更深层的视觉基础和推理。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种统一的合成数据生成管道，通过自动生成无限多模态视频数据并采用基于视觉问答的微调策略，显著提升了模型在视频理解任务上的推理能力和泛化性能。

Abstract

Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. This formulation encourages deeper visual grounding and reasoning. We evaluate our approach in three challenging tasks: video object counting, video-based visual question answering, and video object segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that models trained predominantly on synthetic data generalize effectively to real-world datasets, often outperforming traditionally trained counterparts. Our findings highlight the potential of unified synthetic data pipelines as a scalable alternative to expensive real-world annotation for multimodal video understanding.

item.title: Information-Geometric Decomposition of Generalization Error in Unsupervised Learning
item.author: Gilhan Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究将无监督学习的Kullback-Leibler泛化误差分解为三个非负部分：模型误差、数据偏差和方差。

背景: 无监督学习中泛化误差的分解对于理解模型性能至关重要。

目的: 将泛化误差分解为三个非负分量，并应用于ε-PCA方法以展示其分析可解性。

方法: 利用信息几何中的广义毕达哥拉斯定理和双e混合方差恒等式，对任意e平坦模型类进行精确分解。

主要发现: 在ε-PCA中，最优秩为λ_cut* = ε，即保留超过噪声地板的样本特征值。研究还确定了三个相区：保留全部、内部和坍塌，分别由Marchenko-Pastur边缘和可计算的坍塌阈值ε_*(α)分隔。

结论: 该框架为ε-PCA提供了分析可解的分解，并验证了所有主张。

翻译: 我们将无监督学习的Kullback-Leibler泛化误差——即从数据分布到训练模型的期望KL散度——分解为三个非负分量：模型误差、数据偏差和方差。该分解对于任何e平坦模型类都是精确的，并源于信息几何的两个恒等式：广义毕达哥拉斯定理和双e混合方差恒等式。作为一个分析可解的演示，我们将该框架应用于ε-PCA，这是一种正则化主成分分析，其中经验协方差在秩N_K处被截断，丢弃的方向固定在固定的噪声地板ε上。虽然秩约束的ε-PCA本身不是e平坦的，但在各向同性高斯数据下，它可以通过具有相同总GE的技术重述来实现，在此重述下，分解的每个分量都取闭式形式。最优秩出现为截止λ_cut* = ε——即模型保留超过噪声地板的样本特征值——其中截止反映了模型误差增益和数据偏差成本之间的边际率平衡。边界比较进一步产生了一个三相图——保留全部、内部和坍塌——分别由Marchenko-Pastur边缘和可计算的坍塌阈值ε_*(α)分隔，其中α是维度与样本大小之比。所有主张均通过数值验证。

Abstract

We decompose the Kullback--Leibler generalization error (GE) -- the expected KL divergence from the data distribution to the trained model -- of unsupervised learning into three non-negative components: model error, data bias, and variance. The decomposition is exact for any e-flat model class and follows from two identities of information geometry: the generalized Pythagorean theorem and a dual e-mixture variance identity. As an analytically tractable demonstration, we apply the framework to $ε$-PCA, a regularized principal component analysis in which the empirical covariance is truncated at rank $N_K$ and discarded directions are pinned at a fixed noise floor $ε$. Although rank-constrained $ε$-PCA is not itself e-flat, it admits a technical reformulation with the same total GE on isotropic Gaussian data, under which each component of the decomposition takes closed form. The optimal rank emerges as the cutoff $λ_{\mathrm{cut}}^{*} = ε$ -- the model retains exactly those empirical eigenvalues exceeding the noise floor -- with the cutoff reflecting a marginal-rate balance between model-error gain and data-bias cost. A boundary comparison further yields a three-regime phase diagram -- retain-all, interior, and collapse -- separated by the lower Marchenko--Pastur edge and an analytically computable collapse threshold $ε_{*}(α)$, where $α$ is the dimension-to-sample-size ratio. All claims are verified numerically.

item.title: Unlocking the Potential of Grounding DINO in Videos: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Limited-Data Spatial-Temporal Localization
item.author: Zanyi Wang, Fan Li, Dengyang Jiang, Liuzhuozheng Li, Yunhua Zhong, Guang Dai, Mengmeng Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ST-GD是一个数据高效的框架，通过冻结预训练模型并注入轻量级适配器来适应视频任务，在有限数据集上表现优异。

背景: 时空视频定位(STVG)需要大量数据，但标注密集帧级边界框和复杂时间语言对齐极其昂贵，导致现有模型在小数据集上过拟合，而零样本基础模型缺乏特定任务的时间感知能力。

目的: 解决STVG任务中的小数据挑战，通过数据高效的方法在有限数据集上实现高性能。

方法: ST-GD框架冻结预训练的2D视觉-语言模型，注入轻量级适配器(~10M可训练参数)以注入时空感知能力，并引入新的时间解码器用于边界预测。

主要发现: ST-GD在有限规模的HC-STVG v1/v2基准测试中取得了高度竞争力的性能，并在VidSTG数据集上保持了强大的泛化能力。

结论: ST-GD验证了在严格小数据约束下进行复杂视频理解的强大范式。

翻译: 时空视频定位(STVG)旨在在动态视频片段中定位查询对象。现有的全训练方法以数据饥渴著称。然而，收集大规模STVG数据极其具有挑战性：密集的帧级边界框和复杂的时间语言对齐标注极其昂贵，特别是对于专业视频领域。因此，传统模型在这些固有的有限数据集上遭受严重的过拟合，而零样本基础模型缺乏精确定位所需的特定任务时间感知能力。为了解决这种小数据挑战，我们介绍了ST-GD，一个数据高效的框架，它将预训练的2D视觉-语言模型(如Grounding DINO)适应到视频任务中。为了避免在小数据集上破坏预训练先验，ST-GD保持基础模型冻结，并战略性地注入轻量级适配器(~10M可训练参数)以注入时空感知能力，以及一个新的时间解码器用于边界预测。这种设计自然地对抗了数据稀缺性。因此，ST-GD在数据稀缺场景中表现出色，在有限规模的HC-STVG v1/v2基准测试中取得了高度竞争力的性能，同时在VidSTG数据集上保持了强大的泛化能力。这验证了ST-GD是在严格小数据约束下进行复杂视频理解的强大范式。

Abstract

Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize queried objects within dynamic video segments. Prevailing fully-trained approaches are notoriously data-hungry. However, gathering large-scale STVG data is exceptionally challenging: dense frame-level bounding boxes and complex temporal language alignments are prohibitively expensive to annotate, especially for specialized video domains. Consequently, conventional models suffer from severe overfitting on these inherently limited datasets, while zero-shot foundational models lack the task-specific temporal awareness needed for precise localization. To resolve this small-data challenge, we introduce ST-GD, a data-efficient framework that adapts pre-trained 2D visual-language models (e.g., Grounding DINO) to video tasks. To avoid destroying pre-trained priors on small datasets, ST-GD keeps the base model frozen and strategically injects lightweight adapters (~10M trainable parameters) to instill spatio-temporal awareness, alongside a novel temporal decoder for boundary prediction. This design naturally counters data scarcity. Consequently, ST-GD excels in data-scarce scenarios, achieving highly competitive performance on the limited-scale HC-STVG v1/v2 benchmarks, while maintaining robust generalization on the VidSTG dataset. This validates ST-GD as a powerful paradigm for complex video understanding under strict small-data constraints.

item.title: Fundus Image-based Glaucoma Screening via Retinal Knowledge-Oriented Dynamic Multi-Level Feature Integration
item.author: Yuzhuo Zhou, Chi Liu, Sheng Shen, Zongyuan Ge, Fengshi Jing, Shiran Zhang, Yu Jiang, Anli Wang, Wenjian Liu, Feilong Yang, Tianqing Zhu, Xiaotong Han
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于视网膜知识导向的青光眼筛查框架，通过动态多尺度特征学习和领域特定的视网膜先验知识，结合三分支结构捕捉互补的视网膜表示，并设计了动态窗口机制和知识增强卷积注意力模块来提高诊断的鲁棒性。

背景: 基于彩色眼底照片的自动诊断对于大规模青光眼筛查至关重要。然而，现有的深度学习模型通常是数据驱动的，缺乏对视网膜解剖知识的显式整合，这限制了它们在不同异质临床数据集上的鲁棒性。此外，眼底图像中的病理线索可能出现在预定义的解剖区域之外，使得固定区域特征提取不足以进行可靠诊断。

目的: 为了解决现有模型缺乏解剖知识整合以及固定区域特征提取不足的问题，提出了一种视网膜知识导向的青光眼筛查框架，该框架集成了动态多尺度特征学习和领域特定的视网膜先验知识。

方法: 该框架采用三分支结构来捕捉互补的视网膜表示，包括全局视网膜上下文、视盘/视杯的结构特征以及动态定位的病理区域。具体包括动态窗口机制以自适应识别具有诊断信息的区域，以及知识增强卷积注意力模块，该模块结合从预训练基础模型中提取的视网膜先验来引导注意力学习。

主要发现: 在大型AIROGS数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法优于多种基线，实现了98.5%的AUC和94.6%的准确率。在SMDG-19基准测试的多个数据集上的额外评估进一步证实了其强大的跨领域泛化能力。

结论: 知识引导的注意力结合自适应病灶定位可以显著提高自动青光眼筛查系统的鲁棒性。

翻译: 基于彩色眼底照片的自动诊断对于大规模青光眼筛查至关重要。然而，现有的深度学习模型通常是数据驱动的，缺乏对视网膜解剖知识的显式整合，这限制了它们在不同异质临床数据集上的鲁棒性。此外，眼底图像中的病理线索可能出现在预定义的解剖区域之外，使得固定区域特征提取不足以进行可靠诊断。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种视网膜知识导向的青光眼筛查框架，该框架集成了动态多尺度特征学习和领域特定的视网膜先验知识。该框架采用三分支结构来捕捉互补的视网膜表示，包括全局视网膜上下文、视盘/视杯的结构特征以及动态定位的病理区域。设计了一种动态窗口机制来自适应识别具有诊断信息的区域，并采用知识增强卷积注意力模块结合从预训练基础模型中提取的视网膜先验来引导注意力学习。在大型AIROGS数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法优于多种基线，实现了98.5%的AUC和94.6%的准确率。在SMDG-19基准测试的多个数据集上的额外评估进一步证实了其强大的跨领域泛化能力，表明知识引导的注意力结合自适应病灶定位可以显著提高自动青光眼筛查系统的鲁棒性。

Abstract

Automated diagnosis based on color fundus photography is essential for large-scale glaucoma screening. However, existing deep learning models are typically data-driven and lack explicit integration of retinal anatomical knowledge, which limits their robustness across heterogeneous clinical datasets. Moreover, pathological cues in fundus images may appear beyond predefined anatomical regions, making fixed-region feature extraction insufficient for reliable diagnosis. To address these challenges, we propose a retinal knowledge-oriented glaucoma screening framework that integrates dynamic multi-scale feature learning with domain-specific retinal priors. The framework adopts a tri-branch structure to capture complementary retinal representations, including global retinal context, structural features of the optic disc/cup, and dynamically localized pathological regions. A Dynamic Window Mechanism is devised to adaptively identify diagnostically informative regions, while a Knowledge-Enhanced Convolutional Attention Module incorporates retinal priors extracted from a pre-trained foundation model to guide attention learning. Extensive experiments on the large-scale AIROGS dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms diverse baselines, achieving an AUC of 98.5% and an accuracy of 94.6%. Additional evaluations on multiple datasets from the SMDG-19 benchmark further confirm its strong cross-domain generalization capability, indicating that knowledge-guided attention combined with adaptive lesion localization can significantly improve the robustness of automated glaucoma screening systems.

item.title: Cross-Domain Transfer with Particle Physics Foundation Models: From Jets to Neutrino Interactions
item.author: Gregor Krzmanc, Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman, Callum Wilkinson
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究基于OmniLearned基础模型在粒子物理中的应用，通过迁移学习将高Q2模拟和真实pp及ep碰撞预训练模型应用于低能中微子实验，验证了其在能量尺度、探测器技术和物理过程差异下的泛化能力。

背景: 未来粒子物理中的AI研究可能从基础模型开始，以加速训练并提高灵敏度。作为迈向通用粒子物理基础模型的一步，研究探讨了OmniLearned基础模型在低能中微子实验中的迁移效果。

目的: 探究预训练的OmniLearned基础模型能否有效迁移到低能中微子实验，并评估其在能量回归和分类任务上的性能。

方法: 处理MINERvA中微子-原子核散射事件，在两种任务上评估预训练模型：可用能量回归和带电流π末态（CC1π±, CCNπ±, CC1π0）的二分类。

主要发现: 预训练的OmniLearned模型在相同计算预算和训练步数下，始终优于从头训练的类似大小模型，表现出更好的整体性能。

结论: 粒子级基础模型获得了跨大能量尺度、探测器技术和底层物理过程差异的归纳偏置，指向了粒子物理中探测器无关推理的新范式。

翻译: 未来基于AI的粒子物理研究可能从基础模型开始，以加速训练并提高灵敏度。作为迈向通用粒子物理基础模型的一步，我们研究了在多样化高Q2模拟和真实pp及ep碰撞上预训练的OmniLearned基础模型，能否有效迁移到低能中微子实验。我们处理MINERvA中微子-原子核散射事件，并在两种任务上评估预训练模型：可用能量回归和带电流π末态（CC1π±, CCNπ±, CC1π0）的二分类。预训练的OmniLearned模型始终优于从头训练的类似大小模型，在相同计算预算下表现出更好的整体性能，以及在相同训练步数下也表现出更好的性能。这些结果表明，粒子级基础模型获得了跨大能量尺度、探测器技术和底层物理过程差异的归纳偏置，指向了粒子物理中探测器无关推理的新范式。

Abstract

Future AI-based studies in particle physics will likely start from a foundation model to accelerate training and enhance sensitivity. As a step towards a general-purpose foundation model for particle physics, we investigate whether the OmniLearned foundation model pre-trained on diverse high-$Q^2$ simulated and real $pp$ and $ep$ collisions can be effectively transferred to a few-GeV fixed-target neutrino experiment. We process MINERvA neutrino--nucleus scattering events and evaluate pre-trained models on two types of tasks: regression of available energy and binary classification of charged-current pion final states ($\mathrm{CC1π^{\pm}}$, $\mathrm{CCNπ^{\pm}}$, and $\mathrm{CC1π^{0}}$). Pre-trained OmniLearned models consistently outperform similarly sized models trained from scratch, achieving better overall performance at the same compute budget, as well as achieving better performance at the same number of training steps. These results suggest that particle-level foundation models acquire inductive biases that generalize across large differences in energy scale, detector technology, and underlying physics processes, pointing toward a paradigm of detector-agnostic inference in particle physics.

item.title: Masked by Consensus: Disentangling Privileged Knowledge in LLM Correctness
item.author: Tomer Ashuach, Liat Ein-Dor, Shai Gretz, Yoav Katz, Yonatan Belinkov
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了大型语言模型是否拥有类似人类的特权知识，即关于答案正确性的内部状态，这种知识对外部观察者不可见。

背景: 人类利用内省来评估自己对知识的理解，这种内部状态对外部观察者不可见。

目的: 调查大型语言模型是否拥有关于答案正确性的特权知识，以及这种知识是否可以通过外部观察获得。

方法: 在标准评估中，使用模型自身的隐藏状态和外部模型的表示训练正确性分类器，比较自表示和同伴模型表示的性能。随后在模型预测不一致的子集上评估，以隔离真正的特权知识。

主要发现: 在标准评估中，自探针与同伴模型探针性能相当，这归因于模型间答案正确性的一致性。在预测不一致的子集上，发现领域特定的特权知识：自表示在事实知识任务中始终优于同伴表示，但在数学推理中无优势。此外，事实优势从早期到中期层逐渐出现，与模型特定的记忆检索一致，而数学推理在任何深度均无一致优势。

结论: 大型语言模型确实拥有领域特定的特权知识，特别是在事实知识任务中，这种知识在模型内部表示中比外部表示更有效。

翻译: 摘要：人类利用内省来评估他们对知识的理解，这种内部状态对外部观察者不可见。我们调查大型语言模型是否拥有关于答案正确性的类似特权知识，这种知识无法通过外部观察获得。我们在标准评估中发现没有优势：自探针与同伴模型探针性能相当。我们假设这是由于模型间答案正确性的一致性。为了隔离真正的特权知识，我们在模型产生冲突预测的不一致子集上评估。在这里，我们发现了领域特定的特权知识：自表示在事实知识任务中始终优于同伴表示，但在数学推理中没有优势。我们进一步在模型层中定位这种领域不对称性，发现事实优势从早期到中期层逐渐出现，与模型特定的记忆检索一致，而数学推理在任何深度都没有一致优势。

Abstract

Humans use introspection to evaluate their understanding through private internal states inaccessible to external observers. We investigate whether large language models possess similar privileged knowledge about answer correctness, information unavailable through external observation. We train correctness classifiers on question representations from both a model's own hidden states and external models, testing whether self-representations provide a performance advantage. On standard evaluation, we find no advantage: self-probes perform comparably to peer-model probes. We hypothesize this is due to high inter-model agreement of answer correctness. To isolate genuine privileged knowledge, we evaluate on disagreement subsets, where models produce conflicting predictions. Here, we discover domain-specific privileged knowledge: self-representations consistently outperform peer representations in factual knowledge tasks, but show no advantage in math reasoning. We further localize this domain asymmetry across model layers, finding that the factual advantage emerges progressively from early-to-mid layers onward, consistent with model-specific memory retrieval, while math reasoning shows no consistent advantage at any depth.

item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Nemotron 3 Super模型，这是一个1200亿参数的混合Mamba-注意力混合专家模型，包括预训练、后训练和量化过程。

背景: Nemotron 3 Super是Nemotron 3系列中的首个模型，采用了NVFP4格式预训练，利用了LatentMoE架构，并包含MTP层用于推理加速。

目的: 为了优化每FLOP和每参数的准确性，并实现通过原生推测解码进行推理加速。

方法: 在25万亿token上进行预训练，随后使用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行后训练，并支持高达100万上下文长度。

主要发现: 在通用基准测试中达到可比的准确性，与GPT-OSS-120B相比推理吞吐量提高2.2倍，与Qwen3.5-122B相比提高7.5倍。

结论: Nemotron 3 Super模型在保持高准确性的同时显著提高了推理吞吐量，相关数据集和检查点已开源。

翻译: 本文描述了Nemotron 3 Super的预训练、后训练和量化过程，这是一个1200亿参数的混合Mamba-注意力混合专家模型。Nemotron 3 Super是Nemotron 3系列中的首个模型，1)在NVFP4中预训练，2)利用LatentMoE架构，该架构针对每FLOP和每参数的准确性进行了优化，3)包含MTP层，用于通过原生推测解码进行推理加速。我们在25万亿token上预训练了Nemotron 3 Super，随后使用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行后训练。最终模型支持高达100万上下文长度，并在通用基准测试中达到可比的准确性，同时与GPT-OSS-120B和Qwen3.5-122B相比，推理吞吐量分别提高了2.2倍和7.5倍。Nemotron 3 Super数据集以及基础、后训练和量化检查点已在HuggingFace上开源。

Abstract

We describe the pre-training, post-training, and quantization of Nemotron 3 Super, a 120 billion (active 12 billion) parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to 1) be pre-trained in NVFP4, 2) leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and 3) include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Super on 25 trillion tokens followed by post-training using supervised fine tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). The final model supports up to 1M context length and achieves comparable accuracy on common benchmarks, while also achieving up to 2.2x and 7.5x higher inference throughput compared to GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively. Nemotron 3 Super datasets, along with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, are open-sourced on HuggingFace.

item.title: On the Distillation Loss Functions of Speech VAE for Unified Reconstruction, Understanding, and Generation
item.author: Changhao Cheng, Wei Wang, Wangyou Zhang, Dongya Jia, Jian Wu, Zhuo Chen, Yanmin Qian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了基于变分自编码器VAE的连续语音表示在语音生成和重建任务中的表现，并探讨了如何通过自监督学习SSL特征对齐来增强VAE潜在表示的结构信息。

背景: 传统的基于频谱图或离散标记的特征在语音生成和重建中存在局限，而基于VAE的连续语音表示被视为一种有前景的替代方案。近期研究尝试通过将VAE潜在表示与自监督学习SSL特征对齐来丰富结构信息。

目的: 为了解决当前广泛使用的时间轴蒸馏对齐方法在考虑更多任务时是否最优的问题，本文旨在系统探索不同的对齐方法，并分析它们在重建、理解和生成三个维度上的性能影响。

方法: 本文调查了蒸馏损失中的各种设计选择，特别是比较了不同的对齐方法，并引入了联合边缘对齐方法与自适应加权。

主要发现: 实验表明，联合边缘对齐方法配合自适应加权能够实现最佳的整体性能，并允许可控的平衡。

结论: 联合边缘对齐方法配合自适应加权是优于其他方法的最佳选择。

翻译: 基于变分自编码器VAE的连续语音表示已成为语音生成和重建任务中传统频谱图或离散标记特征的潜在替代方案。近期研究试图通过将VAE潜在表示与自监督学习SSL特征对齐来丰富结构信息，以实现更好的生成性能。然而，当考虑更多任务时，广泛使用的时间轴蒸馏对齐方法是否最优尚不清楚。为了解决这个问题，本文系统地探索了不同的对齐方法，并分析了它们在重建、理解和生成三个维度上的性能影响。我们调查了蒸馏损失中的各种设计选择。广泛的实验表明，联合边缘对齐方法配合自适应加权可以实现最佳的整体性能，同时允许可控的平衡。

Abstract

Continuous speech representations based on Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional spectrogram or discrete token based features for speech generation and reconstruction. Recent research has tried to enrich the structural information in VAE latent representations by aligning with self-supervised learning (SSL) features, aiming for better generation performance. However, it remains unclear whether the widely-used alignment approach based on time-axis distillation is optimal when considering more tasks. To address this problem, this paper systematically explores different alignment approaches and analyzes their impact on the performances over three axes: reconstruction, understanding, and generation. We investigate various design choices in the distillation loss. Extensive experiments show that the joint-marginal alignment approach with adaptive weighting can achieve the best overall performance while allowing for a controllable balance.

item.title: Chain-of-Models Pre-Training: Rethinking Training Acceleration of Vision Foundation Models
item.author: Jiawei Fan, Shigeng Wang, Chao Li, Xiaolong Liu, Anbang Yao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT)，一种针对视觉基础模型的无损训练加速方法。该方法通过建立模型链，利用逆向知识转移在参数空间和特征空间共享知识，从而在减少训练成本的同时提升模型性能。

背景: 现有的加速方法通常优化单个模型，而CoM-PT旨在在模型家族层面加速训练流程，随着模型家族的扩展高效扩展。

目的: 设计一种新的训练加速方法，在模型家族层面进行训练，以减少训练成本并保持性能，同时验证其在不同数据集上的有效性。

方法: 建立按模型大小升序排列的模型链。在链中，仅最小模型进行标准训练，其他模型通过从较小前驱模型进行逆向知识转移来高效训练，同时重用参数空间和特征空间中的知识。

主要发现: CoM-PT使所有模型在性能上优于标准训练，显著降低训练成本。随着模型家族扩展，训练更多模型甚至导致更高效率；例如，在CC3M数据集上，添加较小模型可将计算复杂度降低高达72%；在固定模型大小范围内，随着模型家族从3个增加到7个，加速比从4.13倍跃升至7.09倍。

结论: CoM-PT在45个数据集上广泛验证了其有效性，具有高效扩展性，且不依赖于特定的预训练范式。代码已开源，以促进在更大语言模型等计算密集型场景中的进一步扩展。

翻译: 本文提出了Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT)，一种针对视觉基础模型的无损训练加速方法。该方法与现有加速方法的核心动机不同，它不是优化每个模型，而是设计在模型家族层面加速训练流程，随着模型家族的扩展高效扩展。具体来说，CoM-PT为模型家族建立了按模型大小升序排列的预训练序列，称为模型链。在该链中，仅最小模型接受标准个体预训练，而其他模型通过从其较小的前驱模型进行顺序逆向知识转移来高效训练，同时联合重用参数空间和特征空间中的知识。因此，CoM-PT使所有模型能够实现主要优于标准个体训练的性能，同时显著降低训练成本，并在跨越零样本和微调任务的45个数据集上广泛验证了这一点。值得注意的是，其高效扩展性产生了一个显著现象：训练更多模型甚至导致更高的效率。例如，在CC3M上预训练时：i) 给定ViT-L作为最大模型，逐渐在模型链中添加较小模型可将计算复杂度降低高达72%；ii) 在固定模型大小范围内，随着VFM家族扩展到3、4和7个模型，CoM-PT的加速比表现出显著跃升：从4.13倍跃升至5.68倍和7.09倍。由于CoM-PT天然不依赖于特定的预训练范式，我们开源了代码以促进在更大语言模型等计算密集型场景中的进一步扩展。

Abstract

In this paper, we present Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT), a novel performance-lossless training acceleration method for vision foundation models (VFMs). This approach fundamentally differs from existing acceleration methods in its core motivation: rather than optimizing each model individually, CoM-PT is designed to accelerate the training pipeline at the model family level, scaling efficiently as the model family expands. Specifically, CoM-PT establishes a pre-training sequence for the model family, arranged in ascending order of model size, called model chain. In this chain, only the smallest model undergoes standard individual pre-training, while the other models are efficiently trained through sequential inverse knowledge transfer from their smaller predecessors by jointly reusing the knowledge in the parameter space and the feature space. As a result, CoM-PT enables all models to achieve performance that is mostly superior to standard individual training while significantly reducing training cost, and this is extensively validated across 45 datasets spanning zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks. Notably, its efficient scaling property yields a remarkable phenomenon: training more models even results in higher efficiency. For instance, when pre-training on CC3M: i) given ViT-L as the largest model, progressively prepending smaller models to the model chain reduces computational complexity by up to 72%; ii) within a fixed model size range, as the VFM family scales across 3, 4, and 7 models, the acceleration ratio of CoM-PT exhibits a striking leap: from 4.13X to 5.68X and 7.09X. Since CoM-PT is naturally agnostic to specific pre-training paradigms, we open-source the code to spur further extensions in more computationally intensive scenarios, such as large language model pre-training.

item.title: DiffusionPrint: Learning Generative Fingerprints for Diffusion-Based Inpainting Localization
item.author: Paschalis Giakoumoglou, Symeon Papadopoulos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DiffusionPrint是一个基于补丁级对比学习的框架，用于在基于扩散的图像修复模型中定位伪造，通过利用生成指纹作为自监督信号来学习鲁棒的取证信号。

背景: 现代基于扩散的图像修复模型在图像伪造定位（IFL）方面面临重大挑战，因为它们通过潜在解码器重建整个图像，破坏了现有取证方法所依赖的相机级噪声模式。

目的: 提出DiffusionPrint框架，以学习对潜在解码引入的光谱失真具有鲁棒性的取证信号，并利用生成指纹作为自监督信号。

方法: DiffusionPrint采用补丁级对比学习框架，利用MoCo风格的跨类别硬负样本挖掘和生成器感知分类头训练卷积骨干网络，生成作为融合式IFL框架中高度判别性次要模态的取证特征图。

主要发现: 将DiffusionPrint集成到TruFor、MMFusion和轻量级融合基线中，在多个生成模型上一致提高了定位性能，在微调期间未见过的掩码类型上增益高达+28%，并证实了对未见生成架构的泛化能力。

结论: DiffusionPrint能够有效提升基于扩散的图像修复模型的伪造定位性能，并具有良好的泛化能力。

翻译: Modern diffusion-based inpainting models pose significant challenges for image forgery localization (IFL), as their full regeneration pipelines reconstruct the entire image via a latent decoder, disrupting the camera-level noise patterns that existing forensic methods rely on. We propose DiffusionPrint, a patch-level contrastive learning framework that learns a forensic signal robust to the spectral distortions introduced by latent decoding. It exploits the fact that inpainted regions generated by the same model share a consistent generative fingerprint, using this as a self-supervisory signal. DiffusionPrint trains a convolutional backbone via a MoCo-style objective with cross-category hard negative mining and a generator-aware classification head, producing a forensic feature map that serves as a highly discriminative secondary modality in fusion-based IFL frameworks. Integrated into TruFor, MMFusion, and a lightweight fusion baseline, DiffusionPrint consistently improves localization across multiple generative models, with gains of up to +28% on mask types unseen during fine-tuning and confirmed generalization to unseen generative architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/mever-team/diffusionprint

Abstract

Modern diffusion-based inpainting models pose significant challenges for image forgery localization (IFL), as their full regeneration pipelines reconstruct the entire image via a latent decoder, disrupting the camera-level noise patterns that existing forensic methods rely on. We propose DiffusionPrint, a patch-level contrastive learning framework that learns a forensic signal robust to the spectral distortions introduced by latent decoding. It exploits the fact that inpainted regions generated by the same model share a consistent generative fingerprint, using this as a self-supervisory signal. DiffusionPrint trains a convolutional backbone via a MoCo-style objective with cross-category hard negative mining and a generator-aware classification head, producing a forensic feature map that serves as a highly discriminative secondary modality in fusion-based IFL frameworks. Integrated into TruFor, MMFusion, and a lightweight fusion baseline, DiffusionPrint consistently improves localization across multiple generative models, with gains of up to +28% on mask types unseen during fine-tuning and confirmed generalization to unseen generative architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/mever-team/diffusionprint

item.title: Enhancing Clustering: An Explainable Approach via Filtered Patterns
item.author: Motaz Ben Hassine, Saïd Jabbour
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种模式减少框架，通过保留每个不同k覆盖的唯一代表模式来消除冗余，从而显著减少模式搜索空间并提高计算效率，同时保持或增强聚类质量。

背景: 可解释聚类是一种知识驱动的无监督学习范式，将数据划分为若干互斥的簇，每个簇由显式的符号表示描述。近期引入的k-relaxed频繁模式模型通过广义k覆盖定义放松了严格的覆盖约束，但该方法存在多个不同的k-RFPs可能诱导相同的k覆盖，导致冗余符号表示的问题。

目的: 解决k-RFPs诱导相同k覆盖导致的冗余问题，通过模式减少框架消除冗余，优化模式搜索空间和计算复杂度。

方法: 1. 形式化描述不同k-RFPs诱导相同k覆盖的条件，为冗余检测提供理论基础；2. 提出优化策略，通过保留每个不同k覆盖的唯一代表模式来移除冗余模式；3. 通过分析所选模式对其诱导簇的鲁棒性，调查ILP模型所选模式的可解释性和代表性。

主要发现: 在多个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法显著减少了模式搜索空间，提高了计算效率，并保持或增强了结果聚类的质量。

结论: 提出的模式减少框架有效解决了冗余问题，在保持聚类质量的同时提高了计算效率。

翻译: 机器学习已成为一个核心研究领域，越来越多的注意力集中在可解释聚类上，也称为概念聚类，这是一种知识驱动的无监督学习范式，将数据划分为θ个互斥的簇，其中每个簇由显式的符号表示描述，通常表示为封闭模式或项集。通过提供人类可解释的簇描述，可解释聚类在可解释人工智能和知识发现中发挥着重要作用。近期工作通过引入k-relaxed频繁模式改善了聚类质量，这是一种通过广义k覆盖定义放松严格覆盖约束的模式模型。该框架集成了基于约束的推理，使用SAT求解器进行模式生成，与组合优化，使用整数线性规划进行簇选择。尽管有效，但该方法存在一个关键限制：多个不同的k-RFPs可能诱导相同的k覆盖，导致冗余的符号表示，不必要地扩大搜索空间并在簇构建期间增加计算复杂性。在本文中，我们通过模式减少框架解决了这种冗余问题。我们的贡献有三点。首先，我们形式化描述了不同k-RFPs诱导相同k覆盖的条件，为冗余检测提供了理论基础。其次，我们提出了一种优化策略，通过保留每个不同k覆盖的唯一代表模式来移除冗余模式。第三，我们通过分析所选模式对其诱导簇的鲁棒性，调查了ILP模型所选模式的可解释性和代表性。在几个真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，提出的方法显著减少了模式搜索空间，提高了计算效率，在某些情况下保持并增强了结果聚类的质量。

Abstract

Machine learning has become a central research area, with increasing attention devoted to explainable clustering, also known as conceptual clustering, which is a knowledge-driven unsupervised learning paradigm that partitions data into $θ$ disjoint clusters, where each cluster is described by an explicit symbolic representation, typically expressed as a closed pattern or itemset. By providing human-interpretable cluster descriptions, explainable clustering plays an important role in explainable artificial intelligence and knowledge discovery. Recent work improved clustering quality by introducing k-relaxed frequent patterns (k-RFPs), a pattern model that relaxes strict coverage constraints through a generalized kcover definition. This framework integrates constraint-based reasoning, using SAT solvers for pattern generation, with combinatorial optimization, using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) for cluster selection. Despite its effectiveness, this approach suffers from a critical limitation: multiple distinct k-RFPs may induce identical k-covers, leading to redundant symbolic representations that unnecessarily enlarge the search space and increase computational complexity during cluster construction. In this paper, we address this redundancy through a pattern reduction framework. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formally characterize the conditions under which distinct k-RFPs induce identical kcovers, providing theoretical foundations for redundancy detection. Second, we propose an optimization strategy that removes redundant patterns by retaining a single representative pattern for each distinct k-cover. Third, we investigate the interpretability and representativeness of the patterns selected by the ILP model by analyzing their robustness with respect to their induced clusters. Extensive experiments conducted on several real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly reduces the pattern search space, improves computational efficiency, preserves and enhances in some cases the quality of the resulting clusters.

item.title: SEATrack: Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive Multimodal Tracker
item.author: Junbin Su, Ziteng Xue, Shihui Zhang, Kun Chen, Weiming Hu, Zhipeng Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SEATrack是一种简单、高效且自适应的双流多模态跟踪器，旨在解决性能与效率之间的权衡问题。

背景: 多模态跟踪中的参数高效微调（PEFT）显示出一种令人担忧的趋势，即最近的性能提升往往是以膨胀的参数预算为代价的，这从根本上侵蚀了PEFT的效率承诺。

目的: 引入SEATrack以从两个互补的角度解决性能-效率困境。

方法: 1. 优先考虑匹配响应的跨模态对齐，提出AMG-LoRA，将低秩适应（LoRA）与自适应互导（AMG）无缝集成，以动态细化和对齐跨模态的注意力图。2. 引入分层专家混合（HMoE）以实现高效的全局关系建模，平衡跨模态融合中的表达能力和计算效率。

主要发现: 现有双流方法中的模态特定偏差会产生冲突的匹配注意力图，从而阻碍有效的联合表示学习。

结论: SEATrack在RGB-T、RGB-D和RGB-E跟踪任务中，在平衡性能与效率方面取得了显著进展。

翻译: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) in multimodal tracking reveals a concerning trend where recent performance gains are often achieved at the cost of inflated parameter budgets, which fundamentally erodes PEFT's efficiency promise. In this work, we introduce SEATrack, a Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive two-stream multimodal tracker that tackles this performance-efficiency dilemma from two complementary perspectives. We first prioritize cross-modal alignment of matching responses, an underexplored yet pivotal factor that we argue is essential for breaking the trade-off. Specifically, we observe that modality-specific biases in existing two-stream methods generate conflicting matching attention maps, thereby hindering effective joint representation learning. To mitigate this, we propose AMG-LoRA, which seamlessly integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for domain adaptation with Adaptive Mutual Guidance (AMG) to dynamically refine and align attention maps across modalities. We then depart from conventional local fusion approaches by introducing a Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HMoE) that enables efficient global relation modeling, effectively balancing expressiveness and computational efficiency in cross-modal fusion. Equipped with these innovations, SEATrack advances notable progress over state-of-the-art methods in balancing performance with efficiency across RGB-T, RGB-D, and RGB-E tracking tasks.

Abstract

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) in multimodal tracking reveals a concerning trend where recent performance gains are often achieved at the cost of inflated parameter budgets, which fundamentally erodes PEFT's efficiency promise. In this work, we introduce SEATrack, a Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive two-stream multimodal tracker that tackles this performance-efficiency dilemma from two complementary perspectives. We first prioritize cross-modal alignment of matching responses, an underexplored yet pivotal factor that we argue is essential for breaking the trade-off. Specifically, we observe that modality-specific biases in existing two-stream methods generate conflicting matching attention maps, thereby hindering effective joint representation learning. To mitigate this, we propose AMG-LoRA, which seamlessly integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for domain adaptation with Adaptive Mutual Guidance (AMG) to dynamically refine and align attention maps across modalities. We then depart from conventional local fusion approaches by introducing a Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HMoE) that enables efficient global relation modeling, effectively balancing expressiveness and computational efficiency in cross-modal fusion. Equipped with these innovations, SEATrack advances notable progress over state-of-the-art methods in balancing performance with efficiency across RGB-T, RGB-D, and RGB-E tracking tasks. \href{https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/SEATrack}{\textcolor{cyan}{Code is available}}.

item.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for PET-Free Amyloid-Beta Detection from MRI
item.author: Francesco Chiumento, Julia Dietlmeier, Ronan P. Killeen, Kathleen M. Curran, Noel E. O'Connor, Mingming Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于PET引导的知识蒸馏框架，仅利用MRI数据预测淀粉样蛋白阳性，无需PET或临床协变量。

背景: 检测淀粉样蛋白阳性对阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断至关重要，但PET成像成本高、有创且难以普及，限制了其在人群筛查中的应用。

目的: 解决PET成像的局限性，提出一种仅利用MRI数据预测淀粉样蛋白阳性，且在推理过程中无需PET或非成像临床协变量的方法。

方法: 采用基于BiomedCLIP的教师模型，通过跨模态注意力和三元组对比学习学习PET-MRI对齐，并使用PET信息感知的在线负采样；MRI-only学生模型通过特征级和logit级蒸馏模仿教师模型。

主要发现: 该方法在四种MRI对比度（T1w, T2w, FLAIR, T2*）和两个独立数据集上进行了评估，展示了有效的知识转移（最佳AUC：OASIS-3为0.74，ADNI为0.68），且预测具有可解释性，无需临床变量。

结论: 该方法支持了无PET淀粉样蛋白筛查的临床可行性，预测结果集中在解剖学相关的皮层区域。

翻译: Detecting amyloid-$\beta$ (A$\beta$) positivity is crucial for early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease but typically requires PET imaging, which is costly, invasive, and not widely accessible, limiting its use for population-level screening. We address this gap by proposing a PET-guided knowledge distillation framework that enables A$\beta$ prediction from MRI alone, without requiring non-imaging clinical covariates or PET at inference. Our approach employs a BiomedCLIP-based teacher model that learns PET-MRI alignment via cross-modal attention and triplet contrastive learning with PET-informed (Centiloid-aware) online negative sampling. An MRI-only student then mimics the teacher via feature-level and logit-level distillation. Evaluated across four MRI contrasts (T1w, T2w, FLAIR, T2*) and two independent datasets, our approach demonstrates effective knowledge transfer (best AUC: 0.74 on OASIS-3, 0.68 on ADNI) while maintaining interpretability and eliminating the need for clinical variables. Saliency analysis confirms that predictions focus on anatomically relevant cortical regions, supporting the clinical viability of PET-free A$\beta$ screening. Code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoChiumento/pet-guided-mri-amyloid-detection.

Abstract

Detecting amyloid-$β$ (A$β$) positivity is crucial for early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease but typically requires PET imaging, which is costly, invasive, and not widely accessible, limiting its use for population-level screening. We address this gap by proposing a PET-guided knowledge distillation framework that enables A$β$ prediction from MRI alone, without requiring non-imaging clinical covariates or PET at inference. Our approach employs a BiomedCLIP-based teacher model that learns PET-MRI alignment via cross-modal attention and triplet contrastive learning with PET-informed (Centiloid-aware) online negative sampling. An MRI-only student then mimics the teacher via feature-level and logit-level distillation. Evaluated across four MRI contrasts (T1w, T2w, FLAIR, T2*) and two independent datasets, our approach demonstrates effective knowledge transfer (best AUC: 0.74 on OASIS-3, 0.68 on ADNI) while maintaining interpretability and eliminating the need for clinical variables. Saliency analysis confirms that predictions focus on anatomically relevant cortical regions, supporting the clinical viability of PET-free A$β$ screening. Code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoChiumento/pet-guided-mri-amyloid-detection.

item.title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts
item.author: Runhe Zhou, Shanglin Li, Guanxiang Huang, Xinliang Zhou, Qibin Zhao, Motoaki Kawanabe, Yi Ding, Cuntai Guan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于双曲空间的混合专家框架，用于多模态脑电信号分析，在情感识别、睡眠分期和认知评估等任务中取得了最先进的性能。

背景: 基于脑电的多模态学习通过整合脑信号与互补模态来改善精神状态评估，但欧几里得嵌入难以表示脑电信号及相关模态（如面部表情）的层级结构。

目的: 为了解决欧几里得嵌入难以表示层级结构的问题，提出一种新的双曲混合专家框架，以自适应建模模态的内在几何结构。

方法: 提出EEG-MoCE框架，将每个模态分配给可学习曲率双曲空间中的专家，并采用曲率感知融合策略动态加权专家，强调具有丰富层级信息的模态。

主要发现: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，EEG-MoCE在情感识别、睡眠分期和认知评估中取得了最先进的性能。

结论: EEG-MoCE框架能够有效利用模态的层级结构，显著提升多模态神经技术的表现。

翻译: 基于脑电的多模态学习将脑信号与互补模态相结合，以改善精神状态评估，具有巨大的临床潜力。此类范式的有效性在很大程度上取决于异构模态上的表示学习。对于基于脑电的范式，一个有前景的方法是利用它们的层级结构，因为最近的研究表明，脑电和相关模态（如面部表情）都表现出反映复杂认知过程的层级结构。然而，由于欧几里得嵌入具有平坦几何结构，难以表示这些层级结构，而双曲空间由于其指数增长特性，天然适合表示它们。在这项工作中，我们提出了EEG-MoCE，一种用于多模态神经技术的新型双曲混合专家框架。EEG-MoCE将每个模态分配给可学习曲率双曲空间中的一个专家，从而能够自适应地建模其内在几何结构。随后，一种曲率感知融合策略动态地加权专家，强调具有丰富层级信息的模态。在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，EEG-MoCE取得了最先进的性能，包括情感识别、睡眠分期和认知评估。

Abstract

Electroencephalography (EEG)-based multimodal learning integrates brain signals with complementary modalities to improve mental state assessment, providing great clinical potential. The effectiveness of such paradigms largely depends on the representation learning on heterogeneous modalities. For EEG-based paradigms, one promising approach is to leverage their hierarchical structures, as recent studies have shown that both EEG and associated modalities (e.g., facial expressions) exhibit hierarchical structures reflecting complex cognitive processes. However, Euclidean embeddings struggle to represent these hierarchical structures due to their flat geometry, while hyperbolic spaces, with their exponential growth property, are naturally suited for them. In this work, we propose EEG-MoCE, a novel hyperbolic mixture-of-curvature experts framework designed for multimodal neurotechnology. EEG-MoCE assigns each modality to an expert in a learnable-curvature hyperbolic space, enabling adaptive modeling of its intrinsic geometry. A curvature-aware fusion strategy then dynamically weights experts, emphasizing modalities with richer hierarchical information. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that EEG-MoCE achieves state-of-the-art performance, including emotion recognition, sleep staging, and cognitive assessment.

item.title: Relaxing Anchor-Frame Dominance for Mitigating Hallucinations in Video Large Language Models
item.author: Zijian Liu, Sihan Cao, Pengcheng Zheng, Kuien Liu, Caiyan Qin, Xiaolin Qin, Jiwei Wei, Chaoning Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对视频大语言模型在生成过程中存在的时间不平衡注意力偏差问题，提出了一种无需训练的解码器侧时间重平衡方法，以减少幻觉并提升视频理解能力。

背景: 现有的缓解方法主要依赖训练、输入修改、辅助指导或额外解码过程，但忽略了生成过程中模型过度依赖有限时间证据导致的时间不平衡证据聚合这一根本挑战。

目的: 研究解码器侧现象中模型表现出时间不平衡的集中模式，并解决由此产生的幻觉问题。

方法: 提出解码器侧时间重平衡方法，这是一种无需训练、层选择推理方法，在解码器中间到后期层中重新平衡时间证据分配，自适应校准解码器侧视觉注意力，鼓励被忽视的帧更有效地参与响应生成。

主要发现: 模型倾向于过度依赖有限的时间证据，导致时间不平衡的集中模式；这种偏差在很大程度上独立于输入视频，反映了模型特定的结构性或位置偏差；这种偏差的过度主导与易产生幻觉的生成密切相关。

结论: DTR方法在幻觉和视频理解基准测试中表现出色，一致地提高了不同视频大语言模型家族的幻觉鲁棒性，同时保持了竞争力的视频理解性能和高推理效率。

翻译: Recent Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated strong capability in video understanding, yet they still suffer from hallucinations. Existing mitigation methods typically rely on training, input modification, auxiliary guidance, or additional decoding procedures, while largely overlooking a more fundamental challenge. During generation, Video-LLMs tend to over-rely on a limited portion of temporal evidence, leading to temporally imbalanced evidence aggregation across the video. To address this issue, we investigate a decoder-side phenomenon in which the model exhibits a temporally imbalanced concentration pattern. We term the frame with the highest aggregated frame-level attention mass the anchor frame. We find that this bias is largely independent of the input video and instead appears to reflect a persistent, model-specific structural or positional bias, whose over-dominance is closely associated with hallucination-prone generation. Motivated by this insight, we propose Decoder-side Temporal Rebalancing (DTR), a training-free, layer-selective inference method that rebalances temporal evidence allocation in middle-to-late decoder layers without altering visual encoding or requiring auxiliary models. DTR adaptively calibrates decoder-side visual attention to alleviate temporally imbalanced concentration and encourage under-attended frames to contribute more effectively to response generation. In this way, DTR guides the decoder to ground its outputs in temporally broader and more balanced video evidence. Extensive experiments on hallucination and video understanding benchmarks show that DTR consistently improves hallucination robustness across diverse Video-LLM families, while preserving competitive video understanding performance and high inference efficiency.

Abstract

Recent Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated strong capability in video understanding, yet they still suffer from hallucinations. Existing mitigation methods typically rely on training, input modification, auxiliary guidance, or additional decoding procedures, while largely overlooking a more fundamental challenge. During generation, Video-LLMs tend to over-rely on a limited portion of temporal evidence, leading to temporally imbalanced evidence aggregation across the video. To address this issue, we investigate a decoder-side phenomenon in which the model exhibits a temporally imbalanced concentration pattern. We term the frame with the highest aggregated frame-level attention mass the anchor frame. We find that this bias is largely independent of the input video and instead appears to reflect a persistent, model-specific structural or positional bias, whose over-dominance is closely associated with hallucination-prone generation. Motivated by this insight, we propose Decoder-side Temporal Rebalancing (DTR), a training-free, layer-selective inference method that rebalances temporal evidence allocation in middle-to-late decoder layers without altering visual encoding or requiring auxiliary models. DTR adaptively calibrates decoder-side visual attention to alleviate temporally imbalanced concentration and encourage under-attended frames to contribute more effectively to response generation. In this way, DTR guides the decoder to ground its outputs in temporally broader and more balanced video evidence. Extensive experiments on hallucination and video understanding benchmarks show that DTR consistently improves hallucination robustness across diverse Video-LLM families, while preserving competitive video understanding performance and high inference efficiency.

item.title: ELoG-GS: Dual-Branch Gaussian Splatting with Luminance-Guided Enhancement for Extreme Low-light 3D Reconstruction
item.author: Yuhao Liu, Dingju Wang, Ziyang Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了针对NTIRE 2026 3D恢复与重建挑战赛（赛道1）的方法，旨在从退化多视图输入中重建高质量3D表示。

背景: 该挑战赛聚焦于在极端低光环境下恢复几何一致且照片级真实的3D场景。

目的: 提出一种鲁棒的低光3D重建流程，以解决在极端低光条件下重建高质量3D场景的任务。

方法: 提出了极端低光优化的高斯泼溅（ELoG-GS）方法，该方法集成了基于学习的点云初始化和亮度引导的颜色增强，并包含了几何感知初始化和光度适应策略。

主要发现: 在NTIRE赛道1基准测试中，该方法显著提高了重建质量，在官方排行榜上达到了18.6626的PSNR和0.6855的SSIM。

结论: 该方法为现实世界退化场景中的鲁棒3D重建提供了实用解决方案。

翻译: 本文介绍了针对NTIRE 2026 3D恢复与重建挑战赛（赛道1）的方法，旨在从退化多视图输入中重建高质量3D表示。该挑战赛聚焦于在极端低光环境下恢复几何一致且照片级真实的3D场景。本文提出了一种鲁棒的低光3D重建流程，即极端低光优化的高斯泼溅（ELoG-GS），该方法集成了基于学习的点云初始化和亮度引导的颜色增强，以实现稳定且照片级真实的高斯泼溅效果。该方法结合了几何感知初始化和光度适应策略，以提高在挑战性条件下的重建保真度。在NTIRE赛道1基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法显著优于基线方法，实现了卓越的视觉保真度和几何一致性。该方法为现实世界退化场景中的鲁棒3D重建提供了实用解决方案。在最终测试阶段，该方法在官方排行榜上达到了18.6626的PSNR和0.6855的SSIM。代码可在 https://github.com/lyh120/FSGS_EAPGS 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决在极低光照和极稀疏视图条件下，传统重建方法因传感器噪声、特征匹配失败导致几何崩溃和颜色漂移的问题。这个问题在现实中非常重要，因为光照条件往往很差且照片数量有限，该研究为在真实场景中实现高质量、逼真的3D重建提供了一种实用的解决方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统方法在极低光照和稀疏视角下失效的问题，设计了“先修复后重建”的解耦框架。在预处理阶段，利用Retinexformer恢复图像，并使用VGGT进行深度估计和体素化融合以获得可靠的点云。在重建阶段，设计了结合FSGS和EAP-GS的混合双分支架构。该方法借鉴了现有的低光图像增强技术（如Retinexformer）和3DGS技术（如EAP-GS和FSGS），以及VGGT等学习型几何初始化方法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是针对极低光照和稀疏视角，采用“先修复再重建”的解耦框架，通过学习初始化和亮度引导增强来恢复几何一致性和照片级真实感。整体流程分为三步：预处理阶段利用Retinexformer和VGGT恢复图像细节并生成点云；重建阶段采用混合双分支架构并行训练并选择最优分支；后处理阶段通过亮度调整、对比度增强和直方图匹配消除伪影。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种“先修复后重建”的解耦框架，利用VGGT深度估计和体素融合生成可靠的点云初始化，并采用混合双分支架构结合FSGS和EAP-GS来平衡几何与纹理细节。相比之前的工作，它不再依赖传统的SfM方法，而是通过Retinexformer进行零样本低光修复，并引入亮度引导的后处理来消除颜色伪影，从而在极端低光和稀疏视图下实现更高质量的重建。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了ELoG-GS方法，用于在极端低光照和稀疏视图条件下进行3D重建。该方法通过结合基于学习的点云初始化、双分支重建架构以及亮度引导的后处理，解决了传统方法在极低光照下失效的问题，实现了高质量的3D重建。

Abstract

This paper presents our approach to the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Challenge (Track 1), which focuses on reconstructing high-quality 3D representations from degraded multi-view inputs. The challenge involves recovering geometrically consistent and photorealistic 3D scenes in extreme low-light environments. To address this task, we propose Extreme Low-light Optimized Gaussian Splatting (ELoG-GS), a robust low-light 3D reconstruction pipeline that integrates learning-based point cloud initialization and luminance-guided color enhancement for stable and photorealistic Gaussian Splatting. Our method incorporates both geometry-aware initialization and photometric adaptation strategies to improve reconstruction fidelity under challenging conditions. Extensive experiments on the NTIRE Track 1 benchmark demonstrate that our approach significantly improves reconstruction quality over the baselines, achieving superior visual fidelity and geometric consistency. The proposed method provides a practical solution for robust 3D reconstruction in real-world degraded scenarios.
