Abstract

Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, especially for fine-grained manipulation tasks such as robotic assembly. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit preliminary spatial awareness, they largely rely on coarse 2D perception and lack the ability to perform accurate reasoning over 3D geometry, which is crucial for precise assembly operations. To address this limitation, we propose AssemLM, a spatial multimodal large language model tailored for robotic assembly. AssemLM integrates assembly manuals, point clouds, and textual instructions to reason about and predict task-critical 6D assembly poses, enabling explicit geometric understanding throughout the assembly process. To effectively bridge raw 3D perception and high-level reasoning, we adopt a specialized point cloud encoder to capture fine-grained geometric and rotational features, which are then integrated into the multimodal language model to support accurate 3D spatial reasoning for assembly tasks. In addition, we construct AssemBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for assembly-oriented spatial reasoning, comprising over 900K multimodal samples with precise 6D pose annotations. AssemBench extends spatial reasoning evaluation beyond 2D and grounding tasks into full 3D geometric inference, filling a critical gap in existing embodied AI benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AssemLM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 6D pose reasoning across diverse assembly scenarios. Furthermore, real-robot evaluations show that our model can support fine-grained and multi-step assembly execution in real-world settings, demonstrating its potential for robotic assembly applications.

item.title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos
item.author: Zhiyu Zhou, Peilin Liu, Ruoxuan Zhang, Luyang Zhang, Cheng Zhang, Hongxia Xie, Wen-Huang Cheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PinpointQA是首个针对室内视频中微小物体中心空间理解的基准数据集，包含1024个场景和10094对问答对，旨在评估模型在目标定位和空间描述方面的能力。

背景: 尽管多模态大语言模型在视频空间智能、具身推理和诊断感知方面已有进展，但现有基准未能直接评估模型在室内视频中定位目标物体并表达其位置精度的能力。

目的: 引入PinpointQA数据集和基准，评估模型在室内视频中微小物体中心空间理解的能力，特别是目标存在验证、最近参考识别、细粒度空间描述和结构化空间预测。

方法: 数据集基于ScanNet++和ScanNet200构建，包含1024个场景和10094对QA对，分为四个递进难度的任务：目标存在验证、最近参考识别、细粒度空间描述和结构化空间预测。QA对通过中间空间表示自动生成，并经过质量控制。

主要发现: 在代表性MLLMs上的实验显示，模型在递进任务链上存在一致的能力差距，结构化空间预测任务尤为困难。在PinpointQA上的监督微调显著提升了性能，尤其是在较难的任务上。

结论: PinpointQA作为一个诊断基准和有效的训练数据集，证明了其在提升模型微小物体中心空间理解能力方面的价值。

翻译: Small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos remains a significant challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), despite its practical value for object search and assistive applications. Although existing benchmarks have advanced video spatial intelligence, embodied reasoning, and diagnostic perception, no existing benchmark directly evaluates whether a model can localize a target object in video and express its position with sufficient precision for downstream use. In this work, we introduce PinpointQA, the first dataset and benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos. Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, PinpointQA comprises 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs organized into four progressively challenging tasks: Target Presence Verification (TPV), Nearest Reference Identification (NRI), Fine-Grained Spatial Description (FSD), and Structured Spatial Prediction (SSP). The dataset is built from intermediate spatial representations, with QA pairs generated automatically and further refined through quality control. Experiments on representative MLLMs reveal a consistent capability gap along the progressive chain, with SSP remaining particularly difficult. Supervised fine-tuning on PinpointQA yields substantial gains, especially on the harder tasks, demonstrating that PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training dataset. The dataset and project page are available at https://rainchowz.github.io/PinpointQA.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决多模态大语言模型在室内视频中理解小物体位置及其空间关系的问题。在现实生活中，用户常需通过视频寻找钥匙、耳机等小物体，这需要模型不仅能发现物体，还能精确描述其位置供后续使用。从研究角度看，这符合人类视觉搜索机制，且填补了现有基准测试未系统评估小物体定位及表达精度这一空白。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过分析现有基准的不足，发现它们缺乏对小物体定位和精确表达能力的直接评估，因此设计了PinpointQA。他们借鉴了人类视觉搜索机制，即注意力集中在目标相关区域并利用局部线索缩小搜索空间，将其转化为从目标感知到结构化输出的渐进能力链。此外，他们参考了现有的空间理解和小物体感知基准，如VSI-Bench、V-STaR、EgoObjects等，以明确这些工作的局限性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是填补现有基准测试的空白，专门评估多模态大模型在室内视频中定位小物体并以足够精度表达其位置的能力。它将问题建模为一个从目标感知到结构化空间预测的渐进能力链。实现流程基于 ScanNet++ 和 ScanNet200 数据集，通过筛选小物体、构建局部空间表示，进而生成包含存在验证、参考识别、自然语言描述和结构化预测四个任务的问答对，最后通过自动过滤和人工审查确保数据质量。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了首个专门针对室内视频中小物体中心空间理解的数据集和基准测试。它定义了四个渐进任务，从目标存在验证到结构化空间预测，形成能力链。相比之前的工作，它填补了现有基准无法直接评估小物体定位精度和表达能力的空白，提供了从感知到结构化输出的统一评估标准。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了首个专注于室内视频中微小物体空间理解的专用数据集和基准，定义了从目标识别到结构化预测的四个任务，并验证了其作为诊断和训练资源的有效性。

Abstract

Small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos remains a significant challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), despite its practical value for object search and assistive applications. Although existing benchmarks have advanced video spatial intelligence, embodied reasoning, and diagnostic perception, no existing benchmark directly evaluates whether a model can localize a target object in video and express its position with sufficient precision for downstream use. In this work, we introduce PinpointQA, the first dataset and benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos. Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, PinpointQA comprises 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs organized into four progressively challenging tasks: Target Presence Verification (TPV), Nearest Reference Identification (NRI), Fine-Grained Spatial Description (FSD), and Structured Spatial Prediction (SSP). The dataset is built from intermediate spatial representations, with QA pairs generated automatically and further refined through quality control. Experiments on representative MLLMs reveal a consistent capability gap along the progressive chain, with SSP remaining particularly difficult. Supervised fine-tuning on PinpointQA yields substantial gains, especially on the harder tasks, demonstrating that PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training dataset. The dataset and project page are available at https://rainchowz.github.io/PinpointQA.

item.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
item.author: Zile Wang, Zexiang Liu, Jaixing Li, Kaichen Huang, Baixin Xu, Fei Kang, Mengyin An, Peiyu Wang, Biao Jiang, Yichen Wei, Yidan Xietian, Jiangbo Pei, Liang Hu, Boyi Jiang, Hua Xue, Zidong Wang, Haofeng Sun, Wei Li, Wanli Ouyang, Xianglong He, Yang Liu, Yangguang Li, Yahui Zhou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Matrix-Game 3.0是一个用于720p实时长视频生成的增强型交互式世界模型，通过改进数据、模型和推理策略，实现了长时序一致性。

背景: 现有方法难以同时实现内存支持的长时序一致性和高分辨率实时生成。

目的: 设计一个内存增强的交互式世界模型，以实现720p实时长视频生成。

方法: 1. 升级工业级无限数据引擎，生成高质量四元组数据；2. 提出长时序一致性训练框架，包括建模预测残差和重注入不完美生成帧；3. 设计基于分布匹配蒸馏的多段自回归蒸馏策略，结合模型量化和VAE解码器剪枝。

主要发现: Matrix-Game 3.0在5B模型下实现高达40 FPS的720p实时生成，并保持分钟级序列的稳定内存一致性；2x14B模型进一步提升了生成质量、动态效果和泛化能力。

结论: 该方法为工业级可部署的世界模型提供了实用路径。

翻译: 随着交互式视频生成的进步，扩散模型作为世界模型的潜力日益显现。然而，现有方法仍难以同时实现内存支持的长时序一致性和高分辨率实时生成，限制了其在现实场景中的应用。为此，我们提出了Matrix-Game 3.0，这是一个为720p实时长视频生成设计的内存增强交互式世界模型。在Matrix-Game 2.0的基础上，我们在数据、模型和推理方面进行了系统性改进。首先，我们开发了一个升级的工业级无限数据引擎，该引擎集成了基于虚幻引擎的合成数据、从AAA游戏中大规模自动化收集的数据以及现实世界视频增强，以大规模生产高质量的视频姿态动作提示四元组数据。其次，我们提出了一个长时序一致性训练框架：通过建模预测残差并在训练期间重注入不完美的生成帧，基础模型学会了自我纠正；同时，相机感知的内存检索和注入使基础模型能够实现长时序时空一致性。第三，我们设计了一种基于分布匹配蒸馏的多段自回归蒸馏策略，结合模型量化和VAE解码器剪枝，以实现高效的实时推理。实验结果表明，Matrix-Game 3.0在5B模型下实现了高达40 FPS的720p实时生成，并在分钟级序列中保持了稳定的内存一致性。扩展到2x14B模型进一步提高了生成质量、动态效果和泛化能力。我们的方法为工业级可部署的世界模型提供了实用路径。

Abstract

With the advancement of interactive video generation, diffusion models have increasingly demonstrated their potential as world models. However, existing approaches still struggle to simultaneously achieve memory-enabled long-term temporal consistency and high-resolution real-time generation, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. To address this, we present Matrix-Game 3.0, a memory-augmented interactive world model designed for 720p real-time longform video generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 2.0, we introduce systematic improvements across data, model, and inference. First, we develop an upgraded industrial-scale infinite data engine that integrates Unreal Engine-based synthetic data, large-scale automated collection from AAA games, and real-world video augmentation to produce high-quality Video-Pose-Action-Prompt quadruplet data at scale. Second, we propose a training framework for long-horizon consistency: by modeling prediction residuals and re-injecting imperfect generated frames during training, the base model learns self-correction; meanwhile, camera-aware memory retrieval and injection enable the base model to achieve long horizon spatiotemporal consistency. Third, we design a multi-segment autoregressive distillation strategy based on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), combined with model quantization and VAE decoder pruning, to achieve efficient real-time inference. Experimental results show that Matrix-Game 3.0 achieves up to 40 FPS real-time generation at 720p resolution with a 5B model, while maintaining stable memory consistency over minute-long sequences. Scaling up to a 2x14B model further improves generation quality, dynamics, and generalization. Our approach provides a practical pathway toward industrial-scale deployable world models.

item.title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
item.author: Junxi Wang, Te Sun, Jiayi Zhu, Junxian Li, Haowen Xu, Zichen Wen, Xuming Hu, Zhiyu Li, Linfeng Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: StreamMeCo是一个高效的流媒体智能体内存压缩框架，通过图连接性分析优化内存节点，引入时间衰减检索机制，在压缩70%内存图的情况下实现1.87倍检索加速和平均1.0%准确率提升。

背景: 视觉智能体在流媒体视频理解中表现出色，但存储视频记忆会产生大量内存开销，导致存储和计算成本高昂。

目的: 提出StreamMeCo框架以解决视频记忆存储的高内存开销问题，在减少冗余内存节点的同时保持准确性。

方法: 基于记忆图的连接性，对孤立节点引入无边界的minmax采样，对连接节点引入边缘感知的权重剪枝；同时引入时间衰减记忆检索机制以消除压缩导致的性能下降。

主要发现: 在三个挑战性基准数据集（M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web和Video-MME-Long）上，在70%内存图压缩下，StreamMeCo实现了1.87倍的记忆检索加速，并带来了平均1.0%的准确率提升。

结论: StreamMeCo框架有效解决了视频记忆存储的高成本问题，通过压缩和优化机制显著提升了检索速度和模型性能。

翻译: Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in streaming video understanding. However, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial memory overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for the isolated nodes and an edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting the redundant memory nodes while maintaining the accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to further eliminate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87* speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.

Abstract

Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in streaming video understanding. However, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial memory overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for the isolated nodes and an edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting the redundant memory nodes while maintaining the accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to further eliminate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87* speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.

item.title: The nextAI Solution to the NeurIPS 2023 LLM Efficiency Challenge
item.author: Gyuwon Park, DongIl Shin, SolGil Oh, SangGi Ryu, Byung-Hak Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文参与NeurIPS LLM效率挑战，在单张A100 40GB GPU上24小时内对LLaMa2 70B模型进行高效微调，采用QLoRA微调及Flash Attention 2等注意力机制，通过优化LoRA配置和迭代测试数据集，实现了在资源受限环境下的大规模模型优化，显著降低资源消耗并保持高准确率。

背景: 大型语言模型快速发展对自然语言处理领域产生重大影响，但其日益增长的复杂性引发了关于资源使用和透明度的担忧。

目的: 参加NeurIPS LLM效率挑战，旨在在严格限制下对基础模型进行微调，以解决资源使用和透明度问题。

方法: 使用LLaMa2 70B模型，在单张A100 40GB GPU上，24小时限制内进行微调。采用QLoRA微调技术，结合Flash Attention 2等先进注意力机制。通过实验优化LoRA技术配置，并创建和迭代测试多个数据集组合。

主要发现: 成功在单GPU约束下高效微调了LLaMa2 70B模型，显著减少了资源利用，并在各种问答基准测试中表现出高准确率。

结论: 证明了在资源受限环境中优化大规模模型的可行性，强调了LLM在现实世界应用中的潜力。

翻译: 大型语言模型的快速演变显著影响了自然语言处理领域，但其日益增长的复杂性引发了关于资源使用和透明度的担忧。为应对这些挑战，我们参加了NeurIPS LLM效率挑战，旨在在严格限制下对基础模型进行微调。我们的重点是LLaMa2 70B模型，在单张A100 40GB GPU上，24小时限制内进行优化。我们的方法依赖于自定义数据集，该数据集由各种开源资源和基准测试精心汇编，符合挑战的开源精神。我们的方法利用了QLoRA微调，结合Flash Attention 2等先进注意力机制。我们实验了LoRA技术的各种配置，优化了计算效率和模型准确性之间的平衡。我们的微调策略建立在创建和迭代测试多个数据集组合的基础上，从而选择了一个在各种任务和基准测试中表现出强大性能的版本。我们工作的成果是一个高效微调的LLaMa2 70B模型，在单GPU约束下运行，不仅展示了资源利用的显著减少，而且在一系列问答基准测试中表现出高准确性。我们的研究证明了在资源受限环境中优化大规模模型的可行性，强调了LLM在现实世界应用中的潜力。

Abstract

The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly impacted the field of natural language processing, but their growing complexity raises concerns about resource usage and transparency. Addressing these challenges, we participated in the NeurIPS LLM Efficiency Challenge, aiming to fine-tune a foundation model within stringent constraints. Our focus was the LLaMa2 70 billion model, optimized on a single A100 40GB GPU within a 24-hour limit. Our methodology hinged on a custom dataset, carefully assembled from diverse open-source resources and benchmark tests, aligned with the challenge's open-source ethos. Our approach leveraged Quantized-Low Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) Fine tuning, integrated with advanced attention mechanisms like Flash Attention 2. We experimented with various configurations of the LoRA technique, optimizing the balance between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Our fine-tuning strategy was underpinned by the creation and iterative testing of multiple dataset compositions, leading to the selection of a version that demonstrated robust performance across diverse tasks and benchmarks. The culmination of our efforts was an efficiently fine-tuned LLaMa2 70B model that operated within the constraints of a single GPU, showcasing not only a significant reduction in resource utilization but also high accuracy across a range of QA benchmarks. Our study serves as a testament to the feasibility of optimizing large-scale models in resource-constrained environments, emphasizing the potential of LLMs in real-world applications.

item.title: V-CAGE: Vision-Closed-Loop Agentic Generation Engine for Robotic Manipulation
item.author: Yaru Liu, Ao-bo Wang, Nanyang Ye
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: V-CAGE是一个用于自主机器人数据合成的代理框架，通过场景生成和视觉闭环验证机制，实现了高保真、可访问的机器人操作数据集的高效合成与压缩。

背景: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型需要大规模数据集，但现有的场景生成方法缺乏上下文感知能力，导致生成的场景语义丰富但物理上不可达，任务失败。

目的: 提出V-CAGE框架，用于自主机器人数据合成，旨在解决场景生成缺乏上下文感知、轨迹不正确以及大规模视频数据集存储瓶颈的问题。

方法: V-CAGE采用代理框架，利用基础模型连接高层语义推理与低层物理交互；引入Inpainting-Guided Scene Construction进行上下文感知布局；集成功能元数据与基于视觉语言模型的闭环验证机制；实现感知驱动压缩算法以减少文件大小。

主要发现: V-CAGE通过上下文感知布局和视觉闭环验证，确保生成的场景语义结构化和运动学可达；感知驱动压缩算法在减少文件大小超过90%的同时，不损害下游VLA训练效果。

结论: V-CAGE通过集中语义布局规划和视觉自验证，自动化了端到端流程，实现了多样化、高质量机器人操作数据集的高效、可扩展合成。

翻译: 摘要：扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要大规模数据集，这些数据集在语义上连贯且在物理上可行。然而，现有的场景生成方法往往缺乏上下文感知能力，使得合成嵌入丰富语义信息的高保真环境变得困难，经常导致不可达的目标位置，从而导致任务过早失败。我们提出了V-CAGE（视觉闭环代理生成引擎），这是一个用于自主机器人数据合成的代理框架。与传统的脚本化管道不同，V-CAGE作为一个具身代理系统运行，利用基础模型连接高层语义推理与低层物理交互。具体而言，我们引入了Inpainting-Guided Scene Construction来系统地排列上下文感知布局，确保生成的场景既语义结构化又运动学可达。为了确保轨迹正确性，我们将功能元数据与基于视觉语言模型的闭环验证机制集成在一起，充当视觉批评家，严格过滤掉静默失败并切断错误传播链。最后，为了克服大规模视频数据集的存储瓶颈，我们实现了一种感知驱动的压缩算法，在不损害下游VLA训练效果的情况下实现了超过90%的文件大小减少。通过集中语义布局规划和视觉自验证，V-CAGE自动化了端到端流程，实现了多样化、高质量机器人操作数据集的高效、可扩展合成。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有场景生成方法缺乏上下文感知，导致生成无法到达的目标位置和几何冲突，且缺乏功能注释，容易产生无声失败的问题。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为VLA模型严重依赖海量高质量数据，而现实世界收集数据昂贵且难以覆盖长尾场景，利用模拟进行自动化数据收集是克服“数据饥渴”瓶颈的有希望途径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为现有方法缺乏智能且容易出错，因此设计了一个名为 V-CAGE 的代理式框架，旨在从脚本化转向具备任务导向场景配置和语义推理能力的具身系统。他们借鉴了 GenSim 和 RoboTwin 等利用 LLM 生成任务的工作，但将其从“生成-执行”的开放循环改为闭环验证；同时参考了 SAGE 的场景合成思路，但更注重任务语义的正确性，并利用 VLM 作为视觉验证器来过滤错误。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个自主的机器人数据合成框架，利用代理架构弥合高层语义推理与底层物理交互的差距，确保生成的数据既语义合理又物理可行。整体实现流程包括：首先利用大语言模型选择物体并进行初始无碰撞放置；接着根据任务指令生成布局计划，并通过图像补全模型调整视觉布局；随后利用视觉模型匹配物体以恢复精确坐标；最后通过优化算法微调位置消除碰撞，并结合视觉语言模型进行闭环验证，从而生成高质量的机器人操作数据集。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点包括：引入了Inpainting-Guided Scene Construction算法来自动构建语义连贯且物理可达的场景；集成了基于视觉语言模型的闭环验证机制来过滤静默失败；以及实现了感知驱动的压缩算法以减少存储。相比之前的工作，V-CAGE从传统的“盲”脚本化管道转变为代理式系统，通过闭环验证解决了长时序任务中的静默失败问题，并更强调任务级的语义正确性而非仅仅是场景稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 V-CAGE 框架，通过修复引导的场景构建和视觉语言模型的闭环验证，解决了现有场景生成缺乏上下文感知和静默失败的问题，从而实现了高质量、可扩展的机器人操作数据集的自动化合成。

Abstract

Scaling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models requires massive datasets that are both semantically coherent and physically feasible. However, existing scene generation methods often lack context-awareness, making it difficult to synthesize high-fidelity environments embedded with rich semantic information, frequently resulting in unreachable target positions that cause tasks to fail prematurely. We present V-CAGE (Vision-Closed-loop Agentic Generation Engine), an agentic framework for autonomous robotic data synthesis. Unlike traditional scripted pipelines, V-CAGE operates as an embodied agentic system, leveraging foundation models to bridge high-level semantic reasoning with low-level physical interaction. Specifically, we introduce Inpainting-Guided Scene Construction to systematically arrange context-aware layouts, ensuring that the generated scenes are both semantically structured and kinematically reachable. To ensure trajectory correctness, we integrate functional metadata with a Vision-Language Model based closed-loop verification mechanism, acting as a visual critic to rigorously filter out silent failures and sever the error propagation chain. Finally, to overcome the storage bottleneck of massive video datasets, we implement a perceptually-driven compression algorithm that achieves over 90\% filesize reduction without compromising downstream VLA training efficacy. By centralizing semantic layout planning and visual self-verification, V-CAGE automates the end-to-end pipeline, enabling the highly scalable synthesis of diverse, high-quality robotic manipulation datasets.

item.title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
item.author: Tsuheng Hsu, Guiyu Liu, Juho Kannala, Janne Heikkilä
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于数据集级别的、以对象为中心的监督方案，用于在3D高斯溅射中学习对象表示，该方法利用预训练的GOCL模块和场景无关的对象代码本，实现了无需额外掩码预处理或显式多视图对齐的对象监督，从而提升了下游任务的泛化能力。

背景: 现有的3D场景理解工作利用视觉基础模型（VFMs）的2D掩码来监督辐射场，但VFMs提供的监督信号并非本质上以对象为中心，且往往需要额外的掩码预处理/后处理或专门的训练和损失设计来解决跨视图的掩码身份冲突，导致学习到的3D场景身份具有场景依赖性，限制了跨场景的泛化能力。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中监督信号非对象中心、需要额外处理以及泛化能力受限的问题，提出一种数据集级别的、对象中心的监督方案，旨在学习3D高斯溅射中的对象表示。

方法: 构建在预训练的基于槽注意力（slot attention）的全局对象中心学习（GOCL）模块基础上，学习一个场景无关的对象代码本，该代码本提供跨视图和场景的一致的、以身份锚定的表示。通过将代码本与模块的无监督对象掩码耦合，可以直接监督3D高斯的对象身份特征，无需额外的掩码预处理/后处理或显式多视图对齐。

主要发现: 学习到的场景无关代码本使得对象监督和识别无需针对每个场景进行微调或重新训练。

结论: 该方法将无监督对象中心学习（OCL）引入了3D高斯溅射，产生了更结构化的表示，并改善了下游任务（如机器人交互、场景理解和跨场景泛化）的性能。

翻译: Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有3D场景理解方法利用视觉基础模型时，缺乏物体中心性、跨视图身份不一致以及跨场景泛化能力差的问题。现有方法依赖外观分割，容易过度分割单个物理实体，阻碍物理交互，且场景身份是场景依赖的，限制了通用性。这对于具身AI、机器人和场景编辑等需要以可交互物体方式理解场景的下游应用至关重要，该研究通过引入无监督物体中心学习，实现了无需微调的跨场景识别和泛化。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有基于视觉基础模型的方法生成的掩码不是本质上的“物体中心”的，且跨视图身份冲突，导致泛化能力差。因此，作者旨在引入无监督的物体中心学习（OCL）到 3DGS 中。设计上，作者借鉴了基于 Slot Attention 的 GOLD 框架，学习一个场景无关的物体代码本，提供一致的表示。通过将代码本与 GOLD 的无监督物体掩码耦合，直接监督 3D 高斯核的身份特征，无需额外预处理。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将无监督物体中心学习引入3D高斯溅射，通过学习一个场景无关的物体代码本，提供跨视图和场景间一致的身份锚定表示，从而解决现有方法缺乏物体中心性和泛化能力的问题。整体实现流程是：首先训练基于Slot Attention的GOCL模块以学习场景无关的代码本；在场景优化时，将图像输入模块获取无监督掩码；将代码本特征分配给掩码并广播到图像分辨率，直接监督3D高斯的身份特征；最后通过结合渲染损失、特征损失和3D正则化损失进行训练，无需额外的掩码预处理或逐场景微调。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 本文的关键创新点包括：首次将无监督物体中心学习引入3D高斯分布；引入了场景无关的物体代码本，提供跨视角和跨场景的一致、身份锚定的表示；以及一种无需视觉基础模型掩码预处理或显式多视角对齐的监督流程。相比之前依赖视觉基础模型（VFMs）的工作，本文无需额外的掩码处理或对比学习，且代码本具有跨场景泛化能力；与NeRF上的OCL相比，解决了隐式表示的限制，实现了显式的物体中心表示。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文将无监督的以物体为中心的学习引入了3D高斯泼溅，通过学习一个全局的物体代码本，实现了跨场景的物体识别和泛化，且无需对每个场景进行微调或使用视觉基础模型的掩码预处理。

Abstract

Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.

item.title: {\sf TriDeliver}: Cooperative Air-Ground Instant Delivery with UAVs, Couriers, and Crowdsourced Ground Vehicles
item.author: Junhui Gao, Yan Pan, Qianru Wang, Wenzhe Hou, Yiqin Deng, Liangliang Jiang, Yuguang Fang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TriDeliver框架通过整合人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆，实现了高效的即时配送。该方法利用迁移学习算法从快递员的历史行为中提取知识，并将其应用于无人机和地面车辆的调度，从而降低了配送成本并提高了效率。

背景: 现有的多种配送方式（如快递员、无人机、众包车辆）各自存在局限性，无法单独满足日益增长的配送需求。

目的: 提出首个集成了人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆的分层协作框架，以实现高效的即时配送。

方法: 设计了一种基于迁移学习的算法，从快递员的历史行为中提取配送知识，并将其通过微调转移到无人机和地面车辆上，用于调度配送任务。

主要发现: 在真实数据集上评估显示，TriDeliver相比现有的无人机与快递员协作配送方法，将配送成本降低了65.8%；在配送时间、配送成本以及对众包地面车辆原有任务的影响方面分别实现了17.7%、9.8%和43.6%的进一步改善。

结论: 即使使用简单的神经网络表示转移的知识，TriDeliver也能显著提升配送性能，证明了该框架的有效性。

翻译: 摘要：即时配送，在截止日期前运送物品，在日常生活中至关重要。虽然多种配送代理，如快递员、无人机和众包代理已被广泛使用，但它们各自都面临固有的局限性（例如，低效率/劳动力短缺、飞行控制和动态能力），阻止它们单独满足激增的需求。本文提出了TriDeliver，首个集成了人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆的分层协作框架，以实现高效的即时配送。为了获得地面车辆和无人机的初始调度知识并提高协作配送性能，我们设计了一种基于迁移学习的算法，从快递员的行为历史中提取配送知识，并通过微调将其转移到无人机和地面车辆上，然后用于调度包裹以实现高效配送。在一个月的真实世界轨迹和配送数据集上进行了评估，结果表明1）通过整合快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆，TriDeliver相比最先进的无人机与快递员协作配送方法，将配送成本降低了65.8%；2）TriDeliver在配送时间（-17.7%）、配送成本（-9.8%）以及对众包地面车辆原有任务的影响（-43.6%）方面实现了进一步改善，即使使用简单的神经网络表示转移的知识，也是如此。

Abstract

Instant delivery, shipping items before critical deadlines, is essential in daily life. While multiple delivery agents, such as couriers, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and crowdsourced agents, have been widely employed, each of them faces inherent limitations (e.g., low efficiency/labor shortages, flight control, and dynamic capabilities, respectively), preventing them from meeting the surging demands alone. This paper proposes {\sf TriDeliver}, the first hierarchical cooperative framework, integrating human couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced ground vehicles (GVs) for efficient instant delivery. To obtain the initial scheduling knowledge for GVs and UAVs as well as improve the cooperative delivery performance, we design a Transfer Learning (TL)-based algorithm to extract delivery knowledge from couriers' behavioral history and transfer their knowledge to UAVs and GVs with fine-tunings, which is then used to dispatch parcels for efficient delivery. Evaluated on one-month real-world trajectory and delivery datasets, it has been demonstrated that 1) by integrating couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced GVs, {\sf TriDeliver} reduces the delivery cost by $65.8\%$ versus state-of-the-art cooperative delivery by UAVs and couriers; 2) {\sf TriDeliver} achieves further improvements in terms of delivery time ($-17.7\%$), delivery cost ($-9.8\%$), and impacts on original tasks of crowdsourced GVs ($-43.6\%$), even with the representation of the transferred knowledge by simple neural networks, respectively.

item.title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy
item.author: Jiaheng Dai, Huanrong Liu, Tailai Zhou, Tongyu Jia, Qin Liu, Yutong Ban, Zeju Li, Yu Gao, Xin Ma, Qingbiao Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一个名为SIA-RAPN的基准测试，用于评估机器人辅助部分肾切除术（RAPN）中精细动作分割的性能。该基准测试基于50个临床视频，包含12个帧级标签，并比较了四种基于I3D特征的时间模型。

背景: 在机器人辅助部分肾切除术中，精细动作分割需要在帧级别上识别视觉上相似的缝合动作，这些动作具有可变的持续时间和显著的类别不平衡。

目的: 定义并评估在机器人辅助部分肾切除术中进行精细动作分割的问题，通过SIA-RAPN基准测试比较四种时间模型。

方法: 使用da Vinci Xi系统获取的50个临床视频，标注了12个帧级标签。评估方法包括平衡准确率、编辑分数、重叠阈值为10、25和50的段级F1、帧级准确率和帧级平均精度。

主要发现: 在主要数据集上，DiffAct模型在F1、帧级准确率、编辑分数和帧级平均精度上表现最高，而MS-TCN++模型在平衡准确率上表现最高。

结论: SIA-RAPN基准测试为评估机器人辅助部分肾切除术中精细动作分割提供了标准，并揭示了不同时间模型在处理可变持续时间和类别不平衡问题上的性能差异。

翻译: 该研究提出了一个名为SIA-RAPN的基准测试，用于评估机器人辅助部分肾切除术（RAPN）中精细动作分割的性能。该基准测试基于50个临床视频，包含12个帧级标签，并比较了四种基于I3D特征的时间模型。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决机器人辅助部分肾切除术中缝合重建阶段的细粒度动作分割难题。由于缝合动作视觉相似且持续时间变化大，模型需要准确识别每一帧的动作类型并确定动作的起止时间。这对手术培训、回顾性工作流评估以及视频辅助系统的开发具有重要意义。缝合术技术要求高，自动化分析有助于在恢复组织完整性的同时保持止血和限制热缺血时间。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对机器人辅助部分肾切除术中肾修补术这一特定阶段，定义了细粒度动作分割任务，并考虑了相邻动作区别细微、持续时间变化和类别不平衡等挑战。他们借鉴了微创手术中的细粒度手术活动分析研究，采用了现有的I3D视频编码器和多种时间建模模型（如MS-TCN++、AsFormer、TUT和DiffAct）作为基线进行对比。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用深度学习自动分析机器人辅助部分肾切除术中缝合阶段的手术视频，以解决视觉相似动作的精细级时序分割问题，包括识别动作类型和确定时间边界。整体实现流程是：首先使用I3D网络提取视频特征；然后将特征输入多种时间建模模型（如DiffAct、MS-TCN++等）进行训练，其中DiffAct通过迭代去噪来处理动作边界的模糊；最后在包含50个临床视频的数据集上评估模型的准确性和一致性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于定义了针对缝合阶段的临床基础动作分割任务，并建立了包含多种模型类型的基准协议。相比之前的工作，它针对缝合阶段相邻动作差异细微、罕见事件重要且视觉条件多变的特点，采用了平衡准确率等指标来处理类别不平衡和边界模糊问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文定义了针对机器人辅助部分肾切除缝合阶段的细粒度动作分割任务，建立了包含50个临床视频的基准数据集，并提供了多种时间模型在域内和跨域评估下的基线结果。

Abstract

Fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy requires frame-level recognition of visually similar suturing gestures with variable duration and substantial class imbalance. The SIA-RAPN benchmark defines this problem on 50 clinical videos acquired with the da Vinci Xi system and annotated with 12 frame-level labels. The benchmark compares four temporal models built on I3D features: MS-TCN++, AsFormer, TUT, and DiffAct. Evaluation uses balanced accuracy, edit score, segmental F1 at overlap thresholds of 10, 25, and 50, frame-wise accuracy, and frame-wise mean average precision. In addition to the primary evaluation across five released split configurations on SIA-RAPN, the benchmark reports cross-domain results on a separate single-port RAPN dataset. Across the strongest reported values over those five runs on the primary dataset, DiffAct achieves the highest F1, frame-wise accuracy, edit score, and frame mAP, while MS-TCN++ attains the highest balanced accuracy.

item.title: Beyond Isolated Clients: Integrating Graph-Based Embeddings into Event Sequence Models
item.author: Harry Proshian, Nikita Severin, Sergey Nikolenko, Kireev Ivan, Andrey Savchenko, Ivan Sergeev, Maria Postnova, Ilya Makarov
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对大规模数字平台中的用户属性预测问题，提出了一种将图结构信息整合到自监督学习中的方法。

背景: 大规模数字平台产生数十亿个带有时间戳的用户-项目交互事件，这些事件对于欺诈预防和推荐等用户属性预测至关重要。

目的: 为了解决自监督学习（SSL）通常忽略用户-项目交互图全局结构的问题，提出三种模型无关的策略来整合这种结构信息到对比自监督学习中。

方法: 提出了三种模型无关的策略：丰富事件嵌入、将客户端表示与图嵌入对齐以及添加结构预任务。

主要发现: 在四个金融和电子商务数据集上的实验表明，该方法始终提高了准确性（最高提高2.3% AUC），并揭示了图密度是选择最佳整合策略的关键因素。

结论: 该方法有效将图结构信息整合到对比自监督学习中，显著提升了用户属性预测的准确率。

翻译: Large-scale digital platforms generate billions of timestamped user-item interactions (events) that are crucial for predicting user attributes in, e.g., fraud prevention and recommendations. While self-supervised learning (SSL) effectively models the temporal order of events, it typically overlooks the global structure of the user-item interaction graph. To bridge this gap, we propose three model-agnostic strategies for integrating this structural information into contrastive SSL: enriching event embeddings, aligning client representations with graph embeddings, and adding a structural pretext task. Experiments on four financial and e-commerce datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves the accuracy (up to a 2.3% AUC) and reveals that graph density is a key factor in selecting the optimal integration strategy.

Abstract

Large-scale digital platforms generate billions of timestamped user-item interactions (events) that are crucial for predicting user attributes in, e.g., fraud prevention and recommendations. While self-supervised learning (SSL) effectively models the temporal order of events, it typically overlooks the global structure of the user-item interaction graph. To bridge this gap, we propose three model-agnostic strategies for integrating this structural information into contrastive SSL: enriching event embeddings, aligning client representations with graph embeddings, and adding a structural pretext task. Experiments on four financial and e-commerce datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves the accuracy (up to a 2.3% AUC) and reveals that graph density is a key factor in selecting the optimal integration strategy.

item.title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation
item.author: Yu Zhang, Yiwen Zhang, Yi Zhang, Lei Sang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DIAURec是一个统一了意图建模和语言建模的推荐系统表示学习框架，通过重构基于协作和语言信号的原型和分布意图空间，并采用对齐和均匀性作为主要优化目标，结合粗粒度和细粒度匹配以及空间内和交互正则化来增强表示一致性和模型鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的推荐系统通过学习用户和物品表示来提供个性化服务，但稀疏交互衍生的表示往往无法全面刻画用户行为，限制了推荐效果。近期研究尝试通过意图或语言建模增强用户表示，但大多侧重于模型可解释性而非表示优化，而表示优化对提升推荐质量至关重要。

目的: 提出DIAURec框架，以克服现有方法的局限性，通过统一意图建模和语言建模来优化用户和物品的表示，从而提升推荐质量。

方法: DIAURec重构基于协作和语言信号形成的原型和分布意图空间的表示。设计了全面的表示优化策略，包括以对齐和均匀性为主要优化目标，结合粗粒度和细粒度匹配以实现不同空间间的有效对齐，以及引入空间内和交互正则化以增强模型鲁棒性并防止表示坍塌。

主要发现: 在三个公共数据集上，DIAURec相较于十五个基线方法 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines，充分验证了其有效性和优越性。

结论: DIAURec通过统一意图和语言建模及全面的表示优化策略，有效解决了现有推荐系统在表示优化方面的不足，显著提升了推荐性能。

翻译: General recommender systems deliver personalized services by learning user and item representations, with the central challenge being how to capture latent user preferences. However, representations derived from sparse interactions often fail to comprehensively characterize user behaviors, thereby limiting recommendation effectiveness. Recent studies attempt to enhance user representations through sophisticated modeling strategies (e.g., intent or language modeling). Nevertheless, most works primarily concentrate on model interpretability instead of representation optimization. This imbalance has led to limited progress, as representation optimization is crucial for recommendation quality by promoting the affinity between users and their interacted items in the feature space, yet remains largely overlooked. To overcome these limitations, we propose DIAURec, a novel representation learning framework that unifies intent and language modeling for recommendation. DIAURec reconstructs representations based on the prototype and distribution intent spaces formed by collaborative and language signals. Furthermore, we design a comprehensive representation optimization strategy. Specifically, we adopts alignment and uniformity as the primary optimization objectives, and incorporates both coarse- and fine-grained matching to achieve effective alignment across different spaces, thereby enhancing representational consistency. Additionally, we further introduce intra-space and interaction regularization to enhance model robustness and prevent representation collapse in reconstructed space representation. Experiments on three public datasets against fifteen baseline methods show that DIAURec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, fully validating its effectiveness and superiority.

Abstract

General recommender systems deliver personalized services by learning user and item representations, with the central challenge being how to capture latent user preferences. However, representations derived from sparse interactions often fail to comprehensively characterize user behaviors, thereby limiting recommendation effectiveness. Recent studies attempt to enhance user representations through sophisticated modeling strategies ($e.g.,$ intent or language modeling). Nevertheless, most works primarily concentrate on model interpretability instead of representation optimization. This imbalance has led to limited progress, as representation optimization is crucial for recommendation quality by promoting the affinity between users and their interacted items in the feature space, yet remains largely overlooked. To overcome these limitations, we propose DIAURec, a novel representation learning framework that unifies intent and language modeling for recommendation. DIAURec reconstructs representations based on the prototype and distribution intent spaces formed by collaborative and language signals. Furthermore, we design a comprehensive representation optimization strategy. Specifically, we adopts alignment and uniformity as the primary optimization objectives, and incorporates both coarse- and fine-grained matching to achieve effective alignment across different spaces, thereby enhancing representational consistency. Additionally, we further introduce intra-space and interaction regularization to enhance model robustness and prevent representation collapse in reconstructed space representation. Experiments on three public datasets against fifteen baseline methods show that DIAURec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, fully validating its effectiveness and superiority.

item.title: Memory-Efficient Transfer Learning with Fading Side Networks via Masked Dual Path Distillation
item.author: Yutong Zhang, Jiaxin Chen, Honglin Chen, Kaiqi Zheng, Shengcai Liao, Hanwen Zhong, Weixin Li, Yunhong Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

summary: Memory-efficient transfer learning (METL) approaches have recently achieved promising performance in adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks. They avoid applying gradient backpropagation in large backbones, thus significantly reducing the number of trainable parameters and high memory consumption during fine-tuning. However, since they typically employ a lightweight and learnable side network, these methods inevitably introduce additional memory and time overhead during inference, which contradicts the ultimate goal of efficient transfer learning. To address the above issue, we propose a novel approach dubbed Masked Dual Path Distillation (MDPD) to accelerate inference while retaining parameter and memory efficiency in fine-tuning with fading side networks. Specifically, MDPD develops a framework that enhances the performance by mutually distilling the frozen backbones and learnable side networks in fine-tuning, and discard the side network during inference without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, we design a novel feature-based knowledge distillation method for the encoder structure with multiple layers. Extensive experiments on distinct backbones across vision/language-only and vision-and-language tasks demonstrate that our method not only accelerates inference by at least 25.2% while keeping parameter and memory consumption comparable, but also remarkably promotes the accuracy compared to SOTA approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zhang-VKk/MDPD.

Abstract

Memory-efficient transfer learning (METL) approaches have recently achieved promising performance in adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks. They avoid applying gradient backpropagation in large backbones, thus significantly reducing the number of trainable parameters and high memory consumption during fine-tuning. However, since they typically employ a lightweight and learnable side network, these methods inevitably introduce additional memory and time overhead during inference, which contradicts the ultimate goal of efficient transfer learning. To address the above issue, we propose a novel approach dubbed Masked Dual Path Distillation (MDPD) to accelerate inference while retaining parameter and memory efficiency in fine-tuning with fading side networks. Specifically, MDPD develops a framework that enhances the performance by mutually distilling the frozen backbones and learnable side networks in fine-tuning, and discard the side network during inference without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, we design a novel feature-based knowledge distillation method for the encoder structure with multiple layers. Extensive experiments on distinct backbones across vision/language-only and vision-and-language tasks demonstrate that our method not only accelerates inference by at least 25.2\% while keeping parameter and memory consumption comparable, but also remarkably promotes the accuracy compared to SOTA approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zhang-VKk/MDPD.

item.title: EquiformerV3: Scaling Efficient, Expressive, and General SE(3)-Equivariant Graph Attention Transformers
item.author: Yi-Lun Liao, Alexander J. Hoffman, Sabrina C. Shen, Alexandre Duval, Sam Walton Norwood, Tess Smidt
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了EquiformerV3，这是第三代的SE(3)-等变图注意力Transformer，旨在提升效率、表达能力和通用性。

背景: 随着SE(3)-等变图神经网络在3D原子建模中成熟，提高其效率、表达能力和物理一致性已成为大规模应用的核心挑战。

目的: 设计EquiformerV3以在效率、表达能力和通用性三个维度上取得进步。

方法: 基于EquiformerV2进行了三项关键改进：1. 优化软件实现，实现1.75倍加速；2. 引入等变合并层归一化、改进前馈网络超参数和带平滑半径截断的注意力机制；3. 提出SwiGLU-S2激活函数以包含多体相互作用，提高理论表达能力并简化S2网格采样。

主要发现: SwiGLU-S2激活函数和平滑截断注意力机制能够准确建模平滑变化的势能面，使模型能够处理能量守恒模拟和PES高阶导数任务。
