翻译: 密集标注，如分割掩码，在获取3D医学图像时既昂贵又耗时，尤其是需要专家逐体素标注。弱监督方法旨在解决这一局限性，但通常依赖于基于归因的方法，难以准确捕捉小结构如肺部结节。在本文中，我们提出了一种通过以即插即用方式结合预训练最先进正则流和预测器模型来分割肺部结节的弱监督方法。我们的方法使用3D正则流模型的无训练引导，仅需使用图像级标签对预测器进行微调，无需重新训练生成模型。所提出的方法在两个独立的预测器上产生了改进质量的分割，一致检测出不同大小和形状的肺部结节。在LUNA16上的实验表明，该方法优于基线方法，突出了生成式基础模型作为弱监督3D医学图像分割工具的潜力。

Abstract

Dense annotations, such as segmentation masks, are expensive and time-consuming to obtain, especially for 3D medical images where expert voxel-wise labeling is required. Weakly supervised approaches aim to address this limitation, but often rely on attribution-based methods that struggle to accurately capture small structures such as lung nodules. In this paper, we propose a weakly-supervised segmentation method for lung nodules by combining pretrained state-of-the-art rectified flow and predictor models in a plug-and-play manner. Our approach uses training-free guidance of a 3D rectified flow model, requiring only fine-tuning of the predictor using image-level labels and no retraining of the generative model. The proposed method produces improved-quality segmentations for two separate predictors, consistently detecting lung nodules of varying size and shapes. Experiments on LUNA16 demonstrate improvements over baseline methods, highlighting the potential of generative foundation models as tools for weakly supervised 3D medical image segmentation.

item.title: InstAP: Instance-Aware Vision-Language Pre-Train for Spatial-Temporal Understanding
item.author: Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Jingjing Pan, Mustafa Erdogan, Mingfang Zhang, Betty Le Dem, Norimasa Kobori, Quan Kong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为InstAP的实例感知预训练框架，旨在解决现有视觉语言预训练模型在实例级推理上的不足。

背景: 现有的视觉语言预训练范式擅长全局场景理解，但在实例级推理方面表现不佳，因为它们仅依赖全局监督。

目的: 引入InstAP框架，通过联合优化全局视觉文本对齐和细粒度的实例级对比对齐，将文本提及具体化到特定的时空区域。

方法: 提出了InstVL数据集，包含200万张图像和5万段视频，具有双重粒度的标注：整体场景描述和密集的实例描述。

主要发现: 在InstVL基准上，InstAP在实例级检索任务上显著优于现有VLP模型；在零样本视频基准测试中表现具有竞争力；实例中心预训练改善了全局理解。

结论: InstAP能够将文本提及定位到正确的实例，而仅依赖全局监督的模型表现出更分散的场景级注意力。

翻译: Current vision-language pre-training (VLP) paradigms excel at global scene understanding but struggle with instance-level reasoning due to global-only supervision. We introduce InstAP, an Instance-Aware Pre-training framework that jointly optimizes global vision-text alignment and fine-grained, instance-level contrastive alignment by grounding textual mentions to specific spatial-temporal regions. To support this, we present InstVL, a large-scale dataset (2 million images, 50,000 videos) with dual-granularity annotations: holistic scene captions and dense, grounded instance descriptions. On the InstVL benchmark, InstAP substantially outperforms existing VLP models on instance-level retrieval, and also surpasses a strong VLP baseline trained on the exact same data corpus, isolating the benefit of our instance-aware objective. Moreover, instance-centric pre-training improves global understanding: InstAP achieves competitive zero-shot performance on multiple video benchmarks, including MSR-VTT and DiDeMo. Qualitative visualizations further show that InstAP localizes textual mentions to the correct instances, while global-only models exhibit more diffuse, scene-level attention.

Abstract

Current vision-language pre-training (VLP) paradigms excel at global scene understanding but struggle with instance-level reasoning due to global-only supervision. We introduce InstAP, an Instance-Aware Pre-training framework that jointly optimizes global vision-text alignment and fine-grained, instance-level contrastive alignment by grounding textual mentions to specific spatial-temporal regions. To support this, we present InstVL, a large-scale dataset (2 million images, 50,000 videos) with dual-granularity annotations: holistic scene captions and dense, grounded instance descriptions. On the InstVL benchmark, InstAP substantially outperforms existing VLP models on instance-level retrieval, and also surpasses a strong VLP baseline trained on the exact same data corpus, isolating the benefit of our instance-aware objective. Moreover, instance-centric pre-training improves global understanding: InstAP achieves competitive zero-shot performance on multiple video benchmarks, including MSR-VTT and DiDeMo. Qualitative visualizations further show that InstAP localizes textual mentions to the correct instances, while global-only models exhibit more diffuse, scene-level attention.

item.title: PokeGym: A Visually-Driven Long-Horizon Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
item.author: Ruizhi Zhang, Ye Huang, Yuangang Pan, Chuanfu Shen, Zhilin Liu, Ting Xie, Wen Li, Lixin Duan
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了PokeGym基准测试，旨在解决现有视觉语言模型在复杂3D具身环境中部署受限的问题。该基准测试通过严格的代码级隔离，仅使用原始RGB观察进行决策，并利用内存扫描进行自动化评估。测试包含30个任务，涵盖导航、交互和混合场景，并分析了当前VLMs在物理死锁恢复方面的局限性。

背景: 现有视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解方面取得了显著进展，但在复杂3D具身环境中的部署仍然严重受限。现有的基准测试存在四个关键缺陷：被动感知任务回避了交互动态；简化的2D环境无法评估深度感知；特权状态泄露绕过了真正的视觉处理；以及人工评估既昂贵又不可扩展。

目的: 为了解决现有基准测试的缺陷，作者引入了PokeGym，这是一个在《宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯》这一视觉复杂的3D开放世界角色扮演游戏中实例化的视觉驱动型长时序基准测试。

方法: PokeGym通过严格的代码级隔离来确保纯视觉决策：智能体仅操作原始RGB观察，而独立的评估器通过内存扫描验证成功情况。该基准包含30个任务（30-220步），涵盖导航、交互和混合场景，并具有三种指令粒度（视觉引导、步骤引导、仅目标）。

主要发现: 评估揭示了当前VLMs的一个关键局限性：物理死锁恢复而非高层规划构成了主要瓶颈，死锁与任务成功显示出强烈的负相关。此外，作者发现了一种元认知差异：较弱的模型主要遭受无意识死锁（对被困状态不知情），而先进的模型则表现出有意识死锁（识别出被困但无法恢复）。

结论: 这些发现突出了在VLM架构中整合显式空间直觉的必要性。

翻译: 虽然视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们在复杂3D具身环境中的部署仍然严重受限。现有的基准测试存在四个关键缺陷：被动感知任务回避了交互动态；简化的2D环境无法评估深度感知；特权状态泄露绕过了真正的视觉处理；以及人工评估既昂贵又不可扩展。我们引入了PokeGym，这是一个在《宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯》这一视觉复杂的3D开放世界角色扮演游戏中实例化的视觉驱动型长时序基准测试。PokeGym通过严格的代码级隔离来确保纯视觉决策：智能体仅操作原始RGB观察，而独立的评估器通过内存扫描验证成功情况。该基准包含30个任务（30-220步），涵盖导航、交互和混合场景，并具有三种指令粒度（视觉引导、步骤引导、仅目标）。评估揭示了当前VLMs的一个关键局限性：物理死锁恢复而非高层规划构成了主要瓶颈，死锁与任务成功显示出强烈的负相关。此外，作者发现了一种元认知差异：较弱的模型主要遭受无意识死锁（对被困状态不知情），而先进的模型则表现出有意识死锁（识别出被困但无法恢复）。这些发现突出了在VLM架构中整合显式空间直觉的必要性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有视觉语言模型在复杂3D具身环境中应用受限的问题。现有基准通常存在静态感知、环境简化、依赖特权信息或人工评估昂贵等缺陷。这很重要，因为现实世界中的智能体需要从像素中感知、在部分可观测性下行动，并完成长时域的目标规划，而现有基准无法真实反映这种能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为现有基准测试存在缺乏交互动态、2D环境无法评估深度、泄露特权状态以及人工评估不可扩展等缺陷，因此设计了 PokeGym 来解决这些问题。他们借鉴了 NetHack、StarDojo 和 VisGym 等现有游戏和交互式基准测试，但选择了复杂的 3D 开放世界 RPG《宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯》作为测试环境。为了确保公平性和可扩展性，他们采用了严格的代码级隔离，让代理仅基于原始像素观察进行操作，并通过独立的内存扫描评估器来验证成功。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法旨在构建一个严格的基准，评估视觉语言模型在复杂 3D 开放世界环境中的长时域交互能力。它通过仅使用原始像素输入和自动化评估，解决了现有基准中特权状态泄露和人工评估不可扩展的问题。整体流程基于《宝可梦传说 Z-A》游戏构建。智能体仅接收原始 RGB 图像作为观测，基于视觉输入做出决策。独立的评估器通过扫描游戏内存来验证任务是否成功，从而实现客观且可扩展的自动评估。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了PokeGym基准测试，基于《宝可梦传说 Z-A》的3D开放世界，采用严格的代码级隔离仅使用原始像素输入，并包含30个长时域任务以解耦视觉基础、语义推理和自主探索能力。相比之前的工作，它解决了现有基准的四个关键缺陷：克服了静态感知的局限、使用了复杂的3D视觉而非简化的2D环境、消除了特权状态泄漏，并实现了可扩展的自动化评估，而非昂贵且不客观的人工评估。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 PokeGym，一个在 3D 开放世界游戏中评估视觉语言模型的新基准，它通过仅使用原始像素输入和自动评估来解决现有基准的局限性。

Abstract

While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in static visual understanding, their deployment in complex 3D embodied environments remains severely limited. Existing benchmarks suffer from four critical deficiencies: (1) passive perception tasks circumvent interactive dynamics; (2) simplified 2D environments fail to assess depth perception; (3) privileged state leakage bypasses genuine visual processing; and (4) human evaluation is prohibitively expensive and unscalable. We introduce PokeGym, a visually-driven long-horizon benchmark instantiated within Pokemon Legends: Z-A, a visually complex 3D open-world Role-Playing Game. PokeGym enforces strict code-level isolation: agents operate solely on raw RGB observations while an independent evaluator verifies success via memory scanning, ensuring pure vision-based decision-making and automated, scalable assessment. The benchmark comprises 30 tasks (30-220 steps) spanning navigation, interaction, and mixed scenarios, with three instruction granularities (Visual-Guided, Step-Guided, Goal-Only) to systematically deconstruct visual grounding, semantic reasoning, and autonomous exploration capabilities. Our evaluation reveals a key limitation of current VLMs: physical deadlock recovery, rather than high-level planning, constitutes the primary bottleneck, with deadlocks showing a strong negative correlation with task success. Furthermore, we uncover a metacognitive divergence: weaker models predominantly suffer from Unaware Deadlocks (oblivious to entrapment), whereas advanced models exhibit Aware Deadlocks (recognizing entrapment yet failing to recover). These findings highlight the need to integrate explicit spatial intuition into VLM architectures. The code and benchmark will be available on GitHub.

item.title: EgoEverything: A Benchmark for Human Behavior Inspired Long Context Egocentric Video Understanding in AR Environment
item.author: Qiance Tang, Ziqi Wang, Jieyu Lin, Ziyun Li, Barbara De Salvo, Sai Qian Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EgoEverything是一个基准数据集，通过利用人类注意力信号生成问题，包含超过5000个问答对，覆盖超过100小时的视频，旨在评估长上下元视角视频理解。

背景: 长上下元视角视频理解在增强现实（AR）领域备受关注，但面临挑战，需要推理扩展的时间上下文和多样化的非结构化活动。现有的元视角数据集主要依赖人工佩戴相机，关注视觉内容，在形成视频相关查询时对潜在用户行为的考虑有限。

目的: 创建一个明确考虑人类行为的基准数据集，通过利用从注视数据中抽象出的注意力信号生成问题。

方法: 利用从注视数据中抽象出的人类注意力信号生成问题，整合这些信号以更忠实地捕捉自然人类行为。

主要发现: 通过整合人类注意力信号，该基准数据集更忠实地捕捉自然人类行为，为AR中的长上下元视角视频理解提供了现实的评估环境。

结论: EgoEverything基准数据集通过整合人类注意力信号，为长上下元视角视频理解提供了更真实的评估环境。

翻译: 长上下元视角视频理解最近引起了显著的研究关注，增强现实（AR）被突出为其最重要的应用领域之一。然而，由于需要对扩展的时间上下文和多样化的非结构化活动进行推理，该任务仍然具有高度挑战性。虽然存在几个基准，但大多数元视角数据集依赖人工佩戴相机，主要关注视觉内容，在形成视频相关查询时对潜在用户行为的考虑有限。EgoEverything是一个基准，通过利用从注视数据中抽象出的人类注意力信号生成问题，明确考虑人类行为。它包含超过5000个多选题答案对，跨越超过100小时的视频。通过在问题生成期间整合人类注意力信号，它更忠实地捕捉自然人类行为，并为AR中的长上下元视角视频理解提供了现实的评估环境。

Abstract

Long context egocentric video understanding has recently attracted significant research attention, with augmented reality (AR) highlighted as one of its most important application domains. Nevertheless, the task remains highly challenging due to the need for reasoning over extended temporal contexts and diverse, unstructured activities. Although several benchmarks exist, most egocentric datasets rely on human worn cameras and focus mainly on visual content, with limited consideration of underlying user behavior when forming video-related queries. EgoEverything is a benchmark that explicitly considers human behavior by leveraging human attention signals, abstracted from gaze data, when generating questions. It comprises over 5,000 multiple choice question answer pairs, spanning more than 100 hours of video. By integrating human attention signals during question generation, it more faithfully captures natural human behavior and offers a realistic evaluation setting for long-context egocentric video understanding in AR.

item.title: Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces
item.author: Jiawei Chen, Ruoxi Xu, Boxi Cao, Ruotong Pan, Yunfei Zhang, Yifei Hu, Yong Du, Tingting Gao, Yaojie Lu, Yingfei Sun, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xiangyu Wu, Hongyu Lin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文介绍了OmniBehavior基准测试，旨在解决现有用户模拟基准测试的局限性。

背景: 现有基准测试局限于孤立场景、狭窄动作空间或合成数据，无法捕捉真实人类行为的整体性。

目的: 构建首个完全基于真实世界数据的用户模拟基准测试，整合长时程、跨场景和异质性行为模式。

方法: 基于OmniBehavior基准测试，对最先进的LLM进行了广泛评估，并对比了模拟行为与真实行为。

主要发现: 现有数据集存在隧道视野问题；当前LLM难以准确模拟复杂行为；LLM存在结构性偏差，倾向于收敛为积极平均人，表现出过度活跃、人格同质化和乌托邦偏见。

结论: LLM在模拟中会丢失个体差异和长尾行为，这指出了未来高保真模拟研究的关键方向。

翻译: 大型语言模型的出现揭示了通用用户模拟器的潜力。然而，现有的基准测试仍然局限于孤立场景、狭窄的动作空间或合成数据，无法捕捉真实人类行为的整体性。为了弥合这一差距，我们介绍了OmniBehavior，这是第一个完全由真实世界数据构建的用户模拟基准测试，将长时程、跨场景和异质性行为模式整合到一个统一的框架中。基于此基准测试，我们首先提供了经验证据，表明具有孤立场景的先前数据集存在隧道视野问题，而现实世界的决策依赖于长期、跨场景的因果链。对最先进的LLM的广泛评估表明，当前模型难以准确模拟这些复杂行为，即使随着上下文窗口的扩大，性能也趋于停滞。至关重要的是，模拟行为与真实行为之间的系统比较揭示了一种根本的结构性偏差：LLM倾向于收敛为一个积极的平均人，表现出过度活跃、人格同质化和乌托邦偏见。这导致了个体差异和长尾行为的丧失，突出了未来高保真模拟研究的关键方向。

Abstract

The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has illuminated the potential for a general-purpose user simulator. However, existing benchmarks remain constrained to isolated scenarios, narrow action spaces, or synthetic data, failing to capture the holistic nature of authentic human behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniBehavior, the first user simulation benchmark constructed entirely from real-world data, integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns into a unified framework. Based on this benchmark, we first provide empirical evidence that previous datasets with isolated scenarios suffer from tunnel vision, whereas real-world decision-making relies on long-term, cross-scenario causal chains. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that current models struggle to accurately simulate these complex behaviors, with performance plateauing even as context windows expand. Crucially, a systematic comparison between simulated and authentic behaviors uncovers a fundamental structural bias: LLMs tend to converge toward a positive average person, exhibiting hyper-activity, persona homogenization, and a Utopian bias. This results in the loss of individual differences and long-tail behaviors, highlighting critical directions for future high-fidelity simulation research.

item.title: MegaStyle: Constructing Diverse and Scalable Style Dataset via Consistent Text-to-Image Style Mapping
item.author: Junyao Gao, Sibo Liu, Jiaxing Li, Yanan Sun, Yuanpeng Tu, Fei Shen, Weidong Zhang, Cairong Zhao, Jun Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MegaStyle，一种新颖且可扩展的数据构建流程，用于创建具有内部风格一致性、外部风格多样性和高质量的风格数据集。

背景: 利用当前大型生成模型一致的文本到图像风格映射能力，可以从给定的风格描述生成相同风格图像。

目的: 构建一个多样化且平衡的提示词库，并生成大规模风格数据集MegaStyle-1.4M，以训练风格编码器和风格迁移模型。

方法: 通过内容-风格提示词组合生成MegaStyle-1.4M数据集，采用风格监督对比学习微调风格编码器MegaStyle-Encoder，并训练基于FLUX的风格迁移模型MegaStyle-FLUX。

主要发现: 实验表明保持风格数据集的内部一致性、外部多样性和高质量的重要性，以及MegaStyle-1.4M的有效性。

结论: 在MegaStyle-1.4M上训练的MegaStyle-Encoder和MegaStyle-FLUX提供了可靠的风格相似度测量和可泛化的风格迁移能力，对风格迁移社区做出了重要贡献。

翻译: 本文介绍了MegaStyle，一种新颖且可扩展的数据构建流程，用于创建具有内部风格一致性、外部风格多样性和高质量的风格数据集。我们通过利用当前大型生成模型一致的文本到图像风格映射能力来实现这一点，该能力可以从给定的风格描述生成相同风格的图像。在此基础上，我们构建了一个包含17万风格提示词和40万内容提示词的多样化且平衡的提示词库，并通过内容-风格提示词组合生成了大规模风格数据集MegaStyle-1.4M。利用MegaStyle-1.4M，我们提出了风格监督对比学习来微调风格编码器MegaStyle-Encoder以提取表达性、风格特定的表示，我们还训练了一个基于FLUX的风格迁移模型MegaStyle-FLUX。广泛的实验证明了保持风格数据集的内部一致性、外部多样性和高质量的重要性，以及所提出的MegaStyle-1.4M的有效性。此外，当在MegaStyle-1.4M上训练时，MegaStyle-Encoder和MegaStyle-FLUX提供了可靠的风格相似度测量和可泛化的风格迁移能力，为风格迁移社区做出了重大贡献。更多结果可在我们的项目网站https://jeoyal.github.io/MegaStyle/上查看。

Abstract

In this paper, we introduce MegaStyle, a novel and scalable data curation pipeline that constructs an intra-style consistent, inter-style diverse and high-quality style dataset. We achieve this by leveraging the consistent text-to-image style mapping capability of current large generative models, which can generate images in the same style from a given style description. Building on this foundation, we curate a diverse and balanced prompt gallery with 170K style prompts and 400K content prompts, and generate a large-scale style dataset MegaStyle-1.4M via content-style prompt combinations. With MegaStyle-1.4M, we propose style-supervised contrastive learning to fine-tune a style encoder MegaStyle-Encoder for extracting expressive, style-specific representations, and we also train a FLUX-based style transfer model MegaStyle-FLUX. Extensive experiments demonstrate the importance of maintaining intra-style consistency, inter-style diversity and high-quality for style dataset, as well as the effectiveness of the proposed MegaStyle-1.4M. Moreover, when trained on MegaStyle-1.4M, MegaStyle-Encoder and MegaStyle-FLUX provide reliable style similarity measurement and generalizable style transfer, making a significant contribution to the style transfer community. More results are available at our project website https://jeoyal.github.io/MegaStyle/.

item.title: SOLAR: Communication-Efficient Model Adaptation via Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparametrization
item.author: Seyed Mahmoud Sajjadi Mohammadabadi, Xiaolong Ma, Lei Yang, Feng Yan, Junshan Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SOLAR是一种后训练压缩框架，旨在减少PEFT适配器的通信和存储成本。

背景: PEFT方法如LoRA虽然能实现基础模型的可扩展适应，但在资源受限环境下，其通信和存储成本仍是一个主要瓶颈。

目的: 提出SOLAR框架，以显著降低PEFT适配器的通信成本（即传输或存储的参数数量）。

方法: SOLAR将每个PEFT更新表示为基础模型奇异向量的线性组合，并加入受控的随机扰动。它利用基础模型与任务特定微调更新之间的子空间相似性，解耦适配器大小与PEFT结构，确保紧凑且具有表现力的表示。该方法模型无关，兼容现有PEFT方法。

主要发现: 实验表明，SOLAR在LLaMA、GPT和ViT模型的语言和视觉任务中，在显著减小模型表示大小的同时保持了任务性能。

结论: SOLAR提供了一种有效的通信高效解决方案，适用于分布式系统和边缘设备的部署。

翻译: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，如LoRA，通过注入低秩适配器实现了基础模型的可扩展适应。然而，在资源受限的设置中，它们的通信和存储成本仍然是一个主要瓶颈。我们提出了SOLAR（子空间导向潜在适配器重参数化），一种后训练压缩框架，它显著减少了PEFT适配器的通信成本（即传输或存储的参数数量）。SOLAR将每个PEFT更新表示为基础模型的奇异向量形成的基向量的线性组合，并加入受控的随机扰动。通过利用基础模型和任务特定微调更新之间的子空间相似性（主方向的对齐），SOLAR解耦了适配器大小与PEFT结构，并确保了紧凑且具有表现力的表示。它是模型无关的，与现有的PEFT方法兼容，包括LoRA、AdaLoRA和其他适配器模块。我们在理论上建立了重建误差的界限。在LLaMA、GPT和ViT模型的语言和视觉任务上的实验表明，SOLAR在显著减小模型表示大小的同时保持了任务性能，为分布式系统和边缘设备的部署提供了一种有效的通信高效的解决方案。

Abstract

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA, enable scalable adaptation of foundation models by injecting low-rank adapters. However, their communication and storage costs remain a major bottleneck in resource-constrained settings. We propose SOLAR (Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparameterization), a post-training compression framework that substantially reduces the communication cost (i.e., the number of parameters to transmit or store) of PEFT adapters. SOLAR expresses each PEFT update as a linear combination of basis vectors formed from the foundation model's singular vectors with controlled random perturbations. By exploiting the subspace similarity (the alignment of principal directions) between the foundation model and task-specific fine-tuned updates, SOLAR decouples the adapter size from PEFT structure and ensures compact yet expressive representations. It is model-agnostic and compatible with existing PEFT methods, including LoRA, AdaLoRA, and other adapter modules. We theoretically establish a bound on the reconstruction error. Experiments on language and vision tasks using LLaMA, GPT, and ViT models demonstrate that SOLAR preserves task performance while significantly reducing model representation sizes, offering an effective and communication-efficient solution for deployment in distributed systems and edge devices.

item.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
item.author: Ziyu Ma, Shidong Yang, Yuxiang Ji, Xucong Wang, Yong Wang, Yiming Hu, Tongwen Huang, Xiangxiang Chu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SkillClaw是一个用于多用户智能体生态系统中集体技能演进的框架，通过跨用户和跨时间的交互来改进技能。

背景: 现有的LLM智能体如OpenClaw依赖可重用技能执行复杂任务，但这些技能在部署后大多保持静态。这导致类似的工作流程、工具使用模式和失败模式在不同用户中反复被重新发现，阻碍了系统从经验中学习。

目的: 为了解决现有系统缺乏将不同用户的异构体验转化为可靠技能更新的机制的问题，提出SkillClaw框架。

方法: SkillClaw将跨用户和跨时间的交互作为改进技能的主要信号。它持续聚合使用过程中生成的轨迹，并通过自主演化器处理这些轨迹，识别重复的行为模式，并将这些模式转化为对技能集的更新，包括细化现有技能或扩展新能力。

主要发现: 在WildClawBench上的实验表明，在有限的交互和反馈下，SkillClaw显著提高了Qwen3-Max在现实世界智能体场景中的性能。

结论: 通过将多用户经验整合到持续的技能更新中，SkillClaw实现了跨用户知识转移和累积能力提升，无需用户额外努力即可实现系统范围的改进。

翻译: Large language model (LLM) agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, yet these skills remain largely static after deployment. As a result, similar workflows, tool usage patterns, and failure modes are repeatedly rediscovered across users, preventing the system from improving with experience. While interactions from different users provide complementary signals about when a skill works or fails, existing systems lack a mechanism to convert such heterogeneous experiences into reliable skill updates. To address these issues, we present SkillClaw, a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills. SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities. The resulting skills are maintained in a shared repository and synchronized across users, allowing improvements discovered in one context to propagate system-wide while requiring no additional effort from users. By integrating multi-user experience into ongoing skill updates, SkillClaw enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement, and experiments on WildClawBench show that limited interaction and feedback, it significantly improves the performance of Qwen3-Max in real-world agent scenarios.

Abstract

Large language model (LLM) agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, yet these skills remain largely static after deployment. As a result, similar workflows, tool usage patterns, and failure modes are repeatedly rediscovered across users, preventing the system from improving with experience. While interactions from different users provide complementary signals about when a skill works or fails, existing systems lack a mechanism to convert such heterogeneous experiences into reliable skill updates. To address these issues, we present SkillClaw, a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills. SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities. The resulting skills are maintained in a shared repository and synchronized across users, allowing improvements discovered in one context to propagate system-wide while requiring no additional effort from users. By integrating multi-user experience into ongoing skill updates, SkillClaw enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement, and experiments on WildClawBench show that limited interaction and feedback, it significantly improves the performance of Qwen3-Max in real-world agent scenarios.

item.title: ADAPTive Input Training for Many-to-One Pre-Training on Time-Series Classification
item.author: Paul Quinlan, Qingguo Li, Xiaodan Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ADAPT的新型时间序列数据预训练范式，旨在解决现有方法在多数据集预训练时泛化能力不足的问题，通过高效对齐时间序列数据的物理属性，实现了混合批次预训练。

背景: 现有的自监督训练方法在从单一数据集预训练并微调到下游任务的“一对一”场景中表现出色，但在预训练阶段加入更多数据集时，难以泛化到新数据集。

目的: 构建时间序列领域的基础模型，以解决现有预训练方法在多数据集场景下泛化能力受限的根本挑战。

方法: 提出了ADAPT预训练范式，该方法能够高效对齐时间序列数据的物理属性，从而支持在输入大小和通道维度存在极端差异的数据上进行混合批次预训练。

主要发现: 在162个时间序列分类数据集上训练，在分类基准测试中取得了新的最先进性能；成功在广泛的数据集范围内同时训练模型。

结论: ADAPT范式是构建时间序列领域通用基础模型的关键组成部分，它允许模型从大量多样化的数据集中学习。

翻译: 时间序列模型方面的近期工作利用自监督训练来学习有意义的特征和模式，以提高下游任务的表现并泛化到未见过的模态。虽然这些预训练方法在从单一数据集预训练并在下游数据集上微调的一对多场景中显示出巨大前景，但在预训练期间添加更多数据集时，它们难以泛化到新数据集。这是构建时间序列数据基础模型的一个根本挑战，因为它限制了开发能够从大量可用的多样化数据集中学习的能力。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于时间序列数据的新预训练范式ADAPT，它能够高效对齐时间序列域中数据的物理属性，使得尽管预训练数据的输入大小和通道维度存在极端差异，仍能进行混合批次预训练。我们在162个时间序列分类数据集上进行了训练，并为分类基准测试设定了新的最先进性能。我们成功地在广泛的数据集范围内同时训练模型，这是构建时间序列领域通用基础模型的主要组成部分。

Abstract

Recent work on time-series models has leveraged self-supervised training to learn meaningful features and patterns in order to improve performance on downstream tasks and generalize to unseen modalities. While these pretraining methods have shown great promise in one-to-many scenarios, where a model is pre-trained on one dataset and fine-tuned on a downstream dataset, they have struggled to generalize to new datasets when more datasets are added during pre-training. This is a fundamental challenge in building foundation models for time-series data, as it limits the ability to develop models that can learn from a large variety of diverse datasets available. To address this challenge, we present a new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data. We trained on 162 time-series classification datasets and set new state-of-the-art performance for classification benchmarks. We successfully train a model within the time-series domain on a wide range of datasets simultaneously, which is a major building block for building generalist foundation models in time-series domains.

item.title: Zero-shot Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Using Tabular Prior Fitted Networks
item.author: Mayuka Jayawardhana, Nihal Sharma, Kazem Meidani, Bayan Bruss, Tom Goldstein, Doron Bergman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究介绍了一种通用的多变量时间序列预测框架，将多变量时间序列预测问题转化为一系列标量回归问题，并利用具备回归能力的表格基础模型进行零样本求解。

背景: 表格基础模型如TabPFN在各类表格数据任务中表现优异，超越了传统树模型。尽管已有研究尝试将其应用于时间序列预测，但大多仅将多变量问题视为多个独立的单变量子问题，忽略了通道间的交互作用。

目的: 克服现有方法仅处理独立单变量时间序列的局限，提出一种通用的多变量时间序列预测框架。

方法: 将多变量时间序列预测问题重新表述为一系列标量回归问题，并利用具备回归能力的表格基础模型进行零样本求解。

主要发现: 使用TabPFN-TS作为骨干网络的方法取得了积极结果，并与当前最先进的表格方法进行了比较。

结论: 该方法通过将多变量时间序列预测转化为标量回归问题，能够利用表格基础模型实现零样本预测，有效解决了多变量时间序列预测中忽略通道间交互的问题。

翻译: 表格基础模型，特别是像TabPFN这样的先验数据拟合网络，在从数据插补到标签预测的众多任务中表现突出，超越了树模型的过往成功。这促使人们研究它们在时间序列预测数据中的应用，该问题可表述为表格问题。虽然近期在这方面的工作显示了积极的结果，但大多数工作将多变量时间序列问题的处理限制为几个独立的单变量时间序列预测子问题，从而忽略了任何通道间的交互作用。克服这一局限性，我们介绍了一种使用表格基础模型进行多变量时间序列预测的通用框架。我们通过将多变量时间序列预测问题重新表述为一系列标量回归问题来实现这一点，然后可以由任何具备回归能力的表格基础模型零样本求解。我们展示了使用TabPFN-TS骨干网络的方法的结果，并与当前最先进的表格方法进行了比较。

Abstract

Tabular foundation models, particularly Prior-data Fitted Networks like TabPFN have emerged as the leading contender in a myriad of tasks ranging from data imputation to label prediction on the tabular data format surpassing the historical successes of tree-based models. This has led to investigations on their applicability to forecasting time series data which can be formulated as a tabular problem. While recent work to this end has displayed positive results, most works have limited their treatment of multivariate time series problems to several independent univariate time series forecasting subproblems, thus ignoring any inter-channel interactions. Overcoming this limitation, we introduce a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models. We achieve this by recasting the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can then be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities. We present results of our method using the TabPFN-TS backbone and compare performance with the current state of the art tabular methods.

item.title: Adversarial Label Invariant Graph Data Augmentations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
item.author: Simon Zhang, Ryan P. DeMilt, Kun Jin, Cathy H. Xia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RIA 是一种用于协变量偏移下 OoD 泛化的新方法，通过对抗性训练实现不变性正则化。

背景: 在现实场景中，训练和测试数据常来自不同环境，导致分布偏移，其中协变量偏移仅影响输入数据而概念分布保持不变。

目的: 提出 RIA 方法以解决协变量偏移下的 OoD 泛化问题。

方法: RIA 通过对抗性探索训练数据环境，利用对抗标签不变数据增强防止模型坍缩到分布内学习者，并采用交替梯度下降-上升算法求解。

主要发现: RIA 在多种合成和自然分布偏移的 OoD 图分类任务中，相比现有 OoD 基线方法能实现高精度。

结论: RIA 是一种有效的 OoD 泛化方法，可与多种现有方法结合使用。

翻译: RIA 是一种用于协变量偏移下 OoD 泛化的新方法，通过对抗性训练实现不变性正则化。在现实场景中，训练和测试数据常来自不同环境，导致分布偏移，其中协变量偏移仅影响输入数据而概念分布保持不变。RIA 通过对抗性探索训练数据环境，利用对抗标签不变数据增强防止模型坍缩到分布内学习者，并采用交替梯度下降-上升算法求解。RIA 在多种合成和自然分布偏移的 OoD 图分类任务中，相比现有 OoD 基线方法能实现高精度。

Abstract

Out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization occurs when representation learning encounters a distribution shift. This occurs frequently in practice when training and testing data come from different environments. Covariate shift is a type of distribution shift that occurs only in the input data, while the concept distribution stays invariant. We propose RIA - Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training, a new method for OoD generalization under convariate shift. Motivated by an analogy to $Q$-learning, it performs an adversarial exploration for training data environments. These new environments are induced by adversarial label invariant data augmentations that prevent a collapse to an in-distribution trained learner. It works with many existing OoD generalization methods for covariate shift that can be formulated as constrained optimization problems. We develop an alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm to solve the problem, and perform extensive experiments on OoD graph classification for various kinds of synthetic and natural distribution shifts. We demonstrate that our method can achieve high accuracy compared with OoD baselines.

item.title: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
item.author: Tongbo Chen, Zhengxi Lu, Zhan Xu, Guocheng Shao, Shaohan Zhao, Fei Tang, Yong Du, Kaitao Song, Yizhou Liu, Yuchen Yan, Wenqi Zhang, Xu Tan, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文介绍了KnowU-Bench基准测试，用于评估个性化移动代理在推断用户偏好和主动协助方面的能力。

背景: 现有的基准测试无法捕捉个性化移动代理所需的用户偏好推断和主动协助校准能力。以往的工作仅评估静态历史中的偏好恢复或固定上下文中的意图预测，未测试代理是否能在交互中获取缺失的偏好，也未测试在实时GUI环境中决定何时干预、寻求同意或保持沉默的能力。

目的: 引入KnowU-Bench，这是一个基于可重现Android模拟环境的在线基准测试，旨在评估个性化移动代理的能力。

方法: KnowU-Bench包含42个通用GUI任务、86个个性化任务和64个主动任务。它将用户偏好视为动态而非静态上下文，隐藏用户档案，仅暴露行为日志，迫使代理进行真实的偏好推断而非上下文查找。它使用基于结构化档案的LLM驱动的用户模拟器来支持多轮偏好获取，并评估完整的主动决策链，包括基于GUI的执行、同意协商和拒绝后的克制。评估采用结合基于规则的验证和LLM-as-a-Judge评分的混合协议。

主要发现: 实验显示了一个显著的性能下降：擅长明确任务执行的代理在需要用户偏好推断或干预校准的模糊指令下成功率低于50%，即使是前沿模型如Claude Sonnet 4.6也是如此。核心瓶颈不是GUI导航，而是偏好获取和干预校准。

结论: 这暴露了具备界面操作能力与提供可信个人协助之间存在的根本差距。

翻译: 论文介绍了KnowU-Bench基准测试，用于评估个性化移动代理在推断用户偏好和主动协助方面的能力。现有的基准测试无法捕捉个性化移动代理所需的用户偏好推断和主动协助校准能力。以往的工作仅评估静态历史中的偏好恢复或固定上下文中的意图预测，未测试代理是否能在交互中获取缺失的偏好，也未测试在实时GUI环境中决定何时干预、寻求同意或保持沉默的能力。引入KnowU-Bench，这是一个基于可重现Android模拟环境的在线基准测试，旨在评估个性化移动代理的能力。KnowU-Bench包含42个通用GUI任务、86个个性化任务和64个主动任务。它将用户偏好视为动态而非静态上下文，隐藏用户档案，仅暴露行为日志，迫使代理进行真实的偏好推断而非上下文查找。它使用基于结构化档案的LLM驱动的用户模拟器来支持多轮偏好获取，并评估完整的主动决策链，包括基于GUI的执行、同意协商和拒绝后的克制。评估采用结合基于规则的验证和LLM-as-a-Judge评分的混合协议。实验显示了一个显著的性能下降：擅长明确任务执行的代理在需要用户偏好推断或干预校准的模糊指令下成功率低于50%，即使是前沿模型如Claude Sonnet 4.6也是如此。核心瓶颈不是GUI导航，而是偏好获取和干预校准。这暴露了具备界面操作能力与提供可信个人协助之间存在的根本差距。

Abstract

Personalized mobile agents that infer user preferences and calibrate proactive assistance hold great promise as everyday digital assistants, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture what this requires. Prior work evaluates preference recovery from static histories or intent prediction from fixed contexts. Neither tests whether an agent can elicit missing preferences through interaction, nor whether it can decide when to intervene, seek consent, or remain silent in a live GUI environment. We introduce KnowU-Bench, an online benchmark for personalized mobile agents built on a reproducible Android emulation environment, covering 42 general GUI tasks, 86 personalized tasks, and 64 proactive tasks. Unlike prior work that treats user preferences as static context, KnowU-Bench hides the user profile from the agent and exposes only behavioral logs, forcing genuine preference inference rather than context lookup. To support multi-turn preference elicitation, it instantiates an LLM-driven user simulator grounded in structured profiles, enabling realistic clarification dialogues and proactive consent handling. Beyond personalization, KnowU-Bench provides comprehensive evaluation of the complete proactive decision chain, including grounded GUI execution, consent negotiation, and post-rejection restraint, evaluated through a hybrid protocol combining rule-based verification with LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. Our experiments reveal a striking degradation: agents that excel at explicit task execution fall below 50% under vague instructions requiring user preference inference or intervention calibration, even for frontier models like Claude Sonnet 4.6. The core bottlenecks are not GUI navigation but preference acquisition and intervention calibration, exposing a fundamental gap between competent interface operation and trustworthy personal assistance.

item.title: CrashSight: A Phase-Aware, Infrastructure-Centric Video Benchmark for Traffic Crash Scene Understanding and Reasoning
item.author: Rui Gan, Junyi Ma, Pei Li, Xingyou Yang, Kai Chen, Sikai Chen, Bin Ran
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了CrashSight，这是一个基于真实路边摄像头数据的用于道路碰撞理解的大规模视觉语言基准数据集，包含250个碰撞视频和1.3万个问答对，旨在评估VLM在安全关键场景下的表现。

背景: Cooperative autonomous driving requires traffic scene understanding from both vehicle and infrastructure perspectives. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong general reasoning capabilities, their performance in safety-critical traffic scenarios remains insufficiently evaluated due to the ego-vehicle focus of existing benchmarks.

目的: To bridge this gap, we present CrashSight, a large-scale vision-language benchmark for roadway crash understanding using real-world roadside camera data.

方法: The dataset comprises 250 crash videos, annotated with 13K multiple-choice question-answer pairs organized under a two-tier taxonomy. Tier 1 evaluates the visual grounding of scene context and involved parties, while Tier 2 probes higher-level reasoning, including crash mechanics, causal attribution, temporal progression, and post-crash outcomes. We benchmark 8 state-of-the-art VLMs.

主要发现: Despite strong scene description capabilities, current models struggle with temporal and causal reasoning in safety-critical scenarios.

结论: The benchmark provides a standardized evaluation framework for infrastructure-assisted perception in cooperative autonomous driving. We provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and discuss directions for improving VLM crash understanding.

翻译: 摘要：协同自动驾驶需要从车辆和基础设施两个角度理解交通场景。虽然视觉语言模型（VLM）表现出强大的通用推理能力，但由于现有基准测试的车辆自聚焦，其在安全关键交通场景中的性能评估仍不足。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了CrashSight，这是一个使用真实路边摄像头数据进行道路碰撞理解的大规模视觉语言基准。该数据集包含250个碰撞视频，标注了1.3万个组织在两级分类法下的多选题问答对。第一级评估场景背景和涉及方的视觉基础，第二级探测高级推理，包括碰撞力学、因果归因、时间进展和碰撞后结果。我们对8个最先进的VLM进行了基准测试，结果表明，尽管具有强大的场景描述能力，当前模型在安全关键场景中的时间和因果推理方面仍很吃力。我们提供了对失败场景的详细分析，并讨论了改进VLM碰撞理解的方向。该基准为合作自动驾驶中的基础设施辅助感知提供了标准化评估框架。CrashSight基准测试，包括完整数据集和代码，可在https://mcgrche.github.io/crashsight访问。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有基准测试主要关注自车视角，缺乏对基础设施视角下交通场景理解的问题，以及现有视觉语言模型在安全关键场景中表现不足的问题。这个问题在现实中很重要，因为事故是交通环境中的关键长尾事件，需要系统理解；在研究中，基础设施视角对于协同自动驾驶、事故后分析和交通管理至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有基准测试多聚焦于车辆视角，缺乏对事故场景中因果和时间推理的评估，因此设计了 CrashSight，引入“阶段感知”标注将事故分解为四个时间阶段。在借鉴现有工作方面，作者使用了 TAD corpus 作为数据来源，并参考了现有的 VLM 辅助标注管道和 LLM 驱动的问答生成方法，同时也参考了其他交通场景理解基准和基础设施异常检测数据集来识别差距。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用路侧摄像头视角，通过“阶段感知”标注来评估视觉语言模型在安全关键事故场景中的因果和时间推理能力。实现流程包括：首先从TAD语料库选取250个真实事故视频；其次采用三阶段标注管道，先用VLM起草四阶段描述，再由专家修正细节，最后验证质量；最后生成包含13K多项选择题对的VQA数据集，并进行鲁棒性增强和改写。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了首个基于基础设施视角的交通碰撞视频问答基准CrashSight，引入了将碰撞分解为四个时间阶段的感知标注设计，并构建了包含250个视频和13K问答对的大规模数据集。相比之前的工作，不同之处在于它专注于从路边摄像头视角理解安全关键的碰撞场景，而非传统的自车视角，且包含了针对因果推理和时间序列等高级认知任务的评估，而以往基准多缺乏这些结构化标注。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了CrashSight，这是一个基于真实路边摄像头视频的大规模视觉-语言基准，包含250个事故视频和13K多项选择题对，旨在评估VLM在安全关键场景下的理解和推理能力。

Abstract

Cooperative autonomous driving requires traffic scene understanding from both vehicle and infrastructure perspectives. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong general reasoning capabilities, their performance in safety-critical traffic scenarios remains insufficiently evaluated due to the ego-vehicle focus of existing benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we present \textbf{CrashSight}, a large-scale vision-language benchmark for roadway crash understanding using real-world roadside camera data. The dataset comprises 250 crash videos, annotated with 13K multiple-choice question-answer pairs organized under a two-tier taxonomy. Tier 1 evaluates the visual grounding of scene context and involved parties, while Tier 2 probes higher-level reasoning, including crash mechanics, causal attribution, temporal progression, and post-crash outcomes. We benchmark 8 state-of-the-art VLMs and show that, despite strong scene description capabilities, current models struggle with temporal and causal reasoning in safety-critical scenarios. We provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and discuss directions for improving VLM crash understanding. The benchmark provides a standardized evaluation framework for infrastructure-assisted perception in cooperative autonomous driving. The CrashSight benchmark, including the full dataset and code, is accessible at https://mcgrche.github.io/crashsight.

item.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Turbofan Health Estimation via Inverse Problem Formulation
item.author: Milad Leyli-Abadi, Lucas Thil, Sebastien Razakarivony, Guillaume Doquet, Jesse Read
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了如何从运行传感器数据中恢复涡轮风扇发动机的组件级健康指标，通过引入包含维护事件和使用变化的行业导向数据集，建立了稳态和非稳态数据驱动模型与贝叶斯滤波器的基准，并探讨了自监督学习方法。

背景: 涡轮风扇发动机健康状态估计是一个具有挑战性的病态逆问题，受稀疏传感和复杂非线性热力学影响。现有研究因使用不切实际的数据集和未能充分利用时序信息而显得支离破碎。

目的: 研究如何在现实的退化和维护模式下，从运行传感器数据中恢复组件级健康指标。同时，为了支持这项研究，引入了一个包含维护事件和使用变化等行业导向复杂性的新数据集。

方法: 使用新数据集建立基准，比较稳态和非稳态数据驱动模型以及贝叶斯滤波器。此外，引入了自监督学习方法，该方法无需真实健康标签即可学习潜在表示。

主要发现: 传统滤波器仍然是强有力的基准，而自监督方法揭示了健康估计的内在复杂性，并强调了需要更先进和可解释的推理策略。

结论: 自监督方法与直接预测基准相比，为解决该逆问题设定了实际的下限。为了可重复性，本文公开了生成数据集和使用的实现。

翻译: Estimating the health state of turbofan engines is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem, hindered by sparse sensing and complex nonlinear thermodynamics. Research in this area remains fragmented, with comparisons limited by the use of unrealistic datasets and insufficient exploration of the exploitation of temporal information. This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns. To support this study, we introduce a new dataset that incorporates industry-oriented complexities such as maintenance events and usage changes. Using this dataset, we establish an initial benchmark that compares steady-state and nonstationary data-driven models, and Bayesian filters, classic families of methods used to solve this problem. In addition to this benchmark, we introduce self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints. By comparing the downstream estimation performance of these unsupervised representations against the direct prediction baselines, we establish a practical lower bound on the difficulty of solving this inverse problem. Our results reveal that traditional filters remain strong baselines, while SSL methods reveal the intrinsic complexity of health estimation and highlight the need for more advanced and interpretable inference strategies. For reproducibility, both the generated dataset and the implementation used in this work are made accessible.

Abstract

Estimating the health state of turbofan engines is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem, hindered by sparse sensing and complex nonlinear thermodynamics. Research in this area remains fragmented, with comparisons limited by the use of unrealistic datasets and insufficient exploration of the exploitation of temporal information. This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns. To support this study, we introduce a new dataset that incorporates industry-oriented complexities such as maintenance events and usage changes. Using this dataset, we establish an initial benchmark that compares steady-state and nonstationary data-driven models, and Bayesian filters, classic families of methods used to solve this problem. In addition to this benchmark, we introduce self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints. By comparing the downstream estimation performance of these unsupervised representations against the direct prediction baselines, we establish a practical lower bound on the difficulty of solving this inverse problem. Our results reveal that traditional filters remain strong baselines, while SSL methods reveal the intrinsic complexity of health estimation and highlight the need for more advanced and interpretable inference strategies. For reproducibility, both the generated dataset and the implementation used in this work are made accessible.

item.title: OVS-DINO: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation via Structure-Aligned SAM-DINO with Language Guidance
item.author: Haoxi Zeng, Qiankun Liu, Yi Bin, Haiyue Zhang, Yujuan Ding, Guoqing Wang, Deqiang Ouyang, Heng Tao Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为OVS-DINO的新框架，通过结构对齐SAM来激活DINO的边界感知能力，从而在弱监督OVS基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

背景: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS)旨在利用语义描述分割图像区域。虽然基于CLIP的方法擅长语义泛化，但缺乏密集预测所需的细粒度空间感知；而基于VFMs（如DINO）的方法虽然缓解了这些问题，但在高保真分割所需的精确边缘感知方面仍面临困难。

目的: 分析DINO的内部表示，发现其固有的边界感知能力在特征进入更深层的Transformer模块时会发生渐进衰减。提出OVS-DINO框架，通过结构对齐SAM来复兴DINO的潜在边缘敏感性。

方法: 引入结构感知编码器(SAE)和结构调制解码器(SMD)利用SAM的结构先验有效激活DINO的边界特征，并采用利用SAM生成的伪掩码的监督策略。

主要发现: DINO的边界感知能力并非不存在，而是随着特征进入深层Transformer模块而发生渐进衰减。

结论: 该方法在多个弱监督OVS基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，平均得分提高了2.1%。在复杂、杂乱场景下的分割精度显著提升，在Cityscapes数据集上提高了6.3%。

翻译: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS)旨在利用语义描述分割图像区域。虽然基于CLIP的方法擅长语义泛化，但缺乏密集预测所需的细粒度空间感知；而基于VFMs（如DINO）的方法虽然缓解了这些问题，但在高保真分割所需的精确边缘感知方面仍面临困难。本文分析了DINO的内部表示，发现其固有的边界感知能力在特征进入更深层的Transformer模块时会发生渐进衰减。为此，提出OVS-DINO框架，通过结构对齐SAM来复兴DINO的潜在边缘敏感性。具体而言，引入结构感知编码器(SAE)和结构调制解码器(SMD)利用SAM的结构先验有效激活DINO的边界特征，并采用利用SAM生成的伪掩码的监督策略。大量实验表明，该方法在多个弱监督OVS基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，平均得分提高了2.1%。值得注意的是，该方法显著提高了复杂、杂乱场景下的分割精度，在Cityscapes数据集上提高了6.3%。

Abstract

Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) aims to segment image regions beyond predefined category sets by leveraging semantic descriptions. While CLIP based approaches excel in semantic generalization, they frequently lack the fine-grained spatial awareness required for dense prediction. Recent efforts have incorporated Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) like DINO to alleviate these limitations. However, these methods still struggle with the precise edge perception necessary for high fidelity segmentation. In this paper, we analyze internal representations of DINO and discover that its inherent boundary awareness is not absent but rather undergoes progressive attenuation as features transition into deeper transformer blocks. To address this, we propose OVS-DINO, a novel framework that revitalizes latent edge-sensitivity of DINO through structural alignment with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). Specifically, we introduce a Structure-Aware Encoder (SAE) and a Structure-Modulated Decoder (SMD) to effectively activate boundary features of DINO using SAM's structural priors, complemented by a supervision strategy utilizing SAM generated pseudo-masks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple weakly-supervised OVS benchmarks, improving the average score by 2.1% (from 44.8% to 46.9%). Notably, our approach significantly enhances segmentation accuracy in complex, cluttered scenarios, with a gain of 6.3% on Cityscapes (from 36.6% to 42.9%).

item.title: Faithful GRPO: Improving Visual Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models via Constrained Policy Optimization
item.author: Sai Srinivas Kancheti, Aditya Kanade, Rohit Sinha, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Tanuja Ganu
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了一种名为FGRPO的方法，通过约束逻辑一致性和视觉基础性来提升多模态推理模型的推理质量，显著减少了推理不一致性并提高了最终答案的准确性。

背景: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练的多模态推理模型在视觉推理基准测试中显示出准确性的提升，但往往以推理质量为代价，生成的思维链与最终答案不一致且缺乏视觉证据支持。

目的: 系统研究多模态推理模型中思维链推理质量的问题，并提出一种名为FGRPO的方法来改善推理质量，确保推理过程与最终答案一致且基于视觉证据。

方法: 提出Faithful GRPO（FGRPO），一种GRPO的变体，通过拉格朗日对偶上升法将一致性和基础性作为约束条件纳入优势计算中，并在优化过程中自适应调整约束的相对重要性。

主要发现: 在七个空间数据集上评估FGRPO，发现推理不一致性率从24.5%降至1.7%，视觉基础性得分提高了13%，且最终答案准确性优于简单的GRPO。

结论: FGRPO显著提高了推理质量，证明了忠实推理能够带来更好的答案，验证了该方法的有效性。

翻译: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练的多模态推理模型在视觉推理基准测试中显示出准确性的提升，但往往以推理质量为代价，生成的思维链与最终答案不一致且缺乏视觉证据支持。研究系统分析了这一现象，并提出了Faithful GRPO方法，通过约束逻辑一致性和视觉基础性来提升推理质量。实验表明，FGRPO显著减少了推理不一致性，提高了视觉基础性得分，并改善了最终答案的准确性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决多模态推理模型在训练中为了提高准确率而牺牲推理质量的问题，具体表现为生成的思维链与最终答案不一致，且缺乏对视觉证据的准确描述。这个问题很重要，因为模型如果只追求正确答案而忽略了推理过程，可能会利用捷径或偏差来“作弊”，导致生成的推理过程不可信，无法应用于需要可靠逻辑和视觉理解的现实场景。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到标准强化学习方法虽然提高了准确率，但往往导致推理质量下降（如逻辑不一致或缺乏视觉依据）。他们借鉴了约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）和拉格朗日松弛技术，将推理质量视为硬约束而非奖励项，通过拉格朗日对偶上升法来优化策略。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将推理质量视为必须满足的硬约束，而非奖励项，通过拉格朗日对偶上升法在优化中强制执行这些约束。整体流程分为两阶段：首先在思维链数据上进行监督微调，然后利用强化学习训练，通过定义一致性奖励和依据奖励，在最大化答案准确率的同时，确保推理过程符合视觉证据和逻辑要求。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的主要创新点在于提出了Faithful GRPO（FGRPO）方法，将逻辑一致性和视觉基础性作为硬约束而非奖励项。与之前的工作不同，传统方法通常在提高准确率的同时牺牲推理质量，而FGRPO通过拉格朗日对偶上升确保推理质量必须满足最低标准，从而同时提升准确率和推理质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为 Faithful GRPO 的新方法，通过将推理的一致性和视觉依据作为硬约束而非奖励项，解决了多模态模型在视觉推理中“答案正确但推理过程不可信”的问题，从而在提升推理质量的同时也提高了最终答案的准确率。

Abstract

Multimodal reasoning models (MRMs) trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) show improved accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. However, we observe that accuracy gains often come at the cost of reasoning quality: generated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces are frequently inconsistent with the final answer and poorly grounded in the visual evidence. We systematically study this phenomenon across seven challenging real-world spatial reasoning benchmarks and find that it affects contemporary MRMs such as ViGoRL-Spatial, TreeVGR as well as our own models trained with standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We characterize CoT reasoning quality along two complementary axes: "logical consistency" (does the CoT entail the final answer?) and "visual grounding" (does each reasoning step accurately describe objects, attributes, and spatial relationships in the image?). To address this, we propose Faithful GRPO (FGRPO), a variant of GRPO that enforces consistency and grounding as constraints via Lagrangian dual ascent. FGRPO incorporates batch-level consistency and grounding constraints into the advantage computation within a group, adaptively adjusting the relative importance of constraints during optimization. We evaluate FGRPO on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 3B backbones across seven spatial datasets. Our results show that FGRPO substantially improves reasoning quality, reducing the inconsistency rate from 24.5% to 1.7% and improving visual grounding scores by +13%. It also improves final answer accuracy over simple GRPO, demonstrating that faithful reasoning enables better answers.

item.title: The Impact of Dimensionality on the Stability of Node Embeddings
item.author: Tobias Schumacher, Simon Reichelt, Markus Strohmaier
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究节点嵌入维度对稳定性和下游性能的影响

背景: 先前工作已表明神经网络节点嵌入在相同参数和数据集上因不同训练种子而产生不同结果，但关键超参数如嵌入维度如何影响这种不稳定性尚未得到充分分析

目的: 调查节点嵌入维度的变化如何影响其稳定性和下游性能

方法: 系统评估了五种广泛使用的方法（ASNE、DGI、GraphSAGE、node2vec 和 VERSE）在多个数据集和嵌入维度上的表现，从表示和功能角度评估稳定性，并进行性能评估

主要发现: 嵌入稳定性随维度显著变化，但不同方法表现出不同模式；某些方法（如 node2vec 和 ASNE）随维度增加变得更稳定，而其他方法不呈现相同趋势；最大稳定性不一定与最佳任务性能一致

结论: 强调了仔细选择嵌入维度的重要性，并提供了关于图表示学习中稳定性、性能和计算有效性之间权衡的新见解

翻译: 先前工作已表明神经网络节点嵌入在相同参数和数据集上因不同训练种子而产生不同结果，但关键超参数如嵌入维度如何影响这种不稳定性尚未得到充分分析。在这项工作中，我们调查节点嵌入维度的变化如何影响其稳定性和下游性能。我们在多个数据集和嵌入维度上系统评估了五种广泛使用的方法——ASNE、DGI、GraphSAGE、node2vec 和 VERSE。我们从表示和功能角度评估稳定性，同时进行性能评估。我们的结果表明嵌入稳定性随维度显著变化，但我们观察到所考虑的方法之间存在不同模式：虽然某些方法如 node2vec 和 ASNE 随维度增加变得更稳定，但其他方法不呈现相同趋势。此外，我们发现最大稳定性不一定与最佳任务性能一致。这些发现强调了仔细选择嵌入维度的重要性，并提供了关于图表示学习中稳定性、性能和计算有效性之间权衡的新见解。

Abstract

Previous work has established that neural network-based node embeddings return different outcomes when trained with identical parameters on the same dataset, just from using different training seeds. Yet, it has not been thoroughly analyzed how key hyperparameters such as embedding dimension could impact this instability. In this work, we investigate how varying the dimensionality of node embeddings influences both their stability and downstream performance. We systematically evaluate five widely used methods -- ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, and VERSE -- across multiple datasets and embedding dimensions. We assess stability from both a representational perspective and a functional perspective, alongside performance evaluation. Our results show that embedding stability varies significantly with dimensionality, but we observe different patterns across the methods we consider: while some approaches, such as node2vec and ASNE, tend to become more stable with higher dimensionality, other methods do not exhibit the same trend. Moreover, we find that maximum stability does not necessarily align with optimal task performance. These findings highlight the importance of carefully selecting embedding dimension, and provide new insights into the trade-offs between stability, performance, and computational effectiveness in graph representation learning.

item.title: What They Saw, Not Just Where They Looked: Semantic Scanpath Similarity via VLMs and NLP metric
item.author: Mohamed Amine Kerkouri, Marouane Tliba, Bin Wang, Aladine Chetouani, Ulas Bagci, Alessandro Bruno
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种将视觉语言模型整合到眼动追踪分析中的语义注视点相似性框架，通过将注视点编码为文本描述并计算语义相似性，以补充传统的空间对齐评估。

背景: 现有的注视点相似性指标主要评估空间和时间对齐，而忽视了被注视图像区域之间的语义等价性。

目的: 构建一个语义注视点相似性框架，将视觉语言模型引入眼动追踪分析，以捕捉语义相似性。

方法: 采用基于补丁和标记的策略在受控视觉背景下对每个注视点进行编码，将其转换为简短的文本描述并聚合为注视点级表示；使用基于嵌入和词汇的自然语言处理指标计算语义相似性；并与多匹配和多维时间规整等空间度量进行比较。

主要发现: 在自由观看眼动追踪数据上的实验表明，语义相似性捕捉到了与几何对齐部分独立的方差；即使在空间上存在分歧的情况下，也能揭示出高内容一致性的情况；分析了上下文编码对描述保真度和指标稳定性的影响。

结论: 多模态基础模型使得经典注视点分析的可解释、内容感知扩展成为可能，为ETRA社区内的注视研究提供了补充维度。

翻译: 注视点相似性指标是眼动追踪研究的核心，然而现有方法主要评估空间和时间对齐，而忽视了被注视图像区域之间的语义等价性。我们提出了一种语义注视点相似性框架，将视觉语言模型整合到眼动追踪分析中。在每个注视点在受控视觉背景下（基于补丁和标记策略）进行编码，并转换为简短的文本描述，然后聚合为注视点级表示。然后使用基于嵌入和词汇的自然语言处理指标计算语义相似性，并与多匹配和DTW等既定的空间度量进行比较。在自由观看眼动追踪数据上的实验表明，语义相似性捕捉到了与几何对齐部分独立的方差，揭示了即使在空间上存在分歧的情况下也存在高内容一致性的情况。我们进一步分析了上下文编码对描述保真度和指标稳定性的影响。我们的发现表明，多模态基础模型使得经典注视点分析的可解释、内容感知扩展成为可能，为ETRA社区内的注视研究提供了补充维度。

Abstract

Scanpath similarity metrics are central to eye-movement research, yet existing methods predominantly evaluate spatial and temporal alignment while neglecting semantic equivalence between attended image regions. We present a semantic scanpath similarity framework that integrates vision-language models (VLMs) into eye-tracking analysis. Each fixation is encoded under controlled visual context (patch-based and marker-based strategies) and transformed into concise textual descriptions, which are aggregated into scanpath-level representations. Semantic similarity is then computed using embedding-based and lexical NLP metrics and compared against established spatial measures, including MultiMatch and DTW. Experiments on free-viewing eye-tracking data demonstrate that semantic similarity captures partially independent variance from geometric alignment, revealing cases of high content agreement despite spatial divergence. We further analyze the impact of contextual encoding on description fidelity and metric stability. Our findings suggest that multimodal foundation models enable interpretable, content-aware extensions of classical scanpath analysis, providing a complementary dimension for gaze research within the ETRA community.

item.title: Quantifying Explanation Consistency: The C-Score Metric for CAM-Based Explainability in Medical Image Classification
item.author: Kabilan Elangovan, Daniel Ting
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为C-Score的新指标，用于评估深度学习分类器在医学影像中生成的可视化解释的一致性，而非仅评估其定位的准确性。研究通过在Kermany胸部X光数据集上评估多种CAM技术，发现了三种导致AUC一致性分离的机制，并指出C-Score能作为模型不稳定的早期预警信号。

背景: 现有的CAM方法评估框架主要关注解释是否正确，即与放射科医生标注的定位保真度，而忽略了模型在不同患者间应用相同空间推理策略的一致性。

目的: 提出C-Score（一致性得分），这是一种置信度加权、无标注的指标，用于量化同类解释的可重复性。

方法: 在Kermany胸部X光数据集上，针对DenseNet201、InceptionV3和ResNet50V2三种CNN架构，对GradCAM、GradCAM++、LayerCAM、EigenCAM、ScoreCAM和MS GradCAM++六种CAM技术进行了三十个训练周期的评估，涵盖迁移学习和微调阶段。

主要发现: 识别出三种导致AUC一致性分离的机制：阈值介导的金标准列表崩溃、特定技术在峰值AUC处的归因崩溃，以及全局聚合中的类级一致性掩盖。C-Score能检测到ResNet50V2上ScoreCAM的恶化，并在灾难性AUC崩溃前一个检查点发出预警。

结论: C-Score提供了模型不稳定的早期预警信号，能够基于解释质量而非仅基于预测排名，为特定架构的临床部署提供架构特定的临床部署建议。

翻译: Class Activation Mapping (CAM) 方法广泛用于为深度学习分类器在医学影像中生成可视化解释。然而，现有的评估框架评估解释是否正确，通过定位保真度与放射科医生标注进行比较，而不是评估一致性：即模型是否在具有相同病理的不同患者之间应用相同的空间推理策略。我们提出了C-Score（一致性得分），这是一种置信度加权、无标注的指标，通过正确分类实例之间的强调强度的成对软IoU来量化同类解释的可重复性。我们在Kermany胸部X光数据集上，针对三种CNN架构（DenseNet201、InceptionV3、ResNet50V2），在三十个训练周期上评估了六种CAM技术：GradCAM、GradCAM++、LayerCAM、EigenCAM、ScoreCAM和MS GradCAM++，涵盖了迁移学习和微调阶段。我们识别出三种AUC一致性分离的不同机制，这些机制对标准分类指标是不可见的：阈值介导的金标准列表崩溃、峰值AUC处的特定技术归因崩溃，以及全局聚合中的类级一致性掩盖。C-Score提供了即将来临的模型不稳定的早期预警信号。ResNet50V2上ScoreCAM的恶化可以在灾难性AUC崩溃前一个完整的检查点被检测到，并产生基于解释质量的架构特定的临床部署建议，而不仅仅是基于预测排名。

Abstract

Class Activation Mapping (CAM) methods are widely used to generate visual explanations for deep learning classifiers in medical imaging. However, existing evaluation frameworks assess whether explanations are correct, measured by localisation fidelity against radiologist annotations, rather than whether they are consistent: whether the model applies the same spatial reasoning strategy across different patients with the same pathology. We propose the C-Score (Consistency Score), a confidence-weighted, annotation-free metric that quantifies intra-class explanation reproducibility via intensity-emphasised pairwise soft IoU across correctly classified instances. We evaluate six CAM techniques: GradCAM, GradCAM++, LayerCAM, EigenCAM, ScoreCAM, and MS GradCAM++ across three CNN architectures (DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ResNet50V2) over thirty training epochs on the Kermany chest X-ray dataset, covering transfer learning and fine-tuning phases. We identify three distinct mechanisms of AUC-consistency dissociation, invisible to standard classification metrics: threshold-mediated gold list collapse, technique-specific attribution collapse at peak AUC, and class-level consistency masking in global aggregation. C-Score provides an early warning signal of impending model instability. ScoreCAM deterioration on ResNet50V2 is detectable one full checkpoint before catastrophic AUC collapse and yields architecture-specific clinical deployment recommendations grounded in explanation quality rather than predictive ranking alone.

item.title: Phantom: Physics-Infused Video Generation via Joint Modeling of Visual and Latent Physical Dynamics
item.author: Ying Shen, Jerry Xiong, Tianjiao Yu, Ismini Lourentzou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为Phantom的物理感知视频生成模型，该模型通过联合建模视觉内容和潜在物理动力学，在保持视觉真实性的同时提高了物理一致性。

背景: 尽管大规模数据集和强大架构使生成视频具有高度视觉真实感，但现有方法往往缺乏对现实世界物理定律的理解，导致生成的视频在物理一致性上存在缺陷。

目的: 研究将潜在物理属性的推断直接整合到视频生成过程中，是否能赋予模型产生物理合理视频的能力。

方法: 提出Phantom模型，该模型联合建模视觉内容和潜在物理动力学。在观察到的视频帧和推断的物理状态条件下，Phantom联合预测潜在物理动力学并生成未来视频帧。模型利用物理感知的视频表示作为底层物理的抽象但信息丰富的嵌入，无需显式指定复杂的物理动力学和属性集合即可实现联合预测。

主要发现: 在标准视频生成和物理感知基准测试上的定量和定性结果表明，Phantom不仅在遵循物理动力学方面优于现有方法，还提供了具有竞争力的感知保真度。

结论: 通过将物理感知视频表示的推断直接整合到视频生成过程中，Phantom能够生成既视觉真实又物理一致的视频序列。

翻译: 最近，在大型数据集和强大架构的推动下，生成视频建模取得了显著进展，产生了高度视觉真实感。然而，新兴证据表明，仅仅扩展数据和模型规模并不能赋予这些系统理解支配现实世界动态的底层物理定律的能力。现有方法往往无法捕捉或强制执行这种物理一致性，导致不真实的运动和动力学。在这项工作中，我们研究将潜在物理属性的推断直接整合到视频生成过程中，是否能赋予模型产生物理合理视频的能力。为此，我们提出了Phantom，一个物理融合视频生成模型，它联合建模视觉内容和潜在物理动力学。在观察到的视频帧和推断的物理状态的条件下，Phantom联合预测潜在物理动力学并生成未来视频帧。Phantom利用物理感知的视频表示，作为底层物理的抽象但信息丰富的嵌入，促进了物理动力学与视频内容的联合预测，而无需显式指定复杂的物理动力学和属性集合。通过将物理感知视频表示的推断直接整合到视频生成过程中，Phantom生成了既视觉真实又物理一致的视频序列。在标准视频生成和物理感知基准测试上的定量和定性结果表明，Phantom不仅在遵循物理动力学方面优于现有方法，还提供了具有竞争力的感知保真度。

Abstract

Recent advances in generative video modeling, driven by large-scale datasets and powerful architectures, have yielded remarkable visual realism. However, emerging evidence suggests that simply scaling data and model size does not endow these systems with an understanding of the underlying physical laws that govern real-world dynamics. Existing approaches often fail to capture or enforce such physical consistency, resulting in unrealistic motion and dynamics. In his work, we investigate whether integrating the inference of latent physical properties directly into the video generation process can equip models with the ability to produce physically plausible videos. To this end, we propose Phantom, a Physics-Infused Video Generation model that jointly models the visual content and latent physical dynamics. Conditioned on observed video frames and inferred physical states, Phantom jointly predicts latent physical dynamics and generates future video frames. Phantom leverages a physics-aware video representation that serves as an abstract yet informaive embedding of the underlying physics, facilitating the joint prediction of physical dynamics alongside video content without requiring an explicit specification of a complex set of physical dynamics and properties. By integrating the inference of physical-aware video representation directly into the video generation process, Phantom produces video sequences that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. Quantitative and qualitative results on both standard video generation and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate that Phantom not only outperforms existing methods in terms of adherence to physical dynamics but also delivers competitive perceptual fidelity.

item.title: When Fine-Tuning Changes the Evidence: Architecture-Dependent Semantic Drift in Chest X-Ray Explanations
item.author: Kabilan Elangovan, Daniel Ting
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了医学图像分类中迁移学习后微调过程中语义漂移的问题，指出在多类别设置下，分类准确率的提升并不保证视觉证据支持的稳定性。

背景: 迁移学习后微调在医学图像分类中被广泛采用，以获得一致的诊断性能提升。然而，在具有重叠视觉特征的多类别设置中，准确率的提高并不保证支持预测的视觉证据的稳定性。

目的: 定义语义漂移，即模型预测的归因结构在迁移学习和完全微调之间发生的系统性变化，反映底层视觉推理的潜在转变，尽管分类性能保持稳定。

方法: 使用五类胸部X光任务，评估DenseNet201、ResNet50V2和InceptionV3在两阶段训练协议下的表现，并使用参考无关指标量化归因图的空间定位和结构一致性的漂移。

主要发现: 跨架构分析显示，粗略的解剖定位保持稳定，而重叠IoU揭示了架构依赖的归因结构显著重组。在收敛的预测性能下，不同架构间的稳定性排名在LayerCAM和GradCAM++之间可能反转。

结论: 解释稳定性是架构、优化阶段和归因目标之间相互作用的结果。

翻译: 该研究探讨了医学图像分类中迁移学习后微调过程中语义漂移的问题，指出在多类别设置下，分类准确率的提升并不保证视觉证据支持的稳定性。

Abstract

Transfer learning followed by fine-tuning is widely adopted in medical image classification due to consistent gains in diagnostic performance. However, in multi-class settings with overlapping visual features, improvements in accuracy do not guarantee stability of the visual evidence used to support predictions. We define semantic drift as systematic changes in the attribution structure supporting a model's predictions between transfer learning and full fine-tuning, reflecting potential shifts in underlying visual reasoning despite stable classification performance. Using a five-class chest X-ray task, we evaluate DenseNet201, ResNet50V2, and InceptionV3 under a two-stage training protocol and quantify drift with reference-free metrics capturing spatial localization and structural consistency of attribution maps. Across architectures, coarse anatomical localization remains stable, while overlap IoU reveals pronounced architecture-dependent reorganization of evidential structure. Beyond single-method analysis, stability rankings can reverse across LayerCAM and GradCAM++ under converged predictive performance, establishing explanation stability as an interaction between architecture, optimization phase, and attribution objective.

item.title: MolmoWeb: Open Visual Web Agent and Open Data for the Open Web
item.author: Tanmay Gupta, Piper Wolters, Zixian Ma, Peter Sushko, Rock Yuren Pang, Diego Llanes, Yue Yang, Taira Anderson, Boyuan Zheng, Zhongzheng Ren, Harsh Trivedi, Taylor Blanton, Caleb Ouellette, Winson Han, Ali Farhadi, Ranjay Krishna
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了MolmoWeb系列完全开放的网页代理模型，该模型在浏览器使用基准测试中表现出色，超越了类似规模的开放权重模型，并展示了通过测试时扩展获得持续性能提升的能力。

背景: 当前的网页代理主要依赖未公开训练数据和配方的高性能专有模型，限制了科学理解、可重复性和社区驱动的进步。

目的: 为了构建开放网络的代理，作者介绍了MolmoWebMix数据集和MolmoWeb代理家族，旨在促进科学理解和社区研究。

方法: MolmoWebMix结合了超过10万个合成任务轨迹和3万多个人类演示、原子网页技能轨迹及GUI感知数据。MolmoWeb代理作为指令条件化的视觉语言动作策略，根据任务指令和网页截图预测下一个浏览器动作，无需访问HTML、可访问性树或专用API。

主要发现: MolmoWeb代理在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和DeepShop等基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，超越了Fara-7B、UI-Tars-1.5-7B和Holo1-7B等模型。MolmoWeb-8B甚至超过了基于GPT-4o等大型封闭前沿模型构建的SoM代理。通过最佳选择策略，在WebVoyager和Online-Mind2Web上分别实现了94.7%和60.5%的pass@4，显著高于pass@1的78.2%和35.3%。

结论: 作者将发布模型检查点、训练数据、代码和统一评估工具，以实现可重复性并加速开放网络代理的研究。

翻译: Web agents--autonomous systems that navigate and execute tasks on the web on behalf of users--have the potential to transform how people interact with the digital world. However, the most capable web agents today rely on proprietary models with undisclosed training data and recipes, limiting scientific understanding, reproducibility, and community-driven progress. We believe agents for the open web should be built in the open. To this end, we introduce (1) MolmoWebMix, a large and diverse mixture of browser task demonstrations and web-GUI perception data and (2) MolmoWeb, a family of fully open multimodal web agents. Specifically, MolmoWebMix combines over 100K synthetic task trajectories from multiple complementary generation pipelines with 30K+ human demonstrations, atomic web-skill trajectories, and GUI perception data, including referring expression grounding and screenshot question answering. MolmoWeb agents operate as instruction-conditioned visual-language action policies: given a task instruction and a webpage screenshot, they predict the next browser action, requiring no access to HTML, accessibility trees, or specialized APIs. Available in 4B and 8B size, on browser-use benchmarks like WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and DeepShop, MolmoWeb agents achieve state-of-the-art results outperforming similar scale open-weight-only models such as Fara-7B, UI-Tars-1.5-7B, and Holo1-7B. MolmoWeb-8B also surpasses set-of-marks (SoM) agents built on much larger closed frontier models like GPT-4o. We further demonstrate consistent gains through test-time scaling via parallel rollouts with best-of-N selection, achieving 94.7% and 60.5% pass@4 (compared to 78.2% and 35.3% pass@1) on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web respectively. We will release model checkpoints, training data, code, and a unified evaluation harness to enable reproducibility and accelerate open research on web agents.

Abstract

Web agents--autonomous systems that navigate and execute tasks on the web on behalf of users--have the potential to transform how people interact with the digital world. However, the most capable web agents today rely on proprietary models with undisclosed training data and recipes, limiting scientific understanding, reproducibility, and community-driven progress. We believe agents for the open web should be built in the open. To this end, we introduce (1) MolmoWebMix, a large and diverse mixture of browser task demonstrations and web-GUI perception data and (2) MolmoWeb, a family of fully open multimodal web agents. Specifically, MolmoWebMix combines over 100K synthetic task trajectories from multiple complementary generation pipelines with 30K+ human demonstrations, atomic web-skill trajectories, and GUI perception data, including referring expression grounding and screenshot question answering. MolmoWeb agents operate as instruction-conditioned visual-language action policies: given a task instruction and a webpage screenshot, they predict the next browser action, requiring no access to HTML, accessibility trees, or specialized APIs. Available in 4B and 8B size, on browser-use benchmarks like WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and DeepShop, MolmoWeb agents achieve state-of-the-art results outperforming similar scale open-weight-only models such as Fara-7B, UI-Tars-1.5-7B, and Holo1-7B. MolmoWeb-8B also surpasses set-of-marks (SoM) agents built on much larger closed frontier models like GPT-4o. We further demonstrate consistent gains through test-time scaling via parallel rollouts with best-of-N selection, achieving 94.7% and 60.5% pass@4 (compared to 78.2% and 35.3% pass@1) on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web respectively. We will release model checkpoints, training data, code, and a unified evaluation harness to enable reproducibility and accelerate open research on web agents.

item.title: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding
item.author: Joungbin An, Agrim Jain, Kristen Grauman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UniversalVTG 是一种单一的视频时间定位模型，通过大规模跨数据集预训练实现，旨在解决现有模型在跨域和查询风格上的局限性。

背景: 视频时间定位（VTG）任务通常依赖于特定数据集的模型，导致跨域和查询风格迁移能力差。虽然大型多模态语言模型（MLLMs）被引入以克服这一限制，但它们计算成本高且视频上下文有限，难以处理长视频。

目的: 提出一种轻量级且可扩展的统一监督方法，以克服现有方法的计算成本高和视频上下文有限的限制。

方法: UniversalVTG 采用离线查询统一器将异构查询格式标准化为共享的声明性空间，以减少语言不匹配和防止负迁移，并结合高效的定位头以处理长且未修剪的视频。

主要发现: 在 GoalStep-StepGrounding、Ego4D-NLQ、TACoS、Charades-STA 和 ActivityNet-Captions 等多个基准测试中，UniversalVTG 检查点实现了最先进的性能。

结论: 尽管 UniversalVTG 比最近的 MLLM 基于方法小 100 倍以上，但在多个基准测试中匹配或超过了它们的准确性，为参数繁重的 MLLMs 提供了一种实用的替代方案。

翻译: UniversalVTG 是一种单一的视频时间定位模型，通过大规模跨数据集预训练实现，旨在解决现有模型在跨域和查询风格上的局限性。视频时间定位（VTG）任务通常依赖于特定数据集的模型，导致跨域和查询风格迁移能力差。虽然大型多模态语言模型（MLLMs）被引入以克服这一限制，但它们计算成本高且视频上下文有限，难以处理长视频。提出一种轻量级且可扩展的统一监督方法，以克服现有方法的计算成本高和视频上下文有限的限制。UniversalVTG 采用离线查询统一器将异构查询格式标准化为共享的声明性空间，以减少语言不匹配和防止负迁移，并结合高效的定位头以处理长且未修剪的视频。在 GoalStep-StepGrounding、Ego4D-NLQ、TACoS、Charades-STA 和 ActivityNet-Captions 等多个基准测试中，UniversalVTG 检查点实现了最先进的性能。尽管 UniversalVTG 比最近的 MLLM 基于方法小 100 倍以上，但在多个基准测试中匹配或超过了它们的准确性，为参数繁重的 MLLMs 提供了一种实用的替代方案。

Abstract

Video temporal grounding (VTG) is typically tackled with dataset-specific models that transfer poorly across domains and query styles. Recent efforts to overcome this limitation have adapted large multimodal language models (MLLMs) to VTG, but their high compute cost and limited video context still hinder long-video grounding. We instead scale unified supervision while keeping the model lightweight. We present UniversalVTG, a single VTG model trained with large-scale cross-dataset pretraining. An offline Query Unifier canonicalizes heterogeneous query formats into a shared declarative space, reducing linguistic mismatch and preventing the negative transfer observed under naïve joint training. Combined with an efficient grounding head, UniversalVTG scales to long, untrimmed videos. Across diverse benchmarks-GoalStep-StepGrounding, Ego4D-NLQ, TACoS, Charades-STA, and ActivityNet-Captions-one UniversalVTG checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art performance versus dedicated VTG models. Moreover, despite being $>100\times$ smaller than recent MLLM-based approaches, UniversalVTG matches or exceeds their accuracy on multiple benchmarks, offering a practical alternative to parameter-heavy MLLMs.

item.title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
item.author: Yuxuan Zhang, Yubo Wang, Yipeng Zhu, Penghui Du, Junwen Miao, Xuan Lu, Wendong Xu, Yunzhuo Hao, Songcheng Cai, Xiaochen Wang, Huaisong Zhang, Xian Wu, Yi Lu, Minyi Lei, Kai Zou, Huifeng Yin, Ping Nie, Liang Chen, Dongfu Jiang, Wenhu Chen, Kelsey R. Allen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了 ClawBench 评估框架，用于测试 AI 代理在处理日常在线任务方面的能力。

背景: 现有 AI 代理主要关注自动化收件箱，但日常在线任务是一个现实的测试床，用于评估下一代 AI 代理。

目的: 介绍 ClawBench 评估框架，以评估 AI 代理在处理 153 个日常任务方面的能力。

方法: ClawBench 包含 15 个类别、144 个实时平台上的 153 个简单任务，要求代理具备超越现有基准的能力，如从用户文档中获取信息、跨平台导航和多步骤工作流。评估在实时网站上进行，使用轻量级拦截层捕获并阻止最终提交请求，确保安全评估。

主要发现: 对 7 个前沿模型的评估显示，专有和开源模型只能完成这些任务的一小部分，例如 Claude Sonnet 4.6 仅完成 33.3%。

结论: 在 ClawBench 上的进展使我们更接近能够作为可靠通用助手发挥作用的 AI 代理。

翻译: AI 代理可能能够自动化你的收件箱，但它们能否自动化你生活中的其他常规方面？日常在线任务为评估下一代 AI 代理提供了一个现实且未解决的测试床。为此，我们介绍了 ClawBench，这是一个包含 153 个简单任务的评估框架，这些任务是人们在生活和工作中需要定期完成的，涵盖了 15 个类别中的 144 个实时平台，从完成购买和预订预约到提交求职申请。这些任务需要超越现有基准的苛刻能力，例如从用户提供的文档中获取相关信息、跨不同平台导航多步骤工作流，以及像正确填写许多详细表单这样的重度写作操作。与在静态页面的离线沙箱中评估代理的现有基准不同，ClawBench 在生产网站上运行，保留了现实世界网络交互的完整复杂性、动态性和挑战。轻量级拦截层捕获并仅阻止最终提交请求，确保安全评估，没有现实世界的副作用。我们对 7 个前沿模型的评估显示，专有和开源模型只能完成这些任务的一小部分。例如，Claude Sonnet 4.6 仅达到 33.3%。在 ClawBench 上的进展使我们更接近能够作为可靠通用助手发挥作用的 AI 代理。

Abstract

AI agents may be able to automate your inbox, but can they automate other routine aspects of your life? Everyday online tasks offer a realistic yet unsolved testbed for evaluating the next generation of AI agents. To this end, we introduce ClawBench, an evaluation framework of 153 simple tasks that people need to accomplish regularly in their lives and work, spanning 144 live platforms across 15 categories, from completing purchases and booking appointments to submitting job applications. These tasks require demanding capabilities beyond existing benchmarks, such as obtaining relevant information from user-provided documents, navigating multi-step workflows across diverse platforms, and write-heavy operations like filling in many detailed forms correctly. Unlike existing benchmarks that evaluate agents in offline sandboxes with static pages, ClawBench operates on production websites, preserving the full complexity, dynamic nature, and challenges of real-world web interaction. A lightweight interception layer captures and blocks only the final submission request, ensuring safe evaluation without real-world side effects. Our evaluations of 7 frontier models show that both proprietary and open-source models can complete only a small portion of these tasks. For example, Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves only 33.3%. Progress on ClawBench brings us closer to AI agents that can function as reliable general-purpose assistants.

item.title: FIT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Fit-Aware Virtual Try-On
item.author: Johanna Karras, Yuanhao Wang, Yingwei Li, Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FIT的新型虚拟试穿数据集及模型，旨在解决现有方法在服装合身度准确性上的不足，通过合成数据生成和重纹理技术实现了对过大或过小服装的逼真试穿效果。

背景: 现有虚拟试穿方法虽然能可视化服装外观，但往往忽略了服装合身度这一关键体验要素，且缺乏包含精确尺寸信息的“不合身”数据集，导致模型默认生成合身结果。

目的: 解决虚拟试穿中服装合身度准确性这一开放问题，通过构建包含精确身体和服装测量数据的大规模数据集，训练出能够感知服装合身度的试穿模型。

方法: 1. 采用可扩展的合成策略：使用GarmentCode生成3D服装并通过物理模拟模拟服装合身；2. 引入新颖的重纹理框架将合成渲染转化为逼真图像并严格保留几何结构；3. 在重纹理模型中引入人物身份保持机制以生成配对图像；4. 利用FIT数据集训练基线合身感知虚拟试穿模型。

主要发现: FIT数据集和训练出的模型在合身感知虚拟试穿任务上达到了新的最先进水平，并为未来研究提供了稳健的基准。

结论: 通过合成数据生成和重纹理技术，本文成功构建了FIT数据集并训练出能够准确展示服装在不同体型上合身度的模型，为虚拟试穿领域提供了新的突破。

翻译: 给定一个人和一件服装图像，虚拟试穿旨在合成该人穿着服装的真实图像，同时保留其原始姿势和身份。虽然最近的VTO方法擅长可视化服装外观，但它们在很大程度上忽略了试穿体验的一个关键方面：服装合身的准确性——例如，描绘一件特大号衬衫穿在一个特小号人身上的样子。一个关键障碍是缺乏提供精确服装和身体尺寸信息的数据集，特别是对于“不合身”情况，即服装明显过大或过小。因此，当前的VTO方法默认生成合身的结果，无论服装或人的尺寸如何。在本文中，我们迈出了解决这一开放问题的第一步。我们介绍了FIT（Fit-Inclusive Try-on），这是一个大规模的VTO数据集，包含超过113万试穿图像三元组，并附有精确的身体和服装测量数据。我们通过可扩展的合成策略克服了数据收集的挑战：（1）我们使用GarmentCode程序化生成3D服装，并通过物理模拟将其挂起以捕捉逼真的服装合身。（2）我们采用新颖的重纹理框架将合成渲染转化为逼真图像，同时严格保留几何结构。（3）我们将人物身份保持引入我们的重纹理模型，以生成配对的人物图像（同一个人，不同的服装）以进行监督训练。最后，我们利用我们的FIT数据集训练了一个基线合身感知虚拟试穿模型。我们的数据和结果在合身感知虚拟试穿方面设定了新的最先进水平，并为未来的研究提供了稳健的基准。我们将在我们的项目页面上公开所有数据和代码：https://johannakarras.github.io/FIT。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有虚拟试穿技术忽略服装尺寸与人体尺寸匹配的问题，即无法准确模拟衣服穿在不同体型人身上的“合身度”。这在现实中非常重要，因为用户无法通过现有工具准确预判衣服的实际穿着效果，限制了在线购物体验的真实性和可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有虚拟试穿方法忽略了服装的合身度，因此设计了 FIT 数据集。他们借鉴了 GarmentCode 工具来生成带有精确尺寸的 3D 服装模型，并通过物理模拟捕捉真实的褶皱和拉伸效果。为了解决合成图像缺乏真实感的问题，他们利用 Flux.1-dev 模型将合成渲染转换为照片级真实图像，同时严格保留几何形状。此外，他们还参考了 VLM 模型来生成平铺的服装图像。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是解决现有虚拟试穿技术忽略服装合身度的问题，通过构建包含精确尺寸标注的大规模数据集，训练能够根据人体和服装尺寸准确模拟服装穿着效果（如过大或过小）的模型。整体实现流程包括：首先利用 GarmentCode 程序化生成 3D 服装，并通过物理模拟将其挂在不同尺寸的人体上以获取真实的合身度；接着通过重纹理框架将合成图像转换为照片级逼真图像；最后利用身份条件生成成对的人体图像，并使用 VLM 生成平铺服装图像。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了首个大规模的“合身感知”虚拟试穿数据集 FIT，包含超过 113 万张带有精确身体和服装尺寸标注的图片。此外，他们开发了一套可扩展的合成数据生成流程，利用物理模拟生成逼真的 3D 服装悬垂效果，并通过重纹理技术将合成图像转化为照片级真实图像，同时生成成对的人像数据以辅助训练。相比之前的工作，现有 VTO 数据集大多缺乏“不合身”的案例和精确尺寸信息，且合成数据往往缺乏真实感；而该论文通过程序化生成和物理模拟，解决了数据稀缺和真实感不足的问题，提供了可控且真实的成对训练数据。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文构建了包含精确尺寸标注的大规模数据集，并开发了合成数据生成流程与合身感知模型，以解决现有虚拟试穿忽视服装合身度的问题。

Abstract

Given a person and a garment image, virtual try-on (VTO) aims to synthesize a realistic image of the person wearing the garment, while preserving their original pose and identity. Although recent VTO methods excel at visualizing garment appearance, they largely overlook a crucial aspect of the try-on experience: the accuracy of garment fit -- for example, depicting how an extra-large shirt looks on an extra-small person. A key obstacle is the absence of datasets that provide precise garment and body size information, particularly for "ill-fit" cases, where garments are significantly too large or too small. Consequently, current VTO methods default to generating well-fitted results regardless of the garment or person size. In this paper, we take the first steps towards solving this open problem. We introduce FIT (Fit-Inclusive Try-on), a large-scale VTO dataset comprising over 1.13M try-on image triplets accompanied by precise body and garment measurements. We overcome the challenges of data collection via a scalable synthetic strategy: (1) We programmatically generate 3D garments using GarmentCode and drape them via physics simulation to capture realistic garment fit. (2) We employ a novel re-texturing framework to transform synthetic renderings into photorealistic images while strictly preserving geometry. (3) We introduce person identity preservation into our re-texturing model to generate paired person images (same person, different garments) for supervised training. Finally, we leverage our FIT dataset to train a baseline fit-aware virtual try-on model. Our data and results set the new state-of-the-art for fit-aware virtual try-on, as well as offer a robust benchmark for future research. We will make all data and code publicly available on our project page: https://johannakarras.github.io/FIT.

item.title: Self-Improving 4D Perception via Self-Distillation
item.author: Nan Huang, Pengcheng Yu, Weijia Zeng, James M. Rehg, Angjoo Kanazawa, Haiwen Feng, Qianqian Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SelfEvo是一个自改进框架，利用无标注视频持续改进预训练的多视角重建模型，通过时空上下文不对称性实现自蒸馏，无需外部标注数据。

背景: 现有大规模多视角重建模型严重依赖昂贵的地面真值3D/4D标注，且动态场景标注稀缺，限制了模型的扩展性。

目的: 提出SelfEvo框架，旨在利用无标注视频持续改进预训练的多视角重建模型，实现基于学习的4D感知的自改进，无需外部标注。

方法: 引入基于时空上下文不对称性的自蒸馏方案，系统研究了损失信号、不对称形式及其他训练策略的设计选择。

主要发现: SelfEvo在涵盖不同数据集和领域的八个基准测试中持续改进预训练基线，并在动态场景上表现显著；在视频深度估计上相对提升达36.5%，相机估计上相对提升达20.1%。

结论: SelfEvo无需使用任何标注数据即可实现模型的自改进，并在多个任务上取得了显著的性能提升。

翻译: Large-scale multi-view reconstruction models have made remarkable progress, but most existing approaches still rely on fully supervised training with ground-truth 3D/4D annotations. Such annotations are expensive and particularly scarce for dynamic scenes, limiting scalability. We propose SelfEvo, a self-improving framework that continually improves pretrained multi-view reconstruction models using unlabeled videos. SelfEvo introduces a self-distillation scheme using spatiotemporal context asymmetry, enabling self-improvement for learning-based 4D perception without external annotations. We systematically study design choices that make self-improvement effective, including loss signals, forms of asymmetry, and other training strategies. Across eight benchmarks spanning diverse datasets and domains, SelfEvo consistently improves pretrained baselines and generalizes across base models (e.g. VGGT and $π^3$), with significant gains on dynamic scenes. Overall, SelfEvo achieves up to 36.5% relative improvement in video depth estimation and 20.1% in camera estimation, without using any labeled data. Project Page: https://self-evo.github.io/.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有基于学习的多视图重建模型严重依赖昂贵且稀有的3D/4D真值标注，导致在动态场景中可扩展性受限的问题。同时，现有系统缺乏持续改进机制，无法适应目标数据分布的偏移。这个问题很重要，因为真值标注获取困难，限制了模型在现实世界和跨域场景中的应用，阻碍了技术的进一步发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到，当模型输入更多的视图时，其几何预测通常更加可靠，因此设计了让一个网络接收丰富上下文、另一个接收受限上下文的自蒸馏框架。该方法借鉴了知识蒸馏和自训练（如BYOL）的思想，利用时空上下文不对称作为监督信号。同时，作者也对比了并发工作Selfi，指出其方法能处理动态场景且无需冻结模型。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用时空上下文的不对称性，即模型在输入更多视图时产生的预测更可靠，以此作为无标注数据的监督信号。实现流程是首先初始化两个架构相同的模型实例，教师接收更丰富的输入视图，学生接收受限的输入视图。教师利用丰富的上下文生成预测作为伪标签来指导学生，同时教师通过指数移动平均（EMA）不断更新，形成在线自改进循环。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了SelfEvo框架，无需标注数据即可持续改进预训练的多视图重建模型；利用时空上下文不对称性进行自蒸馏，让模型从自身更丰富上下文的预测中学习；系统研究了设计选择以实现有效的自改进。相比之前的工作，它不需要昂贵的标注数据，不依赖光度一致性（在动态场景下不可靠），而是通过自蒸馏信号实现模型持续进化，且适用于动态场景。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了SelfEvo框架，通过自蒸馏机制利用时空上下文不对称性，使预训练的多视图重建模型能够在无标注数据下持续改进4D感知能力。

Abstract

Large-scale multi-view reconstruction models have made remarkable progress, but most existing approaches still rely on fully supervised training with ground-truth 3D/4D annotations. Such annotations are expensive and particularly scarce for dynamic scenes, limiting scalability. We propose SelfEvo, a self-improving framework that continually improves pretrained multi-view reconstruction models using unlabeled videos. SelfEvo introduces a self-distillation scheme using spatiotemporal context asymmetry, enabling self-improvement for learning-based 4D perception without external annotations. We systematically study design choices that make self-improvement effective, including loss signals, forms of asymmetry, and other training strategies. Across eight benchmarks spanning diverse datasets and domains, SelfEvo consistently improves pretrained baselines and generalizes across base models (e.g. VGGT and $π^3$), with significant gains on dynamic scenes. Overall, SelfEvo achieves up to 36.5% relative improvement in video depth estimation and 20.1% in camera estimation, without using any labeled data. Project Page: https://self-evo.github.io/.

item.title: ActiveGlasses: Learning Manipulation with Active Vision from Ego-centric Human Demonstration
item.author: Yanwen Zou, Chenyang Shi, Wenye Yu, Han Xue, Jun Lv, Ye Pan, Chuan Wen, Cewu Lu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ActiveGlasses 是一个利用主动视觉从人类演示中学习机器人操作的系统，通过佩戴在智能眼镜上的立体相机实现数据采集和策略推理，实现了零样本迁移。

背景: 现有机器人数据收集流程通常依赖专用手持设备，这增加了操作员负担、限制了可扩展性，且难以捕捉人类日常互动中自然协调的感知-操作行为。

目的: 开发一个更自然的系统，能够忠实地捕捉人类操作和感知行为，并实现零样本迁移到机器人平台。

方法: ActiveGlasses 系统使用佩戴在智能眼镜上的立体相机作为唯一的感知设备。在演示过程中，操作员佩戴该相机进行徒手演示；在部署时，将同一相机安装在六自由度感知臂上以复现人类主动视觉。系统从演示中提取物体轨迹，并使用基于物体的点云策略联合预测操作和头部运动。

主要发现: 在涉及遮挡和精确交互的几个具有挑战性的任务中，ActiveGlasses 实现了主动视觉的零样本迁移，在相同的硬件设置下始终优于强基线，并在两个机器人平台上实现了泛化。

结论: ActiveGlasses 成功展示了利用主动视觉从人类演示中学习机器人操作的能力，证明了该系统在零样本迁移和跨平台泛化方面的有效性。

翻译: ActiveGlasses 是一个利用主动视觉从人类演示中学习机器人操作的系统，通过佩戴在智能眼镜上的立体相机实现数据采集和策略推理，实现了零样本迁移。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有机器人数据收集管道效率低下且不自然的问题，即现有方法通常依赖专用手持设备或遥操作，增加了操作员负担，限制了可扩展性，且难以捕捉人类自然协调的感知与操作行为。这个问题在现实中至关重要，因为机器人数据收集缓慢、劳动密集且昂贵，为了实现通用机器人智能，需要一种更自然、高效且可扩展的框架来收集操作数据，以捕捉人类对齐的演示。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有数据收集方式依赖专用设备，难以捕捉人类感知与操作的自然协调。他们设计ActiveGlasses，利用智能眼镜作为唯一感知设备，让操作员用裸手演示，并在部署时用机械臂模仿头部运动以实现主动视觉。为了解决人手与机器人的形态学差距，他们借鉴了基于物体的表示方法，通过预测物体轨迹而非直接模仿动作来实现零样本迁移。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用主动视觉从人类演示中学习机器人操作，通过佩戴智能眼镜徒手完成任务，并利用物体轨迹和点云策略实现零样本跨平台迁移。整体流程包括：操作员佩戴智能眼镜和双目相机徒手演示，系统记录双目视频和头部运动；通过深度估计和物体分割处理数据，利用桌子上的球体校准建立世界坐标系；最后训练基于物体的3D点云策略预测物体轨迹，由主臂执行轨迹，辅助臂模仿头部运动以实现主动感知。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 关键创新点包括：利用智能眼镜配合立体相机，允许操作员赤手进行自然演示；捕捉操作员的头部运动以实现主动视觉，从而处理遮挡；以及采用基于物体的3D点云策略预测物体轨迹，实现跨平台的零样本迁移。相比之前的工作，不同之处在于：数据收集方式更自然，无需笨重手持设备或遥操作；感知方式更主动，利用头部运动而非仅靠手腕相机；迁移能力更强，通过物体轨迹预测而非运动学重定向，实现了跨机器人平台的零样本部署。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种利用智能眼镜捕捉人类裸手操作中主动视觉的系统，通过基于物体的 3D 点云策略实现机器人零样本迁移，从而更自然地学习操作技能。

Abstract

Large-scale real-world robot data collection is a prerequisite for bringing robots into everyday deployment. However, existing pipelines often rely on specialized handheld devices to bridge the embodiment gap, which not only increases operator burden and limits scalability, but also makes it difficult to capture the naturally coordinated perception-manipulation behaviors of human daily interaction. This challenge calls for a more natural system that can faithfully capture human manipulation and perception behaviors while enabling zero-shot transfer to robotic platforms. We introduce ActiveGlasses, a system for learning robot manipulation from ego-centric human demonstrations with active vision. A stereo camera mounted on smart glasses serves as the sole perception device for both data collection and policy inference: the operator wears it during bare-hand demonstrations, and the same camera is mounted on a 6-DoF perception arm during deployment to reproduce human active vision. To enable zero-transfer, we extract object trajectories from demonstrations and use an object-centric point-cloud policy to jointly predict manipulation and head movement. Across several challenging tasks involving occlusion and precise interaction, ActiveGlasses achieves zero-shot transfer with active vision, consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same hardware setup, and generalizes across two robot platforms.

item.title: RewardFlow: Generate Images by Optimizing What You Reward
item.author: Onkar Susladkar, Dong-Hwan Jang, Tushar Prakash, Adheesh Juvekar, Vedant Shah, Ayush Barik, Nabeel Bashir, Muntasir Wahed, Ritish Shrirao, Ismini Lourentzou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RewardFlow 是一个无需逆变换的框架，通过多奖励朗之万动力学在推理时引导预训练的扩散和流匹配模型。

背景: 现有模型在处理互补的可微分奖励时存在挑战，包括语义对齐、感知保真度、局部定位、对象一致性和人类偏好。
