如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Standard evaluation protocols reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: on 7.7% of benchmark problems spanning five datasets, larger language models underperform smaller ones by 28.4 percentage points despite 10-100x more parameters. Through systematic evaluation of 31 models (0.5B-405B parameters) across 1,485 problems, we identify the mechanism as spontaneous scale-dependent verbosity that introduces errors through overelaboration. Causal intervention experiments demonstrate this reflects correctable prompt design rather than fundamental capability limitations. Constraining large models to produce brief responses improves accuracy by 26 percentage points and reduces performance gaps by up to two-thirds. Most critically, brevity constraints completely reverse performance hierarchies on mathematical reasoning and scientific knowledge benchmarks, with large models achieving 7.7-15.9 percentage point advantages over small models -- direct inversions of the original gaps. These reversals prove large models possess superior latent capabilities that universal prompting masks. We validate findings through three independent contamination tests and demonstrate inverse scaling operates continuously across the full parameter spectrum, with dataset-specific optimal scales ranging from 0.5B to 3.0B parameters. Our results establish that maximizing large model performance requires scale-aware prompt engineering rather than universal evaluation protocols, with immediate implications for deployment: prompt adaptation simultaneously improves accuracy and reduces computational costs.

item.title: Forecast collapse of transformer-based models under squared loss in financial time series
item.author: Pierre Andreoletti
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在弱条件结构时间序列下，使用高表达能力预测模型进行轨迹预测的平方损失问题。

背景: 基于平方损失风险最小化的经典刻画，在标准金融设置中，未来轨迹的条件期望是退化的，导致贝叶斯最优预测器是平凡的（价格平坦，收益为零）。

目的: 强调在条件期望退化的情况下，增加模型表达能力不会提高预测精度，反而会引入围绕最优预测器的虚假轨迹波动。

方法: 结合理论分析与高频 EUR/USD 汇率数据的数值实验，分析轨迹级预测误差的分布。

主要发现: Transformer 基于模型的预测误差大于简单线性基准，且波动主要由噪声重用引起的方差增加驱动，而非偏差减少。

结论: Transformer 模型在金融时间序列上的预测性能下降存在过程层面的解释，即高表达能力在特定条件下会导致预测方差增加。

翻译: 本文研究了在弱条件结构时间序列下，使用高表达能力预测模型进行轨迹预测的平方损失问题。基于平方损失风险最小化的经典刻画，我们强调了未来轨迹的条件期望在标准金融设置中实际上是退化的，导致贝叶斯最优预测器是平凡的（价格平坦，收益为零）。在这种情况下，增加模型表达能力不会提高预测精度，反而会在最优预测器周围引入虚假的轨迹波动。这些波动源于噪声的重用，导致预测方差增加，而偏差没有减少。这为 Transformer 基于模型在金融时间序列上的预测性能下降提供了过程层面的解释。我们通过高频 EUR/USD 汇率数据的数值实验补充了这些理论结果，分析了轨迹级预测误差的分布。结果表明，Transformer 基于模型的预测误差在大多数预测窗口上都大于简单线性基准，这与理论识别出的方差驱动机制一致。

Abstract

We study trajectory forecasting under squared loss for time series with weak conditional structure, using highly expressive prediction models. Building on the classical characterization of squared-loss risk minimization, we emphasize regimes in which the conditional expectation of future trajectories is effectively degenerate, leading to trivial Bayes-optimal predictors (flat for prices and zero for returns in standard financial settings). In this regime, increased model expressivity does not improve predictive accuracy but instead introduces spurious trajectory fluctuations around the optimal predictor. These fluctuations arise from the reuse of noise and result in increased prediction variance without any reduction in bias. This provides a process-level explanation for the degradation of Transformerbased forecasts on financial time series. We complement these theoretical results with numerical experiments on high-frequency EUR/USD exchange rate data, analyzing the distribution of trajectory-level forecasting errors. The results show that Transformer-based models yield larger errors than a simple linear benchmark on a large majority of forecasting windows, consistent with the variance-driven mechanism identified by the theory.

item.title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Models
item.author: Eugene Lee, Ting-Yu Chang, Jui-Huang Tsai, Jiajie Diao, Chen-Yi Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HIVE的框架，通过引入分层交叉注意力机制来增强视觉编码器与大型语言模型的对齐，从而提升视觉语言模型的表现。

背景: 现有的计算机视觉方法通常将视觉编码器和大型语言模型视为独立模块，限制了分层视觉特征的整合。

目的: 提出HIVE框架，以增强视觉语言对齐，并改善梯度流动和表示学习。

方法: HIVE框架引入了视觉编码器与LLM之间的分层交叉注意力，采用三阶段训练策略来逐步对齐视觉编码器与LLM，确保稳定优化和有效的多模态融合。

主要发现: HIVE在图像分类和各种视觉语言任务中均表现出优越性能，在MME、GQA、OK-VQA和ScienceQA等基准测试中优于基于自注意力的方法。

结论: 分层特征整合带来了显著益处，为更高效和更具表现力的视觉语言模型铺平了道路。

翻译: 计算机视觉领域通过可扩展的视觉编码器和多模态预训练框架取得了显著进展。然而，现有方法通常将视觉编码器和大型语言模型视为独立模块，限制了分层视觉特征的整合。在这项工作中，我们提出了HIVE（视觉编码器的分层预训练），这是一种新颖的框架，通过在视觉编码器和LLM之间引入分层交叉注意力来增强视觉语言对齐。与将图像嵌入扁平化的传统方法不同，HIVE能够在多层之间实现结构化的特征融合，改善梯度流动和表示学习。为了优化这种交互，我们引入了一种三阶段训练策略，逐步对齐视觉编码器与LLM，确保稳定优化和有效的多模态融合。实证评估表明，HIVE不仅在图像分类中表现出优越性能，而且在各种视觉语言任务中也表现出色，在MME、GQA、OK-VQA和ScienceQA等基准测试中优于基于自注意力的方法。我们的结果强调了分层特征整合的益处，为更高效和更具表现力的视觉语言模型铺平了道路。

Abstract

The field of computer vision has experienced significant advancements through scalable vision encoders and multimodal pre-training frameworks. However, existing approaches often treat vision encoders and large language models (LLMs) as independent modules, limiting the integration of hierarchical visual features. In this work, we propose HIVE (Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders), a novel framework that enhances vision-language alignment by introducing hierarchical cross-attention between the vision encoder and LLM. Unlike conventional methods that flatten image embeddings, HIVE enables structured feature fusion across multiple layers, improving gradient flow and representation learning. To optimize this interaction, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that progressively aligns the vision encoder with the LLM, ensuring stable optimization and effective multimodal fusion. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that HIVE achieves superior performance not only in image classification but also on various vision-language tasks, outperforming self-attention-based methods in benchmarks such as MME, GQA, OK-VQA, and ScienceQA. Our results highlight the benefits of hierarchical feature integration, paving the way for more efficient and expressive vision-language models.

item.title: Learning Compact Terrain-Context Representations for Feasibility-Aware Offline Reinforcement Learning in UAV Relaying Networks
item.author: Joseanne Viana, Viswak R Balaji, Boris Galkin, Lester Ho, Holger Claussen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了地形感知无人机中继系统中紧凑状态表示对离线强化学习的影响。

背景: 在无人机系统中，由于在线探索成本高昂且存在安全隐患，离线强化学习成为一种有吸引力的工具。在涉及地形感知的无人机中继场景中，代理需要观察地形和土地覆盖图等高维输入，这些输入描述了传播环境，但使得从固定数据集中进行离线学习变得复杂。

目的: 研究紧凑状态表示对无人机中继离线强化学习的影响，以解决高维地形上下文带来的挑战。

方法: 引入候选集可行性上界(CS-FUB)来区分可行性限制和控制引起的次优性；使用变分自编码器(VAE)将地图状观察压缩为低维潜在表示；通过保守Q学习(CQL)训练策略。

主要发现: 直接在高维地形上下文状态上训练CQL会导致收敛缓慢和较大的可行性差距；相比之下，VAE编码的表示提高了学习稳定性，使代理更早收敛到可行的中继配置，并相对于物理极限减少了次优性。

结论: 结构化表示学习对于地形感知无人机系统中的有效离线强化学习具有显著益处。

翻译: 该研究探讨了地形感知无人机中继系统中紧凑状态表示对离线强化学习的影响。在无人机系统中，由于在线探索成本高昂且存在安全隐患，离线强化学习成为一种有吸引力的工具。在涉及地形感知的无人机中继场景中，代理需要观察地形和土地覆盖图等高维输入，这些输入描述了传播环境，但使得从固定数据集中进行离线学习变得复杂。研究引入候选集可行性上界(CS-FUB)来区分可行性限制和控制引起的次优性；使用变分自编码器(VAE)将地图状观察压缩为低维潜在表示；通过保守Q学习(CQL)训练策略。实验结果表明，直接在高维地形上下文状态上训练CQL会导致收敛缓慢和较大的可行性差距；相比之下，VAE编码的表示提高了学习稳定性，使代理更早收敛到可行的中继配置，并相对于物理极限减少了次优性。结构化表示学习对于地形感知无人机系统中的有效离线强化学习具有显著益处。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决的是在无人机中继网络中，如何利用离线强化学习处理高维地形数据的问题。直接使用高维地形图会导致学习不稳定和收敛缓慢。在现实中，无人机中继系统需要同时满足回程和接入链路，且地形复杂，在线探索既昂贵又有安全隐患，因此离线学习至关重要。在研究中，高维地形数据直接用于学习会显著增加复杂性，导致样本效率低下，而紧凑的表示能提高学习效率和稳定性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对高维地形输入导致离线学习困难的问题，借鉴了控制领域中“紧凑表示能提升稳定性”的思路，利用变分自编码器将高维地形图压缩为低维潜在状态。同时，他们借鉴了保守Q学习算法来缓解离线学习中的过估计问题。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用变分自编码器将高维的地形上下文压缩为低维的潜在表示，以解决离线强化学习中因输入维度过高导致的收敛慢和次优问题，并结合保守 Q 学习来训练策略。整体实现流程分为两步：首先使用离线数据集训练变分自编码器，学习地形上下文的紧凑表示；然后将数据集编码为低维潜在状态，并在该潜在状态上使用保守 Q 学习训练策略。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于：一是利用变分自编码器将高维地形上下文压缩为低维潜在状态，以解决离线学习中的高维输入难题；二是引入候选集可行性上界来区分物理可行性限制与控制导致的次优性；三是将压缩表示与保守 Q 学习结合，实现稳定且高效的离线策略训练。相比之前的工作，本文不再依赖低维状态和在线交互，而是专注于处理高维地形感知数据，并在无环境交互的离线数据集上进行训练，从而解决了地形感知场景下离线 RL 的样本效率低和收敛慢的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出利用变分自编码器将高维地形地图压缩为低维表示，并结合保守Q学习训练无人机中继策略。实验表明，这种压缩后的表示能提高学习稳定性，使无人机更早收敛到可行的配置，并减少次优性。

Abstract

Offline reinforcement learning (RL) is an attractive tool for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems, where online exploration is costly and raises safety concerns. In terrain-aware UAV relaying, agents may observe high-dimensional inputs such as terrain and land-cover maps, which describe the propagation environment, but complicate offline learning from fixed datasets. This paper investigates the impact of compact state representations on offline RL for UAV relaying. End-to-end service is jointly constrained by UAV--user access links and a base-station--to--UAV backhaul link, yielding feasibility limits driven by user mobility and independent of UAV control. To distinguish feasibility limits from control-induced sub-optimality, a candidate-set feasibility upper bound (CS-FUB) is introduced, which estimates the maximum achievable user coverage over a restricted set of UAV placements. To address high-dimensional terrain context, map-like observations are compressed into low-dimensional latent representations using a variational autoencoder (VAE) and policies are trained via Conservative Q-Learning (CQL). Simulation results show that training CQL directly on raw high-dimensional terrain-context states leads to slow convergence and large feasibility gaps. In contrast, VAE-encoded representations improve learning stability, enable earlier convergence to feasible relay configurations, and reduce sub-optimality relative to physical limits. Comparisons with autoencoder and linear compression baselines further demonstrate the benefit of structured representation learning for effective offline RL in terrain-aware UAV systems.

item.title: UCell: rethinking generalizability and scaling of bio-medical vision models
item.author: Nicholas Kuang, Vanessa Scalon, Ji Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在生物医学研究背景下，通过构建小型深度学习模型来提高单细胞分割任务性能的方法，提出了一种名为UCell的模型。

背景: 现代深度学习领域以模型规模为中心，更大的模型通常表现更好。但在生物医学研究的许多子领域中，模型扩展受到可用训练数据量以及生成和验证高质量数据的高成本的限制。

目的: 探索改进小型模型能力的方法，以解决生物医学研究中数据量不足和高成本的问题。

方法: 构建了参数量在1000万到3000万之间的小型模型，通过在模型前向计算图中引入递归结构，设计了一种更参数高效的架构。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，小型模型UCell的性能与规模大10到20倍的模型相当，且对未见数据的泛化能力相似。UCell可以从显微镜成像数据中从头训练，无需依赖大规模自然图像预训练，从而将模型构建与外部商业利益解耦。

结论: 通过实验验证了UCell在单细胞分割任务中的适应性和有效性，证明了小型模型在特定任务中可以替代大型模型。

翻译: 现代深度学习领域是一个以规模为中心的领域。更大的模型已被证明 consistently 比相似架构的较小模型表现更好。然而，在生物医学研究的许多子领域中，模型扩展受到可用训练数据量的限制，以及生成和验证额外高质量数据的高成本。尽管存在实际障碍，大多数正在进行的研究仍然集中在构建更大的基础模型上，而改进小型模型能力的替代方案则未被充分探索。在这里，我们实验性地构建了参数量为1000万到3000万的小型模型，这在现代标准下非常小，以执行单细胞分割任务。一个重要的设计选择是在模型的前向计算图中引入递归结构，从而形成一种更参数高效的架构。我们发现，在多个基准测试中，我们的小型模型UCell与规模大10到20倍的模型性能相当，并且对未见数据的泛化能力相似。更重要的是，我们发现UCell可以使用显微镜成像数据集从头训练，而不依赖于大规模自然图像预训练，因此将模型构建与任何外部商业利益解耦。最后，我们通过在多样化的数据集上进行广泛的一次性微调和少样本微调实验，检查并确认了UCell的适应性。实现代码可在 https://github.com/jiyuuchc/ucell 获取。

Abstract

The modern deep learning field is a scale-centric one. Larger models have been shown to consistently perform better than smaller models of similar architecture. In many sub-domains of biomedical research, however, the model scaling is bottlenecked by the amount of available training data, and the high cost associated with generating and validating additional high quality data. Despite the practical hurdle, the majority of the ongoing research still focuses on building bigger foundation models, whereas the alternative of improving the ability of small models has been under-explored. Here we experiment with building models with 10-30M parameters, tiny by modern standards, to perform the single-cell segmentation task. An important design choice is the incorporation of a recursive structure into the model's forward computation graph, leading to a more parameter-efficient architecture. We found that for the single-cell segmentation, on multiple benchmarks, our small model, UCell, matches the performance of models 10-20 times its size, and with a similar generalizability to unseen out-of-domain data. More importantly, we found that ucell can be trained from scratch using only a set of microscopy imaging data, without relying on massive pretraining on natural images, and therefore decouples the model building from any external commercial interests. Finally, we examined and confirmed the adaptability of ucell by performing a wide range of one-shot and few-shot fine tuning experiments on a diverse set of small datasets. Implementation is available at https://github.com/jiyuuchc/ucell

item.title: Feature-level Site Leakage Reduction for Cross-Hospital Chest X-ray Transfer via Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Ayoub Louaye Bouaziz, Lokmane Chebouba
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了跨医院胸部X光模型中的领域偏移问题，通过直接测量站点泄漏来评估迁移方法的效果。

背景: 跨医院胸部X光模型的失败通常归因于领域偏移，但大多数工作假设不变性而未测量它。

目的: 研究如何直接测量站点泄漏，以及该测量如何改变对迁移方法的结论。

方法: 研究多站点自监督学习和特征级对抗站点混淆用于跨医院迁移。首先在NIH和CheXpert上预训练ResNet-18，然后冻结编码器并在NIH上训练线性肺炎分类器以评估迁移到RSNA的效果。

主要发现: 多站点自监督学习将RSNA的AUC从0.6736提高到0.7804。添加对抗站点混淆减少了测量的泄漏，但未可靠地提高AUC并增加了方差。在特征f上，站点探测器的准确率从0.9890降至0.8504；在投影特征z上，准确率从0.8912降至0.7810。

结论: 测量泄漏改变了迁移方法的解释方式：多站点自监督学习驱动迁移，而对抗混淆揭示了不变性假设的局限性。

翻译: 本文研究了跨医院胸部X光模型中的领域偏移问题，通过直接测量站点泄漏来评估迁移方法的效果。

Abstract

Cross-hospital failure in chest X-ray models is often attributed to domain shift, yet most work assumes invariance without measuring it. This paper studies how to measure site leakage directly and how that measurement changes conclusions about transfer methods. We study multi-site self-supervised learning (SSL) and feature-level adversarial site confusion for cross-hospital transfer. We pretrain a ResNet-18 on NIH and CheXpert without pathology labels. We then freeze the encoder and train a linear pneumonia classifier on NIH only, evaluating transfer to RSNA. We quantify site leakage using a post hoc linear probe that predicts acquisition site from frozen backbone features $f$ and projection features $z$. Across 3 random seeds, multi-site SSL improves RSNA AUC from 0.6736 $\pm$ 0.0148 (ImageNet initialization) to 0.7804 $\pm$ 0.0197. Adding adversarial site confusion on $f$ reduces measured leakage but does not reliably improve AUC and increases variance. On $f$, site probe accuracy drops from 0.9890 $\pm$ 0.0021 (SSL-only) to 0.8504 $\pm$ 0.0051 (CanonicalF), where chance is 0.50. On $z$, probe accuracy drops from 0.8912 $\pm$ 0.0092 to 0.7810 $\pm$ 0.0250. These results show that measuring leakage changes how transfer methods should be interpreted: multi-site SSL drives transfer, while adversarial confusion exposes the limits of invariance assumptions.

item.title: OmniSch: A Multimodal PCB Schematic Benchmark For Structured Diagram Visual Reasoning
item.author: Taiting Lu, Kaiyuan Lin, Yuxin Tian, Yubo Wang, Muchuan Wang, Sharique Khatri, Akshit Kartik, Yixi Wang, Amey Santosh Rane, Yida Wang, Yifan Yang, Yi-Chao Chen, Yincheng Jin, Mahanth Gowda
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了OmniSch基准测试，旨在评估大型多模态模型在电路原理图理解和空间网表图构建方面的能力。

背景: 大型多模态模型在视觉定位、文档理解和图表推理任务上取得了快速进展，但在将印刷电路板原理图转换为机器可读的空间加权网表图方面能力仍被忽视，尽管这种图表示是实际电子设计自动化工作流程的基础。

目的: 为了填补这一空白，引入了OmniSch，这是第一个旨在评估LMMs在原理图理解和空间网表图构建方面的综合基准。

方法: OmniSch包含1,854个真实世界的原理图，并包括四个任务：1. 原理图实体的视觉定位；2. 图到图的推理，理解图元之间的拓扑关系；3. 几何推理，构建每个连接的布局相关权重；4. 工具增强的代理推理，用于视觉搜索，调用外部工具来完成前三个任务。

主要发现: 结果显示当前LMMs在解释原理图工程工件方面存在显著差距，包括不可靠的细粒度定位、脆弱的布局到图解析、不一致的全局连接推理和低效的视觉探索。

结论: 当前的大型多模态模型在处理原理图工程工件时存在局限性，需要进一步改进以更好地支持电子设计自动化工作流程。

翻译: 近期大型多模态模型在视觉定位、文档理解和图表推理任务上取得了快速进展。然而，尽管这种图表示是实际电子设计自动化工作流程的基础，但它们将印刷电路板原理图转换为机器可读的空间加权网表图的能力，同时捕获组件属性、连接性和几何形状，仍然很大程度上未被探索。为了填补这一差距，我们介绍了OmniSch，这是第一个旨在评估LMMs在原理图理解和空间网表图构建方面的综合基准。OmniSch包含1,854个真实世界的原理图，并包括四个任务：1. 原理图实体的视觉定位，有109.9K定位实例将423.4K图元语义标签与其视觉区域对齐；2. 图到图的推理，理解图元之间的拓扑关系；3. 几何推理，构建每个连接的布局相关权重；4. 工具增强的代理推理，用于视觉搜索，调用外部工具来完成前三个任务。我们的结果显示当前LMMs在解释原理图工程工件方面存在显著差距，包括不可靠的细粒度定位、脆弱的布局到图解析、不一致的全局连接推理和低效的视觉探索。

Abstract

Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have made rapid progress in visual grounding, document understanding, and diagram reasoning tasks. However, their ability to convert Printed Circuit Board (PCB) schematic diagrams into machine-readable spatially weighted netlist graphs, jointly capturing component attributes, connectivity, and geometry, remains largely underexplored, despite such graph representations are the backbone of practical electronic design automation (EDA) workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSch, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to assess LMMs on schematic understanding and spatial netlist graph construction. OmniSch contains 1,854 real-world schematic diagrams and includes four tasks: (1) visual grounding for schematic entities, with 109.9K grounded instances aligning 423.4K diagram semantic labels to their visual regions; (2) diagram-to-graph reasoning, understanding topological relationship among diagram elements; (3) geometric reasoning, constructing layout-dependent weights for each connection; and (4) tool-augmented agentic reasoning for visual search, invoking external tools to accomplish (1)-(3). Our results reveal substantial gaps of current LMMs in interpreting schematic engineering artifacts, including unreliable fine-grained grounding, brittle layout-to-graph parsing, inconsistent global connectivity reasoning and inefficient visual exploration.

item.title: Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe): Domain-Agnostic Fine-Grained Mask Discovery with Feature Calibration and Self-Supervised Upsampling
item.author: Deepank Singh, Anurag Nihal, Vedhus Hoskere
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EASe是一种无监督的、领域无关的语义分割框架，旨在解决复杂多组件形态场景下的细粒度掩码发现问题。

背景: 现有的无监督分割方法通常依赖基础模型，但在复杂多组件形态场景中表现不佳，因为它们使用粗粒度的补丁级表示，抑制了细粒度结构细节。

目的: 提出EASe框架，以实现跨具有复杂形态的挑战性现实场景的简单细粒度掩码发现。

方法: EASe利用语义感知上采样与通道激励（SAUCE）来激励低分辨率FM特征通道，并在空间编码的图像和FM特征之间进行注意力机制以恢复全分辨率语义表示。此外，使用无训练的提示感知特征聚合器（CAFE）将聚合特征分割为多粒度掩码。

主要发现: 在主要标准基准和具有复杂形态的多样化数据集上，EASe表现出优于先前最先进方法的性能。

结论: EASe、SAUCE和CAFE直接在像素级特征表示上运行，能够实现准确的细粒度密集语义掩码发现。代码已公开。

翻译: Unsupervised segmentation approaches have increasingly leveraged foundation models (FM) to improve salient object discovery. However, these methods often falter in scenes with complex, multi-component morphologies, where fine-grained structural detail is indispensable. Many state-of-the-art unsupervised segmentation pipelines rely on mask discovery approaches that utilize coarse, patch-level representations. These coarse representations inherently suppress the fine-grained detail required to resolve such complex morphologies. To overcome this limitation, we propose Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe), an unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework for easy fine-grained mask discovery across challenging real-world scenes. EASe utilizes novel Semantic-Aware Upsampling with Channel Excitation (SAUCE) to excite low-resolution FM feature channels for selective calibration and attends across spatially-encoded image and FM features to recover full-resolution semantic representations. Finally, EASe segments the aggregated features into multi-granularity masks using a novel training-free Cue-Attentive Feature Aggregator (CAFE) which leverages SAUCE attention scores as a semantic grouping signal. EASe, together with SAUCE and CAFE, operate directly at pixel-level feature representations to enable accurate fine-grained dense semantic mask discovery. Our evaluation demonstrates superior performance of EASe over previous state-of-the-arts (SOTAs) across major standard benchmarks and diverse datasets with complex morphologies. Code is available at https://ease-project.github.io

Abstract

Unsupervised segmentation approaches have increasingly leveraged foundation models (FM) to improve salient object discovery. However, these methods often falter in scenes with complex, multi-component morphologies, where fine-grained structural detail is indispensable. Many state-of-the-art unsupervised segmentation pipelines rely on mask discovery approaches that utilize coarse, patch-level representations. These coarse representations inherently suppress the fine-grained detail required to resolve such complex morphologies. To overcome this limitation, we propose Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe), an unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework for easy fine-grained mask discovery across challenging real-world scenes. EASe utilizes novel Semantic-Aware Upsampling with Channel Excitation (SAUCE) to excite low-resolution FM feature channels for selective calibration and attends across spatially-encoded image and FM features to recover full-resolution semantic representations. Finally, EASe segments the aggregated features into multi-granularity masks using a novel training-free Cue-Attentive Feature Aggregator (CAFE) which leverages SAUCE attention scores as a semantic grouping signal. EASe, together with SAUCE and CAFE, operate directly at pixel-level feature representations to enable accurate fine-grained dense semantic mask discovery. Our evaluation demonstrates superior performance of EASe over previous state-of-the-arts (SOTAs) across major standard benchmarks and diverse datasets with complex morphologies. Code is available at https://ease-project.github.io

item.title: Geometry-informed neural atlas for boundary value problems of complex 3D geometries
item.author: WaiChing Sun
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于学习几何表示的方法，通过重叠体积坐标图和神经解码器来替代传统的体积网格化步骤，从而解决三维物体在具有薄特征、非平凡拓扑或扫描表面时的模拟工作流瓶颈。

背景: 当三维物体包含薄特征、非平凡拓扑或扫描表面时，体积网格化往往成为模拟工作流中的主要瓶颈。

目的: 用一种学习到的几何表示来替代体积网格化步骤，以支持不同的求解器而不需要重新网格化或重新参数化。

方法: 使用重叠体积坐标图，每个图配备神经解码器和雅可比矩阵，从点云或水平集数据训练形成可微图。 governing方程通过Piola恒等式拉回到图局部参考坐标，并通过重叠图上的乘法Schwarz迭代耦合局部解。

主要发现: 学习图保留了预期的有限元收敛行为，并能够在几何体上同时进行正向和逆向分析，这些几何体通常需要求解器特定的体积网格化。

结论: 一种冻结的几何底座可以支持 fundamentally 不同的求解器（例如无网格物理信息神经网络和传统有限元方法），而无需重新网格化或重新参数化。

翻译: 当三维物体包含薄特征、非平凡拓扑或扫描表面时，体积网格化往往成为模拟工作流中的主要瓶颈。我们用一种学习到的几何表示来替代这一步骤：重叠体积坐标图，每个图配备神经解码器和雅可比矩阵，从点云或水平集数据训练形成可微图。 governing方程通过Piola恒等式拉回到图局部参考坐标，并通过重叠图上的乘法Schwarz迭代耦合局部解。由于图是独立于下游离散化构建的，一种冻结的几何底座可以支持 fundamentally 不同的求解器（例如无网格物理信息神经网络和传统有限元方法），而无需重新网格化或重新参数化。基准和验证研究显示，学习图保留了预期的有限元收敛行为，并能够在几何体上同时进行正向和逆向分析，这些几何体通常需要求解器特定的体积网格化。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决在处理具有复杂几何特征（如薄特征、非平凡拓扑或扫描数据）的3D物体时，传统计算流程中“体网格化”步骤成为主要瓶颈的问题。论文提出用一种基于神经网络的“神经图谱”来替代体网格化。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为该方法允许使用一个冻结的几何底座来支持多种不同的求解器（如无网格方法和有限元法），而无需重新网格化或重新参数化，从而提高了计算效率和灵活性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到复杂3D几何体（如薄特征、非平凡拓扑）的体积网格化是瓶颈，因此设计了一种“神经图集”方法。该方法用重叠的体积坐标图来表示几何体，每个图配备神经网络解码器和雅可比矩阵，通过乘法 Schwarz 迭代耦合局部解。作者借鉴了等几何分析（IGA）和映射有限元中的 Piola 映射算子，以及多补丁 IGA 和 Schwarz 方法中的重叠分解逻辑。同时也借鉴了物理信息神经网络（PINN）和域分解方法，但改变了子域来源，使其从图集结构中涌现。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是用神经网络来表示复杂几何体，特别是那些难以网格化的形状，构建一个重叠的体积坐标图集合作为计算基底。整体流程是：首先从点云或水平集数据中学习这些图；然后将控制方程拉回到局部参考坐标；最后通过重叠图上的乘法 Schwarz 迭代耦合局部解，从而支持不同的求解器而无需重新网格化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于利用神经图谱替代体积网格，支持多种求解器且无需重新参数化；通过乘法 Schwarz 迭代实现图间一致性；以及构建独立的几何基底以支持不同求解器。相比之前工作，不同之处在于：用神经图替代 CAD 导出的 NURBS 块，使重叠成为表示的固有部分；改变子域来源，由图谱定义几何和分解而非划分已离散化域；提供求解器就绪的体积图谱、重叠结构和映射 PDE 求解算子。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种基于神经图谱的几何表示方法，利用重叠的体积坐标图替代传统网格化，从而在无需重新网格化的情况下支持多种求解器处理复杂几何体的边界值问题。

Abstract

When three-dimensional bodies contain thin features, non-trivial topology, or scan-derived surfaces, volumetric meshing can become the dominant bottleneck in simulation workflows. We replace this step with a learned geometric representation: overlapping volumetric coordinate charts, each equipped with a neural decoder and Jacobian, trained from point-cloud or level-set data to form a differentiable atlas. Governing equations are pulled back to chart-local reference coordinates via the Piola identity, and local solutions are coupled through multiplicative Schwarz iterations on the overlap graph. Because the atlas is constructed independently of the downstream discretization, one frozen geometric substrate can support fundamentally different solvers (for example, a meshfree physics-informed neural network and a conventional finite-element method) without re-meshing or re-parametrization. Benchmark and verification studies show that the learned atlas preserves expected finite-element convergence behavior and enables both forward and inverse analyses on geometries that would otherwise require solver-specific volumetric meshing.

item.title: NeuroVase: A Tangible Mobile Augmented Reality Learning System for Neurovascular Anatomy and Stroke Education
item.author: Bahar Jahani, Matsanga Leyila Kaseka, Marta Kersten-Oertel, Yiming Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NeuroVase是一个基于平板的移动增强现实平台，旨在通过交互式和引人入胜的方式增强中风相关神经解剖学的学习，相比传统方法更为有效。

背景: 中风是全球死亡和残疾的主要原因，需要快速和明智的临床决策。对脑血管解剖和血管区域的良好空间理解对于及时的临床决策至关重要。然而，这种知识通常通过静态二维图表和印刷材料传达，这可能会阻碍掌握复杂的神经血管系统及其临床影响。

目的: 提出NeuroVase，一个基于平板的移动增强现实平台，在一个结构化的教学框架内，通过提供交互式、引人入胜且易于获取的替代传统方法的方式，增强中风相关神经解剖学的学习。

方法: NeuroVase具有双模式设置，使用实体提示卡作为独立的学习辅助工具，同时也作为AR内容交付的交互标记。一个专注于脑血管解剖和中风的定制学习课程支持在NeuroVase中注释的3D解剖模型背景下对血管区域、中风综合征和动脉闭塞的探索。一项包含40名参与者的受控用户研究比较了NeuroVase与传统学习的效果。

主要发现: NeuroVase是一个有效且用户友好的AR平台，能够促进复杂的解剖和生理教育。

结论: NeuroVase是一个有效的AR平台，用于促进复杂的解剖和生理教育，相比传统学习方法更为有效。

翻译: 摘要：中风仍然是全球死亡和残疾的主要原因，需要快速和明智的临床决策。对脑血管解剖和血管区域与中风症状和严重程度之间关系的良好空间理解对于及时的临床决策和患者护理至关重要。然而，这种知识通常通过静态二维图表和印刷材料传达，这可能会阻碍掌握复杂的神经血管系统及其临床影响。移动增强现实（AR）为提供直观的3D解剖教育提供了一种可获取的媒介，尽管需求巨大，但专注于神经血管系统和中风的AR应用仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了NeuroVase，一个基于平板的移动AR平台，在一个结构化的教学框架内，通过提供交互式、引人入胜且易于获取的替代传统方法的方式，增强中风相关神经解剖学的学习。NeuroVase具有双模式设置，使用实体提示卡作为独立的学习辅助工具，同时也作为AR内容交付的交互标记。一个专注于脑血管解剖和中风的定制学习课程支持在NeuroVase中注释的3D解剖模型背景下对血管区域、中风综合征和动脉闭塞的探索。一项包含40名参与者的受控用户研究显示，与传统的学习方法相比，NeuroVase是一个有效且用户友好的AR平台，能够促进复杂的解剖和生理教育。

Abstract

Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and disability worldwide, requiring rapid and informed clinical decision-making. A solid spatial understanding of cerebrovascular anatomy and vascular territories in relation to stroke symptoms and severity is critical for timely clinical decision and patient care. However, this knowledge is typically conveyed through static 2D diagrams and printed materials, which can hinder mastery of the complex neurovascular system and their clinical implications. Mobile augmented reality (AR) offers an accessible medium for delivering intuitive 3D anatomical education, yet applications focused on the neurovascular system and stroke remain limited despite the demand. To address this, we propose NeuroVase, a tablet-based mobile AR platform within a structured pedagogical framework that enhances stroke-related neuroanatomy learning by providing an interactive, engaging, and accessible alternative to traditional methods. NeuroVase features a dual-mode setup, using tangible cue cards as standalone study aids while also serving as interactive markers for AR content delivery. A custom learning curriculum focused on cerebrovascular anatomy and stroke supports exploration of vascular territories, stroke syndromes, and arterial occlusions, in the context of annotated 3D anatomical models in NeuroVase. A controlled user study with 40 participants revealed that NeuroVase is an effective and user-friendly AR platform to facilitate complex anatomical and physiological education, compared with traditional learning.

item.title: Label-efficient underwater species classification with semi-supervised learning on frozen foundation model embeddings
item.author: Thomas Manuel Rost
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究利用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入和自训练方法，在极少量标注数据下实现了水下图像物种分类，效果接近甚至超过全监督模型。

背景: 水下图像物种分类面临专家标注成本高、跨数据集泛化能力差的问题。

目的: 探究利用冻结的预训练模型嵌入和半监督方法，能否以最小标注努力缩小标注差距。

方法: 使用DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入，通过最近邻自训练传播少量标注种子，在AQUA20基准数据集上评估。

主要发现: 在少于5%的训练标签下，自训练能缩小与全监督ConvNeXt基线的差距；全监督时差距缩小至几个百分点，部分物种表现超过基线；嵌入空间分类可分性高。

结论: 该方法无需训练、无需领域特定数据工程或水下适配模型，建立了实用的、可立即部署的标签高效海洋物种识别基线。

翻译: 摘要：从水下图像中自动分类物种受限于专家标注成本，且在一个数据集上训练的监督模型很少能迁移到新条件下。我们调查了在冻结的预训练模型嵌入上运行的半监督方法，能否以最小的标注努力缩小这一标注差距。使用DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入且不进行微调，我们通过基于最近邻的自训练将少量标注种子传播到未标注数据上，并在AQUA20基准（20种海洋物种）上进行评估。在少于5%的训练标签下，冻结嵌入上的自训练缩小了与在全部标注数据集上训练的全监督ConvNeXt基线的差距；在全监督下，差距缩小到几个百分点，其中几个物种超过了监督基线。嵌入空间中的分类可分性（通过ROC-AUC测量）即使在极端标签稀缺的情况下也很高，表明冻结表示在决策边界能可靠估计之前很好地捕获了判别结构。我们的方法不需要训练、不需要领域特定的数据工程，也不需要水下适配模型，建立了一个实用的、可立即部署的标签高效的海洋物种识别基线。所有结果均在100次随机种子初始化的保留测试集上报告。

Abstract

Automated species classification from underwater imagery is bottlenecked by the cost of expert annotation, and supervised models trained on one dataset rarely transfer to new conditions. We investigate whether semi-supervised methods operating on frozen foundation model embeddings can close this annotation gap with minimal labeling effort. Using DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings with no fine-tuning, we propagate a small set of labeled seeds through unlabeled data via nearest-neighbor-based self-training and evaluate on the AQUA20 benchmark (20 marine species). With fewer than 5% of the training labels, self-training on frozen embeddings closes much of the gap to a fully supervised ConvNeXt baseline trained on the entire labeled dataset; at full supervision, the gap narrows to a few percentage points, with several species exceeding the supervised baseline. Class separability in the embedding space, measured by ROC-AUC, is high even at extreme label scarcity, indicating that the frozen representations capture discriminative structure well before decision boundaries can be reliably estimated. Our approach requires no training, no domain-specific data engineering, and no underwater-adapted models, establishing a practical, immediately deployable baseline for label-efficient marine species recognition. All results are reported on the held-out test set over 100 random seed initializations.

item.title: Collaborative AI Agents and Critics for Fault Detection and Cause Analysis in Network Telemetry
item.author: Syed Eqbal Alam, Zhan Shu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 开发了一种用于多智能体联邦系统的协作控制算法，使AI代理和评论家能够共同完成多模态任务。

背景: 在多智能体联邦多智能体系统中，每个AI代理和评论家都可以访问经典机器学习或生成式AI基础模型。

目的: 使AI代理和评论家协作完成多模态任务，如网络遥测系统中的故障检测、严重程度和原因分析，文本到图像生成，视频生成，医疗图像和患者记录的医疗诊断等。

方法: AI代理完成任务后发送给AI评论家进行评估，评论家将反馈发送给代理以改进其响应。他们协作最小化系统总成本，且代理和评论家之间无需通信。使用多时间尺度随机逼近技术，提供AI代理和评论家时间平均活跃状态的收敛保证。通信开销为O(m)，与代理和评论家的数量无关。

主要发现: 通信开销很小，为O(m)的量级，m为模态数，且独立于AI代理和评论家的数量。

结论: 通过网络遥测中的故障检测、严重程度和原因分析的示例以及全面评估，验证了算法的有效性。

翻译: 我们开发了一种用于多智能体联邦系统中AI代理和评论家协作控制的算法。每个AI代理和评论家都可以访问经典机器学习或生成式AI基础模型。AI代理和评论家与中央服务器协作完成多模态任务，如网络遥测系统中的故障检测、严重程度和原因分析，文本到图像生成，视频生成，医疗图像和患者记录的医疗诊断等。AI代理完成其任务并将其发送给AI评论家进行评估。评论家然后将反馈发送给代理以改进其响应。他们协作最小化系统总成本，且代理和评论家之间无需通信。AI代理和评论家保持其成本函数或成本函数导数的私有性。使用多时间尺度随机逼近技术，我们提供了AI代理和评论家时间平均活跃状态的收敛保证。通信开销在系统中很小，为O(m)的量级，m为模态数，且独立于AI代理和评论家的数量。最后，我们提出了网络遥测中故障检测、严重程度和原因分析的示例，并进行全面评估以检查算法的有效性。

Abstract

We develop algorithms for collaborative control of AI agents and critics in a multi-actor, multi-critic federated multi-agent system. Each AI agent and critic has access to classical machine learning or generative AI foundation models. The AI agents and critics collaborate with a central server to complete multimodal tasks such as fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in a network telemetry system, text-to-image generation, video generation, healthcare diagnostics from medical images and patient records, etcetera. The AI agents complete their tasks and send them to AI critics for evaluation. The critics then send feedback to agents to improve their responses. Collaboratively, they minimize the overall cost to the system with no inter-agent or inter-critic communication. AI agents and critics keep their cost functions or derivatives of cost functions private. Using multi-time scale stochastic approximation techniques, we provide convergence guarantees on the time-average active states of AI agents and critics. The communication overhead is a little on the system, of the order of $\mathcal{O}(m)$, for $m$ modalities and is independent of the number of AI agents and critics. Finally, we present an example of fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in network telemetry and thorough evaluation to check the algorithm's efficacy.

item.title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
item.author: Shuguang Chen, Adil Hafeez, Salman Paracha
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于轻量级信号的分诊框架，用于处理大型语言模型代理交互轨迹

背景: 基于大型语言模型的代理应用越来越多地依赖多步骤交互循环，但部署后改进具有挑战性，因为代理轨迹庞大且非确定性，人工或辅助LLM审查既慢又昂贵

目的: 提出一种轻量级、基于信号的框架，用于对代理交互轨迹进行分诊，以识别可能具有信息量的交互而不影响在线代理行为

方法: 从实时交互中计算廉价、广泛适用的信号，并将其作为结构化属性附加到轨迹分诊中；信号组织成跨交互、执行和环境的粗粒度分类法；在τ-bench上进行受控标注研究

主要发现: 基于信号的采样在τ-bench上的信息率达到82%，而启发式过滤为74%，随机采样为54%；每个信息轨迹的效率增益为1.52倍；优势在奖励分层和任务领域中稳健；信号提供真正的每轨迹信息增益，而不仅仅是过度采样明显的失败

结论: 轻量级信号可以作为代理系统的实用采样基础设施，并指向偏好数据构建和部署后优化的路径

翻译: 基于大型语言模型的代理应用越来越多地依赖涉及规划、行动执行和环境反馈的多步骤交互循环。虽然此类系统现在已大规模部署，但改进它们仍然具有挑战性。代理轨迹庞大且非确定性，审查每一个轨迹，无论是通过人工审查还是辅助LLM，既慢又成本高昂。我们提出了一种用于分诊代理交互轨迹的轻量级、基于信号的框架。我们的方法从实时交互中计算廉价、广泛适用的信号，并将其作为结构化属性附加到轨迹分诊中，识别可能具有信息量的交互而不影响在线代理行为。我们将信号组织成跨越交互、执行和环境的粗粒度分类法，设计用于无需模型调用的计算。在τ-bench上进行受控标注研究，τ-bench是一个广泛使用的用于工具增强代理评估的基准，我们表明基于信号的采样实现了82%的信息率，而启发式过滤为74%，随机采样为54%，每个信息轨迹的效率增益为1.52倍。优势在奖励分层和任务领域中稳健，证实信号提供真正的每轨迹信息增益，而不仅仅是过度采样明显的失败。这些结果表明轻量级信号可以作为代理系统的实用采样基础设施，并指向偏好数据构建和部署后优化的路径。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Agentic applications based on large language models increasingly rely on multi-step interaction loops involving planning, action execution, and environment feedback. While such systems are now deployed at scale, improving them post-deployment remains challenging. Agent trajectories are voluminous and non-deterministic, and reviewing each one, whether through human review or auxiliary LLMs, is slow and cost-prohibitive. We propose a lightweight, signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories. Our approach computes cheap, broadly applicable signals from live interactions and attaches them as structured attributes for trajectory triage, identifying interactions likely to be informative without affecting online agent behavior. We organize signals into a coarse-grained taxonomy spanning interaction (misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, satisfaction), execution (failure, loop), and environment (exhaustion), designed for computation without model calls. In a controlled annotation study on $τ$-bench, a widely used benchmark for tool-augmented agent evaluation, we show that signal-based sampling achieves an 82\% informativeness rate compared to 74\% for heuristic filtering and 54\% for random sampling, with a 1.52x efficiency gain per informative trajectory. The advantage is robust across reward strata and task domains, confirming that signals provide genuine per-trajectory informativeness gains rather than merely oversampling obvious failures. These results show that lightweight signals can serve as practical sampling infrastructure for agentic systems, and suggest a path toward preference data construction and post-deployment optimization.

item.title: Neural Reconstruction of LiDAR Point Clouds under Jamming Attacks via Full-Waveform Representation and Simultaneous Laser Sensing
item.author: Ryo Yoshida, Takami Sato, Wenlun Zhang, Yuki Hayakawa, Shota Nagai, Takahiro Kado, Taro Beppu, Ibuki Fujioka, Yunshan Zhong, Kentaro Yoshioka
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PULSAR-Net的神经网络，旨在在干扰攻击下重建真实的点云数据。

背景: LiDAR传感器对自动驾驶感知至关重要，但容易受到干扰攻击的欺骗。干扰攻击通过注入高频激光脉冲，用恶意信号淹没真实返回信号，导致传感器完全失明。

目的: 利用现代LiDAR系统中未充分利用的中间全波形表示和同时激光传感，提出PULSAR-Net以在干扰攻击下重建真实的点云。

方法: PULSAR-Net采用了一种新颖的U-Net架构，结合轴向空间注意力机制，专门设计用于在全波形表示中识别攻击引起的信号与真实物体返回信号。此外，引入了一个物理感知的数据集生成管道，用于合成干扰攻击下的全波形表示。

主要发现: 尽管仅在合成数据上训练，PULSAR-Net在现实世界的静态和驾驶场景中，分别实现了92%和73%的车辆重建率。

结论: 该方法能够有效处理干扰攻击，恢复被遮挡的车辆点云。

翻译: LiDAR传感器是自动驾驶感知的关键，但仍然容易受到欺骗攻击。干扰攻击注入高频激光脉冲，通过用恶意信号淹没真实返回信号，使LiDAR传感器完全失明。我们发现，虽然点云变得随机化，但底层全波形数据在攻击和合法信号之间仍保留着可区分的特征。在这项工作中，我们提出了PULSAR-Net，它能够利用现代LiDAR系统中未充分利用的中间全波形表示和同时激光传感，在干扰攻击下重建真实的点云。PULSAR-Net采用了一种新颖的U-Net架构，结合轴向空间注意力机制，专门设计用于在全波形表示中识别攻击引起的信号与真实物体返回信号。为了解决现有LiDAR数据集中缺乏干扰攻击下的全波形表示的问题，我们引入了一个物理感知的数据集生成管道，用于合成干扰攻击下的全波形表示。尽管仅在合成数据上训练，PULSAR-Net在现实世界的静态和驾驶场景中，分别实现了92%和73%的车辆重建率。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决自动驾驶中 LiDAR 传感器面临的干扰攻击问题。干扰攻击会注入高频激光脉冲，使传感器无法区分真实信号和恶意信号，导致点云完全随机化，使车辆无法感知周围环境。论文提出了一种名为 PULSAR-Net 的方法，利用全波形数据和同时激光传感功能，从被干扰的信号中恢复出真实的点云。这个问题在现实中非常重要，因为 LiDAR 是自动驾驶感知的关键组件，干扰攻击可能导致车辆无法检测障碍物或行人，引发致命的交通事故；在研究中，这是首个能有效防御干扰攻击的实用机制，填补了安全防御的空白。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现代 LiDAR 捕捉了丰富但被废弃的信息，他们利用全波形表示和同时激光感知来区分攻击信号和真实信号。他们设计了 PULSAR-Net，这是一种带有轴向注意力的 U-Net 架构。他们借鉴了 U-Net 架构、高斯脉冲模型以及关于 LiDAR 干扰攻击的现有研究。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法利用现代激光雷达中未被充分利用的中间数据——全波形表示和同时激光传感——来区分真实信号和干扰信号，从而恢复被干扰的点云。首先通过基于物理的合成管道从现有数据集生成模拟干扰的全波形数据；其次利用专门设计的U-Net架构训练PULSAR-Net来分离攻击信号；最后将训练好的模型集成到商用激光雷达中处理实时全波形数据，以恢复原始点云。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了PULSAR-Net，这是一种基于U-Net并带有轴向空间注意力机制的架构，专门用于在全波形数据中识别攻击信号。此外，论文开发了一种物理感知的数据集生成管道，用于从现有点云数据集合成逼真的受攻击全波形数据。与之前的工作相比，之前的研究认为干扰攻击会使点云完全随机化，导致无法恢复原始场景，而本文利用现代LiDAR中被忽视的中间全波形数据和同时传感特性，成功实现了在静态场景92%和驾驶场景73%的恢复率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了首个针对LiDAR干扰攻击的有效防御机制PULSAR-Net，利用全波形数据和同时激光传感功能，在现实世界的静态和驾驶场景中实现了高恢复率。

Abstract

LiDAR sensors are critical for autonomous driving perception, yet remain vulnerable to spoofing attacks. Jamming attacks inject high-frequency laser pulses that completely blind LiDAR sensors by overwhelming authentic returns with malicious signals. We discover that while point clouds become randomized, the underlying full-waveform data retains distinguishable signatures between attack and legitimate signals. In this work, we propose PULSAR-Net, capable of reconstructing authentic point clouds under jamming attacks by leveraging previously underutilized intermediate full-waveform representations and simultaneous laser sensing in modern LiDAR systems. PULSAR-Net adopts a novel U-Net architecture with axial spatial attention mechanisms specifically designed to identify attack-induced signals from authentic object returns in the full-waveform representation. To address the lack of full-waveform representations in existing LiDAR datasets under jamming attacks, we introduce a physics-aware dataset generation pipeline that synthesizes realistic full-waveform representations under jamming attacks. Despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, PULSAR-Net achieves reconstruction rates of 92% and 73% for vehicles obscured by jamming attacks in real-world static and driving scenarios, respectively.

item.title: Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar
item.author: Taeyoun Kwon, Youngwon Choi, Hyeonyu Kim, Myeongkyun Cho, Junhyeok Choi, Moon Hwan Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Mine-JEPA 是首个针对侧扫声纳水雷分类的领域内自监督学习管道，使用 SIGReg 损失函数在仅 1,170 张无标签声纳图像上进行预训练，在二分类和三分类任务中均优于微调后的 DINOv3 模型，且在参数量更少的情况下取得了竞争力。

背景: 侧扫声纳水雷分类是一个具有极端数据稀缺性和与自然图像存在巨大领域差距的挑战性海洋视觉问题。虽然自监督学习和通用视觉基础模型在通用视觉和几个专业领域表现出强大性能，但在侧扫声纳领域的应用仍 largely未被探索。

目的: 提出 Mine-JEPA，这是首个针对侧扫声纳水雷分类的领域内自监督学习管道，旨在解决数据稀缺问题，并探索在数据稀缺的海洋声纳图像中，精心设计的领域内自监督学习是否是大模型的有力替代方案。

方法: 使用 SIGReg，一种基于正则化的自监督学习损失函数，在仅 1,170 张无标签声纳图像上进行预训练。在二分类水雷与非水雷设置中，使用 Mine-JEPA；在三分类水雷状物体分类中，使用 Mine-JEPA 并结合合成数据增强。

主要发现: 在二分类设置中，Mine-JEPA 达到 0.935 的 F1 分数，优于微调后的 DINOv3（0.922）；在三分类设置中，Mine-JEPA 达到 0.820，优于微调后的 DINOv3（0.810）。此外，在基础模型上应用领域内自监督学习会导致性能下降 10-13 个百分点，表明更强的预训练模型并不总是能从额外的领域适应中受益。Mine-JEPA 使用紧凑的 ViT-Tiny 骨干网络，参数量比 DINOv3 少 4 倍。

结论: 精心设计的领域内自监督学习是数据稀缺的海洋声纳图像中比大得多的基础模型更可行的替代方案。

翻译: Side-scan sonar (SSS) mine classification is a challenging maritime vision problem characterized by extreme data scarcity and a large domain gap from natural images. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and general-purpose vision foundation models have shown strong performance in general vision and several specialized domains, their use in SSS remains largely unexplored. We present Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain SSL pipeline for SSS mine classification, using SIGReg, a regularization-based SSL loss, to pretrain on only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images. In the binary mine vs. non-mine setting, Mine-JEPA achieves an F1 score of 0.935, outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.922), a foundation model pretrained on 1.7B images. For 3-class mine-like object classification, Mine-JEPA reaches 0.820 with synthetic data augmentation, again outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.810). We further observe that applying in-domain SSL to foundation models degrades performance by 10--13 percentage points, suggesting that stronger pretrained models do not always benefit from additional domain adaptation. In addition, Mine-JEPA with a compact ViT-Tiny backbone achieves competitive performance while using 4x fewer parameters than DINOv3. These results suggest that carefully designed in-domain self-supervised learning is a viable alternative to much larger foundation models in data-scarce maritime sonar imagery.

Abstract

Side-scan sonar (SSS) mine classification is a challenging maritime vision problem characterized by extreme data scarcity and a large domain gap from natural images. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and general-purpose vision foundation models have shown strong performance in general vision and several specialized domains, their use in SSS remains largely unexplored. We present Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain SSL pipeline for SSS mine classification, using SIGReg, a regularization-based SSL loss, to pretrain on only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images. In the binary mine vs. non-mine setting, Mine-JEPA achieves an F1 score of 0.935, outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.922), a foundation model pretrained on 1.7B images. For 3-class mine-like object classification, Mine-JEPA reaches 0.820 with synthetic data augmentation, again outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.810). We further observe that applying in-domain SSL to foundation models degrades performance by 10--13 percentage points, suggesting that stronger pretrained models do not always benefit from additional domain adaptation. In addition, Mine-JEPA with a compact ViT-Tiny backbone achieves competitive performance while using 4x fewer parameters than DINOv3. These results suggest that carefully designed in-domain self-supervised learning is a viable alternative to much larger foundation models in data-scarce maritime sonar imagery.

item.title: COTTA: Context-Aware Transfer Adaptation for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
item.author: Seohyoung Park, Jaeyeol Lim, Seoyoung Ju, Kyeonghun Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet)模型在从美国数据迁移到韩国道路环境时的适应性，并比较了不同的训练策略。

背景: 现有的公开数据集如Waymo Open Motion Dataset和Argoverse主要收集于西方道路环境，未能反映韩国等地区的独特交通模式、基础设施和驾驶行为。

目的: 调查QCNet模型从美国数据迁移到韩国道路环境时的适应性，并比较四种训练策略的效果。

方法: 使用韩国自动驾驶数据集，对比四种训练策略：零样本迁移、从头训练、全微调和编码器冻结。

主要发现: 利用预训练知识显著提高预测性能；选择性微调解码器同时冻结编码器在准确性和训练效率之间取得了最佳平衡，相比从头训练将预测误差减少了66%以上。

结论: 选择性微调解码器是部署轨迹预测模型到新地理区域的有效迁移学习策略。

翻译: 开发稳健的模型来准确预测周围代理的轨迹对于自动驾驶安全至关重要。然而，大多数公开数据集，如Waymo Open Motion Dataset和Argoverse，是在西方道路环境中收集的，未能反映其他地区包括韩国的独特交通模式、基础设施和驾驶行为。这种领域差异导致在西方数据上训练的最先进模型在部署到不同地理环境时性能下降。在这项工作中，我们调查了Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet)从基于美国的数据迁移到韩国道路环境时的适应性。使用韩国自动驾驶数据集，我们比较了四种训练策略：零样本迁移、从头训练、全微调和编码器冻结。实验结果表明，利用预训练知识显著提高了预测性能。具体而言，选择性微调解码器同时冻结编码器在准确性和训练效率之间取得了最佳平衡，与从头训练相比，预测误差减少了66%以上。本研究为在新地理区域部署轨迹预测模型提供了有效的迁移学习策略的实用见解。

Abstract

Developing robust models to accurately predict the trajectories of surrounding agents is fundamental to autonomous driving safety. However, most public datasets, such as the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and Argoverse, are collected in Western road environments and do not reflect the unique traffic patterns, infrastructure, and driving behaviors of other regions, including South Korea. This domain discrepancy leads to performance degradation when state-of-the-art models trained on Western data are deployed in different geographic contexts. In this work, we investigate the adaptability of Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet) when transferred from U.S.-based data to Korean road environments. Using a Korean autonomous driving dataset, we compare four training strategies: zero-shot transfer, training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and encoder freezing. Experimental results demonstrate that leveraging pretrained knowledge significantly improves prediction performance. Specifically, selectively fine-tuning the decoder while freezing the encoder yields the best trade-off between accuracy and training efficiency, reducing prediction error by over 66% compared to training from scratch. This study provides practical insights into effective transfer learning strategies for deploying trajectory prediction models in new geographic domains.

item.title: Out of Sight, Out of Track: Adversarial Attacks on Propagation-based Multi-Object Trackers via Query State Manipulation
item.author: Halima Bouzidi, Haoyu Liu, Yonatan Gizachew Achamyeleh, Praneetsai Vasu Iddamsetty, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为FADE的新型攻击框架，旨在利用时序查询传播方法在多目标跟踪中的架构漏洞。FADE通过两种攻击策略，即时序查询泛滥和时序记忆破坏，来破坏跟踪器的性能，导致身份切换和跟踪终止。实验表明FADE对最先进的时序查询传播跟踪器非常有效。

背景: 近年来，时序查询传播跟踪方法通过实现端到端流程和长程时序建模，推动了多目标跟踪的进步。然而，这种对查询传播的依赖引入了未被探索的架构漏洞，使其容易受到对抗性攻击。

目的: 提出FADE攻击框架，旨在利用时序查询传播方法中的特定架构漏洞。

方法: FADE采用两种攻击策略：1. 时序查询泛滥：生成虚假的、时序一致的查询，耗尽跟踪器有限的查询预算，迫使跟踪器终止有效跟踪。2. 时序记忆破坏：直接攻击查询更新器的记忆，通过状态去相关切断时序链接，并擦除匹配跟踪的学习特征身份。此外，引入了一个可微分的管道，利用先进感知传感器欺骗的模拟来优化这些攻击，以提高其在物理世界的可实现性。

主要发现: 在MOT17和MOT20基准测试上，FADE对最先进的时序查询传播跟踪器非常有效，导致显著的身份切换和跟踪终止。

结论: FADE是一种高度有效的攻击框架，能够利用时序查询传播跟踪器的架构漏洞，破坏其跟踪性能。

翻译: 近年来，时序查询传播跟踪方法通过实现端到端流程和长程时序建模，推动了多目标跟踪的进步。然而，这种对查询传播的依赖引入了未被探索的架构漏洞，使其容易受到对抗性攻击。我们提出了FADE，一种旨在利用这些特定漏洞的新型攻击框架。FADE采用两种攻击策略，针对核心时序查询传播机制：1. 时序查询泛滥：生成虚假的、时序一致的查询，耗尽跟踪器有限的查询预算，迫使跟踪器终止有效跟踪。2. 时序记忆破坏：直接攻击查询更新器的记忆，通过状态去相关切断时序链接，并擦除匹配跟踪的学习特征身份。此外，我们引入了一个可微分的管道，利用先进感知传感器欺骗的模拟来优化这些攻击，以提高其在物理世界的可实现性。在MOT17和MOT20基准测试上，FADE对最先进的时序查询传播跟踪器非常有效，导致显著的身份切换和跟踪终止。

Abstract

Recent Tracking-by-Query-Propagation (TBP) methods have advanced Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) by enabling end-to-end (E2E) pipelines with long-range temporal modeling. However, this reliance on query propagation introduces unexplored architectural vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks. We present FADE, a novel attack framework designed to exploit these specific vulnerabilities. FADE employs two attack strategies targeting core TBP mechanisms: (i) Temporal Query Flooding: Generates spurious temporally consistent track queries to exhaust the tracker's limited query budget, forcing it to terminate valid tracks. (ii) Temporal Memory Corruption: Directly attacks the query updater's memory by severing temporal links via state de-correlation and erasing the learned feature identity of matched tracks. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable pipeline to optimize these attacks for physical-world realizability by leveraging simulations of advanced perception sensor spoofing. Experiments on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks demonstrate that FADE is highly effective against state-of-the-art TBP trackers, causing significant identity switches and track terminations.

item.title: Executing as You Generate: Hiding Execution Latency in LLM Code Generation
item.author: Zhensu Sun, Zhihao Lin, Zhi Chen, Chengran Yang, Mingyi Zhou, Li Li, David Lo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种并行执行范式，旨在解决现有基于大语言模型的编码代理中存在的串行执行模式带来的延迟问题。

背景: 现有的基于大语言模型的编码代理采用串行执行范式，即模型先生成完整代码，然后调用解释器执行。这种顺序工作流导致生成期间解释器空闲，执行期间模型空闲，从而产生不必要的端到端延迟。

目的: 为了解决串行执行模式带来的延迟问题，本文提出了一种并行执行范式，并实现了名为Eager的具体系统。

方法: 本文将并行执行范式形式化为一个三阶段流水线：生成、检测和执行。Eager系统通过基于AST的分块、动态批处理和门控执行以及早期错误中断来实现。

主要发现: 在四个基准测试、七个大语言模型和三个执行环境中进行的评估显示，Eager将非重叠执行延迟减少了高达99.9%，并将端到端延迟减少了高达55%。

结论: Eager通过并行执行范式显著降低了代码生成的延迟，提高了效率。

翻译: 当前的基于大语言模型的编码代理遵循串行执行范式：模型首先生成完整代码，然后调用解释器执行它。这种顺序工作流导致生成期间解释器空闲，执行期间模型空闲，从而产生不必要的端到端延迟。我们观察到，与人类开发者不同，大语言模型按顺序生成代码令牌而不进行修改，这使得可以在生成过程中执行代码。我们将这种并行执行范式形式化，将其建模为生成、检测和执行的三阶段流水线，并推导出表征其加速潜力和运行状态的闭式延迟界限。然后我们提出了Eager，一个具体的实现，具有基于AST的分块、带门控执行的动态批处理和早期错误中断。我们在四个基准测试、七个大语言模型和三个执行环境中评估了Eager。结果显示，Eager在七个大语言模型和四个基准测试中，将非重叠执行延迟减少了高达99.9%，将端到端延迟减少了高达55%。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决在大型语言模型进行代码生成时，如何隐藏执行延迟的问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要：unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Current LLM-based coding agents follow a serial execution paradigm: the model first generates the complete code, then invokes an interpreter to execute it. This sequential workflow leaves the executor idle during generation and the generator idle during execution, resulting in unnecessary end-to-end latency. We observe that, unlike human developers, LLMs produce code tokens sequentially without revision, making it possible to execute code as it is being generated. We formalize this parallel execution paradigm, modeling it as a three-stage pipeline of generation, detection, and execution, and derive closed-form latency bounds that characterize its speedup potential and operating regimes. We then present Eager, a concrete implementation featuring AST-based chunking, dynamic batching with gated execution, and early error interruption. We evaluate Eager across four benchmarks, seven LLMs, and three execution environments. Results show that Eager reduces the non-overlapped execution latency by up to 99.9% and the end-to-end latency by up to 55% across seven LLMs and four benchmarks.

item.title: A Reasoning-Enabled Vision-Language Foundation Model for Chest X-ray Interpretation
item.author: Yabin Zhang, Chong Wang, Yunhe Gao, Jiaming Liu, Maya Varma, Justin Xu, Sophie Ostmeier, Jin Long, Sergios Gatidis, Seena Dehkharghani, Arne Michalson, Eun Kyoung Hong, Christian Bluethgen, Haiwei Henry Guo, Alexander Victor Ortiz, Stephan Altmayer, Sandhya Bodapati, Joseph David Janizek, Ken Chang, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Akshay S. Chaudhari, Curtis P. Langlotz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CheXOne是一个推理驱动的视觉语言模型，用于胸部X光片（CXR）解读，能够生成诊断预测和临床推理过程。

背景: 胸部X光片是全球最常进行的影像检查之一，但影像量增加导致放射科医生工作负担加重和诊断错误风险上升。

目的: 开发一个推理驱动的视觉语言模型，用于胸部X光片解读，明确展示视觉证据如何转化为放射学发现和诊断预测。

方法: CheXOne在来自30个公共数据集的1470万条指令和推理样本上进行训练，采用结合指令微调和强化学习的两阶段框架。

主要发现: CheXOne在零样本设置下优于现有的医疗和通用领域基础模型；临床读者研究显示其生成的报告在55%的病例中与住院医师撰写的报告相当或更好；生成的推理过程具有高临床事实性和因果支持。

结论: 显式推理可以提高AI辅助胸部X光片解读中的模型性能、可解释性和临床实用性。

翻译: Chest X-rays (CXRs) are among the most frequently performed imaging examinations worldwide, yet rising imaging volumes increase radiologist workload and the risk of diagnostic errors. Although artificial intelligence (AI) systems have shown promise for CXR interpretation, most generate only final predictions, without making explicit how visual evidence is translated into radiographic findings and diagnostic predictions. We present CheXOne, a reasoning-enabled vision-language model for CXR interpretation. CheXOne jointly generates diagnostic predictions and explicit, clinically grounded reasoning traces that connect visual evidence, radiographic findings, and these predictions. The model is trained on 14.7 million instruction and reasoning samples curated from 30 public datasets spanning 36 CXR interpretation tasks, using a two-stage framework that combines instruction tuning with reinforcement learning to improve reasoning quality. We evaluate CheXOne in zero-shot settings across visual question answering, report generation, visual grounding and reasoning assessment, covering 17 evaluation settings. CheXOne outperforms existing medical and general-domain foundation models and achieves strong performance on independent public benchmarks. A clinical reader study demonstrates that CheXOne-drafted reports are comparable to or better than resident-written reports in 55% of cases, while effectively addressing clinical indications and enhancing both report writing and CXR interpretation efficiency. Further analyses involving radiologists reveal that the generated reasoning traces show high clinical factuality and provide causal support for the final predictions, offering a plausible explanation for the performance gains. These results suggest that explicit reasoning can improve model performance, interpretability and clinical utility in AI-assisted CXR interpretation.

Abstract

Chest X-rays (CXRs) are among the most frequently performed imaging examinations worldwide, yet rising imaging volumes increase radiologist workload and the risk of diagnostic errors. Although artificial intelligence (AI) systems have shown promise for CXR interpretation, most generate only final predictions, without making explicit how visual evidence is translated into radiographic findings and diagnostic predictions. We present CheXOne, a reasoning-enabled vision-language model for CXR interpretation. CheXOne jointly generates diagnostic predictions and explicit, clinically grounded reasoning traces that connect visual evidence, radiographic findings, and these predictions. The model is trained on 14.7 million instruction and reasoning samples curated from 30 public datasets spanning 36 CXR interpretation tasks, using a two-stage framework that combines instruction tuning with reinforcement learning to improve reasoning quality. We evaluate CheXOne in zero-shot settings across visual question answering, report generation, visual grounding and reasoning assessment, covering 17 evaluation settings. CheXOne outperforms existing medical and general-domain foundation models and achieves strong performance on independent public benchmarks. A clinical reader study demonstrates that CheXOne-drafted reports are comparable to or better than resident-written reports in 55% of cases, while effectively addressing clinical indications and enhancing both report writing and CXR interpretation efficiency. Further analyses involving radiologists reveal that the generated reasoning traces show high clinical factuality and provide causal support for the final predictions, offering a plausible explanation for the performance gains. These results suggest that explicit reasoning can improve model performance, interpretability and clinical utility in AI-assisted CXR interpretation.

item.title: RegFormer: Transferable Relational Grounding for Efficient Weakly-Supervised Human-Object Interaction Detection
item.author: Jihwan Park, Chanhyeong Yang, Jinyoung Park, Taehoon Song, Hyunwoo J. Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为RegFormer的模块，用于在弱监督条件下高效且准确地识别人类与物体的交互。

背景: 弱监督人类-物体交互检测对于可扩展的场景理解至关重要，因为它仅从图像级注释中学习交互。由于缺乏定位信号，先前的工作通常依赖外部物体检测器生成候选对，然后通过成对推理推断它们的交互。然而，这种框架由于枚举大量实例对而产生巨大的计算成本，并且由于非交互组合产生的误报而阻碍准确的实例级HOI推理。

目的: 为了解决这些问题，作者引入了关系基础Transformer（RegFormer），这是一个用于高效且准确的HOI推理的多功能交互识别模块。

方法: 在图像级监督下，RegFormer利用空间基础信号作为推理过程的指导，并促进局部感知的交互学习。通过学习局部化的交互线索，该模块区分人类、物体及其交互，从而无需额外训练即可直接从图像级交互推理转移到精确且高效的实例级推理。

主要发现: 广泛的实验和分析表明，RegFormer有效地学习了实例级交互推理的空间线索，具有高效率，甚至达到了与全监督模型相当的性能。

结论: RegFormer能够有效地学习空间线索以进行实例级交互推理，运行效率高，并且性能可与全监督模型相媲美。

翻译: Weakly-supervised Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is essential for scalable scene understanding, as it learns interactions from only image-level annotations. Due to the lack of localization signals, prior works typically rely on an external object detector to generate candidate pairs and then infer their interactions through pairwise reasoning. However, this framework often struggles to scale due to the substantial computational cost incurred by enumerating numerous instance pairs. In addition, it suffers from false positives arising from non-interactive combinations, which hinder accurate instance-level HOI reasoning. To address these issues, we introduce Relational Grounding Transformer (RegFormer), a versatile interaction recognition module for efficient and accurate HOI reasoning. Under image-level supervision, RegFormer leverages spatially grounded signals as guidance for the reasoning process and promotes locality-aware interaction learning. By learning localized interaction cues, our module distinguishes humans, objects, and their interactions, enabling direct transfer from image-level interaction reasoning to precise and efficient instance-level reasoning without additional training. Our extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that RegFormer effectively learns spatial cues for instance-level interaction reasoning, operates with high efficiency, and even achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Our code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/RegFormer.

Abstract

Weakly-supervised Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is essential for scalable scene understanding, as it learns interactions from only image-level annotations. Due to the lack of localization signals, prior works typically rely on an external object detector to generate candidate pairs and then infer their interactions through pairwise reasoning. However, this framework often struggles to scale due to the substantial computational cost incurred by enumerating numerous instance pairs. In addition, it suffers from false positives arising from non-interactive combinations, which hinder accurate instance-level HOI reasoning. To address these issues, we introduce Relational Grounding Transformer (RegFormer), a versatile interaction recognition module for efficient and accurate HOI reasoning. Under image-level supervision, RegFormer leverages spatially grounded signals as guidance for the reasoning process and promotes locality-aware interaction learning. By learning localized interaction cues, our module distinguishes humans, objects, and their interactions, enabling direct transfer from image-level interaction reasoning to precise and efficient instance-level reasoning without additional training. Our extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that RegFormer effectively learns spatial cues for instance-level interaction reasoning, operates with high efficiency, and even achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Our code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/RegFormer.

item.title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
item.author: Junxian Wu, Chenghan Fu, Zhanheng Nie, Daoze Zhang, Bowen Wan, Wanxian Guan, Chuan Yu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MOON3.0的推理感知多模态大语言模型，用于电商产品表示学习，通过多模态融合、联合对比强化学习及细粒度残差增强模块解决长上下文推理、监督微调限制及细节衰减问题，并在新基准MBE3.0上实现了最先进的零样本性能。

背景: 随着电子商务的快速发展，探索通用表示而非特定任务表示受到越来越多的关注。尽管多模态大语言模型在产品理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们通常作为特征提取器，将产品信息隐式编码为全局嵌入，限制了捕捉细粒度属性的能力。

目的: 利用多模态大语言模型的推理能力来显式建模细粒度产品属性，以解决现有模型在捕捉细粒度细节方面的局限性。

方法: 1. 采用多头模态融合模块自适应集成原始信号；2. 引入联合对比和强化学习框架，自主探索更有效的推理策略；3. 引入细粒度残差增强模块，在网络传播过程中逐步保留局部细节。

主要发现: 实验表明，该模型在自建的大规模多模态电商基准MBE3.0以及公共数据集的各种下游任务上，均表现出最先进的零样本性能。

结论: MOON3.0通过解决长上下文推理、监督微调限制和细节衰减等关键挑战，成功实现了对细粒度产品属性的显式建模，证明了其在电商产品表示学习中的有效性。

翻译: 随着电子商务的快速增长，探索通用表示而非特定任务表示引起了越来越多的关注。尽管最近的多模态大语言模型在产品理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们通常被用作特征提取器，将产品信息隐式编码为全局嵌入，从而限制了它们捕捉细粒度属性的能力。因此，我们认为利用多模态大语言模型的推理能力来显式建模细粒度产品属性具有巨大的潜力。然而，由于几个关键挑战，实现这一目标仍然非同寻常：(i) 长上下文推理往往稀释模型对原始输入中显著信息的注意力；(ii) 监督微调主要鼓励刚性模仿，限制了探索有效推理策略；(iii) 细粒度细节在前向传播过程中逐渐衰减。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MOON3.0，这是第一个用于产品表示学习的推理感知多模态大语言模型。我们的方法(1)采用多头模态融合模块自适应集成原始信号；(2)引入联合对比和强化学习框架，自主探索更有效的推理策略；(3)引入细粒度残差增强模块，在网络传播过程中逐步保留局部细节。此外，我们发布了一个大规模多模态电商基准MBE3.0。实验表明，我们的模型在自建基准和公共数据集的各种下游任务上均表现出最先进的零样本性能。

Abstract

With the rapid growth of e-commerce, exploring general representations rather than task-specific ones has attracted increasing attention. Although recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have driven significant progress in product understanding, they are typically employed as feature extractors that implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. Therefore, we argue that leveraging the reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to explicitly model fine-grained product attributes holds significant potential. Nevertheless, achieving this goal remains non-trivial due to several key challenges: (i) long-context reasoning tends to dilute the model's attention to salient information in the raw input; (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) primarily encourages rigid imitation, limiting the exploration of effective reasoning strategies; and (iii) fine-grained details are progressively attenuated during forward propagation. To address these issues, we propose MOON3.0, the first reasoning-aware MLLM-based model for product representation learning. Our method (1) employs a multi-head modality fusion module to adaptively integrate raw signals; (2) incorporates a joint contrastive and reinforcement learning framework to autonomously explore more effective reasoning strategies; and (3) introduces a fine-grained residual enhancement module to progressively preserve local details throughout the network. Additionally, we release a large-scale multimodal e-commerce benchmark MBE3.0. Experimentally, our model demonstrates state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across various downstream tasks on both our benchmark and public datasets.

item.title: MAESIL: Masked Autoencoder for Enhanced Self-supervised Medical Image Learning
item.author: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Junsu Lim, YeonJu Jean, Seongbin Park, Eunseob Choi, Hyunsu Go, SeoYoung Ju, Seohyoung Park, Gyeongmin Kim, MinJu Kwon, KyungSeok Yuh, Soo Yong Kim, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MAESIL的新型自监督学习框架，旨在通过引入3D结构信息来提升3D医学图像重建的性能。

背景: 3D医学图像训练面临标注数据稀缺的挑战，现有的预训练方法存在显著的领域差异，且许多自监督框架未能有效利用CT扫描的3D特性，通常将3D扫描视为独立的2D切片，从而丢失了轴向连贯性和3D结构上下文。

目的: 开发一种能够高效捕获3D结构信息的新型自监督学习框架，以解决现有方法在处理3D医学图像时的局限性。

方法: 提出了MAESIL框架，其核心创新是引入了“超级块”作为3D块输入单元，该单元在保留3D上下文的同时兼顾计算效率。框架将体积数据分割为超级块，并采用具有双重掩码策略的3D掩码自编码器策略来学习全面的空间表示。

主要发现: 在三个大型公共CT数据集上的实验结果表明，MAESIL在关键重建指标如PSNR和SSIM方面显著优于现有的AE、VAE和VQ-VAE方法。

结论: MAESIL被确立为3D医学图像任务的一种稳健且实用的预训练解决方案。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为MAESIL的新型自监督学习框架，旨在通过引入3D结构信息来提升3D医学图像重建的性能。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决现有自监督学习方法将3D CT扫描视为独立2D切片，从而丢失了关键的轴向连贯性和3D结构上下文的问题。这在研究中很重要，因为3D结构信息对于准确分析解剖结构和病理至关重要，而现有的2D方法无法有效利用CT的3D特性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法将3D扫描视为独立2D切片会丢失3D结构上下文，因此设计“superpatch”来平衡3D上下文保留与计算效率。他们借鉴了Masked Autoencoders (MAE)的思路，特别是MedMAE的工作，但针对MedMAE仍将3D数据视为2D切片的局限性进行了改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是解决现有自监督学习将3D医学图像视为独立2D切片而丢失3D结构上下文的问题。它引入了“超级补丁”作为3D输入单元，通过双重掩码策略来学习全面的3D表示。整体流程是将3D扫描划分为3D块，再细分为小块，随机遮住部分块和切片，让编码器处理可见部分，解码器利用掩码标记重建原始块，从而通过重建任务学习3D结构。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于引入了“超块”作为3D输入单元，以及“双重掩码”策略。超块旨在保留3D结构信息，而双重掩码结合了平面和轴向的随机遮挡，迫使模型学习3D上下文。相比之前的工作，它没有像传统方法那样将3D扫描视为独立的2D切片，从而避免了丢失轴向连贯性；同时，它在重建指标上显著优于传统的自编码器等基线模型。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为MAESIL的自监督学习框架，通过引入3D“超级补丁”和双重掩码策略，有效解决了现有方法将3D CT视为独立2D切片而丢失结构上下文的问题，显著提升了重建性能。

Abstract

Training deep learning models for three-dimensional (3D) medical imaging, such as Computed Tomography (CT), is fundamentally challenged by the scarcity of labeled data. While pre-training on natural images is common, it results in a significant domain shift, limiting performance. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) on unlabeled medical data has emerged as a powerful solution, but prominent frameworks often fail to exploit the inherent 3D nature of CT scans. These methods typically process 3D scans as a collection of independent 2D slices, an approach that fundamentally discards critical axial coherence and the 3D structural context. To address this limitation, we propose the autoencoder for enhanced self-supervised medical image learning(MAESIL), a novel self-supervised learning framework designed to capture 3D structural information efficiently. The core innovation is the 'superpatch', a 3D chunk-based input unit that balances 3D context preservation with computational efficiency. Our framework partitions the volume into superpatches and employs a 3D masked autoencoder strategy with a dual-masking strategy to learn comprehensive spatial representations. We validated our approach on three diverse large-scale public CT datasets. Our experimental results show that MAESIL demonstrates significant improvements over existing methods such as AE, VAE and VQ-VAE in key reconstruction metrics such as PSNR and SSIM. This establishes MAESIL as a robust and practical pre-training solution for 3D medical imaging tasks.

item.title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
item.author: Haibo Wang, Zihao Lin, Zhiyang Xu, Lifu Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Think, Act, Build (TAB)的动态代理框架，旨在通过将3D视觉定位任务重新定义为直接在原始RGB-D流上运行的生成式2D到3D重建范式，来解决现有方法依赖预处理点云和静态工作流的问题。

背景: 现有的3D视觉定位方法通常依赖预处理的3D点云，将定位任务退化为提案匹配，且在零样本能力上存在局限。

目的: 为了绕过对预处理点云的依赖，将3D视觉定位任务解耦，利用2D视觉语言模型解决复杂的空间语义，并依靠确定性的多视图几何来实例化3D结构。

方法: 提出Think, Act, Build (TAB)框架，利用专门的3D-VG技能引导VLM代理动态调用视觉工具在2D帧中跟踪和重建目标。引入语义锚定几何扩展机制，通过在参考视频片段中锚定目标并利用多视图几何传播其空间位置，聚合多视图特征以构建目标的3D表示。

主要发现: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上的广泛实验表明，该框架完全依赖开源模型，显著优于之前的零样本方法，甚至超越了全监督基线。

结论: 该框架通过语义锚定几何扩展机制有效克服了视觉语言模型语义跟踪导致的多视图覆盖不足问题，实现了从2D视觉线索到3D坐标的直接映射。

翻译: 3D Visual Grounding (3D-VG)旨在通过自然语言描述在3D场景中定位物体。虽然利用视觉语言模型(VLMs)探索零样本可能性的近期进展已取得进展，但它们通常依赖于预处理3D点云的静态工作流，本质上将定位退化为提案匹配。为了绕过这种依赖，我们的核心动机是解耦任务：利用2D VLMs解决复杂的空间语义，同时依靠确定性的多视图几何来实例化3D结构。受此启发，我们提出了“Think, Act, Build (TAB)”，一个动态代理框架，将3D-VG任务重新定义为直接在原始RGB-D流上运行的生成式2D到3D重建范式。具体而言，在专门的3D-VG技能的指导下，我们的VLM代理动态调用视觉工具在2D帧中跟踪和重建目标。至关重要的是，为了克服由严格的VLM语义跟踪引起的多视图覆盖不足，我们引入了语义锚定几何扩展，该机制首先在参考视频片段中锚定目标，然后利用多视图几何将其空间位置传播到未观察到的帧中。这使代理能够通过相机参数聚合这些多视图特征来“构建”目标的3D表示，直接将2D视觉线索映射到3D坐标。此外，为了确保严格的评估，我们识别了现有基准中的缺陷，如参考模糊和类别错误，并手动修正了不正确的查询。在ScanRefer和Nr3D上的广泛实验表明，我们的框架完全依赖开源模型，显著优于之前的零样本方法，甚至超越了全监督基线。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是零样本 3D 视觉定位的问题，即让模型在无需针对特定场景进行训练的情况下，仅凭文本描述就能在 3D 场景中找到对应的物体。这在现实和研究中很重要，因为 3D 视觉定位是机器人导航、增强现实和计算机视觉的基础，而零样本能力意味着模型可以快速适应新环境，无需大量重新训练，大大提高了实用性和效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

3D Visual Grounding (3D-VG) aims to localize objects in 3D scenes via natural language descriptions. While recent advancements leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored zero-shot possibilities, they typically suffer from a static workflow relying on preprocessed 3D point clouds, essentially degrading grounding into proposal matching. To bypass this reliance, our core motivation is to decouple the task: leveraging 2D VLMs to resolve complex spatial semantics, while relying on deterministic multi-view geometry to instantiate the 3D structure. Driven by this insight, we propose "Think, Act, Build (TAB)", a dynamic agentic framework that reformulates 3D-VG tasks as a generative 2D-to-3D reconstruction paradigm operating directly on raw RGB-D streams. Specifically, guided by a specialized 3D-VG skill, our VLM agent dynamically invokes visual tools to track and reconstruct the target across 2D frames. Crucially, to overcome the multi-view coverage deficit caused by strict VLM semantic tracking, we introduce the Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion, a mechanism that first anchors the target in a reference video clip and then leverages multi-view geometry to propagate its spatial location across unobserved frames. This enables the agent to "Build" the target's 3D representation by aggregating these multi-view features via camera parameters, directly mapping 2D visual cues to 3D coordinates. Furthermore, to ensure rigorous assessment, we identify flaws such as reference ambiguity and category errors in existing benchmarks and manually refine the incorrect queries. Extensive experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D demonstrate that our framework, relying entirely on open-source models, significantly outperforms previous zero-shot methods and even surpasses fully supervised baselines.

item.title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
item.author: Haibo Wang, Zihao Lin, Zhiyang Xu, Lifu Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Think, Act, Build (TAB)的动态代理框架，旨在通过2D视觉语言模型和确定性多视图几何来直接在原始RGB-D流上实现3D视觉定位。

背景: 现有的3D视觉定位方法通常依赖预处理的3D点云，将任务退化为提案匹配，且在多视图覆盖方面存在不足。

目的: 为了绕过对预处理点云的依赖，将3D视觉定位任务重新定义为直接在原始RGB-D流上运行的生成式2D到3D重建范式。

方法: 提出Think, Act, Build (TAB)框架，利用专门的3D视觉定位技能，通过动态调用视觉工具在2D帧中跟踪和重建目标，并引入语义锚定几何扩展机制来传播空间位置。

主要发现: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上的实验表明，该框架完全依赖开源模型，显著优于之前的零样本方法，甚至超过了全监督基线。

结论: 该方法通过解耦任务，利用2D VLM处理复杂空间语义，结合几何扩展解决了多视图覆盖问题，实现了更精准的3D结构实例化。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有3D视觉定位方法严重依赖预处理的3D点云，将其简化为静态的“提案匹配”任务，导致在无预处理数据环境下无法应用的问题。此外，现有方法仅依赖2D语义匹配，在极端视角变化下容易失效。这个问题很重要，因为3D视觉定位是人机交互、具身AI导航和AR/VR的基础。解决它可以摆脱对大量标注数据的依赖，实现开放世界下的零样本定位，具有更高的可扩展性和通用性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法严重依赖预处理的3D点云，导致任务退化为简单的提案匹配。因此，作者的核心动机是解耦任务：利用2D VLM处理复杂的空间语义，而利用确定性的多视图几何来实例化3D结构。基于此，他们提出了TAB框架，将3D-VG任务重新表述为在原始RGB-D流上运行的生成式2D到3D重建范式。作者借鉴了现有的零样本方法（如SeeGround, SPAZER）和2D视图方法（如VLM-Grounder），但指出这些方法存在依赖预处理点云和仅依赖启发式2D语义匹配的局限性，从而在此基础上进行了改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将 3D 视觉定位任务解耦，利用 2D 视觉语言模型处理复杂的语义，并依靠确定性的多视角几何来构建 3D 结构，将任务重构为基于原始 RGB-D 流的生成式 2D 到 3D 重建过程。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先通过分析查询和过滤候选帧，定位参考目标；接着利用语义锚定几何扩展机制，先在局部时间范围内跟踪目标构建初始 3D 几何，再通过多视角几何将 3D 中心投影到未观察帧中获取完整掩码；最后利用几何工具将 2D 掩码直接提升到 3D 空间，构建结构完整的点云并估计 3D 边界框。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了TAB框架，将3D视觉定位重构为生成式2D到3D重建范式。核心创新包括：一是引入Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion机制，通过锚定参考帧并利用几何传播克服多视图覆盖不足；二是直接在原始RGB-D流上运行，而非依赖预处理好的3D点云。相比之前工作，它不再将任务降级为静态的提案匹配，而是结合了VLM的语义推理和确定性多视图几何，避免了纯语义匹配在极端视角下的脆弱性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为 TAB 的动态智能框架，通过结合视觉语言模型的语义推理与多视角几何投影，在无需预处理点云的情况下实现了鲁棒的零样本 3D 目标定位。

3D Visual Grounding (3D-VG) aims to localize objects in 3D scenes via natural language descriptions. While recent advancements leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored zero-shot possibilities, they typically suffer from a static workflow relying on preprocessed 3D point clouds, essentially degrading grounding into proposal matching. Driven by this insight, we propose "Think, Act, Build (TAB)", a dynamic agentic framework that reformulates 3D-VG tasks as a generative 2D-to-3D reconstruction paradigm operating directly on raw RGB-D streams. Specifically, guided by a specialized 3D-VG skill, our VLM agent dynamically invokes visual tools to track and reconstruct the target across 2D frames. Crucially, to overcome the multi-view coverage deficit caused by strict VLM semantic tracking, we introduce the Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion, a mechanism that first anchors the target in a reference video clip and then leverages multi-view geometry to propagate its spatial location across unobserved frames. This enables the agent to "Build" the target's 3D representation by aggregating these multi-view features via camera parameters, directly mapping 2D visual cues to 3D coordinates. Furthermore, to ensure rigorous assessment, we identify flaws such as reference ambiguity and category errors in existing benchmarks and manually refine the incorrect queries. Extensive experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D demonstrate that our framework, relying entirely on open-source models, significantly outperforms previous zero-shot methods and even surpasses fully supervised baselines.

item.title: Learning Shared Representations for Multi-Task Linear Bandits
item.author: Jiabin Lin, Shana Moothedath
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的多任务线性带臂学习算法，通过共享低秩潜在表示来提高样本效率。

背景: 多任务表示学习是一种通过学习相关任务间的共享潜在表示来促进知识转移和提高样本效率的方法。

目的: 在具有T个并发线性带臂任务的设置中，每个任务具有特征维度d，共享一个维数r远小于min{d,T}的公共潜在表示，提出一种新的乐观不确定性线性算法。

方法: 算法首先通过探索阶段收集数据，通过谱初始化估计共享模型，然后在新构建的置信集上进行基于OFUL的学习。

主要发现: 算法在累积遗憾方面达到了ilde{O}(\sqrt{drNT})，显著优于独立解决T个任务的方法，其遗憾为ilde{O}(dTackslash sqrt{N})。

结论: 数值模拟验证了该算法在不同问题规模下的性能。

翻译: 多任务表示学习是一种通过学习相关任务间的共享潜在表示来促进知识转移和提高样本效率的方法。本文在具有T个并发线性带臂任务的设置中，每个任务具有特征维度d，共享一个维数r远小于min{d,T}的公共潜在表示，提出了一种新的乐观不确定性线性算法，该算法利用共享低秩表示来以样本高效的方式增强决策制定。算法首先通过探索阶段收集数据，通过谱初始化估计共享模型，然后在新构建的置信集上进行基于OFUL的学习。我们为置信集提供了理论保证，并证明了未知奖励向量以高概率位于置信集内。我们推导了累积遗憾界限，并表明所提出的方法达到了ilde{O}(ackslash sqrt{drNT})，显著优于独立解决T个任务的方法，其遗憾为ilde{O}(dTackslash sqrt{N})。我们进行了数值模拟以验证该算法在不同问题规模下的性能。

Abstract

Multi-task representation learning is an approach that learns shared latent representations across related tasks, facilitating knowledge transfer and improving sample efficiency. This paper introduces a novel approach to multi-task representation learning in linear bandits. We consider a setting with T concurrent linear bandit tasks, each with feature dimension d, that share a common latent representation of dimension r \ll min{d,T}$, capturing their underlying relatedness. We propose a new Optimism in the Face of Uncertainty Linear (OFUL) algorithm that leverages shared low-rank representations to enhance decision-making in a sample-efficient manner. Our algorithm first collects data through an exploration phase, estimates the shared model via spectral initialization, and then conducts OFUL based learning over a newly constructed confidence set. We provide theoretical guarantees for the confidence set and prove that the unknown reward vectors lie within the confidence set with high probability. We derive cumulative regret bounds and show that the proposed approach achieves \tilde{O}(\sqrt{drNT}), a significant improvement over solving the T tasks independently, resulting in a regret of \tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{N}). We performed numerical simulations to validate the performance of our algorithm for different problem sizes.

item.title: FreqPhys: Repurposing Implicit Physiological Frequency Prior for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography
item.author: Wei Qian, Dan Guo, Jinxing Zhou, Bochao Zou, Zitong Yu, Meng Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 FreqPhys 的频率引导远程光电容积描记法框架，旨在通过显式利用生理频率先验信息来增强信号恢复的鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的远程光电容积描记法方法主要依赖时域建模，容易受到运动伪影和光照波动的影响，导致微弱的生理线索被噪声淹没。

目的: 为了解决这些挑战，提出 FreqPhys 框架，通过显式建模生理频率先验来提高信号恢复的鲁棒性。

方法: FreqPhys 框架包含四个主要部分：首先应用生理带通滤波模块抑制带外干扰；然后进行生理频谱调制和自适应频谱选择以强调脉冲相关频率分量并抑制带内残留噪声；接着通过跨域表示学习模块融合频谱先验与深度时域特征以捕捉时空依赖性；最后使用频率感知条件扩散过程逐步重建高保真 rPPG 信号。

主要发现: 在六个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FreqPhys 相比最先进的方法取得了显著改进，特别是在具有挑战性的运动条件下。

结论: 研究强调了显式建模生理频率先验的重要性。

翻译: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring by capturing subtle skin-color variations from facial videos. However, most existing methods predominantly rely on time-domain modeling, making them vulnerable to motion artifacts and illumination fluctuations, where weak physiological clues are easily overwhelmed by noise. To address these challenges, we propose FreqPhys, a frequency-guided rPPG framework that explicitly leverages physiological frequency priors for robust signal recovery. Specifically, FreqPhys first applies a Physiological Bandpass Filtering module to suppress out-of-band interference, and then performs Physiological Spectrum Modulation together with adaptive spectral selection to emphasize pulse-related frequency components while suppress residual in-band noise. A Cross-domain Representation Learning module further fuses these spectral priors with deep time-domain features to capture informative spatial--temporal dependencies. Finally, a frequency-aware conditional diffusion process progressively reconstructs high-fidelity rPPG signals. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that FreqPhys yields significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches, particularly under challenging motion conditions. It highlights the importance of explicitly modeling physiological frequency priors. The source code will be released.

Abstract

Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring by capturing subtle skin-color variations from facial videos. However, most existing methods predominantly rely on time-domain modeling, making them vulnerable to motion artifacts and illumination fluctuations, where weak physiological clues are easily overwhelmed by noise. To address these challenges, we propose FreqPhys, a frequency-guided rPPG framework that explicitly leverages physiological frequency priors for robust signal recovery. Specifically, FreqPhys first applies a Physiological Bandpass Filtering module to suppress out-of-band interference, and then performs Physiological Spectrum Modulation together with adaptive spectral selection to emphasize pulse-related frequency components while suppress residual in-band noise. A Cross-domain Representation Learning module further fuses these spectral priors with deep time-domain features to capture informative spatial--temporal dependencies. Finally, a frequency-aware conditional diffusion process progressively reconstructs high-fidelity rPPG signals. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that FreqPhys yields significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches, particularly under challenging motion conditions. It highlights the importance of explicitly modeling physiological frequency priors. The source code will be released.

item.title: TF-SSD: A Strong Pipeline via Synergic Mask Filter for Training-free Co-salient Object Detection
item.author: Zhijin He, Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Shuwei Wu, Bingfeng Zhang, Li Yu, Jimin Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于视觉基础模型的无训练Co-salient Object Detection方法，通过结合SAM和DINO模型来生成和筛选显著对象掩码。

背景: 现有的基于训练的CoSOD方法受限于封闭数据集且泛化能力有限，而视觉基础模型展现出强大的泛化能力和鲁棒的显著理解能力。

目的: 利用视觉基础模型解决CoSOD问题，提出一种新的无训练方法。

方法: 首先利用SAM生成原始候选掩码池，然后通过质量掩码生成器过滤冗余掩码，接着使用DINO的注意力图进行图像内显著过滤，最后通过跨图像原型选择器计算相似度分数来选择最终掩码。

主要发现: TF-SSD在实验中优于现有方法，比最近的训练无方法高出13.7%。

结论: TF-SSD是一种有效的无训练CoSOD方法，通过SAM和DINO的协同作用实现了显著的性能提升。

翻译: Co-salient Object Detection (CoSOD) 旨在分割一组相关图像中一致出现的显著对象。尽管最近的基于训练的方法取得了显著进展，但它们仍然受到封闭数据集的限制，且泛化能力有限。然而，很少有研究探索视觉基础模型在CoSOD中的潜力，这些模型表现出强大的泛化能力和鲁棒的显著理解能力。在本文中，我们调查并利用视觉基础模型来解决CoSOD问题，并通过SAM和DINO的协同作用提出了一种新的无训练方法。具体而言，我们首先利用SAM生成全面的原始候选掩码，作为候选掩码池。然后，我们引入一个质量掩码生成器来过滤掉冗余掩码，从而获得精炼的掩码集。由于该生成器基于SAM构建，因此缺乏对显著性的语义理解。为此，我们采用了一种图像内显著过滤器，利用DINO的注意力图来识别单个图像中的视觉显著掩码。此外，为了在组图像之间扩展显著理解，我们提出了一种跨图像原型选择器，它计算跨图像原型之间的相似度分数以选择得分最高的掩码。这些选定的掩码作为CoSOD的最终预测。大量实验表明，我们的TF-SSD优于现有方法（例如，比最近的训练无方法高出13.7%）。代码可在 https://github.com/hzz-yy/TF-SSD 获取。

Abstract

Co-salient Object Detection (CoSOD) aims to segment salient objects that consistently appear across a group of related images. Despite the notable progress achieved by recent training-based approaches, they still remain constrained by the closed-set datasets and exhibit limited generalization. However, few studies explore the potential of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to address CoSOD, which demonstrate a strong generalized ability and robust saliency understanding. In this paper, we investigate and leverage VFMs for CoSOD, and further propose a novel training-free method, TF-SSD, through the synergy between SAM and DINO. Specifically, we first utilize SAM to generate comprehensive raw proposals, which serve as a candidate mask pool. Then, we introduce a quality mask generator to filter out redundant masks, thereby acquiring a refined mask set. Since this generator is built upon SAM, it inherently lacks semantic understanding of saliency. To this end, we adopt an intra-image saliency filter that employs DINO's attention maps to identify visually salient masks within individual images. Moreover, to extend saliency understanding across group images, we propose an inter-image prototype selector, which computes similarity scores among cross-image prototypes to select masks with the highest score. These selected masks serve as final predictions for CoSOD. Extensive experiments show that our TF-SSD outperforms existing methods (e.g., 13.7\% gains over the recent training-free method). Codes are available at https://github.com/hzz-yy/TF-SSD.

item.title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems
item.author: Mingming Ha, Guanchen Wang, Linxun Chen, Xuan Rao, Yuexin Shi, Tianbao Ma, Zhaojie Liu, Yunqian Fan, Zilong Lu, Yanan Niu, Han Li, Kun Gai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文提出了一种名为UniMixer的统一推荐模型架构，旨在提升推荐系统的扩展效率并建立统一的理论框架，通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转化为可参数化的结构，设计了一个通用的参数化特征混合模块，并进一步提出了轻量级的UniMixing-Lite模块以降低计算成本同时提升性能。

背景: 近年来，推荐模型的缩放定律受到越来越多的关注，这些定律 governing了推荐器性能与参数/计算量之间的关系。目前主要有三种主流架构来实现推荐模型的缩放，即基于注意力的、基于TokenMixer的和基于因子分解机的。

目的: 提出一种统一的推荐系统缩放架构，即UniMixer，以改善缩放效率并建立统一的理论框架，统一主流的缩放块。

方法: 将基于规则的TokenMixer转化为等效的参数化结构，构建了通用的参数化特征混合模块，允许在模型训练期间优化和学习token混合模式。此外，还设计了一个轻量级的UniMixing-Lite模块。

主要发现: 通过广泛的离线和在线实验验证了UniMixer的优越缩放能力。

结论: UniMixer通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转化为可参数化的结构，构建了通用的参数化特征混合模块，并设计了轻量级的UniMixing-Lite模块，从而在显著提升模型性能的同时压缩了模型参数和计算成本。

翻译: 近年来，推荐模型的缩放定律引起了越来越多的关注，这些定律 govern了推荐器性能与参数/计算量之间的关系。目前，有三种主流架构来实现推荐模型的缩放，即基于注意力的、基于TokenMixer的和基于因子分解机的。本文提出了一种统一的推荐系统缩放架构，即UniMixer，以改善缩放效率并建立统一的理论框架，统一主流的缩放块。通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转化为等效的参数化结构，构建了通用的参数化特征混合模块，允许在模型训练期间优化和学习token混合模式。此外，还设计了一个轻量级的UniMixing-Lite模块。通过广泛的离线和在线实验验证了UniMixer的优越缩放能力。
