如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

In recent years, the scaling laws of recommendation models have attracted increasing attention, which govern the relationship between performance and parameters/FLOPs of recommenders. Currently, there are three mainstream architectures for achieving scaling in recommendation models, namely attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods, which exhibit fundamental differences in both design philosophy and architectural structure. In this paper, we propose a unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems, namely \textbf{UniMixer}, to improve scaling efficiency and establish a unified theoretical framework that unifies the mainstream scaling blocks. By transforming the rule-based TokenMixer to an equivalent parameterized structure, we construct a generalized parameterized feature mixing module that allows the token mixing patterns to be optimized and learned during model training. Meanwhile, the generalized parameterized token mixing removes the constraint in TokenMixer that requires the number of heads to be equal to the number of tokens. Furthermore, we establish a unified scaling module design framework for recommender systems, which bridges the connections among attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods. To further boost scaling ROI, a lightweight UniMixing module is designed, \textbf{UniMixing-Lite}, which further compresses the model parameters and computational cost while significantly improve the model performance. The scaling curves are shown in the following figure. Extensive offline and online experiments are conducted to verify the superior scaling abilities of \textbf{UniMixer}.

item.title: Towards Viewpoint-Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving with 3D Foundation Model Priors
item.author: Hiroki Hashimoto, Hiromichi Goto, Hiroyuki Sugai, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种无需数据增强的鲁棒轨迹规划方法，利用3D基础模型的几何先验来应对相机视角变化。

背景: 现有的模型往往严重依赖训练过程中观察到的相机视角。

目的: 研究一种增强方法，以减少相机视角变化对性能的负面影响。

方法: 该方法利用3D基础模型的几何先验，将深度估计得出的每个像素的3D位置作为位置嵌入注入，并通过交叉注意力融合中间几何特征。

主要发现: 在VR-Drive相机视角扰动基准测试中，该方法在大多数扰动条件下减少了性能下降，特别是在俯仰角和高度扰动下有显著改善，但在纵向平移下的增益较小。

结论: 需要更多视角无关的集成方法来提高对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。

翻译: 在相机视角变化下进行鲁棒的轨迹规划对于可扩展的端到端自动驾驶至关重要。然而，现有模型往往严重依赖训练过程中观察到的相机视角。我们研究了一种无需数据增强的方法，该方法利用3D基础模型的几何先验。该方法将深度估计得出的每个像素的3D位置作为位置嵌入注入，并通过交叉注意力融合中间几何特征。在VR-Drive相机视角扰动基准测试中，该方法在大多数扰动条件下减少了性能下降，特别是在俯仰角和高度扰动下有显著改善。在纵向平移下的增益较小，这表明需要更多视角无关的集成方法来提高对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有端到端自动驾驶模型在相机视角发生变化时性能显著下降的问题。在现实应用中，不同车辆平台的传感器配置差异会导致相机视角不同，若每次部署都需要重新训练，成本过高且难以操作。因此，提高模型对未见视角的鲁棒性对于实现可扩展的自动驾驶系统至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有模型严重依赖训练时的相机视角，因此思考如何利用3D基础模型的知识来增强模型对未见视角的鲁棒性。他们借鉴了VR-Drive处理视角变化和World4Drive使用深度估计的思路，设计了两个模块：一是利用深度估计将像素转换为3D位置并作为位置嵌入；二是通过交叉注意力将3D模型的中间特征融合到图像特征中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用 3D 基础模型的几何先验来增强端到端自动驾驶模型对未见相机视角变化的鲁棒性，无需额外数据增强。实现流程包括：首先利用 3D 基础模型计算场景的深度和每个像素的 3D 位置，将其作为位置嵌入注入图像特征；接着通过交叉注意力融合 3D 基础模型的中间特征；最后将融合后的特征输入规划模块以预测轨迹。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了两个模块：一是3D空间编码器，它利用3D基础模型（DA3）的深度估计来计算像素的3D位置，并将其作为位置嵌入注入图像特征；二是几何特征融合模块，通过交叉注意力将3D基础模型的中间几何特征融合进图像特征。相比之前的工作，本文采用了一种无需数据增强的方法，利用预训练的3D基础模型的通用几何知识来提高模型对未见相机视角的鲁棒性，而不是仅仅依赖增加训练时的视角多样性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种无需数据增强的方法，利用3D基础模型的几何先验来提升端到端自动驾驶模型对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。该方法通过将深度估计得到的3D位置信息和几何特征融合到图像特征中，有效减少了模型在训练视角之外的性能下降。

Abstract

Robust trajectory planning under camera viewpoint changes is important for scalable end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing models often depend heavily on the camera viewpoints seen during training. We investigate an augmentation-free approach that leverages geometric priors from a 3D foundation model. The method injects per-pixel 3D positions derived from depth estimates as positional embeddings and fuses intermediate geometric features through cross-attention. Experiments on the VR-Drive camera viewpoint perturbation benchmark show reduced performance degradation under most perturbation conditions, with clear improvements under pitch and height perturbations. Gains under longitudinal translation are smaller, suggesting that more viewpoint-agnostic integration is needed for robustness to camera viewpoint changes.

item.title: TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
item.author: Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Bingfeng Zhang, Chao Yao, Meiqin Liu, Jimin Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TALENT的新框架，旨在解决参数高效微调方法在指代图像分割中出现的非目标激活问题，通过引入目标感知的高效微调策略来提高分割精度。

背景: 参数高效微调在指代图像分割中显示出前景，但现有方法存在视觉特征无法强调文本所指目标实例，反而激活无关同类对象的问题。

目的: 提出一种名为TALENT的新框架，利用目标感知的高效微调来解决参数高效微调方法中存在的非目标激活问题，从而提高分割的准确性。

方法: TALENT框架包含两个主要组件：Rectified Cost Aggregator用于高效聚合文本所指特征；Target-aware Learning Mechanism包括上下文对一致性学习和以目标为中心的对比学习，用于校准非目标激活并增强目标定位。

主要发现: TALENT在多个指标上优于现有方法，例如在G-Ref验证集上mIoU提升了2.5%。

结论: TALENT框架通过目标感知的高效微调有效解决了非目标激活问题，显著提升了指代图像分割的性能。

翻译: 指代图像分割旨在根据自然语言表达式分割特定目标。最近，参数高效微调显示出前景。然而，现有的基于PET的方法经常存在视觉特征无法强调文本所指目标实例，而是激活无关同类对象的问题。我们分析和量化了这一问题，称之为非目标激活问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为TALENT的新框架，利用目标感知的高效微调进行基于PET的RIS。具体来说，我们首先提出了Rectified Cost Aggregator来高效聚合文本所指特征。然后，为了将非目标激活校准为准确的目标激活，我们采用了目标感知学习机制，包括上下文对一致性学习和以目标为中心的对比学习。前者使用句子级文本特征实现对照物的整体理解，并构建文本所指亲和图来优化视觉特征的语义关联。后者进一步增强了目标定位以发现不同的实例，同时抑制与其他无关对象的关联。这两个目标协同工作并有效地解决了非目标激活问题。大量评估表明，TALENT在各种指标上优于现有方法（例如，在G-Ref验证集上mIoU增益2.5%）。我们的代码将在：https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT发布。

Abstract

Referring image segmentation aims to segment specific targets based on a natural text expression. Recently, parameter-efficient tuning (PET) has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing PET-based methods often suffer from the fact that visual features can't emphasize the text-referred target instance but activate co-category yet unrelated objects. We analyze and quantify this problem, terming it the `non-target activation' (NTA) issue. To address this, we propose a novel framework, TALENT, which utilizes target-aware efficient tuning for PET-based RIS. Specifically, we first propose a Rectified Cost Aggregator (RCA) to efficiently aggregate text-referred features. Then, to calibrate `NTA' into accurate target activation, we adopt a Target-aware Learning Mechanism (TLM), including contextual pairwise consistency learning and target-centric contrastive learning. The former uses the sentence-level text feature to achieve a holistic understanding of the referent and constructs a text-referred affinity map to optimize the semantic association of visual features. The latter further enhances target localization to discover the distinct instance while suppressing associations with other unrelated ones. The two objectives work in concert and address `NTA' effectively. Extensive evaluations show that TALENT outperforms existing methods across various metrics (e.g., 2.5\% mIoU gains on G-Ref val set). Our codes will be released at: https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT.

item.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
item.author: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了面向大语言模型（LLMs）的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，旨在解决离线策略蒸馏中因训练与推理不匹配导致的误差累积问题。

背景: 现有的知识蒸馏主要采用离线策略，即学生模型在静态教师生成的数据上训练，从未见过自己的错误，导致推理时的自回归误差累积。

目的: 提供首个关于面向LLMs的在线策略蒸馏的全面综述，并引入统一的框架来组织该领域。

方法: 引入了一个统一的框架，基于在线样本分析代表性方法，并从反馈信号、教师访问权限和损失粒度三个正交维度对方法进行组织。

主要发现: 将OPD文献分为基于对数概率的反馈、基于结果的反馈或自我博弈；教师访问方式包括白盒、黑盒或无教师；损失粒度包括词元级、序列级或混合。

结论: 识别了开放性问题，包括蒸馏缩放定律、不确定性感知反馈以及智能体级蒸馏。

翻译: Knowledge distillation has become a primary mechanism for transferring reasoning and domain expertise from frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, deployable students. However, the dominant paradigm remains off-policy: students train on static teacher-generated data and never encounter their own errors during learning. This train--test mismatch, an instance of exposure bias, causes prediction errors to compound autoregressively at inference time. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) addresses this by letting the student generate its own trajectories and receive teacher feedback on these self-generated outputs, grounding distillation in the theory of interactive imitation learning. Despite rapid growth spanning divergence minimization, reward-guided learning, and self-play, the OPD literature remains fragmented with no unified treatment. This survey provides the first comprehensive overview of OPD for LLMs. We introduce a unified f-divergence framework over on-policy samples and organize the landscape along three orthogonal dimensions: feedback signal (logit-based, outcome-based, or self-play), teacher access (white-box, black-box, or teacher-free), and loss granularity (token-level, sequence-level, or hybrid). We systematically analyze representative methods, examine industrial deployments, and identify open problems including distillation scaling laws, uncertainty-aware feedback, and agent-level distillation.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决大语言模型在线策略蒸馏方法的研究现状梳理问题。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为它为该领域提供了系统的总结和分类，帮助研究者快速了解如何利用在线策略来优化和压缩大模型。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 1. **分析请求：** * **角色：** 严谨的学术论文助手。 * **输入：** 一段 PDF 文件内容（arXiv 论文《A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models》的元数据/结构）。 * **任务：** 回答“一个”问题：“这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？” * **约束条件：** * 基于输入文本回答（不要编造）。 * 简洁、准确、通俗的中文解释。 * 避免公式、符号或缩写。 * 如果文中没有明确说明，写 "unknown"。 * 简短（2-4 句）。 * 不要输出 JSON、markdown、代码块或额外文字。 * *关键观察：* 输入文本*仅*包含 PDF 元数据、目录结构（大纲）和部分二进制流（乱码）。它*不*包含论文的实际文本内容（摘要、引言、方法、结论）。2. **分析输入文本：** * `2 0 obj`：标题为 "A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models"。 * `3 0 obj`：元数据（作者、DOI、arXiv ID）。 * `6 0 obj`：大纲（`/Count 9`，`/First 10 0 R`，`/Last 11 0 R`）。这表明有 9 个大纲项。 * `10 0 obj`：大纲项 1（`/Title 29 0 R` -> "Introduction"）。 * `11 0 obj`：大纲项 2（`/Title 32 0 R` -> "Conclusion"）。 * `22 0 obj`：一个二进制流（压缩内容）。我无法直接读取它，但通常，`/Contents` 数组包含页面内容。然而，提示要求我基于*输入文本*回答。输入文本*不*包含关于“核心思想”或“实现流程”的描述性文本。它只有结构信息。3. **确定答案：** * 提示要求解释“这个方法”的核心思想和流程。 * 输入文本是*关于*一篇论文的元数据，而不是论文本身。 * 因此，输入文本中*不*包含关于“核心思想”或“实现流程”的信息。 * 约束条件指出：“如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'，不要编造。”4. **起草回复：** * 草稿 1：输入文本仅包含论文的元数据和目录结构，没有描述具体方法的核心思想或实现流程的详细内容。 * 草稿 2（更简洁）：输入文本仅包含论文的元数据和目录结构，未提供关于核心思想和实现流程的具体描述，因此无法回答。5. **根据约束条件进行优化：** * “简洁、准确、通俗”：草稿 2 很好。 * “避免公式/符号”：已检查。 * “如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”：由于输入文本*没有*这些信息，严格来说，答案是“unknown”或“未提供”。然而，通常在这些提示中，如果用户*期望*我阅读论文（但提供了损坏/元数据），我应该说明信息缺失。提示说“基于输入文本回答”。文本*不*包含答案。 * Abstract

Knowledge distillation has become a primary mechanism for transferring reasoning and domain expertise from frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, deployable students. However, the dominant paradigm remains \textit{off-policy}: students train on static teacher-generated data and never encounter their own errors during learning. This train--test mismatch, an instance of \textit{exposure bias}, causes prediction errors to compound autoregressively at inference time. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) addresses this by letting the student generate its own trajectories and receive teacher feedback on these self-generated outputs, grounding distillation in the theory of interactive imitation learning. Despite rapid growth spanning divergence minimization, reward-guided learning, and self-play, the OPD literature remains fragmented with no unified treatment. This survey provides the first comprehensive overview of OPD for LLMs. We introduce a unified $f$-divergence framework over on-policy samples and organize the landscape along three orthogonal dimensions: \emph{feedback signal} (logit-based, outcome-based, or self-play), \emph{teacher access} (white-box, black-box, or teacher-free), and \emph{loss granularity} (token-level, sequence-level, or hybrid). We systematically analyze representative methods, examine industrial deployments, and identify open problems including distillation scaling laws, uncertainty-aware feedback, and agent-level distillation.

item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OJALA是一个基于Transformer的自回归基础模型，用于同时分类天体对象并推断其物理参数。

背景: 大规模调查需要高效的机器学习技术来利用海量数据集的信息。

目的: 利用J-PAS的54个窄带和DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys及WISE的宽带数据，同时分类天体对象并推断其物理参数。

方法: 该模型基于Transformer架构，在约2000万个由DESI DR1光谱生成的合成光谱能量分布（SED）上进行训练。

主要发现: 模型在i<21时对光谱分类（恒星、星系和类星体）的加权F1分数约为0.9；星系照片红移精度为σ_NMAD<0.01，类星体在z>1.5时精度显著提高，在z≈3.5时达到σ_NMAD≈0.006；模型能恢复星系的质量和恒星形成率，散射分别为0.11 dex和0.22 dex；准确预测主要光学发射线的等效宽度，允许推导消光校正的Hα光度，散射为0.29 dex；在BPT和WHAN诊断图中成功重现，分类恒星形成、活动星系核和被动星系，F1分数通常在70%到90%之间；对恒星可靠推断有效温度和金属度，尽管表面重力仍具挑战性；通过微调预训练嵌入预测黑洞质量，恢复光谱维里估计，精度约为0.5 dex。

结论: OJALA成功重现了BPT和WHAN诊断图，对恒星有效温度和金属度推断可靠，展示了架构的模块化特性，并发布了代码、模型权重和J-PAS EDR的综合VAC。

翻译: 大规模调查的出现需要高效的机器学习技术来利用海量数据集的信息。我们提出了OJALA，一个基于Transformer的自回归基础模型，旨在利用来自J-PAS的54个窄带和来自DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys及WISE的宽带数据，同时分类天体对象并推断其物理参数。该模型在约2000万个由DESI DR1光谱生成的合成光谱能量分布上进行训练。我们使用J-PAS和DESI之间约12.1万个对象的交叉匹配样本验证OJALA。模型在i<21时对光谱分类（恒星、星系和类星体）的加权F1分数约为0.9。对于星系，我们以σ_NMAD<0.01的精度恢复照片红移，而对于类星体，精度在z>1.5时显著提高，在z≈3.5时达到σ_NMAD≈0.006。我们展示了星系物理性质的稳健估计，以约0.11 dex和0.22 dex的散射恢复恒星质量和恒星形成率。此外，模型准确预测主要光学发射线的等效宽度，允许以0.29 dex的散射推导消光校正的Hα光度。OJALA成功重现了BPT和WHAN诊断图，分类恒星形成、活动星系核和被动星系，F1分数通常在70%到90%之间，取决于诊断类别。对于恒星，模型可靠地推断有效温度和金属度，尽管表面重力仍然具有挑战性。最后，我们通过微调预训练嵌入来预测黑洞质量，展示了架构的模块化特性，这是一个在主要训练中未包含的属性，以约0.5 dex的精度恢复光谱维里估计。我们发布了代码、模型权重和J-PAS EDR的综合VAC。

Abstract

The advent of large-scale surveys requires efficient ML techniques to exploit the information of massive datasets. We present OJALA, a transformer-based autoregressive foundation model designed to simultaneously classify astronomical objects and infer their physical parameters using 54 narrow bands from J-PAS, combined with broad bands from the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys and WISE. The model is trained on $\sim20$ million synthetic SEDs generated from DESI DR1 spectra. We validate OJALA using a cross-matched sample of $\sim121,000$ objects between J-PAS and DESI. The model achieves a weighted F1-score of approximately 0.9 for spectral classification (stars, galaxies, and QSOs) at $i < 21$. For galaxies, we recover photo-z with a precision of $σ_{\rm NMAD} < 0.01$, while for QSOs, the precision improves significantly at $z > 1.5$, reaching $σ_{\rm NMAD} \approx 0.006$ at $z \approx 3.5$. We demonstrate robust estimation of physical properties for galaxies, recovering stellar masses and SFR with a scatter of approximately 0.11 dex and 0.22 dex, respectively. Furthermore, the model accurately predicts EWs for major optical emission lines, allowing for the derivation of extinction-corrected H$α$ luminosities with a scatter of 0.29 dex. OJALA successfully reproduces the BPT and WHAN diagnostic diagrams, classifying SF, AGN, and passive galaxies with F1-scores typically ranging from 70% to 90% depending on the diagnostic class. For stars, the model reliably infers effective temperature and metallicity, though surface gravity remains challenging. Finally, we show the modularity of the architecture by fine-tuning the pre-trained embeddings to predict BH masses, a property not included in the primary training, recovering spectroscopic virial estimates with a precision of approximately 0.5 dex. We release the code, model weights, and a comprehensive VAC for the J-PAS EDR.

item.title: CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models
item.author: Haiyang Guo, Yichen Shi, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Hongbo Zhao, Fanhu Zeng, Shijie Ma, Da-Han Wang, Xu-Yao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CL-VISTA是一个为视频大语言模型持续学习设计的基准测试，包含8个多样化任务和全面的评估框架。

背景: 现有基准测试存在局限性，如依赖无大规模预训练的模型、任务划分导致高冗余和遗忘问题，无法有效评估现代基础模型。

目的: 提出CL-VISTA基准测试，以评估视频大语言模型在持续视频理解中的表现，并建立包含性能、计算效率和内存占用的综合评估框架。

方法: 通过策划8个涵盖感知、理解和推理的多样化任务来诱导显著的分布变化，建立包含6种不同协议的评估框架，并在性能维度中加入通用视频理解评估。

主要发现: 主流持续学习方法存在权衡，成功缓解灾难性遗忘的方法往往在泛化能力或计算/内存开销上有所妥协，没有单一方法在所有维度上表现优越。

结论: CL-VISTA为多模态基础模型的持续学习提供了关键见解，揭示了方法间的权衡关系。

翻译: CL-VISTA是一个为视频大语言模型持续学习设计的基准测试，包含8个多样化任务和全面的评估框架。现有基准测试存在局限性，如依赖无大规模预训练的模型、任务划分导致高冗余和遗忘问题，无法有效评估现代基础模型。CL-VISTA通过策划8个涵盖感知、理解和推理的多样化任务来诱导显著的分布变化，并建立包含6种不同协议的评估框架，在性能维度中加入通用视频理解评估。研究发现主流持续学习方法存在权衡，成功缓解灾难性遗忘的方法往往在泛化能力或计算/内存开销上有所妥协，没有单一方法在所有维度上表现优越。CL-VISTA为多模态基础模型的持续学习提供了关键见解，揭示了方法间的权衡关系。

Abstract

Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) require continual learning to adapt to non-stationary real-world data. However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating modern foundation models: many still rely on models without large-scale pre-training, and prevailing benchmarks typically partition a single dataset into sub-tasks, resulting in high task redundancy and negligible forgetting on pre-trained Video-LLMs. To address these limitations, we propose CL-VISTA, a benchmark tailored for continual video understanding of Video-LLMs. By curating 8 diverse tasks spanning perception, understanding, and reasoning, CL-VISTA induces substantial distribution shifts that effectively expose catastrophic forgetting. To systematically assess CL methods, we establish a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising 6 distinct protocols across 3 critical dimensions: performance, computational efficiency, and memory footprint. Notably, the performance dimension incorporates a general video understanding assessment to assess whether CL methods genuinely enhance foundational intelligence or merely induce task-specific overfitting. Extensive benchmarking of 10 mainstream CL methods reveals a fundamental trade-off: no single approach achieves universal superiority across all dimensions. Methods that successfully mitigate catastrophic forgetting tend to compromise generalization or incur prohibitive computational and memory overheads. We hope CL-VISTA provides critical insights for advancing continual learning in multimodal foundation models.

item.title: Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations
item.author: Ritish Shrirao, Aditya Priyadarshi, Raghuram Bharadwaj Diddigi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FG-SFRQL的算法，通过最小化全均方贝尔曼误差来优化后继特征表示，以解决标准半梯度方法在非线性函数近似和多任务设置中的不稳定性问题。

背景: 后继特征结合广义策略改进提供了一种强大的强化学习迁移学习框架，但标准后继特征学习方法通常依赖半梯度时间差分更新，在结合非线性函数近似时缺乏稳健的收敛保证，且容易导致不稳定性。

目的: 受全梯度DQN启发，提出全梯度后继特征表示Q学习（FG-SFRQL）算法，通过优化后继特征来最小化全均方贝尔曼误差。

方法: FG-SFRQL算法通过最小化全均方贝尔曼误差来优化后继特征，与标准方法不同，该方法分别对在线网络和目标网络的参数计算梯度。

主要发现: 理论证明FG-SFRQL具有几乎必然的收敛性，实验表明最小化全残差相比半梯度基线在样本效率和迁移性能上表现更优。

结论: FG-SFRQL在离散和连续域中均优于半梯度基线，证明了其在强化学习迁移学习中的有效性。

翻译: 后继特征结合广义策略改进为强化学习中的迁移学习提供了一个稳健的框架，通过将环境动力学与奖励函数解耦。然而，标准后继特征学习方法通常依赖于半梯度时间差分更新。当与非线性的函数近似结合时，半梯度方法缺乏稳健的收敛保证，并可能导致不稳定性，特别是在多任务设置中，准确的特征估计对于有效的广义策略改进至关重要。受全梯度DQN的启发，我们提出了全梯度后继特征表示Q学习（FG-SFRQL），这是一种通过最小化全均方贝尔曼误差来优化后继特征的算法。与标准方法不同，我们的方法分别对在线网络和目标网络中的参数计算梯度。我们提供了FG-SFRQL几乎必然收敛的理论证明，并实证表明，与离散和连续域中的半梯度基线相比，最小化全残差带来了更高的样本效率和迁移性能。

Abstract

Successor Features (SF) combined with Generalized Policy Improvement (GPI) provide a robust framework for transfer learning in Reinforcement Learning (RL) by decoupling environment dynamics from reward functions. However, standard SF learning methods typically rely on semi-gradient Temporal Difference (TD) updates. When combined with non-linear function approximation, semi-gradient methods lack robust convergence guarantees and can lead to instability, particularly in the multi-task setting where accurate feature estimation is critical for effective GPI. Inspired by Full Gradient DQN, we propose Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations Q-Learning (FG-SFRQL), an algorithm that optimizes the successor features by minimizing the full Mean Squared Bellman Error. Unlike standard approaches, our method computes gradients with respect to parameters in both the online and target networks. We provide a theoretical proof of almost-sure convergence for FG-SFRQL and demonstrate empirically that minimizing the full residual leads to superior sample efficiency and transfer performance compared to semi-gradient baselines in both discrete and continuous domains.

item.title: Learning to Hint for Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Yu Xia, Canwen Xu, Zhewei Yao, Julian McAuley, Yuxiong He
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HiLL的框架，用于在强化学习中解决优势崩溃问题，通过联合训练提示策略和推理策略来生成适应性提示。

背景: GRPO在奖励可验证的强化学习中广泛使用，但常因优势崩溃而失效，即当组内所有rollouts获得相同奖励时，无法提供学习信号。

目的: 为了解决现有提示方法固定且可能无法有效提升测试时无提示策略的问题，提出HiLL框架，使提示能够适应推理策略的演变错误。

方法: HiLL框架联合训练提示策略和推理策略；提示策略根据当前推理策略的错误rollout在线生成提示；引入提示依赖性来衡量正确提示轨迹对提示的依赖程度；使用转移加权奖励训练提示策略。

主要发现: 实验表明，HiLL在多个基准测试中持续优于GRPO和先前的基于提示的基线；较低的提示依赖性意味着更强的从提示成功到无提示成功的转移。

结论: 自适应且转移感知的提示学习对强化学习具有价值，HiLL验证了这一点。

翻译: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 在奖励可验证的强化学习中被广泛使用，但它经常遭受优势崩溃：当组内的所有rollouts获得相同的奖励时，该组产生零相对优势，从而没有学习信号。例如，如果一个问题对于推理者来说太难，所有采样的rollouts都可能是错误的，并获得零奖励。最近的工作通过向这类难题添加提示或辅助支架来解决这个问题，以便推理者产生混合结果并恢复非零更新。然而，现有的提示通常是固定的，而不是适应当前的推理者；在提示输入下产生学习信号的提示并不一定改善测试时使用的无提示策略。为此，我们提出了强化学习的提示学习，一个在RL期间联合训练提示策略和推理策略的框架。对于每个难题，提示策略根据当前推理者的错误rollout在线生成提示，使提示生成能够适应推理者不断演变的错误。我们进一步引入了提示依赖性，它衡量正确提示轨迹对提示的依赖程度有多强。我们推导出一个转移性结果，表明较低的提示依赖性意味着更强的从提示成功到无提示成功的转移，我们使用这个结果来定义一个转移加权的奖励来训练提示策略。因此，HiLL不仅倾向于恢复信息丰富的GRPO组，而且倾向于产生更有可能改善原始无提示策略的信号。在多个基准测试中的实验表明，HiLL持续优于GRPO和先前的基于提示的基线，证明了自适应和转移感知的提示学习对RL的价值。代码可在 https://github.com/Andree-9/HiLL 获取。

Abstract

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, but it often suffers from advantage collapse: when all rollouts in a group receive the same reward, the group yields zero relative advantage and thus no learning signal. For example, if a question is too hard for the reasoner, all sampled rollouts can be incorrect and receive zero reward. Recent work addresses this issue by adding hints or auxiliary scaffolds to such hard questions so that the reasoner produces mixed outcomes and recovers a non-zero update. However, existing hints are usually fixed rather than adapted to the current reasoner, and a hint that creates learning signal under the hinted input does not necessarily improve the no-hint policy used at test time. To this end, we propose Hint Learning for Reinforcement Learning (HiLL), a framework that jointly trains a hinter policy and a reasoner policy during RL. For each hard question, the hinter generates hints online conditioned on the current reasoner's incorrect rollout, allowing hint generation to adapt to the reasoner's evolving errors. We further introduce hint reliance, which measures how strongly correct hinted trajectories depend on the hint. We derive a transferability result showing that lower hint reliance implies stronger transfer from hinted success to no-hint success, and we use this result to define a transfer-weighted reward for training the hinter. Therefore, HiLL favors hints that not only recover informative GRPO groups, but also produce signals that are more likely to improve the original no-hint policy. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that HiLL consistently outperforms GRPO and prior hint-based baselines, demonstrating the value of adaptive and transfer-aware hint learning for RL. The code is available at https://github.com/Andree-9/HiLL.

item.title: BioCOMPASS: Integrating Biomarkers into Transformer-Based Immunotherapy Response Prediction
item.author: Sayed Hashim, Frank Soboczenski, Paul Cairns
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BioCOMPASS是一个改进的COMPASS模型，通过整合生物标志物和治疗信息来增强免疫治疗反应预测的泛化能力。

背景: 免疫治疗反应预测数据集通常规模较小，且癌症类型、药物和测序仪种类多样。现有模型在未包含在训练过程中的患者队列上表现下降。基于Transformer和自监督学习的模型比基于阈值的生物标志物表现更好，但仍不理想。

目的: 提出BioCOMPASS，这是COMPASS模型的扩展，旨在通过整合生物标志物和治疗信息进一步提高模型的泛化能力。

方法: 不将生物标志物数据作为输入，而是构建损失组件将其与模型的中间表示对齐。引入了治疗门控和通路一致性损失等组件。

主要发现: 治疗门控和通路一致性损失等组件在Leave-one-cohort-out、Leave-one-cancer-type-out和Leave-one-treatment-out策略下提高了泛化能力。利用生物标志物和治疗信息的组件有助于免疫治疗反应预测的泛化。

结论: 构建利用生物标志物和治疗信息的组件是提高免疫治疗反应预测泛化能力的有前景的方向。未来研究应关注利用补充临床信息和领域知识的组件。

翻译: BioCOMPASS是一个改进的COMPASS模型，通过整合生物标志物和治疗信息来增强免疫治疗反应预测的泛化能力。免疫治疗反应预测数据集通常规模较小，且癌症类型、药物和测序仪种类多样。现有模型在未包含在训练过程中的患者队列上表现下降。基于Transformer和自监督学习的模型比基于阈值的生物标志物表现更好，但仍不理想。提出BioCOMPASS，这是COMPASS模型的扩展，旨在通过整合生物标志物和治疗信息进一步提高模型的泛化能力。不将生物标志物数据作为输入，而是构建损失组件将其与模型的中间表示对齐。引入了治疗门控和通路一致性损失等组件。治疗门控和通路一致性损失等组件在Leave-one-cohort-out、Leave-one-cancer-type-out和Leave-one-treatment-out策略下提高了泛化能力。利用生物标志物和治疗信息的组件有助于免疫治疗反应预测的泛化。构建利用生物标志物和治疗信息的组件是提高免疫治疗反应预测泛化能力的有前景的方向。未来研究应关注利用补充临床信息和领域知识的组件。

Abstract

Datasets used in immunotherapy response prediction are typically small in size, as well as diverse in cancer type, drug administered, and sequencer used. Models often drop in performance when tested on patient cohorts that are not included in the training process. Recent work has shown that transformer-based models along with self-supervised learning show better generalisation performance than threshold-based biomarkers, but is still suboptimal. We present BioCOMPASS, an extension of a transformer-based model called COMPASS, that integrates biomarkers and treatment information to further improve its generalisability. Instead of feeding biomarker data as input, we built loss components to align them with the model's intermediate representations. We found that components such as treatment gating and pathway consistency loss improved generalisability when evaluated with Leave-one-cohort-out, Leave-one-cancer-type-out and Leave-one-treatment-out strategies. Results show that building components that exploit biomarker and treatment information can help in generalisability of immunotherapy response prediction. Careful curation of additional components that leverage complementary clinical information and domain knowledge represents a promising direction for future research.

item.title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models
item.author: Dong-Jae Lee, Sunghyun Baek, Junmo Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于注意力双重形式视角的训练免费令牌剪枝框架，旨在解决大型视觉语言模型计算成本随视觉令牌数量增加而迅速上升的问题。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型在图像和视频理解任务中表现出色，但其计算成本随着视觉令牌数量的增加而迅速上升。现有的令牌剪枝方法主要通过经验方法缓解这一问题，但忽视了注意力的内部机制。

目的: 提出一种新颖的训练免费令牌剪枝框架，基于注意力的双重形式视角，以在性能和效率之间取得更好的平衡。

方法: 将注意力重新表述为一个隐式线性层，其权重矩阵是秩为1的外积之和，每个外积由单个令牌的键值对生成。通过引入渐进式分块最大边际相关性方法来高效选择最佳子集。

主要发现: 该方法通过提出的指标量化了令牌的信息量和信息重复，实现了性能和效率之间的更好权衡，并为现有剪枝方法提供了另一种视角。

结论: 实验表明，该方法在性能和效率之间取得了更好的平衡，同时为现有剪枝方法提供了另一种视角。

翻译: 大型视觉语言模型在图像和视频理解任务中表现出色，但其计算成本随着视觉令牌数量的增加而迅速上升。现有的令牌剪枝方法主要通过经验方法缓解这一问题，但忽视了注意力的内部机制。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的训练免费令牌剪枝框架，基于注意力的双重形式视角。我们将注意力重新表述为一个隐式线性层，其权重矩阵是秩为1的外积之和，每个外积由单个令牌的键值对生成。令牌剪枝因此减少为选择这些秩为1更新的最佳子集，以最好地近似原始的双重权重矩阵。将这种视角扩展到大型视觉语言模型中的标准softmax注意力，我们推导出一个新指标，量化令牌的信息量和信息重复。为了有效地选择具有所提出指标的子集，我们引入了渐进式分块最大边际相关性。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在性能和效率之间取得了更好的平衡，同时为现有剪枝方法提供了另一种视角。

Abstract

Large Vision Language Models show impressive performance across image and video understanding tasks, yet their computational cost grows rapidly with the number of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods mitigate this issue through empirical approaches while overlooking the internal mechanism of attention. In this paper, we propose a novel training free token pruning framework grounded in the dual form perspective of attention. We reformulate attention as an implicit linear layer whose weight matrix is the sum of rank 1 outer products, each generated by a single token's key value pair. Token pruning thus reduces to selecting an optimal subset of these rank 1 updates that best approximates the original dual weight matrix. Extending this perspective to standard softmax attention in LVLMs, we derive a novel metric quantifying both a token's information magnitude and information duplication. To efficiently select the subset with the proposed metric, we introduce Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade off between performance and efficiency, while providing another perspective on existing pruning approaches.

item.title: An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models
item.author: Lennart Maack, Alexander Schlaefer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出SurgSTU-Pipeline和SurgSTU数据集，用于提升手术视频理解中的时空动态分析能力

背景: 现有手术视觉语言模型在处理复杂交错时空动态方面存在不足，且缺乏大规模数据集

目的: 解决现有手术视觉语言数据集在捕捉和评估复杂交错时空动态方面的不足，创建高质量数据集

方法: 提出SurgSTU-Pipeline，包含时间连续性和空间连续性过滤的确定性生成流程，应用于公开数据集创建SurgSTU数据集

主要发现: 通用VLM在零样本设置下表现不佳，但通过上下文学习可提升时空能力；在SurgSTU训练集上微调的VLM在所有时空任务中表现最佳

结论: SurgSTU数据集能有效提升VLM在手术视频中的时空理解能力

翻译: Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 7515 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. Code will be made publicly available.

Abstract

Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 7515 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. Code will be made publicly available.

item.title: Deconfounding Scores and Representation Learning for Causal Effect Estimation with Weak Overlap
item.author: Oscar Clivio, Alexander D'Amour, Alexander Franks, David Bruns-Smith, Chris Holmes, Avi Feller
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文提出了一类称为去混杂分数的特征表示方法，旨在解决因果效应估计中的重叠性问题。

背景: 重叠性是因果处理效应估计的关键条件，但在高维数据中，由于维数灾难，重叠性往往难以实现。许多流行的估计器在特征在不同处理组间差异较大时容易产生高方差和脆弱性。

目的: 提出一种特征表示方法，在保持识别和估计目标的同时改善重叠性。

方法: 提出了去混杂分数这一特征表示类，将寻找具有更好重叠性的表示问题转化为在去混杂分数约束下最小化重叠发散。在广义线性模型和高斯特征下，推导了去混杂分数的闭式表达式，并表明预后分数在此类中是重叠性最优的。

主要发现: 预后分数是广义线性模型和高斯特征类中重叠性最优的去混杂分数。

结论: 通过大量实验评估了这一行为，验证了所提方法的有效性。

翻译: 重叠性，也称为正性，是因果处理效应估计的关键条件。许多流行的估计器在特征在不同处理组间差异较大时容易产生高方差和脆弱性。这在高维情况下尤其具有挑战性：维数灾难可能使重叠性变得不切实际。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一类称为去混杂分数的特征表示，它们既保持了识别和估计的目标；经典倾向性和预后分数是其中的两个特例。我们将寻找具有更好重叠性的表示问题表征为在去混杂分数约束下最小化重叠发散的问题。然后，我们在广义线性模型和高斯特征的一个广泛家族下推导了一类去混杂分数的闭式表达式，并表明预后分数在此类中是重叠性最优的。我们进行了大量实验来评估这一行为的经验表现。

Abstract

Overlap, also known as positivity, is a key condition for causal treatment effect estimation. Many popular estimators suffer from high variance and become brittle when features differ strongly across treatment groups. This is especially challenging in high dimensions: the curse of dimensionality can make overlap implausible. To address this, we propose a class of feature representations called deconfounding scores, which preserve both identification and the target of estimation; the classical propensity and prognostic scores are two special cases. We characterize the problem of finding a representation with better overlap as minimizing an overlap divergence under a deconfounding score constraint. We then derive closed-form expressions for a class of deconfounding scores under a broad family of generalized linear models with Gaussian features and show that prognostic scores are overlap-optimal within this class. We conduct extensive experiments to assess this behavior empirically.

item.title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation
item.author: Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Erland Hilman Fuadi, Shanu Kumar, Alham Fikri Aji, Yova Kementchedjhieva
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LinguDistill是一种无适配器蒸馏方法，通过利用原始冻结语言模型作为教师模型，利用逐层KV缓存共享技术，在恢复语言能力的同时保持视觉任务性能。

背景: 将预训练语言模型适配为视觉语言模型会导致语言能力下降，且难以通过标准微调恢复；现有恢复方法通常引入额外模块，增加了架构复杂性和推理参数。

目的: 提出LinguDistill方法，旨在恢复语言模型的语言能力，同时保持其在视觉任务上的性能，且不增加额外模块。

方法: 引入逐层KV缓存共享技术，使冻结的教师模型能够监督学生模型的多模态表示；利用教师模型在语言密集型数据上的强语言信号进行选择性蒸馏。

主要发现: LinguDistill恢复了约10%的语言和知识基准测试中丢失的性能，同时在视觉密集型任务上保持了可比性能。

结论: 无需额外模块即可恢复语言能力，为多模态模型中模态特定退化提供了高效实用的解决方案。

翻译: 将预训练语言模型适配为视觉语言模型会导致语言能力下降，且难以通过标准微调恢复；现有恢复方法通常引入额外模块，增加了架构复杂性和推理参数。LinguDistill是一种无适配器蒸馏方法，通过利用原始冻结语言模型作为教师模型，利用逐层KV缓存共享技术，在恢复语言能力的同时保持视觉任务性能。

Abstract

Adapting pretrained language models (LMs) into vision-language models (VLMs) can degrade their native linguistic capability due to representation shift and cross-modal interference introduced during multimodal adaptation. Such loss is difficult to recover, even with targeted task-specific fine-tuning using standard objectives. Prior recovery approaches typically introduce additional modules that act as intermediate alignment layers to maintain or isolate modality-specific subspaces, which increases architectural complexity, adds parameters at inference time, and limits flexibility across models and settings. We propose LinguDistill, an adapter-free distillation method that restores linguistic capability by utilizing the original frozen LM as a teacher. We overcome the key challenge of enabling vision-conditioned teacher supervision by introducing layer-wise KV-cache sharing, which exposes the teacher to the student's multimodal representations without modifying the architecture of either model. We then selectively distill the teacher's strong linguistic signal on language-intensive data to recover language capability, while preserving the student's visual grounding on multimodal tasks. As a result, LinguDistill recovers $\sim$10% of the performance lost on language and knowledge benchmarks, while maintaining comparable performance on vision-heavy tasks. Our findings demonstrate that linguistic capability can be recovered without additional modules, providing an efficient and practical solution to modality-specific degradation in multimodal models.

item.title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
item.author: Zhanzhi Lou, Hui Chen, Yibo Li, Qian Wang, Bryan Hooi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Test-Time Learning (TTL) 允许语言代理通过与环境进行反复交互来迭代优化其性能。

背景: 现有的 TTL 方法依赖于固定且人工设计的适应策略，而非针对下游改进进行优化。

目的: 提出 Meta-TTL 框架，将有效适应策略的发现形式化为双层优化问题，主张最优适应策略应从任务环境中学习而非基于人类直觉设计。

方法: Meta-TTL 框架中，内层循环执行标准 TTL 过程，测量候选适应策略在连续回合中帮助代理纠正错误的效率；外层循环利用进化搜索在多样化的训练任务分布上迭代优化适应策略。

主要发现: 在 Jericho 和 WebArena-Lite 两个基准测试中，Meta-TTL 在 ID 和 OOD 设置下均持续优于人工设计的基线。

结论: 优化的适应策略编码了可迁移策略，能够超越训练任务分布进行泛化。

翻译: Test-Time Learning (TTL) 允许语言代理通过在推理时间与环境进行反复交互来迭代优化其性能。TTL 的核心是一个适应策略，它根据先前回合的经验更新演员策略，从而改善未来的行为。现有方法依赖于固定且人工设计的适应策略，而不是针对下游改进进行优化。我们认为最优适应策略应该从任务环境中学习，而不是基于人类直觉进行手工设计。为此，我们引入了 Meta-TTL，这是一个将有效适应策略的发现形式化为双层优化问题的框架。在该框架内，内层循环执行标准的 TTL 过程，测量候选适应策略在连续回合中帮助代理纠正错误的效率。在代理性能的指导下，外层循环在多样化的训练任务分布上对适应策略进行进化搜索，以迭代优化。我们在 Jericho 和 WebArena-Lite 上评估了 Meta-TTL，涵盖了 ID 和 OOD 设置，并使用了多个元代理骨干网络。两个基准上的结果表明，Meta-TTL 持续优于人工设计的基线，表明优化的适应策略编码了可迁移策略，能够超越训练任务分布进行泛化。

Abstract

Test-Time Learning (TTL) enables language agents to iteratively refine their performance through repeated interactions with the environment at inference time. At the core of TTL is an adaptation policy that updates the actor policy based on experience from previous episodes, thereby improving future behavior. Existing methods rely on fixed, hand-crafted adaptation policies rather than optimizing them for downstream improvement. We argue that optimal adaptation policies should be learned from task environments, not hand-engineered based on human intuition. To achieve this, we introduce Meta-TTL, a framework that formulates the discovery of effective adaptation policies as a bi-level optimization problem. Within this framework, the inner loop executes the standard TTL process, measuring how effectively a candidate adaptation policy helps an agent correct errors across sequential episodes. Guided by the agent's performance, the outer loop employs evolutionary search over a diverse distribution of training tasks to iteratively refine the adaptation policy. We evaluate Meta-TTL on Jericho and WebArena-Lite across both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, using multiple meta-agent backbones. Results on both benchmarks show that Meta-TTL consistently outperforms hand-crafted baselines, suggesting that the optimized adaptation policy encodes transferable strategies that generalize beyond the training task distribution.

item.title: Thermodynamics-Informed Accurate pKa Prediction and Protonation State Generation in PlayMolecule AI
item.author: Francesco Pesce, Stephen Farr, Gianni de Fabritiis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了AcepKa，这是一个集成在PlayMolecule AI平台上的先进应用，用于准确预测酸解离常数(pKa)和确定主要质子化状态。

背景: 在药物发现中，准确预测酸解离常数(pKa)和确定主要质子化状态至关重要，因为它们影响分子的溶解度、渗透性和蛋白质-配体结合等性质。

目的: 开发AcepKa应用，旨在通过建模完整的质子化系综而非将pKa视为标量回归目标，确保耦合电离位点的热力学一致性。

方法: AcepKa基于理论上严谨的Uni-pKa框架构建，该框架统一了统计力学与表示学习。应用包含增强架构，重新训练的Uni-Mol骨干网络在标准基准上达到最先进性能。此外，还介绍了AceConfgen（一种专有的GPU加速构象生成器，相比NVIDIA的nvmolkit速度提升约40倍）、简化的推理引擎以及用于将质子化状态应用于结合配体构象的3D感知模态。

主要发现: AcepKa在标准基准上实现了最先进的性能，AceConfgen相比NVIDIA的nvmolkit实现了约40倍的速度提升。

结论: AcepKa已成功集成到PlayMolecule AI生态系统中，这是一个用于分子建模和药物发现的现代AI辅助环境。

翻译: 在药物发现中，准确预测酸解离常数(pKa)和确定主要质子化状态至关重要，因为它们影响分子的溶解度、渗透性和蛋白质-配体结合等性质。我们介绍了AcepKa，这是一个集成在PlayMolecule AI平台上的先进应用。AcepKa基于理论上严谨的Uni-pKa框架构建，该框架统一了统计力学与表示学习。通过建模完整的质子化系综而非将pKa视为标量回归目标，AcepKa确保了耦合电离位点的热力学一致性。我们描述了应用的增强架构，该架构具有重新训练的Uni-Mol骨干网络，在标准基准上实现了最先进的性能。此外，我们还详细介绍了关键的工程进展。这些包括AceConfgen，一种专有的GPU加速构象生成器，相比NVIDIA的nvmolkit实现了约40倍的速度提升，一个简化的推理引擎，可以直接对分子进行质子化，以及一个3D感知模态，用于将质子化状态应用于结合配体构象。最后，我们讨论了将AcepKa集成到PlayMolecule AI生态系统中，这是一个用于分子建模和药物发现的现代AI辅助环境。

Abstract

Accurate prediction of acid dissociation constants (p$K_{\rm a}$) and the determination of dominant protonation states is critical in drug discovery, influencing molecular properties such as solubility, permeability, and protein-ligand binding. We present Acep$K_{\rm a}$, an advanced application integrated into the PlayMolecule AI platform. Acep$K_{\rm a}$ is built upon the theoretically rigorous Uni-p$K_{\rm a}$ framework, which unifies statistical mechanics with representation learning. By modeling the complete protonation ensemble rather than treating p$K_a$ as a scalar regression target, Acep$K_{\rm a}$ ensures thermodynamic consistency across coupled ionization sites. We describe the application's enhanced architecture, which features a retrained Uni-Mol backbone achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Furthermore, we detail critical engineering advancements. These include AceConfgen, a proprietary GPU-accelerated conformer generator that achieves a ~40x speed-up compared to NVIDIA's nvmolkit, a streamlined inference engine to directly protonate molecules, and a 3D-aware modality for applying protonation states to bound ligand poses. Finally, we discuss the integration of Acep$K_{\rm a}$ into the PlayMolecule AI ecosystem, a modern AI-assisted environment for molecular modelling and drug discovery.

item.title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
item.author: Deepak Nathani, Cheng Zhang, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, Yinfei Yang, Alkesh Patel, Zhe Gan, William Yang Wang, Michael Saxon, Xin Eric Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Pare是一个用于构建和评估主动代理的研究环境，Pare-Bench是一个包含143个多样化任务的基准测试。

背景: 缺乏现实的用户模拟框架阻碍了主动代理的发展，现有方法将应用建模为扁平的工具调用API，无法捕捉用户交互的状态性和顺序性。

目的: 介绍Pare框架以构建和评估数字环境中的主动代理，并介绍Pare-Bench基准测试。

方法: Pare将应用建模为有限状态机，具有状态导航和状态依赖的动作空间，以实现主动用户模拟。

主要发现: Pare-Bench包含143个涵盖通信、生产力、日程安排和生活方式应用的多样化任务。

结论: Pare框架和Pare-Bench基准测试为评估主动代理在数字环境中的能力提供了基础。

翻译: Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.

Abstract

Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.

item.title: Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud based Human Motion Capture
item.author: Yiming Ren, Yujing Sun, Aoru Xue, Kwok-Yan Lam, Yuexin Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Sparkle的结构化表示方法，旨在解决基于点云的运动捕捉中表达性与鲁棒性难以平衡的问题。该方法通过显式解耦内部运动学结构与外部表面几何，实现了在噪声、遮挡和域偏移等挑战下的高性能表现。

背景: 现有的基于点云的运动捕捉方法面临表达性与鲁棒性之间的权衡困境。基于点云的方法几何细节丰富但噪声大，而基于骨架的方法鲁棒但过于简化。

目的: 构建一种能够平衡表达性和鲁棒性的有效人类运动捕捉表示方法。

方法: 提出了Sparkle，一种统一骨架关节和表面锚点的结构化表示，结合了显式的运动学-几何分解。SparkleMotion框架通过分层模块学习该表示，嵌入了几何连续性和运动学约束。

主要发现: SparkleMotion在准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力方面均达到了最先进水平，特别是在严重的域偏移、噪声和遮挡情况下。

结论: 该方法在多种传感器类型和现实世界场景中表现出优越性。

翻译: 基于点云的运动捕捉利用丰富的空间几何和隐私保护传感，但从嘈杂、非结构化的点云中学习鲁棒的表示仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在基于点云的方法（几何细节丰富但嘈杂）和基于骨架的方法（鲁棒但过于简化）之间面临权衡困境。本文解决了这一根本挑战：如何构建一种能够平衡表达性和鲁棒性的有效人类运动捕捉表示。在本文中，我们提出了Sparkle，一种统一骨架关节和表面锚点的结构化表示，具有显式的运动学-几何分解。我们的框架SparkleMotion通过分层模块学习该表示，嵌入了几何连续性和运动学约束。通过显式解耦内部运动学结构与外部表面几何，SparkleMotion不仅在准确性方面，而且在严重的域偏移、噪声和遮挡下的鲁棒性和泛化能力方面均取得了最先进的性能。广泛的实验证明了我们在多种传感器类型和具有挑战性的现实世界场景中的优越性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决从嘈杂、未结构化的点云中学习鲁棒人类运动表示的挑战，特别是平衡现有方法在保留几何细节与保持结构鲁棒性之间的矛盾。这个问题很重要，因为它使得在现实世界中的隐私保护运动捕捉成为可能，能够处理黑暗、遮挡和多人互动等复杂场景，且在准确性和泛化能力上优于现有技术。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有方法在点云运动捕捉中存在权衡：基于点的方法保留细节但易受噪声影响，而基于骨架的方法结构稳健但丢失表面细节。他们思考如何结合两者的优势，于是设计了Sparkle表示，它统一了内部运动学（骨架关节）和外部几何（表面锚点）。作者借鉴了现有的基于点的方法和基于骨架的方法，试图解决现有中间表示难以兼顾结构一致性和表面保真度的关键差距。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该论文的核心思想是提出一种名为Sparkle的结构化表示，将骨骼关节（内部运动学）与表面锚点（外部几何）结合，以在保留细节的同时提高鲁棒性。整体实现流程包括：首先通过点对齐骨骼追踪器估计骨骼关节，接着利用骨架引导锚点估计器预测表面锚点，最后基于这些信息通过SMPL求解器生成人体姿态。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了Sparkle，一种统一骨骼关节和表面锚点的结构化表示。相比之前的工作，它解决了基于点云的运动捕捉中“表达性”与“鲁棒性”的权衡问题，显式解耦了内部运动学结构和外部表面几何，通过点对齐和骨架引导机制，在保留细节的同时提高了对噪声和遮挡的鲁棒性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了名为 Sparkle 的统一结构化表示，结合了内部骨架关节和外部表面锚点，以平衡表达能力和鲁棒性；基于此，开发了名为 SparkleMotion 的框架，在噪声和遮挡等挑战性场景中实现了最先进的运动捕捉性能。

Abstract

Point cloud-based motion capture leverages rich spatial geometry and privacy-preserving sensing, but learning robust representations from noisy, unstructured point clouds remains challenging. Existing approaches face a struggle trade-off between point-based methods (geometrically detailed but noisy) and skeleton-based ones (robust but oversimplified). We address the fundamental challenge: how to construct an effective representation for human motion capture that can balance expressiveness and robustness. In this paper, we propose Sparkle, a structured representation unifying skeletal joints and surface anchors with explicit kinematic-geometric factorization. Our framework, SparkleMotion, learns this representation through hierarchical modules embedding geometric continuity and kinematic constraints. By explicitly disentangling internal kinematic structure from external surface geometry, SparkleMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance not only in accuracy but crucially in robustness and generalization under severe domain shifts, noise, and occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate our superiority across diverse sensor types and challenging real-world scenarios.

item.title: Shape Representation using Gaussian Process mixture models
item.author: Panagiotis Sapoutzoglou, George Terzakis, Georgios Floros, Maria Pateraki
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于高斯过程混合模型的新型物体特定功能形状表示方法，该方法利用稀疏采样的点云学习连续方向距离场，能够高效且准确地表示复杂几何形状。

背景: 传统的显式三维表示方法（如点云和网格）需要大量存储来捕捉精细几何细节，并且需要复杂的索引系统进行表面查找，因此功能表示被认为是一种高效、紧凑且连续的替代方案。

目的: 提出一种新颖的、物体特定的功能形状表示方法，旨在利用高斯过程混合模型来建模表面几何，并从稀疏采样的点云中学习连续方向距离场。

方法: 该方法利用高斯过程混合模型来学习连续方向距离场，通过在战略参考点处锚定局部高斯过程先验来捕捉复杂拓扑结构，且该方法无需依赖计算量大的神经网络架构，具有轻量级特点。

主要发现: 在ShapeNetCore和IndustryShapes数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法能够高效且准确地表示复杂几何形状。

结论: 该方法是一种高效、紧凑且连续的形状表示方法，能够灵活地提取局部高斯过程先验以捕捉复杂拓扑结构。

翻译: 传统的显式三维表示，如点云和网格，需要大量存储来捕捉精细几何细节，并且需要复杂的索引系统进行表面查找，这使得功能表示成为了一种高效、紧凑且连续的替代方案。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的、物体特定的功能形状表示方法，该方法使用高斯过程混合模型来建模表面几何。与依赖计算量大的神经网络架构不同，我们的方法是轻量级的，利用高斯过程从稀疏采样的点云中学习连续方向距离场。我们通过在战略参考点处锚定局部高斯过程先验来捕捉复杂拓扑结构，这些先验可以灵活地使用任何结构分解方法（例如骨架化、基于距离的聚类）提取。在ShapeNetCore和IndustryShapes数据集上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法能够高效且准确地表示复杂几何形状。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决传统显式3D表示（如点云和网格）存储需求大且需要复杂索引系统的问题，以及现有神经架构计算量大且难以精确重建特定几何细节的问题。这个问题在现实和研究中很重要，因为3D建模、重建等任务需要紧凑且准确的表示来支持数字孪生、城市建模等应用，而隐式模型在存储效率和拓扑学习方面优于显式模型，但往往缺乏对特定形状细节的精确捕捉能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为传统显式表示存储需求高且索引复杂，而隐式表示虽高效但难以捕捉特定细节。因此，他们提出了一种基于高斯过程混合模型的“对象特定”隐式表示，旨在从稀疏点云中高效重建复杂几何形状。设计上，他们利用高斯过程从稀疏数据学习连续函数的能力，将形状建模为锚定在参考点上的多个方向距离场混合，避免使用深度神经网络。作者借鉴了 Has (2023) 关于分类器混合的工作，以及 Tretschk et al. (2020) 等关于方向距离场（DDF）的研究。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用高斯过程混合模型对物体形状进行隐式表示，通过从稀疏点云学习连续的方向距离场，并在战略参考点处锚定局部先验来捕获复杂拓扑，且无需深度神经网络。整体实现流程包括：首先将形状划分为区域并提取参考点；然后将每个区域的点编码为相对于参考点的方向距离场；最后通过训练局部高斯过程模型来表示这些距离场，形成混合模型。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种基于高斯过程混合模型的物体特定隐式形状表示，该方法完全摒弃了深度神经网络组件，仅操作稀疏采样的表面点。相比之前的工作，它不使用任何神经组件，而是利用高斯过程从不规则稀疏采样数据中学习连续函数。与旨在捕获整个物体类别统计特征的神经形状表示不同，该方法旨在重建特定几何形状的高保真、独特的细节。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种新颖的函数形状表示方法，利用高斯过程混合模型从稀疏点云中学习连续的方向距离场，以实现复杂几何形状的高效、轻量级表示，且不依赖深度神经网络。

Abstract

Traditional explicit 3D representations, such as point clouds and meshes, demand significant storage to capture fine geometric details and require complex indexing systems for surface lookups, making functional representations an efficient, compact, and continuous alternative. In this work, we propose a novel, object-specific functional shape representation that models surface geometry with Gaussian Process (GP) mixture models. Rather than relying on computationally heavy neural architectures, our method is lightweight, leveraging GPs to learn continuous directional distance fields from sparsely sampled point clouds. We capture complex topologies by anchoring local GP priors at strategic reference points, which can be flexibly extracted using any structural decomposition method (e.g. skeletonization, distance-based clustering). Extensive evaluations on the ShapeNetCore and IndustryShapes datasets demonstrate that our method can efficiently and accurately represent complex geometries.

item.title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.author: Md. Abu Bakor Siddique, Shahrin Hossain, Sadman Ahmed Siam, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Hasan Mahmud, Md Kamrul Hasan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对现有几何问题求解模型在逻辑推理方面的不足，提出了一种名为MARS-GPS的新方法，通过并行推理和代码执行来提升模型性能。

背景: 几何问题求解是提升大语言模型数学推理能力的关键，但现有方法主要关注图示理解与符号操作，对逻辑推理的重视不足且推理链往往较为单一。

目的: 为了解决现有模型在逻辑推理方面的缺陷，提出MARS-GPS方法，旨在通过生成多个并行推理路径并利用代码执行进行验证，从而增强模型的逻辑推理能力。

方法: MARS-GPS通过生成多个并行推理路径，并利用Python代码执行进行数值验证；使用基于令牌熵的排名机制作为置信度信号；并通过多阶段投票和自验证流程聚合答案。

主要发现: 在Geometry3K数据集上，MARS-GPS在8个并行推理路径下达到了88.8%的准确率，比之前的最先进模型提高了近11%；准确率随着并行推理路径数量的增加而持续提升。

结论: MARS-GPS方法显著提升了几何问题求解模型在逻辑推理方面的表现，证明了并行推理和代码执行验证的有效性。

翻译: Geometric Problem Solving (GPS) remains at the heart of enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models because it requires the combination of diagrammatic understanding, symbolic manipulation and logical inference. In existing literature, researchers have chiefly focused on synchronising the diagram descriptions with text literals and solving the problem. In this vein, they have either taken a neural, symbolic or neuro-symbolic approach. But this solves only the first two of the requirements, namely diagrammatic understanding and symbolic manipulation, while leaving logical inference underdeveloped. The logical inference is often limited to one chain-of-thought (CoT). To address this weakness in hitherto existing models, this paper proposes MARS-GPS, that generates multiple parallel reasoning rollouts augmented with Python code execution for numerical verification, ranks them using token-level entropy as a confidence signal, and aggregates answers through a multi-stage voting and self-verification pipeline. Empirical results show that MARS-GPS with 8 parallel rollouts achieves 88.8% on Geometry3K, a nearly +11% improvement over the prior state-of-the-art, with accuracy scaling consistently as the number of rollouts increases from 1 to 16 (+6.0% on ablation subset). We provide our code and data in an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55.

Abstract

Geometric Problem Solving (GPS) remains at the heart of enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models because it requires the combination of diagrammatic understanding, symbolic manipulation and logical inference. In existing literature, researchers have chiefly focused on synchronising the diagram descriptions with text literals and solving the problem. In this vein, they have either taken a neural, symbolic or neuro-symbolic approach. But this solves only the first two of the requirements, namely diagrammatic understanding and symbolic manipulation, while leaving logical inference underdeveloped. The logical inference is often limited to one chain-of-thought (CoT). To address this weakness in hitherto existing models, this paper proposes MARS-GPS, that generates multiple parallel reasoning rollouts augmented with Python code execution for numerical verification, ranks them using token-level entropy as a confidence signal, and aggregates answers through a multi-stage voting and self-verification pipeline. Empirical results show that MARS-GPS with 8 parallel rollouts achieves 88.8% on Geometry3K, a nearly +11% improvement over the prior state-of-the-art, with accuracy scaling consistently as the number of rollouts increases from 1 to 16 (+6.0% on ablation subset). We provide our code and data in an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55.

item.title: Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment
item.author: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究构建了IKEA-Bench基准测试，评估了19个视觉语言模型在组装任务中的表现，发现文本理解可恢复但会降低图视对齐，架构比参数量更能预测准确率，视频理解是瓶颈，且图视占据不同的视觉子空间。

背景: 2D组装图抽象难懂，需要智能助手在混合现实环境中监控进度、检测错误并提供指导，但视觉语言模型面临图视特征差异大的描绘差距问题。

目的: 系统评估视觉语言模型在组装任务中的描绘差距，识别提升跨描绘鲁棒性的主要目标。

方法: 构建了包含6种任务类型、29种宜家家具产品、1,623个问题的IKEA-Bench基准测试，评估了19个视觉语言模型（2B-38B参数）的三种对齐策略，并进行三层级机制分析。

主要发现: 1. 组装指令理解可通过文本恢复，但文本同时会降低图视对齐；2. 架构家族比参数数量更能预测对齐准确率；3. 视频理解仍是难以克服的瓶颈；4. 图视占据不同的视觉子空间，添加文本使模型从视觉推理转向文本驱动推理。

结论: 视觉编码是提高跨描绘鲁棒性的主要目标。

翻译: 2D组装图通常是抽象且难以跟随的，这创造了对智能助手的需求，这些助手可以监控进度、检测错误并提供逐步指导。在混合现实设置中，此类系统必须从相机画面中识别已完成和正在进行步骤，并将其与图示指令对齐。视觉语言模型（VLMs）在此任务中显示出前景，但面临描绘差距，因为组装图和视频帧共享很少的视觉特征。为了系统地评估这种差距，我们构建了IKEA-Bench，这是一个包含29种宜家家具产品、6种任务类型、1,623个问题的基准测试，并评估了19个VLMs（2B-38B）在三种对齐策略下的表现。我们的主要发现是：1. 组装指令理解可以通过文本恢复，但文本同时会降低图视对齐；2. 架构家族比参数数量更能预测对齐准确率；3. 视频理解仍然是一个难以克服的瓶颈，不受策略影响。进一步的机制分析进一步揭示，图视占据不同的视觉子空间，并且添加文本使模型从视觉推理转向文本驱动推理。这些结果确定了视觉编码是提高跨描绘鲁棒性的主要目标。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

2D assembly diagrams are often abstract and hard to follow, creating a need for intelligent assistants that can monitor progress, detect errors, and provide step-by-step guidance. In mixed reality settings, such systems must recognize completed and ongoing steps from the camera feed and align them with the diagram instructions. Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise for this task, but face a depiction gap because assembly diagrams and video frames share few visual features. To systematically assess this gap, we construct IKEA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,623 questions across 6 task types on 29 IKEA furniture products, and evaluate 19 VLMs (2B-38B) under three alignment strategies. Our key findings: (1) assembly instruction understanding is recoverable via text, but text simultaneously degrades diagram-to-video alignment; (2) architecture family predicts alignment accuracy more strongly than parameter count; (3) video understanding remains a hard bottleneck unaffected by strategy. A three-level mechanistic analysis further reveals that diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces, and that adding text shifts models from visual to text-driven reasoning. These results identify visual encoding as the primary target for improving cross-depiction robustness. Project page: https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/

item.title: Do Phone-Use Agents Respect Your Privacy?
item.author: Zhengyang Tang, Ke Ji, Xidong Wang, Zihan Ye, Xinyuan Wang, Yiduo Guo, Ziniu Li, Chenxin Li, Jingyuan Hu, Shunian Chen, Tongxu Luo, Jiaxi Bi, Zeyu Qin, Shaobo Wang, Xin Lai, Pengyuan Lyu, Junyi Li, Can Xu, Chengquan Zhang, Han Hu, Ming Yan, Benyou Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究手机使用代理在执行良性移动任务时是否尊重隐私。

背景: 由于隐私合规行为未针对手机使用代理进行操作化，且普通应用不会在执行过程中揭示代理确切输入了哪些表单条目的数据，因此这个问题难以回答。

目的: 为了使该问题可测量，引入了 MyPhoneBench，这是一个用于评估移动代理隐私行为的可验证评估框架。

方法: 通过最小隐私合同 iMy 将尊重隐私的手机使用操作化为许可访问、最小披露和用户控制内存，并将其与经过工具化的模拟应用以及基于规则的审计相结合，以使不必要的权限请求、欺骗性重新披露和不必要的表单填写变得可观察和可重现。

主要发现: 在10个移动应用和300个任务上评估了五个前沿模型，发现任务成功、隐私合规的任务完成以及保存偏好的后续会话使用是不同的能力，没有单一模型在所有三个方面都占主导地位。评估成功和隐私会重新排列模型的顺序。模型中最持久失败的模式是简单的数据最小化：代理仍然填写任务不需要的个人信息条目。

结论: 隐私失败源于对良性任务的过度帮助执行，且仅基于成功的评估会高估当前手机使用代理的部署就绪度。

翻译: 我们研究手机使用代理在完成良性移动任务时是否尊重隐私。这个问题一直很难回答，因为隐私合规行为尚未针对手机使用代理进行操作化，且普通应用不会在执行过程中揭示代理确切输入了哪些表单条目的数据。为了使这个问题可测量，我们引入了 MyPhoneBench，这是一个用于评估移动代理隐私行为的可验证评估框架。我们通过最小隐私合同 iMy 将尊重隐私的手机使用操作化为许可访问、最小披露和用户控制内存，并将其与经过工具化的模拟应用以及基于规则的审计相结合，以使不必要的权限请求、欺骗性重新披露和不必要的表单填写变得可观察和可重现。在10个移动应用和300个任务上评估了五个前沿模型，发现任务成功、隐私合规的任务完成以及保存偏好的后续会话使用是不同的能力，没有单一模型在所有三个方面都占主导地位。评估成功和隐私会重新排列模型的顺序。模型中最持久失败的模式是简单的数据最小化：代理仍然填写任务不需要的个人信息条目。这些结果表明隐私失败源于对良性任务的过度帮助执行，且仅基于成功的评估会高估当前手机使用代理的部署就绪度。所有代码、模拟应用和代理轨迹均在 https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/MyPhoneBench 上公开。

Abstract

We study whether phone-use agents respect privacy while completing benign mobile tasks. This question has remained hard to answer because privacy-compliant behavior is not operationalized for phone-use agents, and ordinary apps do not reveal exactly what data agents type into which form entries during execution. To make this question measurable, we introduce MyPhoneBench, a verifiable evaluation framework for privacy behavior in mobile agents. We operationalize privacy-respecting phone use as permissioned access, minimal disclosure, and user-controlled memory through a minimal privacy contract, iMy, and pair it with instrumented mock apps plus rule-based auditing that make unnecessary permission requests, deceptive re-disclosure, and unnecessary form filling observable and reproducible. Across five frontier models on 10 mobile apps and 300 tasks, we find that task success, privacy-compliant task completion, and later-session use of saved preferences are distinct capabilities, and no single model dominates all three. Evaluating success and privacy jointly reshuffles the model ordering relative to either metric alone. The most persistent failure mode across models is simple data minimization: agents still fill optional personal entries that the task does not require. These results show that privacy failures arise from over-helpful execution of benign tasks, and that success-only evaluation overestimates the deployment readiness of current phone-use agents. All code, mock apps, and agent trajectories are publicly available at~ https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/MyPhoneBench.

item.title: Bridging Structured Knowledge and Data: A Unified Framework with Finance Applications
item.author: Yi Cao, Zexun Chen, Lin William Cong, Heqing Shi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SKINNs是一种统一的估计框架，将理论、模拟、先前学习或跨域见解作为可微约束嵌入灵活的神经函数近似中。

背景: 摘要中未明确提及具体背景，但提到金融应用作为示例。

目的: 开发一种统一的估计框架，将不同见解作为可微约束嵌入神经函数近似中，以联合估计网络参数和经济结构参数。

方法: 通过配点 enforcing 理论一致性，定义 M-估计器类，建立结构参数识别，推导泛化和目标风险界限，提供加权参数的受限最优特征。

主要发现: SKINNs在期权定价应用中提高了样本外估值和对冲性能，特别是在长期和高波动率时期，恢复出经济可解释的结构参数，且稳定性优于传统校准。

结论: SKINNs提供了一种结合基于模型的推理与高维数据驱动估计的一般计量经济学框架。

翻译: 我们开发了结构知识引导神经网络，这是一个统一的估计框架，将理论、模拟、先前学习或跨域见解作为不同可微约束嵌入灵活的神经函数近似中。SKINNs在一个优化问题中联合估计神经网络参数和经济上有意义的结构参数，通过配点 enforcing 理论一致性，不仅针对观测数据，而且针对更广泛的输入域，从而嵌入了功能GMM、贝叶斯更新、迁移学习、PINNs和代理建模等方法。SKINNs定义了一类M-估计器，在误设下具有一致性、渐近正态性、根N收敛、夹心协方差和伪真参数恢复。我们建立了在联合灵活性下的结构参数识别，在凸代理下推导了分布转移下的泛化和目标风险界限，并提供了控制偏差-方差权衡的加权参数的受限最优特征。在期权定价的金融应用示例中，SKINNs提高了样本外估值和对冲性能，特别是在长期和高波动率时期，同时恢复了经济上可解释的结构参数，与传统校准相比具有更好的稳定性。更广泛地说，SKINNs提供了一种结合基于模型的推理与高维数据驱动估计的一般计量经济学框架。

Abstract

We develop Structured-Knowledge-Informed Neural Networks (SKINNs), a unified estimation framework that embeds theoretical, simulated, previously learned, or cross-domain insights as differentiable constraints within flexible neural function approximation. SKINNs jointly estimate neural network parameters and economically meaningful structural parameters in a single optimization problem, enforcing theoretical consistency not only on observed data but over a broader input domain through collocation, and therefore nesting approaches such as functional GMM, Bayesian updating, transfer learning, PINNs, and surrogate modeling. SKINNs define a class of M-estimators that are consistent and asymptotically normal with root-N convergence, sandwich covariance, and recovery of pseudo-true parameters under misspecification. We establish identification of structural parameters under joint flexibility, derive generalization and target-risk bounds under distributional shift in a convex proxy, and provide a restricted-optimal characterization of the weighting parameter that governs the bias-variance tradeoff. In an illustrative financial application to option pricing, SKINNs improve out-of-sample valuation and hedging performance, particularly at longer horizons and during high-volatility regimes, while recovering economically interpretable structural parameters with improved stability relative to conventional calibration. More broadly, SKINNs provide a general econometric framework for combining model-based reasoning with high-dimensional, data-driven estimation.

item.title: Customizing Large Vision Model-Guided Low-Rank Approximation for Ground-Roll Denoise
item.author: Jiacheng Liao, Feng Qian, Ziyin Fan, Yongjian Guo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对地震勘探中地面波干扰的去除问题，提出了一种无需训练的语义引导信号分离框架，利用大型视觉模型提取语义先验并生成软掩码，结合低秩逆公式和ADMM求解器，在合成和野外VSP数据集上实现了优于传统方法的去噪效果。

背景: 地面波是陆地和垂直地震剖面数据中主要的相干噪声源，严重掩盖反射事件，降低成像和解释质量。传统去噪方法如变换域滤波、稀疏表示和深度学习往往存在适应性有限、信号泄漏或依赖标注训练数据等问题，特别是在强信号噪声重叠情况下。

目的: 解决传统方法在强信号噪声重叠下适应性差、信号泄漏及依赖标注数据的问题，提出一种无需训练的框架，将地面波衰减重新表述为语义引导的信号分离问题。

方法: 1. 采用可提示的大型视觉模型，将地震道集转换为视觉表示，通过文本或图像提示定位地面波主导区域，提取高层语义先验；2. 将语义响应转换为连续软掩码；3. 将软掩码嵌入到掩码条件低秩逆公式中；4. 开发基于ADMM的高效求解器。

主要发现: 在合成和野外VSP数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在保持反射连续性和波形保真度的同时，实现了卓越的地面波衰减效果， consistently outperforming 代表性变换域滤波和隐式神经表示方法。

结论: 该方法无需任务特定训练或手动注释即可实现稳定且物理一致的信号恢复，在去噪效果上优于现有方法。

翻译: Ground-roll is a dominant source of coherent noise in land and vertical seismic profiling (VSP) data, severely masking reflection events and degrading subsequent imaging and interpretation. Conventional attenuation methods, including transform-domain filtering, sparse representation, and deep learning, often suffer from limited adaptability, signal leakage, or dependence on labeled training data, especially under strong signal-noise overlap. To address these challenges, we propose a training-free framework that reformulates ground-roll attenuation as a semantic-guided signal separation problem. Specifically, a promptable large vision model is employed to extract high-level semantic priors by converting seismic gathers into visual representations and localizing ground-roll-dominant regions via text or image prompts. The resulting semantic response is transformed into a continuous soft mask, which is embedded into a mask-conditioned low-rank inverse formulation to enable spatially adaptive suppression and reflection-preserving reconstruction. An efficient alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based solver is further developed to solve the proposed inverse problem, enabling stable and physically consistent signal recovery without requiring task-specific training or manual annotation. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and field VSP datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior ground-roll attenuation while preserving reflection continuity and waveform fidelity, consistently outperforming representative transform-domain filtering and implicit neural representation methods.

Abstract

Ground-roll is a dominant source of coherent noise in land and vertical seismic profiling (VSP) data, severely masking reflection events and degrading subsequent imaging and interpretation. Conventional attenuation methods, including transform-domain filtering, sparse representation, and deep learning, often suffer from limited adaptability, signal leakage, or dependence on labeled training data, especially under strong signal-noise overlap. To address these challenges, we propose a training-free framework that reformulates ground-roll attenuation as a semantic-guided signal separation problem. Specifically, a promptable large vision model is employed to extract high-level semantic priors by converting seismic gathers into visual representations and localizing ground-roll-dominant regions via text or image prompts. The resulting semantic response is transformed into a continuous soft mask, which is embedded into a mask-conditioned low-rank inverse formulation to enable spatially adaptive suppression and reflection-preserving reconstruction. An efficient alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based solver is further developed to solve the proposed inverse problem, enabling stable and physically consistent signal recovery without requiring task-specific training or manual annotation. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and field VSP datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior ground-roll attenuation while preserving reflection continuity and waveform fidelity, consistently outperforming representative transform-domain filtering and implicit neural representation methods.

item.title: Query-Conditioned Evidential Keyframe Sampling for MLLM-Based Long-Form Video Understanding
item.author: Yiheng Wang, Lichen Zhu, Yueqian Lin, Yudong Liu, Jingyang Zhang, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于信息瓶颈理论的关键帧采样框架，旨在解决多模态大模型在长视频问答中的上下文长度和计算成本限制问题。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在视频问答任务中表现出色，但在处理长视频时受到上下文长度和计算成本的限制，因此关键帧采样至关重要。现有的方法通常依赖语义相关性或强化学习，但前者无法捕捉证据线索，后者存在组合优化效率低的问题。

目的: 提出一种基于信息瓶颈理论的证据驱动关键帧采样框架，旨在解决现有方法在捕捉证据线索和优化效率方面的不足。

方法: 将关键帧选择形式化为最大化所选帧与查询之间的条件互信息，利用其结构推导出可分解的优化问题，将子集选择简化为独立的帧级评分。此外，引入了一个查询条件证据评分网络，通过对比目标进行训练以高效估计证据重要性。

主要发现: 在长视频理解基准测试中，该方法在严格的令牌预算下始终优于先前的采样策略，并显著提高了训练效率。

结论: 该方法在长视频理解任务中表现优异，能够有效解决长视频处理中的关键帧采样问题。

翻译: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance on video question answering, but their application to long-form videos is constrained by limited context length and computational cost, making keyframe sampling essential. Existing approaches typically rely on semantic relevance or reinforcement learning, which either fail to capture evidential clues or suffer from inefficient combinatorial optimization. In this work, we propose an evidence-driven keyframe sampling framework grounded in information bottleneck theory. We formulate keyframe selection as maximizing the conditional mutual information between selected frames and the query, providing a principled objective that reflects each frame's contribution to answering the question. To make this objective tractable, we exploit its structure to derive a decomposed optimization that reduces subset selection to independent frame-level scoring. We further introduce a query-conditioned evidence scoring network trained with a contrastive objective to estimate evidential importance efficiently. Experiments on long-form video understanding benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms prior sampling strategies under strict token budgets, while significantly improving training efficiency.

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance on video question answering, but their application to long-form videos is constrained by limited context length and computational cost, making keyframe sampling essential. Existing approaches typically rely on semantic relevance or reinforcement learning, which either fail to capture evidential clues or suffer from inefficient combinatorial optimization. In this work, we propose an evidence-driven keyframe sampling framework grounded in information bottleneck theory. We formulate keyframe selection as maximizing the conditional mutual information between selected frames and the query, providing a principled objective that reflects each frame's contribution to answering the question. To make this objective tractable, we exploit its structure to derive a decomposed optimization that reduces subset selection to independent frame-level scoring. We further introduce a query-conditioned evidence scoring network trained with a contrastive objective to estimate evidential importance efficiently. Experiments on long-form video understanding benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms prior sampling strategies under strict token budgets, while significantly improving training efficiency.

item.title: AutoMIA: Improved Baselines for Membership Inference Attack via Agentic Self-Exploration
item.author: Ruhao Liu, Weiqi Huang, Qi Li, Xinchao Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AutoMIA是一个自动化框架，用于解决现有成员推断攻击方法缺乏适应性的问题，通过自我探索和策略进化来优化攻击效果。

背景: 现有的成员推断攻击方法主要依赖静态、手工设计的启发式规则，缺乏适应性，在不同大型模型间迁移时性能往往不佳。

目的: 提出AutoMIA框架，将成员推断重构为自动化的自我探索和策略进化过程，以系统且模型无关地遍历攻击搜索空间。

方法: AutoMIA通过生成可执行的logits级策略并利用闭环评估反馈进行渐进式优化，将抽象策略推理与低级执行解耦。

主要发现: AutoMIA在大量实验中始终匹配或优于最先进的基线，且无需手动特征工程。

结论: AutoMIA成功实现了成员推断攻击的自动化，消除了对人工特征工程的依赖，并提供了系统性的模型无关攻击搜索方法。

翻译: 成员推断攻击是评估机器学习模型训练数据泄露的基本审计工具。然而，现有方法主要依赖静态、手工设计的启发式规则，缺乏适应性，在跨不同大型模型迁移时往往导致性能不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了AutoMIA，一个将成员推断重构为自我探索和策略进化自动化过程的代理框架。给定高层场景规范，AutoMIA通过生成可执行的logits级策略并利用闭环评估反馈进行渐进式优化，来自我探索攻击空间。通过将抽象策略推理与低级执行解耦，我们的框架能够系统且模型无关地遍历攻击搜索空间。大量实验表明，AutoMIA始终匹配或优于最先进的基线，同时消除了对手动特征工程的需求。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决成员推断攻击的基线改进问题，通过代理自我探索的方法来提升攻击效果。文中未明确说明该问题在现实或研究中的重要性，请写 "unknown"。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 AutoMIA 的方法，通过代理自我探索来改进成员推断攻击的基线。

Abstract

Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) serve as a fundamental auditing tool for evaluating training data leakage in machine learning models. However, existing methodologies predominantly rely on static, handcrafted heuristics that lack adaptability, often leading to suboptimal performance when transferred across different large models. In this work, we propose AutoMIA, an agentic framework that reformulates membership inference as an automated process of self-exploration and strategy evolution. Given high-level scenario specifications, AutoMIA self-explores the attack space by generating executable logits-level strategies and progressively refining them through closed-loop evaluation feedback. By decoupling abstract strategy reasoning from low-level execution, our framework enables a systematic, model-agnostic traversal of the attack search space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AutoMIA consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while eliminating the need for manual feature engineering.

item.title: Transfer learning for nonparametric Bayesian networks
item.author: Rafael Sojo, Pedro Larrañaga, Concha Bielza
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了两种用于在数据稀缺情况下估计非参数贝叶斯网络的迁移学习方法，包括基于约束的结构学习方法和基于评分的爬山算法方法，并提出了相应的指标来解决负迁移问题。

背景: 在数据稀缺的情况下，非参数贝叶斯网络的学习具有挑战性。迁移学习是一种解决数据稀缺问题的潜在方法，但可能面临负迁移问题，即迁移学习对模型性能产生负面影响。

目的: 提出两种迁移学习方法，以在数据稀缺时提高非参数贝叶斯网络的学习性能，并解决负迁移问题。

方法: 提出了两种算法：基于约束的结构学习方法PC-stable-transfer learning (PCS-TL)和基于评分的爬山算法方法hill climbing transfer learning (HC-TL)。针对参数估计，提出了对数线性池化方法。为了评估，学习了核密度估计贝叶斯网络，并从合成网络和UCI机器学习库的数据集中采样数据，添加噪声和修改以测试避免负迁移的能力。最后，使用Friedman检验和Bergmann-Hommel事后分析来展示实验行为的增强。

主要发现: PCS-TL和HC-TL被证明是可靠的算法，能够提高数据稀缺时非参数贝叶斯网络的学习性能，并有效避免负迁移。

结论: 在真实工业环境中，这些方法意味着部署网络所需时间的减少。

翻译: 本文介绍了两种用于在数据稀缺情况下估计非参数贝叶斯网络的迁移学习方法。我们提出了两种算法：一种基于约束的结构学习方法，称为PC-stable-transfer learning (PCS-TL)，以及一种基于评分的方法，称为hill climbing transfer learning (HC-TL)。我们还定义了特定的指标来解决这两种方法中的负迁移问题，这是一种迁移学习对模型性能产生负面影响的情况。对于参数，我们提出了一种对数线性池化方法。为了评估，我们学习了核密度估计贝叶斯网络，这是一种非参数贝叶斯网络类型，并将其迁移学习性能与仅使用模型进行了比较。为此，我们从小型、中型和大型合成网络以及UCI机器学习库的数据集中采样数据。然后，我们向这些数据集添加噪声和修改，以测试它们避免负迁移的能力。最后，我们执行了Friedman检验和Bergmann-Hommel事后分析，以展示我们方法的增强实验行为的统计证明。因此，PCS-TL和HC-TL被证明是提高数据稀缺时非参数贝叶斯网络学习性能的可靠算法，这在真实工业环境中意味着部署网络所需时间的减少。

Abstract

This paper introduces two transfer learning methodologies for estimating nonparametric Bayesian networks under scarce data. We propose two algorithms, a constraint-based structure learning method, called PC-stable-transfer learning (PCS-TL), and a score-based method, called hill climbing transfer learning (HC-TL). We also define particular metrics to tackle the negative transfer problem in each of them, a situation in which transfer learning has a negative impact on the model's performance. Then, for the parameters, we propose a log-linear pooling approach. For the evaluation, we learn kernel density estimation Bayesian networks, a type of nonparametric Bayesian network, and compare their transfer learning performance with the models alone. To do so, we sample data from small, medium and large-sized synthetic networks and datasets from the UCI Machine Learning repository. Then, we add noise and modifications to these datasets to test their ability to avoid negative transfer. To conclude, we perform a Friedman test with a Bergmann-Hommel post-hoc analysis to show statistical proof of the enhanced experimental behavior of our methods. Thus, PCS-TL and HC-TL demonstrate to be reliable algorithms for improving the learning performance of a nonparametric Bayesian network with scarce data, which in real industrial environments implies a reduction in the required time to deploy the network.

item.author: Rafael Sojo, Pedro Larrañaga, Concha Bielza

item.title: Revision or Re-Solving? Decomposing Second-Pass Gains in Multi-LLM Pipelines
item.author: Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Chengyu Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究质疑了多模型修订管道的增益主要来自真实错误修正的假设，通过控制分解实验分析了增益的三个组成成分。

背景: 多模型修订管道假设第二模型通过修正第一模型的草稿来产生增益。

目的: 通过受控分解实验将第二轮增益分离为三个加性成分，以探究增益的来源和影响因素。

方法: 使用四个匹配条件，将增益分离为重求解、脚手架和内容三个成分；在三个涵盖知识密集型多项选择问答和竞技编程的基准上评估了两种模型对。

主要发现: 多模型修订的增益不是单一的，取决于任务结构、草稿质量和草稿信息的类型。在多项选择问答任务中，增益与强模型的重新求解一致，直接将查询路由到强模型可能比修正弱草稿更有效；在代码生成任务中，两阶段提示仍然有用，因为即使语义为空的草稿也能提供实质性的结构脚手架，而弱草稿内容可能有害；强草稿明显使弱评审者受益。

结论: 多模型修订的效用受任务结构和草稿质量的动态瓶颈限制，需要更有针对性的管道设计而非一概而论的修订策略。

翻译: 多模型修订管道，即第二模型审查并改进第一模型产生的草稿，被广泛假设其增益来自真实的错误修正。我们通过受控分解实验质疑了这一假设，该实验使用四个匹配条件将第二轮增益分离为三个加性成分：重求解、脚手架和内容。我们在三个涵盖知识密集型多项选择问答和竞技编程的基准上评估了两种模型对的设计。我们的结果表明，多模型修订的增益不是单一的，而是取决于任务结构、草稿质量和草稿信息的类型。在多项选择问答任务中，答案空间受限且草稿提供很少的结构指导，大多数增益与强模型的重新求解一致，直接将查询路由到强模型可能比修正弱草稿更有效。然而，在代码生成任务中，两阶段提示仍然有用，因为即使语义为空的草稿也能提供实质性的结构脚手架，而弱草稿内容可能有害。最后，角色互换实验表明，强草稿明显使弱评审者受益。最终，我们的发现表明，多模型修订的效用受任务结构和草稿质量的动态瓶颈限制，需要更有针对性的管道设计而非一概而论的修订策略。

Multi-LLM revision pipelines, in which a second model reviews and improves a draft produced by a first, are widely assumed to derive their gains from genuine error correction. We question this assumption with a controlled decomposition experiment that uses four matched conditions to separate second-pass gains into three additive components: re-solving, scaffold, and content. We evaluate this design across two model pairs on three benchmarks spanning knowledge-intensive MCQ and competitive programming. Our results show that the gains of multi-LLM revision are not monolithic, but depend on task structure, draft quality, and the type of draft information. On MCQ tasks, where the answer space is constrained and drafts provide little structural guidance, most gains are consistent with stronger-model re-solving, and directly routing queries to the stronger model can be more effective than revising a weak draft. On code generation tasks, however, two-stage prompting remains useful because even semantically null drafts can provide substantial structural scaffolding, while weak draft content can be harmful. Finally, role-reversed experiments show that strong drafts clearly benefit weak reviewers. Ultimately, our findings demonstrate that the utility of multi-LLM revision is dynamically bottlenecked by task structure and draft quality, necessitating more targeted pipeline designs rather than blanket revision strategies.

item.title: Sub-metre Lunar DEM Generation and Validation from Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Multi-View Imagery Using an Open-Source Pipeline
item.author: Aaranay Aadi, Jai Singla, Nitant Dube, Oleg Alexandrov
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 首次利用开源流程从Chandrayaan-2的OHRC多视角影像生成亚米级数字高程模型(DEM)

背景: 高分辨率月球表面数字高程模型(DEM)对表面机动规划、着陆点表征和行星科学至关重要。Chandrayaan-2上的轨道高分辨率相机(OHRC)是目前在轨月球成像设备中具有最佳地面采样能力的相机，能够以约20-30厘米/像素的分辨率获取全色影像。

目的: 首次利用开源流程从OHRC多视角影像生成亚米级DEM。

方法: 通过分析图像元数据的几何特性识别候选立体像对，采用基线高度比(B/H)计算和收敛角估计。应用密集立体匹配和光线三角测量生成点云，将其网格化为DEM。通过迭代最近点(ICP)与月球勘测轨道器窄角相机(NAC)数字地形模型对齐，并进行恒定偏移校正。

主要发现: 在五个地理分布的月球站点，生成的DEM有效空间分辨率约为24至54厘米。与NAC参考地形验证显示，垂直均方根误差(RMSE)为5.85米（在OHRC原始分辨率下），水平精度小于30厘米。

结论: 生成的DEM具有绝对高程一致性，且水平精度小于30厘米。

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决利用印度“月船2号”轨道器高分辨率相机（OHRC）影像生成亚米级月球数字高程模型（DEM）的问题。由于OHRC影像并非以立体像对形式获取，且数据格式在常用工具中不受支持，论文提出了一种基于开源流程的识别、匹配和重建方法。这项研究非常重要，因为高分辨率DEM对月球表面规划、着陆点表征和行星科学至关重要。比现有产品（如LRO NAC DEM）高一个数量级的分辨率（约25-30厘米），能够分辨岩块尺度的地形特征和米级坡度变化，这对未来机器人和人类着陆任务的坡度风险评估、漫游车路径规划以及详细的撞击坑形态测量具有直接意义。
