This work investigates how foundation models can be specialized to generate structured robot policies grounded in multimodal perception, bridging high-dimensional learning and symbolic control. We propose a neuro-symbolic approach in which a VLM synthesizes executable Behavior Tree policies from visual observations, natural language instructions, and structured system specifications. To enable scalable supervision without manual annotation, we introduce an automated pipeline that generates a synthetic multimodal dataset of domain-randomized scenes paired with instruction-policy examples produced by a foundation model. Real-world experiments on two robotic manipulators show that structured policies learned entirely from synthetic supervision transfer successfully to physical systems. The results indicate that foundation models can be adapted to produce interpretable and structured robot policies, providing an alternative to opaque end-to-end approaches for multimodal robot decision making.

item.title: Transfer Learning for Loan Recovery Prediction under Distribution Shifts with Heterogeneous Feature Spaces
item.author: Christopher Gerling
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FT-MDN-Transformer是一种混合密度表格Transformer架构，旨在解决信用风险恢复率预测中的数据稀缺问题，通过迁移学习实现跨异构特征集的预测。

背景: 在许多贷款组合中，恢复率建模受到数据稀缺的制约，这源于罕见违约事件。迁移学习提供了一条有前景的途径，通过利用相关但更丰富的源域信息来缓解这一挑战，但其有效性取决于分布偏移的存在和强度，以及源域和目标特征空间之间潜在的异质性。

目的: 介绍FT-MDN-Transformer架构，专门设计用于在异构特征集中进行恢复率预测的迁移学习。该模型产生贷款级点估计和组合级预测分布，从而支持广泛的实际恢复率预测应用。

主要发现: 在目标域数据有限的情况下，FT-MDN-Transformer优于基线模型，特别是在协变量和条件偏移下表现尤为显著，而标签偏移仍然具有挑战性。其概率预测紧密跟踪经验恢复分布，提供比传统点预测指标更丰富的信息。

结论: 研究发现表明，分布感知的迁移学习架构有潜力改善数据稀缺信用组合中的恢复率预测，并为在异构数据环境中运营的风险管理者提供了实用见解。

翻译: Accurate forecasting of recovery rates (RR) is central to credit risk management and regulatory capital determination. In many loan portfolios, however, RR modeling is constrained by data scarcity arising from infrequent default events. Transfer learning (TL) offers a promising avenue to mitigate this challenge by exploiting information from related but richer source domains, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the presence and strength of distributional shifts, and on potential heterogeneity between source and target feature spaces. This paper introduces FT-MDN-Transformer, a mixture-density tabular Transformer architecture specifically designed for TL in RR forecasting across heterogeneous feature sets. The model produces both loan-level point estimates and portfolio-level predictive distributions, thereby supporting a wide range of practical RR forecasting applications. We evaluate the proposed approach in a controlled Monte Carlo simulation that facilitates systematic variation of covariate, conditional, and label shifts, as well as in a real-world transfer setting using the Global Credit Data (GCD) loan dataset as source and a novel bonds dataset as target. Our results show that FT-MDN-Transformer outperforms baseline models when target-domain data are limited, with particularly pronounced gains under covariate and conditional shifts, while label shift remains challenging. We also observe its probabilistic forecasts to closely track empirical recovery distributions, providing richer information than conventional point-prediction metrics alone. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of distribution-aware TL architectures to improve RR forecasting in data-scarce credit portfolios and offer practical insights for risk managers operating under heterogeneous data environments.

Abstract

Accurate forecasting of recovery rates (RR) is central to credit risk management and regulatory capital determination. In many loan portfolios, however, RR modeling is constrained by data scarcity arising from infrequent default events. Transfer learning (TL) offers a promising avenue to mitigate this challenge by exploiting information from related but richer source domains, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the presence and strength of distributional shifts, and on potential heterogeneity between source and target feature spaces. This paper introduces FT-MDN-Transformer, a mixture-density tabular Transformer architecture specifically designed for TL in RR forecasting across heterogeneous feature sets. The model produces both loan-level point estimates and portfolio-level predictive distributions, thereby supporting a wide range of practical RR forecasting applications. We evaluate the proposed approach in a controlled Monte Carlo simulation that facilitates systematic variation of covariate, conditional, and label shifts, as well as in a real-world transfer setting using the Global Credit Data (GCD) loan dataset as source and a novel bonds dataset as target. Our results show that FT-MDN-Transformer outperforms baseline models when target-domain data are limited, with particularly pronounced gains under covariate and conditional shifts, while label shift remains challenging. We also observe its probabilistic forecasts to closely track empirical recovery distributions, providing richer information than conventional point-prediction metrics alone. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of distribution-aware TL architectures to improve RR forecasting in data-scarce credit portfolios and offer practical insights for risk managers operating under heterogeneous data environments.

item.title: Bilateral Intent-Enhanced Sequential Recommendation with Embedding Perturbation-Based Contrastive Learning
item.author: Shanfan Zhang, Yongyi Lin, Yuan Rao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为BIPCL的框架，旨在通过双边意图增强和基于嵌入扰动的对比学习来准确建模用户的演化偏好。

背景: 准确建模用户演化偏好是推荐系统中的核心挑战。现有方法往往难以有效利用跨用户和物品的集体意图信号，导致信息隔离和鲁棒性有限。同时，现有的对比学习方法难以构建既语义一致又具有充分区分度的视图。

目的: 提出BIPCL框架，通过双边意图增强机制和基于嵌入扰动的对比学习，解决信息隔离问题，提高鲁棒性，并构建有效的对比视图。

方法: BIPCL是一个端到端的框架。它通过双边意图增强机制将多意图信号显式集成到物品和序列表示中。具体而言，用户和物品侧的共享意图原型捕获从行为相似的实体中提炼的集体意图语义。为了构建有效的对比视图而不破坏时间或结构依赖，BIPCL将有界、方向感知的扰动直接注入到结构化物品嵌入中。此外，BIPCL进一步在交互级和意图级表示上强制多级对比对齐。

主要发现: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，BIPCL始终优于最先进的基线。消融研究证实了每个组件的贡献。

结论: BIPCL通过双边意图增强和嵌入扰动对比学习，有效缓解了信息隔离问题，提高了鲁棒性，并实现了有效的对比视图构建。

翻译: Accurately modeling users' evolving preferences from sequential interactions remains a central challenge in recommender systems. Recent studies emphasize the importance of capturing multiple latent intents underlying user behaviors. However, existing methods often fail to effectively exploit collective intent signals shared across users and items, leading to information isolation and limited robustness. Meanwhile, current contrastive learning approaches struggle to construct views that are both semantically consistent and sufficiently discriminative. In this work, we propose BIPCL, an end-to-end Bilateral Intent-enhanced, Embedding Perturbation-based Contrastive Learning framework. BIPCL explicitly integrates multi-intent signals into both item and sequence representations via a bilateral intent-enhancement mechanism. Specifically, shared intent prototypes on the user and item sides capture collective intent semantics distilled from behaviorally similar entities, which are subsequently integrated into representation learning. This design alleviates information isolation and improves robustness under sparse supervision. To construct effective contrastive views without disrupting temporal or structural dependencies, BIPCL injects bounded, direction-aware perturbations directly into structural item embeddings. On this basis, BIPCL further enforces multi-level contrastive alignment across interaction- and intent-level representations. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that BIPCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with ablation studies confirming the contribution of each component.

Abstract

Accurately modeling users' evolving preferences from sequential interactions remains a central challenge in recommender systems. Recent studies emphasize the importance of capturing multiple latent intents underlying user behaviors. However, existing methods often fail to effectively exploit collective intent signals shared across users and items, leading to information isolation and limited robustness. Meanwhile, current contrastive learning approaches struggle to construct views that are both semantically consistent and sufficiently discriminative. In this work, we propose BIPCL, an end-to-end Bilateral Intent-enhanced, Embedding Perturbation-based Contrastive Learning framework. BIPCL explicitly integrates multi-intent signals into both item and sequence representations via a bilateral intent-enhancement mechanism. Specifically, shared intent prototypes on the user and item sides capture collective intent semantics distilled from behaviorally similar entities, which are subsequently integrated into representation learning. This design alleviates information isolation and improves robustness under sparse supervision. To construct effective contrastive views without disrupting temporal or structural dependencies, BIPCL injects bounded, direction-aware perturbations directly into structural item embeddings. On this basis, BIPCL further enforces multi-level contrastive alignment across interaction- and intent-level representations. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that BIPCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with ablation studies confirming the contribution of each component.

item.title: Deformation-based In-Context Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
item.author: Chengxing Lin, Jinhong Deng, Yinjie Lei, Wen Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DeformPIC是一种基于变形的框架，用于点云上下文学习，通过任务特定提示引导查询点云变形，实现了显式几何推理和一致的训练-推理目标。

背景: 现有的点云上下文学习方法通常采用基于掩码点建模的范式，但存在缺乏几何先验、训练-推理目标不匹配等问题。

目的: 提出DeformPIC框架，以解决现有方法在点云上下文学习中缺乏几何先验和训练-推理目标不匹配的挑战。

方法: DeformPIC通过变形学习，在提示的任务特定指导下变形查询点云，而非依赖掩码重建。

主要发现: DeformPIC在重建、去噪和配准任务上分别降低了1.6、1.8和4.7点的平均Chamfer距离，并在新的域外基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: DeformPIC一致地优于之前的最佳方法，在点云上下文学习任务中表现出色。

翻译: DeformPIC是一种基于变形的框架，用于点云上下文学习，通过任务特定提示引导查询点云变形，实现了显式几何推理和一致的训练-推理目标。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 现有的基于掩码点建模的方法主要解决两个问题：一是缺乏几何先验，导致模型难以仅凭抽象标记推断出准确的空间结构；二是训练和推理的目标不一致，模型在训练时能看到目标信息，而在推理时却看不到，导致性能下降。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为现有的方法会产生几何伪影且泛化能力有限。该论文提出的基于变形的方法通过显式建模几何变换，统一了训练和推理目标，从而能更准确地完成重建、去噪和配准等任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有的基于掩码点建模的方法存在两个主要问题：一是直接从几何信息缺失的掩码标记预测目标，迫使模型仅从抽象的标记级相关性推断结构；二是存在训练与推理目标不匹配，导致模型容易产生捷径学习。为了解决这些问题，作者将任务重新构思为几何变形过程，直接应用任务特定的变换将查询输入变形为目标形状。该方法借鉴了自然语言处理中的 In-Context Learning（ICL）概念，以及视觉和点云领域的相关工作，如 PIC 和 Painter，同时也借鉴了神经变形技术来直接操纵几何结构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法将点云上下文学习重新表述为变形过程，不再从无几何信息的掩码标记重建目标，而是学习根据提示示例将查询输入变形为目标形状。整体实现包含两个网络：变形提取网络从提示对中提取任务特定的几何变换；变形转移网络将学习到的变换应用于查询输入，从而生成最终预测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了DeformPIC框架，将点云上下文学习重构为变形过程，在提示示例的指导下将查询输入变换为目标形状。该方法显式建模了几何对应关系，并统一了训练和推理的目标，从而避免了训练时利用目标可见部分、推理时目标被掩码导致的目标不匹配问题。相比之前基于掩码重建的方法，DeformPIC利用变形策略增强了几何连贯性，显著提升了重建、去噪和配准任务的性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了DeformPIC框架，将点云上下文学习重新表述为变形过程，利用提示示例指导查询输入变形为目标形状，从而显式建模几何对应关系并统一训练与推理目标，在多个任务上显著优于现有方法。

Abstract

Recent advances in point cloud In-Context Learning (ICL) have demonstrated strong multitask capabilities. Existing approaches typically adopt a Masked Point Modeling (MPM)-based paradigm for point cloud ICL. However, MPM-based methods directly predict the target point cloud from masked tokens without leveraging geometric priors, requiring the model to infer spatial structure and geometric details solely from token-level correlations via transformers. Additionally, these methods suffer from a training-inference objective mismatch, as the model learns to predict the target point cloud using target-side information that is unavailable at inference time. To address these challenges, we propose DeformPIC, a deformation-based framework for point cloud ICL. Unlike existing approaches that rely on masked reconstruction, DeformPIC learns to deform the query point cloud under task-specific guidance from prompts, enabling explicit geometric reasoning and consistent objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeformPIC consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, achieving reductions of 1.6, 1.8, and 4.7 points in average Chamfer Distance on reconstruction, denoising, and registration tasks, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce a new out-of-domain benchmark to evaluate generalization across unseen data distributions, where DeformPIC achieves state-of-the-art performance.

item.title: SPG: Sparse-Projected Guides with Sparse Autoencoders for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
item.author: Tomoyasu Nanaumi, Yukino Tsuzuki, Junichi Okubo, Junichiro Fujii, Takayoshi Yamashita
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SPG的零样本异常检测与分割框架，通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）学习稀疏引导系数，无需目标域适应即可在未见过的目标类别上实现高性能检测与分割。

背景: 现有基于提示的方法使用手工制作或学习的提示嵌入作为正常/异常状态的参考向量，而本文旨在探索一种无需提示的框架。

目的: 研究零样本异常检测和分割，利用冻结的基础模型特征，仅在有标记的辅助数据集上训练可学习参数，并在未见过的目标类别上部署，无需目标域适应。

方法: 提出Sparse-Projected Guides (SPG)框架，采用两阶段学习策略：1) 在patch-token特征上训练SAE；2) 仅优化引导系数，冻结骨干网络和SAE，使用辅助像素级掩码。

主要发现: 在MVTec AD和VisA的跨数据集零样本设置下，SPG实现了竞争力的图像级检测和强大的像素级分割；使用DINOv3时，SPG在像素级AUROC上达到最高；使用OpenCLIP时，SPG与基于CLIP的基线对齐。

结论: 学习到的引导系数将决策追溯到一组小的字典原子，揭示了类别通用和类别特定的因素。

翻译: We study zero-shot anomaly detection and segmentation using frozen foundation model features, where all learnable parameters are trained only on a labeled auxiliary dataset and deployed to unseen target categories without any target-domain adaptation. Existing prompt-based approaches use handcrafted or learned prompt embeddings as reference vectors for normal/anomalous states. We propose Sparse-Projected Guides (SPG), a prompt-free framework that learns sparse guide coefficients in the Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent space, which generate normal/anomaly guide vectors via the SAE dictionary. SPG employs a two stage learning strategy on the labeled auxiliary dataset: (i) train an SAE on patch-token features, and (ii) optimize only guide coefficients using auxiliary pixel-level masks while freezing the backbone and SAE. On MVTec AD and VisA under cross-dataset zero-shot settings, SPG achieves competitive image-level detection and strong pixel-level segmentation; with DINOv3, SPG attains the highest pixellevel AUROC among the compared methods. We also report SPG instantiated with OpenCLIP (ViT-L/14@336px) to align the backbone with CLIP-based baselines. Moreover, the learned guide coefficients trace decisions back to a small set of dictionary atoms, revealing category-general and category-specific factors.

Abstract

We study zero-shot anomaly detection and segmentation using frozen foundation model features, where all learnable parameters are trained only on a labeled auxiliary dataset and deployed to unseen target categories without any target-domain adaptation. Existing prompt-based approaches use handcrafted or learned prompt embeddings as reference vectors for normal/anomalous states. We propose Sparse-Projected Guides (SPG), a prompt-free framework that learns sparse guide coefficients in the Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent space, which generate normal/anomaly guide vectors via the SAE dictionary. SPG employs a two stage learning strategy on the labeled auxiliary dataset: (i) train an SAE on patch-token features, and (ii) optimize only guide coefficients using auxiliary pixel-level masks while freezing the backbone and SAE. On MVTec AD and VisA under cross-dataset zero-shot settings, SPG achieves competitive image-level detection and strong pixel-level segmentation; with DINOv3, SPG attains the highest pixellevel AUROC among the compared methods. We also report SPG instantiated with OpenCLIP (ViT-L/14@336px) to align the backbone with CLIP-based baselines. Moreover, the learned guide coefficients trace decisions back to a small set of dictionary atoms, revealing category-general and category-specific factors.

item.title: Unlocking Positive Transfer in Incrementally Learning Surgical Instruments: A Self-reflection Hierarchical Prompt Framework
item.author: Yu Zhu, Kang Li, Zheng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自反思分层提示框架，旨在通过正向和负向知识转移增强手术视频场景解析的模型适应性，实现新器械的熟练学习、现有器械技能的改进以及旧器械的灾难性遗忘避免。

背景: 近期研究通过增量更新来逐步学习越来越多的手术器械，但先前的工作忽略了正向前向知识转移和正向后向知识转移的潜力。

目的: 提出自反思分层提示框架，以解锁正向前向和正向后向知识转移在类增量分割中的力量，从而熟练学习新器械，改进现有器械技能，并避免旧器械的灾难性遗忘。

方法: 该框架基于冻结的预训练模型，在训练过程中自适应地为新类添加器械感知提示。为了实现正向前向知识转移，将器械提示组织成分层提示解析树；为了鼓励正向后向知识转移，通过有向加权图传播对现有知识进行自反思细化。

主要发现: 该框架适用于基于CNN的模型和先进的基于Transformer的基础模型，在两个公共基准测试中分别比竞争方法提高了超过5%和11%。

结论: 提出的自反思分层提示框架能够有效实现正向知识转移，提升模型在手术视频场景解析中的性能。

翻译: To continuously enhance model adaptability in surgical video scene parsing, recent studies incrementally update it to progressively learn to segment an increasing number of surgical instruments over time. However, prior works constantly overlooked the potential of positive forward knowledge transfer, i.e., how past knowledge could help learn new classes, and positive backward knowledge transfer, i.e., how learning new classes could help refine past knowledge. In this paper, we propose a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework that unlocks the power of positive forward and backward knowledge transfer in class incremental segmentation, aiming to proficiently learn new instruments, improve existing skills of regular instruments, and avoid catastrophic forgetting of old instruments. Our framework is built on a frozen, pre-trained model that adaptively appends instrument-aware prompts for new classes throughout training episodes. To enable positive forward knowledge transfer, we organize instrument prompts into a hierarchical prompt parsing tree with the instrument-shared prompt partition as the root node, n-part-shared prompt partitions as intermediate nodes and instrument-distinct prompt partitions as leaf nodes, to expose the reusable historical knowledge for new classes to simplify their learning. Conversely, to encourage positive backward knowledge transfer, we conduct self-reflection refining on existing knowledge by directed-weighted graph propagation, examining the knowledge associations recorded in the tree to improve its representativeness without causing catastrophic forgetting. Our framework is applicable to both CNN-based models and advanced transformer-based foundation models, yielding more than 5% and 11% improvements over the competing methods on two public benchmarks respectively.

Abstract

To continuously enhance model adaptability in surgical video scene parsing, recent studies incrementally update it to progressively learn to segment an increasing number of surgical instruments over time. However, prior works constantly overlooked the potential of positive forward knowledge transfer, i.e., how past knowledge could help learn new classes, and positive backward knowledge transfer, i.e., how learning new classes could help refine past knowledge. In this paper, we propose a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework that unlocks the power of positive forward and backward knowledge transfer in class incremental segmentation, aiming to proficiently learn new instruments, improve existing skills of regular instruments, and avoid catastrophic forgetting of old instruments. Our framework is built on a frozen, pre-trained model that adaptively appends instrument-aware prompts for new classes throughout training episodes. To enable positive forward knowledge transfer, we organize instrument prompts into a hierarchical prompt parsing tree with the instrument-shared prompt partition as the root node, n-part-shared prompt partitions as intermediate nodes and instrument-distinct prompt partitions as leaf nodes, to expose the reusable historical knowledge for new classes to simplify their learning. Conversely, to encourage positive backward knowledge transfer, we conduct self-reflection refining on existing knowledge by directed-weighted graph propagation, examining the knowledge associations recorded in the tree to improve its representativeness without causing catastrophic forgetting. Our framework is applicable to both CNN-based models and advanced transformer-based foundation models, yielding more than 5% and 11% improvements over the competing methods on two public benchmarks respectively.

item.title: Progressive Video Condensation with MLLM Agent for Long-form Video Understanding
item.author: Yufei Yin, Yuchen Xing, Qianke Meng, Minghao Chen, Yan Yang, Zhou Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为ProVCA的渐进式视频压缩代理，通过多粒度定位关键视频帧来提高视频理解效率。

背景: 现有文本先处理流程丢失了细粒度的视觉线索，而基于视频的多模态大语言模型虽然能保留视觉细节，但过于依赖帧且计算成本高昂。

目的: 利用多模态大语言模型实现高效的视频理解。

方法: ProVCA包含三个模块：首先使用片段定位模块识别与查询相关的视频片段，然后使用片段选择模块基于相似度选择重要片段，最后使用关键帧细化模块精确定位片段中的关键帧。

主要发现: ProVCA在EgoSchema、NExT-QA和IntentQA数据集上实现了最先进的零样本准确率，分别为69.3%、80.5%和77.7%，且使用的帧数少于之前的无训练方法。

结论: ProVCA通过从粗粒度片段到细粒度帧的渐进式缩小范围，能够识别出少量关键帧供多模态大语言模型进行推理，从而实现了高效的视频理解。

翻译: 理解长视频需要在有限的计算预算下从长序列中提取与查询相关的信息。现有的文本先处理流程丢失了细粒度的视觉线索，而基于视频的多模态大语言模型虽然能保留视觉细节，但过于依赖帧且计算成本高昂。在这项工作中，我们的目标是利用多模态大语言模型实现高效的视频理解。我们提出了ProVCA，一种渐进式视频压缩代理，它可以在多个粒度上迭代定位关键视频帧。ProVCA首先采用片段定位模块来识别与查询相关的视频片段，然后采用片段选择模块基于相似度选择重要片段，最后采用关键帧细化模块来精确定位这些片段中的特定关键帧。通过从粗粒度片段到细粒度帧的渐进式缩小范围，ProVCA识别出少量关键帧供基于多模态大语言模型的推理使用。ProVCA在EgoSchema、NExT-QA和IntentQA上实现了最先进的零样本准确率，分别为69.3%、80.5%和77.7%，同时使用的帧数少于之前的无训练方法。

Abstract

Understanding long videos requires extracting query-relevant information from long sequences under tight compute budgets. Existing text-then-LLM pipelines lose fine-grained visual cues, while video-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can keep visual details but are too frame-hungry and computationally expensive. In this work, we aim to harness MLLMs for efficient video understanding. We propose ProVCA, a progressive video condensation agent that iteratively locates key video frames at multiple granularities. ProVCA first adopts a segment localization module to identify the video segment relevant to the query, then a snippet selection module to select important snippets based on similarity, and finally a keyframe refinement module to pinpoint specific keyframes in those snippets. By progressively narrowing the scope from coarse segments to fine frames, ProVCA identifies a small set of keyframes for MLLM-based reasoning. ProVCA achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracies of 69.3\% on EgoSchema, 80.5\% on NExT-QA, and 77.7\% on IntentQA, while using fewer frames than previous training-free methods.

item.title: EvaNet: Towards More Efficient and Consistent Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Assessment
item.author: Chunyang Cheng, Tianyang Xu, Xiao-Jun Wu, Tao Zhou, Hui Li, Zhangyong Tang, Josef Kittler
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种针对图像融合的统一评估框架，该框架通过轻量级网络近似广泛使用的指标，并采用分治策略。

背景: 现有的图像融合评估指标大多直接借用自其他视觉任务，缺乏针对性适配。这些传统指标通常基于复杂的图像变换，不仅无法捕捉融合结果的真正质量，而且计算成本高昂。

目的: 为了解决现有评估指标的问题，提出一个专门为图像融合设计的统一评估框架。

方法: 该框架的核心是一个高效设计的轻量级网络，用于近似广泛使用的指标，遵循分治策略。与直接评估融合图像与源图像相似性的传统方法不同，首先将融合结果分解为红外和可见光分量。评估模型随后用于测量这些分离分量中信息保留的程度，从而有效解耦融合评估过程。在训练过程中，结合了对比学习策略，并利用大型语言模型提供的感知场景评估来指导评估模型。最后，提出了第一个一致性评估框架，使用独立的无参考评分和下游任务性能作为客观参考，来测量图像融合指标与人类视觉感知的对齐程度。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，基于学习的评估范式在标准图像融合基准测试中提供了卓越的效率（快达1000倍）和更大的跨范围一致性。

结论: 该学习评估范式在效率和一致性方面均优于传统方法。

翻译: 评估在图像融合研究中至关重要，然而大多数现有指标是直接借用自其他视觉任务而没有适当的适配。这些传统指标通常基于复杂的图像变换，不仅无法捕捉融合结果的真正质量，而且计算成本高昂。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种专门为图像融合量身定制的统一评估框架。其核心是一个高效设计的轻量级网络，用于近似广泛使用的指标，遵循分治策略。与直接评估融合图像与源图像之间相似性的传统方法不同，我们首先将融合结果分解为红外和可见光分量。评估模型随后用于测量这些分离分量中信息保留的程度，从而有效解耦融合评估过程。在训练过程中，我们结合了对比学习策略，并利用大型语言模型提供的感知场景评估来指导评估模型。最后，我们提出了第一个一致性评估框架，使用独立的无参考评分和下游任务性能作为客观参考，来测量图像融合指标与人类视觉感知的对齐程度。广泛的实验表明，基于学习的评估范式在标准图像融合基准测试中提供了卓越的效率（快达1000倍）和更大的跨范围一致性。我们的代码将在 https://github.com/AWCXV/EvaNet 上公开。

Abstract

Evaluation is essential in image fusion research, yet most existing metrics are directly borrowed from other vision tasks without proper adaptation. These traditional metrics, often based on complex image transformations, not only fail to capture the true quality of the fusion results but also are computationally demanding. To address these issues, we propose a unified evaluation framework specifically tailored for image fusion. At its core is a lightweight network designed efficiently to approximate widely used metrics, following a divide-and-conquer strategy. Unlike conventional approaches that directly assess similarity between fused and source images, we first decompose the fusion result into infrared and visible components. The evaluation model is then used to measure the degree of information preservation in these separated components, effectively disentangling the fusion evaluation process. During training, we incorporate a contrastive learning strategy and inform our evaluation model by perceptual scene assessment provided by a large language model. Last, we propose the first consistency evaluation framework, which measures the alignment between image fusion metrics and human visual perception, using both independent no-reference scores and downstream tasks performance as objective references. Extensive experiments show that our learning-based evaluation paradigm delivers both superior efficiency (up to 1,000 times faster) and greater consistency across a range of standard image fusion benchmarks. Our code will be publicly available at https://github.com/AWCXV/EvaNet.

item.title: RayMamba: Ray-Aligned Serialization for Long-Range 3D Object Detection
item.author: Cheng Lu, Mingqian Ji, Shanshan Zhang, Zhihao Li, Jian Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RayMamba是一种基于几何感知的即插即用增强方法，用于基于体素的3D目标检测器，旨在解决稀疏场景中的长距离建模问题。

背景: LiDAR观测在远场变得高度稀疏和碎片化，使得现有检测器难以进行可靠的环境建模。虽然基于状态空间模型的方法提高了长距离建模效率，但它们仍受限于通用的序列化策略，无法在稀疏场景中保留有意义的上下文邻域。

目的: 提出RayMamba，一种几何感知的即插即用增强方法，以解决稀疏场景中上下文建模的问题。

方法: RayMamba通过射线对齐的序列化策略将稀疏体素组织成扇区有序序列，从而在后续基于Mamba的建模中保留方向连续性和遮挡相关的上下文。它兼容LiDAR-only和多模态检测器，且仅引入了适度的开销。

主要发现: 在nuScenes数据集上，RayMamba在40-50m的挑战性范围内实现了高达2.49 mAP和1.59 NDS的提升；在Argoverse 2数据集上，进一步将VoxelNeXt的mAP从30.3提升至31.2。

结论: RayMamba在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上的广泛实验中，在强基线模型上取得了持续改进，证明了其有效性和兼容性。

翻译: Long-range 3D object detection remains challenging because LiDAR observations become highly sparse and fragmented in the far field, making reliable context modeling difficult for existing detectors. To address this issue, recent state space model (SSM)-based methods have improved long-range modeling efficiency. However, their effectiveness is still limited by generic serialization strategies that fail to preserve meaningful contextual neighborhoods in sparse scenes. To address this issue, we propose RayMamba, a geometry-aware plug-and-play enhancement for voxel-based 3D detectors. RayMamba organizes sparse voxels into sector-wise ordered sequences through a ray-aligned serialization strategy, which preserves directional continuity and occlusion-related context for subsequent Mamba-based modeling. It is compatible with both LiDAR-only and multimodal detectors, while introducing only modest overhead. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate consistent improvements across strong baselines. In particular, RayMamba achieves up to 2.49 mAP and 1.59 NDS gain in the challenging 40--50 m range on nuScenes, and further improves VoxelNeXt on Argoverse 2 from 30.3 to 31.2 mAP.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决的是在长距离场景下，LiDAR 点云因距离和遮挡变得高度稀疏和碎片化，导致现有 3D 检测器难以捕捉可靠上下文的问题。现有方法受限于通用的序列化策略，无法在稀疏场景中保留有意义的上下文邻域。在现实中，这至关重要，因为自动驾驶中可靠检测远距离物体对安全规划至关重要；在研究中，这有助于提升检测器在远场稀疏场景下的性能，特别是在 40-50 米等挑战性范围内。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现远距离LiDAR观测稀疏且易遮挡，导致现有基于SSM的方法因通用序列化策略无法保留有意义的上下文邻域而受限。因此，他们设计了一种几何感知的“射线对齐序列化策略”，将体素按方位角扇区划分并有序排列，以保留方向连续性和遮挡相关上下文。作者借鉴了现有SSM方法（如PointMamba, VoxelMamba等）的序列化思路，但指出这些通用策略未考虑LiDAR采集几何，在稀疏远场场景中效果不佳，从而提出了改进方案。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是针对长距离稀疏场景，通过一种几何感知的射线对齐序列化策略，在将体素转换为序列时保留物体的方向连续性和遮挡相关的上下文信息，从而提升 Mamba 模型的建模效果。整体实现流程是将稀疏体素先按方位角划分为扇区，在扇区内按高度分层并按角度排序形成有序序列，接着利用 Mamba 模型对序列进行建模，最后将增强后的特征恢复到稀疏 3D 空间。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文识别出通用序列化策略在稀疏场景中难以保留有意义的上下文邻域，并提出了几何感知的 RayMamba 模块。相比之前的工作，RayMamba 采用“射线对齐”的序列化策略，将稀疏体素组织成扇区有序序列，从而减少无关背景混合并保留方向性和遮挡相关的上下文。它是一个轻量级的即插即用模块，适用于基于体素的 3D 检测器，仅引入了适度的开销。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 RayMamba，一种针对长距离 3D 目标检测的几何感知模块。它通过射线对齐的序列化策略，将稀疏体素组织成扇区有序序列，从而保留方向连续性和遮挡相关上下文，显著提升了检测性能。

Abstract

Long-range 3D object detection remains challenging because LiDAR observations become highly sparse and fragmented in the far field, making reliable context modeling difficult for existing detectors. To address this issue, recent state space model (SSM)-based methods have improved long-range modeling efficiency. However, their effectiveness is still limited by generic serialization strategies that fail to preserve meaningful contextual neighborhoods in sparse scenes. To address this issue, we propose RayMamba, a geometry-aware plug-and-play enhancement for voxel-based 3D detectors. RayMamba organizes sparse voxels into sector-wise ordered sequences through a ray-aligned serialization strategy, which preserves directional continuity and occlusion-related context for subsequent Mamba-based modeling. It is compatible with both LiDAR-only and multimodal detectors, while introducing only modest overhead. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate consistent improvements across strong baselines. In particular, RayMamba achieves up to 2.49 mAP and 1.59 NDS gain in the challenging 40--50 m range on nuScenes, and further improves VoxelNeXt on Argoverse 2 from 30.3 to 31.2 mAP.

item.title: SentiAvatar: Towards Expressive and Interactive Digital Humans
item.author: Chuhao Jin, Rui Zhang, Qingzhe Gao, Haoyu Shi, Dayu Wu, Yichen Jiang, Yihan Wu, Ruihua Song
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SentiAvatar是一个构建具有表达力的交互式3D数字人的框架，并创建了名为SuSu的虚拟角色，该角色能够实时说话、做手势和表达情感。

背景: 构建这样的系统具有挑战性，因为它需要同时解决三个关键问题：缺乏大规模、高质量的多模态数据，鲁棒的语义到运动的映射，以及细粒度的帧级运动-韵律同步。

目的: 为了解决上述三个关键问题，构建一个能够实时说话、做手势和表达情感的交互式3D数字人系统。

方法: 首先，构建了SuSuInterActs数据集（21K片段，37小时），通过光学动作捕捉捕获对话语料，包含同步语音、全身动作和面部表情。其次，在20万+动作序列上预训练了一个运动基础模型，赋予其丰富的动作先验。然后，提出了一种音频感知的计划-然后-填充架构，将句子级语义规划与帧级韵律驱动的插值解耦，使生成的动作既语义适当又与语音节奏一致。

主要发现: 实验表明，SentiAvatar在SuSuInterActs和BEATv2上均达到了最先进水平，在SuSuInterActs上R@1达到43.64%，几乎是最佳基线的两倍；在BEATv2上FGD达到4.941，BC达到8.078。该系统能在0.3秒内生成6秒的输出，支持无限多轮流式传输。

结论: SentiAvatar框架成功实现了具有表达力的交互式3D数字人，解决了大规模数据、语义到运动映射以及运动-韵律同步的挑战，并在性能上优于现有基线。

翻译: 我们提出了SentiAvatar，这是一个构建具有表达力的交互式3D数字人的框架，并利用它创建了SuSu，一个能够实时说话、做手势和表达情感的虚拟角色。实现这样一个系统仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要同时解决三个关键问题：缺乏大规模、高质量的多模态数据，鲁棒的语义到运动映射，以及细粒度的帧级运动-韵律同步。为了解决这些问题，首先，我们构建了SuSuInterActs（21K片段，37小时），这是一个通过光学动作捕捉围绕单个角色捕获的对话语料库，包含同步语音、全身动作和面部表情。其次，我们在20万+动作序列上预训练了一个运动基础模型，赋予其丰富的动作先验，这些先验远超对话范围。然后，我们提出了一种音频感知的计划-然后-填充架构，将句子级语义规划与帧级韵律驱动的插值解耦，从而使生成的动作既语义适当又与语音节奏一致。实验表明，SentiAvatar在SuSuInterActs和BEATv2上均达到了最先进水平，在SuSuInterActs上R@1达到43.64%，几乎是最佳基线的两倍；在BEATv2上FGD达到4.941，BC达到8.078，能够在0.3秒内生成6秒的输出，并支持无限多轮流式传输。源代码、模型和数据集可在https://sentiavatar.github.io获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决构建能够自然说话、手势和表达情感的交互式3D数字人的问题，具体包括缺乏高质量的多模态对话数据、语义到动作的映射不够准确，以及动作与语音韵律的帧级同步困难。这个问题在现实中很重要，因为非语言行为是交互不可或缺的一部分，对于建立信任、人机合作以及让虚拟角色更生动至关重要；在研究中，现有方法多基于独白或缺乏对话语境，难以模拟真实的人与人之间的对话交流。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对构建实时对话数字人面临的三个挑战，设计了“音频感知的计划-填充”架构。他们借鉴了离散标记LLM范式和语音驱动手势生成中的韵律感知方法。具体而言，作者利用LLM进行语义规划生成稀疏关键帧，再通过填充Transformer根据语音韵律填充中间帧，从而实现语义与韵律的对齐。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将生成过程解耦为两个阶段：句子级的语义规划和帧级的韵律对齐。整体流程是：首先利用大语言模型根据行为标签和音频生成稀疏的关键帧；然后通过音频感知的填充模型根据音频特征填补中间帧，确保动作与语音节奏同步；最后单独生成面部表情。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点包括构建了包含21K片段和37小时的多模态对话数据集SuSuInterActs，包含同步语音、全身运动和面部表情；提出了“音频感知计划-然后-填充”架构，将句子级语义规划与帧级韵律驱动插值解耦；在20万+运动序列上预训练了运动基础模型。相比之前工作，不同之处在于：现有的文本到运动数据集缺乏对话语境，语音驱动数据集多为独白而非双向对话；之前的语音驱动方法将手势视为低级反射，缺乏句子级语义规划，而该框架实现了语义与韵律的联合生成。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 SentiAvatar 框架，用于构建在实时对话中自然说话、做手势和表达情感的交互式 3D 数字人。为此，他们构建了包含同步语音、动作和表情的 SuSuInterActs 数据集，并提出了将语义规划与韵律驱动填充解耦的“计划-然后-填充”架构。

Abstract

We present SentiAvatar, a framework for building expressive interactive 3D digital humans, and use it to create SuSu, a virtual character that speaks, gestures, and emotes in real time. Achieving such a system remains challenging, as it requires jointly addressing three key problems: the lack of large-scale, high-quality multimodal data, robust semantic-to-motion mapping, and fine-grained frame-level motion-prosody synchronization. To solve these problems, first, we build SuSuInterActs (21K clips, 37 hours), a dialogue corpus captured via optical motion capture around a single character with synchronized speech, full-body motion, and facial expressions. Second, we pre-train a Motion Foundation Model on 200K+ motion sequences, equipping it with rich action priors that go well beyond the conversation. We then propose an audio-aware plan-then-infill architecture that decouples sentence-level semantic planning from frame-level prosody-driven interpolation, so that generated motions are both semantically appropriate and rhythmically aligned with speech. Experiments show that SentiAvatar achieves state-of-the-art on both SuSuInterActs (R@1 43.64%, nearly 2 times the best baseline) and BEATv2 (FGD 4.941, BC 8.078), producing 6s of output in 0.3s with unlimited multi-turn streaming. The source code, model, and dataset are available at https://sentiavatar.github.io.

item.title: GP-4DGS: Probabilistic 4D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video via Variational Gaussian Processes
item.author: Mijeong Kim, Jungtaek Kim, Bohyung Han
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GP-4DGS是一个将高斯过程引入4D高斯泼溅以进行动态场景概率建模的新框架。

背景: 现有的4D高斯泼溅方法专注于确定性重建，但在捕捉运动模糊和缺乏评估预测可靠性的机制方面存在固有限制。

目的: 利用基于核的概率特性，引入不确定性量化、稀疏区域运动估计以及训练帧之外的时间外推能力。

方法: 设计时空核以捕捉变形场的相关性结构，并采用具有诱导点的变分高斯过程以实现可处理的推断。

主要发现: GP-4DGS增强了重建质量，并提供了可靠的不确定性估计，有效识别出高运动模糊区域。

结论: 该工作通过解决这些挑战，在概率建模和神经图形学之间架起了一座有意义的桥梁。

翻译: 我们提出了GP-4DGS，这是一个将高斯过程引入4D高斯泼溅以进行动态场景概率建模的新颖框架。现有的4D高斯泼溅方法专注于确定性重建，但在捕捉运动模糊和缺乏评估预测可靠性的机制方面存在固有限制。通过利用高斯过程的基于核的概率特性，我们的方法引入了三个关键能力：运动预测的不确定性量化、未观测或稀疏采样区域的运动估计，以及训练帧之外的时间外推。为了将高斯过程扩展到4D高斯泼溅中的大量高斯原语，我们设计了捕捉变形场相关性结构的时空核，并采用了具有诱导点的变分高斯过程以实现可处理的推断。我们的实验表明，GP-4DGS增强了重建质量，同时提供了可靠的不确定性估计，有效识别出高运动模糊区域。通过解决这些挑战，我们的工作在概率建模和神经图形学之间架起了一座有意义的桥梁。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 现有4D Gaussian Splatting方法将运动视为确定性优化问题，依赖固定先验且缺乏不确定性估计和外推能力。当图元观察不佳或被遮挡时，这些固定先验往往变得不恰当或过于严格。动态场景重建对机器人、自动驾驶和大型重建模型具有重要意义，能实现不受约束环境下的3D捕获。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有 4DGS 方法使用固定的运动先验，无法处理不确定性或稀疏数据，因此借鉴了高斯过程（GP）的核机制来学习数据自适应的先验。他们设计了一个组合核，将空间和平滑度与时间周期性分开，以处理不同的相关性。为了解决计算问题，他们采用了变分推断和诱导点来降低复杂度，并提出了一个交替优化策略来联合训练 GP 和 4DGS。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将高斯过程引入4D高斯溅射，用基于核的概率建模替代固定先验，从而实现不确定性量化、未见区域估计和未来预测。整体实现流程包括：设计组合核分离空间和时间相关性；采用变分推断和诱导点处理大量高斯原语；通过双重优化策略，在观察良好的数据上进行置信度加权的GP训练，并在外观优化中利用GP进行正则化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于将高斯过程引入4D高斯溅射，构建了动态场景的概率建模框架。具体包括设计时空核以捕捉变形结构、采用变分推断实现可扩展计算，以及提出GP-GS双重优化策略。相比之前的工作，不同之处在于现有方法通常将运动视为确定性优化问题，使用固定的运动先验，而GP-4DGS引入了数据自适应的运动先验，能够处理未观测区域，并提供不确定性量化和时序外推能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该研究将高斯过程引入4D高斯泼溅，通过概率建模实现了不确定性量化、未来运动预测以及自适应运动先验学习，从而提升了动态场景重建的质量。

Abstract

We present GP-4DGS, a novel framework that integrates Gaussian Processes (GPs) into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) for principled probabilistic modeling of dynamic scenes. While existing 4DGS methods focus on deterministic reconstruction, they are inherently limited in capturing motion ambiguity and lack mechanisms to assess prediction reliability. By leveraging the kernel-based probabilistic nature of GPs, our approach introduces three key capabilities: (i) uncertainty quantification for motion predictions, (ii) motion estimation for unobserved or sparsely sampled regions, and (iii) temporal extrapolation beyond observed training frames. To scale GPs to the large number of Gaussian primitives in 4DGS, we design spatio-temporal kernels that capture the correlation structure of deformation fields and adopt variational Gaussian Processes with inducing points for tractable inference. Our experiments show that GP-4DGS enhances reconstruction quality while providing reliable uncertainty estimates that effectively identify regions of high motion ambiguity. By addressing these challenges, our work takes a meaningful step toward bridging probabilistic modeling and neural graphics.

item.title: Open-Loop Planning, Closed-Loop Verification: Speculative Verification for VLA
item.author: Zihua Wang, Zhitao Lin, Ruibo Li, Yu Zhang, Xu Yang, Siya Mi, Xiu-Shen Wei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SV-VLA是一种结合了高效开放循环长时规划与轻量级闭环在线验证的框架，旨在解决VLA模型在高推理成本和开放循环执行中易受环境变化影响及误差累积的问题。

背景: VLA模型作为大型基础模型在操作任务中表现出色，但推理成本高昂。近期方法采用动作分块来降低计算成本，但开放循环执行对环境变化敏感且易因缺乏闭环反馈而累积误差。

目的: 提出SV-VLA框架，旨在结合开放循环长时规划的效率与闭环控制的鲁棒性，以实现动态环境中高效且可靠的VLA控制。

方法: SV-VLA使用重型VLA作为低频宏观规划器生成动作分块及规划上下文，同时使用轻量级验证器基于最新观测持续监控执行。验证器在当前观测和规划上下文条件下，将计划动作与闭环参考动作比较，仅在必要时触发重规划。

主要发现: 实验表明SV-VLA结合了分块预测的效率与闭环控制的鲁棒性，能够在动态环境中实现高效且可靠的VLA控制。

结论: SV-VLA成功解决了VLA模型在动态环境下的控制效率与可靠性问题，提供了有效的解决方案。

翻译: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型作为用于具身控制的大型基础模型，在操作任务中表现出色。然而，它们的性能伴随着高昂的推理成本。为了提高效率，近期方法采用动作分块，即预测一系列未来动作以进行开放循环执行。尽管这对减少计算有效，但开放循环执行对环境变化敏感，且由于缺乏闭环反馈而容易产生误差累积。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了用于VLA控制的投机验证（SV-VLA），该框架结合了高效的开放循环长时规划与轻量级闭环在线验证。具体而言，SV-VLA使用重型VLA作为低频宏观规划器，生成动作分块及规划上下文，而轻量级验证器则基于最新观测持续监控执行。在当前观测和规划上下文的条件下，验证器将计划动作与闭环参考动作进行比较，并在必要时触发重规划。实验表明，SV-VLA结合了分块预测的效率与闭环控制的鲁棒性，能够在动态环境中实现高效且可靠的VLA控制。代码可用：https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA。

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, as large foundation models for embodied control, have shown strong performance in manipulation tasks. However, their performance comes at high inference cost. To improve efficiency, recent methods adopt action chunking, which predicts a sequence of future actions for open-loop execution. Although effective for reducing computation, open-loop execution is sensitive to environmental changes and prone to error accumulation due to the lack of close-loop feedback. To address this limitation, we propose Speculative Verification for VLA Control (SV-VLA), a framework that combines efficient open-loop long-horizon planning with lightweight closed-loop online verification. Specifically, SV-VLA uses a heavy VLA as a low-frequency macro-planner to generate an action chunk together with a planning context, while a lightweight verifier continuously monitors execution based on the latest observations. Conditioned on both the current observation and the planning context, the verifier compares the planned action against a closed-loop reference action and triggers replanning only when necessary. Experiments demonstrate that SV-VLA combines the efficiency of chunked prediction with the robustness of closed-loop control, enabling efficient and reliable VLA-based control in dynamic environments. Code is available: https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA.

item.title: QVAD: A Question-Centric Agentic Framework for Efficient and Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
item.author: Lokman Bekit, Hamza Karim, Nghia T Nguyen, Yasin Yilmaz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: QVAD是一个问题导向的智能体框架，通过迭代优化查询来引导小型视觉语言模型生成高质量描述和精确语义推理，从而在无需参数更新的情况下实现视频异常检测的先进性能。

背景: 视频异常检测是计算机视觉中的基础挑战，特别是由于异常的开放集性质。虽然近期利用视觉语言模型的无训练方法显示出前景，但它们通常依赖大量且资源密集的基础模型来弥补静态提示的模糊性。

目的: 提出QVAD框架，旨在解决视频异常检测中的瓶颈问题，即静态查询的性质，通过将视觉语言模型与大型语言模型的交互视为动态对话，利用迭代优化查询来引导小型模型。

方法: QVAD采用问题导向的智能体框架，将视觉语言模型与大型语言模型的交互视为动态对话。通过基于视觉上下文迭代优化查询，LLM智能体引导小型视觉语言模型生成高保真描述和精确语义推理，无需参数更新。

主要发现: QVAD在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence和UBNormal数据集上实现了最先进的性能，使用比竞争方法少得多的参数；在单场景ComplexVAD数据集上表现出色；具有高推理速度和最小内存占用，使高级视频异常检测能力能够在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。

结论: QVAD通过动态对话和提示更新机制，有效解锁了轻量级模型的潜在能力，实现了无需参数更新的高效视频异常检测，证明了该方法在资源受限环境下的部署潜力。

翻译: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, particularly due to the open-set nature of anomalies. While recent training-free approaches utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise, they typically rely on massive, resource-intensive foundation models to compensate for the ambiguity of static prompts. We argue that the bottleneck in VAD is not necessarily model capacity, but rather the static nature of inquiry. We propose QVAD, a question-centric agentic framework that treats VLM-LLM interaction as a dynamic dialogue. By iteratively refining queries based on visual context, our LLM agent guides smaller VLMs to produce high-fidelity captions and precise semantic reasoning without parameter updates. This "prompt-updating" mechanism effectively unlocks the latent capabilities of lightweight models, enabling state-of-the-art performance on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and UBNormal using a fraction of the parameters required by competing methods. We further demonstrate exceptional generalizability on the single-scene ComplexVAD dataset. Crucially, QVAD achieves high inference speeds with minimal memory footprints, making advanced VAD capabilities deployable on resource-constrained edge devices.

Abstract

Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, particularly due to the open-set nature of anomalies. While recent training-free approaches utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise, they typically rely on massive, resource-intensive foundation models to compensate for the ambiguity of static prompts. We argue that the bottleneck in VAD is not necessarily model capacity, but rather the static nature of inquiry. We propose QVAD, a question-centric agentic framework that treats VLM-LLM interaction as a dynamic dialogue. By iteratively refining queries based on visual context, our LLM agent guides smaller VLMs to produce high-fidelity captions and precise semantic reasoning without parameter updates. This ``prompt-updating" mechanism effectively unlocks the latent capabilities of lightweight models, enabling state-of-the-art performance on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and UBNormal using a fraction of the parameters required by competing methods. We further demonstrate exceptional generalizability on the single-scene ComplexVAD dataset. Crucially, QVAD achieves high inference speeds with minimal memory footprints, making advanced VAD capabilities deployable on resource-constrained edge devices.

item.title: Joint Prediction of Human Motions and Actions in Human-Robot Collaboration
item.author: Alessandra Bulanti, Alessandro Carfì, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为MA-HERP的分层递归概率框架，用于联合估计和预测人类运动和行为。

背景: 流畅的人机协作要求机器人持续估计人类行为并预测未来意图，这涉及对连续运动和离散动作的联合推理，但目前这些通常被孤立建模。

目的: 提出一个分层递归概率框架，以联合估计和预测人类的运动和行为。

方法: 该模型结合了分层表示（通过允许的Allen区间关系将运动组合成动作）、统一的概率因子分解（耦合连续动力学、离散标签和持续时间）以及受贝叶斯滤波启发的递归推理方案（交替进行自上而下的动作预测和自下而上的感官证据）。

主要发现: 基于肌肉骨骼模拟训练的神经模型进行的初步实验评估显示，该模型能够准确预测运动，在噪声下具有鲁棒的动作推理能力，且计算性能与在线人机协作兼容。

结论: 该框架为流畅人机协作提供了有效的解决方案。

翻译: 流畅的人机协作要求机器人持续估计人类行为并预测未来意图。这涉及对连续运动和离散动作的联合推理，目前这些通常被孤立建模。本文介绍了一种名为MA-HERP的分层递归概率框架，用于联合估计和预测人类运动和行为。该模型结合了分层表示、统一的概率因子分解以及受贝叶斯滤波启发的递归推理方案。基于肌肉骨骼模拟训练的神经模型进行的初步实验评估显示，该模型能够准确预测运动，在噪声下具有鲁棒的动作推理能力，且计算性能与在线人机协作兼容。

Abstract

Fluent human--robot collaboration requires robots to continuously estimate human behaviour and anticipate future intentions. This entails reasoning jointly about \emph{continuous movements} and \emph{discrete actions}, which are still largely modelled in isolation. In this paper, we introduce \textsf{MA-HERP}, a hierarchical and recursive probabilistic framework for the \emph{joint estimation and prediction} of human movements and actions. The model combines: (i) a hierarchical representation in which movements compose into actions through admissible Allen interval relations, (ii) a unified probabilistic factorisation coupling continuous dynamics, discrete labels, and durations, and (iii) a recursive inference scheme inspired by Bayesian filtering, alternating top-down action prediction with bottom-up sensory evidence. We present a preliminary experimental evaluation based on neural models trained on musculoskeletal simulations of reaching movements, showing accurate motion prediction, robust action inference under noise, and computational performance compatible with on-line human--robot collaboration.

item.title: Redefining End-of-Life: Intelligent Automation for Electronics Remanufacturing Systems
item.author: Sibo Tian, Xiao Liang, Sara Behdad, Minghui Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了电子废弃物再制造领域的智能自动化技术，探讨了机器人、控制和人工智能如何协同实现可扩展、安全且智能的再制造系统。

背景: 随着废弃电子产品数量增加和关键材料日益稀缺，再制造对于促进循环经济变得日益重要和紧迫。

目的: 回顾现有文献，检查智能自动化在电子废弃物再制造中的关键挑战和新兴机遇，提供关于如何通过机器人、控制和人工智能实现可扩展、安全且智能再制造系统的全面概述。

方法: 通过综述现有文献，深入探讨了拆卸、检测、分类和组件再处理等领域的智能自动化方法，涵盖多模态感知、不确定性决策、灵活规划算法和力感知操作等先进技术。

主要发现: 综述了大型基础模型、人机集成和数字孪生等新兴技术，这些技术有潜力支持该领域的未来研究。

结论: 通过整合这些主题，旨在展示下一代再制造系统如何在复杂的现实世界挑战面前实现稳健、适应性和高效运行。

翻译: 摘要：由于电子废弃物产品固有的显著不确定性、可变性和不完整性，再制造比传统制造更具挑战性。同时，随着废弃电子产品数量的增加和关键材料的日益稀缺，促进循环经济变得日益重要和紧迫。在本文中，我们回顾了现有文献，检查了智能自动化在电子废弃物再制造中的关键挑战和新兴机遇，提供了关于机器人、控制和人工智能如何协同实现可扩展、安全且智能的再制造系统的全面概述。本文首先在循环经济的背景下定义了再制造的范围和动机，强调了其社会和环境意义。然后深入探讨了该领域拆卸、检测、分类和组件再处理的智能自动化方法，涵盖了多模态感知、不确定性决策、灵活规划算法和力感知操作等先进方法。本文还回顾了几种新兴技术，包括大型基础模型、人机集成和数字孪生，这些技术有潜力支持该领域的未来研究。通过整合这些主题，旨在展示下一代再制造系统如何在复杂的现实世界挑战面前实现稳健、适应性和高效运行。

Abstract

Remanufacturing is fundamentally more challenging than traditional manufacturing due to the significant uncertainty, variability, and incompleteness inherent in end-of-life (EoL) products. At the same time, it has become increasingly essential and urgent for facilitating a circular economy, driven by the growing volume of discarded electronic products and the escalating scarcity of critical materials. In this paper, we review the existing literature and examine the key challenges as well as emerging opportunities in intelligent automation for EoL electronics remanufacturing, providing a comprehensive overview of how robotics, control, and artificial intelligence (AI) can jointly enable scalable, safe, and intelligent remanufacturing systems. This paper starts with the definition, scope, and motivation of remanufacturing within the context of a circular economy, highlighting its societal and environmental significance. Then it delves into intelligent automation approaches for disassembly, inspection, sorting, and component reprocessing in this domain, covering advanced methods for multimodal perception, decision-making under uncertainty, flexible planning algorithms, and force-aware manipulation. The paper further reviews several emerging techniques, including large foundation models, human-in-the-loop integration, and digital twins that have the potential to support future research in this area. By integrating these topics, we aim to illustrate how next-generation remanufacturing systems can achieve robust, adaptable, and efficient operation in the face of complex real-world challenges.

item.title: SparseSplat: Towards Applicable Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Pixel-Unaligned Prediction
item.author: Zicheng Zhang, Xiangting Meng, Ke Wu, Wenchao Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 SparseSplat 的自适应 3D 高斯溅射模型，通过基于熵的概率采样和专用点云网络，生成了高度紧凑的 3D 高斯地图，在保持高质量渲染的同时显著减少了高斯数量。

背景: 前馈 3D 高斯溅射方法生成的空间均匀且高度冗余的 3D 高斯地图限制了它们在下游重建任务中的集成。

目的: 开发第一个能够根据场景结构和局部区域的信息丰富度自适应调整高斯密度的前馈 3D 高斯溅射模型，以生成高度紧凑的 3D 高斯地图。

方法: 提出了基于熵的概率采样，在无纹理区域生成大而稀疏的高斯，在信息丰富的区域分配小而密集的高斯；设计了一个专用的点云网络来高效编码局部上下文并将其解码为 3D 高斯属性。

主要发现: SparseSplat 在仅使用 22% 的高斯的情况下实现了最先进的渲染质量，并在仅使用 1.5% 的高斯时保持了合理的渲染质量。

结论: SparseSplat 成功实现了高度紧凑的 3D 高斯地图，在显著减少高斯数量的同时保持了高质量的渲染效果。

翻译: 前馈 3D 高斯溅射的近期进展显著提高了渲染质量。然而，前馈 3D 高斯方法生成的空间均匀且高度冗余的 3D 高斯地图限制了它们在下游重建任务中的集成。我们提出了 SparseSplat，这是第一个能够根据场景结构和局部区域的信息丰富度自适应调整高斯密度的前馈 3D 高斯模型，从而生成高度紧凑的 3D 高斯地图。为此，我们提出了基于熵的概率采样，在无纹理区域生成大而稀疏的高斯，在信息丰富的区域分配小而密集的高斯。此外，我们设计了一个专用的点云网络，高效地编码局部上下文并将其解码为 3D 高斯属性，解决了通用 3D 高斯优化流程与前馈模型之间的感受野不匹配问题。广泛的实验结果表明，SparseSplat 可以在仅使用 22% 的高斯的情况下实现最先进的渲染质量，并在仅使用 1.5% 的高斯的情况下保持合理的渲染质量。项目页面：https://victkk.github.io/SparseSplat-page/

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 现有前馈 3D 高斯泼溅方法生成的 3D 地图空间均匀且高度冗余，导致巨大的内存和计算开销。这个问题很重要，因为它限制了该方法在资源受限的边缘平台（如汽车、无人机、AR 眼镜）上的应用，同时解决了现有方法中分布不匹配和感受野不匹配的根本设计缺陷。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法存在两个根本缺陷：一是结构不匹配，即现有方法使用刚性、均匀的像素或体素结构，与3DGS优化自然产生的自适应分布不符；二是感受野不匹配，即现有方法用全局感知网络却做局部预测，与3DGS优化的局部性质矛盾。为解决这些问题，作者放弃了“逐像素”范式，利用局部信息熵进行概率采样，生成稀疏且自适应的3D锚点；同时设计了3D-Local属性预测器，通过查询每个锚点的K近邻来回归属性，以匹配3DGS优化的局部性质。作者借鉴了DepthSplat的预训练骨干网络进行深度估计，但冻结了权重，其创新在于如何利用特征和深度生成稀疏场景表示。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是解决现有前馈 3D 高斯泼溅方法中高斯分布不匹配和感受野不匹配的问题。该方法放弃逐像素对齐，基于局部信息丰富度（熵）自适应分配高斯密度，模仿传统优化的稀疏特性；同时，使用局部预测器，仅利用局部邻域信息来预测高斯属性。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先利用预训练骨干网络提取图像的深度和特征；接着计算局部熵并基于概率采样生成稀疏的 3D 锚点；最后对每个锚点查询其 K 近邻，利用局部邻域信息预测高斯的具体属性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点包括：一是提出了基于熵的自适应原语采样策略，根据场景局部信息丰富度生成稀疏且非均匀分布的3D锚点；二是设计了3D-Local属性预测器，通过查询3D空间中的K近邻来回归高斯属性，以匹配经典3DGS优化的局部特性。相比之前的工作，不同之处在于：它抛弃了传统的“像素对齐”范式，不再生成空间均匀且高度冗余的地图，而是实现了内容感知的稀疏分布；同时，它解决了全局感知与局部预测之间的不匹配问题，利用局部邻域信息进行预测。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了SparseSplat，通过基于熵的自适应采样和3D局部预测器，解决了前馈3DGS中分布不匹配和感受野不匹配的问题，生成了稀疏且高效的高斯地图。

Abstract

Recent progress in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has notably improved rendering quality. However, the spatially uniform and highly redundant 3DGS map generated by previous feed-forward 3DGS methods limits their integration into downstream reconstruction tasks. We propose SparseSplat, the first feed-forward 3DGS model that adaptively adjusts Gaussian density according to scene structure and information richness of local regions, yielding highly compact 3DGS maps. To achieve this, we propose entropy-based probabilistic sampling, generating large, sparse Gaussians in textureless areas and assigning small, dense Gaussians to regions with rich information. Additionally, we designed a specialized point cloud network that efficiently encodes local context and decodes it into 3DGS attributes, addressing the receptive field mismatch between the general 3DGS optimization pipeline and feed-forward models. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that SparseSplat can achieve state-of-the-art rendering quality with only 22% of the Gaussians and maintain reasonable rendering quality with only 1.5% of the Gaussians. Project page: https://victkk.github.io/SparseSplat-page/.

item.title: Speaker-Reasoner: Scaling Interaction Turns and Reasoning Patterns for Timestamped Speaker-Attributed ASR
item.author: Zhennan Lin, Shuai Wang, Zhaokai Sun, Pengyuan Xie, Chuan Xie, Jie Liu, Qiang Zhang, Lei Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Speaker-Reasoner 是一种端到端的语音大语言模型，旨在通过多轮时间推理解决多说话人对话转录和理解中的挑战。

背景: 多说话人场景由于语音重叠、反应信号、快速轮次转换和上下文窗口限制而具有挑战性。虽然语音大语言模型在单说话人任务中表现出色，但在多说话人场景下仍面临困难。

目的: 提出 Speaker-Reasoner，一种具有代理式多轮时间推理能力的端到端语音大语言模型，以处理重叠语音和复杂的轮次转换。

方法: 模型采用迭代推理而非单次推理，分析全局音频结构，自主预测时间边界，并执行细粒度分段分析，同时建模说话人身份、性别、时间戳和转录。此外，还使用说话人感知缓存来处理超过训练上下文窗口的音频。训练采用三阶段渐进策略。

主要发现: 在 AliMeeting 和 AISHELL-4 数据集上，Speaker-Reasoner 相比强基线取得了持续改进，特别是在处理重叠语音和复杂轮次转换方面。

结论: Speaker-Reasoner 通过其代理式多轮时间推理能力，有效地解决了多说话人对话转录和理解中的关键挑战。

翻译: 转录和理解多说话人对话需要语音识别、说话人归属和时间戳定位。虽然语音大语言模型在单说话人任务方面表现出色，但由于语音重叠、反应信号、快速轮次转换和上下文窗口限制，多说话人场景仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了 Speaker-Reasoner，一种具有代理式多轮时间推理的端到端语音大语言模型。模型不进行单次推理，而是迭代分析全局音频结构，自主预测时间边界，并执行细粒度分段分析，同时联合建模说话人身份、性别、时间戳和转录。说话人感知缓存进一步将处理扩展到超过训练上下文窗口的音频。Speaker-Reasoner 采用三阶段渐进策略进行训练，在 AliMeeting 和 AISHELL-4 数据集上相比强基线取得了持续改进，特别是在处理重叠语音和复杂轮次转换方面。

Abstract

Transcribing and understanding multi-speaker conversations requires speech recognition, speaker attribution, and timestamp localization. While speech LLMs excel at single-speaker tasks, multi-speaker scenarios remain challenging due to overlapping speech, backchannels, rapid turn-taking, and context window constraints. We propose Speaker-Reasoner, an end-to-end Speech LLM with agentic multi-turn temporal reasoning. Instead of single-pass inference, the model iteratively analyzes global audio structure, autonomously predicts temporal boundaries, and performs fine-grained segment analysis, jointly modeling speaker identity, gender, timestamps, and transcription. A speaker-aware cache further extends processing to audio exceeding the training context window. Trained with a three-stage progressive strategy, Speaker-Reasoner achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on AliMeeting and AISHELL-4 datasets, particularly in handling overlapping speech and complex turn-taking.

item.title: An Open-Source LiDAR and Monocular Off-Road Autonomous Navigation Stack
item.author: Rémi Marsal, Quentin Picard, Adrien Poiré, Sébastien Kerbourc'h, Thibault Toralba, Clément Yver, Alexandre Chapoutot, David Filliat
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一个开源的越野自主导航栈，支持激光雷达和单目3D感知，无需特定任务训练。

背景: 越野自主导航需要可靠的3D感知来在具有挑战性的非结构化地形中进行鲁棒的障碍物检测。虽然激光雷达准确但成本高且功耗大，而基于基础模型的单目深度估计虽然轻量，但其在户外导航栈中的集成仍被探索不足。

目的: 提出一个开源的越野导航栈，支持激光雷达和单目3D感知，无需特定任务训练。

方法: 对于单目设置，结合零样本深度预测和基于稀疏SLAM测量的度量深度重缩放。通过边缘掩蔽减少障碍物幻觉，以及时间平滑来缓解SLAM不稳定性的影响。生成的点云用于生成机器人中心的2.5D高程地图用于基于代价地图的规划。

主要发现: 在逼真的仿真和现实世界的非结构化环境中，单目配置在大多数场景中匹配了高分辨率激光雷达的性能，证明了基于基础模型的单目深度估计是鲁棒越野导航中激光雷达的可行替代方案。

结论: 通过开源导航栈和仿真环境，提供了完整的越野导航流程以及可重现的基准。

翻译: 越野自主导航需要可靠的3D感知来在具有挑战性的非结构化地形中进行鲁棒的障碍物检测。虽然激光雷达准确但成本高且功耗大，而基于基础模型的单目深度估计虽然轻量，但其在户外导航栈中的集成仍被探索不足。本文介绍了一个开源的越野自主导航栈，支持激光雷达和单目3D感知，无需特定任务训练。对于单目设置，结合零样本深度预测和基于稀疏SLAM测量的度量深度重缩放。通过边缘掩蔽减少障碍物幻觉，以及时间平滑来缓解SLAM不稳定性的影响。生成的点云用于生成机器人中心的2.5D高程地图用于基于代价地图的规划。在逼真的仿真和现实世界的非结构化环境中，单目配置在大多数场景中匹配了高分辨率激光雷达的性能，证明了基于基础模型的单目深度估计是鲁棒越野导航中激光雷达的可行替代方案。通过开源导航栈和仿真环境，提供了完整的越野导航流程以及可重现的基准。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决在非结构化地形中，利用单目相机替代昂贵的激光雷达进行可靠3D感知的问题。现实中，激光雷达成本高、耗电且易被探测，而单目相机更轻便、节能；研究中，单目深度估计在户外导航中的应用尚未被充分探索，且现有方法往往需要针对特定平台进行大量数据收集和重新训练。该研究提供了一种通用、开源且无需特定训练的解决方案，具有重要的实用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对LiDAR成本高、耗电大以及立体视觉在复杂地形下表现不佳的问题，思考利用单目深度估计作为轻量级替代方案。设计上，他们结合了零样本深度预测模型与稀疏SLAM测量进行深度重缩放，并引入边缘掩蔽和时间平滑来提升鲁棒性。此外，他们借鉴了CSF地面分割方法、A*全局规划器和TEB局部规划器等现有技术。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用单目深度估计作为LiDAR的轻量级替代方案，通过结合SLAM测量恢复度量深度，并利用边缘掩蔽和时间平滑技术提高鲁棒性。整体实现流程包括：首先利用SLAM稀疏测量对单目图像进行深度重缩放以生成点云，随后通过布料仿真过滤器（CSF）将地面与障碍物分离，生成机器人中心的高程图，最后将其转化为代价地图用于路径规划。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一个无需针对特定平台或环境进行额外训练的开源导航堆栈，集成了单目深度估计作为 LiDAR 的轻量级替代方案。为了提升鲁棒性，它引入了边缘掩蔽以减少障碍物幻觉，以及时间平滑以减轻 SLAM 不稳定性。相比传统依赖 LiDAR 或立体视觉的方法，该研究利用基础模型和几何方法实现了跨不同机器人系统的稳健泛化；相比现有的开源堆栈，它支持单目感知并提供了可复现的基准测试。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种开源的越野导航栈，支持LiDAR和单目深度感知，无需特定训练即可适应不同环境，并在仿真和真实场景中验证了其有效性。

Abstract

Off-road autonomous navigation demands reliable 3D perception for robust obstacle detection in challenging unstructured terrain. While LiDAR is accurate, it is costly and power-intensive. Monocular depth estimation using foundation models offers a lightweight alternative, but its integration into outdoor navigation stacks remains underexplored. We present an open-source off-road navigation stack supporting both LiDAR and monocular 3D perception without task-specific training. For the monocular setup, we combine zero-shot depth prediction (Depth Anything V2) with metric depth rescaling using sparse SLAM measurements (VINS-Mono). Two key enhancements improve robustness: edge-masking to reduce obstacle hallucination and temporal smoothing to mitigate the impact of SLAM instability. The resulting point cloud is used to generate a robot-centric 2.5D elevation map for costmap-based planning. Evaluated in photorealistic simulations (Isaac Sim) and real-world unstructured environments, the monocular configuration matches high-resolution LiDAR performance in most scenarios, demonstrating that foundation-model-based monocular depth estimation is a viable LiDAR alternative for robust off-road navigation. By open-sourcing the navigation stack and the simulation environment, we provide a complete pipeline for off-road navigation as well as a reproducible benchmark. Code available at https://github.com/LARIAD/Offroad-Nav.

item.title: Self-Distilled RLVR
item.author: Chenxu Yang, Chuanyu Qin, Qingyi Si, Minghui Chen, Naibin Gu, Dingyu Yao, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Nan Duan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RLSD的新方法，结合了强化学习与自我蒸馏的优势，旨在解决现有模型在训练中信息泄露和稳定性问题。

背景: 在LLM社区中，On-policy distillation (OPD)和On-policy self-distillation (OPSD)是流行的训练范式。OPD使用大模型作为教师提供密集信号，而RLVR仅从环境反馈中获得稀疏信号。OPSD虽然利用特权信息，但仅依赖教师信号会导致信息泄露和训练不稳定。

目的: 为了解决仅依赖特权信息进行自我蒸馏导致的信息泄露和训练不稳定问题，同时结合RLVR和OPSD的优势。

方法: 提出RLSD方法，利用自我蒸馏获取token级别的策略差异以确定精细的更新幅度，同时继续使用RLVR从环境反馈（如响应正确性）中推导可靠的更新方向。

主要发现: RLSD能够同时利用RLVR和OPSD的优势，实现更高的收敛上限和更优越的训练稳定性。

结论: RLSD通过结合自我蒸馏和环境反馈，解决了信息泄露和稳定性问题，提升了模型训练效果。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD)已成为LLM社区中一种流行的训练范式。与仅从环境中可验证结果获得稀疏信号的强化学习与可验证奖励(RLVR)不同，该范式选择较大的模型作为教师，为每个采样的轨迹提供密集的、细粒度的信号。最近，社区探索了On-policy self-distillation (OPSD)，其中同一个模型同时充当教师和学生，教师接收参考答案等额外特权信息以实现自我进化。本文表明，仅由特权教师导出的学习信号会导致严重的信息泄露和训练不稳定。因此，我们确定了自我蒸馏的最佳定位，并提出了RLSD（带有自我蒸馏的RLVR）。具体而言，我们利用自我蒸馏来获取用于确定精细更新幅度的token级别策略差异，同时继续使用RLVR从环境反馈（如响应正确性）中推导可靠的更新方向。这使得RLSD能够同时利用RLVR和OPSD的优势，实现更高的收敛上限和优越的训练稳定性。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a popular training paradigm in the LLM community. This paradigm selects a larger model as the teacher to provide dense, fine-grained signals for each sampled trajectory, in contrast to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), which only obtains sparse signals from verifiable outcomes in the environment. Recently, the community has explored on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where the same model serves as both teacher and student, with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as reference answers to enable self-evolution. This paper demonstrates that learning signals solely derived from the privileged teacher result in severe information leakage and unstable long-term training. Accordingly, we identify the optimal niche for self-distillation and propose \textbf{RLSD} (\textbf{RL}VR with \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{D}istillation). Specifically, we leverage self-distillation to obtain token-level policy differences for determining fine-grained update magnitudes, while continuing to use RLVR to derive reliable update directions from environmental feedback (e.g., response correctness). This enables RLSD to simultaneously harness the strengths of both RLVR and OPSD, achieving a higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability.

item.title: Persistence of the Wiener Sausage: Sampling Stability and a Law of Large Numbers for Drifted Planar Brownian Motion DRAFT -CURRENTLY UNDER REVIEW
item.author: Tristan Guillaume
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究平面布朗运动带常数非零漂移的偏移滤子的持久同调，重点关注Wiener香肠中孔洞的生与死。

背景: 该研究关注平面布朗运动在常数非零漂移下的偏移滤子，其成员是半径递增的Wiener香肠，通过一阶持久图记录半径变化时加厚轨迹中孔洞的生与死。

目的: 旨在建立采样定理以描述连续路径与采样点云之间的持久图差异，并证明漂移平面情形下的大数定律。

方法: 利用沿漂移方向的再生方案，将平面路径投影到漂移轴上产生具有正漂移的一维布朗运动；通过边界引理控制拓扑在拼接时的非可加性；利用Betti曲线表示将双参数持久问题转化为单参数固定半径孔洞计数。

主要发现: 采样定理表明，对于任何连续路径，瓶颈距离受路径连续模控制，对于布朗运动几乎必然达到O(|π_n| log(1/|π_n|))的速率；大数定律指出，对于任意有界Borel权重，平滑持久泛函收敛于确定性常数ρ_ψ，揭示了支配拓扑复杂度线性增长的有限正强度测度。

结论: 该研究揭示了漂移平面情形下拓扑复杂度随时间线性增长的规律，并提供了采样定理的速率估计。

翻译: 我们研究了由平面布朗运动带常数非零漂移的范围生成的偏移滤子的持久同调。该滤子的成员是半径递增的Wiener香肠，一阶持久图记录了半径变化时加厚轨迹中孔洞的生与死。我们的第一个结果是采样定理：对于在时间网格π_n上观察到的R^d中的任何连续路径，连续偏移滤子的持久图与采样点云的持久图之间的瓶颈距离受路径连续模ω_X(|π_n|)控制。对于布朗运动，这几乎必然得到O(|π_n| log(1/|π_n|))的速率。我们的第二个也是主要结果是漂移平面情形下的大数定律。对于每一个有界Borel权重ψ，其支撑在紧半径窗口[r0, r1]上且r0 > 0，平滑持久泛函Φ_ψ(T)（其中β_T^1(r)计算时间T时半径-r香肠中的孔洞数）满足Φ_ψ(T)/T几乎必然且在L1中收敛于确定性常数ρ_ψ。这产生了一个支配拓扑复杂度线性增长的半径轴上的有限正强度测度。证明引入了沿漂移方向的再生方案：将平面路径投影到漂移轴上产生具有正漂移的一维布朗运动，其梯级击中事件和有界回溯事件生成独立同分布的路径块。通过边界引理控制拼接时拓扑的非可加性，该引理结合确定性的Mayer-Vietoris估计与通过Coarea公式将积分Betti数与香肠面积联系起来的几何界。Betti曲线表示将双参数持久问题转化为单参数固定半径孔洞计数族，使得再生论证成为可能。

Abstract

We study the persistent homology of the offset filtration generated by the range of a planar Brownian motion with constant nonzero drift. The members of this filtration are the Wiener sausages of increasing radius, and the degree-one persistence diagram records the birth and death of holes in the thickened trace as the radius varies. Our first result is a sampling theorem: for any continuous path in R d observed on a time grid $π$n the bottleneck distance between the persistence diagram of the continuous offset filtration and that of the sampled point cloud is bounded by the pathwise modulus of continuity $ω$X (|$π$n|). For Brownian motion this yields the almost-sure rate O |$π$n| log(1/|$π$n|) . Our second and main result is a law of large numbers for the drifted planar case. For every bounded Borel weight $ψ$ supported on a compact radius window [r0, r1] with r0 > 0, the smoothed persistence functional $Φ$ $ψ$ (T ), where $β$ T 1 (r) counts the holes in the radius-r sausage at time T , satisfies $Φ$ $ψ$ (T )/T $\rightarrow$ $ρ$ $ψ$ almost surely and in L 1 for a deterministic constant $ρ$ $ψ$ . This yields a finite positive intensity measure on the radius axis that governs the linear growth of topological complexity. The proof introduces a regeneration scheme along the drift direction: projecting the planar path onto the drift axis produces a one-dimensional Brownian motion with positive drift, whose ladder hits and bounded-backtracking events generate i.i.d. path blocks. The non-additivity of topology under concatenation is controlled by a Boundary Lemma, which combines a deterministic Mayer-Vietoris estimate with a geometric bound relating integrated Betti numbers to sausage area via the coarea formula. A Betti-curve representation converts the two-parameter persistence problem into a one-parameter family of fixed-radius hole counts, making the regeneration argument possible.

item.title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking
item.author: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Jiajun Wu, Junhang Cheng, Tuney Zheng, Fanglin Xu, Weicheng Gu, Lin Jing, Yaxin Du, Joseph Li, Yizhi Li, Yan Xing, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Ruihao Gong, Aishan Liu, Zhoujun Li, Mingjie Tang, Chenghua Lin, Siheng Chen, Wayne Xin Zhao, Xianglong Liu, Ming Zhou, Bryan Dai, Weifeng Lv
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: InCoder-32B-Thinking是一个针对工业软件开发的模型，通过ECoT合成框架和工业代码世界模型训练，生成推理轨迹，并在通用和工业基准测试中取得顶尖开源结果。

背景: 跨芯片设计、GPU优化和嵌入式系统的工业软件开发缺乏专家推理轨迹，无法展示工程师如何推理硬件约束和时序语义。

目的: 提出InCoder-32B-Thinking模型，通过合成推理轨迹来展示工程师如何推理硬件约束和时序语义。

方法: 使用错误驱动的思维链（ECoT）合成框架和工业代码世界模型（ICWM）进行训练。ECoT通过合成多轮对话中的思考内容来生成推理链，明确建模错误修正过程。ICWM通过Verilog仿真、GPU分析等领域的特定执行轨迹训练，学习代码如何影响硬件行为的因果动态，并能在实际编译前预测执行结果以实现自验证。所有合成的推理轨迹都通过领域工具链进行验证，以匹配工业任务的自然推理深度分布。

主要发现: 在14个通用基准测试中，LiveCodeBench v5的准确率为81.3%；在9个工业基准测试中，CAD-Coder的准确率为84.0%，KernelBench的准确率为38.0%。InCoder-32B-Thinking在所有领域都取得了顶尖的开源结果。

结论: InCoder-32B-Thinking在通用和工业基准测试中均取得了顶尖的开源结果，验证了其在工业软件开发中的有效性。

翻译: 摘要：跨芯片设计、GPU优化和嵌入式系统的工业软件开发缺乏展示工程师如何推理硬件约束和时序语义的专家推理轨迹。在这项工作中，我们提出了InCoder-32B-Thinking，该模型在错误驱动的思维链（ECoT）合成框架和工业代码世界模型（ICWM）的数据上训练，以生成推理轨迹。具体来说，ECoT通过合成多轮对话中的思考内容来生成推理链，明确建模了错误修正过程。ICWM在Verilog仿真、GPU分析等领域的特定执行轨迹上训练，学习了代码如何影响硬件行为的因果动态，并能够在实际编译前预测执行结果以实现自验证。所有合成的推理轨迹都通过领域工具链进行验证，创建了与工业任务自然推理深度分布相匹配的训练数据。在14个通用基准测试（LiveCodeBench v5上为81.3%）和9个工业基准测试（CAD-Coder上为84.0%，KernelBench上为38.0%）上的评估表明，InCoder-32B-Thinking在所有领域都取得了顶尖的开源结果。GPU优化

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 InCoder-32B-Thinking 的工业代码世界模型，旨在提升代码推理能力。

Abstract

Industrial software development across chip design, GPU optimization, and embedded systems lacks expert reasoning traces showing how engineers reason about hardware constraints and timing semantics. In this work, we propose InCoder-32B-Thinking, trained on the data from the Error-driven Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) synthesis framework with an industrial code world model (ICWM) to generate reasoning traces. Specifically, ECoT generates reasoning chains by synthesizing the thinking content from multi-turn dialogue with environmental error feedback, explicitly modeling the error-correction process. ICWM is trained on domain-specific execution traces from Verilog simulation, GPU profiling, etc., learns the causal dynamics of how code affects hardware behavior, and enables self-verification by predicting execution outcomes before actual compilation. All synthesized reasoning traces are validated through domain toolchains, creating training data matching the natural reasoning depth distribution of industrial tasks. Evaluation on 14 general (81.3% on LiveCodeBench v5) and 9 industrial benchmarks (84.0% in CAD-Coder and 38.0% on KernelBench) shows InCoder-32B-Thinking achieves top-tier open-source results across all domains.GPU Optimization

item.title: Chart-RL: Policy Optimization Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Visual Reasoning in Chart Question Answering with Vision Language Models
item.author: Yunfei Bai, Amit Dhanda, Shekhar Jain
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Chart-RL的强化学习框架，旨在提升视觉语言模型在图表问答任务中的表现。

背景: 视觉语言模型在图表问答任务中面临数值提取不精确、难以解读隐含视觉关系以及注意力机制不足以捕捉图表空间关系等挑战。

目的: 通过反馈驱动的视觉感知和逻辑推理策略优化，增强VLMs对图表的理解能力。

方法: 提出Chart-RL框架，结合策略优化强化学习技术与自适应奖励函数，并采用低秩适应参数高效微调技术，仅需单GPU配置。

主要发现: 在ChartQAPro数据集上，RL微调后的Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型准确率达到0.634，超过了参数量减半的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型（0.580），同时推理延迟从31秒降至9秒。

结论: Chart-RL框架在保持性能完整性的同时，显著提升了模型在图表问答任务中的准确性和效率。

翻译: 近期视觉语言模型的发展展示了向需要强大推理能力的真正智能迈进。除了模式识别外，语言推理必须与视觉理解相结合，特别是对于涉及复杂数据可视化的图表问答任务。当前的VLMs在图表问答方面面临重大限制，包括数值提取不精确、难以解读隐含的视觉关系，以及捕捉图表中空间关系的注意力机制不足。在这项工作中，我们通过提出Chart-RL，一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过反馈驱动的视觉感知和逻辑推理策略优化，解决了这些挑战。我们的关键创新包括一个综合框架，集成了来自策略优化的强化学习技术与自适应奖励函数，与基线基础模型相比表现出优越性能，并与更大的最先进架构竞争。我们还在RL框架中集成了通过低秩适应的参数高效微调，仅需单GPU配置同时保持性能完整性。我们在ChartQAPro数据集上对开源、专有和最先进的封闭源模型进行了广泛的基准测试。RL微调的Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型达到了0.634的答案准确率，超过了Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct基础模型的0.580准确率，尽管使用了减半的参数数量，同时将推理延迟从31秒减少到9秒。

Abstract

The recent advancements in Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated progress toward true intelligence requiring robust reasoning capabilities. Beyond pattern recognition, linguistic reasoning must integrate with visual comprehension, particularly for Chart Question Answering (CQA) tasks involving complex data visualizations. Current VLMs face significant limitations in CQA, including imprecise numerical extraction, difficulty interpreting implicit visual relationships, and inadequate attention mechanisms for capturing spatial relationships in charts. In this work, we address these challenges by presenting Chart-RL, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enhances VLMs chart understanding through feedback-driven policy optimization of visual perception and logical inference. Our key innovation includes a comprehensive framework integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL) from Policy Optimization techniques along with adaptive reward functions, that demonstrates superior performance compared to baseline foundation models and competitive results against larger state-of-the-art architectures. We also integrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in the RL framework that only requires single GPU configurations while preserving performance integrity. We conducted extensive benchmarking across open-source, proprietary, and state-of-the-art closed-source models utilizing the ChartQAPro dataset. The RL fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct model achieved an answer accuracy of 0.634, surpassing the 0.580 accuracy of the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct foundation model despite utilizing half the parameter count, while simultaneously reducing inference latency from 31 seconds to 9 seconds.

item.title: Mapping the redshift drift at various redshifts through cosmography
item.author: Anna Chiara Alfano, Orlando Luongo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究通过结合多种观测数据，利用泰勒展开和帕德近似方法构建宇宙学模型，并评估了红移漂移测量的内部一致性。

背景: 红移漂移提供了通过宇宙源红移的缓慢时间变化来检验宇宙膨胀历史的运动学测试。受未来设施预期的Sandage-Loeb测量启发，研究在宇宙学框架内调查了红移漂移。

目的: 研究旨在结合Pantheon+和SH0ES Ia型超新星以及伽马射线爆的数据，并加入第二轮DESIBAO测量，构建模拟的Sandage-Loeb星表，以评估重建背景的内部一致性。

方法: 研究在宇宙学框架内建模哈勃率，使用二阶泰勒展开和(2,1)帕德近似。通过结合Pantheon+和SH0ES Ia型超新星、伽马射线爆以及DESIBAO数据来约束宇宙学参数(H0,q0,j0)，并构建模拟的Sandage-Loeb星表，随后包含模拟的红移漂移数据重复分析。

主要发现: 对于Ia型超新星+伽马射线爆分析，泰勒重建在1σ水平上与ω0ω1CDM场景兼容，而帕德参数化改善了q0与ΛCDM范式的吻合。一旦加入DESIBAO数据，与参考背景模型的吻合度减弱至2σ水平。添加模拟的Sandage-Loeb样本主要收紧了q0和j0的界限，中心值有适度移动。

结论: 研究比较了重建的红移漂移与ΛCDM和ω0ω1CDM场景预测的相应行为。

翻译: 红移漂移通过宇宙源红移的缓慢时间变化提供了检验宇宙膨胀历史的运动学测试。受未来设施预期的Sandage-Loeb测量启发，我们在宇宙学框架内调查了红移漂移，通过二阶泰勒展开和(2,1)帕德近似来建模哈勃率。我们通过结合Pantheon+和SH0ES Ia型超新星与伽马射线爆来约束宇宙学参数(H0,q0,j0)，然后检查加入第二轮DESIBAO测量数据的影响。所得约束被用来构建模拟的Sandage-Loeb星表，之后重复分析，包括模拟的红移漂移数据。以此方式，我们评估重建背景的内部一致性，而不是进行独立的预测。因此，我们发现，对于Ia型超新星+伽马射线爆分析，泰勒重建在1σ水平上与ω0ω1CDM场景兼容，而帕德参数化改善了q0与ΛCDM范式的吻合。一旦加入DESIBAO数据，与参考背景模型的吻合度减弱至2σ水平。添加模拟的Sandage-Loeb样本主要收紧了q0和j0的界限，中心值有适度移动。最后，我们比较了重建的红移漂移与ΛCDM和ω0ω1CDM场景预测的相应行为。

Abstract

The redshift drift provides a kinematic test of the cosmic expansion history through the slow time variation of the redshift of comoving sources. Motivated by the expected Sandage-Loeb measurements from future facilities, we investigate the drift within a cosmographic framework, modeling the Hubble rate through both a second-order Taylor expansion and a $(2,1)$ Padé approximant. We constrain the cosmographic parameters $(H_0,q_0,j_0)$ by combining Pantheon+ and SH0ES type Ia supernovae with gamma-ray bursts and then examine the impact of adding baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from the second DESI data release. The resulting constraints are used to construct a mock Sandage-Loeb catalog, after which the analyses are repeated including the simulated drift data. In this way, we assess the internal consistency of the reconstructed background rather than perform an independent forecast. Accordingly, we find that, for the SNeIa+GRB analysis, the Taylor reconstruction is compatible at the $1σ$ level with the $ω_0ω_1$CDM scenario, whereas the Padé parameterization improves the agreement of $q_0$ with the $Λ$CDM paradigm. Once DESI BAO data are included, the agreement with the reference background models weakens to the $2σ$ level. The addition of the mock Sandage-Loeb sample mainly tightens the bounds on $q_0$ and $j_0$, with moderate shifts in the central values. We finally compare the reconstructed redshift drift with the corresponding behavior predicted by the $Λ$CDM and $ω_0ω_1$CDM scenarios.

item.title: Learning the Signature of Memorization in Autoregressive Language Models
item.author: David Ilić, Kostadin Cvejoski, David Stanojević, Evgeny Grigorenko
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种可迁移的学习型成员推断攻击方法，通过利用微调语言模型产生的记忆不变性签名，实现了跨架构和领域的零样本迁移。

背景: 以往针对微调语言模型的成员推断攻击主要依赖设计者直觉的手工启发式方法，如损失阈值、Min-K%和参考校准，这些方法存在局限性。

目的: 引入首个可迁移的学习型成员推断攻击，旨在通过学习而非设计来捕捉模型记忆的通用信号，从而突破阴影模型瓶颈。

方法: 将成员推断重新定义为基于序列分类的统计任务，训练一个分类器，利用微调语言模型产生的记忆不变性签名，通过训练多样性和规模实现泛化。

主要发现: 微调语言模型会产生一种跨架构家族和数据域可检测的记忆不变性签名；该方法在零样本迁移到Mamba、RWKV-4和RecurrentGemma等不同架构时均表现优异；该方法在代码数据上也表现出强迁移能力。

结论: 该方法通过捕捉梯度下降和交叉熵损失下的通用信号，实现了比最强基线高2.8倍的真正率，证明了成员推断已进入深度学习时代。

翻译: 摘要：所有针对微调语言模型的先前成员推断攻击都使用手工设计的启发式方法（例如损失阈值、Min-K%、参考校准），每种方法都受限于设计者的直觉。我们引入了首个可迁移的学习型攻击，其通过观察微调任何模型在任何语料库上都会产生无限标记数据而实现，因为成员关系由构造已知。这消除了阴影模型瓶颈，并将成员推断带入深度学习时代：通过训练多样性和规模实现泛化，学习什么重要而不是设计它。我们发现微调语言模型会产生一种跨架构家族和数据域可检测的记忆不变性签名。我们仅基于Transformer模型训练成员推断分类器。它零样本迁移到Mamba（状态空间）、RWKV-4（线性注意力）和RecurrentGemma（门控循环），分别达到0.963、0.972和0.936 AUC。每次评估都结合了训练中从未见过的架构和数据集，但这三者均超过保留的Transformer性能（0.908 AUC）。这四个家族没有共同的计算机制，它们的唯一共同点是交叉熵损失上的梯度下降。即使简单的基于似然度的方法也表现出强迁移，确认该签名独立于检测方法。我们的方法，学习型迁移MIA（LT-MIA），通过将成员推断重新定义为基于序列分类的逐令牌分布统计任务，最有效地捕捉了该信号。在Transformer上，LT-MIA在0.1% FPR下比最强基线高2.8倍的真正率。该方法也迁移到代码（0.865 AUC），尽管仅用自然语言文本训练。代码和训练好的分类器可在 https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/learned-mia 获取。

Abstract

All prior membership inference attacks for fine-tuned language models use hand-crafted heuristics (e.g., loss thresholding, Min-K\%, reference calibration), each bounded by the designer's intuition. We introduce the first transferable learned attack, enabled by the observation that fine-tuning any model on any corpus yields unlimited labeled data, since membership is known by construction. This removes the shadow model bottleneck and brings membership inference into the deep learning era: learning what matters rather than designing it, with generalization through training diversity and scale. We discover that fine-tuning language models produces an invariant signature of memorization detectable across architectural families and data domains. We train a membership inference classifier exclusively on transformer-based models. It transfers zero-shot to Mamba (state-space), RWKV-4 (linear attention), and RecurrentGemma (gated recurrence), achieving 0.963, 0.972, and 0.936 AUC respectively. Each evaluation combines an architecture and dataset never seen during training, yet all three exceed performance on held-out transformers (0.908 AUC). These four families share no computational mechanisms, their only commonality is gradient descent on cross-entropy loss. Even simple likelihood-based methods exhibit strong transfer, confirming the signature exists independently of the detection method. Our method, Learned Transfer MIA (LT-MIA), captures this signal most effectively by reframing membership inference as sequence classification over per-token distributional statistics. On transformers, LT-MIA achieves 2.8$\times$ higher TPR at 0.1\% FPR than the strongest baseline. The method also transfers to code (0.865 AUC) despite training only on natural language texts. Code and trained classifier available at https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/learned-mia.

item.title: CoME-VL: Scaling Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language Learning
item.author: Ankan Deria, Komal Kumar, Xilin He, Imran Razzak, Hisham Cholakkal, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoME-VL是一个模块化融合框架，结合了对比训练的视觉编码器和自监督DINO编码器，通过表示级融合提升视觉语言模型性能。

背景: 现有的视觉语言模型通常依赖单一对比训练的视觉编码器，虽然对比编码器在跨模态对齐和检索方面有效，但自监督视觉编码器能捕捉更丰富的密集语义并在识别和理解任务中表现出更强的鲁棒性。

目的: 研究如何扩展互补视觉表示的融合以用于视觉语言建模。

方法: 提出CoME-VL框架，通过熵引导的多层聚合和正交约束投影减少冗余，以及RoPE增强的交叉注意力来对齐异构token网格并生成紧凑的融合视觉token。

主要发现: CoME-VL在多个视觉语言基准测试中持续优于单编码器基线，在视觉理解任务上平均提升4.9%，在定位任务上平均提升5.4%，并在RefCOCO检测任务上达到最先进性能。

结论: 融合互补的对比和自监督信号能显著提升视觉语言模型性能，通过消融研究验证了层合并、非冗余特征混合和融合容量的影响。

翻译: CoME-VL是一个模块化融合框架，结合了对比训练的视觉编码器和自监督DINO编码器，通过表示级融合提升视觉语言模型性能。现有的视觉语言模型通常依赖单一对比训练的视觉编码器，虽然对比编码器在跨模态对齐和检索方面有效，但自监督视觉编码器能捕捉更丰富的密集语义并在识别和理解任务中表现出更强的鲁棒性。研究如何扩展互补视觉表示的融合以用于视觉语言建模。提出CoME-VL框架，通过熵引导的多层聚合和正交约束投影减少冗余，以及RoPE增强的交叉注意力来对齐异构token网格并生成紧凑的融合视觉token。CoME-VL在多个视觉语言基准测试中持续优于单编码器基线，在视觉理解任务上平均提升4.9%，在定位任务上平均提升5.4%，并在RefCOCO检测任务上达到最先进性能。融合互补的对比和自监督信号能显著提升视觉语言模型性能，通过消融研究验证了层合并、非冗余特征混合和融合容量的影响。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决多编码器融合在视觉-语言模型中的问题，以增强多模态理解能力。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为多模态理解是人工智能的重要方向，能帮助机器更好地处理图像和文本信息。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 CoME-VL 模型，通过多编码器融合和熵引导层选择来增强多模态理解。

Abstract

Recent vision-language models (VLMs) typically rely on a single vision encoder trained with contrastive image-text objectives, such as CLIP-style pretraining. While contrastive encoders are effective for cross-modal alignment and retrieval, self-supervised visual encoders often capture richer dense semantics and exhibit stronger robustness on recognition and understanding tasks. In this work, we investigate how to scale the fusion of these complementary visual representations for vision-language modeling. We propose CoME-VL: Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language, a modular fusion framework that integrates a contrastively trained vision encoder with a self-supervised DINO encoder. Our approach performs representation-level fusion by (i) entropy-guided multi-layer aggregation with orthogonality-constrained projections to reduce redundancy, and (ii) RoPE-enhanced cross-attention to align heterogeneous token grids and produce compact fused visual tokens. The fused tokens can be injected into a decoder-only LLM with minimal changes to standard VLM pipelines. Extensive experiments across diverse vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that CoME-VL consistently outperforms single-encoder baselines. In particular, we observe an average improvement of 4.9% on visual understanding tasks and 5.4% on grounding tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on RefCOCO for detection while improving over the baseline by a large margin. Finally, we conduct ablation studies on layer merging, non-redundant feature mixing, and fusion capacity to evaluate how complementary contrastive and self-supervised signals affect VLM performance.

item.title: Self-Execution Simulation Improves Coding Models
item.author: Gallil Maimon, Ori Yoran, Felix Kreuk, Michael Hassid, Gal Cohen, Pierre Chambon, Yossi Adi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种通过训练代码大模型模拟程序执行步骤来提高其生成代码正确性的方法，并结合监督微调和强化学习，在多项编程基准测试中取得了优于标准推理方法的改进。

背景: 现有代码大模型在生成代码时无法正确估计程序执行，导致生成的代码可能存在错误。

目的: 研究如何训练代码大模型以逐步模拟程序执行，从而提升其在竞争性编程任务中的表现。

方法: 结合监督微调（基于自然语言执行轨迹和基于真实执行的文本解释）与强化学习（使用可验证的奖励）。引入两个互补目标：给定代码和输入的输出预测，以及利用真实或自预测的执行反馈解决竞争性编程任务。

主要发现: 该方法使模型能够对多个候选解决方案进行自我验证，并通过模拟测试执行进行迭代自我修复。在多个竞争性编程基准测试中，该方法相比标准推理方法取得了持续改进。

结论: 执行模拟在提升模型性能中发挥了关键作用，同时也揭示了其局限性。

翻译: A promising research direction in enabling LLMs to generate consistently correct code involves addressing their inability to properly estimate program execution, particularly for code they generate. In this work, we demonstrate that Code LLMs can be trained to simulate program execution in a step-by-step manner and that this capability can be leveraged to improve competitive programming performance. Our approach combines supervised fine-tuning on natural language execution traces, textual explanations grounded in true execution, with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards. We introduce two complementary objectives: output prediction given code and inputs, and solving competitive programming tasks with either ground-truth or self-predicted execution feedback. These objectives enable models to perform self-verification over multiple candidate solutions, and iterative self-fixing by simulating test execution. Across multiple competitive programming benchmarks, our method yields consistent improvements over standard reasoning approaches. We further present ablations and analysis to elucidate the role of execution simulation and its limitations.

Abstract

A promising research direction in enabling LLMs to generate consistently correct code involves addressing their inability to properly estimate program execution, particularly for code they generate. In this work, we demonstrate that Code LLMs can be trained to simulate program execution in a step-by-step manner and that this capability can be leveraged to improve competitive programming performance. We further present ablations and analysis to elucidate the role of execution simulation and its limitations.

item.title: Emergent Compositional Communication for Latent World Properties
item.author: Tomek Kaszyński
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 多智能体通信压力能够从冻结的视频特征中提取离散、组合性的不可见物理属性表示，无需属性标签或消息结构监督。

背景: 研究多智能体通信压力是否能从冻结的视频特征中提取离散、组合性的不可见物理属性表示。

目的: 探索多智能体通信压力在提取不可见物理属性表示方面的能力，并验证其有效性、机制及在不同感知模型和场景下的表现。

方法: 使用通过Gumbel-Softmax瓶颈进行通信的智能体，结合迭代学习，在无属性标签和消息结构监督的情况下进行训练。

主要发现: 4个智能体在80个种子中100%收敛到近完美的组合性；因果干预显示对特定属性的破坏导致约15%的下降；感知先验决定了哪些属性是可通信的；冻结协议支持动作条件规划；在真实物理视频上验证了85.6%的质量比较准确率。

结论: 多智能体结构而非带宽或时间覆盖驱动了这一效果；感知先验决定了可通信的内容；视频原生预训练是造成差异的主要原因；冻结协议支持动作条件规划和反事实速度推理。

翻译: Can multi-agent communication pressure extract discrete, compositional representations of invisible physical properties from frozen video features? We show that agents communicating through a Gumbel-Softmax bottleneck with iterated learning develop positionally disentangled protocols for latent properties (elasticity, friction, mass ratio) without property labels or supervision on message structure. With 4 agents, 100% of 80 seeds converge to near-perfect compositionality (PosDis=0.999, holdout 98.3%). Controls confirm multi-agent structure -- not bandwidth or temporal coverage -- drives this effect. Causal intervention shows surgical property disruption (~15% drop on targeted property, <3% on others). A controlled backbone comparison reveals that the perceptual prior determines what is communicable: DINOv2 dominates on spatially-visible ramp physics (98.3% vs 95.1%), while V-JEPA 2 dominates on dynamics-only collision physics (87.4% vs 77.7%, d=2.74). Scale-matched (d=3.37) and frame-matched (d=6.53) controls attribute this gap entirely to video-native pretraining. The frozen protocol supports action-conditioned planning (91.5%) with counterfactual velocity reasoning (r=0.780). Validation on Physics 101 real camera footage confirms 85.6% mass-comparison accuracy on unseen objects, temporal dynamics contributing +11.2% beyond static appearance, agent-scaling compositionality replicating at 90% for 4 agents, and causal intervention extending to real video (d=1.87, p=0.022).

深度解读
