item.author: Hyunsoo Cha, Wonjung Woo, Byungjun Kim, Hanbyul Joo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Vanast是一个统一框架，能从单张人体图像、服装图像和姿态引导视频直接生成服装转移的人体动画视频。

背景: 传统两阶段流程将基于图像的虚拟试穿和姿态驱动的动画视为独立过程，常导致身份漂移、服装扭曲和前后不一致。

目的: 通过统一流程解决这些问题，实现连贯合成，并支持零样本服装插值。

方法: 构建大规模三元组监督；数据生成流程包括生成身份保持的人体图像、捕获完整的上下装三元组以及组装多样化的野外三元组；引入双模块架构以稳定训练，保持预训练生成质量，并提高服装准确性、姿态遵从性和身份保持。

主要发现: Vanast能够产生高保真、身份一致的人体动画，适用于广泛的服装类型。

结论: Vanast通过统一流程和双模块架构，有效解决了传统方法中的问题，实现了高质量的服装转移动画生成。

翻译: 我们提出了Vanast，一个统一框架，能够直接从单个人体图像、服装图像和姿态引导视频生成服装转移的人体动画视频。传统的两阶段流程将基于图像的虚拟试穿和姿态驱动的动画视为独立过程，这通常导致身份漂移、服装扭曲和前后不一致。我们的模型通过在单个统一步骤中执行整个过程来解决这些问题，以实现连贯的合成。为了实现这一设置，我们构建了大规模的三元组监督。我们的数据生成流程包括生成身份保持的人体图像，这些图像穿着与服装目录图像不同的服装；捕获完整的上下装三元组以克服单服装姿态视频对的限制；以及组装多样化的野外三元组，而无需服装目录图像。我们进一步引入了用于视频扩散变换器的双模块架构，以稳定训练，保持预训练的生成质量，并提高服装准确性、姿态遵从性和身份保持，同时支持零样本服装插值。这些贡献共同使Vanast能够产生高保真、身份一致的人体动画，适用于广泛的服装类型。

Abstract

We present Vanast, a unified framework that generates garment-transferred human animation videos directly from a single human image, garment images, and a pose guidance video. Conventional two-stage pipelines treat image-based virtual try-on and pose-driven animation as separate processes, which often results in identity drift, garment distortion, and front-back inconsistency. Our model addresses these issues by performing the entire process in a single unified step to achieve coherent synthesis. To enable this setting, we construct large-scale triplet supervision. Our data generation pipeline includes generating identity-preserving human images in alternative outfits that differ from garment catalog images, capturing full upper and lower garment triplets to overcome the single-garment-posed video pair limitation, and assembling diverse in-the-wild triplets without requiring garment catalog images. We further introduce a Dual Module architecture for video diffusion transformers to stabilize training, preserve pretrained generative quality, and improve garment accuracy, pose adherence, and identity preservation while supporting zero-shot garment interpolation. Together, these contributions allow Vanast to produce high-fidelity, identity-consistent animation across a wide range of garment types.

item.title: Learning to Retrieve from Agent Trajectories
item.author: Yuqi Zhou, Sunhao Dai, Changle Qu, Liang Pang, Jun Xu, Ji-Rong Wen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的训练范式，即从智能体轨迹中学习检索，以解决传统检索模型与智能体搜索需求之间的不匹配问题。

背景: 随着大型语言模型驱动的搜索智能体的兴起，检索正越来越多地由智能体而非人类用户消费，并被嵌入到多轮推理和行动循环中。然而，基于以人类为中心假设训练的检索模型与智能体发出查询和消费结果的方式存在根本性不匹配。

目的: 本文主张智能体搜索的检索模型应直接从智能体交互数据中训练，并引入从智能体轨迹中学习检索作为新的训练范式。

方法: 通过系统分析搜索智能体轨迹，识别揭示文档效用（包括浏览动作、未浏览拒绝和浏览后推理痕迹）的关键行为信号。基于这些见解，提出了LRAT框架，该框架从智能体轨迹中挖掘高质量的检索监督信号，并通过加权优化整合相关性强度。

主要发现: 在领域内和领域外深度研究基准上的广泛实验表明，使用LRAT训练的检索器在多样化的智能体架构和规模下，始终提高了证据召回率、端到端任务成功率和执行效率。

结论: 研究结果突出了智能体轨迹作为实用且可扩展的监督来源，为智能体搜索时代的检索指明了有前景的方向。

翻译: 信息检索（IR）系统传统上是为人类用户设计和训练的，排序学习方法严重依赖大规模人类交互日志，如点击和停留时间。然而，随着大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索智能体的迅速兴起，检索正越来越多地由智能体而非人类消费，并被嵌入到多轮推理和行动循环中。在这种设置下，以人类为中心假设训练的检索模型与智能体发出查询和消费结果的方式表现出根本性不匹配。在这项工作中，我们主张智能体搜索的检索模型应直接从智能体交互数据中训练。我们引入了从智能体轨迹中学习检索作为新的训练范式，其中监督来自多步智能体交互。通过对搜索智能体轨迹的系统分析，我们识别了揭示文档效用（包括浏览动作、未浏览拒绝和浏览后推理痕迹）的关键行为信号。受这些见解的指导，我们提出了LRAT，一个简单而有效的框架，它从智能体轨迹中挖掘高质量的检索监督信号，并通过加权优化整合相关性强度。在领域内和领域外深度研究基准上的广泛实验表明，使用LRAT训练的检索器在多样化的智能体架构和规模下，始终提高了证据召回率、端到端任务成功率和执行效率。我们的结果突出了智能体轨迹作为实用且可扩展的监督来源，为智能体搜索时代的检索指明了有前景的方向。

Abstract

Information retrieval (IR) systems have traditionally been designed and trained for human users, with learning-to-rank methods relying heavily on large-scale human interaction logs such as clicks and dwell time. With the rapid emergence of large language model (LLM) powered search agents, however, retrieval is increasingly consumed by agents rather than human beings, and is embedded as a core component within multi-turn reasoning and action loops. In this setting, retrieval models trained under human-centric assumptions exhibit a fundamental mismatch with the way agents issue queries and consume results. In this work, we argue that retrieval models for agentic search should be trained directly from agent interaction data. We introduce learning to retrieve from agent trajectories as a new training paradigm, where supervision is derived from multi-step agent interactions. Through a systematic analysis of search agent trajectories, we identify key behavioral signals that reveal document utility, including browsing actions, unbrowsed rejections, and post-browse reasoning traces. Guided by these insights, we propose LRAT, a simple yet effective framework that mines high-quality retrieval supervision from agent trajectories and incorporates relevance intensity through weighted optimization. Extensive experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain deep research benchmarks demonstrate that retrievers trained with LRAT consistently improve evidence recall, end-to-end task success, and execution efficiency across diverse agent architectures and scales. Our results highlight agent trajectories as a practical and scalable supervision source, pointing to a promising direction for retrieval in the era of agentic search.

item.title: Video-MME-v2: Towards the Next Stage in Benchmarks for Comprehensive Video Understanding
item.author: Chaoyou Fu, Haozhi Yuan, Yuhao Dong, Yi-Fan Zhang, Yunhang Shen, Xiaoxing Hu, Xueying Li, Jinsen Su, Chengwu Long, Xiaoyao Xie, Yongkang Xie, Xiawu Zheng, Xue Yang, Haoyu Cao, Yunsheng Wu, Ziwei Liu, Xing Sun, Caifeng Shan, Ran He
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Video-MME-v2是一个旨在评估视频理解鲁棒性和忠实度的综合基准测试，通过渐进式三层级层次结构和基于组的非线性评估策略来系统评估模型能力。

背景: 随着视频理解技术的快速发展，现有基准测试的排行榜分数日益饱和，暴露了模型实际能力与 inflated leaderboard scores 之间的关键差异。

目的: 引入Video-MME-v2以解决这一差距，旨在作为最权威的视频基准测试之一，为下一代视频多模态大语言模型的开发提供 demanding new testbed。

方法: 1. 设计了渐进式三层级层次结构，逐步增加视频理解的复杂性，从多点视觉信息聚合到时间动态建模，再到复杂的多模态推理。2. 提出了基于组的非线性评估策略，强制相关查询之间的一致性和多步推理的连贯性，惩罚碎片化或猜测性的正确性。3. 通过严格控制的标注管道构建数据，涉及12名标注员和50名独立评审员，投入3300个人工小时和多达5轮质量保证。

主要发现: 1. 当前最佳模型Gemini-3-Pro与人类专家之间存在显著差距。2. 发现了一个清晰的层级瓶颈，其中视觉信息聚合和时间建模中的错误会传播并限制高级推理。3. 发现基于推理的推理高度依赖于文本线索，在有字幕的情况下提高性能，但在纯视觉设置中有时会降低性能。

结论: Video-MME-v2通过暴露这些局限性，建立了一个要求更高的新测试平台，以推动下一代视频多模态大语言模型的发展。

翻译: 随着视频理解技术的快速发展，现有基准测试的排行榜分数日益饱和，暴露了模型实际能力与 inflated leaderboard scores 之间的关键差异。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了Video-MME-v2，这是一个旨在严格评估视频理解鲁棒性和忠实度的综合基准测试。为了系统评估模型能力，我们设计了一个渐进式三层级层次结构，逐步增加视频理解的复杂性，从多点视觉信息聚合到时间动态建模，再到复杂的多模态推理。此外，与传统的每个问题准确率不同，我们提出了基于组的非线性评估策略，强制相关查询之间的一致性和多步推理的连贯性，惩罚碎片化或猜测性的正确性，并仅对由有效推理支持的答案分配分数。为了确保数据质量，Video-MME-v2通过严格控制的标注管道构建，涉及12名标注员和50名独立评审员。在3300个人工小时和多达5轮质量保证的支持下，Video-MME-v2旨在成为最权威的视频基准测试之一。广泛的实验揭示了当前最佳模型Gemini-3-Pro与人类专家之间存在显著差距，并发现了一个清晰的层级瓶颈，其中视觉信息聚合和时间建模中的错误会传播并限制高级推理。我们进一步发现，基于推理的推理高度依赖于文本线索，在有字幕的情况下提高性能，但在纯视觉设置中有时会降低性能。通过暴露这些局限性，Video-MME-v2为下一代视频多模态大语言模型的开发建立了一个要求更高的新测试平台。

Abstract

With the rapid advancement of video understanding, existing benchmarks are becoming increasingly saturated, exposing a critical discrepancy between inflated leaderboard scores and real-world model capabilities. To address this widening gap, we introduce Video-MME-v2, a comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the robustness and faithfulness of video understanding. To systematically evaluate model capabilities, we design a \textbf{progressive tri-level hierarchy} that incrementally increases the complexity of video comprehension, ranging from multi-point visual information aggregation, to temporal dynamics modeling, and ultimately to complex multimodal reasoning. Besides, in contrast to conventional per-question accuracy, we propose a \textbf{group-based non-linear evaluation} strategy that enforces both consistency across related queries and coherence in multi-step reasoning. It penalizes fragmented or guess-based correctness and assigns credit only to answers supported by valid reasoning. To guarantee data quality, Video-MME-v2 is constructed through a rigorously controlled human annotation pipeline, involving 12 annotators and 50 independent reviewers. Backed by \textbf{3,300 human-hours} and up to \textbf{5 rounds} of quality assurance, Video-MME-v2 aims to serve as one of the most authoritative video benchmarks. Extensive experiments reveal a substantial gap between current best model Gemini-3-Pro and human experts, and uncover a clear hierarchical bottleneck where errors in visual information aggregation and temporal modeling propagate to limit high-level reasoning. We further find that thinking-based reasoning is highly dependent on textual cues, improving performance with subtitles but sometimes degrading it in purely visual settings. By exposing these limitations, Video-MME-v2 establishes a demanding new testbed for the development of next-generation video MLLMs.

item.title: R3PM-Net: Real-time, Robust, Real-world Point Matching Network
item.author: Yasaman Kashefbahrami, Erkut Akdag, Panagiotis Meletis, Evgeniya Balmashnova, Dip Goswami, Egor Bondarau
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文介绍了一种名为R3PM-Net的轻量级、全局感知的物体级点云匹配网络，旨在解决传统方法和现有深度学习方法在噪声、异常值、遮挡和初始化方面的局限性，同时提高在真实工业场景中的泛化能力和实时效率。

背景: 传统的非学习方法对噪声、异常值、遮挡和初始化敏感，而现有的深度学习方法通常在干净、密集、合成的数据集上开发和评估，限制了其在真实工业场景中的泛化能力。

目的: 为了弥合这一差距，提出R3PM-Net，该网络优先考虑泛化能力和实时效率，并提出了两个数据集以支持这一转变。

方法: R3PM-Net是一种轻量级、全局感知的物体级点匹配网络。为了支持这一转变，提出了两个数据集：Sioux-Cranfield和Sioux-Scans，用于评估将不完美的摄影测量和事件相机扫描与数字CAD模型进行配准。

主要发现: R3PM-Net在ModelNet40上达到了完美的适配度分数1和内点均方根误差0.029 cm，仅需0.007秒，比最先进的方法RegTR快约7倍。在Sioux-Cranfield数据集上，保持了适配度1和内点均方根误差0.030 cm，且延迟同样低。在具有挑战性的Sioux-Scans数据集上，R3PM-Net在50毫秒内成功解决了边缘情况。

结论: R3PM-Net为关键工业应用提供了一种稳健、高速的解决方案，其中精度和实时性能是必不可少的。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/YasiiKB/R3PM-Net上获取。

翻译: 该论文介绍了一种名为R3PM-Net的轻量级、全局感知的物体级点云匹配网络，旨在解决传统方法和现有深度学习方法在噪声、异常值、遮挡和初始化方面的局限性，同时提高在真实工业场景中的泛化能力和实时效率。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有深度学习方法在现实世界工业场景中泛化能力差的问题。现有的方法通常依赖复杂的骨干网络，导致计算开销大且推理延迟高，无法满足实时工业应用的需求。这非常重要，因为点云配准是3D重建、SLAM和自动质量检查的基础。现实工业数据通常包含噪声、遮挡和稀疏性，因此需要一种既能在不完美数据上保持高精度，又能以极低延迟运行的鲁棒解决方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为现有深度学习方法过于依赖复杂的特征工程和重型骨干网络，导致在处理现实工业场景中的稀疏和噪声数据时速度慢且鲁棒性不足。他们借鉴了RPMNet作为基线，但重新设计了特征提取模块，采用轻量级网络扩大感受野以捕获全局几何上下文，从而在保持高效的同时提升了鲁棒性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是采用轻量级、全局感知的特征提取架构，通过扩大网络的有效感受野来捕获更广泛的几何上下文，从而在不依赖复杂特征工程或重型骨干网络的情况下，实现对稀疏、嘈杂和不完整输入的鲁棒性处理。整体实现流程包括四个主要步骤：首先利用共享权重的多层感知机提取全局特征；接着基于特征距离计算匹配矩阵；随后通过动态预测阈值来抑制错误匹配；最后利用可微分的奇异值分解估计刚体变换，并结合粗到细的注册策略及广义迭代最近点算法进行局部细化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了一个轻量级、全局感知的点匹配网络R3PM-Net，通过扩大感受野来处理稀疏和噪声数据，从而在真实工业场景中实现高精度和实时效率。相比之前依赖复杂骨干网络或混合特征表示的方法，R3PM-Net简化了架构，避免了昂贵的特征工程，显著降低了计算开销，实现了比现有最先进方法更快的速度。此外，论文还提出了两个新的数据集以填补合成数据与真实世界数据之间的差距。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了R3PM-Net，一种轻量级且具有全局感知能力的点匹配网络，旨在解决现有方法在真实工业场景中鲁棒性差和计算效率低的问题，并为此提供了两个新的公开数据集。

Abstract

Accurate Point Cloud Registration (PCR) is an important task in 3D data processing, involving the estimation of a rigid transformation between two point clouds. While deep-learning methods have addressed key limitations of traditional non-learning approaches, such as sensitivity to noise, outliers, occlusion, and initialization, they are developed and evaluated on clean, dense, synthetic datasets (limiting their generalizability to real-world industrial scenarios). This paper introduces R3PM-Net, a lightweight, global-aware, object-level point matching network designed to bridge this gap by prioritizing both generalizability and real-time efficiency. To support this transition, two datasets, Sioux-Cranfield and Sioux-Scans, are proposed. They provide an evaluation ground for registering imperfect photogrammetric and event-camera scans to digital CAD models, and have been made publicly available. Extensive experiments demonstrate that R3PM-Net achieves competitive accuracy with unmatched speed. On ModelNet40, it reaches a perfect fitness score of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.029$ cm in only $0.007$s, approximately 7 times faster than the state-of-the-art method RegTR. This performance carries over to the Sioux-Cranfield dataset, maintaining a fitness of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.030$ cm with similarly low latency. Furthermore, on the highly challenging Sioux-Scans dataset, R3PM-Net successfully resolves edge cases in under 50 ms. These results confirm that R3PM-Net offers a robust, high-speed solution for critical industrial applications, where precision and real-time performance are indispensable. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/YasiiKB/R3PM-Net.

item.title: Feature-Aware Anisotropic Local Differential Privacy for Utility-Preserving Graph Representation Learning in Metal Additive Manufacturing
item.author: MD Shafikul Islam, Mahathir Mohammad Bappy, Saifur Rahman Tushar, Md Arifuzzaman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FI-LDP-HGAT的计算框架，旨在解决金属增材制造中质量保证与数据共享之间的矛盾，通过分层图注意力网络和特征重要性感知各向异性高斯机制来提高缺陷检测的准确性和隐私保护效果。

背景: 金属增材制造能够制造安全关键部件，但可靠的质量保证依赖于包含专有过程信息的高保真传感器流，限制了协作数据共享。现有的缺陷检测模型通常将熔池观测视为独立样本，忽略了层间的物理耦合。此外，传统的隐私保护技术，特别是局部差分隐私，会导致严重的效用退化，因为它们在所有特征维度上注入均匀噪声。

目的: 为了解决这些相互关联的挑战，提出了一种名为FI-LDP-HGAT的计算框架，该框架结合了分层图注意力网络和特征重要性感知各向异性高斯机制，以在保持隐私保证的同时提高缺陷检测的效用。

方法: FI-LDP-HGAT框架包含两个方法论组件：分层图注意力网络（HGAT），用于捕获扫描轨迹和沉积层之间的空间和热依赖关系；以及特征重要性感知各向异性高斯机制（FI-LDP），用于非交互式特征隐私化。与各向同性LDP不同，FI-LDP使用编码器导出的重要性先验重新分配隐私预算，对任务关键的热特征分配较低的噪声，对冗余维度分配较高的噪声，同时保持正式的LDP保证。

主要发现: 在定向能量沉积DED孔隙度数据集上的实验表明，FI-LDP-HGAT在中等隐私预算下实现了81.5%的效用恢复，在严格隐私下保持了0.762的缺陷召回率，并且在所有评估指标上均优于经典机器学习、标准图神经网络和替代隐私机制，包括DP-SGD。机制分析证实了特征重要性与噪声幅度之间存在强烈的负相关。

结论: FI-LDP-HGAT在保持严格隐私保证的同时，显著提高了缺陷检测的效用，证明了各向异性分配在隐私-效用增益方面的原则性驱动作用。

翻译: 金属增材制造（AM）能够制造安全关键部件，但可靠的质量保证依赖于包含专有过程信息的高保真传感器流，限制了协作数据共享。现有的缺陷检测模型通常将熔池观测视为独立样本，忽略了层间的物理耦合。此外，传统的隐私保护技术，特别是局部差分隐私（LDP），会导致严重的效用退化，因为它们在所有特征维度上注入均匀噪声。为了解决这些相互关联的挑战，我们提出了FI-LDP-HGAT。这种计算框架结合了两个方法论组件：分层图注意力网络（HGAT），用于捕获扫描轨迹和沉积层之间的空间和热依赖关系；以及特征重要性感知各向异性高斯机制（FI-LDP），用于非交互式特征隐私化。与各向同性LDP不同，FI-LDP使用编码器导出的重要性先验重新分配隐私预算，对任务关键的热特征分配较低的噪声，对冗余维度分配较高的噪声，同时保持正式的LDP保证。在定向能量沉积（DED）孔隙度数据集上的实验表明，FI-LDP-HGAT在中等隐私预算下实现了81.5%的效用恢复，在严格隐私下保持了0.762的缺陷召回率，并且在所有评估指标上均优于经典机器学习、标准图神经网络和替代隐私机制，包括DP-SGD。机制分析证实了特征重要性与噪声幅度之间存在强烈的负相关，为隐私-效用增益是由原则性各向异性分配驱动提供了可解释的证据。

Abstract

Metal additive manufacturing (AM) enables the fabrication of safety-critical components, but reliable quality assurance depends on high-fidelity sensor streams containing proprietary process information, limiting collaborative data sharing. Existing defect-detection models typically treat melt-pool observations as independent samples, ignoring layer-wise physical couplings. Moreover, conventional privacy-preserving techniques, particularly Local Differential Privacy (LDP), lead to severe utility degradation because they inject uniform noise across all feature dimensions. To address these interrelated challenges, we propose FI-LDP-HGAT. This computational framework combines two methodological components: a stratified Hierarchical Graph Attention Network (HGAT) that captures spatial and thermal dependencies across scan tracks and deposited layers, and a feature-importance-aware anisotropic Gaussian mechanism (FI-LDP) for non-interactive feature privatization. Unlike isotropic LDP, FI-LDP redistributes the privacy budget across embedding coordinates using an encoder-derived importance prior, assigning lower noise to task-critical thermal signatures and higher noise to redundant dimensions while maintaining formal LDP guarantees. Experiments on a Directed Energy Deposition (DED) porosity dataset demonstrate that FI-LDP-HGAT achieves 81.5% utility recovery at a moderate privacy budget (epsilon = 4) and maintains defect recall of 0.762 under strict privacy (epsilon = 2), while outperforming classical ML, standard GNNs, and alternative privacy mechanisms, including DP-SGD across all evaluated metrics. Mechanistic analysis confirms a strong negative correlation (Spearman = -0.81) between feature importance and noise magnitude, providing interpretable evidence that the privacy-utility gains are driven by principled anisotropic allocation.

item.title: SVAgent: Storyline-Guided Long Video Understanding via Cross-Modal Multi-Agent Collaboration
item.author: Zhongyu Yang, Zuhao Yang, Shuo Zhan, Tan Yue, Wei Pang, Yingfang Yuan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SVAgent是一个基于故事线引导的跨模态多智能体框架，用于视频问答任务，通过模拟人类对视频故事线的推理来提升性能和可解释性。

背景: 视频问答任务需要整合空间、时间和语义信息。现有方法大多依赖定位相关帧，而非像人类那样通过连贯的故事线进行推理。

目的: 为了解决现有方法缺乏人类自然理解视频的连贯故事线能力的问题，提出SVAgent框架。

方法: SVAgent包含故事线智能体、细化建议智能体、跨模态决策智能体和元智能体。故事线智能体基于历史失败分析构建叙事表示；跨模态决策智能体在故事线指导下独立预测答案；元智能体评估输出以对齐预测并增强推理鲁棒性。

主要发现: 实验结果表明SVAgent在视频理解任务中实现了优越的性能和可解释性。

结论: SVAgent通过模拟人类风格的故事线推理，增强了视频问答的推理鲁棒性和答案一致性。

翻译: 视频问答是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要整合空间、时间和语义信息以捕捉视频序列的复杂动态。尽管最近的进展引入了各种视频理解方法，但大多数现有方法仍然依赖于定位相关帧来回答问题，而不是像人类那样通过演变的故事线进行推理。人类自然地通过连贯的故事线来解释视频，这种能力对于做出稳健和上下文合理的预测至关重要。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了SVAgent，这是一个用于视频问答的故事线引导跨模态多智能体框架。故事线智能体基于细化建议智能体分析历史失败而建议的帧，逐步构建叙事表示。此外，跨模态决策智能体在演变的故事线指导下，独立地从视觉和文本模态预测答案。然后，元智能体评估它们的输出，以对齐跨模态预测并增强推理鲁棒性和答案一致性。实验结果表明，SVAgent通过在视频理解中模拟类人的故事线推理，实现了优越的性能和可解释性。

Abstract

Video question answering (VideoQA) is a challenging task that requires integrating spatial, temporal, and semantic information to capture the complex dynamics of video sequences. Although recent advances have introduced various approaches for video understanding, most existing methods still rely on locating relevant frames to answer questions rather than reasoning through the evolving storyline as humans do. Humans naturally interpret videos through coherent storylines, an ability that is crucial for making robust and contextually grounded predictions. To address this gap, we propose SVAgent, a storyline-guided cross-modal multi-agent framework for VideoQA. The storyline agent progressively constructs a narrative representation based on frames suggested by a refinement suggestion agent that analyzes historical failures. In addition, cross-modal decision agents independently predict answers from visual and textual modalities under the guidance of the evolving storyline. Their outputs are then evaluated by a meta-agent to align cross-modal predictions and enhance reasoning robustness and answer consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that SVAgent achieves superior performance and interpretability by emulating human-like storyline reasoning in video understanding.

item.title: Watch Before You Answer: Learning from Visually Grounded Post-Training
item.author: Yuxuan Zhang, EunJeong Hwang, Huaisong Zhang, Penghui Du, Yiming Jia, Dongfu Jiang, Xuan He, Shenhui Zhang, Ping Nie, Peter West, Kelsey R. Allen
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了一种名为VidGround的解决方案，通过仅使用实际视觉基础的问题进行后训练，显著提高了视频理解模型的性能，同时减少了数据使用量。

背景: 尽管多模态建模取得了快速进步，视频理解性能仍落后于基于文本的推理。研究发现，常见的长视频理解基准测试中，有40-60%的问题仅靠文本线索即可回答。

目的: 介绍VidGround作为一种简单有效的解决方案，旨在通过仅使用实际视觉基础的问题进行后训练，以提高VLM的视频理解性能。

方法: VidGround仅使用实际视觉基础的问题，不包含任何语言偏见，与基于强化学习的后训练算法结合使用。

主要发现: 使用VidGround相比使用完整数据集，性能提高了最多6.2点，同时仅使用了原始后训练数据的69.1%。简单的数据筛选算法优于几种更复杂的后训练技术，表明数据质量是提高VLM视频理解的主要瓶颈。

结论: 强调了为后训练数据和评估基准进行精心策划的重要性，这些基准必须真正需要视觉基础，以推动更强大的VLM的发展。

翻译: 研究提出了一种名为VidGround的解决方案，通过仅使用实际视觉基础的问题进行后训练，显著提高了视频理解模型的性能，同时减少了数据使用量。

Abstract

It is critical for vision-language models (VLMs) to comprehensively understand visual, temporal, and textual cues. However, despite rapid progress in multimodal modeling, video understanding performance still lags behind text-based reasoning. In this work, we find that progress is even worse than previously assumed: commonly reported long video understanding benchmarks contain 40-60% of questions that can be answered using text cues alone. Furthermore, we find that these issues are also pervasive in widely used post-training datasets, potentially undercutting the ability of post-training to improve VLM video understanding performance. Guided by this observation, we introduce VidGround as a simple yet effective solution: using only the actual visually grounded questions without any linguistic biases for post-training. When used in tandem with RL-based post-training algorithms, this simple technique improves performance by up to 6.2 points relative to using the full dataset, while using only 69.1% of the original post-training data. Moreover, we show that data curation with a simple post-training algorithm outperforms several more complex post-training techniques, highlighting that data quality is a major bottleneck for improving video understanding in VLMs. These results underscore the importance of curating post-training data and evaluation benchmarks that truly require visual grounding to advance the development of more capable VLMs. Project page: http://vidground.etuagi.com.

item.title: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry
item.author: Jarrid Rector-Brooks, Théophile Lambert, Marta Skreta, Daniel Roth, Yueming Long, Zi-Qi Li, Xi Zhang, Miruna Cretu, Francesca-Zhoufan Li, Tanvi Ganapathy, Emily Jin, Avishek Joey Bose, Jason Yang, Kirill Neklyudov, Yoshua Bengio, Alexander Tong, Frances H. Arnold, Cheng-Hao Liu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DISCO是一种多模态模型，能够仅基于反应中间体设计具有新颖活性位点几何结构的新颖血红素酶。

背景: 进化是酶多样性的引擎，但探索的化学范围有限；深度生成模型可以设计结合配体的新蛋白质，但尚未能在不预先指定催化残基的情况下创建酶。

目的: 介绍DISCO（DIffusion for Sequence-structure CO-design），一种多模态模型，用于围绕任意生物分子共同设计蛋白质序列和3D结构，以及跨两种模态优化目标的推理时缩放方法。

方法: DISCO仅以反应中间体为条件，设计具有新颖活性位点几何结构的不同血红素酶。

主要发现: 这些酶催化了自然界中未见过的卡宾转移反应，包括烯烃环丙基化、螺环丙基化、B-H和C(sp$^3$)-H插入反应，其活性超过工程酶。

结论: 通过提供可进化酶的可扩展途径，DISCO拓宽了基因编码转化范围的潜力。

翻译: 进化是酶多样性的引擎，但探索的化学范围有限；深度生成模型可以设计结合配体的新蛋白质，但尚未能在不预先指定催化残基的情况下创建酶。DISCO是一种多模态模型，能够仅基于反应中间体设计具有新颖活性位点几何结构的新颖血红素酶。这些酶催化了自然界中未见过的卡宾转移反应，包括烯烃环丙基化、螺环丙基化、B-H和C(sp$^3$)-H插入反应，其活性超过工程酶。通过提供可进化酶的可扩展途径，DISCO拓宽了基因编码转化范围的潜力。

Abstract

Evolution is an extraordinary engine for enzymatic diversity, yet the chemistry it has explored remains a narrow slice of what DNA can encode. Deep generative models can design new proteins that bind ligands, but none have created enzymes without pre-specifying catalytic residues. We introduce DISCO (DIffusion for Sequence-structure CO-design), a multimodal model that co-designs protein sequence and 3D structure around arbitrary biomolecules, as well as inference-time scaling methods that optimize objectives across both modalities. Conditioned solely on reactive intermediates, DISCO designs diverse heme enzymes with novel active-site geometries. These enzymes catalyze new-to-nature carbene-transfer reactions, including alkene cyclopropanation, spirocyclopropanation, B-H, and C(sp$^3$)-H insertions, with high activities exceeding those of engineered enzymes. Random mutagenesis of a selected design further confirmed that enzyme activity can be improved through directed evolution. By providing a scalable route to evolvable enzymes, DISCO broadens the potential scope of genetically encodable transformations. Code is available at https://github.com/DISCO-design/DISCO.

item.title: Exploring Speech Foundation Models for Speaker Diarization Across Lifespan
item.author: Anfeng Xu, Tiantian Feng, Shrikanth Narayanan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究跨生命周期语音模型在年龄相关领域偏移下的鲁棒性，提出跨年龄评估和训练方法。

背景: 语音基础模型在广泛语音应用中显示出强大的迁移能力，但在说话人分离任务中，其对年龄相关领域偏移的鲁棒性仍被探索不足。

目的: 在一个统一的端到端神经说话人分离框架（EEND-VC）内，对涉及儿童、成人和老年人的对话语音样本进行跨生命周期评估。

方法: 对比模型在零样本跨年龄推理、联合多年龄训练和特定年龄组适应三种设置下的表现。

主要发现: 在成人特定语音上训练的模型应用于儿童和老年成人对话数据时，性能出现显著下降；跨不同年龄组的联合多年龄训练能提高鲁棒性且不降低成人对话的说话人分离性能；目标年龄组适应能进一步提高性能，特别是使用Whisper编码器时。

结论: 针对年龄相关领域偏移的鲁棒性需要专门的训练和适应策略，联合多年龄训练和特定年龄组适应是有效的解决方案。

翻译: Speech foundation models have shown strong transferability across a wide range of speech applications. However, their robustness to age-related domain shift in speaker diarization remains underexplored. In this work, we present a cross-lifespan evaluation within a unified end-to-end neural diarization framework (EEND-VC), covering speech samples from conversations involving children, adults, and older adults. We compare models under zero-shot cross-age inference, joint multi-age training, and domain-specific adaptation. Results show substantial performance degradation when models trained on adult-specific speech are applied to child and older-adult conversational data. Moreover, joint multi-age training across different age groups improves robustness without reducing diarization performance in canonical adult conversations, while targeted age group adaptation yields further gains in diarization performance, particularly when using the Whisper encoder.

Abstract

Speech foundation models have shown strong transferability across a wide range of speech applications. However, their robustness to age-related domain shift in speaker diarization remains underexplored. In this work, we present a cross-lifespan evaluation within a unified end-to-end neural diarization framework (EEND-VC), covering speech samples from conversations involving children, adults, and older adults. We compare models under zero-shot cross-age inference, joint multi-age training, and domain-specific adaptation. Results show substantial performance degradation when models trained on adult-specific speech are applied to child and older-adult conversational data. Moreover, joint multi-age training across different age groups improves robustness without reducing diarization performance in canonical adult conversations, while targeted age group adaptation yields further gains in diarization performance, particularly when using the Whisper encoder.

item.title: Boxer: Robust Lifting of Open-World 2D Bounding Boxes to 3D
item.author: Daniel DeTone, Tianwei Shen, Fan Zhang, Lingni Ma, Julian Straub, Richard Newcombe, Jakob Engel
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为Boxer的算法，用于从二维开放词汇目标检测、姿态图像和可选深度信息中估计静态三维边界框。

背景: 三维目标定位是计算机视觉中的基本问题，但相比二维目标检测，三维目标定位探索较少且尚未解决，特别是在开放世界类别中。

目的: 解决从二维开放词汇目标检测和图像中估计静态三维边界框的研究挑战。

方法: 提出了Boxer算法，其核心是BoxerNet，这是一个基于Transformer的网络，用于将二维边界框提案提升到三维，随后进行多视图融合和几何过滤，以产生全局一致的去重三维边界框。该方法利用现有的二维边界框检测算法，并结合不确定性回归、深度补丁编码和大规模训练数据。

主要发现: BoxerNet在开放世界三维边界框提升方面优于最先进的基线，包括在无密集深度的情况下优于CuTR（0.532 vs. 0.010 mAP）以及在CA-1M上使用密集深度时优于CuTR（0.412 vs. 0.250 mAP）。

结论: Boxer算法通过利用现有的二维检测算法和Transformer网络，成功实现了从二维到三维的边界框估计，显著减少了昂贵的三维标注训练数据的需求，并在性能上超越了现有方法。

翻译: 在空间中检测和定位物体是计算机视觉中的基本问题。虽然在解决二维目标检测方面取得了很大进展，但三维目标定位探索较少且尚未解决，特别是在开放世界类别中。为了解决这一研究挑战，我们提出了Boxer，一种从二维开放词汇目标检测、姿态图像和可选深度（表示为稀疏点云或密集深度）估计静态三维边界框的算法。其核心是BoxerNet，这是一个基于Transformer的网络，用于将二维边界框提案提升到三维，随后进行多视图融合和几何过滤，以产生全局一致的去重三维边界框。Boxer利用现有二维边界框检测算法（如DETIC、OWLv2、SAM3）的力量来在二维中定位物体。这允许主要的BoxerNet模型专注于提升到三维而不是检测，最终减少了对昂贵标注的三维边界框训练数据的需求。扩展CuTR公式，我们结合了用于鲁棒回归的随机不确定性，支持稀疏深度输入的深度补丁编码，以及超过120万个唯一三维边界框的大规模训练。BoxerNet在开放世界三维边界框提升方面优于最先进的基线，包括在无密集深度的情况下在自中心设置中优于CuTR（0.532 vs. 0.010 mAP）以及在CA-1M上使用密集深度时优于CuTR（0.412 vs. 0.250 mAP）。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决开放世界中3D目标定位的难题，即如何从2D开放世界检测和图像（以及可选深度）中估计静态、全局的3D边界框。这个问题很重要，因为从被动观察转向主动交互需要理解度量3D世界，这对于目标导向的自主导航、灵巧操作、沉浸式AR和数字孪生至关重要。此外，该方案利用现有2D检测器，减少了对昂贵标注的3D数据的需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为3D边界框估计面临数据标注稀缺和碎片化的问题，因此将问题分解为两个阶段：首先利用现有的开放世界2D检测器进行2D定位，然后专注于3D几何提升。他们设计了一个基于Transformer的网络（BoxerNet），将2D边界框提升为3D。在借鉴现有工作方面，他们借鉴了现有的开放世界2D检测算法（如DETI C, OWLv2, SAM3）。在3D方面，他们借鉴了CuTR的架构，但进行了改进，增加了不确定性建模和更灵活的深度输入处理。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将 3D 目标检测问题分解为两个阶段：首先利用现有的开放世界 2D 检测器进行 2D 定位，然后专注于几何提升步骤，将 2D 框架映射到度量 3D 空间。整体实现流程包括：首先使用现成的 2D 检测器在图像中定位对象；接着通过 BoxerNet 网络，结合图像特征、可选的深度信息以及相机校准信息，将 2D 检测结果提升为 3D 边界框；最后利用多视图时间融合算法，合并并过滤逐帧的 3D 检测结果，生成全局一致的 3D 边界框。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了Boxer算法和BoxerNet网络，将现成的2D开放世界检测器输出的2D框提升到度量3D空间。相比之前工作，它通过引入随机不确定性头和中值深度补丁编码，支持稀疏深度输入并实现了大规模训练。与封闭集3D检测器不同，它专注于开放世界类别；与3D-MOOD等无法利用外部深度信息的方法相比，它支持条件化于深度传感器或稀疏点云。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了 Boxer，一种利用 Transformer 网络将 2D 开放世界检测框提升为 3D 框的方法，通过多视图融合和不确定性建模来处理不同类型的深度输入，从而减少对昂贵 3D 标注数据的依赖。

Abstract

Detecting and localizing objects in space is a fundamental computer vision problem. While much progress has been made to solve 2D object detection, 3D object localization is much less explored and far from solved, especially for open-world categories. To address this research challenge, we propose Boxer, an algorithm to estimate static 3D bounding boxes (3DBBs) from 2D open-vocabulary object detections, posed images and optional depth either represented as a sparse point cloud or dense depth. At its core is BoxerNet, a transformer-based network which lifts 2D bounding box (2DBB) proposals into 3D, followed by multi-view fusion and geometric filtering to produce globally consistent de-duplicated 3DBBs in metric world space. Boxer leverages the power of existing 2DBB detection algorithms (e.g. DETIC, OWLv2, SAM3) to localize objects in 2D. This allows the main BoxerNet model to focus on lifting to 3D rather than detecting, ultimately reducing the demand for costly annotated 3DBB training data. Extending the CuTR formulation, we incorporate an aleatoric uncertainty for robust regression, a median depth patch encoding to support sparse depth inputs, and large-scale training with over 1.2 million unique 3DBBs. BoxerNet outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in open-world 3DBB lifting, including CuTR in egocentric settings without dense depth (0.532 vs. 0.010 mAP) and on CA-1M with dense depth available (0.412 vs. 0.250 mAP).

item.title: Hierarchical Mesh Transformers with Topology-Guided Pretraining for Morphometric Analysis of Brain Structures
item.author: Yujian Xiong, Mohammad Farazi, Yanxi Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Xuanzhao Dong, Natasha Lepore, Yi Su, Raza Mushtaq, Stephen Foldes, Andrew Yang, Yalin Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种分层Transformer框架用于异构网格分析，通过空间自适应树分区处理体素和表面网格，并整合多种顶点级形态学描述符。

背景: 大规模非结构化体素和表面网格的表示学习在神经影像中面临重大挑战，特别是当模型需要包含多种顶点级形态学描述符（如皮层厚度、曲率、沟回深度和髓鞘含量）时。

目的: 设计一种分层Transformer框架，用于异构网格分析，能够在单一架构中同时处理体素和表面离散化，并高效进行多尺度注意力计算。

方法: 通过空间自适应树分区构建单纯复数，引入特征投影模块将可变长度的顶点级临床描述符映射到空间层次结构中，并使用自监督预训练方法进行掩码重建。

主要发现: 在ADNI数据集的阿尔茨海默病分类和淀粉样蛋白负荷预测任务中，以及在MELD数据集的局灶性皮质发育不良检测任务中，该方法均取得了最先进的结果。

结论: 该方法能够无缝整合不同的神经影像特征集，并具有可迁移性，适用于多样化的下游任务和网格模态。

翻译: Representation learning on large-scale unstructured volumetric and surface meshes poses significant challenges in neuroimaging, especially when models must incorporate diverse vertex-level morphometric descriptors, such as cortical thickness, curvature, sulcal depth, and myelin content, which carry subtle disease-related signals. Current approaches either ignore these clinically informative features or support only a single mesh topology, restricting their use across imaging pipelines. We introduce a hierarchical transformer framework designed for heterogeneous mesh analysis that operates on spatially adaptive tree partitions constructed from simplicial complexes of arbitrary order. This design accommodates both volumetric and surface discretizations within a single architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale attention without topology-specific modifications. A feature projection module maps variable-length per-vertex clinical descriptors into the spatial hierarchy, separating geometric structure from feature dimensionality and allowing seamless integration of different neuroimaging feature sets. Self-supervised pretraining via masked reconstruction of both coordinates and morphometric channels on large unlabeled cohorts yields a transferable encoder backbone applicable to diverse downstream tasks and mesh modalities. We validate our approach on Alzheimer's disease classification and amyloid burden prediction using volumetric brain meshes from ADNI, as well as focal cortical dysplasia detection on cortical surface meshes from the MELD dataset, achieving state-of-the-art results across all benchmarks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决在神经影像学中处理大型非结构化网格的挑战，特别是现有方法往往忽略临床特征或仅支持单一拓扑结构的问题。这个问题很重要，因为临床数据中包含皮层厚度、曲率等携带疾病诊断信息的形态测量特征，现有方法无法有效利用这些微妙信号，限制了其在临床成像管道中的应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法往往忽略临床特征或计算成本过高，因此借鉴了 OctFormer 的八叉树结构来降低计算复杂度，并借鉴了 MAE 自编码器范式进行预训练。他们设计了一个分层 Transformer 框架，利用八叉树处理异构网格，并通过特征投影模块将临床形态测量信息融入模型，从而实现高效的多尺度分析。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个统一的分层Transformer框架，通过空间自适应的八叉树结构来处理异构的脑部网格，并将临床形态测量特征与几何结构融合，从而在单一架构中高效地捕捉多尺度信息。整体实现流程包括：首先利用单纯形中心或顶点构建多层八叉树，并使用Z-order曲线进行分区；接着将顶点的临床特征与空间坐标拼接并投影到八叉树层级中；随后采用掩码自编码器（MAE）策略对大量无标签数据进行预训练，通过重建被掩码的坐标和特征来学习通用表示；最后将预训练得到的编码器作为骨干网络，适配不同的下游任务。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了一个支持异构网格的分层Transformer框架，其关键创新点包括：支持四面体和三角形网格的多单纯形感知八叉树构建；能够灵活集成不同神经影像特征的特征投影模块；以及针对通用医学网格的MAE自监督预训练策略。相比之前工作，该框架解决了现有方法忽略临床形态测量特征或仅支持单一网格拓扑的问题，实现了体素和表面离散化的统一架构，并利用共享拓扑结构进行预训练以提升泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种分层Transformer框架，通过构建八叉树支持异构网格分析，结合自监督预训练和特征投影模块，实现了对脑结构形态测量的高效分析，并在多项神经影像学任务中达到最佳效果。

Abstract

Representation learning on large-scale unstructured volumetric and surface meshes poses significant challenges in neuroimaging, especially when models must incorporate diverse vertex-level morphometric descriptors, such as cortical thickness, curvature, sulcal depth, and myelin content, which carry subtle disease-related signals. Current approaches either ignore these clinically informative features or support only a single mesh topology, restricting their use across imaging pipelines. We introduce a hierarchical transformer framework designed for heterogeneous mesh analysis that operates on spatially adaptive tree partitions constructed from simplicial complexes of arbitrary order. This design accommodates both volumetric and surface discretizations within a single architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale attention without topology-specific modifications. A feature projection module maps variable-length per-vertex clinical descriptors into the spatial hierarchy, separating geometric structure from feature dimensionality and allowing seamless integration of different neuroimaging feature sets. Self-supervised pretraining via masked reconstruction of both coordinates and morphometric channels on large unlabeled cohorts yields a transferable encoder backbone applicable to diverse downstream tasks and mesh modalities. We validate our approach on Alzheimer's disease classification and amyloid burden prediction using volumetric brain meshes from ADNI, as well as focal cortical dysplasia detection on cortical surface meshes from the MELD dataset, achieving state-of-the-art results across all benchmarks.

item.title: Protecting and Preserving Protest Dynamics for Responsible Analysis
item.author: Cohen Archbold, Usman Hassan, Nazmus Sakib, Sen-ching Cheung, Abdullah-Al-Zubaer Imran
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种负责任的计算框架，用于分析集体抗议动态，同时减少对个人隐私的风险。

背景: 抗议相关的社交媒体数据对于理解集体行动很有价值，但存在监控、镇压和个人隐私方面的风险。现有的AI系统可以识别个人、推断敏感属性并在跨平台交叉引用视觉信息，从而进行监控。现有的抗议分析自动化方法缺乏整合隐私风险评估、下游分析和公平性考虑的综合性管道。

目的: 为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种负责任的计算框架，用于分析集体抗议动态，同时减少对个人隐私的风险。

方法: 我们的框架使用条件图像合成技术，用经过良好标记的合成复制品替换敏感的抗议图像，从而在不直接暴露可识别个人的情况下分析集体模式。

主要发现: 我们的方法产生了逼真且多样化的合成图像，同时平衡了下游分析效用与隐私风险的降低。我们还评估了生成数据中的人口统计公平性，检查合成表征是否不成比例地影响特定子群体。

结论: 我们的方法采用了一种务实的、减轻伤害的方法，能够在承认残余风险的同时，实现社会敏感分析。

翻译: 抗议相关的社交媒体数据对于理解集体行动很有价值，但存在监控、镇压和个人隐私方面的风险。现有的AI系统可以识别个人、推断敏感属性并在跨平台交叉引用视觉信息，从而进行监控。现有的抗议分析自动化方法缺乏整合隐私风险评估、下游分析和公平性考虑的综合性管道。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种负责任的计算框架，用于分析集体抗议动态，同时减少对个人隐私的风险。我们的框架使用条件图像合成技术，用经过良好标记的合成复制品替换敏感的抗议图像，从而在不直接暴露可识别个人的情况下分析集体模式。我们的方法产生了逼真且多样化的合成图像，同时平衡了下游分析效用与隐私风险的降低。我们还评估了生成数据中的人口统计公平性，检查合成表征是否不成比例地影响特定子群体。我们的方法采用了一种务实的、减轻伤害的方法，能够在承认残余风险的同时，实现社会敏感分析。

Abstract

Protest-related social media data are valuable for understanding collective action but inherently high-risk due to concerns surrounding surveillance, repression, and individual privacy. Contemporary AI systems can identify individuals, infer sensitive attributes, and cross-reference visual information across platforms, enabling surveillance that poses risks to protesters and bystanders. In such contexts, large foundation models trained on protest imagery risk memorizing and disclosing sensitive information, leading to cross-platform identity leakage and retroactive participant identification. Existing approaches to automated protest analysis do not provide a holistic pipeline that integrates privacy risk assessment, downstream analysis, and fairness considerations. To address this gap, we propose a responsible computing framework for analyzing collective protest dynamics while reducing risks to individual privacy. Our framework replaces sensitive protest imagery with well-labeled synthetic reproductions using conditional image synthesis, enabling analysis of collective patterns without direct exposure of identifiable individuals. We demonstrate that our approach produces realistic and diverse synthetic imagery while balancing downstream analytical utility with reductions in privacy risk. We further assess demographic fairness in the generated data, examining whether synthetic representations disproportionately affect specific subgroups. Rather than offering absolute privacy guarantees, our method adopts a pragmatic, harm-mitigating approach that enables socially sensitive analysis while acknowledging residual risks.

item.title: Extending Tabular Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Time-Series Data Generation
item.author: Umang Dobhal, Christina Garcia, Sozo Inoue
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于扩散模型的时序数据生成方法，通过引入轻量级时间适配器和上下文感知嵌入模块，实现了对时间序列数据的隐私保护增强。

背景: 现有的表格去噪扩散概率模型虽然能从异构表格数据集中生成高质量合成数据，但假设样本之间相互独立，限制了其在时间序列领域的应用，因为时间序列中时间依赖性至关重要。

目的: 为了解决现有模型在时间序列生成中的局限性，研究旨在提出一种时间序列扩展的TabDDPM方法，通过引入序列感知机制来显式建模时间依赖性。

方法: 研究将传感器数据重新构建为窗口序列，并利用轻量级时间适配器和上下文感知嵌入模块，通过时间步嵌入、条件活动标签以及观测/缺失掩码来显式建模时间上下文。

主要发现: 与基线和插值技术相比，该方法在双元组转移矩阵和自相关分析中显示出增强的时间真实感、多样性和连贯性。在WISDM加速度计数据集上，生成的合成时间序列与真实世界传感器模式相似，分类性能与真实数据相当。

结论: 配备时间推理能力的扩散模型为序列数据合成提供了有效且可适应的解决方案，特别是在少数类表示和保持与真实分布的统计对齐方面具有优势。

翻译: Diffusion models are increasingly being utilised to create synthetic tabular and time series data for privacy-preserving augmentation. Tabular Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (TabDDPM) generate high-quality synthetic data from heterogeneous tabular datasets but assume independence between samples, limiting their applicability to time-series domains where temporal dependencies are critical. To address this, we propose a temporal extension of TabDDPM, introducing sequence awareness through the use of lightweight temporal adapters and context-aware embedding modules. By reformulating sensor data into windowed sequences and explicitly modeling temporal context via timestep embeddings, conditional activity labels, and observed/missing masks, our approach enables the generation of temporally coherent synthetic sequences. Compared to baseline and interpolation techniques, validation using bigram transition matrices and autocorrelation analysis shows enhanced temporal realism, diversity, and coherence. On the WISDM accelerometer dataset, the suggested system produces synthetic time-series that closely resemble real world sensor patterns and achieves comparable classification performance (macro F1-score 0.64, accuracy 0.71). This is especially advantageous for minority class representation and preserving statistical alignment with real distributions. These developments demonstrate that diffusion based models provide effective and adaptable solutions for sequential data synthesis when they are equipped for temporal reasoning. Future work will explore scaling to longer sequences and integrating stronger temporal architectures.

Abstract

Diffusion models are increasingly being utilised to create synthetic tabular and time series data for privacy-preserving augmentation. Tabular Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (TabDDPM) generate high-quality synthetic data from heterogeneous tabular datasets but assume independence between samples, limiting their applicability to time-series domains where temporal dependencies are critical. To address this, we propose a temporal extension of TabDDPM, introducing sequence awareness through the use of lightweight temporal adapters and context-aware embedding modules. By reformulating sensor data into windowed sequences and explicitly modeling temporal context via timestep embeddings, conditional activity labels, and observed/missing masks, our approach enables the generation of temporally coherent synthetic sequences. Compared to baseline and interpolation techniques, validation using bigram transition matrices and autocorrelation analysis shows enhanced temporal realism, diversity, and coherence. On the WISDM accelerometer dataset, the suggested system produces synthetic time-series that closely resemble real world sensor patterns and achieves comparable classification performance (macro F1-score 0.64, accuracy 0.71). This is especially advantageous for minority class representation and preserving statistical alignment with real distributions. These developments demonstrate that diffusion based models provide effective and adaptable solutions for sequential data synthesis when they are equipped for temporal reasoning. Future work will explore scaling to longer sequences and integrating stronger temporal architectures.

item.title: Cross-Machine Anomaly Detection Leveraging Pre-trained Time-series Model
item.author: Yangmeng Li, Kei Sano, Toshihiro Kitao, Ryoji Anzaki, Yukiya Saitoh, Hironori Moki, Dragan Djurdjanovic
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种跨机器时间序列异常检测框架，旨在解决名义上相同但行为不同的机器在执行相同过程时利用传感器数据检测异常的问题。

背景: 实现具有韧性和高质量制造的可靠数据驱动异常检测方法，需要解决名义上相同且执行相同过程的个体机器之间的行为差异问题。

目的: 提出一种跨机器时间序列异常检测框架，以解决利用来自不同个体机器的传感器数据检测机器异常的问题。

方法: 该框架集成了领域不变特征提取器和无监督异常检测模块。利用预训练的基础模型 MOMENT，特征提取器使用随机森林分类器将嵌入特征解耦为机器相关和条件相关的特征，后者作为对个体机器差异不变的表示。这些精炼的特征使下游异常检测器能够有效地泛化到未见的目标机器。

主要发现: 在从三台执行名义上相同操作的不同机器收集的工业数据集上进行的实验表明，所提出的方法优于基于原始信号和 MOMENT 嵌入特征的基线，证实了其在增强跨机器泛化方面的有效性。

结论: 该方法在提升跨机器泛化能力方面是有效的。

翻译: Achieving resilient and high-quality manufacturing requires reliable data-driven anomaly detection methods that are capable of addressing differences in behaviors among different individual machines which are nominally the same and are executing the same processes. To address the problem of detecting anomalies in a machine using sensory data gathered from different individual machines executing the same procedure, this paper proposes a cross-machine time-series anomaly detection framework that integrates a domain-invariant feature extractor with an unsupervised anomaly detection module. Leveraging the pre-trained foundation model MOMENT, the extractor employs Random Forest Classifiers to disentangle embeddings into machine-related and condition-related features, with the latter serving as representations which are invariant to differences between individual machines. These refined features enable the downstream anomaly detectors to generalize effectively to unseen target machines. Experiments on an industrial dataset collected from three different machines performing nominally the same operation demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms both the raw-signal-based and MOMENT-embedding feature baselines, confirming its effectiveness in enhancing cross-machine generalization.

Abstract

Achieving resilient and high-quality manufacturing requires reliable data-driven anomaly detection methods that are capable of addressing differences in behaviors among different individual machines which are nominally the same and are executing the same processes. To address the problem of detecting anomalies in a machine using sensory data gathered from different individual machines executing the same procedure, this paper proposes a cross-machine time-series anomaly detection framework that integrates a domain-invariant feature extractor with an unsupervised anomaly detection module. Leveraging the pre-trained foundation model MOMENT, the extractor employs Random Forest Classifiers to disentangle embeddings into machine-related and condition-related features, with the latter serving as representations which are invariant to differences between individual machines. These refined features enable the downstream anomaly detectors to generalize effectively to unseen target machines. Experiments on an industrial dataset collected from three different machines performing nominally the same operation demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms both the raw-signal-based and MOMENT-embedding feature baselines, confirming its effectiveness in enhancing cross-machine generalization.

item.title: TFRBench: A Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Forecasting Systems
item.author: Md Atik Ahamed, Mihir Parmar, Palash Goyal, Yiwen Song, Long T. Le, Qiang Cheng, Chun-Liang Li, Hamid Palangi, Jinsung Yoon, Tomas Pfister
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TFRBench是首个用于评估预测系统推理能力的基准测试，通过多代理框架和迭代验证循环生成基于数值的推理轨迹，并在十个数据集上验证了其因果有效性和对LLM预测准确性的提升作用。

背景: 传统时间序列预测评估仅关注数值准确性，将基础模型视为黑盒，缺乏对跨通道依赖、趋势和外部事件分析等推理能力的评估。

目的: 设计首个评估预测系统推理能力的基准测试，提供一种评估预测系统生成的推理（特别是跨通道依赖、趋势和外部事件分析）的协议。

方法: 提出一种系统化的多代理框架，利用迭代验证循环来合成基于数值的推理轨迹。

主要发现: 1. 该推理具有因果有效性且对评估有用；2. 使用生成的轨迹提示LLM比直接数值预测显著提高预测准确率（平均约40.2%提升至56.6%）；3. 现成的LLM在推理和数值预测方面持续挣扎，经常无法捕捉特定领域的动态。

结论: TFRBench为时间序列预测中的可解释性、基于推理的评估建立了新标准。

翻译: 我们介绍了TFRBench，这是首个旨在评估预测系统推理能力的基准测试。传统上，时间序列预测仅基于数值准确性进行评估，将基础模型视为“黑盒”。与现有基准不同，TFRBench提供了评估预测系统生成的推理的协议——具体来说是它们对跨通道依赖、趋势和外部事件的分析。为此，我们提出了一种系统化的多代理框架，利用迭代验证循环来合成基于数值的推理轨迹。跨越五个领域的十个数据集，我们的评估证实这种推理在因果上是有效的；对评估有用；并且用我们的生成轨迹提示LLM比直接数值预测显著提高预测准确率（例如，平均约40.2%到56.6%），验证了我们推理的质量。相反，基准测试实验表明，现成的LLM在推理（较低的LLM-as-a-Judge分数）和数值预测方面持续挣扎，经常无法捕捉特定领域的动态。因此，TFRBench为时间序列预测中的可解释性、基于推理的评估建立了新标准。我们的基准测试可在以下网址获取：https://tfrbench.github.io

Abstract

We introduce TFRBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of forecasting systems. Traditionally, time-series forecasting has been evaluated solely on numerical accuracy, treating foundation models as ``black boxes.'' Unlike existing benchmarks, TFRBench provides a protocol for evaluating the reasoning generated by forecasting systems--specifically their analysis of cross-channel dependencies, trends, and external events. To enable this, we propose a systematic multi-agent framework that utilizes an iterative verification loop to synthesize numerically grounded reasoning traces. Spanning ten datasets across five domains, our evaluation confirms that this reasoning is causally effective; useful for evaluation; and prompting LLMs with our generated traces significantly improves forecasting accuracy compared to direct numerical prediction (e.g., avg. $\sim40.2\%\to56.6\%)$, validating the quality of our reasoning. Conversely, benchmarking experiments reveal that off-the-shelf LLMs consistently struggle with both reasoning (lower LLM-as-a-Judge scores) and numerical forecasting, frequently failing to capture domain-specific dynamics. TFRBench thus establishes a new standard for interpretable, reasoning-based evaluation in time-series forecasting. Our benchmark is available at: https://tfrbench.github.io

item.title: ICR-Drive: Instruction Counterfactual Robustness for End-to-End Language-Driven Autonomous Driving
item.author: Kaiser Hamid, Can Cui, Nade Liang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了ICR-Drive框架，用于评估端到端语言条件自动驾驶中指令的反事实鲁棒性。该框架通过生成四种扰动类型的指令变体（改写、歧义、噪声、误导），在CARLA仿真器中复现相同路线和配置，以隔离语言指令对性能的影响。实验表明，微小的指令变化会导致显著性能下降和不同的失败模式，揭示了部署具身基础模型在安全关键驾驶中的可靠性差距。

背景: 现有的VLA模型在封闭回路仿真中能够执行自然语言导航指令，但标准评估通常假设指令是精确且格式良好的。在实际部署中，指令的措辞和具体性各不相同，可能遗漏关键限定词，甚至包含误导性、权威框架的文本，导致指令级鲁棒性评估不足。

目的: 引入ICR-Drive框架，旨在诊断端到端语言条件自动驾驶中指令反事实鲁棒性的问题。

方法: ICR-Drive生成四种扰动家族的受控指令变体：改写、歧义、噪声和误导。误导变体与导航目标冲突并试图覆盖意图。在匹配的仿真器配置和种子下复现相同的CARLA路线，以隔离性能变化归因于指令语言。鲁棒性使用标准CARLA排行榜指标和相对于基准指令的每家族性能下降来量化。

主要发现: 在LMDrive和BEVDriver上的实验表明，微小的指令变化可以诱导显著的性能下降和不同的失败模式。

结论: 这揭示了部署具身基础模型在安全关键驾驶中的可靠性差距。

翻译: Recent progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models has enabled language-conditioned driving agents to execute natural-language navigation commands in closed-loop simulation, yet standard evaluations largely assume instructions are precise and well-formed. In deployment, instructions vary in phrasing and specificity, may omit critical qualifiers, and can occasionally include misleading, authority-framed text, leaving instruction-level robustness under-measured. We introduce ICR-Drive, a diagnostic framework for instruction counterfactual robustness in end-to-end language-conditioned autonomous driving. ICR-Drive generates controlled instruction variants spanning four perturbation families: Paraphrase, Ambiguity, Noise, and Misleading, where Misleading variants conflict with the navigation goal and attempt to override intent. We replay identical CARLA routes under matched simulator configurations and seeds to isolate performance changes attributable to instruction language. Robustness is quantified using standard CARLA Leaderboard metrics and per-family performance degradation relative to the baseline instruction. Experiments on LMDrive and BEVDriver show that minor instruction changes can induce substantial performance drops and distinct failure modes, revealing a reliability gap for deploying embodied foundation models in safety-critical driving.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有语言驱动自动驾驶模型假设指令精确，但实际指令多变（如措辞、歧义、噪声或误导），导致系统鲁棒性未得到充分测量的问题。这个问题很重要，因为微小的指令变化能引发显著的性能下降和不同失败模式，暴露了在安全关键场景中部署具身基础模型的可靠性差距，且现有评估未将指令措辞作为核心测试维度。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到微小的指令措辞变化会导致显著性能下降，因此设计 ICR-Drive 来专门测试指令的鲁棒性。他们通过固定环境（路线和种子），仅改变指令文本，生成四种受控的指令变体（同义转述、歧义、噪声和误导）来评估模型。该方法借鉴了 NLP 领域的提示鲁棒性研究以及驾驶领域的压力测试框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是评估端到端语言驱动自动驾驶系统对指令变化的鲁棒性，将语言视为受分布偏移影响的输入通道。实现流程包括：首先固定驾驶环境和模拟器参数；其次利用模板生成四种指令变体；最后在相同环境下运行模型，对比不同指令下的驾驶性能指标，以量化指令变化对驾驶行为的影响。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了ICR-Drive框架，主要创新点包括：1. 提出了一种配对路线控制评估协议，通过重放相同路线来隔离指令语言对性能的影响；2. 构建了包含改写、歧义、噪声和误导四种变体的反事实指令分类法；3. 实证了微小的指令变化会导致显著性能下降。相比之前工作，它将指令措辞作为第一类评估轴，不仅测试了目标保持的变体，还专门测试了与目标冲突的误导性指令，填补了指令稳健性评估的空白。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了ICR-Drive框架，通过生成改写、歧义、噪声和误导四种指令变体，评估了端到端语言驱动自动驾驶模型对指令变化的鲁棒性，揭示了其脆弱性。

Abstract

Recent progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models has enabled language-conditioned driving agents to execute natural-language navigation commands in closed-loop simulation, yet standard evaluations largely assume instructions are precise and well-formed. In deployment, instructions vary in phrasing and specificity, may omit critical qualifiers, and can occasionally include misleading, authority-framed text, leaving instruction-level robustness under-measured. We introduce ICR-Drive, a diagnostic framework for instruction counterfactual robustness in end-to-end language-conditioned autonomous driving. ICR-Drive generates controlled instruction variants spanning four perturbation families: Paraphrase, Ambiguity, Noise, and Misleading, where Misleading variants conflict with the navigation goal and attempt to override intent. We replay identical CARLA routes under matched simulator configurations and seeds to isolate performance changes attributable to instruction language. Robustness is quantified using standard CARLA Leaderboard metrics and per-family performance degradation relative to the baseline instruction. Experiments on LMDrive and BEVDriver show that minor instruction changes can induce substantial performance drops and distinct failure modes, revealing a reliability gap for deploying embodied foundation models in safety-critical driving.

item.title: Weather-Conditioned Branch Routing for Robust LiDAR-Radar 3D Object Detection
item.author: Hongsheng Li, Lingfeng Zhang, Zexian Yang, Liang Li, Rong Yin, Xiaoshuai Hao, Wenbo Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于条件分支路由的鲁棒3D目标检测框架，通过动态调整传感器模态偏好来应对恶劣天气下的挑战。

背景: 恶劣天气下3D目标检测面临挑战，现有LiDAR-4D雷达融合方法主要依赖固定或弱自适应管道，无法根据环境条件动态调整模态偏好。

目的: 将多模态感知重新表述为天气条件下的分支路由问题，以实现更灵活的模态选择和融合。

方法: 框架维护三个并行3D特征流：纯LiDAR分支、纯4D雷达分支和条件门控融合分支。通过从视觉和语义提示中提取条件令牌，轻量级路由器动态预测样本特定权重以软聚合表示。引入天气监督学习策略，包含辅助分类和多样性正则化以防止分支坍塌。

主要发现: 在K-Radar基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，提供了关于模态偏好的明确且高度可解释的见解，透明地揭示了自适应路由如何在各种恶劣天气场景中鲁棒地转移对LiDAR和4D雷达的依赖。

结论: 该方法在恶劣天气条件下表现出色，通过动态路由机制有效提升了检测的鲁棒性和可解释性。

翻译: 在恶劣天气下进行鲁棒3D目标检测由于不同传感器的可靠性不同而极具挑战性。虽然现有的LiDAR-4D雷达融合方法提高了鲁棒性，但它们主要依赖固定或弱自适应管道，无法根据环境条件的变化动态调整模态偏好。为了填补这一差距，我们将多模态感知重新表述为天气条件下的分支路由问题。我们的框架明确维护三个并行的3D特征流：纯LiDAR分支、纯4D雷达分支和条件门控融合分支。在从视觉和语义提示中提取的条件令牌的指导下，轻量级路由器动态预测样本特定权重以软聚合这些表示。此外，为了防止分支坍塌，我们引入了一种天气监督学习策略，包含辅助分类和多样性正则化，以强制执行不同且条件依赖的路由行为。在K-Radar基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。此外，它提供了关于模态偏好的明确且高度可解释的见解，透明地揭示了自适应路由如何在各种恶劣天气场景中鲁棒地转移对LiDAR和4D雷达的依赖。源代码将发布。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有激光雷达与雷达融合方法依赖固定管道，无法根据天气变化动态调整模态偏好的问题。这很重要，因为在恶劣天气下不同传感器的可靠性差异显著，且现有方法缺乏可解释性，难以分析模型在特定条件下的表现，这对自动驾驶的安全部署至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有方法多依赖固定管道，无法随环境变化动态调整模态偏好，因此思考将融合问题重新表述为“条件感知的分支路由”。设计上，他们构建了三个并行分支（纯LiDAR、纯雷达、融合），并用路由器根据场景上下文预测权重来组合。在借鉴方面，作者参考了现有的LiDAR-4D雷达融合方法（如InterFusion等），指出其框架在概念上不同于这些固定融合方法，且与统一融合架构互补，同时使用了CLIP文本编码器提供语义天气先验。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将恶劣天气下的多模态感知重新定义为“天气条件下的分支路由”问题。它不依赖单一固定的融合方式，而是明确维护三个并行分支（纯LiDAR、纯雷达、融合特征），并通过一个轻量级路由器根据当前天气动态调整这三个分支的权重，以选择最可靠的表示。整体实现流程包括：首先，通过融合视觉特征和语义文本提示生成一个条件令牌，并利用传感器上下文进行细化；接着，LiDAR和雷达数据分别输入三个并行分支进行处理；然后，路由器根据条件令牌预测三个分支的权重，加权聚合它们的BEV特征作为最终输出；最后，通过天气监督学习策略（辅助分类和多样性正则化）来优化路由过程，防止模型过度依赖某一分支。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了天气条件分支路由框架，显式维护三个并行分支（纯LiDAR、纯雷达和融合特征），并通过轻量级路由器根据环境条件动态分配权重。此外，引入了天气监督路由学习策略，利用辅助分类和多样性正则化防止模型过度依赖单一分支。相比现有方法，本文不再依赖固定或弱自适应管道，而是显式建模了不同天气条件下对特定表示分支的偏好，实现了更灵活和可解释的模态选择。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种天气条件下的分支路由框架，通过动态调整LiDAR、雷达和融合特征的权重，并结合天气监督学习策略，实现了在恶劣天气下更鲁棒和可解释的3D目标检测。

Abstract

Robust 3D object detection in adverse weather is highly challenging due to the varying reliability of different sensors. While existing LiDAR-4D radar fusion methods improve robustness, they predominantly rely on fixed or weakly adaptive pipelines, failing to dy-namically adjust modality preferences as environmental conditions change. To bridge this gap, we reformulate multi-modal perception as a weather-conditioned branch routing problem. Instead of computing a single fused output, our framework explicitly maintains three parallel 3D feature streams: a pure LiDAR branch, a pure 4D radar branch, and a condition-gated fusion branch. Guided by a condition token extracted from visual and semantic prompts, a lightweight router dynamically predicts sample-specific weights to softly aggregate these representations. Furthermore, to prevent branch collapse, we introduce a weather-supervised learning strategy with auxiliary classification and diversity regularization to enforce distinct, condition-dependent routing behaviors. Extensive experiments on the K-Radar benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, it provides explicit and highly interpretable insights into modality preferences, transparently revealing how adaptive routing robustly shifts reliance between LiDAR and 4D radar across diverse adverse-weather scenarios. The source code with be released.

item.title: Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation Meets SAM3
item.author: Yi-Jen Tsai, Yen-Yu Lin, Chien-Yao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于 Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) 的无需训练的少样本语义分割方法，通过简单的空间拼接策略实现了最先进的性能。

背景: 现有的少样本语义分割方法严重依赖大量的 episodic 训练来学习可迁移表示，这不仅计算成本高昂，而且对分布偏移敏感。

目的: 从现代视觉基础模型的角度重新审视少样本语义分割，探索 SAM3 作为无需训练解决方案的潜力。

方法: 利用 SAM3 的 Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) 能力，采用简单的空间拼接策略，将支持图像和查询图像放置在共享画布上进行分割，无需微调或架构更改。

主要发现: 在 PASCAL-5i 和 COCO-20i 数据集上取得了最先进的性能；发现负提示词在少样本设置中往往适得其反，会削弱目标表示并导致预测崩溃。

结论: 简单的空间公式化可以产生强大的跨图像推理能力，同时也揭示了当前基础模型在处理冲突提示信号方面的局限性。

翻译: Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (FSS) 专注于从仅有的少量标注示例中分割新对象类别。大多数现有方法依赖于大量的 episodic 训练来学习可迁移表示，这既计算成本高昂又对分布偏移敏感。在这项工作中，我们从现代视觉基础模型的角度重新审视 FSS，并探索 Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) 作为无需训练解决方案的潜力。通过重新利用其 Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) 能力，我们采用了一种简单的空间拼接策略，将支持图像和查询图像放置在共享画布上，允许完全冻结的 SAM3 在不进行任何微调或架构更改的情况下执行分割。在 PASCAL-5i 和 COCO-20i 上的实验表明，这种最小设计已经达到了最先进的性能，超过了许多经过大量工程优化的方法。除了经验上的收益外，我们发现负提示词在少样本设置中往往是有害的，它们经常削弱目标表示并导致预测崩溃，尽管它们旨在抑制干扰项。这些发现表明，简单的空间公式化可以产生强大的跨图像推理能力，同时也突显了当前基础模型在处理冲突提示信号方面的局限性。代码位于：https://github.com/WongKinYiu/FSS-SAM3

Abstract

Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (FSS) focuses on segmenting novel object categories from only a handful of annotated examples. Most existing approaches rely on extensive episodic training to learn transferable representations, which is both computationally demanding and sensitive to distribution shifts. In this work, we revisit FSS from the perspective of modern vision foundation models and explore the potential of Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) as a training-free solution. By repurposing its Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) capability, we adopt a simple spatial concatenation strategy that places support and query images into a shared canvas, allowing a fully frozen SAM3 to perform segmentation without any fine-tuning or architectural changes. Experiments on PASCAL-$5^i$ and COCO-$20^i$ show that this minimal design already achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming many heavily engineered methods. Beyond empirical gains, we uncover that negative prompts can be counterproductive in few-shot settings, where they often weaken target representations and lead to prediction collapse despite their intended role in suppressing distractors. These findings suggest that strong cross-image reasoning can emerge from simple spatial formulations, while also highlighting limitations in how current foundation models handle conflicting prompt signals. Code at: https://github.com/WongKinYiu/FSS-SAM3

item.title: Learned Elevation Models as a Lightweight Alternative to LiDAR for Radio Environment Map Estimation
item.author: Ljupcho Milosheski, Fedja Močnik, Mihael Mohorčič, Carolina Fortuna
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种无需3D数据即可进行无线电环境图REM估计的两阶段框架，利用卫星RGB图像和天线参数预测REM。

背景: 下一代无线系统如6G工作在更高频段，信号传播对建筑物和植被等环境因素高度敏感，因此准确的无线电环境图REM估计对网络规划至关重要。

目的: 消除推理时对昂贵且快速过时的3D环境数据（如LiDAR点云）的需求，提供一种实用的、可扩展的无线电环境建模替代方案。

方法: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段利用学习到的估计器直接从卫星RGB图像预测高度图；第二阶段将高度图与天线参数输入REM估计器。

主要发现: 在现有的基于CNN的REM估计架构中，该方法相比仅使用图像的基线，RMSE提高了最多7.8%，且在相同输入特征空间下运行，推理时无需3D数据。

结论: 该方法提供了一种实用的替代方案，能够在不依赖3D数据的情况下实现高效的无线电环境建模。

翻译: 下一代无线系统如6G工作在更高频段，使得信号传播对建筑物和植被等环境因素高度敏感。因此，准确的无线电环境图REM估计对于有效的网络规划和运行变得越来越重要。现有的方法，从射线追踪模拟器到深度学习生成模型，都取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但需要详细的3D环境数据，如LiDAR衍生的点云，这些数据获取成本高，每平方公里大小达数GB，并且在动态环境中很快过时。我们提出了一种两阶段框架，消除了推理时对3D数据的需求：在第一阶段，一个学习到的估计器直接从卫星RGB图像预测高度图，这些高度图随后与天线参数一起输入到第二阶段的REM估计器中。在现有的基于CNN的REM估计架构中，提出的方法相比仅使用图像的基线，RMSE提高了最多7.8%，同时在相同的输入特征空间上运行，推理时不需要3D数据，为可扩展的无线电环境建模提供了实用的替代方案。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决的是在下一代无线网络（如6G）中，准确估计无线电环境图（REM）时，对昂贵且难以获取的3D环境数据（如LiDAR点云）的依赖问题。这个问题很重要，因为6G等高频信号对环境（如建筑物和植被）高度敏感，需要精确的网络规划；而现有的LiDAR数据获取成本高、数据量大且难以实时更新，限制了其在动态环境下的应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法依赖昂贵且难以获取的3D数据（如LiDAR点云）的问题，设计了一个两阶段框架来替代3D数据。第一阶段利用深度学习模型从卫星RGB图像预测高度图，第二阶段将预测的高度图与天线参数结合来估计无线电环境图。作者借鉴了Im2Ele模型[11]进行高度估计，并参考了Jaensch等人[6]的REM估计器架构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用深度学习模型，将昂贵的激光雷达三维数据替换为从卫星图像中学习得到的地面高程模型。整体实现流程分为两个阶段：第一阶段通过训练模型从卫星图像预测环境的高度信息；第二阶段将预测的高度图与图像和天线参数结合，输入到无线电环境图估计器中，从而实现无需三维数据的无线电环境建模。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 本文提出了一个两阶段框架，第一阶段利用深度学习从卫星RGB图像预测环境高度图，第二阶段结合高度图和天线参数估算无线电环境图。相比之前仅使用图像的端到端方法，本文将问题解耦为两个独立阶段，假设独立优化能带来更好的专业化性能；此外，推理时无需昂贵的3D数据，仅需RGB图像，更轻量且可动态更新。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，利用深度学习模型从卫星图像预测高度图，从而在推理时无需昂贵的3D数据即可更准确地预测无线电环境图。

Abstract

Next-generation wireless systems such as 6G operate at higher frequency bands, making signal propagation highly sensitive to environmental factors such as buildings and vege- tation. Accurate Radio Environment Map (REM) estimation is therefore increasingly important for effective network planning and operation. Existing methods, from ray-tracing simulators to deep learning generative models, achieve promising results but require detailed 3D environment data such as LiDAR-derived point clouds, which are costly to acquire, several gigabytes per km2 in size, and quickly outdated in dynamic environments. We propose a two-stage framework that eliminates the need for 3D data at inference time: in the first stage, a learned estimator predicts elevation maps directly from satellite RGB imagery, which are then fed alongside antenna parameters into the REM estimator in the second stage. Across existing CNN- based REM estimation architectures, the proposed approach improves RMSE by up to 7.8% over image-only baselines, while operating on the same input feature space and requiring no 3D data during inference, offering a practical alternative for scalable radio environment modelling.

item.title: Prior-guided Fusion of Multimodal Features for Change Detection from Optical-SAR Images
item.author: Xuanguang Liu, Lei Ding, Yujie Li, Chenguang Dai, Zhenchao Zhang, Mengmeng Li, Ziyi Yang, Yifan Sun, Yongqi Sun, Hanyun Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 多模态变化检测（MMCD）旨在识别多模态遥感数据中的变化区域，在土地利用监测、灾害评估和城市可持续发展方面具有重要应用价值。

背景: 现有文献中的MMCD方法在跨模态交互和利用模态特定特征方面存在局限性，导致对细粒度变化信息的建模不足，阻碍了多模态数据中语义变化的精确检测。

目的: 提出STSF-Net框架，用于光学和SAR图像之间的多模态变化检测。

方法: STSF-Net联合建模模态特定特征和时空共同特征以增强变化表示；利用模态特定特征捕获真实的语义变化信号，并将时空共同特征嵌入以抑制由成像机制差异引起的伪变化；引入基于预训练基础模型语义先验的自适应特征融合策略；引入Delta-SN6数据集。

主要发现: 在Delta-SN6、BRIGHT和Wuhan-Het数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在平均交并比（mIoU）上分别比最先进（SOTA）方法高出3.21%、1.08%和1.32%。

结论: 该方法优于现有最先进方法，代码和数据集将在指定链接发布。

翻译: 多模态变化检测（MMCD）旨在识别多模态遥感（RS）数据中的变化区域，在土地利用监测、灾害评估和城市可持续发展方面展现出显著的应用价值。然而，文献中的MMCD方法在跨模态交互和利用模态特定特征方面表现出局限性。这导致对细粒度变化信息的建模不足，从而阻碍了多模态数据中语义变化的精确检测。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了STSF-Net，这是一个专为光学和SAR图像之间的MMCD设计的框架。STSF-Net联合建模模态特定特征和时空共同特征以增强变化表示。具体而言，利用模态特定特征来捕获真实的语义变化信号，同时将时空共同特征嵌入以抑制由成像机制差异引起的伪变化。此外，我们引入了一种光学和SAR特征融合策略，该策略根据从预训练基础模型获得的语义先验自适应地调整特征重要性，从而实现多模态信息的语义引导自适应融合。此外，我们引入了Delta-SN6数据集，这是第一个公开可访问的多类MMCD基准，由超高分辨率（VHR）全极化SAR和光学图像组成。在Delta-SN6、BRIGHT和Wuhan-Het数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在mIoU上分别比最先进（SOTA）方法高出3.21%、1.08%和1.32%。相关代码和Delta-SN6数据集将在：https://github.com/liuxuanguang/STSF-Net 发布。

Abstract

Multimodal change detection (MMCD) identifies changed areas in multimodal remote sensing (RS) data, demonstrating significant application value in land use monitoring, disaster assessment, and urban sustainable development. However, literature MMCD approaches exhibit limitations in cross-modal interaction and exploiting modality-specific characteristics. This leads to insufficient modeling of fine-grained change information, thus hindering the precise detection of semantic changes in multimodal data. To address the above problems, we propose STSF-Net, a framework designed for MMCD between optical and SAR images. STSF-Net jointly models modality-specific and spatio-temporal common features to enhance change representations. Specifically, modality-specific features are exploited to capture genuine semantic change signals, while spatio-temporal common features are embedded to suppress pseudo-changes caused by differences in imaging mechanisms. Furthermore, we introduce an optical and SAR feature fusion strategy that adaptively adjusts feature importance based on semantic priors obtained from pre-trained foundational models, enabling semantic-guided adaptive fusion of multi-modal information. In addition, we introduce the Delta-SN6 dataset, the first openly-accessible multiclass MMCD benchmark consisting of very-high-resolution (VHR) fully polarimetric SAR and optical images. Experimental results on Delta-SN6, BRIGHT, and Wuhan-Het datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 3.21%, 1.08%, and 1.32% in mIoU, respectively. The associated code and Delta-SN6 dataset will be released at: https://github.com/liuxuanguang/STSF-Net.

item.title: Evaluation of Randomization through Style Transfer for Enhanced Domain Generalization
item.author: Dustin Eisenhardt, Timothy Schaumlöffel, Alperen Kantarci, Gemma Roig
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为StyleMixDG的轻量级、模型无关的数据增强方法，用于解决计算机视觉模型在合成数据到真实数据迁移时的泛化问题。

背景: 计算机视觉模型在真实世界环境中往往泛化能力较差，特别是在使用合成数据训练时存在Sim2Real差距。尽管风格迁移作为域泛化策略日益流行，但关于风格池多样性、纹理复杂度和风格来源选择这三个关键设计维度的文献中存在未解决的矛盾。

目的: 通过系统的实证研究，分离并评估这三个关键因素对驾驶场景理解的影响，以解决先前工作中的不一致性。

方法: 提出了一种名为StyleMixDG的轻量级、模型无关的数据增强配方，不需要架构修改或额外损失。该方法基于实证研究得出的设计原则。

主要发现: 1. 扩展风格池比使用少量风格进行重复增强能带来更大的增益；2. 当风格池足够大时，纹理复杂度没有显著影响；3. 多样化的艺术风格优于领域对齐的替代方案。

结论: 在GTAV到{BDD100k, Cityscapes, Mapillary Vistas}基准测试中，StyleMixDG相比强基线表现出一致的改进，证实了实证识别的设计原则转化为实际收益。

翻译: 计算机视觉中的深度学习模型在真实世界设置中部署时往往泛化能力较差，特别是在使用合成数据训练时，由于众所周知的Sim2Real差距。尽管风格迁移作为域泛化的数据增强策略日益流行，但文献中关于三个关键设计轴存在未解决的矛盾：风格池的多样性、纹理复杂度的作用以及风格来源的选择。我们提出了一项系统的实证研究，分离并评估了这些因素对驾驶场景理解的影响，解决了先前工作中的不一致性。我们的发现表明，（i）扩展风格池比使用少量风格进行重复增强能带来更大的增益，（ii）当池足够大时，纹理复杂度没有显著影响，（iii）多样化的艺术风格优于领域对齐的替代方案。受这些见解的指导，我们提出了StyleMixDG，一种轻量级、模型无关的数据增强配方，不需要架构修改或额外损失。在GTAV到{BDD100k, Cityscapes, Mapillary Vistas}基准测试中，StyleMixDG相比强基线表现出一致的改进，证实了实证识别的设计原则转化为实际收益。代码将在GitHub上发布。

Abstract

Deep learning models for computer vision often suffer from poor generalization when deployed in real-world settings, especially when trained on synthetic data due to the well-known Sim2Real gap. Despite the growing popularity of style transfer as a data augmentation strategy for domain generalization, the literature contains unresolved contradictions regarding three key design axes: the diversity of the style pool, the role of texture complexity, and the choice of style source. We present a systematic empirical study that isolates and evaluates each of these factors for driving scene understanding, resolving inconsistencies in prior work. Our findings show that (i) expanding the style pool yields larger gains than repeated augmentation with few styles, (ii) texture complexity has no significant effect when the pool is sufficiently large, and (iii) diverse artistic styles outperform domain-aligned alternatives. Guided by these insights, we derive StyleMixDG (Style-Mixing for Domain Generalization), a lightweight, model-agnostic augmentation recipe that requires no architectural modifications or additional losses. Evaluated on the GTAV $\rightarrow$ {BDD100k, Cityscapes, Mapillary Vistas} benchmark, StyleMixDG demonstrates consistent improvements over strong baselines, confirming that the empirically identified design principles translate into practical gains. The code will be released on GitHub.

item.title: Semantic-Topological Graph Reasoning for Language-Guided Pulmonary Screening
item.author: Chenyu Xue, Yiran Liu, Mian Zhou, Jionglong Su, Zhixiang Lu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于语言引导的肺筛查的语义拓扑图推理框架。

背景: 现有的多模态和基础模型在处理临床报告的语义模糊性以及在低对比度扫描中区分复杂解剖结构重叠方面存在困难。此外，在有限的医学数据集上完全微调这些大型架构往往会导致严重的过拟合。

目的: 为了解决这些挑战，提出了一种新的语义拓扑图推理框架。

方法: 该方法将大型语言模型与视觉基础模型的零样本描绘相结合。具体包括引入文本到视觉意图蒸馏模块以提取精确的诊断指导，将掩码选择制定为动态图推理问题，并引入选择性非对称微调策略以更新不到1%的参数。

主要发现: 在LIDC-IDRI和LNDb数据集上进行严格的5折交叉验证表明，该框架建立了新的最先进水平。在LIDC-IDRI上实现了81.5%的Dice相似系数，比LISA等领先的基于LLM的工具高出5%以上。SAFT策略作为强大的正则化器，产生了卓越的跨折稳定性。

结论: 该框架在肺筛查中表现优异，SAFT策略为稳健、上下文感知的临床部署铺平了道路。

翻译: 摘要：由自由文本临床指令驱动的医学图像分割是计算机辅助诊断的一个关键前沿。然而，现有的多模态和基础模型在处理临床报告的语义模糊性以及在低对比度扫描中区分复杂解剖结构重叠方面存在困难。此外，在有限的医学数据集上完全微调这些大型架构往往会导致严重的过拟合。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于语言引导的肺筛查的新型语义拓扑图推理框架。我们的方法优雅地协同了大型语言模型的推理能力与视觉基础模型的零样本描绘。具体而言，我们引入了文本到视觉意图蒸馏模块以提取精确的诊断指导。为了解决解剖学模糊性，我们将掩码选择制定为动态图推理问题，其中候选病灶被建模为节点，边捕获空间和语义亲和性。为了确保部署的可行性，我们引入了选择性非对称微调策略，该策略更新不到1%的参数。在LIDC-IDRI和LNDb数据集上进行严格的5折交叉验证表明，我们的框架建立了新的最先进水平。值得注意的是，它在LIDC-IDRI上实现了81.5%的Dice相似系数，比LISA等领先的基于LLM的工具高出5%以上。至关重要的是，我们的SAFT策略充当强大的正则化器，产生了卓越的跨折稳定性，并为稳健、上下文感知的临床部署铺平了道路。

Abstract

Medical image segmentation driven by free-text clinical instructions is a critical frontier in computer-aided diagnosis. However, existing multimodal and foundation models struggle with the semantic ambiguity of clinical reports and fail to disambiguate complex anatomical overlaps in low-contrast scans. Furthermore, fully fine-tuning these massive architectures on limited medical datasets invariably leads to severe overfitting. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Semantic-Topological Graph Reasoning (STGR) framework for language-guided pulmonary screening. Our approach elegantly synergizes the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLaMA-3-V) with the zero-shot delineation of vision foundation models (MedSAM). Specifically, we introduce a Text-to-Vision Intent Distillation (TVID) module to extract precise diagnostic guidance. To resolve anatomical ambiguity, we formulate mask selection as a dynamic graph reasoning problem, where candidate lesions are modeled as nodes and edges capture spatial and semantic affinities. To ensure deployment feasibility, we introduce a Selective Asymmetric Fine-Tuning (SAFT) strategy that updates less than 1% of the parameters. Rigorous 5-fold cross-validation on the LIDC-IDRI and LNDb datasets demonstrates that our framework establishes a new state-of-the-art. Notably, it achieves an 81.5% Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) on LIDC-IDRI, outperforming leading LLM-based tools like LISA by over 5%. Crucially, our SAFT strategy acts as a powerful regularizer, yielding exceptional cross-fold stability (0.6% DSC variance) and paving the way for robust, context-aware clinical deployment.

item.title: A Unified Foundation Model for All-in-One Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Image Restoration and Fusion with Language Prompting
item.author: Yongchuan Cui, Peng Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LLaRS是一个统一的大规模遥感低级视觉基础模型，通过多模态和多任务方法解决遥感图像恢复和融合问题。

背景: 遥感图像面临云层、雾霾、噪声、分辨率限制和传感器异质性等挑战，现有方法通常针对每种退化类型训练单独的模型。

目的: 提出LLaRS，即首个统一的多模态和多任务遥感低级视觉基础模型。

方法: LLaRS采用Sinkhorn-Knopp最优传输对齐异质波段，通过三个互补的混合专家层路由特征，并通过步级动态权重调整稳定联合训练。

主要发现: LLaRS在实验中持续超越七个竞争模型，参数高效微调实验显示其在未见数据上具有强大的迁移能力和适应效率。

结论: LLaRS作为首个统一基础模型，在遥感图像恢复和增强任务中表现出色，且具备高效的迁移和适应能力。

翻译: Remote sensing imagery suffers from clouds, haze, noise, resolution limits, and sensor heterogeneity. Existing restoration and fusion approaches train separate models per degradation type. In this work, we present Language-conditioned Large-scale Remote Sensing restoration model (LLaRS), the first unified foundation model for multi-modal and multi-task remote sensing low-level vision. LLaRS employs Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport to align heterogeneous bands into semantically matched slots, routes features through three complementary mixture-of-experts layers (convolutional experts for spatial patterns, channel-mixing experts for spectral fidelity, and attention experts with low-rank adapters for global context), and stabilizes joint training via step-level dynamic weight adjustment. To train LLaRS, we construct LLaRS1M, a million-scale multi-task dataset spanning eleven restoration and enhancement tasks, integrating real paired observations and controlled synthetic degradations with diverse natural language prompts. Experiments show LLaRS consistently outperforms seven competitive models, and parameter-efficient finetuning experiments demonstrate strong transfer capability and adaptation efficiency on unseen data. Repo: https://github.com/yc-cui/LLaRS

Abstract

Remote sensing imagery suffers from clouds, haze, noise, resolution limits, and sensor heterogeneity. Existing restoration and fusion approaches train separate models per degradation type. In this work, we present Language-conditioned Large-scale Remote Sensing restoration model (LLaRS), the first unified foundation model for multi-modal and multi-task remote sensing low-level vision. LLaRS employs Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport to align heterogeneous bands into semantically matched slots, routes features through three complementary mixture-of-experts layers (convolutional experts for spatial patterns, channel-mixing experts for spectral fidelity, and attention experts with low-rank adapters for global context), and stabilizes joint training via step-level dynamic weight adjustment. To train LLaRS, we construct LLaRS1M, a million-scale multi-task dataset spanning eleven restoration and enhancement tasks, integrating real paired observations and controlled synthetic degradations with diverse natural language prompts. Experiments show LLaRS consistently outperforms seven competitive models, and parameter-efficient finetuning experiments demonstrate strong transfer capability and adaptation efficiency on unseen data. Repo: https://github.com/yc-cui/LLaRS

item.title: Graph-Based Chain-of-Thought Pruning for Reducing Redundant Reflections in Reasoning LLMs
item.author: Hongyuan Yuan, Xinran He, Run Shao, Bolei He, Xianwei Xue, Mengke Chen, Qiutong Pan, Haiwei Wang, Haifeng Li
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于图的思维链优化框架，通过双重剪枝策略和三阶段管道来减少冗余推理，在保持准确率的同时显著降低了推理令牌数量。

背景: 通过强化学习扩展思维链已被广泛用于增强大语言模型的推理能力，但由于奖励信号的稀疏性，容易导致过度思考等不良思维模式。

目的: 解决思维链中的冗余问题，特别是无效的反思行为，包括不加区分的反思和重复的反思。

方法: 将线性思维链转换为具有显式依赖边的有向无环图，设计分支级剪枝和深度级剪枝策略，并通过监督微调、直接偏好优化和带长度惩罚的组策略优化三阶段管道进行蒸馏。

主要发现: 该方法将平均推理令牌减少了42%，同时保持了或提高了准确率。

结论: 基于图的CoT优化框架能有效减少冗余推理内容，提升推理效率。

翻译: 通过强化学习扩展思维链已被广泛用于增强大语言模型的推理能力。然而，由于奖励信号的稀疏性，它也可能诱导不良的思维模式，如过度思考，即生成多余的中间推理内容。在这项工作中，我们认为这种冗余的主要来源是低效的反思，它通常表现为两种有问题的模式：不加区分的反思，即模型在整个推理过程中进行广泛、低影响的检查；以及重复的反思，即它反复重新验证已经确立的结论。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种基于图的CoT优化框架。具体来说，我们将每个线性CoT转换为具有显式依赖边的有向无环图，并设计了一种双重剪枝策略：分支级剪枝移除了贡献微弱的反思分支，而深度级剪枝消除了后期的重新验证。我们通过三阶段管道蒸馏了这种行为：(1) SFT在修剪后的简洁轨迹上初始化策略，(2) DPO偏好正确但不冗余的轨迹，(3) GRPO与长度惩罚联合优化答案的正确性和效率。实验表明，我们的方法将平均推理令牌减少了42%，同时保持了或提高了准确率。

Abstract

Extending CoT through RL has been widely used to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, due to the sparsity of reward signals, it can also induce undesirable thinking patterns such as overthinking, i.e., generating redundant intermediate reasoning content. In this work, we argue that a major source of such redundancy is inefficient reflection, which often manifests in two problematic patterns: Indiscriminate Reflection, where the model performs broad, low-impact checks throughout reasoning, and Repetitive Reflection, where it repeatedly re-verifies an already established conclusion. To address this, we introduce a graph-based CoT optimization framework. Specifically, we convert each linear CoT into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with explicit dependency edges, and design a dual pruning strategy: branch-level pruning removes weakly contributing reflection branches, while depth-level pruning eliminates late-stage re-verification. We distill this behavior via a three-stage pipeline: (1) SFT to initialize the policy on pruned concise traces, (2) DPO to prefer correct but less redundant trajectories, and (3) GRPO with length penalty to jointly optimize answer correctness and efficiency. Experiments show that our approach reduces the average reasoning tokens by 42\% while maintaining or improving accuracy.

item.title: Analogical Reasoning as a Doctor: A Foundation Model for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Diagnosis
item.author: Peixi Peng, Housheng Xie, Yanling Wei, Guangcong Ruan, Xiaoyang Zou, Qian Cao, Yongjian Nian, Guoyan Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RATNet是一种基于类比推理的胃肠道内窥镜成像基础模型，通过循环预训练策略从异构专家注释中获取和转移知识，支持微调、线性探测和零样本转移，并在多种场景下优于现有模型。

背景: 胃肠道疾病给全球健康带来日益沉重的负担，内窥镜是早期诊断的主要工具，但常规内窥镜图像解读仍存在漏诊和效率有限的问题。

目的: 解决现有AI辅助诊断模型因医疗数据有限、领域偏移和异构注释而缺乏泛化性、适应性、鲁棒性和可扩展性的挑战。

方法: 开发RATNet，一种基于类比推理的胃肠道内窥镜成像基础模型。其架构包括编码器、相关性知识获取与转移（RAT）模块、投影器和多任务头。通过循环预训练策略从五个胃肠道内窥镜数据集中的异构专家注释中获取和转移知识。

主要发现: RATNet在六种场景下优于现有基础模型，包括常见胃肠道疾病诊断、罕见疾病的少样本学习、对新医疗场所的零样本转移、长尾疾病分布下的鲁棒性、对新型疾病的适应以及通过联邦学习进行的隐私保护部署。

结论: RATNet的优势源于类比推理机制，该机制将图像派生的后验知识与学习到的先验知识库相匹配，并转移相对知识以指导诊断，提高了泛化能力和抗偏差性。RATNet是开放且具有成本效益的，支持异构注释的自动集成，无需手动标签统一，降低了数据获取成本，使其成为资源有限环境中智能胃肠道诊断的实用基础。

翻译: 胃肠道疾病给全球健康带来日益沉重的负担，内窥镜是早期诊断的主要工具。然而，常规内窥镜图像解读仍存在漏诊和效率有限的问题。尽管AI辅助诊断显示出前景，但由于医疗数据有限、领域偏移和异构注释，现有模型往往缺乏泛化性、适应性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。为了解决这些挑战，我们开发了RATNet，一种基于类比推理的胃肠道内窥镜成像基础模型。RATNet通过循环预训练策略从五个胃肠道内窥镜数据集中的异构专家注释中获取和转移知识。其架构包括编码器、相关性知识获取与转移（RAT）模块、投影器和多任务头，并支持微调、线性探测和零样本转移。评估显示，RATNet在六种场景下优于现有基础模型，包括常见胃肠道疾病诊断、罕见疾病的少样本学习、对新医疗场所的零样本转移、长尾疾病分布下的鲁棒性、对新型疾病的适应以及通过联邦学习进行的隐私保护部署。其优势源于类比推理机制，该机制将图像派生的后验知识与学习到的先验知识库相匹配，并转移相对知识以指导诊断，提高了泛化能力和抗偏差性。RATNet是开放且具有成本效益的，支持异构注释的自动集成，无需手动标签统一，降低了数据获取成本，使其成为资源有限环境中智能胃肠道诊断的实用基础。

Abstract

Gastrointestinal diseases impose a growing global health burden, and endoscopy is a primary tool for early diagnosis. However, routine endoscopic image interpretation still suffers from missed lesions and limited efficiency. Although AI-assisted diagnosis has shown promise, existing models often lack generalizability, adaptability, robustness, and scalability because of limited medical data, domain shift, and heterogeneous annotations. To address these challenges, we develop RATNet, a foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy imaging based on analogical reasoning. RATNet acquires and transfers knowledge from heterogeneous expert annotations across five gastrointestinal endoscopy datasets through a cyclic pre-training strategy. Its architecture consists of an encoder, a relevance-knowledge acquisition and transfer (RAT) module, a projector, and a multi-task head, and supports fine-tuning, linear probing, and zero-shot transfer. Evaluations show that RATNet outperforms existing foundation models, including GastroNet and GastroVision, across six scenarios: diagnosis of common gastrointestinal diseases, few-shot learning for rare diseases, zero-shot transfer to new medical sites, robustness under long-tailed disease distributions, adaptation to novel diseases, and privacy-preserving deployment via federated learning. Its advantage comes from an analogical reasoning mechanism that matches image-derived posterior knowledge to a learned prior knowledge base and transfers relative knowledge to guide diagnosis, improving generalization and resistance to bias. RATNet is open and cost-effective, supports automatic integration of heterogeneous annotations without manual label unification, and reduces data acquisition costs, making it a practical foundation for intelligent gastrointestinal diagnosis, especially in resource-limited settings.

item.title: Improving Semantic Proximity in Information Retrieval through Cross-Lingual Alignment
item.author: Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Jungseob Lee, Hyeonseok Moon, Heuiseok Lim
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对多语言文档检索中的跨语言对齐问题进行研究，提出了一种新的训练策略以提升模型性能并缓解英语偏向问题。

背景: 随着多语言文档的普及，跨语言信息检索（CLIR）成为重要研究领域。传统CLIR任务通常假设文档和查询语言不同，且文档由单一连贯语言组成。

目的: 指出在传统设置下，跨语言对齐能力可能无法得到充分评估；引入各种场景和指标来量化分析跨语言对齐性能；提出一种新的训练策略以改善跨语言检索性能。

方法: 提出了一种新的训练策略，旨在增强跨语言对齐能力；仅使用包含2.8k样本的小数据集进行训练。

主要发现: 在包含英语文档和其他语言文档的文档池中，大多数多语言检索器倾向于优先选择与查询无关的英语文档，而非与查询语言相同的文档；该方法显著提高了跨语言检索性能，同时缓解了英语偏向问题。

结论: 该方法显著增强了大多数多语言嵌入模型的跨语言对齐能力。

翻译: 随着多语言文档的可及性和利用率的增加，跨语言信息检索（CLIR）已成为一个重要的研究领域。传统上，CLIR任务是在文档语言与查询语言不同的设置下进行的，并且通常，文档由单一连贯的语言组成。在本文中，我们强调在这种设置下，跨语言对齐能力可能无法得到充分评估。具体来说，我们观察到，在英语文档与其他语言文档共存的文档池中，大多数多语言检索器倾向于优先选择与查询无关的英语文档，而不是与查询语言相同的文档。为了严格分析和量化这一现象，我们引入了各种场景和指标，旨在评估多语言检索模型的跨语言对齐性能。此外，为了在这些具有挑战性的条件下改善跨语言性能，我们提出了一种新的训练策略，旨在增强跨语言对齐。仅使用包含2.8k样本的小数据集，我们的方法显著提高了跨语言检索性能，同时缓解了英语偏向问题。广泛的分析表明，该方法显著增强了大多数多语言嵌入模型的跨语言对齐能力。

Abstract

With the increasing accessibility and utilization of multilingual documents, Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval (CLIR) has emerged as an important research area. Conventionally, CLIR tasks have been conducted under settings where the language of documents differs from that of queries, and typically, the documents are composed in a single coherent language. In this paper, we highlight that in such a setting, the cross-lingual alignment capability may not be evaluated adequately. Specifically, we observe that, in a document pool where English documents coexist with another language, most multilingual retrievers tend to prioritize unrelated English documents over the related document written in the same language as the query. To rigorously analyze and quantify this phenomenon, we introduce various scenarios and metrics designed to evaluate the cross-lingual alignment performance of multilingual retrieval models. Furthermore, to improve cross-lingual performance under these challenging conditions, we propose a novel training strategy aimed at enhancing cross-lingual alignment. Using only a small dataset consisting of 2.8k samples, our method significantly improves the cross-lingual retrieval performance while simultaneously mitigating the English inclination problem. Extensive analyses demonstrate that the proposed method substantially enhances the cross-lingual alignment capabilities of most multilingual embedding models.

item.title: Let Geometry GUIDE: Layer-wise Unrolling of Geometric Priors in Multimodal LLMs
item.author: Chongyu Wang, Ting Huang, Chunyu Sun, Xinyu Ning, Di Wang, Hao Tang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为GUIDE的渐进式几何先验注入框架，旨在解决多模态大语言模型在处理真实世界视觉流时物理空间感知能力有限的问题。

背景: 现有的几何感知多模态大语言模型主要受限于单层深度提取和输入级融合的范式，这种扁平化融合导致局部几何细节丢失并在早期层造成语义不匹配。

目的: 打破这一瓶颈，通过在多模态大语言模型的早期层中引入几何先验，引导模型逐步学习从二维到三维的过渡过程，从而提升物理空间感知能力。

方法: GUIDE框架在几何编码器内执行多级采样，全面捕获从局部边缘到全局拓扑的多粒度特征；随后将这些多级几何先验与多模态大语言模型的早期层逐步对齐和融合；此外，引入了上下文感知门控机制，使模型能够根据当前语义获取必要空间线索，并有效抑制冗余几何噪声。

主要发现: 在多种复杂的空间推理和感知任务中，GUIDE显著优于现有基线模型。

结论: 该研究建立了一种将三维几何先验集成到大模型中的新范式，证明了该方法在提升模型物理空间感知方面的有效性。
